admiral-thumpback.name: Admiral Thumpback
admiral-thumpback.description: Admiral Thumpback is a sailor counterpart of Thumpback exclusive to Skylanders: Lost Islands.
admiral-thumpback.biography: Admiral Thumpback is a sailor counterpart of Thumpback exclusive to Skylanders: Lost Islands. Unlike the other Lost Islands-exclusive Skylanders, he cannot be owned from the Wishing Well. Instead, you can only get him by paying 2,000 Kudos.
admiral-thumpback.catchphrase: Admiral Thumpback has sailed into the kingdom!
admiral-thumpback.personality: Not much is known about Admiral Thumpback's personality, other than his role as a sailor counterpart to Thumpback.
admiral-thumpback.gameplay: Admiral Thumpback is the only Lost Islands-exclusive Skylander to be a Giant and the only one that must be bought by Kudos. Unlike other characters in the game, he cannot be obtained through the Wishing Well and is instead always available for purchase for 2,000 Kudos.
trivia: Admiral Thumpback is the only Lost Islands-exclusive Skylander to be a Giant.
He is also the first Lost Islands-exclusive version of a non-Core Skylander.
He is also the first ingame variant Giant exclusive to the tablet games (the second being Obsidian Hot Head).
He is the second Lost Islands Exclusive Skylander to be released on September (the other being Autumn Stump Smash).
He is also the first Lost Islands exclusive Skylander who was not available in the Wishing Well.
He is the only Lost Islands-exclusive Skylander to be bought by Kudos.
He is also the only Lost Islands-exclusive Skylander who is always available.

air-strike.name: Air Strike
air-strike.description: Air Strike and Birdie are an Air elemental falconer Sensei and his Blue Zephyr Falcon friend in Skylanders: Imaginators that teach Imaginators of the Brawler Class. They are available in the Gryphon Park Observatory Adventure Pack.
air-strike.biography: Before he began training Brawlers, Air Strike trained birds – especially the rare Blue Zephyr Falcons. They were once one of Skylands' most endangered species, but Air Strike taught them how to defend themselves from predators... and not fly into windows. Birds would come from all over Skylands to learn his proven techniques. But despite their new defensive skills, the Blue Zephyr Falcons continued to be hunted by a band of evil trolls, who liked to use their eggs in blue-bacon omelets. So it was time for Air Strike to strike back! He journeyed to the peak of the Zephyr Mountain and single-handedly took down the trolls, rescuing the stolen eggs. After returning them to their mother, one of the eggs hatched, revealing a very energetic Falcon that would not leave his side. Air Strike named him 'Birdie' – and together, they now use their skills to train Skylanders, despite Master Eon's crippling fear of falcons.
air-strike.personality: Air Strike is a dedicated trainer of birds who rescued the rare Blue Zephyr Falcons from extinction. His companion Birdie is a very energetic Falcon that refuses to leave his side.
air-strike.gameplay: These are the starting and maximum Statistics for this Skylander in the Skylanders games. Warning: These stats are not used in any of the Skylander games. They are only listed for completeness reasons. Basic Abilities: These abilities are available from the start of the game. Skylanders can buy new abilities from Persephone/Power Pods. Primal Elements: Gain the power of wind and lightning! What Goes Up: Improve the Falcon's attacks!

abilities.name: Bird Brawl
abilities.description: Press Attack 1 to attack with or without the Falcon!

abilities.name: Bird Dive Bomb
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 to send out or call the Falcon down for a dive bomb attack - all with a trail of explosive feathers!

abilities.name: Spinning Bird Fist!
abilities.description: Press Attack 3 to attack with a special strike! The Falcon sucks enemies into the attack!

abilities.name: Storm Front Finish
abilities.description: Add wind to the final hit of your Attack 1 four-combo attack!

abilities.name: We Have Liftoff
abilities.description: Sending up the Falcon will also launch nearby enemies and reflect enemy projectiles!

abilities.name: Side of Eggs
abilities.description: Sending off the Falcon leaves an explosive egg you can hit - which contains a random prize!

abilities.name: Secret Falling Palm Strike!
abilities.description: Hold Attack 2 to launch yourself into the sky to do the Secret Falling Palm Strike technique!

abilities.name: Fight and Flight
abilities.description: The ultimate Sensei attack! Hold Special Attack to perform your Sky-Chi power! Press Attack 1 for an additional swift dash forward!

abilities.name: Eye of the Storm
abilities.description: While the Falcon is out, you gain a windy aura that damages anything you touch and reduces damage you take!

abilities.name: Gale Force
abilities.description: Your feather placements do more damage when they touch enemies and when they explode!

abilities.name: One with the Elements
abilities.description: Every Bird Brawl attack shoots out wind power!

abilities.name: Free Range Eggs
abilities.description: The Side of Eggs upgrade now explodes into more valuable prizes!

abilities.name: Smooth Landing
abilities.description: While the Falcon is out, press Attack 1 thrice, HOLD Attack 1 to coordinate a devastating landing attack!

abilities.name: Chance of Showers
abilities.description: Egg bombs fall from the sky while the Falcon is out.

trivia: Air Strike and Birdie are one of the few playable duos in Skylanders (other duos are Fright Rider, Eye-Brawl, Eye-Small, Rocky Roll, Shrednaught and Bad Juju with Juju Junior).
Birdie's bladed wings and feet resemble Blades' weaponry. He also caws with the same sound as Whiskers.
The duo has a peculiar magic moment: Air Strike enters the game facing the wrong way before correcting himself, and Birdie enters it offscreen before flying to his friend.
In prototype versions of their figure, Birdie was a bright cyan.
When first placed on the portal, Air Strike grants Imaginators backpack wings that resemble Birdie's, and knuckles fashioned after metal wings when his Shrine is opened.

Air Strike is the only Sensei who doesn't use any kind of weapon in combat, as other Brawlers have wrist blades (King Pen), gloves with metal knuckles (Crash Bandicoot) or large natural gauntlets (Grave Clobber).
When Air Strike is driving a vehicle, Birdie is absent.
Air Strike is the first Air Skylander to have the word 'Air' in his name.
Air Strike shares many physical similarities with Tread Head, including proportions, stature and facial features.
Air Strike's catchphrase ('Fight and Flight!') is a reference to the survival instinct, the fight or flight response, that prepares one for either fighting or fleeing a life or death situation.

Air Strike was the most difficult and expensive figure to make within the game's available budget, as there were so many parts on them that Toys For Bob struggled to get the cost down. As a result, Air Strike's colors had to be tweaked and parts of his and Birdie's armor had to be removed.

ambush.name: Ambush
ambush.description: Ambush is a Life Knight Sensei in Skylanders: Imaginators.
ambush.biography: There were many mysterious things in the Mystical Bamboo Forest, but none more so than Ambush. The forest was considered to be one of Skylands' greatest natural wonders, and no outsider, good or bad, was ever permitted to trespass. But that didn't stop Kaos' mother! After deciding that the ancient trees would make an exquisite display in her Royal Courtyard, she commanded her army of chainsaw-wielding trolls to chop down the entire forest. This angered Ambush, the mystical tree-knight, who saw the atrocity and swore revenge! Wielding his mythic sword, he fought off the trolls and forced Kaos' mother into hiding. When Master Eon heard the story, he knew that the mysterious sword master would make the ideal Sensei, and promised to 'go green' himself if Ambush would join the Skylander team. Ambush now trains other Knights - and those who are not environmentally conscious cower in fear!
ambush.personality: Ambush is direct with his words, and is protective of nature.
ambush.gameplay: Ambush can hack and slash his enemies with his mythic sword. The sword can cause grass marks to grow on enemies, which will let it deal extra damage on later hits. Ambush can dash across the battlefield while causing bamboo shoots to erupt from behind him, finishing his dash with a shockwave of energy. He can even summon a field of sharp bamboo trees to erupt around him. His Sky-Chi allows him to focus his energy into a target symbol and mark enemies with it. After they are marked, Ambush dashes across the battlefield at lightning speed while slashing his enemies to deal great damage.

abilities.name: Whack Attack
abilities.description: Press Attack 1 to use your sword.

abilities.name: Splintering Punch
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 to knock your enemies back and then fly into them.

abilities.name: Meditative Strike
abilities.description: Briefly stand still to charge up your sword attack.

abilities.name: Arboreal Upheaval
abilities.description: Press Attack 3 to summon bamboo trees that throw enemies into the air.

abilities.name: Leaf on the Wind
abilities.description: Hold Attack 1 to perform a flying spin slash.

abilities.name: Mark of the Angry Tree
abilities.description: Whack Attacks leave a mark on your enemies. On the third mark, that enemy will take extra damage. Marks weaken over time.

abilities.name: Nature's Revenge
abilities.description: Hold Attack 3 to execute a stronger Arboreal Upheaval attack.

abilities.name: Foreseen Victory
abilities.description: The ultimate Sensei attack! Hold Special Attack to perform your Sky-Chi Power! Use Left Stick to select your targets.

abilities.name: Pruning the Hedges
abilities.description: Using Meditative Strikes when you get Marked Enemy bonus damage does even more damage.

abilities.name: Slam Trunk
abilities.description: During Whack Attack combos, hold Attack 2 to smash enemies with a giant bamboo tree.

abilities.name: Spinning Bamboo Piledriver
abilities.description: During Whack Attack combos, hold Attack 3 to pile drive a bamboo tree on top of enemies.

abilities.name: Wood Knocks You!
abilities.description: Press Attack 3, then Attack 1 to send out large bamboo projectiles in all directions.

abilities.name: The Sharing Tree
abilities.description: Splintering Punch now creates an area of effect giving Marks to your enemies.

abilities.name: A New Leaf on Life
abilities.description: Arboreal Upheaval creates a zone of pain around you. Marks absorbed by Arboreal Upheaval increase this zone's duration.

trivia: His catchphrase is a pun on the saying 'Read 'em and weep!', a common brag used by poker players when revealing their hand.

His upgrade path, 'The Master Splinterer', could be a reference to the character Master Splinter from the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles franchise, while his other upgrade path, 'Go Go Forest Ranger', could be a reference to the phrase 'Go Go Power Rangers!' from the Power Rangers franchise.

His name means a long-established military tactic in which combatants take advantage of concealment and the element of surprise to attack unsuspecting enemy combatants from concealed positions, such as among dense underbrush or behind hilltops.
Even though Ambush is a Tree Knight, his armour is similar in design to a ninja's outfit.
Incidentally, his armour looks similar to Tuff Luck's armour, but with the addition of a fundoshi, a traditional Japanese loincloth.
He shares the same voice actor as Hood Sickle, J. B. Blanc.
He's the (only non-villain) Life Sensei to not be part of an Adventure pack.
His Sky-Chi voice line 'By the power of Sky-Chi!' could be a reference to the phrase 'By the power of Grayskull!' from the Masters of the Universe franchise.

astroblast.name: Astroblast
astroblast.description: Astroblast is the Light SuperCharger in Skylanders: SuperChargers. His signature vehicle is the Sun Runner. He has a Legendary counterpart named Legendary Astroblast.
astroblast.biography: While on a secret mission in troll territory, Astroblast crash landed on a remote island where he stumbled upon an ancient relic not seen in thousands of years - a legendary Rift Engine. These magical machines were believed to have the power to travel through the portals between Skylands and other worlds! Shortly after the discovery, an army of trolls appeared on a nearby canyon ridge and quickly charged toward Astroblast. Knowing that the Rift Engine would be very dangerous in the wrong hands, he pulled out his pulse laser and prepared to defend the relic against the incoming horde. After an epic shootout, the trolls fled in defeat. When Astroblast then brought the relic back to his ship, the Sun Runner, it surged with power and a hologram of Master Eon appeared. Eon thanked him for saving the Rift Engine and beckoned him to return it to the Skylander Academy. Astroblast accepted the invitation and was made a Skylander shortly thereafter.
astroblast.personality: Astroblast is a curious type who won't back down from a fight. He's always prepared to protect people and relics from danger.
astroblast.gameplay: Astroblast can use his special class EZ 9000 laser gun to shoot enemies; the laser blasts bounce off walls and objects. He can also throw out space rocks; when he shoots a space rock, it floats up in the air and fires lasers in a wide area below it before crumbling to pieces. His third attack, gained through the Starsault upgrade, allows Astroblast to kick back enemies that get too close directly in front of him, and he can do this many times with very little delay between each kick. This combination of moves allows Astroblast to deal heavy damage from a distance, concentrate damage on a small area, and quickly knock back enemies that get too close before firing again. Unfortunately Astroblast is very fragile due to his low health and armor, meaning that players should be careful and take care when playing as him.

abilities.name: Solar Flair
abilities.description: Press Attack 1 to fire the condensed sunlight which bounces off walls.

abilities.name: Asteroid Belt
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 to lob a prismatic space rock. Press Attack 1 to shoot the prism, creating an area of lasers that damage enemies in he area.

abilities.name: Starsault
abilities.description: Press Attack 3 to kick close enemies and knock them away.

abilities.name: Solar Field
abilities.description: Fast-moving light particles around you protect your suit, improving your armor. Additionally, Life Skylanders near you regenerate health.

abilities.name: Solar Powered
abilities.description: Hold Attack 1 to charge up Solar Flair with the light of hotter and hotter suns. Release to shoot a high-powered laser at enemies.

abilities.name: Space Rocks!
abilities.description: Hold Attack 3 to bring down an explosive space rock.

abilities.name: Wool Encounters
abilities.description: Hold Attack 3 to bring down a space rock inhabited by a creature with its own laser gun set to Blaaaaaast.

abilities.name: Surface of the Sun
abilities.description: Your Solar Field heats up and does damage to enemies that get too close.

abilities.name: Meatier Meteors
abilities.description: Hold Attack 3 down longer to bring down a bigger (more explosive) space rock.

abilities.name: Star Light: Star Bright
abilities.description: Rapidly press Attack 1 to fire Solar Flairs at its currently charged level. The charge will slowly diminish over time.

abilities.name: Meteor Shower
abilities.description: Hold Attack 2 and release to lob multiple space rocks.

abilities.name: Full Spectrum
abilities.description: When you shoot a space rock, the dust will last longer.

abilities.name: Supernova
abilities.description: Once before you lose your last hit point, you will go supernova and gain half health.

trivia: Astroblast is the only Light Skylander introduced in SuperChargers.
He is also one of two Skylanders to be the only one of their respective element introduced in that game, the other being the Dark Skylander Nightfall.

Astroblast went through a number of alternative designs, including concepts with insectile wings, a star-shaped body, dual swords, a crystalline pickaxe, or a radiant shield. His full-colored, near-finalized design wears an orange-and-yellow spacesuit along with a translucent astronaut helmet.
Some people call Astroblast a Space Cowboy.
One of his quest quotes references Star Wars, with him talking about the Sun Runner in a similar manner to how Han Solo talks about his ship, the Millennium Falcon.

Additionally, Astroblast mentions something called the Kettle Corn Run and how the Sun Runner cleared it in 12 minutes, referencing the Kessel Run and how the Millennium Falcon cleared it in twelve parsecs.

He is the second of at least five Skylanders with the ability to avoid being defeated (only in his Nova Hopper path and if his Supernova upgrade is purchased) by normal upgrades. The first is Night Shift, while the other three are Double Dare Trigger Happy, Crash Bandicoot and Ember.
He is the first Skylander whose name starts with an 'A'. The three others with this distinction are Ambush, Air Strike and Aurora.
The Solar Field upgrade in Imaginators gives Astroblast +20 Armor.
Astroblast is voiced by Neal McDonough, known for his portrayal of Lieutenant Lynn 'Buck' Compton in Band of Brothers and Vincent Sofel in Paul Blart Mall Cop 2.

The triangular shape protruding from his pulse laser resembles a prism; this is fitting, as prisms are tools that can either refract light, or break up white light into its constituent spectral colors (aka, the colors of the rainbow).
Astroblast has similarities to Gemini Man from Mega Man 3.
Their primary weapons are lasers that bounce off walls (Solar Flair from Astroblast, and Gemini Laser for Gemini Man).

Astroblast and Gemini Man also have astronomy motifs in their designs (Astroblast resembles an astronaut and many of his quotes and upgrades are puns on space exploration, while Gemini Man was, alongside the other Robot Masters in the game, meant to be a space exploration/mining robot and is named after a constellation).
Astroblast's head slightly resembles Gemini Man's helmet, specifically the 4-pronged crest.
Astroblast is also similar to Cosmic Wario from Wario: Master Of Disguise, as both are space-themed and use laser guns whose shots can ricochet off walls.
Since Astroblast is an astronaut-themed skylander, his idle animation could be a reference to Micheal Jackson's iconic dance, 'Moon Walk'

aurora.name: Aurora
aurora.description: Aurora is a Light elemental Sensei in Skylanders: Imaginators. She is the niece of the great Portal Master Eon and she trains Imaginators of the Swashbuckler Battle Class.
aurora.biography: Aurora is the niece of Master Eon. For years, he tried to keep her identity a secret so that she would remain safe from harm. But as she grew older, Aurora wanted nothing more than to become a Skylander, but Eon would not permit it. So without telling him, she wore a disguise and studied swordplay and combat arts under the name 'Boss Blades McSlashinator.' Soon, everyone was talking about this new mysterious hero and her amazing abilities. Even Master Eon was notably impressed, but when he learned the skilled fighter was none other than his own niece, he once again refused her entry into the Skylanders team. However, before she could protest, Eon smiled and told her it was because he was immediately promoting her to his Sensei program, where she would train the Swashbuckler Class under her true name and identity. Although he did later admit that 'Boss Blades McSlashinator' sounded pretty cool.
aurora.personality: Aurora is determined, heroic, and clever. She demonstrated great persistence by training in secret under a pseudonym to prove her capabilities to her uncle, Master Eon. She carries herself with the confidence of a master swordswoman and takes pride in her family legacy while maintaining an optimistic and energetic 'Speed of Light' attitude.
aurora.gameplay: Aurora is a Swashbuckler Sensei, meaning she dual-wields golden swords and uses fast-paced dashes and light-based explosions to overwhelm her foes. Her playstyle focuses on high mobility via her Flash Dash and area-of-effect damage with Light Burst swords. Her ultimate Sky-Chi ability, Flicker Flash, allows her to steer through enemies while dealing massive damage.

abilities.name: Double Sword Strike
abilities.description: Press Attack 1 thrice to perform a double sword strike combo.

abilities.name: Flash Dash
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 to dash and flip through your enemies.

abilities.name: Light Burst
abilities.description: Press Attack 3 to drop a light sword that slows enemies and explodes.

abilities.name: Speed of Light
abilities.description: Flash Dash is faster and does more damage.

abilities.name: Brighter Light
abilities.description: Light Burst swords knock enemies up and deal more damage.

abilities.name: Extended Reach
abilities.description: Double Sword Strike hits further and does more damage.

abilities.name: Eon's Power
abilities.description: Press and hold Attack 1 to unlock the true power of Eon, granting increased damage and armor.

abilities.name: Flicker Flash
abilities.description: The ultimate Sensei attack! Hold Special Attack to perform your Sky-Chi Power! Use Left Stick to steer into enemies!

abilities.name: Sword Techniques
abilities.description: Press Attack 1 twice, Attack 2 for a Flash Dive combo. Press Attack 1 twice, Attack 3 for a X-Ray Shot combo.

abilities.name: Rapid Strike Mode
abilities.description: Press Attack 1 rapidly to enter Rapid Strike mode.

abilities.name: Dervish
abilities.description: Hitting enemies with Double Sword Strike combos speeds up your Double Sword Strike attacks.

abilities.name: Forever Runner
abilities.description: Hold Attack 2 to continuously Flash Dash, and Flash Dash does more damage.

abilities.name: Momentum
abilities.description: Flash Dash now gives a 3 second damage boost to your Double Sword Strike attacks.

abilities.name: Explosive Finish
abilities.description: You now drop Light Burst explosive swords during Flash Dash, and your Light Burst swords deal more damage.

trivia: Her outfit resembles Master Eon's helmet and robes, however with different colors and the addition of the bust.
She also references his lines, for example the way he talks to the player at the start and end of every game.
She is the first Skylander to be related to a Portal Master, namely Master Eon.
In older versions of the game, her icon had her concept art, in which her helmet's horns were white and her robes had reversed colors.
Her outfit has pearlized paint in areas with white, and glossy effects in areas with black.
She is the only Skylander of the Light element to have visible pupils.
'Blades McSlashinator' is a possible reference to the Boaty McBoatface meme, in which internet users would create humorous names for objects using their attributes.
One of her upgrades, Dervish was one of the names used for the Sentinel Battle Class during development.

autumn-stump-smash.name: Autumn Stump Smash
autumn-stump-smash.description: Autumn Stump Smash is the Fall counterpart of Stump Smash in Skylanders: Lost Islands. He was only available in September 2013.
autumn-stump-smash.biography: Autumn Stump Smash is the Fall counterpart of Stump Smash in Skylanders: Lost Islands. He was only available in September 2013.
autumn-stump-smash.catchphrase: Autumn Stump Smash has set in around your kingdom!
autumn-stump-smash.personality: Autumn Stump Smash is a seasonal guardian of the forest, embodying the spirit of the fall season in Skylands.
autumn-stump-smash.gameplay: As an Alter Ego in Skylanders: Lost Islands, Autumn Stump Smash functions as a seasonal variant of the character Stump Smash.
trivia: Autumn Stump Smash was only available during September 2013.
He is the Fall counterpart of the Skylander, Stump Smash.
His English voice actor is Kevin Michael Richardson.
He is one of several seasonal Alter Egos featured in Skylanders: Lost Islands.

awakened-forms.name: Awakened Forms
awakened-forms.description: Awakened Forms are a type of upgraded Skylanders in Skylanders: Ring of Heroes. Identified by purple star rarities, they are obtained by collecting a very large Soul Stones and Elemental Ores. Unlike other empowered forms in the series, this transformation appears to be a permanent change of the Skylander's outfit or appearance, into more elaborate accessories or additional armor.
awakened-forms.biography: As seen in the game's tutorial, this transformation can be deactivated in some way, as all Awakened Skylanders that help the dazed Portal Master are later summoned in their regular forms. In game, however, it is permanent; shown in the tutorial comics to be the materials and Soul Stones transforming into new patterns or armor on the Skylander.
awakened-forms.catchphrase: Awakened Forms are a type of upgraded Skylanders in Skylanders: Ring of Heroes.
awakened-forms.personality: Awakened Skylanders are stronger forms of Skylanders, gaining a new outfit and a large boost in stats. They also upgrade one of their skills to a new form, with more powerful or different effects. This transformation appears to be a permanent change of the Skylander's outfit or appearance, into more elaborate accessories or additional armor.
awakened-forms.gameplay: Awakened Skylanders are stronger forms of Skylanders, gaining a new outfit and a large boost in stats. They also upgrade one of their skills to a new form, with more powerful or different effects. These characters can still level up, use runes and upgrade their attacks as usual, with no additional cost.

abilities.name: Skill Upgrade
abilities.description: Awakened Skylanders upgrade one of their skills to a new form, with more powerful or different effects.

trivia: The concept of Awakened Skylanders is similar to Awakening, a gameplay element present in Summoners War, another game from Com2Us, the developers of Ring of Heroes. In that game, however, characters start out as generic mythical creatures or fantasy archetypes and an element, and awaken into characters with specific names.
Awakened Hot Dog is a reference to Shishi, statues of armored guardian lions of Chinese mythology.
Awakened Fiesta is a subtle reference to La Parka, a masked luchador known for his outfit with stylized bones painted over the clothes.

Regular Awakened Stealth Elf wears a Hachimaki, a type of headband once used by Samurai to prevent head attacks and make helmets more comfortable to use. However, its engraved appearance appears to be a reference to Ninja outfits in movies and the Naruto franchise.

Awakened Form versions of Trap Shadow, Double Trouble, Dune Bug, Fright Rider, Wind-Up, Bat Spin, Bushwhack, Night Shift, Stump Smash, Rubble Rouser and Shroomboom were planned for Ring of Heroes with concept art being released. However they were scrapped due to the game's closure.

bad-breath.name: Bad Breath
bad-breath.description: Bad Breath is a Skylander only featured in the Skylanders Academy television series. Of an unknown element, he possesses a powerful putrid breath to incapacitate enemies. Though he is officially a graduated Skylander, because of his anxiety and gastrointestinal issues, he still has to take part in cadet assignments.
bad-breath.biography: Bad Breath is a character created exclusively for the Skylanders Academy television series, designed as a figure of a non-ideal yet comedic Skylander. He possesses a powerful putrid breath that can incapacitate enemies and control its duration and strength to sicken targets far larger than himself. He is known to have great empathy, abhorring the mistreatment of others, which can trigger a significant temper, especially when his friends like Cy are targeted.
bad-breath.catchphrase: Okay, everyone, plug your noses. It's about to get funky up in here!
bad-breath.personality: Bad Breath is easily startled or bothered, making him gassy. Despite his unpopularity with the other students, he appears to not mind, but too much stress has caused him to be temporarily put out of duty at the start of Season 1. Unknown to the rest, he sometimes uses empty rooms to burp for as long as he pleases. Though Bad Breath couldn't care less about the bullying from various students over his weakness, he has been shown to have great empathy, as he abhors other people being mistreated, going as far as to lose his temper when Cy becomes the target of the prejudiced cadets.
bad-breath.gameplay: Bad Breath can use a particularly putrid breath when burping, with such a powerful smell that it can temporarily knock his targets out and stick to clothing forever. He can also control its duration and strength to sicken enemies far larger than him. When stressed or startled, he becomes gassy and may burp uncontrollably. During the mission to rescue King Pen, his noxious belches were powerful enough to affect the digestive tract of the Fire Viper.

abilities.name: Putrid breath
abilities.description: Bad Breath can use a particularly putrid breath when burping, with such a powerful smell that it can temporarily knock his targets out and stick to clothing forever. He can also control its duration and strength to sicken enemies far larger than him.

abilities.name: Massive Rancid Fumes
abilities.description: Bad Breath releases massive rancid fumes, leading even giant enemies to be incapacitated or repelled. This ability was powerful enough to cause the Fire Viper to vomit the entire team.

trivia: Bad Breath is a character created exclusively for the show, as a figure of a non-ideal yet comedic Skylander.
Bad Breath made the pretzels in the Skylands Music Festival in Pop Rocks, however, because of his constant unhygienic state, Master Eon advised the guests to avoid his food once it was found out.
According to Food Fight in Belly of the Beast, Bad Breath's breath smells like flaming desert diapers at times.
In Sheep(ball) Dreams, Bad Breath's skin is mentioned to be furry.

Bad Breath's powers resemble those of the recurring enemy Malboro from the Final Fantasy series, who are known to have such a putrid smell, shown as the ability also named Bad Breath, that they can inflict multiple status ailments at once and severely cripple their target's skills.
Unlike other Grumblebum, he only has two eyes and no antlers. It is likely that Bad Breath is not mutated like the Grumblebum in Swap Force.

bad-juju.name: Bad Juju
bad-juju.description: Bad Juju is a witch doctor spirit who first appeared as one of the Air villains in Skylanders: Trap Team. She later appeared in Skylanders: SuperChargers, as one of the non-playable villain racers in the Racing Mode, driving an unnamed oddly-shaped vehicle with a duplicate of her skull on the front. In Skylanders: Imaginators, Bad Juju has traded a life of crime to become a Sensei, training Imaginators of the Swashbuckler Battle Class with a new appearance and accompanied by her son Juju Junior.
bad-juju.biography: Just like her name suggests, Bad Juju had always been bad. From her humble beginnings as a witch doctor, where she put curses on her patients instead of curing them, to being the Golden Queen's right-hand sorceress, she had spent her entire life as a villain. Being captured by the Skylanders didn't do much to change her attitude either. At least, that was the case until the day she conjured up more then she bargained for - a son named Juju Junior. That was when she finally decided it was time to come to change her lifestyle. She didn't want to raise Juju Junior inside a prison thinking that his magical mother was a criminal. So she asked Master Eon to give her a chance to be a hero instead. As luck would have it, Eon was looking for a Swashbuckler Sensei who could help train Imaginators the value of being good. Not bad for Bad Juju.
bad-juju.personality: If there's one thing the witch doctor loves, it's an afternoon nap. Bad Juju loves to sleep, and those that disturb her must weather the consequences. Despite being mean to a fault, she soon changed her villainous ways to become a better role model for her son; this is reflected in gameplay with Bad Juju playing defensively while near her son and aggressively while he is away. Meanwhile, Juju Junior is cheerful and always excited, eager to help his mother. Despite being a high-ranking servant of the Golden Queen for a long time, Bad Juju admitted to greatly disliking her after capture.
bad-juju.gameplay: Bad Juju can summon storms and whirlwinds to suck in enemies and call upon lightning strikes, and she can also teleport as seen in her introduction. In Imaginators, Bad Juju no longer fights alone, now with her son Juju Junior and wind spirits at her side. She also wields the Whirling Blades, which channel the wind spirits to power up the blades with an aura while alone, and a protective circle when accompanied by her son. She now takes full advantage of her detached head, keeping her focus on enemies as she spins for attacks and channels the wind to increase the duration of attacks and her speed; while Juju Junior can curse enemies and release static electricity when eating lightning. For their Sky-Chi, Bad Juju creates a lightning tether between her and her son, electrifying enemies that he runs into.

abilities.name: Whirling Blades
abilities.description: Press Attack 1 to slash your enemies down.

abilities.name: Juju Junior
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 to send Juju Junior out to make trouble. Press Attack 2 to call him back. Bad Juju has better defense with Junior but better attack power when Junior is out playing.

abilities.name: Windy Wail
abilities.description: Juju Junior does more damage and also has an area of effect attack when sent out.

abilities.name: Snack Attack
abilities.description: Press Attack 3 to feed Juju Junior a snack of lightning.

abilities.name: Airspeed Velocity
abilities.description: When Bad Juju isn't attacking, as she moves she will gradually become faster and faster.

abilities.name: Tornado Slash
abilities.description: Keep pressing Attack 1 to continually slash your enemies down.

abilities.name: Overeating
abilities.description: Hold Attack 3 to have Juju Junior explode with lightning.

abilities.name: Harnessing Havoc
abilities.description: The ultimate Sensei attack! Hold Special Attack to perform your Sky-Chi power! Use Left Stick to steer Junior into enemies!

abilities.name: Static Shock
abilities.description: When Whirling Blades hits, another nearby enemy will get shocked with static electricity.

abilities.name: A Storm of Blades
abilities.description: Whirling Blades and Tornado Slash attacks do more damage.

abilities.name: A Cut-ter Cut-tastrophe
abilities.description: After a Storm of Blades, send out flying blades in all directions.

abilities.name: Child Protection
abilities.description: When Juju Junior is called back, Bad Juju becomes temporarily invulnerable.

abilities.name: Voodoo Curse
abilities.description: Enemies hit by Juju Junior become cursed. If Bad Juju damages one cursed enemy, they all take damage.

abilities.name: The Main Attraction
abilities.description: When sent out, Juju Junior pulls enemies towards him before doing more damage.

trivia: When explaining her quest, she is incorrectly referred to as male ('He') by Glumshanks, even though she is female ('She'). She is also referred to as a male, ('he/him') by a Battlecast artist.
She and Eye Scream are the only two female villains that are mistaken to be males in gameplay, either by the writers or the voice actors of Cali and Glumshanks.
In game, she is slouched over but she straightens when she uses her attacks, as well as spinning her skull vertically or horizontally.

She is briefly seen in Stormblade's backstory in Dive, Dive, Dive!, being chased by the Sky Slicer, and shown with Grave Clobber in Biting Back's credits page. This is because she would've been a major villain in the next comic arc along with Grave Clobber, but it was cancelled during production.

Bad Juju speaks in a Jamaican accent, with a very slight warble filter. Bad Juju is voiced by Kimberly Brooks who also voices Echo, well known for her voice acting roles as Buena Girl from Mucha Lucha! and Jasper from Steven Universe.

She has upside-down versions of the Air symbol engraved into, or part of her eyes. The eye-like structure on Bad Juju's skull, as seen in both designs. Stranger still, Bad Juju and Juju Junior have an eye-like appendage on the back of their skulls, which in Imaginators glows greenish. It is unknown if it's their true eye or just another engraving, as in Trap Team it was entirely gold and flat. In her toy form and in Ring of Heroes', the eye engraving is replaced with a ball with engravings, connecting the skull to the shoulders. The reason for its inclusion in the mobile game, however, is unknown.
On the official Skylanders website, she was mistakenly listed twice.

Bad Juju, Hood Sickle and Grave Clobber are the only Undead creatures to not be from that element. Oddly, she is the only one of them to not change elements in Imaginators. Additionally, only Grave Clobber had no color changes between games.

Bad Juju is the third character to fight with the help of family members, after Sonic Boom and Eye-Brawl. Bad Juju and Sonic Boom, alongside Hammer Slam Bowser, are the only known Skylanders to have children (Juju Junior, the baby griffins and Bowser Jr., respectively).

Her catchphrase is based on the Bible verse Matthew Ch.26:41, 'Watch and pray, that ye enter not into temptation: the spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak', meaning that despite the individual's intention, the body might be a limitation. Bad Juju using only the first part of the quote might represent that she overcame her villainous drive to be a better mother to Juju Junior.
She is the only Air Sensei to not come in an Adventure Pack.
For her idle animation, Bad Juju sharpens her blades against each other, or taunts while pointing forward. She is one of the few Skylanders with multiple idle animations.

barbella.name: Barbella
barbella.description: Barbella is a crystalline Earth Sensei in Skylanders: Imaginators, who trains Imaginators of the Sentinel Battle Class.
barbella.biography: Barbella was the best fitness trainer in all of Skylands. Not only did she possess otherworldly strength, she was also a firm believer that a healthy diet and exercise led to true happiness. With such a positive message to spread, Barbella decided to open her own fitness center called 'Flex-a-lot', where she hoped to instill good eating and workout habits with all of her patrons. But one day, the gelatinous villain known as The Gulper destroyed her gym, and it took all of Barbella's strength to keep it from collapsing while everyone fled to safety. It was then that Barbella realized that bad guys were more hazardous to your health than anything else, so she began to train in the ways of the Sentinel, where she quickly became one of the greatest masters in the world!
barbella.personality: Barbella is a highly positive and dedicated fitness enthusiast who believes that true happiness comes from a healthy diet and exercise. She is characterized by her otherworldly strength and her selfless nature, as demonstrated when she held up her collapsing gym to save her patrons from The Gulper. Her realization that villains are the ultimate hazard to health drove her to apply her discipline toward mastering the ways of the Sentinel.
barbella.gameplay: Barbella uses her super-strength and boulder barbells in battle. With her boulder barbells she can smash enemies, and even use them to summon rock constructs, ranging from a large pair of stone hands, or a runic cube that she can push at enemies with great force. Her Sky-Chi has her lift her barbells which causes crystal shards to shoot out towards her foes.

abilities.name: Barbell Bash
abilities.description: Press Attack 1 to whack, thwack and smash with your Boulder Barbells.

abilities.name: Rocky Rep
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 to create stone hands that pull enemies towards you.

abilities.name: Cubic Runic Rock
abilities.description: Press Attack 3 to conjure a giant rock that damages enemies near it and can be launched to explode into Rock Crystals.

abilities.name: Unsteady Ground
abilities.description: Attack 1 triple-combo covers a larger area, dealing more bonus damage to closer enemies.

abilities.name: Have a Gneiss Day
abilities.description: Rocky Rep's stone hands create Rock Crystals you can launch at foes with Barbell Bash.

abilities.name: Rocks in a Hard Place
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 during Rocky Rep to create Rock Crystals.

abilities.name: Taken for Granite
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 five times to buff yourself. You take less damage. Rock Crystals spawn over time. Attack 1 pulls Rock Crystals.

abilities.name: Do You Even Lift?
abilities.description: The ultimate Sensei attack! Hold Special Attack for a Sensei-tional workout! Aim with Left Stick to shoot out Crystal Shards at your enemies!

abilities.name: Gifts of the Deadlift
abilities.description: Rock Crystals will pound the ground when you press Attack 1. Press Attack 1 thrice to create Rock Crystals.

abilities.name: Caving In
abilities.description: Barbell Bash does even more damage and the shockwave extends further.

abilities.name: Rocky Roads
abilities.description: Press Attack 1 thrice to send out cascading earthquakes.

abilities.name: For the Crater Good
abilities.description: Damaging enemies sometimes spawns a Rock Crystal.

abilities.name: Rocky Rebound
abilities.description: Rock Crystals will return to their targets when they fly out.

abilities.name: Boulder and All the Wiser
abilities.description: Rock Crystals spawn more frequently when damaging enemies. Rock Crystals critically hit on their return trip.

trivia: Barbella is a pun on both barbells, a type of exercise equipment, and the Italian word bella, meaning beautiful.
Her name is also a pun on Barbarella.
Barbella is also an Italian surname.
In earlier versions of the game, Barbella had an icon based on concept art and had white instead of yellow hair.
Surprisingly, Barbella's element and battle class have more female senseis than males.

While most of the Senseis' garments consist of robes, tunics, and armor, Barbella's outfit is a jumpsuit with golden linen on the sleeves, pant leg, and even outlines around the chest like an actual chest plate with pauldrons.
Barbella is very similar to Crusher - Both are members of elite Skylander teams, are Earth elements, have very similar powers and weapons, and have nearly identical catchphrases.
She's the only Earth sensei without an alternate deco.

barkley.name: Barkley
barkley.description: Barkley is one of the four Sidekicks in Skylanders: Giants. He is the miniature version of the Life Giant, Tree Rex. As a Mini Skylander, he is in the Nintendo 3DS Starter Pack of Skylanders: Trap Team along with the Trap Master, Gusto.
barkley.biography:
Within the Skylands, a realm of infinite possibilities, there is in fact an alternate reality known as the Skylands Miniverse. Everything there is smaller, including the Skylanders. The Skylanders Sidekicks come from that Miniverse and have traveled to the Skylands to meet their regular-sized alter egos and tag along with them on adventures.

The Skylander Minis started off as regular 'Sidekicks', assisting the Skylanders on many exciting adventures. And what they lacked in size they more than made up for in courage. Ultimately determined to become full-fledged heroes, they trained at the Skylands Academy - honing their powers and skills until they were ready. Now, they stand side by side with their full grown counterparts, ready to defend Skylands against Kaos and his evil minions.
barkley.personality: Barkley will do anything to protect Skylands from dark magic. Mess with him and you'll be barking up the wrong tree! He loves and respects nature as much as his mentor, Tree Rex.
barkley.gameplay: Barkley is the miniature version of the Life Giant, Tree Rex. Initially appearing as a non-playable Sidekick who followed players around, he was later released as a fully playable Mini Skylander. He possesses the same move set as Tree Rex, including Arbor Smash, Sequoia Charge, and the Photosynthesis Cannon, allowing him to deliver powerful Life-based attacks despite his small stature.

abilities.name: Arbor Smash
abilities.description: A powerful physical attack involving a smashing motion.

abilities.name: Sequoia Charge
abilities.description: A charging attack inspired by the Sequoia tree.

abilities.name: Big Thorn Shockwave Slam
abilities.description: A powerful slam that creates a shockwave with thorns.

abilities.name: Photosynthesis Cannon
abilities.description: A ranged attack using the power of photosynthesis.

abilities.name: Super Stampede
abilities.description: A massive stampede attack that crushes enemies.

trivia: Barkley is a play on the word tree bark which is a part of a tree.
His name may also be a play on the type of bread 'Barley'.
In Giants, Barkley is the only sidekick whose name isn't a pun on their regular-sized counterparts.
He is the only Mini to appear in a starter pack.
Coincidentally, he and Tree Rex are the only counterparts who are available in the Nintendo 3DS starter packs.
In the 3DS version, he calls himself 'Tree Rex' instead of 'Barkley'.

bash.name: Bash
bash.description: Bash is a brown rock dragon who first appeared in Skylanders: Spyro's Adventure. He has a Legendary counterpart called Legendary Bash exclusive to the Toys 'R' Us Legendary Pack. He also has a birthday counterpart that became available on November 2013 in Skylanders: Lost Islands.
bash.biography: Bash spent most of his early dragonhood staring into the sky, watching the flying creatures of Skylands soar amongst the clouds. Determined to join them, he learned how to curl himself into a ball and roll with incredible momentum in a vain attempt to take flight. Over the years, his skin hardened, forming a natural protective armor unlike any other creature. He now thunders through Skylands, leaving a wake of destruction against any who threaten it. Despite his thick skin, he still gets very touchy about his inability to fly.
bash.personality: Never tell Bash he can't do something. This resourceful, stubborn Skylander will keep on rolling until he's proved you wrong. He never gives up without a fight. Despite his gruff disposition, Bash is very sensitive about his inability to fly.
bash.gameplay: Bash uses his spiky tail to slam and strike his opponents away using a 360 degree tailspin. He can also summon rocks to rise from the ground to scramble his enemies. His signature attack is Rock Roll, which involves him curling up into a spiky ball and steamrolling into his enemies.

abilities.name: Tail Swipe
abilities.description: Bash swings his tail around to attack a full 360 degrees of enemies.

abilities.name: Rock and Roll
abilities.description: Bash rolls into a ball to bowl over his enemies.

abilities.name: Tennis Tail
abilities.description: Deflect incoming objects with Tail Swipe.

abilities.name: Iron Tail
abilities.description: Tail Swipe does increased damage.

abilities.name: Summoning: Stone Projection
abilities.description: Bash can summon up to three rock walls at a time and hit them with Tail Swipe to launch rocks.

abilities.name: Double Roll
abilities.description: Bash can use the Roll attack twice as long.

abilities.name: Triceratops Honor Guard
abilities.description: New armor makes Bash harder to hit. Armor +40.

abilities.name: Rolling Thunder
abilities.description: While rolling, press Attack 3 to launch into the air and slam down.

abilities.name: Mace of Destruction
abilities.description: Tail Swipe does MORE increased damage.

abilities.name: Summoning: Stone Uppercut
abilities.description: Stone Projection does increased damage.

abilities.name: Gaia Hammer
abilities.description: Charge up Tail Swipe to make it deal extra damage.

abilities.name: Pulver Roll
abilities.description: Roll attack does increased damage.

abilities.name: Earthen Force Roll
abilities.description: Roll does MORE damage and can roll right through enemy attacks.

abilities.name: Continental Boulder
abilities.description: Bash becomes giant while rolling, rolling faster and doing even more damage.

trivia: Many fans mistake him for being a dinosaur due to his resemblance to an Ankylosaurus (and Triceratops, if he is equipped with the Triceratops Honor Guard Soul Gem power).
He also bears a slight resemblance to Doedicurus with Postosuchus and Styracosaurus features.

Over the years, Bash has jumped off cliffs, leapt from airships and even launched himself into the sky from a giant catapult in his attempts at flying. He always makes a painful landing, but he refuses to give up and insists that one day he'll soar like the other dragons.
One of his upgrades, Iron Tail, share its name with a Pokémon move.
Despite the upgrade description saying he rolls into a ball, Bash rolls more in the form of a wheel, like a Droideka from the Star Wars series.
Series 2 Bash has his Iron Tail and Triceratops Honor Guard upgrades, giving him a steel-plated skull and a metal plated tail.
His catchphrase is the base of Wrecking Ball's ('Wreck-n-Roll!') and Snap Shot's ('Croc and Roll!').
In Skylanders: Spyro's Adventure: Master Eon's Official Guide, it incorrectly states that he is a Tech Skylander.
He and Ghost Roaster both have spikeballs attached to them.
Bash's quote, 'Rock it to me!' is a play on the term 'Sock it to me!'

In Swap Force, his Triceratops Honor Guard Soul Gem does change his appearance when he's wearing a hat. In SuperChargers, his Triceratops Honor Guard Soul Gem disappears when wearing a hat. Bop also shares the same error. The error was fixed for both in Imaginators.
Bash is the first Skylander to have Triceratops-like features (the second being Tri-Tip).
Bash's promotional pictures show him with more teeth compared to his toy and in-game form. This however was corrected ever since Swap Force, where he does have many more teeth.
Of the Series 2 Earth Skylanders in Giants, Bash is the only one without a Series 3 counterpart.

bat-spin.name: Bat Spin
bat-spin.description: Bat Spin is a vampire who is one of the Core Frito-Lay Skylanders for Skylanders: Trap Team.
bat-spin.biography: Bat Spin hailed from the underworld, where as a child she was separated from her people. After spending months searching for them, she eventually was welcomed by a colony of magical bats who raised her as one of their own. After many peaceful years living with the bats, the colony was invaded by an army of undead trolls, who were set on stealing their magic to build an ultimate sonar weapon. Bat Spin quickly took action and used powerful abilities that she had learned growing up with the bats and essentially becoming one of them. She heroically defeated the trolls and saved the colony. This caught the attention of Master Eon, who saw at once she would make a worthy Skylander!
bat-spin.personality: Bat Spin was born in the underworld, which makes her witchy in a good way. She's also pretty cool under pressure and isn't known to fly off the handle. Her mannerisms in idle and win animations imply she might be still young, and strangely she sounds hesitant when given a hat or nickname.
bat-spin.gameplay: Bat Spin's gameplay revolves around summoning and managing pet bats that attack enemies. She can also transform into a Giant Bat to bite enemies and use a powerful screech attack. Her upgrade paths allow her to either improve her bat-summoning abilities with specific named bats or enhance her powerful Bat Form.

abilities.name: Bat Attack
abilities.description: Press Attack 1 to shoot bitey pet bats at enemies.

abilities.name: Bat Swarm
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 to summon a maelstrom of bat damage.

abilities.name: Healing Bite
abilities.description: Collect pet bats after they have bitten enemies to regain HP.

abilities.name: Brawny Bats
abilities.description: Pet bats last longer, do more damage and are more aggressive.

abilities.name: Go Batty!
abilities.description: Press Attack 3 to transform into a Giant Bat! In Bat Form, press Attack 1 to bite and Attack 2 to screech.

abilities.name: A Colony of Bats
abilities.description: Increase the maximum number of pet bats.

abilities.name: Great Balls of Bats!
abilities.description: Hold Attack 1 to launch a giant ball of bats!

abilities.name: Bat Friends (Primary Attack)
abilities.description: Press Y to summon up to 3 bats that will attack nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Monster Bat (Secondary Attack)
abilities.description: Press X to transform into Monster Bat. You will be able to lunge foward by pressing Y. Press X to revert to normal while doing a screech that will damage anyone around.

abilities.name: Bat Cyclone (requires level: 3)
abilities.description: Hold X to summon up to 3 bats that will spin around the character and damage enemies if they come in contact.

abilities.name: Ball of Bats (requires level: 6)
abilities.description: Hold Y to charge up a ball of energy that will fire towards enemies when the input is released.

abilities.name: Bat Squad (requires level: 9)
abilities.description: In Monster Bat form, press Y to summon 3 bats. Press Y again to fire them foward and explode while doing Area of Damage.

abilities.name: Mr. Dizzy
abilities.description: A new pet bat, Mr. Dizzy, stuns and confuses enemies.

abilities.name: Mr. Blocky
abilities.description: A new pet bat, Mr. Blocky, protects you by deflecting projectiles.

abilities.name: Mr. Bitey
abilities.description: A new pet bat, Mr. Bitey, does extra biting damage.

abilities.name: Bat-tle Cry
abilities.description: In Bat Form, the screech attack does extra damage and powers up bats.

abilities.name: Ultimate Bat Squad
abilities.description: More pet bats fly with you and have additional powers.

abilities.name: Chiropteran Call
abilities.description: In Bat Form, the bite attack shoots out three additional pet bats.

trivia: When first revealed for the Frito Lay contest, Bat Spin's image url revealed that her original name was Frightengale.
Her game files in SuperChargers show a different name, Fright Bite.
Her catchphrase originated from one of Cynder's battle cries.
She is the third vampire Skylander (the others being Night Shift and Roller Brawl).
Like Night Shift, she speaks with a Transylvanian accent.
She shares some similarities to Venger from the 1980s Dungeons & Dragons TV series. Both have red clothing and bat-like features.
Her name might be a pun on 'backspin'.

Bat Spin is voiced by Eliza Schneider, who is best known for voicing most of the female characters including Wendy Testaburger from the 4th to 7th seasons of South Park, She also voices Mags and Vampress Imaginators. Coincidentally, they are all Undead themed characters.
Bat Spin was shown on the Skylanders: Ring of Heroes store page. However, she did not make it into the final game before its closure. Only concept art of her Awakened Form was released.
Unlike other vampire characters, her two fangs stick up from her lower lip, instead of her top lip.

big-bubble-pop-fizz.name: Big Bubble Pop Fizz
big-bubble-pop-fizz.description: Big Bubble Pop Fizz is the SuperChargers counterpart of Pop Fizz in Skylanders: SuperChargers. His signature vehicle is the Soda Skimmer.
big-bubble-pop-fizz.biography: Big Bubble Pop Fizz is the SuperChargers counterpart of Pop Fizz in Skylanders: SuperChargers. His signature vehicle is the Soda Skimmer. He has a birthday counterpart called Birthday Bash Big Bubble Pop Fizz.
big-bubble-pop-fizz.personality: Pop Fizz is known for being unpredictable and scatterbrained due to his many potion experiments. He is often seen enthusiastically testing new formulas, even if they have strange side effects on his memory or appearance. As he says, 'sometimes these potions can be a little -- uh, unpredictable.'
big-bubble-pop-fizz.gameplay: Big Bubble Pop Fizz uses a sousaphone-like weapon to blow bubbles that bounce on their way to enemies. He can transform into a beast by pressing Attack 2, where he uses claws for melee attacks. His SuperCharger form allows him to stay in beast mode indefinitely. He uses a Mixture Modifier to transform the color and effects of liquid attacks. After reverting to normal form, he receives a temporary defense boost.

abilities.name: Bubble Blast
abilities.description: Press Attack 1 to blow bubbles that bounce on their way to enemies.

abilities.name: Bubbling Beast Form
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 to transform into a beast. Press Attack 1 to attack nearby enemies with claws.

abilities.name: Mixture Modifier
abilities.description: Press Attack 3 to cause a chemical reaction and transform the color and effects of liquid attacks.

abilities.name: Know Your Bases
abilities.description: All base liquid attacks do more damage.

abilities.name: Genetic Engineering
abilities.description: Press Attack 3 while in beast mode to perform new attacks depending on the liquid color.

abilities.name: Side Effects
abilities.description: After reverting to normal Pop Fizz mode, gain a temporary defense boost.

abilities.name: Spiked Punch!
abilities.description: While in beast mode, hold and release Attack 1 to pound the ground and knock all enemies in the area up!

abilities.name: Larger Lungs
abilities.description: Hold Attack 1 to perform improved liquid attacks depending on the current color.

abilities.name: For Science!
abilities.description: Hold Attack 3 while in normal form to constantly spew liquids that damage enemies in the nearby area.

abilities.name: Follow The Formula
abilities.description: Mixture Modifier gains additional effects depending upon the liquid color.

abilities.name: Better Beast
abilities.description: Hold Attack 3 to perform enhanced and longer versions of unique beast attacks.

abilities.name: Juiced Up!
abilities.description: Melee attacks in Beast Form do more damage. I'm a monster, rawr!

abilities.name: Feed The Beast
abilities.description: In Beast Mode, hold Attack 3 to perform Better Beast attacks. Press Attack 1 after using a Better Beast attack to do more damage with your claws.

trivia: Despite the artwork depiction, Big Bubble Pop Fizz doesn't carry a beaker in-game.
Unlike his previous versions, Big Bubble Pop Fizz can remain in his Beast mode limitlessly.
His Beast mode now has three different colors based on whichever ability he possesses.
The figure's hair is not colored at the back, under his sousaphone-like weapon.

When he, Deep Dive Gill Grunt, Super Shot Stealth Elf and Bone Bash Roller Brawl are placed on the portal, they say their official catchphrases and some of their quotes in a slightly different tone of their voices. This also applies to most of their quotes, which have been completely re-recorded.

In SuperChargers, there is a glitch that can make Big Bubble Pop Fizz have his berserker stance, even when he's in his normal mode. This is done by changing his upgrade path while he's still in his berserker form. His idle and running animations are the same as berserker form, but his attacks are otherwise normal.

variants.name: Birthday Bash Big Bubble Pop Fizz

birthday-bash-big-bubble-pop-fizz.name: Birthday Bash Big Bubble Pop Fizz
birthday-bash-big-bubble-pop-fizz.description: Birthday Bash Big Bubble Pop Fizz is the birthday counterpart of Big Bubble Pop Fizz in Skylanders: SuperChargers.
birthday-bash-big-bubble-pop-fizz.biography: It is customary tradition at the Skylanders Academy for all of the Skylanders to gather around and sing the birthday song to the guest of honor. For fun, any Skylanders that arrives late must sing the birthday song solo in front of the entire Academy. But rather than seeing this as an embarrassment, Pop Fizz continues to see this as an opportunity to show off his new Big Bubble party instruments, and so he arrives late every time... much to the dismay of the party guests!
birthday-bash-big-bubble-pop-fizz.personality: Pop Fizz is a showman who views the Academy's tradition of late-comers singing solo as an opportunity to demonstrate his musical talent with his Big Bubble party instruments. He intentionally arrives late to parties just to take the spotlight, showing a playful and somewhat mischievous nature.
birthday-bash-big-bubble-pop-fizz.gameplay: Birthday Bash Big Bubble Pop Fizz uses musical party instruments to create bubbles for his attacks and can transform into a beast form. His gameplay revolves around managing his bubble projectiles and timing his transformations to maximize damage.

abilities.name: Bubble Blast
abilities.description: A primary attack that launches bubble-based projectiles using party instruments.

abilities.name: Bubbling Beast Form
abilities.description: A secondary attack that allows Pop Fizz to transform into a powerful Bubbling Beast.

abilities.name: Mixture Modifier
abilities.description: Modifies the potion mixtures to enhance combat effectiveness.

abilities.name: Larger Lungs
abilities.description: Increases lung capacity for more powerful bubble attacks.

abilities.name: Better Beast
abilities.description: An upgrade that further enhances the Bubbling Beast Form.

trivia: He shares his name with Bash's Lost Islands alter ego, Birthday Bash.
In his toy form, the colors of his gloves are colored all the way up to his claws.
His Magic Rift Engine pedestal is colored glittery silver all over.
He and Legendary Bone Bash Roller Brawl currently have the longest name out of all the Skylanders, consisting of a whopping 28 letters.
In addition, the first four words in his name begin with the letter 'B'.
This is the only Alt Deco of Pop Fizz whose Beast Form is the same color as his original counterpart.
His promotional art appears in the Personality option for Imaginators.
In the in-game Collection, the profile of Birthday Bash Big Bubble Pop Fizz shows him wearing clown makeup and a red rubber nose.

variants.name: Birthday Bash Big Bubble Pop Fizz

birthday-bash.name: Birthday Bash
birthday-bash.description: The party as arrived with Birthday Bash. Help us celebrate a year of Lost Islands
birthday-bash.biography: Birthday Bash is a birthday counterpart of Bash in Skylanders: Lost Islands. He represents the Lost Islands first anniversary.
birthday-bash.catchphrase: The party as arrived with Birthday Bash. Help us celebrate a year of Lost Islands
birthday-bash.personality: Birthday Bash's personality is not explicitly detailed, but he serves as a celebratory figure for the anniversary of Lost Islands.
birthday-bash.gameplay: Birthday Bash is a mobile-exclusive Alter Ego available in Skylanders: Lost Islands. Unlike console Skylanders, he does not have a traditional move set or upgrade paths, serving instead as a collectible celebratory character for the game's first anniversary.
trivia: He along with Surfer Slam Bam are the only Alter Ego Skylanders to have original artwork for Lost Islands.
His name is a play on the real term 'birthday bash', which is a birthday party.
Although Birthday Bash was supposed to represent the Lost Islands' first anniversary. Lost Islands actually was first released on October 6th 2012.
Birthday Bash is the first Lost Islands exclusive alter ego to be in the Earth Element.
There is also an arena Challenge in Skylanders: Giants called 'Birthday Bash'.
His name is shared by Birthday Bash Big Bubble Pop Fizz.

blackout.name: Blackout
blackout.description: Blackout is a black dragon who is the Dark Core Skylander in Skylanders: Trap Team.
blackout.biography: Blackout hails from the Realm of Dreams, where the collective imagination of all the creatures in the universe come together to create beautiful wonders... and terrible nightmares. At a young age, he was recruited into the Dark Stygian – a Dragon Clan whose chief responsibility was to create nightmares for evil creatures as a way to discourage them from doing more villainy. But the clan began to abuse their power, and soon spread nightmares far and wide for its own amusement. But Blackout would not stand for it. So he learned to teleport directly into the nightmares the clan created and fought the creatures within. Eventually, the nightmares reached as far as Master Eon, who witnessed Blackout's courage within his own dreams. After helping him put a stop to the Dark Stygian, Eon then made Blackout a Skylander, serving as the protector of the Realm of Dreams and beyond!
blackout.personality: Despite knowing of his sinister origins, Blackout shows bravery, compassion, and encouragement towards others. Like all Skylanders of his element, Blackout sees no relation between the Dark element and The Darkness.
blackout.gameplay: Blackout can fire orbs of darkness from his horn and summon black holes with a flick of his wings. Using the powers of the Dark element, he can teleport through his black holes from one to place to another. His wings are elastic, allowing Blackout to stretch his wings and whip them at enemies.

abilities.name: Wing Whip
abilities.description: Press Attack 1 to perform a Wing Whip. Press Attack 1, Attack 1, Attack 1 for a combo attack.

abilities.name: Shadow Orbs
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 to shoot Shadow Orbs, which leave behind Darkness energy shockwaves.

abilities.name: Black Hole
abilities.description: Press Attack 3 to open up Black Holes that pull enemies in - hold and release the button to teleport yourself.

abilities.name: Darkness Overload
abilities.description: Shoot a Shadow Orb into a Black Hole to create an explosive eruption.

abilities.name: Shadow Blade
abilities.description: Jump and press Attack 1 to turn into a spinning Shadow Blade.

abilities.name: Cloud Gravity

trivia: Blackout is the only core Skylander of the Dark Element as of Imaginators.

A statue of Blackout is spotted along with the other Skylander statues in the Collection Chamber of the Eternal Archives in the Nintendo 3DS version of Skylanders: Trap Team. This was an early teaser for the character before he was officially announced along with Spotlight, Knight Light and Knight Mare in December 2014.
His name refers to the common term for a power outage.
Statues of Blackout can be seen on the ledges of the Midnight Museum.
The Legendary Treasure, Legendary Gargoyle, is based on Blackout.
Blackout's wings appear in the design of the Dark towers in Kaos Doom Challenges.
His dark skin color, dream teleportation and manipulation, horn and wings, and night motif also makes him similar to Princess Luna aka Nightmare Moon from the same series.
Although Blackout has wings, he cannot fly. However, the Cloud Gravity upgrade from his 'Prince of Darkness' path allows him to fly over enemies for a short time.

blades.name: Blades
blades.description: Blades is a blue dragon knight who is one of the Air Skylanders in Skylanders: Trap Team. He is released with the Nightmare Express Adventure Pack, and in a Triple Pack with Torch and Tidal Wave Gill Grunt. He was originally one of the three starter Skylanders in the first version of Skylanders: Ring of Heroes.
blades.biography: Blades came from a long line of dragons that guarded the dungeon of Scalos Castle, where the Golden Fear Serpent had slumbered for a century. Although it was considered an honor, Blades dreamed of becoming a knight so he could go on adventures in faraway lands. But one evening, a deafening roar shook the castle and a wave of fear swept over. The serpent had awoken! Fighting his fear with each step, Blades descended into the chamber. As he entered, the golden beast grinned and made Blades an offer - he would leave the kingdom unharmed and slumber for another hundred years, as long as Blades agreed to remain in the dungeon for eternity. Knowing the safety of the kingdom was more important than his ambition, Blades accepted the offer. Then suddenly, the fear was gone and the serpent vanished - for it turned out the only way to defeat the serpent was to confront his fear. News of this bravery soon found its way to Master Eon, who came to see Blades at once and made him a Skylander.
blades.personality: Blades is a brave and noble dragon despite his young age. He is willing to do whatever it takes to protect others from harm. Even if it means sacrificing himself to do it! However, like most youngsters, Blades can be a headache. In I Am Legendary, while still attending the Skylanders Academy, he was cocky, reckless and full of himself, convinced that he didn't need anyone's help. He would call elder and experienced Skylanders 'old timers' and 'slow'. This trait diminished when he realized that working in a team was more effective than handling bad guys on his own.
blades.gameplay: Wearing bladed armor, Blades is literally sharp everywhere on him, making it difficult for enemies to dodge his strikes. He can swipe and slash enemies with his bladed wings and tail, and even release a string of Blade Shards. Blades can also summon whirlwinds that can carry his Blade Shards to make them fly into his opponents for additional damage.

abilities.name: Instant Swirl Shards!

abilities.name: Follow Like The Wind
abilities.description: Cyclone Swirl follows you more closely and spins Blade Shards faster.

abilities.name: Shielding Swirl
abilities.description: Cyclone Swirl is larger and can deflect enemy projectiles.

abilities.name: Slice Shards

abilities.name: Cutting Edge
abilities.description: Blade Shards do increased damage.

abilities.name: Shard Shrapnel
abilities.description: Blade Shards stick to enemies, causing more damage over time.

trivia: Blades is the second dragon Skylander of the Air element (the first being Whirlwind).
Blades is the second Air Skylander to have his Soul Gem located in the first level of the game (the first being Pop Thorn for Skylanders: Swap Force).
Coincidentally, they both come in Adventure Packs.
Like Sunburn and Flashwing, Blades is the third dragon with wings that cannot fly in the game.
He is voiced by Robin Atkin Downes, who is known for voicing Hoot Loop, and the Medic from Team Fortress 2.
Blades and Fist Bump can both perform combos, however, they are currently the only two Skylanders who cannot purchase any additional combos, regardless of which upgrade path is selected.
His armor was originally gray instead of blue.
He, Spyro, and Bash are currently the only known dragons with Legendary counterparts.
Blades is one of the few core Skylanders from Trap Team to have an in-game variant, the others being Food Fight, Déjà Vu, and Cobra Cadabra.
One of his upgrade paths, Shard Shooter, is a play on the term 'Sharp Shooter'.
The pun is also shared with Shark Shooter Terrafin.
In the Ring of Heroes comics, Blades has opposable thumbs, despite not having them in his regular appearance or ingame.
He and Sunburn are the only two dragon Skylanders to be included in adventure packs (Nightmare Express and Dragon's Peak).

blast-zone.name: Blast Zone
blast-zone.description: Blast Zone is a Fire furnace knight who is one of the SWAP Force Skylanders in Skylanders: Swap Force. He is one of the Starter Pack Skylanders for the game, the others being Wash Buckler and Ninja Stealth Elf. Blast Zone has a Dark counterpart called Dark Blast Zone, and his SWAP Force Ability is Rocket.
blast-zone.biography: As a young furnace knight, Blast Zone was part of the Skylands Bomb Squad, specializing in the safe disarming and removal of troll bombs. But it was not long before the trolls got tired of Blast Zone constantly thwarting their evil plans, so they decided to go after the furnace knight himself. Late one night, an army of trolls snuck into Blast Zone’s village and threw 100 bombs down his chimney. Acting quickly, Blast Zone swallowed each bomb and then belched a jet of fire back at the invaders – sending them fleeing with their boots on fire. The tale of the attack eventually reached the ear of Master Eon, who knew the brave furnace knight had all the makings of a Skylander.
blast-zone.personality: Fiery but disarming, Blast Zone always puts the safety of his friends first. He is always most likely to blow a fuse.
blast-zone.gameplay: Blast Zone is a Fire element SWAP Force Skylander with the Rocket movement power. His primary combat style involves throwing bombs and utilizing fire breath to create damaging walls of fire. On his top half, he can upgrade his bombs to become sticky or flaming projectiles, while his bottom half upgrades focus on rocket-dashing through enemies and leaving trails of fire in his wake.

abilities.description: Hold Attack 2 to charge a rocket dash and deal damage to nearby enemies.

abilities.description: Hold Attack 2 to dash, dashing now lasts for as long as Attack 2 is held.

abilities.name: Bomb Party

trivia: Blast Zone bears a slight resemblance to the Arkeyans.
He also bears a resemblance to the Fire Skylander, Ignitor, as both Skylanders are composed of flames and wear armor.
Early concepts of Blast Zone depict him as an armored flame spirit with a horned, bull-like head, or alternatively as a technological golem that launched bombs from holes in his arms.
Blast Zone's early name was 'Blast Off'.
His catchphrase is a play on 'Fast and Furious'.

Blast Zone is voiced by Jess Harnell, who is best known for voicing Captain Hero from Drawn Together, Wakko Warner from Animaniacs, Ironhide from the Transformers films and Cedric in Sofia the First, and is the current voice actor for Crash Bandicoot.
He also voiced Gusto and Flip Wreck in Skylanders: Trap Team.
Blast Zone looks similar to the Fire Geargolems, except that Fire Geargolems are larger and look more robotic.
When on Blast Zone's Ignition path, any projectiles used by Skylanders that pass through his wall of fire will catch fire just like his bombs do and deal 12% extra damage.
Blast Zone is the second Skylander to use round bombs while Boomer is the first. However, he throws them instead of laying them on the ground and/or kicking them towards enemies.
He and Boom Jet are the only Rocket SWAP Force Skylanders. They also both work with explosives.
He and Doom Stone both have their bottom half names rhyme.
He and Spy Rise are the only SWAP Force Skylanders to not wear a belt.
There is a glitch that sometimes occurs in the Wii version where Blast will not say his catchphrase, just like in the demo version.
There is a glitch that sometimes occurs in the Wii version where the flame on top of his head won't ignite. These two glitches return in Trap Team.
In Trap Team, he sometimes has no hat.
He and Wash Buckler are the only SWAP Force Skylanders to have Dark counterparts.
He, Bumble Blast, Blastermind, Astroblast, and Blaster-Tron (character) are the only Skylanders have the word 'blast' in their names.

blaster-tron.name: Blaster-Tron
blaster-tron.description: Blaster-Tron is a futuristic robot who is one of the Light trappable villains in Skylanders: Trap Team. He later returns as a Sensei of the Knight Battle Class in Skylanders: Imaginators.
blaster-tron.biography: Blaster-Tron isn't just state-of-the-art technology, he literally is from the future. When the Skylanders traveled forward in time to stop Wolfgang, they ended up bringing back the renegade robot with hopes that they could learn from his advanced circuitry. Eon immediately noticed that he had an actual 'Good/Evil' switch that had been set to Evil. After flipping it to Good, Blaster-Tron was completely transformed. Besides going from bad robot to good robot, he ditched his blaster gun in exchange for a laser sword. No one knew exactly why, but as long as he was helping out the cause of justice, the Skylanders were happy. As a bonus, Master Eon noticed that his skill with the blade was second to none, and so he made Blaster-Tron a Sensei for the Knight Class, where he now gives 110% to training his students - which is technically possible because in the future, we figure out how to give more than 100%.
blaster-tron.personality: Blaster-Tron is a literal-minded robot with a personality heavily influenced by his programming. He often speaks in technical jargon, describing his actions and emotions as 'sequences' or 'detecting high amounts of ego.' Despite his futuristic origin and advanced weaponry, he frequently breaks the fourth wall, acknowledging game mechanics like XP balls, level ups, and the repetition of villain dialogue. Since being switched from 'Evil' to 'Good,' he is dedicated to the cause of justice, though he remains analytical and relies on scanners and prediction sensors to navigate the world.
blaster-tron.gameplay: Blaster-Tron can fire a blast of energy at enemies that comes within range. He also has a rocket pack that allows him to fly forward in the direction he is facing. In Imaginators, his sword has taken the role of his gun, firing lasers and summoning various high tech attacks depending on how much it is charged. He also gained greater control of his rocket pack for more movement, and can now fire slow-moving rockets with electric tethers and force field bombs.
