trivia: He is currently the only fully robotic playable character not part of the Tech element.
He is one of few Villains who do not resist capture (the others are Brawlrus, Eye Five, Luminous, Krankenstein, and Nightshade).
He is one of four villains who, upon being captured in a trap, vaguely reference the smell of mustard (the others are Tussle Sprout, Chompy Mage, and Chef Pepper Jack).

Blaster-Tron breaks the fourth wall in most of his sentences, announcing his transition to the game, pointing out recurring villain dialogue and discussing how his magnetic powers come out of nowhere for his Quest.
He has a forcefield present when battled as a villain that is absent in all of his playable forms.

Blaster-Tron and Bone Chompy have the ability to charge off their arenas which mostly lack walls or railings, being the only villains able to defeat themselves without any exploits as they go out of bounds.

Blaster-Tron and Pain-Yatta are the only non-Doom Raider characters to not have major changes in Imaginators, be it color scheme or element. However, while Blaster-Tron has a different weapon, Pain-Yatta just has a slightly altered lollipop.
Blaster-Tron is the only villain to have two different theme songs.
Blaster-Tron, Flameslinger, and Enigma are the only three Skylanders to not have visible eyes.

As of Imaginators, Blaster-Tron is the only Light Skylander to have none of his element's signature colors in any part of his design. However, his figure is slightly closer to silver colors than in the game.

He is the only Sensei with a Sky-Chi in which the primary attack button can be used during the sequence. Also, it drains the Sky-Chi meter much faster every time the primary attack button is pressed multiple times.
He is the only Sensei that is a hidden boss in Trap Team.
His Saber Slash ability is probably a reference to the Lightsabers from the Star Wars franchise.
His Sky-Chi is a play on the expression 'Can you believe it?'.
The quote 'End of Line' at the end of his Sky-Chi is a reference to the movie 'Tron'.

He, the Chompy Mage and Tae Kwon Crow are all villain Senseis who share the same voice actor, Alex Ness. Alex Ness also voices fellow villains Chill Bill, Brawlrus and Broccoli Guy, and fellow Skylanders Drobot, Lightning Rod and Double Trouble.

blastermind.name: Blastermind
blastermind.description: Blastermind is a purple alien-like Magic Trap Master who appeared in Skylanders: Trap Team.
blastermind.biography: Blastermind was once the 'hide and sheep' champion of the Sardonic Mountains, where he and his friends played regularly. But when he was about to set a new Skylands record, the ground collapsed and Blastermind fell into a deep, mysterious cavern filled with shimmering crystals. As his friends circled the hole up top, they suddenly found themselves face to face with a dangerous Ham Dragon, who had felt the rumble of the collapse. Down below, Blastermind felt helpless. But fortunately, the cavern was filled with Psionic Power Crystals once used by the Ancients to amplify their thoughts. When the crystals 'heard' Blastermind's worried thoughts about saving his friends, they found him worthy – and bestowed upon him awesome psionic powers, which he used to get out of the hole and mentally blast the circling Ham Dragon. Soon after, Blastermind joined the Skylanders as part of the Trap Team, using his new Traptanium Psionic Helmet to fight evil everywhere!
blastermind.personality: Blastermind is very attuned to the feelings of others and tries hard to help his friends with their problems whenever he can.
blastermind.gameplay: The Psionic Power Crystals had granted Blastermind incredible Psychic powers, such as levitating himself, as well as creating powerful blasts of brainwaves. He also has telekinesis to levitate and smash his foes against the ground, as well as shoot energy spheres that slow down his foes. His Soul Gem allows him to use his psychic powers to solve Lock Puzzles.

abilities.name: Mind Blown
abilities.description: Mind-controlled enemies damage others after going back to normal.

trivia: Blastermind and Head Rush are the only two Trap Masters with Traptanium attached to their headgears.
He and Short Cut are the shortest Trap Masters in height.

Blastermind shares many similarities with Kaos. Both have dark marking on their eyes. Both wear long coats. Both have four fingered hands, large arms and small legs. (However, Blastermind resembles more of an alien).
The Traptanium crystals on his helmet are the same shape as the base of Traps.
In-game, the Traptanium crystals on his head are crooked, but in artwork and figure, they are straight.

He doesn't get any money if you use Lock Puzzle Psychic on a Lock Puzzle. However, in Skylanders: SuperChargers, he can perform his Soul Gem ability on any Lock Puzzle, whether they are on treasure chests or doors.
When driving in SuperChargers, he steers telepathically.

He shares several similarities with the villain, Masker Mind: Both are purple creatures who float. Both have names which are plays on the term 'mastermind'. Both have quotes based on the phrase 'Mind over matter'. Both have abilities to temporarily control enemies.

bone-bash-roller-brawl.name: Bone Bash Roller Brawl
bone-bash-roller-brawl.description: Bone Bash Roller Brawl is the SuperChargers counterpart of Roller Brawl in Skylanders: SuperChargers. Her signature vehicle is the Tomb Buggy. Compared to her normal counterpart, Bone Bash Roller Brawl is much more aggressive and technical in her play style. Now with SuperCharged abilities, Roller Brawl can slash and punch enemies into submission!
bone-bash-roller-brawl.biography: Compared to her normal counterpart, Bone Bash Roller Brawl is much more aggressive and technical in her play style. Now with SuperCharged abilities, Roller Brawl can slash and punch enemies into submission! She can also throw her Fang Blades out at enemies that will eventually return to her. When she is holding onto her Fang Blades, her attacks are slow but powerful; when she is not holding onto them, her attacks are light but quick. She can also skate forward a short distance and ram into her opponents, and even blow a kiss that saps health from enemies.
bone-bash-roller-brawl.personality: Bone Bash Roller Brawl is much more aggressive and technical in her play style than her previous incarnation. She is described as the star of the show who can bewilder enemies with magnificent performances. She is keeping the enemy on their toes with aggressive upgrades that favor mobility.
bone-bash-roller-brawl.gameplay: Compared to her normal counterpart, Bone Bash Roller Brawl is much more aggressive and technical in her play style. Now with SuperCharged abilities, Roller Brawl can slash and punch enemies into submission! She can also throw her Fang Blades out at enemies that will eventually return to her. When she is holding onto her Fang Blades, her attacks are slow but powerful; when she is not holding onto them, her attacks are light but quick. She can also skate forward a short distance and ram into her opponents, and even blow a kiss that saps health from enemies. In Skylanders: SuperChargers Racing, she is notable for being one of the better all-around drivers with great Top Speed, Handling, and Acceleration.

abilities.name: Blocker Boutfit

abilities.name: Contagious Kiss

trivia: Bone Bash Roller Brawl is the only Skylander that was brought back in Superchargers that did not have a series 3 (or any repose, for that matter) for their original character.
She is the only SuperCharger Skylander to originate from Swap Force.
Her jumping attack has a similar animation and movement to the Screw Attack ability from the Metroid series, and to the Spin Attack from the Sonic series.
Unlike her Series 1 counterpart, Bone Bash Roller Brawl has eyebrows.
Also unlike her Series 1 counterpart, Bone Bash Roller Brawl is sleeveless.
While using 'Love Bites', a kissing sound can be heard.
She's the only female Skylander to own a land vehicle.

One of her quotes, 'Head over Heels', refers to someone being madly in love with someone else. This may refer to her backstory involving Kaos, where he falls in love with her and kidnaps her brothers.

When she, Big Bubble Pop Fizz, Super Shot Stealth Elf and Deep Dive Gill Grunt are placed on the portal, they say their official catchphrases in a slightly different tone of their voices. This also applies to most of their quotes, which have been completely re-recorded.

boom-bloom.name: Boom Bloom
boom-bloom.description: Boom Bloom is a mutant plant who is the Life Sensei of the Ninja Battle Class in Skylanders: Imaginators. She is available in the Enchanted Elven Forest Adventure Pack and is the main character of the fourth Skylanders: Ring of Heroes Episode Dungeon, The Flower that Bloomed from Scrap.
boom-bloom.biography: Boom Bloom was created in the laboratory of a mad scientist! After using his mutation goo to change deadwood into evil creatures, Dr. Krankcase began experimenting with live plants! But it had a much different effect. Instead of becoming subservient villains, the mutated plants instantly rebelled against their creator and tried to destroy his goo factory. Dr. Krankcase and his henchmen were able to thwart all of these insurgent plants, except for one - Boom Bloom! Her mutation gave her extraordinary Ninja skills and a thorny whip, which she used to unleash a flurry of martial arts moves that forced Dr. Krankcase to flee his own factory and vow never to experiment on plants again. Now as a Sensei of the Ninja class, she uses her incredible abilities to teach new Skylanders how to protect nature... and unleash its fury!
boom-bloom.personality: Boom Bloom is soft spoken and polite, rarely using contractions. Despite this, she's headstrong and insensitive, making rash decisions without much thought and is easily confused and embarrassed. She still retains her memories of when she was a living tree, as well as the feelings of the ones that used to be with her.
boom-bloom.gameplay: Boom Bloom is a Ninja Sensei who utilizes a thorny vine whip for rapid combos. Her gameplay focuses on crowd control using Vine Entwine to pull enemies together and Spore Seeds which can be strategically deployed and detonated for area damage. She can also utilize a powerful Sky-Chi attack involving a massive vine spin.

abilities.name: Vine Entwine

abilities.description: Have a total of four Spore Seeds active at a time.

abilities.name: Petal to the Mettle
abilities.description: Hold Attack 1 to rev up a vine wheel that explodes into four Spore Seeds.

abilities.name: Whipper Snapper
abilities.description: The ultimate Sensei Attack! Hold Special Attack to go for a spin with a Sensei-tionally large vine. Move with Left Stick to whip your enemies into shape!

abilities.name: Potent Pollen
abilities.description: When hit, Spore Seeds cover a larger area and do more damage.

abilities.name: Thorn Thrasher
abilities.description: Whip Whap does more damage and Spore Seeds shoot seeking spikes when hit.

abilities.name: In Full Bloom
abilities.description: Spore Seeds can cause an explosion when they are hit enough times.

abilities.name: Greener Grasps
abilities.description: Vine Entwine's pull reaches farther and does more damage.

abilities.name: Spikey Situations
abilities.description: Vine Entwine's burrowing spikes hit wider and do more damage.

abilities.name: Hungry Herbivore
abilities.description: Vine Entwine now grows a plant that explodes for each pulled Spore Seed.

trivia: Boom Bloom's 'hair' resembles succulent plants, a classification for plants with fleshy, thick leaves. The classification includes cacti, asparagus and aloe, which resembles the 'hair' the most with its reddish leaf tips.
Boom Bloom is the third ninja Life Skylander, after Stealth Elf and Stink Bomb.
She is also the third Life Skylander to be a mutated plant, after Tree Rex and Food Fight.
Boom Bloom and Dr. Neo Cortex are the only Senseis to not have weapons of their battle class. Though she can fire the projectiles from her pigtail leaves, her primary weapon is a whip.
Boom Bloom is one of the few Skylanders to have 'boom' in their name.
Boom Bloom is the second life Skylander whose name contains the word 'Boom' (the first being Shroomboom).
Coincidentally, both Bloom Boom and Shroomboom were created through a villain's efforts.
Despite the official renderings of her figure, Boom Bloom, unlike the other Senseis, has the Life element symbol on her base instead of the Ninja battle class symbol.
On the Skylanders Website, her catchphrase was in a noticeably deeper voice.
Though Boom Bloom is of the Ninja class, none of her abilities relate to throwing blades; instead, she specializes in their secondary abilities of trapping enemies and crowd control.
Boom Bloom was the last Sensei (not counting the villains) added to Ring of Heroes.
She was also the last Skylander added to Ring of Heroes before the game was announced to be rebooted.
Boom Bloom is the only Skylander to have an episode dungeon in the revamp of ROH.

boom-jet.name: Boom Jet
boom-jet.description: Boom Jet is a sky surfer who is one of the SWAP Force Skylanders in Skylanders: Swap Force. He is one of the Air element. His SWAP Force Ability is Rocket.
boom-jet.biography: No matter what Boom Jet did, he always had to be the best. He could be seen day and night above his home in the Billowy Cloudplains gunning his engines and performing daredevil maneuvers as he trained to become the best sky surfer in all of Skylands. Unfortunately, Boom Jet never had a chance to compete for the championship because a day came that changed his life forever. The Darkness had come. And with his town on the verge of being completely consumed by the ominous evil force, Boom Jet took action. Using his incredible flying skills, he raced from house to house, rescuing all of the citizens and carrying them to safety… just before The Darkness destroyed his homeland. It was then he realized the protection of Skylands was more important than personal glory, so he sought out Master Eon to offer his services to the Skylanders.
boom-jet.personality: Boom Jet is a complete daredevil, convinced that he always has to be the best as what he does and can seem full of himself at times. Luckily, he's as brave as he is boastful.
boom-jet.gameplay: Skylanders can use abilities depending on their level. Starting Powers: Rocket Bomb (Primary Attack): Press (Y) to throw a rocket bomb. Air Assault (Secondary Attack): Press (X) to call in an air strike to attack your enemies. Rocket (SWAP Force Power): Press (L) to hover in mid-air and move quickly while ignoring gravity. While using this ability, you are still vulnerable to damage and enemy attacks. Upgrades: Giant Rocket Bomb (requires level: 3): Hold (Y) to charge up a giant rocket bomb that does more damage in a larger area. Smoke Trail (requires level: 6): Sprinting (A) leaves a trail of smoke clouds that will damage and stun enemies that come in contact with it. Bombing Run (requires level: 9): Air Strike (X) will also drop rocket bombs that deal extra damage to enemies.

abilities.name: Football Bomb
abilities.description: Press Attack 1 to throw a football sized bomb.

abilities.name: Wind Turbine
abilities.description: Hold Attack 2 to shoot wind at nearby enemies, pushing them backwards.

abilities.name: Air Strike
abilities.description: Press Attack 3 to call for help from the skies. An airstrike shoots projectiles at enemies on the ground.

abilities.name: Tight Spiral
abilities.description: Press Attack 1 to throw a football bomb that does increased damage.

abilities.name: Go Long!
abilities.description: Hold Attack 1 to charge a football bomb, release to throw a Super Bomb.

abilities.name: Mach 1
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 two times to dash forward. Hold Attack 2 to continue bashing quickly.

abilities.name: Ace Pilot
abilities.description: Speed is increased. Tuned up with brand new turbo.

abilities.name: Turbulence
abilities.description: Hold Attack 2 to shoot three homing propellers at enemies.

abilities.name: Supply Drop
abilities.description: Air Strike has a chance to drop health supplies if health is low.

abilities.name: Mach 2
abilities.description: Your base speed is increased and a large blast damages enemies at the beginning of the dash.

abilities.name: Storm Bomb
abilities.description: Hold Attack 1 to charge a football bomb, release to create storm clouds where the bomb lands that shock nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Unfriendly Skies
abilities.description: Storm Bomb does increased damage. Shocking!

abilities.name: Bombers
abilities.description: Air Strike now drops bombs that do damage in a larger area.

abilities.name: Tight Formation
abilities.description: Press Attack 3 to call in an Air Strike that does increased damage.

abilities.name: Sky Writing
abilities.description: A smoke trail is left behind while dashing that stuns and damages enemies.

abilities.name: Thick Smoke
abilities.description: Sky Writing does increased damage and stays around longer.

abilities.name: Gun Ship
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 to shoot missiles from a powerful new mounted turret.

abilities.name: Rocket Fuel
abilities.description: New turret designs make Gun Ship do increased damage.

trivia: Boom Jet's voice actor, Roger Craig Smith, is known for his voicework of the video game character, Sonic the Hedgehog. Roger Craig Smith also does the voice of Bushwhack and Da Pinchy from Skylanders: Trap Team.
Boom Jet and Doom Stone are the only two SWAP Force Skylanders to have first names that rhyme.
He slightly resembles an NFL quarterback.
According to developer Jeremy Russo, Boom Jet totally should have been Flynn's brother.
Boom Jet is one of the few Skylanders to have 'Boom' in his name (others include Boomer, Sonic Boom, Ka-Boom, Boom Bloom and Shroomboom).

Even though Boom Jet is never seen getting off of his propeller rocket, some of the other SWAP Force Skylanders' top halves are capable of doing that with his bottom half momentarily after performing their attacks (specifically ones with melee attacks).

If you pair his top half up with Fire Kraken's bottom half, then activate 'The Big One', and then 'Go Long!' (don't throw the bomb), when Boom Kraken comes back down after the Big One, he should have a blue bomb instead of a red one.
He and Bomb Shell both say 'Bombs away!' Coincidentally, they are both explosion-based characters neither of the Fire nor Tech elements.
If you swap Doom Stone's top half onto Boom Jet's bottom half, you get Doom Jet, which, coincidentally, shares it's name with Kaos's signature vehicle.
On the versus screen, Boom's fur is colored light tan and his helmet light blue and white, instead of its normal coloring.
The name of Boom Jet's bottom half, 'Jet', is the shortest of all the SWAP Force's bottom halves, having only three letters.
An Awakened version of Boom Jet was leaked in Skylanders: Ring of Heroes, but he never appeared in the final game.
Among the three Skylanders whose abilities originated from the scrapped Skylander Breezewing, Boom Jet is the only one who didn't appear in the 3DS Starter pack.

boomer.name: Boomer
boomer.description: Boomer is a green troll Skylander in Skylanders: Spyro's Adventure. He is of the Tech element, and is notable for being the only troll to be a good guy, and have the honor of being a Skylander. He also has a St. Patrick's Day counterpart called Lucky Boomer, who is available only on Skylanders: Lost Islands.
boomer.biography: As a young troll, Boomer loved to blow things up -- particularly sheep. Later, he was drafted into the troll army, where they gave him LOTS of things to blow up. However, Boomer soon realized the sole mission of the army was war and conquest. Even though he was a troll, these things didn't interest him. So he left the trolls after saving a town from being destroyed by them. Not long after, he was invited to be a Skylander -- the only troll ever to win such an honor. Now he uses his explosive skills to fight evil... much to the relief of sheep everywhere.
boomer.personality: Blowing things up is apparently Boomer's answer to everything. He is also known for his love of blowing stuff up; a trait that is shared by all the other Trolls in Skylands. However unlike his brethren, Boomer isn't interested in war and conquest, so he turned his back on the troll lifestyle. He is considered a little odd; if at a great but dangerous height, Boomer enjoys every minute of falling or barreling down towards the ground at a frightening pace, since the resulting crash will make a huge 'boom'. Yet for being a troll he is disgusted by the sight of trolls. Boomer is bursting with manic energy, but is kind through and through. No wonder his troll mother never understood him.
boomer.gameplay: Boomer's gameplay focuses on heavy area-of-effect damage through explosives. He can lob dynamite at range or place Troll Bombs that act as stationary landmines until upgraded to be kicked. For close encounters, he uses a powerful ground smash that creates shockwaves to knock back and stun enemies. His upgrades allow him to delay explosions for tactical play or increase the number of active bombs and sticks of dynamite thrown simultaneously.

abilities.name: Dynamite Toss
abilities.description: Hurl an explosive stick of troll-grade dynamite.

abilities.name: Troll Smash
abilities.description: Smash the ground with such impact that enemies are knocked back from the furious shockwave of power.

abilities.name: Dynamite Fuse Fake-Out
abilities.description: Dynamite does increased damage. Hold down your primary power button to delay the explosion.

abilities.name: Bash Smash
abilities.description: Smash does increased damage and knocks enemies back further.

abilities.name: Troll Bomb
abilities.description: Place a Troll Bomb.

abilities.name: Triple Bundle Dynamite
abilities.description: Dynamite does even more increased damage.

abilities.name: Troll Bomb Boot
abilities.description: Troll Bombs can be kicked at enemies.

abilities.name: Bomblastic
abilities.description: Troll Bombs have bigger explosions and do increased damage.

abilities.name: Troll Bombs Away
abilities.description: You can have six Troll Bombs active at once!

abilities.name: An Accident Waiting to Happen
abilities.description: Throw 3 extra sticks of dynamite at once.

abilities.name: Havoc Smash
abilities.description: Smash does even more increased damage.

abilities.name: Stupification
abilities.description: Smash stuns enemies.

abilities.name: Megaton Charged Super Smash
abilities.description: Charge up the Smash attack, then release to do maximum damage.

trivia: Boomer, Trigger Happy, Sprocket, Chopper, Tread Head and Dr. Krankcase are the only Tech Skylanders who aren't generally robotic.
Producer Michael Graham stated that Boomer had cybernetic arms and legs due to an accident.
In the Skylanders TV Commercials, Boomer talks with a New Jersey accent. In gameplay he speaks with an American accent.
His commercial voice is similar to Terrafin's voice. This may be because they share the same voice actors, Joey Camen and Freddie Winston.
The iris and pupil in Boomer's right eye is bigger than his left eye.
Boomer appears in the artwork for Whirlwind's Soul Gem upgrade, making him the only Skylander to appear in the upgrade artwork for a different Skylander.
Boomer is one of the original Skylanders who did not receive a Series 2. However, he would later be rereleased as an Elite.
Boomer resembles Dr. Teeth from The Muppets.
Boomer is one of the few Skylanders to have 'Boom' in his name (others include Boom Bloom, Sonic Boom, Boom Jet, Shroomboom and Ka-Boom).
In Swap Force and SuperChargers, when Boomer performs his Soul Gem ability, 'Troll Bomb Boot', his bomb actually rolls instead of staying still while traveling in a straight line.

Also in Swap Force and SuperChargers, when Boomer activates 'Dynamite Fuse Fake-Out', his stick(s) of dynamite will explode as soon as it is thrown farther away even if the primary attack button is still being held down.
Boomer is one of the few playable trolls in the series (other examples are the villains, Chill Bill, Shrednaught, Bruiser Cruiser, Threatpack, Smoke Scream, Trolling Thunder, and Lob Goblin).
Boomer is the only playable troll who is a Skylander, as Metal Mage was scrapped.
Boomer is smaller than the other troll enemies. He also has brighter green skin and colored irises, whereas enemy trolls lack whites in their eyes altogether.
Boomer was originally meant to be in the starter pack for Spyro's Adventure. However, late in production, he was replaced with Trigger Happy.
Boomer and Voodood were the lowest selling Skylanders in Spyro's Adventure, notorious for being shelf-warmers.
In the Magic Kinder egg game, Boomer is an enemy (more specifically, his design is used as an enemy that blows itself up, not unlike Enfuego Chompies).
Boomer and Pop Fizz are the only two Skylanders who wear backpacks.

bop.name: Bop
bop.description: Bop is the Mini version of the Earth Skylander, Bash, in Skylanders: Trap Team.
bop.biography: The Skylander Minis started off as regular 'Sidekicks', assisting the Skylanders on many exciting adventures. And what they lacked in size they more than made up for in courage. Ultimately determined to become full-fledged heroes, they trained at the Skylands Academy - honing their powers and skills until they were ready. Now, they stand side by side with their full grown counterparts, ready to defend Skylands against Kaos and his evil minions.
bop.personality: Bop can be a little headstrong sometimes. But he never gives up, when the odds are against him. That's the true mark of a hero. He shares Bash's longing for the ability to flight.
bop.gameplay: Bop, being the Mini version of Bash, utilizes similar rock-themed attacks. He can perform close-range tail swipes and roll into enemies, dealing damage. His gameplay focuses on physical attacks and potentially defensive rock abilities, similar to Bash's earth-elemental combat style.

abilities.name: Tail Swipe
abilities.description: Bop swings his powerful tail to strike nearby enemies with earth-shattering force.

abilities.name: Rock Roll
abilities.description: Bop curls into a boulder and rolls into enemies, knocking them back.

abilities.name: Summoning: Stone Projection
abilities.description: Bop summons a stone projection to aid in combat.

abilities.name: Mace of Destruction
abilities.description: Enhances Bop's tail attacks with a mace-like force for massive destruction.

abilities.name: Gaia Hammer
abilities.description: The ultimate earth attack, slamming the ground with the force of Gaia itself.

trivia: In the Nintendo 3DS version of Skylanders: Trap Team, Bop doesn't have red sclera in his eyes, instead, he has white.
The crystals on the base of his figure are brown instead of transparent.
Before Trap Team, Bop was originally planned to be a sidekick in Spyro's Adventure. He shares this designation with Spry.

bouncer.name: Bouncer
bouncer.description: Bouncer is a Tech Skylander and one of the eight Giants in Skylanders: Giants. He also has a Legendary counterpart called Legendary Bouncer.
bouncer.biography: Long ago, Bouncer was an All-Star Roboto-Ball player. But when the Arkeyan Empire destroyed his home town and discontinued the games, he was converted into a security-bot and stationed in the mines. It was there that Bouncer encountered dozens of Mabu prisoners who remembered him fondly from his playing days. He quickly became a bit of a celebrity around the mines, and it wasn't long before this new adulation convinced him that he could be just as much of a hero in life as he was on the field. Thus, he decided to join the Skylanders and take a stand against the evil, Arkeyan overlords.
bouncer.personality: While still an All-Star Roboto-Ball player, Bouncer had a big, lively personality that helped popularized the sport. Even after he no longer plays the sport of Roboto-Ball, he still holds a sense of loyalty to his Mabu fanbase, who remembered the security-bot fondly from his playing days, and Bouncer became determined to defeat the Arkeyan King, not wanting to let his fans down when they were enslaved by the Arkeyans. Despite his dynamic personality, Bouncer holds little patience to those who are extremely arrogant and little regard to what's at hand, but keeps himself from getting too upset since he considers himself a jolly robot.
bouncer.gameplay: Bouncer's attacks include finger pistols, in which he shoots out some tiny bouncy balls, shoulder mounted cannons with which he fires powerful (and slow) missiles with a targeting computer, and can't move leaving him open to attack; and finally, I-Beam, where he shoots strong lasers from his eyes for close range combat, but it can overheat if used too long and it lowers his speed when using it.

abilities.name: Fingerguns
abilities.description: Press the Attack 1 button to shoot rapid-fire, ricocheting bouncy balls.

abilities.name: Shoulder Rockets
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 to launch rockets into the air that swiftly descend on enemies.

abilities.name: I-Beam
abilities.description: Press Attack 3 to fire concentrated laser eye beams.

abilities.name: Targeting Computer
abilities.description: Hold Attack 2 to bring up a target and control where rockets land.

abilities.name: Machine Fingerguns
abilities.description: Press Attack 1 to repeatedly fire Fingerguns at an accelerated rate.

abilities.name: Cooler I-Beam
abilities.description: Increases the damage of the I-Beam and reduces overheating.

abilities.name: Fists of Destruction
abilities.description: While holding Attack 1, press Attack 2 to fire off rocket-powered homing fists.

abilities.name: Double Targets
abilities.description: Now target 6 enemies at a time with laser-guided rockets.

abilities.name: Rockets on Demand
abilities.description: While holding Attack 2, press Attack 1 to launch unlimited rockets.

abilities.name: Atomic Clouds
abilities.description: Shoulder Rockets leave explosions that damage enemies.

abilities.name: Super Machine Fingerguns
abilities.description: Rate of fire for Fingerguns increases and they do more damage too.

abilities.name: Professionally Cool I-Beam
abilities.description: I-Beam does even more damage yet overheats slower.

abilities.name: Laser Mines
abilities.description: While holding Attack 3, press Attack 1 to drop laser mines.

trivia: His name is probably based on bouncers, which are security guards for various exclusive locations.

During production of Giants, Chopper was originally going to be the Tech Giant, but as T-Rexes were more horizontal than vertical, he wouldn't fit on the Portal of Power. Eventually, the development team tried other ideas for the Tech Giant, including a Dark Arkeyan with miniguns for hands, until they created Bouncer.
Interestingly, he and Chopper both have the ability to fire missiles.
During Giants's early development, Bouncer's abilities/upgrades were differently named, such as 'I-Beam' being called 'Unlock Laser Beams' and 'Atomic Clouds' being 'Mushroom Cloud Explosions'.
His Fingerguns resemble the hand gesture of the Oklahoma State Cowboys, as well as the gestures frequently used in the South Park episode 'Something You Can Do with Your Finger'.
He and Ninjini are the only Giants without legs.
His base is much smaller than the base of all other Giants.
Bouncer is voiced by Bumper Robinson, who also voices Bumblebee and Blitzwing in Transformers Animated, Rook Blonko and Bloxx in Ben 10: Omniverse and Falcon in 'Avengers Assemble.'
One of Bouncer's prototype color schemes has the same colors as Molten Hot Dog.

When first revealed at E3 2012, Bouncer's original biography states that he took too many hits to the head with a Roboto-Ball and decided to retire from the game, with the sport eventually fading away.
In Trap Team, Bouncer's jumping animation has been redone with him performing a backflip.
Bouncer and Eruptor are the only two Skylanders who don't sing their names near the music box in Flynn's Ship.
In the alpha version of Skylanders: Giants, Bouncer fired mini-fists instead of bouncy balls.
Bouncer's placeholder name was Robot Giant.

breeze.name: Breeze
breeze.description: Breeze is the Mini counterpart of the Air Skylander, Whirlwind. She made her debut in Skylanders: Trap Team.
breeze.biography: The Skylander Minis started off as regular 'Sidekicks', assisting the Skylanders on many exciting adventures. And what they lacked in size they more than made up for in courage. Ultimately determined to become full-fledged heroes, they trained at the Skylands Academy - honing their powers and skills until they were ready. Now, they stand side by side with their full grown counterparts, ready to defend Skylands against Kaos and his evil minions.
breeze.personality: When Breeze blows into town - look out! She likes to keep things light and airy but can be a little stubborn from time to time.
breeze.gameplay: Breeze's gameplay mirrors Whirlwind, utilizing rainbow-based projectiles and tempest clouds to control the battlefield. She is one of the few characters capable of healing allies, making her a valuable support unit. Her flight ability allows for high mobility across levels.

abilities.name: Rainbow of Doom
abilities.description: Shoot a rainbow beam at enemies.

abilities.name: Tempest Cloud
abilities.description: Create clouds that strike enemies with lightning.

abilities.name: Dragon Flight
abilities.description: Take to the skies and fly over obstacles.

abilities.name: Duel Rainbows
abilities.description: Fire two rainbows at once for increased damage.

abilities.name: Atomic Rainbow
abilities.description: A powerful rainbow explosion that deals massive damage.

trivia: Breeze and Whirlwind are currently the only Skylanders capable of healing others.
She shares the same glitches with Whirlwind in Trap Team, including colorfully-glowing horn after failing to fully charge the 'Rainbow Singularity' after taking flight.

buckshot.name: Buckshot
buckshot.description: Buckshot is a Magic Sky-Faun Sensei in Skylanders: Imaginators. He trains Imaginators of the Bowslinger Battle Class.
buckshot.biography: When Buckshot was young, he and his siblings were banished to the Magic Realm of Mysterious Mazes by an evil Spell Punk that wanted to rid Skylands of all Sky-Fauns. Buckshot spent years looking for a way out, but found no way to escape the enchanted labyrinth. Over time, however, the magic of the realm began to grow within him, strengthening his already formidable powers. While his siblings had lost all hope of freedom, Buckshot continued to test the boundaries of the maze, using his mystical bow and arrows to try to penetrate the walls around him. Eventually, Buckshot's powers became so potent that he even learned how to teleport. With this new ability, he was finally able to open a portal back into Skylands and free his siblings. Now as a Sensei of the Bowslinger class, Buckshot always keeps one eye on the target – and the other on the lookout for the Spell Punk that had banished him!
buckshot.personality: Buckshot is cheerful and energetic, but apparently not exactly smart, as he failed classes and is unable to count his own Skylander stats.
buckshot.gameplay: Buckshot can shoot his mystical arrows at enemies, and create magical Goat Portals. His Sky-Chi Power has him create so many portals around him and shoot his arrows into the portals at a fast pace.

abilities.name: Spread Shot
abilities.description: Press Attack 1 to shoot a lot of arrows at once!

abilities.name: Goat Portals
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 to create mystical Goat Portals. Shoot arrows in one portal to make them come out the other portal!

abilities.name: Through and Through
abilities.description: Arrows that go through portals do more damage.

abilities.name: Vortex Boomerang
abilities.description: Press Attack 3 to fire a magic boomerang that pulls enemies together.

abilities.name: Now You See Me
abilities.description: When you are creating portals, you move faster and stun most enemies that you touch.

abilities.name: Speedy Exit
abilities.description: After exiting a portal, you gain a burst of speed!

abilities.name: More Bang for Your Buck
abilities.description: Create a magical shockwave every time you make a portal, and have a lot more portals active at a time!

abilities.name: You've Goat to Be Kidding Me
abilities.description: The ultimate Sensei attack! Hold Special Attack to perform your Sky-Chi Power!

abilities.name: Not the Face!
abilities.description: You have a much higher chance of dealing critical hits to enemies that are very close to you.

abilities.name: Random Selection
abilities.description: Spread Shot now always includes a single, more powerful arrow that stuns enemies.

abilities.name: Where'd That Come From?
abilities.description: Portals sometimes shoot ram or sheep projectiles on their own.

abilities.name: Main Attraction
abilities.description: Goat Portals naturally pull enemies towards themselves.

abilities.name: Dimensional Damage
abilities.description: Goat Portals damage anything nearby.

abilities.name: Two for One
abilities.description: Shoot a Vortex Boomerang at a Goat Portal to destroy all Goat Portals in a huge explosion!

trivia: His catchphrase is similar to Snap Shot's early catchphrase.
Despite having very dark brown skin ingame, in the figure and the artwork it's a light brown.
Both Buckshot and Splat are currently the only Skylanders that are fauns.
According to one of his quotes while viewing his stats, he claims that he failed math class.
Buckshot's quote, 'Get outta my way, and into my car!,' is a reference to the song Get Outta My Dreams, Get Into My Car by Billy Ocean.
Buckshot's untraditional run cycle almost didn't make it into the final game because it caused too many complications.

buddy-wrecking-ball.name: Buddy Wrecking Ball
buddy-wrecking-ball.description: Buddy Wrecking Ball is the Spring counterpart of Wrecking Ball, available only on Skylanders: Lost Islands.
buddy-wrecking-ball.biography: Buddy Wrecking Ball is the Spring counterpart of Wrecking Ball, available only on Skylanders: Lost Islands.
buddy-wrecking-ball.catchphrase: Buddy Wrecking Ball has sprouted into Skylands!
buddy-wrecking-ball.gameplay: Buddy Wrecking Ball is the Spring counterpart of Wrecking Ball, available only on Skylanders: Lost Islands.
trivia: Buddy Wrecking Ball is the only spring themed variant that is not an Easter variant.

builda-grilla-drilla.name: Builda Grilla Drilla
builda-grilla-drilla.description: Builda Grilla Drilla is a construction counterpart of Grilla Drilla in Skylanders: Lost Islands. He was available on May 2014.
builda-grilla-drilla.biography: Builda Grilla Drilla is a construction counterpart of Grilla Drilla in Skylanders: Lost Islands. He was available on May 2014.
builda-grilla-drilla.catchphrase: Builda Grilla Drilla has come to fortify Skylands!
builda-grilla-drilla.personality: Builda Grilla Drilla is the construction-themed counterpart of Grilla Drilla.
builda-grilla-drilla.gameplay: Builda Grilla Drilla is an Alter Ego of Grilla Drilla specifically available in the mobile game Skylanders: Lost Islands. He was first released in May 2014 and can be obtained via the Wishing Well.
trivia: Builda Grilla Drilla is the first Alter Ego of a non-core Skylander to be available in the Wishing Well.
He is voiced by Chris Fries.

bumble-blast.name: Bumble Blast
bumble-blast.description: Bumble Blast is a living, anthropomorphic beehive or honey tree, who is one of the core Skylanders in Skylanders: Swap Force. He is of the Life element, and is available in the Fiery Forge Battle Pack and in a single pack. He has a Christmas version called Jolly Bumble Blast who is available in a single pack.
bumble-blast.biography: Bumble Blast started life as a humble beehive in the Radiant Mountains, where for ages the bees made the most sweetest, most magical honey in all of Skylands. When Kaos heard about this 'super honey', he wanted all of it for himself and soon launched an attack on the peaceful Bees. But when his minions arrived to plunder everything the bees had created, they were met by Bumble Blast. He alone had been home to the bees and considered himself their protector. Using the power of the magic honey, Bumble Blast valiantly battled the evil minions, who felt his powerful sting that day. Afterward, Bumble Blast roamed Skylands as a protector of nature, where he soon joined with the Skylanders.
bumble-blast.personality: Protective to the extreme, Bumble Blast defends all wildlife, not just his beloved bees. He places himself in danger to defend others.
bumble-blast.gameplay: Any unit that does not have abilities to run or dodge will feel his sting. Just cover them with honey and let the bees do their work.

abilities.name: Beezooka
abilities.description: Press Attack 1 to shoot honey homing bees at enemies.

abilities.name: Honey Glob
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 to shoot a big ball of honey that will coat enemies in honey when hit.

abilities.name: Honey Beecon
abilities.description: Bees will always target and attack enemies coated in honey.

abilities.name: Hungry Bees
abilities.description: Bees deal increased damage against honeyed targets.

abilities.name: Hive Mine
abilities.description: Press Attack 3 to shoot a beehive into the ground. The hive explodes into honey when an enemy approaches it.

abilities.name: Painful Stings
abilities.description: Bees gain more powerful stingers, increasing their damage!

abilities.name: Bee-Pack Backpack
abilities.description: Gain a beehive backpack that automatically launches bees at nearby foes.

abilities.name: Bee Armada
abilities.description: Hold Attack 1 to charge the Beezooka, release to shoot three bees at once.

abilities.name: Stirred up a Nest
abilities.description: A new Beezooka now shoots even more bees that do increased damage!

abilities.name: Queen Bee
abilities.description: Hold Attack 1 and charge the Beezooka even longer, release to shoot a Queen Bee that knocks enemies into the air.

abilities.name: Honey Buzz Blast
abilities.description: Hold Attack 2 to charge a honey attack, release to shoot a honey glob that contains angry bees.

abilities.name: Heavy Honey
abilities.description: Honey attacks deal increased damage and slow enemies.

abilities.name: Honeycomb Bark
abilities.description: Armor is increased. Bark skin will sometimes drip out honey that coats enemy attackers.

trivia: He, Swarm and Hot Dog are the only Skylanders with bee related moves.

His 'Beezooka' slightly resembles the Beeshooter from Plants vs. Zombies Adventures. Although his upgrade descriptions say that his 'Beezooka' shoots bees, the insects that he shoots sting more than once so it is more likely that he shoots wasps or hornets.
In his character trailer, there is an error in which the symbol for the Earth element appears next to his name instead of the Life element.
His catchphrase, 'The Perfect Swarm', might be a play on The Perfect Storm.

He is voiced by David Sobolov, who voices Depth Charge in Beast Wars, Shockwave in Transformers Prime and Lobo in Young Justice and Injustice: Gods Among Us. He also voices Krypt King and the Stone Heads in Skylanders: Trap Team.
He shares some battle cries with Swarm.

He and Shroomboom share many similarities with each other: they're both Life element characters, they both use a projectile weapon, they both have a LightCore version, and they are both first available in a battle pack.
He shares similarities to Zook, as they are both plant-like creatures who are part of the Life element and wield bazooka-based weapons.
Even though Bumble Blast is shown to be right-handed, in his Soul Gem preview, he is holding his beezooka in his left hand. He may be ambidextrous.
Bumble Blast's personal quest is named 'Not the Bees!', referencing the remake of 'The Wicker Man'.
One of his quotes is a reference to the idiom 'barking up the wrong tree'.
If an Evilized Enemy is defeated while honeyed by Bumble Blast, the freed creature will continue to be honeyed, remaining yellow and moving slowly through its animations.

bushwhack.name: Bushwhack
bushwhack.description: Bushwhack is a tree elf who is one of the Life Trap Masters in Skylanders: Trap Team.
bushwhack.biography: Born to a race of tree elves who were protectors of the rich Arcadian Timberland, Bushwhack was supposed to be a ranger. But being the smallest of his clan, he was sent deep into the woods by the Chieftain to study with Arbo, known for helping the Skylanders rebuild the Core of Light. The tree spirit looked beyond Bushwhack's size, and seeing that he had the heart of a warrior, taught him many secrets. Arbo even gifted him with an enchanted axe. So when a legion of Lumberjack Trolls invaded the forest and overpowered the elves, it was Bushwhack who set out to stop them. Drawing out the trolls, he used his enchanted axe and knowledge of the forest to capture them and destroy their tree-cutting machines. Afterward, Bushwhack not only was made a ranger but a Skylander. As part of the Trap Team, he now uses his Traptanium axe to whack evil wherever it grows!
bushwhack.personality: Bushwhack has a warrior's heart in a tiny elf body. Size doesn't matter when it comes to his passion for heroism.
bushwhack.gameplay: Bushwhack is a Life element Trap Master who wields a Traptanium Axe. His primary attacks involve swinging his axe in various combos, while his secondary attack allows him to throw Mystic Acorns to stun enemies. His upgrades allow him to use a powerful Headbash and create a 'Bush's Shack' for healing and protection. In the 3DS version, he features abilities like Log Splitter and Acorn Grenade, with level-based upgrades including Axe Spin, Head Butt, and a defensive Shield.

abilities.name: Traptanium Axe
abilities.description: Press Button 1 to swing the Traptanium Axe. Press Button 1, 1 and hold 1 for a combo attack.

abilities.name: Mystic Acorn
abilities.description: Throw a Mystic Acorn that stuns enemies.

abilities.name: Headbash
abilities.description: Press Button 3 for a powerful Headbash move, damaging anything nearby.

abilities.name: Nut Grenade!
abilities.description: Acorns now explode on impact, doing more damage.

abilities.name: In a Nut Shell
abilities.description: Get some new armor, taking reduced damage.

abilities.name: Thorn Tail
abilities.description: Traptanium Axe attack now leaves a trail of thorns that damage enemies.

abilities.name: Timber!
abilities.description: Jump and hold Button 3 to plant a giant tree, which is then cut down to smash whatever's below.

abilities.name: An Axe to Grind
abilities.description: Traptanium Axe does extra damage.

abilities.name: Combo Attacks
abilities.description: Press Button 1, 1 and hold 2 for the Slash and Spin combo, and Button 2, 2 and hold 3 for Head first combo.

abilities.name: Go Nuts!
abilities.description: Keep holding Button 3 after a Slash and Spin combo to shoot nuts in all directions.

abilities.name: Bush's Shack
abilities.description: Hold Button 2 to create a leafy hut for protection and healing.

abilities.name: Primal Warrior
abilities.description: Get new armor, taking reduced damage and doing extra damage with the Headbash Attack.

abilities.name: Spring Forward
abilities.description: Hold Button 3 to dash forward and perform a super Headbash attack.

trivia: Bushwhack is also a word for cutting or chopping down foliage to clear a path.
He is the only elven Skylander to have pupils and colored sclera.
As it appears, Bushwhack doesn't wear shoes. So he is also the only elven Skylander to be walking around barefoot.
Bushwhack is the second elven Skylander of the Life element, the first one being Stealth Elf. In addition, they both have Legendary counterparts.
He is voiced by Roger Craig Smith, who is known for being the current voice actor of Sonic the Hedgehog. Roger also voices Da Pinchy, and the Air SWAP Force Skylander, Boom Jet.
He and Jawbreaker are the only Trap Masters to have Legendary counterparts.
He, Voodood and Chopscotch use axes for weapons.
He, Stump Smash and Chompy Mage all use acorns to attack enemies. Stink Bomb also uses acorns to attack if his 'The Art of Acorns' upgrade path is chosen.
Despite numerous sources referencing his small stature, in game Bushwhack is actually taller than most other Skylanders.
Bushwhack was one of the many Skylanders planned to appear in Skylanders: Ring of Heroes. Before the game's closure, only concept art of his Awakened Form was released.

buttered-pop-thorn.name: Buttered Pop Thorn
buttered-pop-thorn.description: Buttered Pop Thorn is a movie theater counterpart of Pop Thorn in Skylanders: Lost Islands.
buttered-pop-thorn.biography: Buttered Pop Thorn is a movie theater counterpart of Pop Thorn in Skylanders: Lost Islands.
buttered-pop-thorn.catchphrase: Buttered Pop Thorn has popped into Skylands!!
buttered-pop-thorn.gameplay: Buttered Pop Thorn is a movie theater counterpart of Pop Thorn in Skylanders: Lost Islands.
trivia: Buttered Pop Thorn is the first Lost Islands variant to be an Air element.
His name is a pun of the phrase 'buttered pop corn'.
He is voiced by Chris Edgerly.

camo.name: Camo
camo.description: Camo is a plant/dragon hybrid core Skylander in Skylanders: Spyro's Adventure. His Series 2 counterpart is called Thorn Horn Camo.
camo.biography: Hatched at the roots of the Tree of Life, Camo is half-dragon, half-plant – with effervescent life energy flowing through his scaly leaves. This power allows him to cultivate fruits and vegetables at a highly-accelerated rate, which causes them to explode when they ripen. Camo's unique gift caught the eye of Master Eon, initially because he was hungry and tried to eat a melon that exploded in his face. But upon realizing his true power, Eon convinced Camo to help the Skylanders protect their world.
camo.personality: Like most dragons, Camo loves a laugh. He is a real prankster, with one of his favorite tricks creating fruit and vegetables that explode in your shocked face! Despite his love of pranks, Camo is serious when it comes to protecting Skylands and its inhabitants.
camo.gameplay: As a result of being half plant and half dragon, Camo can quickly grow fruits and vegetables that explode when they become ripe. His standard attacks involves firing bursts of solar energy from his mouth and conjuring vines of peppers from his tail that explode like firecrackers at enemies around them. He can also grow a ring of melons around him and send them flying and exploding at surrounding enemies. His Wow Pow lets him grow exploding pumpkins that explode into smaller pumpkins.

abilities.name: Sun Burst
abilities.description: Camo can blast enemies with concentrated life energy in the form of a tiny sun.

abilities.name: Firecracker Vines
abilities.description: Conjure a vine of rapid growth and incredibly explosive bounty.

abilities.name: Searing Sun Blast
abilities.description: Sun Blast does increased damage.

abilities.name: Melon Fountain
abilities.description: Send melons flying everywhere.

abilities.name: Firecracker Food
abilities.description: Firecracker Vines do increased damage.

abilities.name: Vigorous Vines
abilities.description: Firecracker Vines move quicker and further.

abilities.name: Orbiting Sun Shield
abilities.description: Create a Sun Blast shield.

abilities.name: Explosive Harvest
abilities.description: Any melons can turn into explosive SUPERMELONS and launch at enemies.

abilities.name: Martial Bounty
abilities.description: Firecracker Vines create more exploding melons.

abilities.name: Peppers of Potency
abilities.description: Firecracker Vines do even more increased damage.

abilities.name: Proliferation
abilities.description: Create two Firecracker Vines at once.

abilities.name: Ring of Might
abilities.description: The Melon Fountain blasts out more melons.

abilities.name: Melon GMO
abilities.description: The Melon Fountain does increased damage.

abilities.name: Melon Fortress
abilities.description: Hide in the Melon Fountain, then send Melons flying.

trivia: When he's not protecting Skylands, Camo tends Eon's vegetable garden.
Camo's favorite food is exploding melons.

The peppers Camo that grow from his tail are among the hottest in all of Skylands. Only the Fire Skylander, Eruptor, has ever been able to eat a whole one. He appeared to have no lasting effects, but he did spend almost a week having to lie down in a darkened room afterwards, and he hasn't been able to look at spicy food since.
In Giants, Camo commonly says fruit and vegetable-related puns and jokes when he talks.
In Giants, Camo's melon attack grants him total invincibility while he is underground in his animation.

He, Spyro, Cynder and Whirlwind are the only four dragons originally from Spyro's Adventure to return in Swap Force. Coincidentally, all except Cynder will have their horns altered in appearance after obtaining their Wow Pow abilities.

Early Swap Force promo boxes at the time had the mistake of labeling Camo as a Series 3 character. This was most likely because Camo was the only Skylander with a Series 2 counterpart in Swap Force who was originally from Spyro's Adventure.

In Swap Force, there is a glitch that Series 2 Camo can pull off where, if on the Melon Master path, one of the attack 3 buttons is held down and the other is pressed rapidly, another ring of melons will grow on top of the first. If this glitch is done with Series 1 Camo, the melon ring will simply replenish itself indefinitely. This glitch will not work on the Wii version.

In Skylanders Giants, there is a glitch with Camo's melon attack on giant bounce pads found in the Jump For It! Heroic Challenge. Doing so will cause the melons to not shrink/despawn, as long as the attack 3 button is held.
Camo's Wow Pow causes his vines to occasionally grow melons, however, this is not mentioned in the upgrade's description.
Camo's voice actor, André Sogliuzzo, is also the voice of Sparx (both the original and Skylanders incarnations).
Camo's name is derived from 'camouflage'. His name is also the name of a municipality in the province of Cuneo in the Italian region Piedmont.
He and Zap are the only two dragon Skylanders included in battle packs (Scorpion Striker and Arkeyan Crossbow). Coincidentally, both of their figures were Series 2s.

If Camo is drawn into a dialogue scene in Giants while his sun shield is active, his orbs will continue to circle him for the duration of the dialogue, only to disappear without healing him when the dialogue ends.

candy-coated-chopscotch.name: Candy-Coated Chopscotch
candy-coated-chopscotch.description: Candy-Coated Chopscotch is the Halloween counterpart of Chopscotch in Skylanders: Imaginators.
candy-coated-chopscotch.biography: The only thing that ever mattered to Chopscotch was mastering her weapon of choice, the giant axe, while rocking out to her favorite musical idol, Wolfgang. It never bothered her that she was short in stature or that all of the other ghouls in the Underworld laughed at the way she spoke in rhymes as she made up her own lyrics to Wolfgang's guitar jams. So when Wolfgang joined the villainous Doom Raiders, she was devastated. But instead of letting it destroy her, she chose to put her axe skills to good use, and fought Wolfgang and his Moon Goons when they attempted to curse her entire town during an evil concert. Her willingness to stand up to her long time hero came as a surprise to everyone, and soon all of the villagers were speaking in rhymes in her honor. Soon after, she met Master Eon, who was so impressed at her fighting abilities and positive outlook that he recruited her as a Sensei for the Smasher Class. Now she teaches new Skylanders how to fight… and how to rhyme!
candy-coated-chopscotch.personality: Chopscotch is a determined and positive ghoul who refuses to let her height or others' opinions get in her way. She is a dedicated fan of music and expresses herself through rhymes. She possesses a strong moral compass, even standing up to her own idol when he turned to evil.
candy-coated-chopscotch.gameplay: As a Smasher Class Sensei, Candy-Coated Chopscotch uses her giant axe to deliver powerful melee attacks. Her fighting style includes a combination of rapid chops, spinning area-of-effect attacks, and the ability to use her own head as a weapon. She also uses rhythmic movements and jumping techniques to control the battlefield.

abilities.name: Chop Chop Chop
abilities.description: Perform a series of axe chops to defeat enemies.

abilities.name: Spin to Win
abilities.description: Spin with the giant axe to deal damage to surrounding foes.

abilities.name: Lose Your Head
abilities.description: Detach and throw your head at enemies for a ranged attack.

abilities.name: Jump Attract
abilities.description: Perform a powerful jump that attracts nearby enemies toward the point of impact.

abilities.name: Axe Frenzy
abilities.description: Unleash a devastating frenzy of axe strikes.

trivia: Candy-Coated Chopscotch is the Halloween-themed counterpart of the Undead Smasher, Chopscotch.
She is one of the few Senseis to have a seasonal variant released for the Skylanders: Imaginators game.
Her biography mentions her idol, Wolfgang, who is also an Undead Sensei in the same game.

chain-reaction.name: Chain Reaction
chain-reaction.description: Chain Reaction is a Tech Sensei of the Swashbuckler Battle Class in Skylanders: Imaginators.
chain-reaction.biography: No matter what he was doing, Chain Reaction always prided himself at being the best at it. Despite his impressive skills, though, the two chainsaw swords he regularly wielded tended to scare most people away. As a result, Chain Reaction was often lonely. But that all changed the day he witnessed a group of young dwarves getting picked on by an evil gang of ninja rats, the dwarves looked at Chain Reaction as their hero, and followed him everywhere he went. While Chain Reaction appreciated the company, he knew that he could not protect them forever, so he decided to teach them all he knew so that they could one day protect themselves. Sometime later, Master Eon heard rumors about dwarves from a small village who had successfully defended themselves against a large army of ninja rats thanks to the teachings of a great master. He knew at once that he needed to find Chain Reaction and make him a Sensei.
chain-reaction.personality: Chain Reaction appears to very vain and conceited, constantly complimenting himself with adjectives such as 'handsome' and 'charming'. However, he doesn't seem to brag too much on himself unlike certain Skylanders such as Lightning Rod and Ro-Bow, always remaining noble and humble when around others.
chain-reaction.gameplay: Chain Reaction uses dual chainsaw swords to perform rapid melee combos and can summon inventions that attack enemies. As a Sensei, he can perform the powerful Saw and Conquer Sky-Chi ability, where he drives a giant invention into his enemies. He can also jump into the air with Thunderslam and rev his saws while running through enemies.

abilities.name: Chainsaw Combo
abilities.description: Press Attack 1 to slash. Press it thrice for a Chainsaw Combo.

abilities.name: Summon Invention
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 to summon an Invention. The Invention's attack speed scales with energy. This attack consumes all available energy.

abilities.name: Running With Chainsaws
abilities.description: Hold Attack 1 to cut through enemies while running around.

abilities.name: Thunderslam
abilities.description: Press Attack 3 to leap into the sky and strike down at a targeted location.

abilities.name: Improved Energy Hoarding
abilities.description: Increases the maximum energy cap.

abilities.name: Overload
abilities.description: Hitting an Invention with Thunderslam causes it to explode.

abilities.name: Lightning God
abilities.description: Shoots lightning down while aiming Thunderslam.

abilities.name: Saw and Conquer
abilities.description: The ultimate Sensei attack! Hold Special Attack to perform your Sky-Chi Power! Drive a giant invention into you enemies! Use Left Stick to move around!

abilities.name: Charged Bolt
abilities.description: Chainsaw melee attacks create three charged bolts.

abilities.name: Improved Charged Bolt
abilities.description: Chainsaw melee attacks create charged bolts whenever an enemy is damaged.

abilities.name: Chainsaw Combo Finishers
abilities.description: Press Attack 1 twice, Attack 2 for a chainsaw rush combo. Or Attack 1 twice, Attack 3 for a short circuit berserker combo.

abilities.name: Maximum Energy
abilities.description: Increases the maximum energy cap.

abilities.name: Explosive Work
abilities.description: Inventions explode upon deactivation.

abilities.name: Lightning Nova
abilities.description: Inventions emit electric shockwaves periodically.

trivia: His name is a term for a physics and chemistry phenomenon, where a reactive product or byproduct causes additional reactions to take place without extra input; this is similar to knocking down a line of dominoes.
He is the only male Swashbuckler Sensei.
He is also the only Swashbuckler Sensei without an in-game variant.
He is also the only non-villain Tech Sensei to not be part of an Adventure Pack.
When voice actor Charlie Adler, who was part of the Imaginators voice cast, was asked on social media who he voiced in the game, he responded, 'I'm not sure. I think Chain Reaction ....'.

charming-cobra-cadabra.name: Charming Cobra Cadabra
charming-cobra-cadabra.description: Charming Cobra Cadabra is a Valentine's Day counterpart of Cobra Cadabra who appears on February 2015 exclusive to Skylanders: Lost Islands.
charming-cobra-cadabra.biography: Charming Cobra Cadabra is a Valentine's Day counterpart of Cobra Cadabra who appears on February 2015 exclusive to Skylanders: Lost Islands. He bears more of a resemblance to King Cobra Cadabra due to his white color scheme and is the third Valentine's day Skylander released in the series.
charming-cobra-cadabra.catchphrase: Charming Cobra Cadabra will cast a spell on your heart!
charming-cobra-cadabra.personality: Charming Cobra Cadabra is a romantic and charming variant of Cobra Cadabra. He shares many aesthetic similarities with Love Potion Pop Fizz, both being pink-themed Magic element male Skylanders released for Valentine's Day in 2015.
charming-cobra-cadabra.gameplay: Charming Cobra Cadabra was released as an exclusive playable Alter Ego for the mobile game Skylanders: Lost Islands in February 2015. He functions as a seasonal variant with a unique pink and white color scheme.
trivia: Charming Cobra Cadabra bears more of a resemblance to King Cobra Cadabra due to his white color scheme.
He is the first Lost Islands exclusive Skylander in 2015.
He is the third Valentine's day Skylander (Behind Cupid Flameslinger and Love Potion Pop Fizz).
Charming Cobra Cadabra shares similarities with Love Potion Pop Fizz: both of them are Magic element male Skylanders, both of them are pink, and both of them are Valentine's Day variants of 2015.

chill.name: Chill
chill.description: Chill wears silver and ice blue armor with a blue long sleeved shirt and pants underneath. She has a silver helmet with small three ice blue horns on the sides. Underneath the helmet, she has blue hair, which is rarely seen. Her eyes are blue as well as her lips. She wields a javelin and shield made of ice.
chill.biography: Chill was the sworn guardian and personal protector of the Snow Queen. As captain of the queen's guard, her many heroic deeds earned her the respect of the entire ice kingdom. But when the Cyclops army began to expand their empire into the northern realms, the Snow Queen was taken prisoner during her watch and Chill has never forgiven herself for letting it happen. Ashamed and embarrassed, she left the Ice Kingdom behind and sworn never to return until she could reclaim her honor. Now as a member of the Skylanders, she remains courageous and strong, while always on the lookout for her lost queen.
chill.personality: As captain of the Queen's guard, Chill was once the most feared and respected of all the people in the Ice Kingdom. She is a proud, noble warrior - but not afraid to play dirty.
chill.gameplay: Chill is a versatile Water Skylander who excels at both defense and offense. She utilizes ice javelins for ranged combat and can create ice walls to block enemies or provide cover. Her unique ability to summon a narwhal provides high burst damage, while her shield-based upgrades allow her to block incoming attacks effectively. In her Series 2 form, she gains the ability to launch mini orcas from her ice walls for additional crowd control.

abilities.name: Ice Javelin
abilities.description: Press the Attack 1 button to throw a spinning ice javelin.

abilities.name: Ice Wall
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 to summon a wall of ice blocks. Can use for protection or to knock back enemies.

abilities.name: The Great Wall
abilities.description: Hold Attack 2 to extend the length of an ice wall.

abilities.name: Glacial Bash
abilities.description: Press Attack 3 to bash enemies and ice wall blocks with your shield.

abilities.description: New armor provides increased protection.

abilities.name: Cold Front
abilities.description: Hold Attack 3 to keep the shield raised and block attacks from the front.

abilities.name: Call The Narwhal!
abilities.description: Hold Attack 1 to charge and summon a narwhal friend!

abilities.name: Orcastration!
abilities.description: Hold Attack 2 longer and mini orcas appear inside the ice wall, then release to shatter the wall and launch orcas.

abilities.name: Brrrr Blade
abilities.description: New ice javelin does increased damage.

abilities.name: Shatterspear
abilities.description: Javelins now split into separate ice spears when passing through an Ice Wall.

abilities.name: Triple Javelins
abilities.description: Throw three ice javelins at once.

abilities.name: Ice Breaker
abilities.description: Ice Wall blocks explode when struck by an ice javelin or by an enemy.

abilities.name: On the Rocks
abilities.description: Exploding ice blocks freeze enemies into ice cubes of their own.

abilities.name: Better Bash
abilities.description: Glacial Bash hits multiple enemies and Ice Wall blocks in a larger area.

trivia: Chill, Freeze Blade, Slam Bam and King Pen are the only four Skylanders who have ice abilities.
She and Slam Bam are both the only Water Skylanders with legendary counterparts. both of which first appeared in Giants.
She, Slam Bam, Freeze Blade, Grave Clobber and Dive-Clops are the only five Water Skylanders not based on aquatic creatures.
On some variants of her Series 1 figures, her lips are painted purple instead of blue.
In Giants' early development, some of Chill's upgrades/abilities were differently named and arranged.
She says her call 'Narwhal!' In three different tones.
Because her ears are hidden under her helmet, Chill's exact species is unknown.
It's unlikely that she is an elf, however, as the known elves with irises have dark pupils.
Chill's hair is blue. This can be seen by the viewers if you look closely in the 3DS version of Skylanders: Giants and in Skylanders: Cloud Patrol.
However, on her toy version, you can see a little bit of her hair under the helmet, and it somehow appears to be blonde.
In early development, Chill was called Ice Sorceress. She spoke in a high-pitched voice, and her original catchphrase was 'Let's break the ice!'.
She, Doom Stone, Ignitor, Chop Chop, Flip Wreck, Wildfire, and High Volt are the only Skylanders who use shields.
She speaks with a thick Russian accent.
Chill is voiced by Julie Nathanson, who is the third voice of Belle from Beauty and the Beast.
Her quote 'Chill power' may be a pun on 'will power.'
She, Tidepool and Rip Tide are the only three Water Skylanders who can summon cetacean allies to attack. Chill calls forth the narwhal to ram into enemies.
In Giants, Swap Force and Trap Team, in the image for Call the Narwhal, two penguins can be seen riding the narwhal.
It is possible that the face on Blizzard Chill's shield is the face of the Snow Queen she guarded.

chompy-mage.name: Chompy Mage
chompy-mage.description: The Chompy Mage is a former antagonist who first appeared as the boss of Wilikin Village in Skylanders: Giants. He is a wizard aligned with the Life element who has the ability to summon Chompies and transform into a giant Chompy. He formerly disliked anyone who isn't a Chompy, and always has a Chompy puppet on his left hand which he occasionally speaks for. His brother is the Sheep Mage.
chompy-mage.biography: Believe it or not, the Chompy Mage actually hatched from inside a Chompy Pod. At least that is how his Chompy hand puppet tells the story. Having been raised by Chompies, it is no surprise that the old magician is a little strange. He simply grew up embracing the Chompy way – believing that Skylands would be a better place if everyone was a Chompy – an illegal enchantment which he has actually tried to perform on several occasions.
chompy-mage.personality: The Chompy Mage is obsessed with Chompies, so much that he dresses like one and formerly didn't like anyone who isn't a Chompy. Aside from that, he also appeared to have little to no respect for others but his own allies, constantly annoying Flynn until he warmed up to him during the credits of Giants. However, after becoming a Doom Raider, the Chompy Mage showed great respect towards his fellow villains, not intending to turn them into Chompies, knowing that doing so would anger them greatly. He's also convinced he is a natural singer, though other characters believe otherwise. His Chompy puppet appears to be a split personality or have a mind of its own occasionally, rather childish and carefree; it is seen mocking or looking away from other people during Trap Team cutscenes while the Mage appears to be paying attention to them, replying to him, and in SuperChargers staring down into another Chompy in their vehicle before the Chompy Mage shooed it away. In Battlecast, it also frequently replies to him and talks to the opponents. After his rehabilitation in Skylanders: Imaginators, the Chompy Mage still holds on to his love for Chompies, but he now believes that they should be used for good instead of evil. Additionally, he has made amends with every faculty member and Skylander at Skylanders Academy, meaning that he has buried every hatchet with his new allies and friends despite his past evildoing, but he still has some patching up to do with the Wilikins he pestered in Giants. However, he is willing to turn his enemies into Chompies only if they deserve it.
chompy-mage.gameplay: Being a wizard, the Chompy Mage has the ability to summon magic that can either be harmful or heal the Skylanders; switching the worlds will reverse their properties. He also has the ability to transform into a giant Chompy, and summon Chompies with a wave of his staff. The Chompy Mage can use his staff's magic to turn anyone into a Chompy. He can also summon a forcefield to protect himself, or teleport when the time calls for it. As a giant Chompy, the Chompy Mage can release eggs that would hatch into regular Chompies or Enfuego Chompy, depending on which world they are in. He can also blow gusts of wind, and inhale to draw the Skylander towards it to bite them. In Trap Team, the Chompy Mage reveals the ability to change into his Super Magma form while in his Chompy stage. In Skylanders: Battlecast, that is extended when he also shows the ability to change his element to Water and become a Jumbo Frigid Chompy, or become a Jumbo Enfuego Chompy with the Fire element.

abilities.name: Chompzooka!
abilities.description: Press Attack 1 to shoot live Chompies out of your 'bazooka'.

abilities.name: Talk to the Hand!
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 and the puppet screams with a burst of life flavored magic (tastes like chicken).

abilities.name: Chompy Pile!
abilities.description: Press Attack 3 to transform into a pile of angry Chompies! Press the Jump Button to jump out of the pile, which will keep going for a short distance on its own.

abilities.name: Staff Shot
abilities.description: Press and hold Attack 1 to launch a magical exploding staff.

abilities.name: A Corn!
abilities.description: Talk to the Hand! now coughs up exploding acorn. Mmmm... corns!

abilities.name: What a Dashing Pile!
abilities.description: Press Attack 1 to dash forward when in pile form. Pile now does more damage!

abilities.name: Chompies to Go Please
abilities.description: Jump then press Attack 3 while in the air to break the Chompy pile up into individual minions.

abilities.name: BoingZooka!
abilities.description: The ultimate Sensei attack! Hold Special Attack to perform your Sky-Chi Power and ride the BoingZooka like a Pogo Stick!

abilities.name: Bitey Chompies!
abilities.description: Chompies now latch onto enemies and chew on them for a bit.

abilities.name: Giant Bitey Chompies!
abilities.description: Bitey Chompies transform into Large Chompies. Large Chompies hang around longer than Bitey Chompies.

abilities.name: Pile Launcher!
abilities.description: Chompies jump out of the pile and attack enemies.

abilities.name: Get Thee to a Shrubbery!
abilities.description: Acorns now spout poisonous shrubbery.

abilities.name: Here Lies a Chompy
abilities.description: Chompies now leave behind shrubbery.

abilities.name: Shrubsplode!
abilities.description: Shrubs now explode! You win Shrub, you lose Shrub.

trivia: He thinks he is a great singer, but he is in fact pretty bad.
He loves enchiladas, like Flynn, Sharpfin, and Buzz.
Flynn has offered to help him find a new job.

The Chompy Mage is the only Doom Raider who wasn't seen in the opening cutscene of Trap Team along with the other Doom Raiders; this is because the Chompy Mage was imprisoned in Cloudcracker Prison sometime after the other Doom Raiders were first incarcerated.
As he appears on the Dread-Yacht's dingy during the credits of Giants, it appears that he can teleport.

The Chompy Mage is very similar to his brother or cousin, the Sheep Mage. Both have left hand puppets of their respective animals, transform into large versions of them, and possess the ability to blow and inhale large amounts of air.
He is also similar to Clopin in The Hunchback of Notre Dame; both of them have puppets of their favorite things.
His magic attack is similar to the Hydra's Life elemental powers, though lacking the bugs.
The Chompy Mage is one of the four trappable villains who, upon being captured in a trap, vaguely references the smell of mustard (the others are Blaster-Tron, Tussle Sprout and Chef Pepper Jack).
He and the Bone Chompy are the only trappable villains who first appeared in Giants.
The Chompy Mage is the only Doom Raider and Sensei who first appeared in Giants.
Any hat he wears is placed on his Chompy Puppet's head, instead of his own.
The Chompy Mage is voiced by Alex Ness, who is the Chief of Staff at Toys for Bob. The voice was inspired by the 1980's version of Skeletor.
The upgrade 'Get Thee to a Shrubbery!' references the Knights Who Say Ni in Monty Python & The Holy Grail.
Chompy Mage's regular figure was exclusively sold online in an Amazon-exclusive 5-pack, making it one of the rarest Senseis.

chop-chop.name: Chop Chop
chop-chop.description: Chop Chop is an Undead Arkeyan warrior and one of the Core Skylanders in Skylanders: Spyro's Adventure. He has a Legendary counterpart called Legendary Chop Chop that was exclusive to the Legendary Triple Pack available only at Toys 'R' Us. His Series 3 Skylander is called Twin Blade Chop Chop.
chop-chop.biography: Chop Chop was once an elite warrior belonging to the ancient race of Arkeyan beings. Like many of the Arkeyans, he was created from a hybrid of elements - in his case, Undead magic and technology. Chop Chop is a relentless, highly-skilled soldier who wields a sword and shield made of an indestructible metal. With the Arkeyans having vanished long ago, Chop Chop wandered Skylands for centuries looking for his creators. Eventually, he was found by Eon and recruited as a Skylander.
chop-chop.personality: With his skeletal frame, cold voice, and tremendous abilities, Chop Chop is often assumed to be a bit of a frightening fellow. In truth, he is a very frightening fellow. Despite that however, he appears to possess a sense of honor, as shown by his dedication to finding those who created him. Despite this, Chop Chop is known to use his shield to take the children of Skylands sledding. It is likely that the children enjoy this, though their screams make it difficult to tell.
chop-chop.gameplay: As a Skylander that uses sword and shield, Chop Chop can both fight and defend himself. Chop Chop can swing his sword in varying combos to attack enemies in front of him, and raising his shield will reduce damage taken from incoming attacks and reflect projectiles. After a few basic upgrades, he can perform a shield bash attack and unleash Bone Brambles that attack enemies directly in front of him for a distance. He can also upgrade his sword so that enemies defeated by it leave behind orbs that will heal him. Choosing the Vampiric Warrior path allows further upgrading to Chop Chop's Arkeyan Blade, catering towards a more aggressive if not reckless 'high risk, high reward' play style. Choosing the Undead Defender path allows further upgrading to Chop Chop's Arkeyan Shield, catering towards a more patient 'a good offense is a great defense' play style.

abilities.name: Shield Stun Bash

abilities.name: Demon Shield of the Shadows
