trivia: Chop Chop, Chill, Doom Stone, Ignitor, Wildfire, Flip Wreck and High Volt are the only seven Skylanders who use shields. Ignitor, however, wears it as a part of his armor instead of using it for combat.
He resembles the skeletons from The 7th Voyage of Sinbad and Jason and the Argonauts. Both are skeletons that wield swords and shields.

Series 1 Chop Chop has translucent jewelry and coins on his pedestal, where as his Series 2 and 3 counterparts do not. He is also the only Skylander to have a specific design on his base that no other Skylander possess, with the exception of Kaos.
As he is an Arkeyan, several enemies and statues in their dwellings have helmets that resemble Chop Chop's.
As a Series 3 figure, he has shoulder pads with spikes. However, in the game, they don't show up on him or are related to any upgrades, even after obtaining his Wow Pow.
He, Shroomboom, Pop Thorn, Magna Charge, Blades, Jawbreaker, Spotlight, and Ambush all have their Soul Gems in the first level of their respective games.
He bears many similarities with Krypt King, as in development, Krypt King was designed to be an 'ultra' Chop Chop.
He is the only Skylander with an Elite counterpart in Trap Team who does not have a Sidekick or Mini based on him.
Chop Chop's helmet looks similar to Arthas from World of Warcraft. (Some people may confuse this helmet to be his actual face as the four yellow dots on the front seem to resemble a surprised face).
He, Whirlwind and Spyro are the only three Skylanders with Elite counterparts who have not been reposed for Skylanders: SuperChargers. He is the only one of these who is bipedal.

During Wow Pow (Series 3) a small glitch can occur, where Chop Chop holds both blades in his hand. When trying to block, he will use the second blade instead, holding it in a crooked way. It will fix itself if you perform the Wow Pow again. This glitch happens in Skylanders: Swap Force.
There is also a glitch in Giants where, when striking the damage-immune portion of an Inhuman Shield enemy, Chop Chop will activate Vampiric Aura and gain health as though he defeated an enemy.
Twin Blade Chop Chop's artwork can be seen in the Season 1 intro of the Skylanders Academy TV series within The Book of Skylanders.

His Series 2 figure and artwork shows his sword and shield having the Demon Blade of The Underworld and Arkeyan Spectral Shield upgrades respectively. Both upgrades being impossible to have simultaneously in-game as they're from different upgrade paths.
Chop Chop's working name was originally Pandoran Elite.

chopper.name: Chopper
chopper.description: Chopper is a T-Rex who is one of the core Tech Skylanders in Skylanders: Trap Team. Despite his small size, he is a mechanical genius who used his inventions to save his village from a volcanic eruption.
chopper.biography: Growing up, Chopper was much smaller than the rest of his dinosaur kin. But this didn't bother him because he had big ideas. Ahead of the annual hunting competition to honor the village idol, Roarke Tunga, Chopper spent weeks building himself a super Gyro-Dino-Exo-Suit. When the competition began, he took the air – firing his missiles and chomping everything in his path. With Chopper on the verge of victory, the competition came to a sudden halt when the nearby volcano erupted, flooding the village with lava. Seeing the residents of his village trapped, Chopper quickly flew into action. One at a time, he airlifted everyone to safety. And was even able to save the village idol. For heroically using his head, Chopper was made a Skylander!
chopper.personality: Chopper might be a little guy, but he's got big ideas. His passion and bravery always impress his teammates.
chopper.gameplay: Chopper is an agile Tech Skylander who utilizes mechanical augmentations for aerial mobility and explosive firepower. He can fly by double-tapping the jump button, which allows him to rain down rockets from above. His abilities focus on a combination of long-range Raptor Rockets and close-quarters Chopper Blades, complemented by a powerful Roar attack that can be upgraded for massive range and damage.

trivia: Chopper is the first dinosaur Skylander who is not of the Earth element.
He was originally set to be the Tech Giant of Skylanders: Giants, but as T-Rexes are more horizontal than vertical, Chopper didn't fit onto the portal with other toys. His successor is Bouncer.
His name and species may have been a reference to Chomper from The Land Before Time series.
He, Chop Chop and Chopscotch are the only Skylanders who have the word 'Chop' in their names.
Chopper appears to wear a pair of reddish fingerless gloves in the game even though his artwork and figure don't show them.
He and Krypt King were both planned to be in Giants, but were scrapped and redesigned to be later released for Trap Team.
Despite not having a flight upgrade, Chopper can fly by double tapping the jump button.
His catchphrase is a pun on 'dynamite.'

Chopper is one of designer I-Wei Huang's favorite Skylanders. According to Huang, Chopper is a Skylander who 'captured the essence' of his design, a character who broke all of the rules but worked nevertheless.
When you place Chopper in Skylanders: SuperChargers Racing, he will say 'Dino Time!' instead of 'Dino Might!'.
Tri-Tip 'stole' Chopper's catchphrase.

chopscotch.name: Chopscotch
chopscotch.description: Chopscotch is a short and young Undead ghoul and a Sensei in Skylanders: Imaginators, belonging to the Smasher Battle Class.
chopscotch.biography: The only thing that ever mattered to Chopscotch was mastering her weapon of choice, the giant axe, while rocking out to her favorite musical idol, Wolfgang. It never bothered her that she was short in stature or that all of the other ghouls in the Underworld laughed at the way she spoke in rhymes as she made up her own lyrics to Wolfgang's guitar jams. So when Wolfgang joined the villainous Doom Raiders, she was devastated. But instead of letting it destroy her, she chose to put her axe skills to good use, and fought Wolfgang and his Moon Goons when they attempted to curse her entire town during an evil concert. Her willingness to stand up to her long time hero came as a surprise to everyone, and soon all of the villagers were speaking in rhymes in her honor. Soon after, she met Master Eon, who was so impressed at her fighting abilities and positive outlook that he recruited her as a Sensei for the Smasher Class. Now she teaches new Skylanders how to fight... and how to rhyme!
chopscotch.personality: Chopscotch loves speaking in rhyme and wasn't bothered when the other ghouls of the Underworld made fun of her short stature.
chopscotch.gameplay: Chopscotch can swing around her giant axe and use its weight to her advantage, being able to spin with it for long periods of time. She can also detach her head and duplicate it, creating a helper that will attack along, and conjure hopscotch titles, creating a blast of flashy Undead energy when she reaches the end.

trivia: Chopscotch is the only Skylander to speak in rhymes, though others only do so while singing.

Chopscotch is a pun on Hopscotch, a children's game about skipping rectangles marked on the ground, which she can do as part of her Soul Gem. Her Undead element might refer to the game's theme in some countries, about a journey in the afterlife.
Though short bodies lacking torsos are associated with the Ninja class, Chopscotch has these features and is a Smasher.
The patterns in Chopscotch's skull-like face resemble Bad Juju's.
Like Bad Juju, her face is detached from her body.
In her idle animation, Chopscotch takes her eyes out to inspect it before putting it back in her skull.
Unlike most characters with Undead particle effects, hers include bugs such as small spiders.

Chopscotch's voice actor, Hynden Walch, is known for voicing Starfire and Blackfire from Teen Titans, DC Superhero Girls and Teen Titans Go!, Viridi, the Goddess of Nature from Kid Icarus: Uprising, Harley Quinn from The Batman and Batman: Assault on Arkham, Princess Bubblegum from Adventure Time and Summer Hugglemonster in Henry Hugglemonster. She also voiced Crash Bandicoot's younger sister, Coco Bandicoot, in the 1999 game Crash Team Racing.
Her catchphrase is a play on 'Shop 'til you drop'.
Chopscotch is one of the few Skylanders who uses a detachable head as an attack (another one is Countdown).
Though she did appear in the original version of the game, she didn't in the revamped version of Ring of Heroes until a few weeks later.

cobra-cadabra.name: Cobra Cadabra
cobra-cadabra.description: Cobra Cadabra is a Magic black King Cobra who was one of the Magic core Skylanders that first appeared in Skylanders: Trap Team.
cobra-cadabra.biography: Though Cobra Cadabra was an assistant to The Great Mabuni, a traveling magician that performed all over Skylands, he wanted more than anything to become a magician himself. Unfortunately, the guild of Mysteriously Mad Magic Masters of Mystery, who for centuries taught all of the greatest magicians, would not permit it. And so Mabuni decided to teach the cobra himself, even though it was forbidden. They studied everything together, from vanishing acts to snake charming. But when the guild discovered this, they sent a team of magic rabbit enforcers to punish them both. Although the beastly hares were the most powerful of their kind in Skylands, Cobra Cadabra remained brave. Playing an enchanted tune on his flute, he used what he had learned to cast a spell over the rabbits and lead them away. Upon hearing this, this guild was impressed by such a display of skill, and accepted the snake charmer as a member. Soon after, Cobra Cadabra was made a member of another group – the Skylanders!
cobra-cadabra.personality: Cobra Cadabra is a charmer, all right. He's brave too! When he plays an enchanting tune, everyone listens. Like a magician, he never reveals his secrets.
cobra-cadabra.gameplay: Cobra Cadabra can play his magical pungi flute, which launches magic notes that attack his enemies, or cast various spells through songs, one can put enemies under his control. His secondary attack allows him to launch cobra baskets which have cobra allies to attack his enemies. His third attack lets Cobra Cadabra launch himself out of his basket which damages enemies in his way, and land into other cobra baskets.

trivia: He is the second snake Skylander in the series, after Rattle Shake and before Pit Boss. He is currently the only snake Skylander who is not in the Undead element.
Cobra Cadabra's name is a play on the magic word 'Abracadabra.'
His eyes constantly shrink and grow, a reference to snake hypnotism.

He is one of the few playable characters to use a musical instrument as a weapon (the others being Wolfgang, Fiesta, Pain Yatta, and Turbo Charge Donkey Kong). Additionally, each of the characters' weapons come from the four main instrument groups; Cobra Cadabra's flute: Woodwinds, Wolfgang's bone harp: Strings, Fiesta's trumpet: Brass, and Donkey Kong's bongo drums: Percussion.
Oddly, Cobra Cadabra does not hiss whenever he says the letter 'S.' As of Imaginators, he is the only snake character to not do so.
Not counting the variants, guests or SuperCharger versions of previous Skylanders, Cobra Cadabra has the highest amount of syllables in his name, specifically five.
Cobra Cadabra is bugged in Trap Team so that, if a cinematic or dialogue scene interrupts him while playing the flute, he will remain in his flute-playing position until the attack is used again.
If Cobra Cadabra is wearing a trinket which goes in his mouth, when he goes to play his flute, the trinket will temporarily disappear, only to reappear when he finishes playing.

In SuperChargers and Imaginatiors, when he plays his snake charmer's solo, his flute tune and music sounds different from how it did in Trap Team. It sounds like ordinary flute music instead of hypnotic flute music.

core-skylanders.name: Core Skylanders
core-skylanders.description: Core Skylanders are basic Skylanders that don't belong to any gimmick (Giants, SWAP Force, Trap Team, SuperChargers, Senseis).
core-skylanders.biography: Core Skylanders are basic Skylanders that don't belong to any gimmick (Giants, SWAP Force, Trap Team, SuperChargers, Senseis). The original 32 Skylanders in Skylanders: Spyro's Adventure are notably Core Skylanders. In addition, there are 8 new Core Skylanders in Skylanders: Giants, 16 in Skylanders: Swap Force, and 18 in Skylanders: Trap Team.
core-skylanders.catchphrase: Basic Skylanders that don't belong to any gimmick.
core-skylanders.gameplay: Core Skylanders are the standard playable characters throughout the Skylanders series. Unlike specialized groups, they do not possess specific mechanical gimmicks like giant size, swappable halves, or the ability to trap villains. Skylanders: SuperChargers and Skylanders: Imaginators do not have any new Core Skylanders.
trivia: The term 'Core Skylanders' might be in reference to the fact that the original 32 Core Skylanders were known to defend the Core of Light, with other Core Skylanders like Spotlight being confirmed to have been training to defend the Core as well.
As not all Core Skylanders were known to defend the Core of Light, this could just be a coincidence.

countdown.name: Countdown
appearances: Stump Smash Crosses the Bone Dragon
countdown.description: Countdown is an anthropomorphic bomb launcher who is one of the newer Tech core Skylanders released alongside Skylanders: Swap Force.
countdown.biography: Countdown was discovered by a group of Yetis who were snowboarding one particularly chilly morning when they came across a big bomb encased in ice. After bringing it back to their cabin, they were shocked when it actually came to life. No one, not even Countdown himself, has any memory of where he came from or how he ended up frozen in the mountains. Since becoming a Skylander, Master Eon has been graciously trying to help piece together fragments of his past. But this has proven difficult, as Countdown loses some of his memory every time he explodes – which happens a lot. In the meantime, Countdown has enjoyed working with Eon and fighting alongside the Skylanders to defend their world against evil – even though he occasionally forgets what he is doing.
countdown.personality: Countdown blows up at a moment's notice, although there is one drawback. Everytime he explodes, he loses his memory all over again.
countdown.gameplay: Countdown can detonate his own head, or self destruct, he can shoot his rocket hands, and summon bomb allies to attack enemies in his place. In Skylanders: Battlecast, he is an incredibly risky fighter with most of his abilities causing damage to himself or even his allies, but with a low energy cost in compensation. His Gear is a Bombrero, which explodes on both the owner and the enemy when attacked, and his special ability is Short Fuse, blasting the enemy for moderate damage but himself as well.

trivia: As a LightCore figure, his bomb head is coloured red, indicating his ability to detach his explosive head. However, his fully-lit fuse lights up orange.
Though based on LightCore Countdown's gameplay figure, he doesn't seem to light up in-game, making him the only LightCore character to do so.
He also, has a soccer ball (football) counterpart called Kickoff Countdown.
Countdown resembles N.Trance from Crash Bandicoot.
Just as Ghost Roaster is capable of dying in the hub level using his Ectoplasm attack, Countdown can die in the hub level using his Self-Destruct attack in the 3DS version of Swap Force.
His bomb head flips upside down, as he jumps.
Countdown was originally called 'Dabomb.' Many of his early voice lines were nonvocal grunts or giggles.
Some of Countdown's abilities are similar to Alisa Bosconovitch from Tekken 6. Both characters use their arms as rockets and can detonate their heads.
Countdown, Stump Smash, Prism Break, Drill Sergeant and Eruptor are the only bipedal Skylanders without hands.
Countdown is voiced by Richard Tatum, who is notable for voicing Agent 9 the Monkey from the classic Spyro series.
In the 3DS version, LightCore Countdown's face isn't red, but his usual black.
He is similar to Grinnade, who is also a walking bomb and can summon smaller bomb allies.
Despite him smiling on his artwork, Countdown is rarely ever seen smiling in gameplay.
Oddly, while his lit fuse is orange in his toy form and in his promotional art, his Swap Force portrait has a green fuse.

crash-bandicoot.name: Crash Bandicoot
crash-bandicoot.description: Crash Bandicoot is a genetically-modified eastern barred bandicoot created by his arch-nemesis, Dr. Neo Cortex, and is the titular character and protagonist of the Crash Bandicoot series. Throughout the series, he is commonly seen with his father figure and mentor, Aku Aku, the series' deuteragonist, his sister Coco and brother Crunch, Crash and Coco's pets Polar and Pura, and on rare occasions, his equally goofy doppelganger Fake Crash.
crash-bandicoot.biography: A wormhole has opened in Skylands and the great Aku Aku appears! He has come to announce the once-in-two-decades Synchronization Celebration--a time when all of the worlds align perfectly. All the inhabitants of Wumpa Island are having a party and they want to invite the Skylanders. But with Kaos on a quest to take over Skylands using his army of Doomlanders, the Skylanders must focus on stopping his evil plans. Never one to shy away from danger, the legendary marsupial Crash Bandicoot leaps through the wormhole to join the Skylanders in the ultimate battle against Kaos!
crash-bandicoot.personality: Crash is reckless and a little goofy, but heroic nonetheless. He appears to be clumsy even as a master of his brawling abilities, being able to lose time with his Sky-Chi should he entangle himself with the yo-yo.
crash-bandicoot.gameplay: Crash Bandicoot retains several of his old abilities from the Crash Bandicoot series as a Skylander. He can perform a punch combo before unleashing his classic spin attack, and even perform his classic slide attack. These can be further upgraded to extend the duration and damage of the spin attack as well as adding an upward kick to the end of the slide attack that Crash can combo out of. He is also capable of performing his classic body slam attack to stun enemies briefly and throw out explosive crates that he can then direct into enemies. A key aspect of Crash Bandicoot's gameplay is his low health and armor, which makes him one of the most frail Skylanders to date. Crash compensates for this by having the highest attack of all Sensei's, as well as the ability to regenerate with brief invincibility multiple times before needing to rest. Crash also has a chance to generate extra lives during combat when he throws out a crate. With his Soul Gem, he also has a chance throw out a special crate that releases his Fruit Bazooka, which he will then use to attack enemies from above. For his Sky-Chi, he uses his yo-yo to pull enemies towards him to attack, though he also entangles himself with it once the meter runs out.

abilities.name: Cyclone Spin
abilities.description: Press Attack 1 to spin into enemies and knock them down a peg.

abilities.name: Super Slide
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 to slide kick towards enemies and knock them back.

abilities.name: Crate Going and Body Slam
abilities.description: Press Attack 3 to toss a crate that explodes. Super slide into or spin near crates to move them around. After enough combat, the next crate is a Crash Crate that spawns an extra life upon destruction. Jump and press Attack 3 to perform a classic body slam belly flop!

abilities.name: Cyclone Spin Combo
abilities.description: Keep pressing Attack 1 to keep the spin going. Move faster during this spin for a while.

abilities.name: Five to Life
abilities.description: Crash can now revive up to four times, a total of five lives!

abilities.name: Upperkick
abilities.description: Hold Attack 3 to perform an upperkick that knocks enemies upwards.

abilities.name: Box O' Rockets
abilities.description: Every now and then, press Attack 3 to throw a Rocket Crate that spawns a rocket. When it is collected, Crash jet packs into the air. Press Attack 1 to shoot Wumpa Fruit and unleash an aerial assault.

abilities.name: Oh No Yo-Yo Fo' Show!
abilities.description: The ultimate Sensei Attack! Hold Special Attack to perform your Sky-Chi Power! Use Left Stick to direct where the yo-yos will go!

abilities.name: Aku Aku Dash
abilities.description: Run faster after reviving while under Aku Aku's protection. Aku Aku also shields for a longer time.

abilities.name: Suction Cyclone Spin
abilities.description: Keep pressing Attack 1 to keep the spin going. Enemies are suctioned in, knocked away, and hit harder when punched. Movement speed slightly decays over time.

abilities.name: Go Yo-Yo Go Yo-Yo Go!
abilities.description: Press Attack 1 three times or more to combo the spin for more area and Attack 1 combo attacks do more damage. Spinning retains its initial speed for a longer time.

abilities.name: Four Squares
abilities.description: Hold Attack 3 to throw crates around in a circle. Makes spinning afterwards a crate idea!

abilities.name: Blasting Impression
abilities.description: Jump on a crate to make a shockwave that knocks enemies down in a big area.

abilities.name: Dynamight
abilities.description: Crate explosions cover a larger area and do more damage.

trivia: Crash Bandicoot originated from his original game series.
He is the fourth character to do so, others include Dr. Neo Cortex, Spyro, Cynder, Turbo Charge Donkey Kong, and Hammer Slam Bowser.
His current voice actor, Jess Harnell, reprises his role as Crash in Imaginators.
Unlike Bowser and Donkey Kong, Crash is capable of saying short words, but Aku Aku does the talking for him.
Using Crash's slide attack in the air has him do a divekick, a common move in fighting games.
Crash will skid for a second when he stops running and does not do any other action such as jumping or attacking.
He, Cortex, Wild Storm and Ro-Bow are the only characters to also act as Adventure Pack figures.

Crash has the only known example of a scrapped Sensei Training Bonus line. The original was as follows, and played in the E3 2016 demo of Imaginators: 'Fear not, Portal Master. I, the wise Aku Aku will act as transmitter for Crash Bandicoot, and assist in making your Imaginators more powerful then ever! And if there are those who have chosen the noble path of Brawler, Crash will train them in a lost Bandicoot-granted secret technique!'
Crash Bandicoot and Dr. Neo Cortex are the only guest characters whom are owned by the same company which owns the Skylanders franchise.
He and Donkey Kong are currently the only guest characters in the Life element.

Aku Aku referring to Spyro as an old friend of Crash could possibly be in reference to the demos they've had to one another's game in the past, as well as cameos in the other's game, or their crossover games Crash Purple and Spyro Orange.
Unlike Hammer Slam Bowser and Turbo Charge Donkey Kong who are only exclusive to Nintendo, Crash and Dr. Neo Cortex are the first and only guest characters that can be played in any gaming consoles.
Also unlike Donkey Kong and Bowser, they keep most of their original moveset and appearance.
As of Skylanders: Imaginators, he has the lowest health out of all the Skylanders. However, because of his multiple lives, he still has more health overall than Trigger Happy and Spitfire.
He is the fourth Skylander to have the ability to return to life after getting defeated, the first being Night Shift, the second being Double Dare Trigger Happy and the third being Astroblast.
He and Cortex are the only Senseis not featured in Skylanders Creator. Despite that, their unique parts can still be unlocked through timed chests.

crusher.name: Crusher
crusher.description: Crusher is a rock golem Earth Skylander and one of the eight Giants in Skylanders: Giants. He also has a black counterpart called Granite Crusher, whose gems are blue instead of green.
crusher.biography: Crusher knew from the moment he put on his father's mining helmet that his true passion in life was crushing rocks. He was fascinated with rock-lore and traveled all throughout Skylands in search of rare minerals to pulverize with his powerful hand-crafted rock hammer, which is also named Crusher. But along his travels, he discovered that the evil Arkeyan King was also searching for rocks to melt down into weapons of war. Crusher's fury built up like an avalanche. After all, crushing was his job! So he put aside his life's passion and decided to use his hammer for a greater purpose- crushing Arkeyan Robots.
crusher.personality: Single-minded and completely unstoppable, Crusher crashes through any situation with the subtlety of a three-ton hammer. He's also incredibly thick-skinned - probably because his skin's made of stone.
crusher.gameplay: Crusher attacks with his large, menacing hammer (also named Crusher) and his secondary attack, shooting eye beams that turn enemies to stone. He can also self-destruct to scatter his rocky parts, but has the ability to reform. In Skylanders: Battlecast, he can also change his composition to endure more attacks or raise his attack. His Special Ability is Golem's Strength, increasing his power, and his signature Gear is his father's hammer, aptly titled My Father's Hammer, which corresponds to his Hammer Daddy console upgrade and doubles his damage.

abilities.name: Crusher's Crusher
abilities.description: Press Attack 1 to swing the big hammer, also named 'Crusher'.

abilities.name: Turn To Stone
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 button to shoot eye beams that turn enemies to stone.

abilities.name: Ground Grinder
abilities.description: Hold Attack 1 to hit the ground so hard that it makes a crack in the ground that damages enemies.

abilities.name: Rockslide
abilities.description: Press Attack 3 to break apart into boulders running over anything in their path.

abilities.name: Super Crusher
abilities.description: Hammer does increased damage.

abilities.name: Cavelight Blast
abilities.description: While holding Attack 2, press Attack 1 to launch a pulse of energy that damages enemies.

abilities.name: Rockslidin' Out
abilities.description: Hold Attack 3 to steer Rockslide boulders around.

abilities.name: Crusher Combos
abilities.description: Press Attack 1, Attack 1, Hold Attack 2 for Hammer Throw. Press Attack 1, Attack 1, Hold Attack 3 for 360 spin.

abilities.name: Hammer Daddy
abilities.description: Hammer takes the face of Crusher's father and does increased damage.

abilities.name: Triple Ground Grinder
abilities.description: Hold Attack 1 to hit the ground and make three cracks appear to damage enemies.

abilities.name: Controlled Rockslide
abilities.description: Control the direction of your Rockslide attack.

abilities.name: Boulder Bombs
abilities.description: While in a Rockslide, press Attack 1 to detonate boulders.

abilities.name: Bedrock Armor
abilities.description: Special rock from deep within the earth provides increased armor.

trivia: Some of Crusher's prototype names include Earth Titan, Rock Giant and Earth Giant.
Crusher slightly resembles the Giant from the movie, The Iron Giant.
In the earliest alpha build of Giants, Crusher is bugged so that he appears to dance within the Skylander menu. His abilities/upgrades are differently named and arranged than the final versions.
He is mentioned in Steel Plated Smash Hit's biography as the winner of the last year's Destruct-o-Thon as of Superchargers.
Crusher resembles the Egg Hammer from Sonic Heroes.
He has crystals all over his body, so he might be a Crystal Golem like Prism Break.
Crusher is the only Giant who can lift a boulder with one hand, carrying the hammer in the other.
His catchphrase is a play on 'It's Rush Hour!' A reference to when a main road has a lot of heavy traffic.
He has the highest health out of all the Giants.
In a Happy Meal interview, Crusher reveals that he wears glasses, listens to rock music, and tried calling his hammer 'Frank'.
He is voiced by Kevin Sorbo, who also portrays Hercules in Hercules: the Legendary Journeys.
Crusher, Prism Break and Jade Flashwing have green crystals around their bodies.
Crusher, Thumpback and Ninjini are the only three Giants to have weapons that are not a part of their bodies.
If the Rock Grinder path is taken, Crusher has the most powerful primary weapon out of all the Giants, his hammer doing 50 damage.
He is one of the few Skylanders with hammer-like abilities (others include Stump Smash, Rubble Rouser, Wallop, and Hammer Slam Bowser).
He slightly resembles Knack as both can reassemble their bodies.
His Turn to Stone move is similar to Medusa's powers in Greek mythology.
His battle cry 'Hammer it Home!' eventually became the earth Trap Master, Wallop's catchphrase.

cupid-flameslinger.name: Cupid Flameslinger
cupid-flameslinger.description: Love is in the air with the arrival of Cupid Flameslinger. Cupid Flameslinger was the Valentine's Day exclusive version of Flameslinger, only available on Skylanders: Lost Islands. In the months of February 2013 and 2014, he provides 25-percent more gold. He was able to be won in Willy's Wishing Well or could be purchased for 1500 Gems.
cupid-flameslinger.biography: Cupid Flameslinger was the Valentine's Day exclusive version of Flameslinger, only available on Skylanders: Lost Islands. In the months of February 2013 and 2014, he provides 25-percent more gold. He was able to be won in Willy's Wishing Well or could be purchased for 1500 Gems.
cupid-flameslinger.catchphrase: Love is in the air with the arrival of Cupid Flameslinger.
cupid-flameslinger.personality: As a festive Valentine's Day version of Flameslinger, he brings a celebratory spirit to the Skylands, focused on sharing the love and increasing the gold collection of his allies.
cupid-flameslinger.gameplay: In the months of February 2013 and 2014, Cupid Flameslinger provides 25-percent more gold to the player in Skylanders: Lost Islands. He was able to be won in Willy's Wishing Well or could be purchased for 1500 Gems.
trivia: Cupid Flameslinger is the first Lost Islands-exclusive Skylander.
He is also the first festive Skylander.
He is the only Valentine's Day Skylander not to be of the Magic element.

cy.name: Cy
cy.description: An Imaginator created from a Creation Crystal, Cy is a tactical genius with a unique set of built-in mechanical abilities. Though initially clueless about the world, he proved his worth by guiding Team Spyro to victory and becoming an official Skylander.
cy.biography: Cy is an Imaginator from the Skylanders Academy television series. Created from a Creation Crystal in King Pen's possession, he is used to assist Skylander teams in need of teamwork training. He is a skilled strategist and, after learning and training with Team Spyro, was able to direct them to fight Fire Viper and adapt to his attacks. After helping a team of Skylanders discover the benefits of teamwork, King Pen and Cy left to assist other teams throughout the land. Between his first and second appearance, Cy stopped his duty temporarily to help guard King Pen's home in Arctic Isle. After helping save King Pen and Arctic Isle from Fire Viper, Cy was accepted by the other cadets as an official Skylander.
cy.personality: Being created from nothing into a full grown creature, Cy is clueless to the world around him or even his own abilities at first, but is a quick learner and even quicker to formulate plans at a whim. Though his love of puns and slowness to understand subtleties make him eccentric, Cy tries to help even if he has to change his ways or follow foolhardy plans. Despite his natural strategist abilities, the Imaginator can be driven to act without thinking if his friends are thought to be killed. Cy's literal-mindedness make him largely unaware of insults, however, the jealously of cadets towards his graduation without the Skylander Games ends up angering another Skylander. Oddly, Cy thinks other people are Imaginators like him, created fully sentient from parts thought up and stiched together magically.
cy.gameplay: Cy uses a variety of built-in mechanical weapons like a potato cannon and vacuum arms. He is also a master strategist, able to adapt and coordinate team attacks in the heat of battle. While he initially lacks combat experience, his ability to learn and formulate plans on a whim makes him a formidable leader. Unlike the Imaginators from the games, Cy is not limited to a single Battle Class nor ability, though like them he can learn the abilities of his masters.

abilities.name: Potato Cannon
abilities.description: A built-in cannon that fires potatoes at enemies.

abilities.name: Vacuum Arms
abilities.description: Mechanical arms with built-in vacuums used for suction and combat utility.

abilities.name: Lighter (Left Index Finger)
abilities.description: A functional lighter integrated into Cy's left index finger.

abilities.name: Daggers
abilities.description: A pair of daggers similar to Stealth Elf's, used for close-quarters defense.

abilities.name: Strategic Mastery
abilities.description: Cy utilizes his advanced tactical mind to direct allies, adapting their powers to subdue even the most powerful enemies.

trivia: Cy was voiced by British YouTube star Daniel Middleton, more commonly known by his channel name, TheDiamondMinecart or DanTDM.
Unlike the Imaginators from the games, Cy is not limited to a single Battle Class nor ability, though like them he can learn the abilities of his masters.
Unlike Sir Hoodington and other Imaginators in promo art, Cy uses the default coloring for all of his parts, resembling the Imaginators in TV adverts.

Cy's parts are as follows: The Bananana head with Human eyes; The Spyro Horns ears; The Tiki Chest; An altered version of the Robot Bouncer arms; Legs resembling a combination of the Skelelegs and Wolfgang Legs, which he calls 'Monster Legs'; An altered version of the Dragon Wings.

Though he and his powers can't be replicated accurately in game, it is possible to use parts close to his actual appearance and the Quickshot class to play as him. Dan Middleton was given a custom Imaginator figure by Activision with the corresponding parts.
Oddly, the figure was from the Earth element, despite Cy's Crystal in the show perfectly matching one of the released Undead Crystals, sans the elemental symbol.
When Dan first placed Cy on the portal, his game name is actually 'C Four', but this is not given a known reason.

cyclops-snail.name: Cyclops Snail
cyclops-snail.description: Cyclops Snail is a scrapped water Skylander that originated from the early concept of Spyro's Kingdom. He was one of the original five characters planned for Spyro's Kingdom, but kept getting redesigned too many times so he was ultimately cut and developed into his successor, Zap. During development, he also went by the names Cyclops Slime and Tarclops.
cyclops-snail.biography: A creature from the sea, Tarclops is slow on land but fierce in water. Many years ago, Tarclops was sent to the islands by his father, King Cyclops, to find a stolen relic that belongs to their underworld kingdom.
cyclops-snail.catchphrase: Slow on land but fierce in water!
cyclops-snail.personality: Described as a 'really fun, but totally bizarre' character, Michael Graham noted that he was 'so weird' and quirky. However, through numerous redesigns—including changing colors from blue to purple and eventually becoming an oil-based creature named Tarclops—the character designer felt the original charm was lost, leading to the character's cancellation.
cyclops-snail.gameplay: Cyclops Snail was a blue water slug that zipped around, leaving a pool of sludge behind him. His primary method of attack was to scream and shoot electricity. His mechanics were later repurposed and evolved into the character Zap. For a time as Tarclops, he was even considered for the starter pack of Spyro's Kingdom before being replaced by Trigger Happy.

abilities.name: Sludge Trail
abilities.description: A little blue water slug that zips around, leaving a pool of sludge behind him.

abilities.name: Electric Scream
abilities.description: Cyclops Snail screams and shoots electricity at enemies.

trivia: Cyclops Snail makes a cameo in Skylanders: Trap Team as the 'Gloop Hat'.
Cyclops Snail resembles B.O.B. from Monsters vs. Aliens.
He also resembles the Tar Monster from Scooby Doo 2: Monsters Unleashed.

Had he appeared in the final game of Spyro's Adventure, Cyclops Snail would have been the first Skylander to have only one eye (others being Shroomboom, Eye-Brawl, Eye Small, Rocky Roll, Magna Charge, Dive-Clops, Smash Hit and Ro-Bow).

cynder.name: Cynder
appearances: Trigger Happy Targets the Evil Kaos
cynder.description: Cynder is a violet dragon who is one of the Undead Core Skylanders in Skylanders: Spyro's Adventure. She and Jet-Vac (or Punch Pop Fizz for 3DS) are the two Skylanders that come with Tree Rex in the Starter Pack of Skylanders: Giants. Her Series 3 counterpart is called Phantom Cynder, and she has a skeletal October counterpart called Skeletal Cynder.
cynder.biography: While just an egg, Cynder was stolen by the henchmen of an evil dragon named Malefor and raised to do his bidding. For years, she spread fear throughout the land until she was defeated by Spyro the Dragon and freed from the grip of Malefor. But dark powers still flow through her, and despite her desire to make amends for her past, most Skylanders try to keep a safe distance... just in case.
cynder.personality: Kidnapped as an egg by the evil Malefor, Cynder was brainwashed and trained in the ways of evil and darkness. She was a sinister dragon, a harbinger of despair and misery taught to strike fear into the hearts of Malefor's subjects and spread terror far and wide. However a speck of goodness burned somewhere in her black heart, which made her internally aware of the evil she was committing. After being freed from Malefor's spell, Cynder desires to make amends by battling evildoers with her dark powers, but she still struggles with her past. As a result of being corrupted under the Undead element, Cynder retains a wicked side and can occasionally be menacing, but she is trying hard to control her dark impulses. While she is loyal to the Skylanders, she is snarky, spiky when riled, witty, fierce and can be a terrifying force for good.
cynder.gameplay: Due to her exposure to the darkness of Malefor's corruption, Cynder gained powers of the Undead element, such as breathing dark electricity and temporarily turning into a shadowy apparition to dash past enemies, leaving behind a trail of ghostly allies that can attack opponents. Being a dragon, Cynder has the ability to fly using her wings, increasing her movement speed and and defence while doing so. Her Series 2 Wow Pow allows her to summon a spectral thunderbolt from above, and her Series 3 Wow Pow allows her to transform into a giant exploding skull. Choosing the Nether Wielder path improves the power of Cynder's Spectral Lightning attack, while the Shadowdancer path improves the power of her Shadow Dash and ghost attacks.

abilities.name: Spectral Lightning
abilities.description: Press and hold your primary power button to shock enemies with bolts of lightning.

abilities.name: Shadow Dash
abilities.description: Dash forward in shadow form. Ghost allies are summoned in your wake.

abilities.name: Cynder Flight
abilities.description: Press the button to fly.

abilities.name: Black Lightning
abilities.description: Spectral Lightning does increased damage.

abilities.name: Double Spooky!
abilities.description: Ghosts do increased damage.

abilities.name: Shadow Reach
abilities.description: Shadow Dash range is increased.

abilities.name: Haunted Ally
abilities.description: A ghost ally travels with you and damages enemies.

abilities.name: Lightning Rain
abilities.description: While flying, press Attack 2 to bring a great lightning blast down from the sky.

abilities.name: Skull-Splosion!
abilities.description: While in a Shadow Dash, hold Attack 2 to morph into a giant skull, which explodes on release.

abilities.name: Unstable Forces
abilities.description: Hitting a ghost with spectral lightning makes it explode, damaging enemies.

abilities.name: Breath Control
abilities.description: Spectral Lightning hold duration is increased.

abilities.name: Breath of Power
abilities.description: Spectral Lightning damages enemies in a larger area.

abilities.name: Death Bound
abilities.description: Enemies hit by ghosts move slower.

abilities.name: Ghost Haunter
abilities.description: Ghosts last longer and have a greater attack range.

abilities.name: Shadow Strike
abilities.description: Shadow Dash does damage to enemies.

trivia: Like Spyro, Cynder is also a recognizable Skylander, since they both appeared in a game series outside the Skylanders franchise: the Spyro series.
She is one of five characters from the Spyro franchise to be featured in the Skylanders series.
Cynder's appearance is heavily based on her counterpart from Legend of Spyro: Dawn of the Dragon.
In the Darklight Crypt, there are head statues that resemble Cynder at the entrance to the maze.
Before her egg was taken by Malefor's minions, Cynder had a biological mother.
Though Cynder is one of few who speaks English in Spyro's Adventure, she does not say her official catchphrase until Skylanders: Giants.
The symbol on Cynder's forehead is the Brand of the Undead, which unleashes ghostly allies from beyond the grave.
Cynder's spiked collar and bracelets are part of the Undead punk fashion.
Phantom Cynder is the second figure to have a translucent appearance after Slam Bam.
Cynder is a female dragon with no visible teeth, a trait shared with other female dragons in the series.
One of Cynder's battle cries, 'No Rest for the Wicked!', would later be used as the catchphrase for Bat Spin.
Cynder was planned to have a Series 4 figure for Skylanders: Trap Team, but it was scrapped from the final toy lineup.

dark-blast-zone.name: Dark Blast Zone
dark-blast-zone.description: Dark Blast Zone is the Dark alter ego of Blast Zone in Skylanders: Swap Force.
dark-blast-zone.biography: While on a special mission, a team of Skylanders discovered a secret lair where Kaos was experimenting with a new discovery -- Petrified Darkness -- which he initially intended to use to stage a coup against Skylands. In their fight to stop Kaos, the lair exploded, releasing a cloud of pure Darkness. The Skylanders knew they couldn't let it escape, so they absorbed this energy, transforming them into dark versions of themselves. Fortunately, Spyro learned to tame that darkness within him long ago. So with his help, these Skylanders now have also learned to control it -- combining its power with their own to fight Kaos and the forces of evil.
dark-blast-zone.personality: Dark Blast Zone is a disciplined Furnace Knight who has mastered the darkness within himself. He is dedicated to protecting Skylands and uses his transformed powers to combat Kaos and his forces.
dark-blast-zone.gameplay: Dark Blast Zone uses fire-based attacks and rocket-powered movement. As a member of the SWAP Force, his top half can be combined with other SWAP Force bottom halves to create new ability combinations. His primary attacks include Bomb Throw and Flame Breath, while his Rocket power allows for high-speed traversal.

abilities.name: Bomb Throw
abilities.description: Dark Blast Zone throws explosive bombs at enemies to deal high area damage.

abilities.name: Rocket Dash
abilities.description: Using his rocket boots, Dark Blast Zone dashes forward, leaving a trail of fire and damaging anyone in his path.

abilities.name: Flame Breath
abilities.description: Dark Blast Zone exhales a stream of fire that deals continuous damage to enemies in front of him.

abilities.name: Flaming Bombs
abilities.description: Dark Blast Zone's bombs now deal increased fire damage and have a larger explosion radius.

abilities.name: Ready For Blast Off
abilities.description: The ultimate rocket dash that leaves a massive explosion at the start and end of the dash.

trivia: Dark Blast Zone resembles the Black Knight Ghost from Scooby Doo 2: Monsters Unleashed.

dark-edition-skylanders.name: Dark Edition Skylanders
dark-edition-skylanders.description: The Dark Edition Skylanders are a group of Skylanders with the ability to transform into darker versions of themselves using the power of the Petrified Darkness within them. They commonly take on a black and silver color scheme, though they sometimes retain some of their original colors.
dark-edition-skylanders.biography: The Dark Edition Skylanders are a group of Skylanders with the ability to transform into darker versions of themselves using the power of the Petrified Darkness within them. They commonly take on a black and silver color scheme, though they sometimes retain some of their original colors, such as the Traptanium weapons of Wildfire and Snap Shot, or Blast Zone's flames. Spyro learned to master this dark magic through Master Eon's tutelage, learning to prevent himself from being consumed by darkness. Later, other teams of Skylanders absorbed energy from Kaos' experiments with Petrified Darkness or Dark Traptanium, learning to control it and combine the dark power with their own to fight Kaos and the forces of evil.
dark-edition-skylanders.personality: Only the Skylanders' brave heart and careful control prevent them from being consumed by darkness. They have learned to control the darkness within, combining its power with their own to fight Kaos and the forces of evil.
dark-edition-skylanders.gameplay: The Dark Edition Skylanders transform into darker versions of themselves. They commonly take on a black and silver color scheme, though they sometimes retain some of their original colors, such as the Traptanium weapons of Wildfire and Snap Shot, or Blast Zone's flames. Spyro and Stealth Elf are the only Dark Skylanders whose attacks have different colored effects compared to their regular counterparts.
trivia: Air, Dark, Light and Tech currently have no Dark Edition Skylanders, though with the exception of Light, they each have a Dark Edition Vehicle.
Notably, the Dark Sea Shadow is the only Dark Edition figure to also be part of the Dark element.

In Skylanders: Ring of Heroes, Dark Spyro (who was a Magic Skylander), Dark Spitfire (who was a Fire Skylander) and Dark King Pen (who was a Water Skylander) have switched to the Dark element under the names of Shadow Spyro, Shadow Spitfire and Shadow King Pen.

Despite the SuperChargers being mentioned in the comics and implied in backstories to have been recruited between Trap Team and SuperChargers, they share their backstory with the Skylanders from Swap Force, which happened at a previous point.

The same happens with the Dark Edition Senseis, who were unavailable when Petrified Darkness was discovered. Similarly to the SuperChargers, two of them hadn't even become Skylanders yet, being Villains locked up in Cloudcracker Prison at the time.
This would later be explained in Skylanders: Ring of Heroes with said villains experimenting with Petrified Darkness out of their own volition.
As of Skylanders: Imaginators, Fire and Life are tied for having the most Dark Edition figures of all elements.
Skylanders: Giants is the only game with no new Dark Edition Skylanders.
Oddly, there is no Dark Edition Starter Pack for the PS3 version of Skylanders: Imaginators.
Spyro and Stealth Elf are the only Skylanders who each have two Dark counterparts.
Coincidentally, they're the only Dark Skylanders whose attacks have different colored effects compared to their regular counterparts.
Both characters also originated from Skylanders: Spyro's Adventure.
Both also gained a Dark edition counterpart in Swap Force.
Their color scheme is similar to the National Football League's Las Vegas Raiders.
Stealth Elf, Super Shot Stealth Elf and the Golden Queen are the only female Skylanders with dark counterparts.

dark-food-fight.name: Dark Food Fight
dark-food-fight.description: Dark Food Fight is a dark version of Food Fight from Skylanders: Trap Team.
dark-food-fight.biography: From his top secret lair, Kaos had engineered a dangerous material known as Dark Traptanium - which he intended to use to capture the Skylanders once and for all! Caught off guard, several Skylanders fell into his trap and were imprisoned within the crystal walls. But the Trap Masters arrived just in time and shattered the dark traps with their weapons made from pure Traptanium! Though they were free, they had absorbed enough of the dark energy within, transforming them into dark versions of themselves! Fortunately, they have learned to control it - combining the dark power with their own to fight Kaos and the forces of evil.
dark-food-fight.personality: Fortunately, they have learned to control it - combining the dark power with their own to fight Kaos and the forces of evil.
dark-food-fight.gameplay: These are the starting and maximum Statistics for this Skylander in the Skylanders games. Dark Food Fight uses his Tomato Launcher and Blooms of Doom to overwhelm enemies.

abilities.name: Tomato Launcher
abilities.description: A rapid-fire tomato launcher that pelts enemies with juicy projectiles.

abilities.name: Blooms of Doom
abilities.description: Launch blooms that explode and cause damage to surrounding enemies.

abilities.name: Extra-Ripe Tomatoes
abilities.description: Tomatoes are extra-ripe, causing even more damage on impact.

abilities.name: Heavy Harvest
abilities.description: The harvest is heavy, increasing the size and area of tomato blasts.

abilities.name: Special Squash
abilities.description: A powerful squash attack that deals massive area damage.

trivia: This is the only alter ego of Food Fight available as a toy. The rest of Food Fight's alter egos are digital-only.
He was the last Skylander to receive a Power Play.

dark-golden-queen.name: Dark Golden Queen
dark-golden-queen.description: Dark Golden Queen is the Dark counterpart of the Golden Queen in Skylanders: Imaginators. She is included in the Dark Edition of Imaginators, along with Dark King Pen and Dark Wolfgang, and a Dark Doom Raider boss in Skylanders: Ring of Heroes.
dark-golden-queen.biography: Dark Golden Queen is the Dark counterpart of the Golden Queen in Skylanders: Imaginators. She is included in the Dark Edition of Imaginators, along with Dark King Pen and Dark Wolfgang. As a Dark variant, she is made of black gold, a rare substance that cannot be 24 karats as it is created through alloys or surface alterations. She also appears as a Dark Doom Raider boss in Skylanders: Ring of Heroes.
dark-golden-queen.personality: As a Dark counterpart to the Golden Queen, she likely shares her original's authoritative and greedy personality, manifested through her rare black gold form.
dark-golden-queen.gameplay: In Skylanders: Imaginators, Dark Golden Queen is an Earth element Sensei of the Sorcerer class. She possesses the same moveset as the standard Golden Queen. While she has specific Power Stats including Strength (80), Defense (200), Agility (150), and Luck (320), these are listed for completeness and are not actively used in-game.

abilities.name: Winged Scarabs
abilities.description: A primary attack where the Queen unleashes Winged Scarabs to attack enemies.

abilities.name: Golden Shockwave
abilities.description: A secondary attack that creates a Golden Shockwave to repel and damage enemies.

abilities.name: Royal Guard
abilities.description: A defensive move involving summoning a Royal Guard to the Queen's aid.

abilities.name: Golden Opportunity
abilities.description: An upgrade that provides a Golden Opportunity for increased damage or collecting wealth.

abilities.name: Royal Treatment
abilities.description: The ultimate attack providing the Royal Treatment to all foes.

trivia: Dark Golden Queen is made of black gold; though it's not naturally found in real life, black gold can be obtained by a process in jewelry by various methods, including cobalt alloys or altering its surface.
This would mean that Dark Golden Queen, unlike the regular one, cannot be 24 karats, as she is not made of pure gold.
She is the second Dark counterpart that belongs to the Earth element, the first being Dark Slobber Tooth.
She, Dark Stealth Elf and Dark Super Shot Stealth Elf are the only dark edition counterparts of female Skylanders.
She is the only one of the three that is not a version of Stealth Elf.

dark-hammer-slam-bowser.name: Dark Hammer Slam Bowser
dark-hammer-slam-bowser.description: Dark Hammer Slam Bowser is a Dark Edition SuperCharger from the Fire element, originating from the Mushroom Kingdom.
dark-hammer-slam-bowser.biography: Dark Hammer Slam Bowser is the Dark counterpart of Hammer Slam Bowser in Skylanders: SuperChargers. His signature vehicle is the Dark Clown Cruiser.
dark-hammer-slam-bowser.personality: Not specified in the records, but Bowser maintains his powerful and commanding presence as a Koopa King.
dark-hammer-slam-bowser.gameplay: In combat, Dark Hammer Slam Bowser utilizes a combination of hammer strikes and Koopa-themed abilities. His move set includes Hammer Slam, summoning Koopa Troopas, and transforming into Molten Bowser. He can also use Warp Pipes for mobility.

abilities.name: Hammer Slam
abilities.description: A powerful melee attack using Bowser's hammer.

abilities.name: Koopa Troopa!
abilities.description: Summons a Koopa Troopa to aid in battle.

abilities.name: Molten Bowser
abilities.description: Bowser transforms into his molten form for enhanced damage.

abilities.name: Warp Pipe
abilities.description: Uses a Warp Pipe to teleport or travel across the battlefield.

abilities.name: Molten Hammer
abilities.description: An ultimate hammer attack infused with molten lava.

trivia: Dark Hammer Slam Bowser is one of the guest characters from the Nintendo franchise.
He is the Dark counterpart of Hammer Slam Bowser.
His signature vehicle is the Dark Clown Cruiser.

dark-king-pen.name: Dark King Pen
dark-king-pen.description: Dark King Pen is the Dark counterpart of King Pen in Skylanders: Imaginators. He is included in the Dark Edition of Imaginators, along with Dark Golden Queen and Dark Wolfgang. In the original version of Skylanders: Ring of Heroes, Dark King Pen has been renamed as Shadow King Pen and is part of the Dark element.
dark-king-pen.biography: King Pen hails from a militaristic unit of penguins who protect the Cloudmelt Glaciers. During an epic battle, King Pen was trapped in an avalanche and had to take refuge in a nearby cave for the remainder of the winter season. During his solitude, he was visited by a mysterious Yeti Master, named Snow Wah, who began teaching him an ancient combat style known as 'Flipper-Fu'. King Pen was already a skilled fighter, but the wise teacher helped him to understand the spiritual and philosophical nature of warfare, turning the penguin into an unstoppable force. When he finally emerged from the cave, tales of his newfound abilities spread far and wide. When Master Eon caught wind, he recruited King Pen into his top secret training program, where he quickly rose up the ranks to become the leader of the Skylander Sensei. Years later, King Pen returned to the site of the avalanche to thank his teacher, but no evidence of Snow Wah or the cave was ever found – leaving many to wonder if the Yeti had ever existed at all. Shadow King Pen is an alter ego of King Pen, the respected leader of the Academy Sensei Group. This is before King Pen met his Yeti Master Snow Wah who taught him the spiritual and philosophical foundation of battle. As an outstanding warrior, Shadow King Pen was able to gain the attention of Master Eon and become a Skylander and an Academy sensei. However, he puts emphasis on being cold-headed and disciplined than being compassionate and on the results of physical training than spiritual training. The students are very afraid of Shadow King Pen, but he won't change his education policy. The actual battle against the evil forces would be much more brutal.
dark-king-pen.personality: Shadow King Pen is an alter ego who puts emphasis on being cold-headed and disciplined rather than being compassionate. He focuses on the results of physical training over spiritual training. The students are very afraid of Shadow King Pen, but he won't change his education policy, believing that actual battle against evil forces would be much more brutal.
dark-king-pen.gameplay: Dark King Pen is a Brawler Sensei who specializes in close-quarters combat using 'Flipper-Fu'. He can also utilize ice-based attacks to freeze enemies and create defensive arenas. In the Ring of Heroes, he is a disciplined warrior capable of stealing effects like Provoke, transferring debuffs to enemies, and utilizing Freeze effects to buff his team's defense as a Leader.

abilities.name: Come Back After More Training
abilities.description: [1 Enemy] Inflicts 48% of ATK as damage to 1 enemy 2 times, and steals the [Provoke] Effect that's possessed by the target whenever you attack accurately.

abilities.name: Penguin Drill
abilities.description: [1 Enemy] Inflicts 127% of ATK as damage to 1 enemy and grants the [Provoke] Effect on yourself for 1 turn.

abilities.name: Break Ice Black
abilities.description: [All Enemies] Increases the cooldown time required to use the skill by 1 when you use the skill with the Freeze Effect granted.

abilities.name: Coldness is on My Side
abilities.description: [1 Ally] Inflicts damage on the enemy and grants the [DEF UP] 10% Effect on yourself for 2 turns with a 40% chance if the enemy possesses the [Freeze] Effect. Leader Effect: After an ally inflicts damage on the enemy, grants the [DEF UP] 10% Effect on the team member for 2 turns with a 40% chance if the enemy possesses the [Freeze] Effect.

abilities.name: There is No Cowardice in Winning
abilities.description: [SELF] Transfers 1 of your debuff effects with a 25% chance whenever you inflict damage on the enemy.

trivia: He's the only Dark Sensei who is not a former villain.
When Ring of Heroes got rebooted, Shadow King Pen was temporarily absent until June 2021.

variants.name: Shadow King Pen
attacks: There is No Cowardice in Winning

dark-slobber-tooth.name: Dark Slobber Tooth
dark-slobber-tooth.description: Dark Slobber Tooth is the Dark counterpart of Slobber Tooth in Skylanders: Swap Force. He is only available in the Dark Edition of the game, along with four other Dark Skylanders.
dark-slobber-tooth.biography: While on a special mission, a team of Skylanders discovered a secret lair where Kaos was experimenting with a new discovery -- Petrified Darkness -- which he initially intended to use to stage a coup against Skylands. In their fight to stop Kaos, the lair exploded, releasing a cloud of pure Darkness. The Skylanders knew they couldn't let it escape, so they absorbed this energy, transforming them into dark versions of themselves. Fortunately, Spyro learned to tame that darkness within him long ago. So with his help, these Skylanders now have also learned to control it -- combining its power with their own to fight Kaos and the forces of evil.
dark-slobber-tooth.personality: Dark Slobber Tooth has learned to control the darkness within him, combining its power with his own to fight Kaos and the forces of evil.
dark-slobber-tooth.gameplay: Dark Slobber Tooth features five primary attacks: Horn Swipe, Chomp & Chunk, Unstoppable Force, Snot Rocket, and Fling. His console statistics start with 300 Health, 35 Speed, 30 Armor, 3 Critical Hit, and 35 Elemental Power.

abilities.name: Horn Swipe
abilities.description: Dark Slobber Tooth uses his horns to swipe at enemies.

abilities.name: Chomp & Chunk
abilities.description: Dark Slobber Tooth chomps down on enemies and chunks them away.

abilities.name: Unstoppable Force
abilities.description: Increases the power and momentum of attacks.

abilities.name: Snot Rocket
abilities.description: Fires a projectile snot rocket at distant foes.

abilities.name: Fling
abilities.description: A powerful move that flings enemies into the air.

trivia: He is the first Dark counterpart that belongs to the Earth element, the second being Dark Golden Queen.

dark-snap-shot.name: Dark Snap Shot
dark-snap-shot.description: Dark Snap Shot is the dark counterpart of Snap Shot in Skylanders: Trap Team.
dark-snap-shot.biography: From his top secret lair, Kaos had engineered a dangerous material known as Dark Traptanium – which he intended to use to capture the Skylanders once and for all! Caught off guard, several Skylanders fell into his trap and were imprisoned within the crystal walls. But the Trap Masters arrived just in time and shattered the dark traps with their weapons made from pure Traptanium! Though they were free, they had absorbed enough of the dark energy within, transforming them into dark versions of themselves! Fortunately, they have learned to control it – combining the dark power with their own to fight Kaos and the forces of evil.
dark-snap-shot.personality: Fortunately, they have learned to control it – combining the dark power with their own to fight Kaos and the forces of evil.
dark-snap-shot.gameplay: Dark Snap Shot features increased health compared to his normal counterpart. As a Trap Master, he uses Traptanium-based attacks like Traptanium Arrows and Crystal Slam to defeat enemies. These are the starting and maximum Statistics for this Skylander in the Skylanders games.

abilities.name: Traptanium Arrows
abilities.description: Shoot powerful Traptanium arrows at enemies from a distance.

abilities.name: Crystal Slam
abilities.description: Slam the Traptanium bow into the ground to create a crystal shockwave.

abilities.name: Sure Shot Croc
abilities.description: Increases the accuracy and damage of arrows.

abilities.name: Arrowsplosion
abilities.description: Arrows explode on impact, dealing area damage.

abilities.name: Big Wave Torrent
abilities.description: Unleash a massive torrent of water that washes away all enemies in its path.

trivia: Dark Snap Shot has more health than his original counterpart.
This is the only alter ego of Snap Shot available as a toy. The rest of Snap Shot's alter egos are digital-only.

dark-spitfire.name: Dark Spitfire
dark-spitfire.description: Dark Spitfire is the dark counterpart of Spitfire in Skylanders: SuperChargers. His signature vehicle is the Dark Hot Streak. In the original version of Skylanders: Ring of Heroes, Dark Spitfire has been renamed as Shadow Spitfire and is part of the Dark element. He is absent in the revamped version of the game.
dark-spitfire.biography: While on a special mission, a team of Skylanders discovered a secret lair where Kaos was experimenting with a new discovery -- Petrified Darkness -- which he initially intended to use to stage a coup against Skylands. In their fight to stop Kaos, the lair exploded, releasing a cloud of pure Darkness. The Skylanders knew they couldn't let it escape, so they absorbed this energy, transforming them into dark versions of themselves. Fortunately, Spyro learned to tame that darkness within him long ago. So with his help, these Skylanders now have also learned to control it -- combining its power with their own to fight Kaos and the forces of evil.
dark-spitfire.gameplay: Dark Spitfire shares the same upgrades as his regular counterpart, but his fire is now imdued with the effects of Petrified Darkness.

abilities.name: Fuel Injected Claws
abilities.description: [1 Enemy] Dashes towards an enemy and swings an uppercut to [decrease Endurance]. Mana cost: 2 Cooldown: 18 seconds

abilities.name: Nitro Boost
abilities.description: [All Enemies] Stirs up all enemies at high speed and casts [ATK DOWN] for 1 turn(s). Mana cost: 3 Cooldown: 14 seconds

abilities.name: Triathlete
abilities.description: [SELF] If there's a team member with the [Provoke] Effect, excluding yourself, steals the beneficial effect x0 whenever you attack the enemy.

abilities.name: Triathlete Boost
abilities.description: [1 Enemy] Slams into an enemy at high speed. This attack ignores 30% of the target's DEF. If enemy has [DEF UP] effect, deals a bonus hit which ignores 50% of DEF. Mana cost: 5 Cooldown: 8 seconds

abilities.name: Intensified Fury
abilities.description: All allies gain [CRIT DMG UP] for 1 turn(s) if the enemy gets [knocked down]. Mana cost: 0 Cooldown: 1

trivia: He is the only Dark elemental Skylander absent in the revamp version of Skylanders: Ring of Heroes.
He and Light Jet-Vac are the only Skylanders from the beta and 1.0 version of Ring of Heroes absent in the revamp.

He is the only Dark edition counterpart of a newly-introduced SuperCharger. The rest of the Dark edition SuperChargers are counterparts of Skylanders from previous games (Dark Super Shot Stealth Elf originated from Spyro's Adventure and Dark Turbo Charge Donkey Kong and Dark Hammer Slam Bowser originated from the Super Mario Bros. series).

dark-spyro.name: Dark Spyro
dark-spyro.description: Dark Spyro is the dark counterpart of Spyro who comes with the Nintendo 3DS version of Skylanders: Spyro's Adventure and in a single pack in certain countries. He is currently the only variant to have a different catchphrase and moveset (3DS only) than his normal counterpart. He has a Series 3 Mega Ram counterpart. In Skylanders: Ring of Heroes, Dark Spyro has been renamed as Shadow Spyro and is part of the Dark element.
dark-spyro.biography: Spyro is a rare magical dragon with the ability to harness the power of the other elements, though he prefers to master fire. However, this innate power also leaves him vulnerable to the influence of dark magic. When The Darkness is nearby, Spyro can channel his energy and combine its power with his own, becoming Dark Spyro. Over the years, he has learned to focus and control his power, using this dark magic to fight the forces of evil.
dark-spyro.personality: Dark Spyro is more wild, erratic, and darker than his normal counterpart, as seen in his Nintendo 3DS gameplay. While in this form, he is always at risk of being consumed by the dark magic. This process worries his fellow Skylanders at times as they fear that the evil forces may eventually corrupt their friend.
dark-spyro.gameplay: Although Dark Spyro has the exact same abilities as Spyro in the console version of Skylanders: Spyro's Adventure (and thus the same as Legendary Spyro, with only a color swap), his changes are quite dramatic in the Nintendo 3DS versions of the game and later handheld installments. In the Nintendo 3DS versions, Spyro and Legendary Spyro are quite masterful shooting just regular fireballs and using their Horn Charge. However, Dark Spyro is more adept at physical slashes and using magical thunder. At first he can use only a three-hit slashing combo, and of course dash and jump, and is also one of the characters able to glide. As he levels up, he learns to shoot thunder balls (which he can later run over to get power and speed boosts) and shoot powerful rays of lightning energy.

abilities.name: Dragon's Fire
abilities.description: Dark Spyro breathes balls of flame from his mouth, incinerating enemies.

abilities.name: Charge
abilities.description: Dark Spyro runs head down knocking over enemies with his horns.

abilities.name: Long Range Raze
abilities.description: Enhancing Dark Spyro's lung capacity, this ability lets Spyro shoot flameballs that travel much farther than before.

abilities.name: Spyro's Flight
abilities.description: Can fly over water and move at great speed.

abilities.name: Sprint Charge
abilities.description: Dark Spyro is able to charge for a longer distance with this upgrade.

abilities.name: Triple Flameballs
abilities.description: Shoot 3 Flameballs instead of one.

abilities.name: Spyro's Earth Pound
abilities.description: Dark Spyro performs a devastating dive-bomb head smash while flying, damaging enemies all around him.

abilities.name: Head Start!
abilities.description: Summon a magic worm ally at the end of your charge and send it after your enemies.

abilities.name: Fire Shield
abilities.description: This upgrade generates fire shields around Dark Spyro when he uses his Flameball attack.

abilities.name: Exploding Fireblast
abilities.description: Dark Spyro's central Flameball ignites into an explosive force that not only does more damage but hits multiple enemies.

abilities.name: The Daybringer Flame
abilities.description: Hold down the primary power button to build up this attack, which generates a flame so big and bright it is said to bring daylight to the sky.

abilities.name: Stun Charge
abilities.description: Enemies hit by Dark Spyro's charge become temporarily stunned.

abilities.name: Comet Dash
abilities.description: A magic aura surrounds Dark Spyro's horns imbuing them with extra power and damage that burns enemies in its path.

abilities.name: Ibex's Wrath Charge
abilities.description: Find Dark Spyro's extra gear. With this upgrade, Dark Spyro builds up speed and such a destructive force that it causes the very air around him to ignite into the magical form of fiery ibex horns.

trivia: Dark Spyro's voice is described as one that isn't recognizable by those around him. 'It was deeper, with an edge they'd never heard before - like something from the depths of a nightmare.'
Dark Spyro originated from 'The Legend of Spyro' series, as Spyro the Dragon's dark form.
His appearance resembles Dark Spyro in the Gameboy Advance version of 'The Eternal Night', with silver claws and teeth instead of red.
Unlike his 'Legend of Spyro' counterpart, Dark Spyro is capable of controlling his dark impulses.
Despite having a completely different catchphrase, Dark Spyro still says normal Spyro's catchphrase in the games.
Dark Spyro was the only 'Dark' variant until the Dark Skylanders made their debut. Before Swap Force, his scales were also dark purple, and were changed to black like the other variants.
Dark Spyro is the first Alter Ego to be reposed.
While viewing his biography in Skylanders: Swap Force, the game reveals a screenshot from an unreleased Dark Spyro trailer.
Dark Spyro manipulates the power of darkness, which turns his fire breath light purple, not unlike Malefor.
Technically, Dark Spyro is the only Skylander with a Series 1 and 3 figure but no Series 2.

dark-stealth-elf.name: Dark Stealth Elf
dark-stealth-elf.description: Dark Stealth Elf, also known as Dark Ninja Stealth Elf is the Dark Edition counterpart of Stealth Elf in Skylanders: Swap Force.
dark-stealth-elf.biography: While on a special mission, a team of Skylanders discovered a secret lair where Kaos was experimenting with a new discovery -- Petrified Darkness -- which he initially intended to use to stage a coup against Skylands. In their fight to stop Kaos, the lair exploded, releasing a cloud of pure Darkness. The Skylanders knew they couldn't let it escape, so they absorbed this energy, transforming them into dark versions of themselves. Fortunately, Spyro learned to tame that darkness within him long ago. So with his help, these Skylanders now have also learned to control it -- combining its power with their own to fight Kaos and the forces of evil.
dark-stealth-elf.personality: Disciplined and stealthy, Dark Stealth Elf has mastered the darkness within her to enhance her ninja skills, remaining a loyal defender of Skylands despite her transformed nature.
dark-stealth-elf.gameplay: Dark Stealth Elf specializes in close-quarters combat and evasion. Her primary attacks include Blade Slash and Stealth. She can upgrade her arsenal with Dragonfang Daggers and Arboreal Acrobatics. Her Wow Pow, Elf Jitsu, allows for even more devastating ninja maneuvers. In Skylanders: Swap Force, her ninja hood is unlocked via her Wow Pow, though it is included by default in later games like Skylanders: Trap Team.

abilities.name: Blade Slash
abilities.description: A rapid melee strike with daggers.

abilities.name: Stealth
abilities.description: Allows her to disappear while leaving a decoy in her place.

abilities.name: Dragonfang Daggers
abilities.description: Upgraded daggers for increased damage.

abilities.name: Arboreal Acrobatics
abilities.description: Enhanced movement and agility through acrobatic maneuvers.

abilities.name: Elf Jitsu
abilities.description: A mastery of combat that also unlocks her ninja hood in Skylanders: Swap Force.

trivia: She is the second Dark Edition Skylander to be announced (the first being Dark Spyro).
Her Stealthier Decoy makes her eyes glow purple instead of green.
However, in her figure form and Trap Team, her eyes glow green.
Her scarecrows have gray or silver heads.

Unlike her normal S3 counterpart, Dark Stealth Elf wears her full black ninja costume except for the hood part where she needs to purchase her Wow Pow in order to get it. But in Trap Team, the hood part is now included even before the Wow Pow is bought. However, any hat she wears removes the top hooded part.
While the S3 version of Dark Stealth Elf has silver skin, Dark Super Shot Stealth Elf has black skin.
She is the second Alt Deco to have a repose (The first being Dark Spyro and the third being Legendary Jet-Vac.)
Dark Stealth Elf was first shown in a K-Zone Magazine where she was identified as Dark Ninja Stealth Elf.
She, Dark Super Shot Stealth Elf and Dark Golden Queen are the only dark edition counterparts of female Skylanders.

dark-super-shot-stealth-elf.name: Dark Super Shot Stealth Elf
dark-super-shot-stealth-elf.description: Dark Super Shot Stealth Elf is the Dark Edition counterpart of Super Shot Stealth Elf in Skylanders: SuperChargers. She is exclusive to Dark Edition Starter Packs for the Xbox and PlayStation platforms.
dark-super-shot-stealth-elf.biography: While on a special mission, a team of Skylanders discovered a secret lair where Kaos was experimenting with a new discovery -- Petrified Darkness -- which he initially intended to use to stage a coup against Skylands. In their fight to stop Kaos, the lair exploded, releasing a cloud of pure Darkness. The Skylanders knew they couldn't let it escape, so they absorbed this energy, transforming them into dark versions of themselves. Fortunately, Spyro learned to tame that darkness within him long ago. So with his help, these Skylanders now have also learned to control it -- combining its power with their own to fight Kaos and the forces of evil.
dark-super-shot-stealth-elf.personality: Dark Super Shot Stealth Elf is a courageous hero who has learned to tame the darkness within her, using it as a weapon against the forces of Kaos.
dark-super-shot-stealth-elf.gameplay: In combat, Dark Super Shot Stealth Elf utilizes her Dagger Cannon for ranged attacks and her agility to close the distance for melee strikes. She can create distractions to confuse enemies and uses 'Smog Slash' to maintain control over the battlefield. Her stats emphasize Speed and Agility, making her a fast-paced attacker.

abilities.name: Dagger Cannon
abilities.description: Fires projectiles from her signature weapon.

abilities.name: Say Hello
abilities.description: A quick melee strike to engage enemies up close.

abilities.name: Circle Slash
abilities.description: A spinning blade attack that damages all surrounding enemies.

abilities.name: Smog Slash
abilities.description: Releases a cloud of dark smog to confuse and damage foes.

abilities.name: Distraction Destruction
abilities.description: The ultimate distraction technique to decimate foes.

trivia: Unlike Dark Stealth Elf, Dark Super Shot Stealth Elf has black skin.
She, Dark Stealth Elf and Dark Golden Queen are the only dark edition counterparts of female Skylanders.
She's the only Dark Edition SuperCharger whose signature vehicle doesn't have a dark edition counterpart.

In Imaginators, when viewing the Skylanders collection, her character icon shows her official render from SuperChargers, but in regular gameplay, it shows the icon for her Series 3 counterpart instead.
She shares the same problem with Legendary Jet-Vac.

dark-turbo-charge-donkey-kong.name: Dark Turbo Charge Donkey Kong
dark-turbo-charge-donkey-kong.description: Dark Turbo Charge Donkey Kong is the Dark counterpart of Turbo Charge Donkey Kong in Skylanders: SuperChargers. His signature vehicle is the Dark Barrel Blaster.
dark-turbo-charge-donkey-kong.biography: Dark Turbo Charge Donkey Kong is the Dark counterpart of Turbo Charge Donkey Kong in Skylanders: SuperChargers. He is a Kong from Donkey Kong Island and his signature vehicle is the Dark Barrel Blaster.
dark-turbo-charge-donkey-kong.personality: As a Dark SuperCharger, he possesses a more intense and brooding nature compared to his standard counterpart, while retaining his legendary strength and loyalty.
dark-turbo-charge-donkey-kong.gameplay: Dark Turbo Charge Donkey Kong uses a combination of brute strength and barrel-based attacks to overcome his foes. He can transition into his Super Donkey Kong form for increased power and utilizes Bongo Barrels for area-of-effect damage.

abilities.name: Primate Punch
abilities.description: DK delivers a powerful punch to enemies.

abilities.name: Barrel Toss
abilities.description: Throws a barrel at enemies that explodes on impact.

abilities.name: Bongo Barrel
abilities.description: Release a barrel that creates a musical shockwave.

abilities.name: Super Donkey Kong
abilities.description: Transform into a more powerful version of Donkey Kong.

abilities.name: Barrels of Fun
abilities.description: A massive barrel attack that causes widespread damage.

trivia: Dark Turbo Charge Donkey Kong is the Dark counterpart of Turbo Charge Donkey Kong.
His signature vehicle is the Dark Barrel Blaster.
He was released as part of the Skylanders: Superchargers Wii U Dark Edition Starter Pack.
His English voice actor is Takashi Nagasako.
Diddy Kong is his nephew.

dark-wash-buckler.name: Dark Wash Buckler
dark-wash-buckler.description: Dark Wash Buckler is the Dark counterpart of the Water SWAP Force Skylander, Wash Buckler.
dark-wash-buckler.biography: While on a special mission, a team of Skylanders discovered a secret lair where Kaos was experimenting with a new discovery – Petrified Darkness – which he initially intended to use to stage a coup against Skylands. In their fight to stop Kaos, the lair exploded, releasing a cloud of pure Darkness. The Skylanders knew they couldn't let it escape, so they absorbed this energy, transforming them into dark versions of themselves. Fortunately, Spyro learned to tame that darkness within him long ago. So with his help, these Skylanders now have also learned to control it – combining its power with their own to fight Kaos and the forces of evil.
dark-wash-buckler.personality: While Dark Wash Buckler was born from pure Darkness, he has learned to control the power within to fight for the forces of good alongside his fellow Skylanders.
dark-wash-buckler.gameplay: These are the starting and maximum Statistics for this Skylander in the Skylanders games. Warning: These stats are not used in any of the Skylander games. They are only listed for completeness reasons.

abilities.name: Sword Slash
abilities.description: A powerful melee attack using a cutlass.

abilities.name: Bladesail
abilities.description: A movement-based attack utilizing the mermasquid's pirate sail.

abilities.name: Bubble Blaster
abilities.description: A ranged attack that fires bubbles at enemies.

abilities.name: Somersaulty
abilities.description: An agile maneuver used to dodge and strike.

abilities.name: Octolash
