abilities.description: A powerful finishing move using all eight tentacles.

trivia: Despite his artwork, Dark Wash Buckler in both figure and in-game forms, his skin is black instead of gray.
Dark Wash Buckler is voiced by John DiMaggio in English.

dark-wildfire.name: Dark Wildfire
dark-wildfire.description: Dark Wildfire is the dark version of Wildfire from Skylanders: Trap Team.
dark-wildfire.biography: From his top secret lair, Kaos had engineered a dangerous material known as Dark Traptanium - which he intended to use to capture the Skylanders once and for all! Caught off guard, several Skylanders fell into his trap and were imprisoned within the crystal walls. But the Trap Masters arrived just in time and shattered the dark traps with their weapons made from pure Traptanium! Though they were free, they had absorbed enough of the dark energy within, transforming them into dark versions of themselves! Fortunately, they have learned to control it - combining the dark power with their own to fight Kaos and the forces of evil.
dark-wildfire.personality: Having absorbed dark energy from Kaos' traps, Dark Wildfire has learned to control this new power, combining it with his own strength to fight for the forces of good.
dark-wildfire.gameplay: In the Skylanders games, Dark Wildfire's starting and maximum statistics such as Health, Speed, Armor, Critical Hit, and Elemental Power are not officially documented for console play. However, his Power Stats include Strength: 150, Defense: 240, Agility: 120, and Luck: 100. These Power Stats are listed for completeness and are not used in actual gameplay.

abilities.name: Traptainium Shield Bash
abilities.description: Traptainium Shield Bash

abilities.name: Chains of Fire
abilities.description: Chains of Fire

abilities.name: Heat Shield
abilities.description: Heat Shield

abilities.name: Burning Bash
abilities.description: Burning Bash

abilities.name: Lots of Chains
abilities.description: Lots of Chains

trivia: Dark Wildfire is the dark version of Wildfire from Skylanders: Trap Team.
He was transformed into a dark version of himself after being trapped in Dark Traptanium created by Kaos.

dark-wolfgang.name: Dark Wolfgang
dark-wolfgang.description: Dark Wolfgang is the Dark counterpart of Wolfgang in Skylanders: Imaginators. He is included in the Dark Edition of Imaginators, along with Dark Golden Queen and Dark King Pen, and a Dark Doom Raider boss in Skylanders: Ring of Heroes.
dark-wolfgang.biography: Dark Wolfgang is the Dark counterpart of Wolfgang in Skylanders: Imaginators. He is included in the Dark Edition of Imaginators, along with Dark Golden Queen and Dark King Pen, and a Dark Doom Raider boss in Skylanders: Ring of Heroes.
dark-wolfgang.personality: As a practitioner of rock and roll, Dark Wolfgang is energetic and rebellious, though he now uses his musical talents to protect Skylands as a reformed Sensei.
dark-wolfgang.gameplay: As a Bowslinger Sensei, Dark Wolfgang uses his guitar-like bow to perform musical attacks. His moveset includes Strike a Chord, Knee Slide, Song of the Underworld, Lay Some Tracks, and his powerful Sky Chi move, Surround Sound.

abilities.name: Strike a Chord
abilities.description: Attack with your guitar bow by striking musical chords.

abilities.name: Knee Slide
abilities.description: Perform a rock-and-roll knee slide to damage enemies in your path.

abilities.name: Song of the Underworld
abilities.description: Play a powerful song that channels the power of the Underworld.

abilities.name: Lay Some Tracks
abilities.description: Lay tracks on the ground to control the battlefield.

abilities.name: Surround Sound
abilities.description: Release a massive Sky Chi attack that surrounds enemies with devastating sound.

trivia: Dark Wolfgang is the first Dark Edition Undead figure.
Dark Wolfgang looks like Wolfgang's evolved state from Trap Team, albeit with minor differences.

deep-dive-gill-grunt.name: Deep Dive Gill Grunt
deep-dive-gill-grunt.description: Deep Dive Gill Grunt is the SuperChargers counterpart of the veteran Gillman, Gill Grunt. Armed with a trident and an advanced water jetpack, he takes to the fight with a mix of sea-powered force and electrical energy.
deep-dive-gill-grunt.biography: Deep Dive Gill Grunt is a Gillman soldier who has upgraded his arsenal with a powerful trident. He uses this weapon to jab opponents and unleash devastating blasts of lightning. Complementing his melee prowess, his new jetpack allows him to hover and create tidal waves that wash away foes. His most powerful technique allows him to channel the storms of the sea to rain lightning down on his enemies.
deep-dive-gill-grunt.personality: Deep Dive Gill Grunt is a stoic and disciplined soldier who remains humble despite his vast experience. He is known for his tenacity, adhering to the mantra that 'Gillmen never give up.' He is highly respectful of authority figures like Buzz and is driven by a sense of duty to his team and his mission across the Eleven Seas.
deep-dive-gill-grunt.gameplay: Deep Dive Gill Grunt specializes in balanced combat, combining trident strikes with long-range lightning. His jetpack provides significant mobility, allowing him to transition between ground combat and hovering. His upgrade paths allow players to focus on either wave-based water maneuvers or intensifying his electrical storm abilities. Unlike previous iterations, his basic jetpack functionality is more fluid and integrated into his combat style.

abilities.name: Trident Thrust
abilities.description: Press Attack 1 to attack enemies with your trident.

abilities.name: Power of the Seas
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 to attack enemies with a long range lightning attack.

abilities.name: Typhoon Turbine Jetpack
abilities.description: Press Attack 3 to begin hovering with your Jetpack. Press Attack 1 to dash forward or Press Attack 2 to send out a tidal wave. Press Attack 3 again to land on the ground.

abilities.name: Trident True
abilities.description: Hold Attack 1 when not using the Jetpack to rapidly attack nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Wild Whirlpool
abilities.description: Hold Attack 2 while using the Jetpack to create a large whirlpool that damages nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Trident Unleashed
abilities.description: Trident attacks do more damage. Unleash the Trident!

abilities.name: Storm of the Seas
abilities.description: Hold down Attack 2 while not using the jetpack to summon a powerful lightning storm!

abilities.name: Wave Jumper
abilities.description: Press Attack 3 to begin hovering with your Jetpack. Press Attack 3 again to land on the ground. Entering or exiting Jetpack mode causes a water explosion that damages nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Tubular Tidal Wave
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 to shoot out three large waves in Jetpack mode.

abilities.name: Drive the Wave
abilities.description: Hold Attack 1 in Jetpack mode to ride a huge tidal wave!

abilities.name: Lightning Strikes
abilities.description: Hold Attack 1 while not using the Jetpack to rapidly attack nearby enemies with lightning.

abilities.name: Shocking Transition
abilities.description: Press Attack 3 to begin with hovering with your Jetpack. Press Attack 3 again to land on the ground. Entering Jetpack mode causes a lightning explosion that damages nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Lightning Build-Up
abilities.description: Lightning attacks do more damage. Storm powered!

trivia: Unlike his previous versions, Deep Dive Gill Grunt's water jetpack (if the Water Weaver path isn't chosen) doesn't require seconds of recharging. However, the feature of his new jetpack is based on choosing the Water Weaver path.
He, Zap, Punk Shock, and Wham-Shell are the only Water Skylanders with electricity-based abilities.
Deep Dive Gill Grunt is the first Water Skylander that can use electricity-based abilities, but is not from royalty.

Deep Dive Gill Grunt was originally conceptualized with a plethora of alternative designs. Some concepts wore hats, overalls, or goggles; others wielded a form of gun; one was even designed as anglerfish; and one was sheathed in metallic armor.

When he, Big Bubble Pop Fizz, Super Shot Stealth Elf and Bone Bash Roller Brawl are placed on the portal, they say their official catchphrases in a slightly different tone of their voices. This also applies to most of their quotes, which have been completely re-recorded.
Deep Dive Gill Grunt has similarities to the DC Comics hero, Aquaman. Both are connected to sea life, both have green and orange in their color schemes and they both have tridents for weapons.
Although not included in the game, Deep Dive Gill Grunt can be seen on promotional artwork of Skylanders: Ring of Heroes.

deja-vu.name: Déjà Vu
deja-vu.description: Déjà Vu is one of the Magic core Skylanders in Skylanders: Trap Team. She is released in the Mirror of Mystery adventure pack.
deja-vu.biography: On a remote island in Skylands, Déjà Vu tirelessly worked on a machine that would make the perfect three-minute egg in half the time. After pouring over countless magic tomes, and even consulting the lost plans used to create the legendary Tower of Time, she finally completed construction of the huge machine. Unfortunately, a gang of evil giant sea slugs, searching for a way to acquire super speed, learned of her machine and set about to take it at all costs. Slow, but well armed, the massive slugs bore down on the island. But rather than allow her work be used for evil, Déjà Vu quickly jumped into action and set the clock's hands to thirteen – causing a time overload. Caught up in the blast, she was given an amazing power over time, which she then used to stop the evil slugs in their tracks and spin them home. Now as a Skylander, Déjà Vu uses her incredible powers to turn back the clock on evil!
deja-vu.personality: Déjà Vu has one of those personalities that makes think you might have met her before.
deja-vu.gameplay: Déjà Vu is a Magic Skylander who wields the power of time. She can shoot homing time energy or create past versions of herself that act as exploding decoys. She can also manipulate time rifts to create damaging black holes, effectively controlling the battlefield through temporal duplication and spatial distortion.

abilities.name: Space-Time Shots
abilities.description: Shoot a magical ball of time energy that homes in on enemies.

abilities.name: Past Selves
abilities.description: Press Button 2 to bring a version of your past self that explodes. Press Button 2 again to switch places with it.

abilities.name: Time Shift
abilities.description: Press Button 3 to create a Time Rift, damaging all who touch it. Shoot the Time Rift to create a black hole.

abilities.name: Long-Term Memory
abilities.description: Past Selves last longer and replay a longer history.

abilities.name: Time Rifts Aplenty
abilities.description: Have more Time Rifts active at once. Time Rifts now attract Space-Time Shots.

abilities.name: Circular Logic
abilities.description: Past Selves fire Time-Space Shots.

abilities.name: Black Hole Beldom
abilities.description: Time Rifts now turn into massive black holes, releasing unstable time power

abilities.name: Explosion Déjà Vu
abilities.description: When a Past Self explodes, the explosion is repeated 2 more times.

abilities.name: Time Heals All Wounds
abilities.description: When a Past Self takes damage, you are healed.

abilities.name: Space-Time Duality
abilities.description: Shoot two Space-Time Shots at once.

abilities.name: Warp Field
abilities.description: Shoot a Past Self to create a warp field, pulling enemies towards the Past Self.

abilities.name: Past Self Paralysis
abilities.description: Past Selves do extra damage and freeze all nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Go Out With a Bang
abilities.description: When a Past Self explodes, or when you switch with it, it releases Space-Time Shots.

trivia: Déjà Vu has a stereotypical Russian accent.
Déjà Vu is also the feeling of having already experienced something that is actually happening for the first time.
Her name is French for 'Already Seen'.
She is the second female Magic Skylander to have her catchphrase end with a question mark (the first being Ninjini).
Déjà Vu is the third Skylander figure to have glow-in-the-dark eyes while Stealth Elf is the first and Whisper Elf is the second.
However, she is the first Magic element Skylander to have that concept.

dino-rang.name: Dino-Rang
dino-rang.description: Dino-Rang is an Earth boomerang-wielding dinosaur Skylander in Skylanders: Spyro's Adventure. He uses his boomerangs to attack his foes at range or to deflect their attacks. He can also use the surrounding dirt to form traps that spring up from the earth when an opponent gets too close.
dino-rang.biography: For years, Dino-Rang trained to use the weapons of his tribe – earthen boomerangs. His people were skilled hunters in a world far away from the realm of Skylands. As he slept one night, a freak portal suddenly opened beneath him. Unsure of how or why he arrived in Skylands, Dino-Rang set out to explore the world that was suddenly his new home. Eventually becoming a Skylander, he now fights with his own brand of Dino-Justice, while seeking out the fabled Twin Diamond Boomerangs, which he believes could hold the clues to his greater destiny.
dino-rang.personality: Unlike most unruly dinosaurs, Dino-Rang has a calm and collected demeanor. However, if anyone calls him a dragon by mistake, Dino-Rang will lose his cool, resulting in a furious display of whirling boomerangs. Even though he loves being a Skylander, he still dreams of the hunting plains of his homeland.
dino-rang.gameplay: Dino-Rang uses his boomerangs to attack his foes at range or to deflect their attacks. He can also use the surrounding dirt to form traps that spring up from the earth when an opponent gets too close. Choosing the Grand Boomerang Master upgrade path for Dino-Rang increases his effectiveness with the boomerang, while the Earthen Avenger upgrade path enhances the power of his Stonefist Traps and provides defensive bonuses.

abilities.name: Stone Boomerangs
abilities.description: Throw boomerangs at enemies.

abilities.name: Boomerang Shield
abilities.description: Throw both boomerangs around in a circle for a close-ranged attack.

abilities.name: Basalt Boomerangs
abilities.description: Stone Boomerangs do increased damage.

abilities.name: Boomerang Finesse
abilities.description: Control boomerangs in the air.

abilities.name: Stonefist Traps
abilities.description: Summon two Stonefist Traps from beneath the earth.

abilities.name: Dervish Shield
abilities.description: Boomerang Shield does extra damage and blocks enemies' shots.

abilities.name: Sticky Boomerangs
abilities.description: Boomerangs pick up treasure, food, and powerups.

abilities.name: Volcanic Glass Boomerangs
abilities.description: Boomerangs do even more increased damage.

abilities.name: Dancing Boomerangs
abilities.description: Boomerangs bounce off of walls and enemies.

abilities.name: It's All In The Wrist
abilities.description: Boomerang Shield lasts longer and does extra damage.

abilities.name: Quad Stonefist Trap
abilities.description: Summon 4 Stonefist Traps at once.

abilities.name: Obsidian Armor
abilities.description: Improved armor makes it harder for enemies to hit Dino-Rang. (Armor +40)

abilities.name: Fist Trap Funeral
abilities.description: Enemies defeated by Boomerangs spawn Stonefist Traps.

trivia: Despite being a dinosaur, Dino-Rang bears more of a resemblance towards a crocodilian.
Dino-Rang, Flashwing, Spyro, Star Strike and Enigma are the only Skylanders whose origin homes are not in Skylands.

Despite his size, Dino-Rang is a surprisingly gifted dancer. Sometimes though, he forgets his own strength. Once, when he was dancing with a female partner, he attempted to lift her above his head, and accidentally launched her screaming several miles into the air. She has not, as of yet, come back down.
His catchphrase is a play on 'Come Rain or Shine'.

Dino-Rang's default boomerangs were redesigned in Skylanders: Giants, changing from the original brown, stony appearance in Spyro's Adventure to yellow with red tips. However, this newer design had already appeared in certain Spyro's Adventure materials, including screenshots, concept art, and the animated section of his Soul Gem preview.
He, Slobber Tooth, Chopper and Tri-Tip are currently the only Skylanders who are dinosaurs.
His name is a pun on the words 'Dinosaur' and 'Boomerang'.
He is the first Skylander that has Obsidian armor (with the second one being Rubble Rouser).
In Swap Force, Dino-Rang's profile picture has the Obsidian Armor upgrade.
In Swap Force, every time he performs the Stonefist Traps, they immediately pop out of the ground rather than waiting for enemies to step on them.
Dino-Rang and Snap Shot are both reptilian Skylanders that use a projectile weapon. Also, they both speak in a heavy Australian accent.
Dino-Rang, Bone Bash Roller Brawl and Gusto all wield boomerangs.

In the Wii version of Skylanders: Spyro's Adventure, attempting to pick up watermelons with the Sticky Boomerangs upgrade can result in a glitch where the food item will levitate in the air and remain hovering there.

In Skylanders: Giants and Trap Team, Dino-Rang can perform a glitch were he seems to moonwalk. In order for this glitch to work, Dino-Rang must have the upgrade Boomerang Finesse. Then the player must make Dino-Rang run to a wall, crate or enemy and hold the primary attack button. As long as the player holds down the primary attack button, Dino-Rang can walk in any direction and still face forward.
Despite pictures, there is no such thing as a Dino-Rang figure with his diamond boomerangs.
Dino-Rang was the most expensive Skylander figure created.

In Spyro's Adventure, if dialogue or a cinematic interrupts Dino-Rang while both of his boomerangs are out of his hands, he will be missing them throughout the scene. His boomerangs will return once the Boomerang Shield ability is used.
If interrupted while using Boomerang Finesse in Giants, Dino-Rang's thrown boomerang will continue to spin around while another boomerang appears sideways in his empty hand.

dive-clops.name: Dive-Clops
dive-clops.description: Dive-Clops is a wingless flying eyeball in an atmospheric diving suit. He is one of the Water SuperChargers in Skylanders: SuperChargers. Apart from being Eye-Brawl's twin brother, his signature vehicle is the Dive Bomber.
dive-clops.biography: Believe it or not, Dive-Clops is actually the twin brother of Eye-Brawl. When he was young, his bat-wings were blasted off by pirates while flying over the Swirling Sea, causing him to plunge into the abyss below. After rolling on the bottom for several days, he was discovered by an underwater civilization of Jelly Dwarves. They were instantly fascinated by the bizarre looking eyeball and took him back to their Corral Castle, where they built him a magnificent dive suit that would allow him explore the depths of the sea. But everything changed when Dive-Clops decided to venture to the mysterious Whirlpool of Destiny deep within the ocean. As he got closer, he suddenly felt pulled by its immense power, and reemerged to discover that thousands of years had passed! Now with his destiny before him as a member of the Skylanders, Dive-Clops lets the minions of Kaos know that there are many dangers of the deep!
dive-clops.personality: Dive-Clops is very observant, similar to his twin brother, Eye-Brawl. He also has great knowledge of aquatic mechanics and the oceans of Skylands.
dive-clops.gameplay: In Skylanders: SuperChargers Racing, Dive-Clops is one of the best combat characters in the game. He boasts both excellent Firepower and maximum Armour, making him capable of both taking and dealing damage. His Top Speed is good, but his Acceleration and Handling let him down. As a SuperCharger, he has access to the vehicle mods. When paired with his Dive Bomber, his battle stats are improved tremendously. His Armour goes up immensely and his Firepower - while only receiving a modest boost - is helped by the Dive Bomber's naturally high stat. His Top Speed also receives a good boost while his Acceleration and Handling receive only minor boosts.

abilities.name: Waterpedo
abilities.description: Press Attack 1 to shoot a Waterpedo that creates a mine that damages enemies close to it and explodes when hit with Sonar.

abilities.name: Sonar
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 to create a sonar ping that damages enemies around you and cause Waterpedo mines to explode.

abilities.name: Put the Eye in Geyser
abilities.description: Press Attack 3 to unleash a geyser that pushes enemies back. Press Attack 3 again to end the geyser.

abilities.name: Echo Enhancers
abilities.description: Increases the range and damage of Sonar.

abilities.name: Power of the Pupil
abilities.description: While using your geyser, press Attack 1 or Attack 2 to perform special attacks.

abilities.name: Ping
abilities.description: Hold Attack 2 and release to shoot existing Waterpedos and mines upon the targeted enemy or location.

abilities.name: Depth of Field
abilities.description: Hold Attack 1 and release to shoot a huge cluster of Waterpedo mines. If you couldn't sea mines, you will now!

abilities.name: Torpeslow
abilities.description: Press Attack 1 to fire Waterpedoes that create mines which slow the movement of enemies close to the mine.

abilities.name: Mark II Waterpedo
abilities.description: Waterpedoes and Waterpedo mines do more damage. Mined your step!

abilities.name: Neato Waterpedo
abilities.description: Every other Waterpedo is a super Waterpedo that does more damage.

abilities.name: Sonar Smarts
abilities.description: Enemies hit with Sonar take more damage from Waterpedos for a short amount of time.

abilities.name: Counter Measures
abilities.description: Automatically send out a small sonar pulse when hit that will damage nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Hatch Off to You
abilities.description: Geyser does more damage and can be used longer. Tear it up!

trivia: Dive-Clops, Eye-Brawl, Eye-Small, Shroomboom, Rocky Roll (Rocky), and Magna Charge are currently the only Skylanders with one eye.

Despite being Eye Brawl's brother, who is a giant flying eyeball with no eyelids, Dive Clops appears to have expressive green eyelids when using certain attacks like the eye geyser, his eyelids are also visible in his defeat animation.
He is the second Skylander to be voiced by Maurice LaMarche while Night Shift is the first.
In his promotional art and figures, Dive-Clops appears to be left-handed.
Dive-Clop's original design bears a slight resemblance to Fish from the Disney movie, Chicken Little.
One of his upgrades, Ping, is a reference to the sound a sonar detector makes.
His name is a play on 'Cyclops'.
He is the only newly-introduced male SuperCharger to own a Sea Vehicle.
His catchphrase could be heard unfiltered on the Skylanders website.

doom-stone.name: Doom Stone
doom-stone.description: Doom Stone is a gladiator-like sentient stone statue who is one of the SWAP Force Skylanders in Skylanders: Swap Force. His SWAP Force Ability is Spin.
doom-stone.biography: Doom Stone was carved from the strongest and purest stone in Skylands, then magically brought to life by a wizard who was rather lazy and wanted someone strong to carry heavy things and perform other tasks around his castle. Doom Stone happily helped, and in his spare time learned the ancient ways of Stone Fighting should he ever need to protect the wizard, who became like a father to him. Sure enough the need arose when the wizard was kidnapped by his evil twin brother in order to steal his spells for himself. Doom Stone wasted no time in using the skills he learned to save his master. Afterward, the wizard knew Doom Stone had a greater calling and introduced him to Master Eon, who made him a Skylander.
doom-stone.personality: Doom Stone is a fearsome opponent but is always happy to help his friends with any task. He is most likely to appear stony-faced in battle and least likely to stand around.
doom-stone.gameplay: Doom Stone is an Earth Skylander from the SWAP Force. He uses a heavy column to bash enemies and can turn them into jade statues by blocking their attacks. His bottom half allows him to spin rapidly, damaging nearby enemies and charging a stone belt for increased power. Additionally, his shield can be upgraded to reflect projectiles and even release enchanted snakes to attack attackers.

abilities.name: Column Club
abilities.description: Press Attack 1 to swing a heavy column at nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Stoney Spin
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 to rapidly attack nearby enemies and charge the stoney belt. The belt increases damages and size the more it is charged.

abilities.name: Living Statue
abilities.description: Hold Attack 3 to block close attacks. Blocking attacks will cause nearby attackers to turn jade for a short time.

abilities.name: Reject and Reflect
abilities.description: Hold Attack 3 to block projectile attacks. Blocked projectiles are hit back at enemies, turning them into jade.

abilities.name: Column Duty
abilities.description: Hold Attack 1 to charge the Column Club, release to cause large area of damage. Cause more damage the longer Attack 1 is held.

abilities.name: Spin Right Around
abilities.description: Hold Attack 2 to charge a spin, release to bounce between nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Revolutionary Belt
abilities.description: Spinning does increased damage.

abilities.name: Speedy Spinner
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 to increase the speed that the belt is spinning. Speed is increased depending on how fast the belt is spinning.

abilities.name: Stoney Stare
abilities.description: Hold Attack 3 to block and cause enchanted snakes to come alive on the shield, damaging enemies while you block.

abilities.name: Spin The Tables
abilities.description: During the fourth spin, enemies in a large radius are damaged.

abilities.name: Falling to Pieces
abilities.description: Hold Attack 1 to charge Column Duty to release to smash the column and break off smaller pieces of it that damages enemies in a larger area.

abilities.name: Club Doom
abilities.description: Column Duty can be charged even longer, dealing more damage in a larger area.

abilities.name: Cracking Up
abilities.description: Enemies turned to jade will burst, causing small shards to damage other enemies near them.

abilities.name: More Doric Warfare
abilities.description: Hold Attack 3 to block attacks and do even more damage to blocked attackers.

abilities.name: The Harder They Fall
abilities.description: Hold Attack 2 to charge a spin, release to bounce between enemies and knock the last enemy hit into the air which damages them when they hit the ground.

abilities.name: Spinball King
abilities.description: Spin Right Around does increased damage. King of the Spinball wizards!

abilities.name: Jaded Spin
abilities.description: Now shoot jade projectiles at enemies when spinning.

abilities.name: Belt Pelters
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 to spin and shoot powerful jade projectiles at enemies that do increased damage.

trivia: His name is a play on the word 'tombstone'.
The pun in which the word 'doom' replaces the word 'tomb' is repeated with the Doom Raiders, and the phrase 'tomb raiders'.

The lazy wizard who brought Doom Stone to life once asked Doom Stone to clean all the windows of his home, but Doom Stone's super-strength caused all the windows to shatter to pieces at the slightest touch, and the wizard has vowed since then to only use a professional window washer.
He slightly resembles Doctor Doom from Marvel. Both have a grey and green color scheme and have 'Doom' for their names.
Doom Stone, Golden Queen and Crusher are the only Skylanders who can turn their enemies into statues. Coincidentally, they are all non-core Skylanders of the Earth element.
On his artwork and toy figure, Doom Stone has sand swirling around the pile of circular stones he has for legs that almost completely obscures them from view. However, the sand is absent in game.
He is voiced by Travis Willingham, who also voices the Undead Giant, Eye-Brawl.
Doom Stone, Magna Charge, Rattle Shake and Night Shift are the only SWAP Force Skylanders without any true legs.
Doom Stone and Free Ranger are the only SWAP Force Skylanders with the spin ability.
Doom Stone is the last SWAP Force member to be released. He is also the second non-core Skylander to be the last one released, while Ninjini is the first.
Doom Stone's 'Column Duty' and 'More Doric Warfare' upgrades are word-plays on the game series Call of Duty and one of the games in it, Modern Warfare (also produced by Activision).
The pupils within his eyes appear to be hollowed out.
Doom Stone is noticeably similar to Rubble Rouser: Both are Earth Skylanders, both are SWAP Force Skylanders, and both are made of stone.
When Doom Stone activates his shield, he is capable of stopping spinning enemies like Pirate Slamspins and Twistpick Cyclopses only when they hit it and become frozen.
If Doom Stone selects 'Jaded Fighter', ruby eyes will appear on the face of his shield and triangular emeralds show up around the rims.
Doom Stone is based on Greek mythology. His clothing/carving resembles that of a Greek/Roman gladiator. He can also turn enemies into jade, similar to how Medusa can turn her victims into stone.
In Skylanders: Lost Islands, Doom Stone is missing his shield.
If you place Doom Stone's top half onto Boom Jet's bottom half, you get Doom Jet, which, coincidentally, shares its name with Kaos's signature vehicle.

double-dare-trigger-happy.name: Double Dare Trigger Happy
double-dare-trigger-happy.description: Double Dare Trigger Happy is the SuperCharger counterpart of Trigger Happy in Skylanders: SuperChargers. His signature vehicle is the Gold Rusher.
double-dare-trigger-happy.biography: As a result of being transformed by a Rift Engine, Trigger Happy's abilities changed drastically, though he is still able to shoot coins rapidly out of his flaming pistols. He can summon a barrier of pyrotechnics to do group damage with his secondary ability, Crowd-Pleaser. When upgraded further, his tertiary ability, Breaking Cannon, Trigger Happy can shoot himself out of an actual cannon and damage enemies on impact. After purchasing his Soul Gem, He's Safe!, the gremlin gunslinger will be able to revive himself after being defeated.
double-dare-trigger-happy.personality: Double Dare Trigger Happy greatly resembles a stereotypical daredevil, often seen shooting himself out of a cannon with little regard for his safety. Despite his normal counterpart being capable of speech in various media, Double Dare Trigger Happy is known to not talk very much.
double-dare-trigger-happy.gameplay: In Skylanders: SuperChargers Racing, Double Dare Trigger Happy is classified as an all-rounder driver. However, his stats are erratic and make it hard to use him effectively. His Top Speed and Handling are both pretty good, and his Acceleration is great; these stats combined resemble classic Intermediate class kart drivers. His Firepower is also high, with his major downside being his below OK Armour. As a SuperCharger, he has access to the vehicle mods. When paired with his Gold Rusher, he receives major stat boosts to his race-specific stats and only minor boosts to his battle stats.

abilities.name: Fire Cracker
abilities.description: Press Attack 1 rapidly to shoot your Fire Cracker.

abilities.name: Crowd-Pleaser
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 to shoot off pyrotechnics and damage enemies around you.

abilities.name: Breaking Cannon
abilities.description: Press Attack 3 to shoot yourself out of a Cannon! Enemies in the way will be damaged by the force of the impact.

abilities.name: Hoop N' Holler
abilities.description: Hold Attack 1 to charge up and shoot out of a fire hoop. Jumping or shooting yourself through it causes it to explode.

abilities.name: Just Warming Up
abilities.description: Ignite your weapons, making them cause more damage to enemies.

abilities.name: Can On and On
abilities.description: Press Attack 3 to shoot yourself out of a Cannon over a greater distance! Enemies in the way will be damaged by the force of impact.

abilities.name: He's Safe!
abilities.description: Once, revive after being defeated and jump out of a huge safe!

abilities.name: Hot Feet Hoop
abilities.description: Hold Attack 1 to charge up and shoot out a fire hoop. Jumping or shooting yourself through it causes it to explode and will cause you to gain increased movement.

abilities.name: Acrobatic
abilities.description: Hold Attack 1 while jumping to charge up your fire ring and jump through it.

abilities.name: Fire And Forget
abilities.description: When you charge up your cannon, you'll shoot out a fire ring in front of you to burst through immediately.

abilities.name: Cannon Crash
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 while charging your cannon to shoot up into the air and do a large amount of to nearby enemies when landing.

abilities.name: Pay Day!
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 to damage enemies around you and pull in coins and food drops.

abilities.name: Making It Rain!
abilities.description: Hold Attack 1 while jumping to unleash a gun barrage on your enemies below!

trivia: Despite his normal counterpart being capable of speech in Skylanders: Imaginators, the Skylanders comics, books and other media, Double Dare Trigger Happy doesn't talk very much.
He greatly resembles a stereotypical daredevil, especially since he can shoot himself out of a cannon.
Double Dare Trigger Happy is the second Skylander that can revive after being defeated, the first being Night Shift and the third being Crash Bandicoot.
One of his quotes is a reference to the movie Snakes on a Plane.
Concept art includes sketches of Double Dare Trigger Happy with a hat, sunglasses, a gun adorned with a flag, or spacesuit-like armor.
Very few characters have less regard for their safety than Trigger Happy. So, of course, he's a daredevil!

double-trouble.name: Double Trouble
appearances: Lightning Rod Faces the Cyclops Queen
double-trouble.description: Double Trouble is a magical sorcerer with a red, and brown tiki mask face with yellow trimmings, feathery hair, green eyes, and a yellow mouth. His skin is blue and he's wearing a dry grass skirt with a small bone in the middle, and wooden armbands. He even holds a magical staff, shaped like a clawed hand holding a green orb. Certain upgrades give his staff a battleaxe shape, or a tiki shape.
double-trouble.biography: Double Trouble was an adept spellcaster. On an expedition to find exotic ingredients for his potions, he traveled in search of a rare lily that was said to multiply the power of any spell. So thrilled was he when he found it, Double Trouble instantly ate the plant and performed a spell. Suddenly, there was a loud pop… then another… and another – until Double Trouble was surrounded by exact copies of himself. As it turned out, he had misunderstood the details about exactly what would multiply. But it didn’t matter, for he quickly realized the clones were delightful companions… never mind that they were only half his size and would explode on contact.
double-trouble.personality: A loner at heart, Double Trouble discovered the joys of companionship through his clones. Always upbeat, the spirited shaman is a bundle of unearthly Eldritch energy.
double-trouble.gameplay: As a result from eating the Whispering Water Lily, the bewitched bloom gave Double Trouble the power to create exploding clones of himself, which seek out foes before they explode. Double Trouble's primary attack is shooting beams of energy from his eldritch staff. Double Trouble can even summon magical spheres to rain down which explode like bombs. His Soul Gem allows him to fly over water. In Lightning Rod Faces the Cyclops Queen, it was shown that he could also use the beams from his eldritch staff to levitate objects, as he was able to raise an anchor with it. Double Trouble could see through the eyes of his clones, and even delay his double's explosions for a while, allowing him to use them as helpers.

abilities.name: Eldritch Beam
abilities.description: Press and hold the primary power button to fire beam of energy that locks onto targets. Damage = 10. Crit = 15.

abilities.name: Conjure Exploding Double
abilities.description: Summon a mindless double that seeks out enemies and explodes. Damage = ??? Crit = ??? x 1.5.

abilities.name: Arcane Eldritch Beam
abilities.description: Eldritch Beam attack does increased damage. Damage = 15. Crit = 22.5.

abilities.name: Conjure Unstable Double
abilities.description: Exploding Doubles do increased damage. Damage = 23. Crit = 34.5.

abilities.name: Summon Magic Bomb
abilities.description: Summon a Magic Bomb. Damage = 50. Crit = 75.

abilities.name: Advanced Construct Techniques
abilities.description: Have up to 3 Exploding Doubles active at any given time.

abilities.name: Waterwalker
abilities.description: Can fly over water. In Swap Force: Double Trouble now hovers over hazards and gains increased speed in Water Power Zones.

abilities.name: Triple Trouble!

abilities.name: Magic Armageddon

abilities.name: Spirit Construct
abilities.description: Exploding Doubles form automatically when enemies are defeated.

trivia: When Double Trouble hits a sheep with his Eldritch Beam, the sheep's white fleece will change color.
The eyes on Double Trouble's mask blink, therefore they are his real eyes.

In Skylanders: Spyro's Adventure, Swap Force, Trap Team, SuperChargers and Imaginators, the mouth on Double Trouble's mask opens while he says his catchphrase, meaning that his mask could potentially be his actual face.
Double Trouble is one of many Skylanders who can summon helpers (others include Sonic Boom, Warnado, Terrafin, Eye-Brawl, and Hot Head).
He is one of three original Skylanders who can fly without the use of wings or jetpacks (the others being Warnado and Hex).

Series 2 Double Trouble has the Arcane Eldritch Beam upgrade, giving him an axe-like staff. Also, in his Series 2 figure form, he has a mini double by his side. He and Sonic Boom are the only two Skylanders in their Series 2 figure to have minions by their sides.

Double Trouble has a unique figure available in the Skylanders: Battlegrounds starter pack, which is identical to his Series 1 counterpart, but with an orange base. In the game, it is treated as a Series 2 character. This figure is often referred to by the community as Series 1.5 Double Trouble.
Sometimes, Double Trouble will sing his 'Ooga Booga' quote in a style of Ride of the Valkyries.
His catchphrase, 'Boom Shock-A-Lacka!' is a pun on Marv Albert and Tim Kitzrow's NBA Jam catchphrase 'Boomshackalacka!'

dr-krankcase.name: Dr. Krankcase
dr-krankcase.description: Dr. Krankcase is a cyborg mad scientist who is one of the playable Tech villains in Skylanders: Trap Team. He is a former member of the Doom Raiders, a group of notorious villains. In Skylanders: Imaginators, Krankcase has given up on a life of crime to become a Quickshot Sensei and train Imaginators.
dr-krankcase.biography: No one is really quite sure exactly what Dr. Krankcase is a doctor of... but his technical engineering achievements are legendary. The secret to his success lies in his modified concoction of glowing green goo, which causes wooden objects to come to life and turn evil. His unique skillset makes him a valuable asset to the Doom Raiders, who have plenty of nefarious uses for evil wooden creatures called Evilikin. It is also commonly known that Dr. Krankcase served as an evil inspiration to Kaos once upon a time, who had figured out how to make his own wooden creatures, the Wilikin, come to life after reading about the doctor's exploits in the Minion Monthly Catalog. Kaos also respected Dr. K's interest in world domination and doom engineering, not to mention his well-documented love of pickles.
dr-krankcase.personality: Dr. Krankcase is polite and has a friendly disposition towards his enemies, even striking up small exchanges before and during a battle, and also makes puns referencing to his goo guns. He is still, however, a maniacal mad scientist who enjoys creating evil inventions and won't hesitate on unleashing them and his own abilities upon those who oppose him and the Doom Raiders. After his rehabilitation in Imaginators, Krankcase still holds great pride in his inventions, but now believes that science should be used for the greater 'GOO'D' of Skylands, as he puts it.
dr-krankcase.gameplay: Dr. Krankcase can fire a spray of green goo from his small gun. He can also rotate his spider legs like a buzzsaw and slide them against enemies. As demonstrated during his boss fight, Dr. Krankcase can create Woodensteins in a matter of seconds from a wooden box, green goo and materials. After completing his Villain Quest, he gained the ability to melt various dioramas throughout Time Town for accessing all areas. In Skylanders: Battlecast, his abilities are augmented with a mechanic to gradually worsen an enemy's health. His green goo now prevents healing, his Woodstein seeks out weak enemies, and he can create a Smog Machine relic whose intoxicating fumes gradually decrease max health on the enemy side. He can also drop a Barrel o' Laughs on enemies to release a Tech spell's energy as damage.

abilities.name: Goo Guns
abilities.description: Press Attack 1 to shoot Goo Blobs.

abilities.name: Spin Doctor
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 to spin at your enemies.

abilities.name: Hat Bots
abilities.description: Press Attack 3 to throw out Hat Bots to fight for you.

abilities.name: Splats All Folks
abilities.description: Spin into Goo Puddles to cause them to splatter for damage.

abilities.name: Hat-tacular

abilities.name: Shot Goo the Heart
abilities.description: Hold Attack 1 to charge up a gigantic Goo Shot attack.

abilities.name: Goo Goo G'shoot (Sky-Chi)
abilities.description: The Ultimate Sensei attack! Hold Special Attack to perform your Sky-Chi Power! Shoot your goo at everyone. Use Left Stick to move around.

abilities.name: Caustic Effect
abilities.description: Goo Puddles cause damage to enemies.

abilities.name: Goo'ing Big
abilities.description: Goo Guns shoot bigger blobs that create bigger puddles.

abilities.name: Goo'd Weather
abilities.description: Spinning into Goo Puddles Releases a shower of Goo Blobs.

abilities.name: Hat Bot Havoc
abilities.description: Throw 3 Hat Bots at one time. Increase the maximum number of Hat Bots to 6.

abilities.name: Goo Bots
abilities.description: When Hat Bots expire, they explode, leaving behind a Goo Puddle.

abilities.name: Goo Wouldn't Believe It!
abilities.description: Hat Bots exposed to Goo become extra strong.

trivia: Despite being shown as white in his art and clips, his eyes are yellow in-game.
In the Skylander Boom Bloom's backstory, it was revealed that Dr. Krankcase created her as a result of his plant mutation experiments.
The official Skylanders website originally misspelled his name as 'Dr. Crankcase.' This has since been changed.
Dr. Krankcase is similar to Spy Rise: both are Tech characters, have spider-like legs, wear goggles, and use ranged weapons.
According to one of his trap crystal quotes, he and Mags went to the same inventor school together, but Krankcase majored in evil.
One of his quotes is a reference to the Star Wars quote, 'May the force be with you.'
He built his own wooden spider-like legs after misplacing his original ones and failing with spring-based designs.
Dr. Krankcase replaces the Dragon Hunter in Skylanders: SuperChargers Racing.
Dr. Krankcase is susceptible to his own Smog Machine in Battlecast.
Dr. Krankcase is the only character to jump from frontline to the back manually using a grappling hook.
He is voiced by Quinton Flynn, known for Axel in Kingdom Hearts and Sheldon Lee in My Life as a Teenage Robot.
His Sky-Chi move is a reference to Goo Goo G'joob from the Beatles' "I Am The Walrus".
Krankcase was planned for Skylanders Academy's season two but was cut due to budget reasons.
Dr. Krankcase and Dr. Neo Cortex are the only playable characters labeled as doctors.
The name of one of his basic upgrades 'Splats All Folks' is a pun of the famous Looney Tunes catchphrase 'That's all Folks'.
His 'For the Greater Goo'd' path is a goo pun on the Warhammer reference 'For the Greater Good'.
Dr. Krankcase is one of the only Skylanders bosses who can be damaged by the hazards in his own boss arena.

dr-neo-cortex.name: Dr. Neo Cortex
dr-neo-cortex.description: Neo Cortex is a short, yellow-skinned and large-headed man with a giant 'N' symbol located on his forehead, bigger lip with a spiky goatee, bald head with hair on the sides of it and a thick black strand on top, and with large red circles under his eyes. He wears a lab coat with black arms and legs, accompanied with yellow gloves. In one hand, he holds a laser blaster.
dr-neo-cortex.biography: Doctor Neo Periwinkle Cortex is a professional scientist born in Peoria, Illinois, and is the main antagonist of the Crash Bandicoot series. He is Crash Bandicoot's arch-nemesis and creator. In Skylanders: Imaginators, a wormhole has opened in Skylands and the great Aku Aku appears! He comes to announce the once-in-two-decades Synchronization Celebration -- it is the time when all the worlds align perfectly. All the inhabitants of Wumpa Island are having a huge party in the Wumpa Islands and want to invite the Skylanders. But Dr. Neo Cortex has created a sinister machine to harness this incredible energy for his own evil purposes, only to watch it go completely haywire. Now Dr. Neo Cortex must partner with Crash Bandicoot to stop the machine before Wumpa Islands are completely shaken apart!
dr-neo-cortex.personality: Dr. Neo Cortex is a professional scientist with a massive ego and a volatile temperament. As a long-time antagonist, he is defined by his deep-seated hatred for Crash Bandicoot and his relentless pursuit of world domination. Despite his brilliance, he is often frustrated by the failures of his own machines and the incompetence of his henchmen. While he is capable of working with his enemies when a greater threat arises, he remains untrustworthy and smug about his superior intellect.
dr-neo-cortex.gameplay: Dr. Neo Cortex is a Sorcerer-class Sensei who utilizes advanced technology and mystical masks in combat. He relies on his blaster for primary ranged damage and can deploy mines that launch enemies into one another. Cortex gains mobility through his hoverboard and can summon Uka Uka for both defense and offensive area control. His Sky-Chi ability, Rehabilita-Laser, allows him to fire a massive laser beam that can be aimed with precision across the battlefield.

abilities.name: Wanted: Dead or Up High

abilities.name: Rehabilita-Laser

abilities.description: Being struck by an Insane Bolt powers up the Blaster Beam. Laser shots split into multiple projectiles for a short time. Insane Bolts try to land nearby until a boost is granted!

abilities.description: Press Attack 2 to damage and push back enemies in a line straight ahead. Projectiles in the way are destroyed.

abilities.description: Uka Uka now defends the area for a short time when a projectile is successfully blocked. Uka Uka also now explodes projectiles when he blocks them, dealing damage in the area around the deflection.

abilities.name: You Do That Voodoo
abilities.description: Hold Attack 2 to control Uka Uka and knock enemies around all over the battlefield.

trivia: Cortex and Boom Bloom are the only Senseis to not have a weapon from their battle classes. While Cortex can turn his weapon into a staff, he mainly wields a gun.
Cortex is the first Skylander to be human, though because of his original series' art style, he does not appear to be one.
His name is a pun on neocortex, the largest part of the brain.

Just as with Crash, characters in Thumpin' Wumpa Islands will have custom dialogue if you play as Cortex. In his case, they will act untrustworthy towards him (rightfully), believing he is the cause of the problem in some way.
He and Crash are two of the characters to also act as Adventure Pack figures, adding Thumpin' Wumpa Islands to the game.
Despite being the only Guest Star who is able to talk freely, like the other Guest Stars, he does not have a catchphrase.
Cortex is the second villain who did not appear in Trap Team to have a Skylander figurine (The first is Hammer Slam Bowser).

Unlike Hammer Slam Bowser and Turbo Charge Donkey Kong who are only playable on Nintendo consoles, he and Crash Bandicoot are the first and only guest characters that can be played on any gaming console.
On his figure he has white sleeves. However, in-game he has black sleeves.
The name of Cortex's first 'Gadgets Galore' ability, 'N. Tropy's Slow Mo Flow', is a reference to Dr. N. Tropy.
Dr. Neo Cortex and Dr. Krankcase are the only playable characters labeled as doctors.
The promo artwork of the Skylander version of Cortex was used for the concepts of Cortex's Castle in Crash Team Racing: Nitro-Fueled.
He and Crash are the only Senseis not featured in Skylanders Creator. Despite that, their unique parts can still be unlocked through timed chests.
One of Cortex's Wonderful Wizardry upgrades 'Mask in the Mirror' is perhaps a play on the Michael Jackson song Man in the Mirror.
His Soul Gem ability's name is a play on 'Wanted: Dead or Alive'.
During a Grind Challenge, he slides only on his left foot.

drill-sergeant.name: Drill Sergeant
drill-sergeant.description: Drill Sergeant is a train-like, drilling Arkeyan machine who is one of the playable Tech Skylanders in the Skylanders series, first appearing in Skylanders: Spyro's Adventure.
drill-sergeant.biography: Like many Arkeyan artifacts, Drill Sergeant was buried for centuries – a long forgotten remnant of an ancient powerful civilization. It was only a chance collision with a burrowing Terrafin that led to his systems firing up again. By Arkeyan custom, Drill Sergeant was then obligated to become Terrafin's servant. This didn't sit well with the dirt shark, so his first order as master was for Drill Sergeant to not serve him at all… a command he continues to follow zealously to this day.
drill-sergeant.personality: Drill Sergeant was built and programmed to obey orders, which results in him calling everyone 'sir', which irritates some of his comrades. He follows rules to the letter, never wavering until the job is done. As a valued member of the Skylanders, he is a free machine, answering to no one, but old habits of his Arkeyan programming hasn't yet diminished. Like all Tech Skylanders, Drill Sergeant is fascinated by machinery.
drill-sergeant.gameplay: Drill Sergeant can destroy rock formations with his drill rocket and bulldoze charge attacks. He is a Tech element Skylander who specializes in long-range Drill Rockets and a dash move. His Auto-Blaster upgrade fires at nearby enemies automatically and is unique for being usable simultaneously with other powers. In older games, he is uniquely capable of destroying rock formations despite not being an Earth element Skylander.

abilities.description: Bulldozer Charge does extra damage and can charge through some attacks.

trivia: Even though the Arkeyans were the first to discover the Tech Element, Drill Sergeant is the only Arkeyan in the series to actually be of the Tech Element (Chop Chop and Krypt King are Undead, and most other Arkeyans do not have known Elements).
In Spyro's Adventure and Giants, Drill Sergeant can destroy rock formations with his Drill Rocket attack.
This makes him the only Skylander who can destroy rocks that isn't of the Earth element.
This ability was excluded in Imaginators. And because of that, there is a glitch. When Drill Sergeant fires the rocket at the rocks, the rocket disappears and Drill Sergeant cannot respawn another.
His catchphrase is a pun on the phrase 'licensed to kill,' often utilized by policemen.
His Auto-Blaster upgrade (when not upgraded) is the least damaging move out of any character's powers, outside of Mining Picks.
It is also the only non-flying upgrade that can be used simultaneously with other powers.
Drill Sergeant, Stump Smash, Prism Break, Eruptor and Countdown are the only five bipedal Skylanders with no hands.
Series 2 Drill Sergeant has the A View To Drill upgrade, giving him spiked drills.
He, Drobot, Bouncer, Drobit, Magna Charge and Ro-Bow are the only six Skylanders who have robotic voices.

Drill Sergeant uses robotic beeping quotes sutch as 'Bee-boo-bop', 'Boo-boo-beep', 'Bee-boop-boo-boo-bop' at the end of most of his battle cries or catchphrases. He's the only Skylander to have this feature.
Drill Sergeant is one of the few Skylanders to have drilling abilities (others include Grilla Drilla and Rubble Rouser, and partially Ro-Bow).

Sometimes Drill Sergeant will have his drills tucked in him and remain until you can do a Bulldoze Charge or fire a drill rocket. This usually happens when Drill Sergeant hits a wall suddenly in his Bulldoze Charge.
If Drill Sergeant shoot a drill rocket at Shrednaught before the battle starts, the camera will glitch.
Despite their description, Drill Rockets do not often home in on enemies.
His Wow Pow on consoles, Futurecannon, is similar to one of his 3DS upgrades, Stun Shot.

drobit.name: Drobit
drobit.description: Drobit is the Mini counterpart of the Tech Skylander, Drobot in Skylanders: Trap Team.
drobit.biography: The Skylander Minis started off as regular 'Sidekicks,' assisting the Skylanders on many exciting adventures. And what they lacked in size they more than made up for in courage. Ultimately determined to become full-fledged heroes, they trained at the Skylands Academy - honing their powers and skills until they were ready. Now, they stand side by side with their full grown counterparts, ready to defend Skylands against Kaos and his evil minions.
drobit.personality: Drobit enjoys studying and is known for being a smarty-pants. He's got a big heart too, which is a nice balance.
drobit.gameplay: Drobit's attacks include Mega Blasters, Tactical Bladegears, Thruster Flight, Hover Mode, and Quadratic Blasters. These are the starting and maximum Statistics for this Skylander in the Skylanders games: Health: 280 (max. 560), Speed: 60 (max. 108), Armor: 24 (max. 54), Critical Hit: 20 (max. 70), and Elemental Power: 25 (max. 75).

abilities.name: Mega Blasters
abilities.description: Drobit fires his Mega Blasters at enemies.

abilities.name: Tactical Bladegears
abilities.description: Drobit releases Tactical Bladegears to slice through foes.

abilities.name: Thruster Flight
abilities.description: Enables flight for Drobit using his thrusters.

abilities.name: Hover Mode

abilities.name: Quadratic Blasters

drobot.name: Drobot
appearances: Lightning Rod Faces the Cyclops Queen
drobot.description: Drobot is a Tech dragon Skylander who wears a robot suit. He first appeared in Skylanders: Spyro's Adventure. He was also featured in the second Episode Dungeon in Skylanders: Ring of Heroes.
drobot.biography: Dragons are smart, but none so much as Drobot. He was born in the highest reaches of Skylands, where dragons spent all their time competing in aerial battles. But Drobot was more interested in taking things apart to see how they worked. While exploring one day, he came upon some mysterious technology, which he used to assemble a robotic suit. Features include laser beams that shoot from his eyes, flight enhancement technology, a vocal synthesizer that gives him a deep booming voice, and the ability to shoot spinning gears. With such power – more than most other dragons – Drobot joined the Skylanders to help protect the residents of Skylands.
drobot.personality: Exceptionally intelligent, Drobot is driven by logic and the pursuit of knowledge. He can turn his hand to any technology and is ferocious in battle. A super-genius, Drobot analyses everything he comes across. While he seemed cold and calculating at first, the Skylanders soon discovered that he is as brave as he is intelligent. Drobot may be smart, but he never shies away from a fight. Instead of waiting to be invited to be a Skylander, Drobot sought out Master Eon and offered his services. Like many dragons, he also has a sense of humor and uses his knowledge to come up with new pranks.
drobot.gameplay: Drobot can shoot powerful rapid fire lasers from his eyes and wings, and fire rotating gears from his wings that ricochet off of surfaces. He can also fly after being upgraded with thruster flight, and it can be further upgraded with afterburners.

abilities.name: Mega Blasters
abilities.description: Shoot rapidfire laser blasts out of your eyes.

abilities.name: Tactical Bladegears
abilities.description: Deploy spinning bladegears that ricochet off of walls and pummel enemies.

abilities.name: Thruster Flight
abilities.description: Allows Drobot to fly.

abilities.name: Galvanized Bladegears
abilities.description: Bladegears do increased damage.

abilities.name: Axon Focus Crystals
abilities.description: Eye Blasters do increased damage.

abilities.name: Hover Mode
abilities.description: Allows Drobot to hover.

abilities.name: Afterburners
abilities.description: Flies faster and afterburners damage enemies.

abilities.name: Supreme Bladegear
abilities.description: Hold Attack 2 to combine Bladegears into one controllable Super Bladegear!

abilities.name: Dendrite Focus Crystals
abilities.description: Eye Blasters do even more increased damage.

abilities.name: Antimatter Charges
abilities.description: Eye Blaster beams explode on contact, doing damage to nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Quadratic Blasters
abilities.description: Shoot lasers out of your wings as well.

abilities.name: Depleted Uranium Bladegears
abilities.description: Bladegears do even more increased damage.

abilities.name: Explosive Bladegears
abilities.description: Bladegears explode on contact, doing damage to nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Tri-Spread Bladegears
abilities.description: Shoot 3 Bladegears at once.

trivia: Drobot relaxes by playing chess - against himself.

Since he uses a vocal synthesizer to give himself a deep booming voice, it is currently unknown what Drobot's real voice sounds like. The full extent of his modifications are also unknown, as he talks like a robot AI despite being partially organic.
Since he wears a suit that covers up most of his head, it's also unknown what his eyes and crest look like.
According to his voice actor, Alex Ness, his robotic voice was inspired by that of the G1 incarnation of the Transformer Soundwave.
Drobot's name is most likely a combination of 'dragon' and 'robot'. It is also a surname.
The mysterious technology he found were Arkeyan.
As a LightCore, the battlesuit core on his back lights up, resembling the afterburners upgrade. It also has the most dim effect and does not glow as brightly as the other Lightcores.
The strategy guide for Skylanders: Giants incorrectly states his catchphrase as 'Seek and Destroy'. His catchphrase is also similar to the Metallica song 'Seek & Destroy'.
The Uranium Bladegears on the Clockwork Dragon path share the color scheme with his suit.
He, Trigger Happy and Spyro are the only three non-Fire Skylanders who can kill Rotting Robbies in Spyro's Adventure. However, this only works on the Wii version.

Drobot's original color scheme was reddish brown to most likely match the color of his element like the other dragon Skylanders. However, this color scheme is still used in Drobot's artwork in the games and in media.

His flight capabilities are quite different to flight capabilities of other Skylanders: harder to control but much faster to accelerate; he will also automatically go forward if the button is not held down to enter hover mode, and if you hit a wall while flying, he will stop.
He and Swarm are the only two Skylanders who can damage enemies just by flying.
If the player uses his Bladegears while flying, Drobot will fly slower than normal.
In his Episode Dungeon in the old version of Skylanders: Ring of Heroes, Drobot is mistakenly referred to as a machine despite being an organic dragon wearing a robotic flying suit.
During the development of Spyro's Kingdom, Drobot was indeed entirely roboticized, and only later on gained organic parts.
Lightcore Drobot's artwork can be seen in the Season 1 intro of the Skylanders Academy television series within The Book of Skylanders.
In his official artwork and figures, Drobot's eyes are yellow. However, in Swap Force his eyes appear green, and the Swap Force HUD portrait for LightCore Drobot depicts his eyes as violet.

dune-bug.name: Dune Bug
dune-bug.description: Dune Bug is a Magic Flying Rhinoceros beetle Skylander from Skylanders: Swap Force.
dune-bug.biography: Hailing from a race of beetles changed by the powerful secrets hidden in a buried Arkeyan city, Dune Bug was next in line to become the defender of those secrets. As a small pupa, Dune Bug and his father would travel to the ruins where he learned to read the ancient writings using his father's magic staff. On the day Dune Bug was to be given his own magic staff, the city fell under attack by the evil Sand Mages of Doom, who were after the secret Arkeyan tomes. Knowing what he had to do, Dune Bug used his magic to defeat the Mages and bury the city deeper into the ground until it was forever out of their reach. Dune Bug earned his magic staff that day - and a place alongside the Skylanders.
dune-bug.personality: Dune Bug is a noble and dedicated defender of ancient secrets. Having been raised to protect Arkeyan knowledge, he is both studious and courageous. He demonstrates a strong sense of duty, as shown when he buried his own city to keep it out of the hands of the evil Sand Mages of Doom.
dune-bug.gameplay: Dune Bug utilizes his magic staff and a rolling Dune Ball to control the battlefield. He can shoot magical beams, explosive orbs, or dune grenades to trap and damage enemies. His high mobility allows him to hover in the air to increase speed and generate shockwaves or sparks of magic while in flight. His unique quest involves rolling his Dune Ball for a total of 5000 feet.

abilities.name: Dune Ball
