abilities.description: Hold Attack 1 to fire rapid streams of powerful magic from a new staff.

abilities.name: Buzzing Beetle
abilities.description: Press Attack 3 to hover in the air. Speed is increased while hovering!

abilities.name: Buggy Buddy
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 twice to summon Buggy, a little bug who rides a dune ball and rolls up nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Stunning Spread
abilities.description: Hold Attack 1 for a short time to charge the staff, release to shoot three powerful exploding orbs of magic at enemies.

abilities.name: Scarab Power
abilities.description: Gain a new golden staff that shoots magic projectiles that do increased damage.

abilities.name: Magic Scarab Ride
abilities.description: Jump while hovering to create a large shockwave that damages nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Dune Bomb
abilities.description: Hold Attack 1 for a short time to charge the staff, release to shoot a dune grenade that traps enemies and explodes.

abilities.name: Hardened Shell
abilities.description: Armor is increased. A new hardened shell reduces damage taken.

abilities.name: Sparking Wings
abilities.description: Press Attack 3 to hover, causing sparks of magic to shoot out from behind.

trivia: Dune Bug's name is a play on 'Dune Buggy'.
It may also be a pun on 'Junebug' which is a type of scarab beetle.
Dune Bug resembles a Japanese rhinoceros beetle.
He shares one of the same quotes with Roller Brawl, 'I'm on a roll!'
When he purchases 'Hardened Shell' from his upgrade path, 'Dune Mage', he will turn gold all over.
He is the second Magic Skylander who can fly while Spyro is the first.
In spite of trusting the Skylanders, Dune Bug never reveals the location of his ancestral home to them, not even to Master Eon.
Dune Bug's British accent, his catchphrase and his species name might be a reference to The Beatles.
Dune Bug slightly resembles Eatle from Ben 10 Ultimate Alien and the Pokémon Karrablast.
Dune Bug is the second insect Skylander (the first being Swarm, the third being High Five, and the fourth being Thrillipede).
Dune Bug is voiced by Nolan North, who is the current voice actor for Deadpool in most MARVEL animated media.
Dune Bug was one of the many Skylanders planned to appear in Skylanders: Ring of Heroes. Before the game's closure, only concept art of his Awakened Form was released.

echo.name: Echo
echo.description: Echo holds the ability to release powerful sound waves by screaming, and breathe explosive bubbles that pump with the musical beat. She can also create a sonic slam to knock away her enemies.
echo.biography: Echo lived in an undersea kingdom that was built around an enormous oyster shell, and at its center was the Pearl of Wisdom. Every day water dragons from all around the kingdom would come to ask questions of the Pearl. Because this was a sacred ritual, anyone living near the Pearl were required to speak only in whispers. This was challenging for Echo, who lived directly next to it. She had a gift – and it was loud – and often got her in trouble. One day, a gang of sea horses known as the Aqua Jocks rode into town and claimed the Pearl for themselves. They cast an unbreakable bubble around it and began dragging it away with enormous chains. The nearby water dragons, who had been quiet for so long, were unable to even call for help. Then Echo appeared – and with her loudest sonar blast, she shattered the bubble and blew the sea horses out of the kingdom! Her heroic actions caught the attention of Gill Grunt, who recruited her as a Skylander. Now Echo sounds off against evil all throughout Skylands!
echo.personality: Echo may seem reserved, but she can be feisty when the time comes for battle. She can be rather noisy, not liking to do things quietly as she is a music lover.
echo.gameplay: Echo holds the ability to release powerful sound waves by screaming, and breathe explosive bubbles that pump with the musical beat. She can also create a sonic slam to knock away her enemies.

abilities.name: Siren Scream
abilities.description: Press Attack 1 for a Siren Scream, damaging enemies.

abilities.name: Bubble Bombs
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 to create explosive bubbles that move to the beat.

abilities.name: Sonic Slam
abilities.description: Press Attack 3 to create a sonic slam, damaging enemies on the ground.

abilities.name: Pitch Control
abilities.description: Can hold the Siren Scream notes for longer, doing more damaging.

abilities.name: 4-Beat
abilities.description: Deploy up to 4 Bubble bombs at any time, which now do extra damage.

abilities.name: Subsonic
abilities.description: Sonic Slam now creates an aftershock that deals extra damage.

abilities.name: Call of the Siren
abilities.description: Use Siren Scream on a Bubble Bomb to put enemies in a painful trance.

abilities.name: Bubble Shield
abilities.description: Hold Attack 2 to protect yourself in a bubble that absorbs damage until it pops.

abilities.name: Power Pop
abilities.description: All Bubble Bombs do MAXIMUM damage at an increased range.

abilities.name: Burst My Bubble
abilities.description: While in a Bubble Shield, press Attack 3 to make it explode and damage nearby enemies..

abilities.name: Ultimate Pitch Control
abilities.description: Hold Attack 1 indefinitely for an never-ending Siren Scream.

abilities.name: Scream Out
abilities.description: Quickly press Attack 1 again after a Siren Scream to deliver a powerful shout attack.

abilities.name: Ultrasound
abilities.description: Hold Attack 3 to charge the Sonic Slam attack and unleash another, more powerful burst.

trivia: She is named after a reflection of sound, like a same sound coming back to you when you shout, which can occur within a hallway with no soft materials, or when up in the mountains. Also known as an 'echo'
Sound travels 4.3 times faster underwater, giving her Water Elemental background a poetic sense of irony.
She is the second dragon Skylander in the Water element (the first being Zap).
Despite being a dragon, Echo resembles a seahorse.
When she's idle or still, Echo dances and moves to the beat of the music she's listening to with her seashell headphones, with three different variations.
She has the loudest roar out of all the other dragons.
Despite being able to scream or roar loudly, she is not a big mouthed dragon. In fact, Echo has the smallest mouth out of all the other dragons.
Her mouth is tiny, and she doesn't have any teeth. Much like all the other known female dragons, such as Cynder, Flashwing, Spotlight and Whirlwind.
In her Sing along path in Trap Team, the Ultrasound upgrade when fully charged is one of the strongest attacks that a Skylander could do.
While charging up the Ultrasound attack, it disrupts the theme music of any level or villain battles momentarily replacing it with dance music as Echo dances.

Echo has a great resemblance to the Dazzlings such as Sonata Dusk from the animated superhero/musical film, My Little Pony: Equestria Girls 2: Rainbow Rocks, namely the fact Sonata Dusk and Echo share the same color scheme of light/dark blue and are mainly underwater adapted quadrupeds with powerful song abilities.
Her siren scream ability is similar to 'Echo Echo' from Ben 10 : Alien Force/Ben 10 : Ultimate Alien.
Coincidentally, her voice actor Kimberly Brooks would later voice a character also named Echo from a completely different series, Oddballs.
Both Echo and Cynder wear punk-styled jewelry on their neck and front legs.

egg-bomber-air-strike.name: Egg Bomber Air Strike
egg-bomber-air-strike.species: Unknown (Air Strike) and Blue Zephyr Falcon (Birdie)
egg-bomber-air-strike.description: Egg Bomber Air Strike is an Easter counterpart of Air Strike in Skylanders: Imaginators.
egg-bomber-air-strike.biography: Before he began training Brawlers, Air Strike trained birds – especially the rare Blue Zephyr Falcons. They were once one of Skylands’ most endangered species, but Air Strike taught them how to defend themselves from predators... and not fly into windows. Birds would come from all over Skylands to learn his proven techniques. But despite their new defensive skills, the Blue Zephyr Falcons continued to be hunted by a band of evil trolls, who liked to use their eggs in blue-bacon omelets. So it was time for Air Strike to strike back! He journeyed to the peak of the Zephyr Mountain and single handedly took down the trolls, rescuing the stolen eggs. After returning them to their mother, one of the eggs hatched, revealing a very energetic Falcon that would not leave his side. Air Strike named him 'Birdie' – and together, they now use their skills to train Skylanders, despite Master Eon's crippling fear of falcons.
egg-bomber-air-strike.personality: Air Strike is a dedicated and protective mentor who values the safety of nature and his avian students. He is brave enough to take on bands of trolls single-handedly and possesses the patience required to train even the most energetic of falcons.
egg-bomber-air-strike.gameplay: Egg Bomber Air Strike is a Brawler class Sensei who utilizes his falcon companion, Birdie, in combat. His moveset includes a variety of bird-themed physical strikes and area-of-effect storm attacks, culminating in his unique explosive egg barrage.

abilities.name: Bird Brawl
abilities.description: Air Strike and Birdie work together to deliver rapid-fire strikes.

abilities.name: Bird Dive Bomb
abilities.description: Birdie dives from the sky to strike enemies from above.

abilities.name: Spinning Bird Fist
abilities.description: A spinning punch attack that knocks back surrounding enemies.

abilities.name: Eye of the Storm
abilities.description: Create a localized storm to trap and damage foes.

abilities.name: Free Range Eggs
abilities.description: Launch a barrage of explosive eggs to devastate groups of enemies.

trivia: Egg Bomber Air Strike is the Easter-themed variant of Air Strike.
His falcon companion is named Birdie.
He was first released for Skylanders: Imaginators.
Master Eon has a crippling fear of falcons, which makes training Skylanders with Birdie an interesting challenge.

eggcited-thrillipede.name: Eggcited Thrillipede
eggcited-thrillipede.description: Eggcited Thrillipede is the Easter counterpart of Thrillipede in Skylanders: SuperChargers.
eggcited-thrillipede.biography: Thrillipede is all suited up and ready to defend his title as the reigning Dragon Egg Toss Champion. After last year's controversy, when Kaos wrongly accused him of coating several Dragon Eggs with sticky tape, Thrillipede is eager to show everyone that his egg tossing supremacy was no fluke. And to prove his point, he's agreed to enter the competition with one hand tied behind his back!
eggcited-thrillipede.personality: Eggcited Thrillipede is a confident and highly competitive athlete. He is extremely proud of his status as the Dragon Egg Toss Champion and is willing to go to extreme lengths, such as fighting with one hand tied behind his back, to prove that his egg tossing supremacy was no fluke.
eggcited-thrillipede.gameplay: In Skylanders: SuperChargers, Eggcited Thrillipede is a Life element SuperCharger who specializes in using explosives and his many limbs. His attacks include throwing Bug Bombs, engaging in Bug Brawls, and immobilizing enemies by keeping them Cocooned. He can also use Better Fly for mobility and summon Gnawing Gnats to distract and damage his enemies.

abilities.name: Bug Bomb
abilities.description: Throws explosive bug bombs at enemies.

abilities.name: Bug Brawl
abilities.description: Engages in close-quarters combat with multiple limbs.

abilities.name: Cocooned
abilities.description: Traps enemies in a sticky cocoon to immobilize them.

abilities.name: Better Fly
abilities.description: Enhances flight capabilities for better mobility.

abilities.name: Gnawing Gnats
abilities.description: Summons a swarm of gnats that persistently attack and distract enemies.

trivia: While his eyes are normal in his promotional art, Eggcited Thrillipede's eyes in the games proper are completely black.

eggsellent-weeruptor.name: Eggsellent Weeruptor
eggsellent-weeruptor.description: Eggsellent Weeruptor is an Easter counterpart of the Fire Mini, Weeruptor, in Skylanders: Trap Team.
eggsellent-weeruptor.biography: It's springtime again and Weeruptor was chosen as this year's official mascot for the Annual Dragon Egg Hunt! Being new to this time honored tradition, he disguised himself as a candy-coated egg and proceeded to capture Spyro, Cynder, and Drobot within a Traptanium basket. Sort of missing the point of the occasion. But what he lacks in point-getting, he more than makes up for in 'Eggsellence'!
eggsellent-weeruptor.personality: Eggsellent Weeruptor is enthusiastic about festive traditions, though he is somewhat literal-minded, which led him to capture his fellow Skylanders during an egg hunt. He is determined to live up to his mascot role with 'Eggsellence'.
eggsellent-weeruptor.gameplay: Eggsellent Weeruptor plays identically to Weeruptor and Eruptor, focusing on area-of-effect fire attacks. He can lob lava at a distance or create eruptions to clear out enemies surrounding him. Despite his small size, he retains the full power of his larger counterpart.

abilities.name: Lava Lob
abilities.description: Lobs a chunk of lava at enemies.

abilities.name: Eruption
abilities.description: Causes a localized volcanic eruption to damage nearby foes.

abilities.name: Big Blob Lava Throw
abilities.description: Increases the size and damage of lava projectiles.

abilities.name: Heavy Duty Plasma
abilities.description: Enhances the lava with plasma for higher intensity.

abilities.name: Quick Eruption
abilities.description: Reduces the cooldown and increases the speed of eruptions.

trivia: He, Power Punch Pet-Vac, and Gnarly Barkley are the only Minis to be available in single packs instead of double packs.

elite-boomer.name: Elite Boomer
elite-boomer.description: Elite Boomer is an Eon's Elite Tech Skylander who represents the pinnacle of troll demolition expertise, featuring significantly boosted stats and a premium golden finish compared to his standard counterpart.
elite-boomer.biography: Elite Boomer is the Eon's Elite counterpart of Boomer in Skylanders: SuperChargers. As a member of Eon's Elite, Elite Boomer has access to incredible race stats when used with Skylanders: SuperChargers Racing, boasting maximum Firepower and improved stats overall compared to his standard form.
elite-boomer.personality: Elite Boomer is explosive, energetic, and dedicated to the cause of Eon's Elite, often letting his bombs do the talking. He represents the pinnacle of troll demolition expertise, specially selected by Master Eon to defend Skylands.
elite-boomer.gameplay: As a member of Eon's Elite, Elite Boomer has access to incredible race stats when used with Skylanders: SuperChargers Racing. Elite Boomer has great race stats overall, with neither Top Speed, Acceleration or Handling being his main priority. He has maximum Firepower for a driver, but he only has decent Armour. His stats are noticeably similar to Double Dare Trigger Happy's, although Elite Boomer's are better.

abilities.name: Dynamite Toss
abilities.description: Throws a stick of dynamite at enemies.

abilities.name: Troll Smash
abilities.description: Smashes the ground to create a shockwave.

abilities.name: Troll Bomb
abilities.description: An enhanced bomb attack.

abilities.name: Bomblastic
abilities.description: A more powerful explosive blast.

abilities.name: Triple Bundle Dynamite
abilities.description: Throws a massive bundle of dynamite for maximum damage.

trivia: Elite Boomer is the only one of Eon's Elites whose health is much lower than Elite Trigger Happy's.
He is voiced by Joey Camen, who has provided the voice for Boomer since 2012.

elite-chop-chop.name: Elite Chop Chop
elite-chop-chop.description: Elite Chop Chop is the Eon's Elite counterpart of Chop Chop in Skylanders: Trap Team.
elite-chop-chop.biography: Of all the heroic Skylanders, there are several that Master Eon depends on to lead others into battle against the forces of evil. Eon's Elites are the selected few that have displayed courage and bravery against all odds – and are revered by their fellow Skylanders for their inspiration and unwavering commitment to defend Skylands!
elite-chop-chop.personality: Chop Chop is a relentless and stoic Arkeyan warrior, possessing an unwavering commitment to defending Skylands. He is loyal, disciplined, and focused entirely on his duty, often speaking in a direct and formal manner.
elite-chop-chop.gameplay: Elite Chop Chop retains the classic move set of Chop Chop, featuring a balance of offensive sword strikes and defensive shield mechanics. As an Eon's Elite, he possesses significantly higher stats than his standard counterpart, making him one of the most durable and powerful warriors in the game.

abilities.name: Sword Slash
abilities.description: A quick slash with the Arkeyan blade that deals damage to enemies in front of you.

abilities.name: Arkeyan Shield
abilities.description: Hold the button to raise the Arkeyan Shield, blocking incoming attacks and reducing damage taken.

abilities.name: Spiked Shield Bash
abilities.description: While the shield is raised, press the primary attack button to perform a powerful bash with the shield's spikes.

abilities.name: Arkeyan Vorpal Blade
abilities.description: The Arkeyan blade is upgraded to deal increased damage with every slash.

abilities.name: Vampiric Aura
abilities.description: A dark aura surrounds Chop Chop, allowing him to regenerate health whenever he defeats an enemy.

trivia: Elite Chop Chop is the Eon's Elite counterpart of Chop Chop.
He was first released in Skylanders: Trap Team.
His English voice actor is Steven Blum (2012).

elite-dino-rang.name: Elite Dino-Rang
elite-dino-rang.description: Elite Dino-Rang is an Earth element Skylander and part of the Eon's Elite team, making his debut in Skylanders: SuperChargers.
elite-dino-rang.biography: Elite Dino-Rang is the Eon's Elite counterpart of Dino-Rang in Skylanders: SuperChargers. As an Eon's Elite Skylander, he has been selected for his courage and strength, and granted significantly increased power by Master Eon himself to lead the charge against the forces of Kaos.
elite-dino-rang.personality: Elite Dino-Rang is a focused and disciplined warrior, embodying the strength and stability of the Earth element. He is a loyal member of Eon's Elite, dedicated to the protection of Skylands.
elite-dino-rang.gameplay: In gameplay, Elite Dino-Rang plays similarly to his standard counterpart but features significantly boosted statistics. He specializes in ranged combat using his Stone Boomerangs and crowd control with his Stonefist Traps and Boomerang Shield.

abilities.name: Stone Boomerangs
abilities.description: Dino-Rang throws powerful earthen boomerangs at his enemies.

abilities.name: Boomerang Shield
abilities.description: Dino-Rang creates a protective shield of rotating boomerangs.

abilities.name: Stonefist Traps
abilities.description: Places traps on the ground that snare and damage enemies using stone fists.

abilities.name: Dervish Shield
abilities.description: Enhances the boomerang shield to deal more damage and last longer.

abilities.name: Volcanic Glass Boomerangs
abilities.description: Boomerangs are infused with volcanic glass, dealing massive fire and earth damage.

abilities.name: Elite Stone Boomerangs
abilities.description: Further increases the damage and range of the Stone Boomerangs.

trivia: Elite Dino-Rang is one of the few Eon's Elite characters released during the SuperChargers era.
He features significantly higher Armor and Power stats compared to his standard version.

elite-eruptor.name: Elite Eruptor
elite-eruptor.description: Elite Eruptor is the Eon's Elite counterpart of Eruptor in Skylanders: Trap Team.
elite-eruptor.biography: Of all the heroic Skylanders, there are several that Master Eon depends on to lead others into battle against the forces of evil. Eon’s Elite are the selected few that have displayed courage and bravery against all odds – and are revered by their fellow Skylanders for their inspiration and unwavering commitment to defend Skylands!
elite-eruptor.personality: Elite Eruptor is revered by his fellow Skylanders for his courage, bravery, and unwavering commitment to defend Skylands, leading others into battle against the forces of evil.
elite-eruptor.gameplay: As a Lava Monster, Elite Eruptor utilizes fire and magma-based attacks. His moveset includes hurling lava, creating eruptions, and launching mega magma balls to devastate enemies, culminating in his powerful Super Eruption ability.

abilities.name: Lava Lob
abilities.description: Elite Eruptor hurls a glob of lava at his enemies.

abilities.name: Eruption
abilities.description: Creates a localized volcanic blast to damage nearby foes.

abilities.name: Mega Magma Balls
abilities.description: Enhances magma projectiles for greater damage and area of effect.

abilities.name: Heavy Duty Plasma
abilities.description: Intensifies fire attacks with high-temperature plasma energy.

abilities.name: Super Eruption
abilities.description: The ultimate volcanic attack, unleashing a massive eruption that covers a wide area.

trivia: Elite Eruptor's official art uses an edited version of his Series 2 artwork, with his extra headspikes from his Wow Pow edited out. This makes him one of only two Elite Skylanders to not use the Series 1 version of his artwork that his figure is based on, along with Elite Gill Grunt.
Coincidentally, both Elite Eruptor and Elite Gill Grunt were released together.
He is the only Elite Skylander of the Fire element.
He and Elite Whirlwind are the only Elite Skylanders of their respective elements.

elite-ghost-roaster.name: Elite Ghost Roaster
elite-ghost-roaster.description: Elite Ghost Roaster is the Eon's Elite counterpart of Ghost Roaster in Skylanders: SuperChargers.
elite-ghost-roaster.biography: Elite Ghost Roaster is the Eon's Elite counterpart of Ghost Roaster in Skylanders: SuperChargers. As an Eon's Elite, he has been granted significantly increased power to defend Skylands against its greatest threats.
elite-ghost-roaster.personality: Elite Ghost Roaster maintains a manic and energetic personality, emphasized by his signature cackling and his catchphrase 'No Chain, No Gain!'
elite-ghost-roaster.gameplay: Elite Ghost Roaster plays similarly to his original version but with vastly increased health and damage output. He relies on his Chain Whip for primary damage and Skull Charge for mobility and crowd control. His Ectoplasm Mode allows him to maneuver through tight spots without taking damage.

abilities.name: Chain Whip
abilities.description: A powerful whip attack using Ghost Roaster's chain to strike enemies from a distance.

abilities.name: Skull Charge
abilities.description: A charging attack where Ghost Roaster rams into enemies with his skull head.

abilities.name: Ectoplasm Mode
abilities.description: Ghost Roaster enters a spectral state, allowing him to pass through enemies and hazards while dealing damage.

abilities.name: Haunt
abilities.description: Infect enemies with spectral energy that damages them over time.

abilities.name: Nightmare Touch
abilities.description: A devastating touch attack that releases immense undead energy upon contact with enemies.

trivia: Elite Ghost Roaster is voiced by John Kassir.
He is the Eon's Elite version of the original Spyro's Adventure character Ghost Roaster.

elite-gill-grunt.name: Elite Gill Grunt
elite-gill-grunt.description: Elite Gill Grunt is the Eon's Elite counterpart of Gill Grunt in Skylanders: Trap Team.
elite-gill-grunt.biography: Of all the heroic Skylanders, there are several that Master Eon depends on to lead others into battle against the forces of evil. Eon's Elite are the selected few that have displayed courage and bravery against all odds – and are revered by their fellow Skylanders for their inspiration and unwavering commitment to defend Skylands!
elite-gill-grunt.personality: Elite Gill Grunt is characterized by his unwavering commitment to defend Skylands and his display of courage and bravery against all odds. He serves as an inspiration to his fellow Skylanders.
elite-gill-grunt.gameplay: As an Eon's Elite, Elite Gill Grunt possesses significantly higher stats than his standard counterpart, specifically in health and power. He utilizes his trademark Harpoon Gun and Water Cannon to dispatch enemies, while his Water Jet Pack allows for superior mobility on the battlefield.

abilities.name: Harpoon Gun
abilities.description: Shoots a harpoon at enemies.

abilities.name: Water Cannon
abilities.description: Sprays a blast of water at enemies.

abilities.name: Boiling Water Hose
abilities.description: The Water Cannon now sprays boiling water for more damage.

abilities.name: Water Jet Pack
abilities.description: Allows Gill Grunt to fly using a water jet pack.

abilities.name: Anchor Cannon
abilities.description: A powerful cannon that launches heavy anchors.

trivia: Elite Gill Grunt's official art uses an edited version of his Series 2 artwork, with his Quadent Harpoon replaced with a regular one and a regular Water Jetpack. This makes him one of only two Elite Skylanders to not use the Series 1 version of his artwork that his figure is based on, along with Elite Eruptor.
Coincidentally, both Elite Gill Grunt and Elite Eruptor were released together.

elite-slam-bam.name: Elite Slam Bam
elite-slam-bam.description: Elite Slam Bam is the Eon's Elite counterpart of Slam Bam in Skylanders: SuperChargers.
elite-slam-bam.biography: Elite Slam Bam is the Eon's Elite counterpart of Slam Bam in Skylanders: SuperChargers.
elite-slam-bam.personality: As one of Eon's Elite, Slam Bam is recognized for his immense strength and heroic deeds. He is a courageous Yeti dedicated to protecting Skylands with his four powerful arms and icy abilities.
elite-slam-bam.gameplay: Elite Slam Bam features significantly increased health and stats compared to his standard counterpart, making him one of the tankiest characters in the series. He retains Slam Bam's core move set including Yeti Fists and Ice Prison but lacks the ice sled Wow Pow from his Series 2 version.

abilities.name: Yeti Fists
abilities.description: Elite Slam Bam uses his four powerful arms to pummel enemies with crushing blows.

abilities.name: Ice Prison
abilities.description: Freeze enemies in blocks of ice to stop them in their tracks.

abilities.name: Arctic Explosion
abilities.description: Ice prisons explode upon breaking, dealing damage to nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Yeti Ice Shoes
abilities.description: Elite Slam Bam slides on ice, allowing for much faster movement.

abilities.name: Ice Knuckles
abilities.description: Elite Slam Bam's fists are reinforced with spiked ice for maximum damage.

trivia: Despite having an ice sled in one of the promotional game screenshots, Elite Slam Bam doesn't possess the Series 2 Wow Pow power to acquire it.
Out of all of the Skylanders, including variants, Elite Slam Bam and Elite Terrafin have the highest amount of health.
Despite being released during SuperChargers, in Trap Team, he is listed as an Eon's Elite.

elite-spyro.name: Elite Spyro
elite-spyro.description: Elite Spyro is the Eon's Elite counterpart of Spyro in Skylanders: Trap Team.
elite-spyro.biography: Of all the heroic Skylanders, there are several that Master Eon depends on to lead others into battle against the forces of evil. Eon's Elite are the selected few that have displayed courage and bravery against all odds – and are revered by their fellow Skylanders for their inspiration and unwavering commitment to defend Skylands!
elite-spyro.personality: He is revered by his fellow Skylanders for his courage and bravery against all odds, as well as his unwavering commitment to defend Skylands.
elite-spyro.gameplay: Elite Spyro is a member of the Eon's Elite, making him significantly more powerful than his standard counterpart. He possesses the same move set as his Series 1 incarnation but with drastically increased statistics to reflect his elite status.

abilities.name: Fire Breath
abilities.description: Shoot a stream of fire.

abilities.name: Horn Charge
abilities.description: Charge at enemies with your horns.

abilities.name: Dragon Flight
abilities.description: Spyro can fly into the air.

abilities.name: Triple Shot
abilities.description: Fire Breath shoots three fireballs at once.

abilities.name: Fire Shield
abilities.description: While flying, Spyro is protected by a shield of fire.

abilities.name: Spitfire
abilities.description: Fire Breath deals more damage.

abilities.name: Super Charge
abilities.description: Horn Charge deals more damage and travels further.

trivia: Spyro and Whirlwind are the only Dragon Skylanders to have Eon's Elite counterparts.
His English voice actors are Josh Keaton (2011-2015) and Matthew Mercer (2016).

elite-stealth-elf.name: Elite Stealth Elf
elite-stealth-elf.description: Elite Stealth Elf is the Eon's Elite counterpart of Stealth Elf in Skylanders: Trap Team.
elite-stealth-elf.biography: Of all the heroic Skylanders, there are several that Master Eon depends on to lead others into battle against the forces of evil. Eon's Elite are the selected few that have displayed courage and bravery against all odds – and are revered by their fellow Skylanders for their inspiration and unwavering commitment to defend Skylands!
elite-stealth-elf.personality: Revered by their fellow Skylanders for their inspiration and unwavering commitment to defend Skylands!
elite-stealth-elf.gameplay: As a member of Eon's Elite, Elite Stealth Elf has access to incredible race stats when used with Skylanders: SuperChargers Racing. Elite Stealth Elf has good Top Speed, and overall great and balanced Firepower and Armour. Her Acceleration is also exceptional, but like her SuperCharger variant, her best stat is her Handling; maxing out at the highest possible for a driver.

abilities.name: Blade Slash
abilities.description: A swift attack using daggers to slash enemies.

abilities.name: Stealth
abilities.description: An ability to disappear and move unseen.

abilities.name: Dragonfang Daggers
abilities.description: Improved daggers for increased damage.

abilities.name: Arboreal Acrobatics
abilities.description: Enhanced mobility and acrobatic maneuvers.

abilities.name: Elf Jitsu
abilities.description: A powerful advanced combat technique.

trivia: Stealth Elf and Whirlwind are the only female Skylanders to be part of Eon's Elites.

elite-terrafin.name: Elite Terrafin
elite-terrafin.description: Elite Terrafin is the Eon's Elite counterpart of Terrafin in Skylanders: Trap Team.
elite-terrafin.biography: Of all the heroic Skylanders, there are several that Master Eon depends on to lead others into battle against the forces of evil. Eon's Elite are the selected few that have displayed courage and bravery against all odds – and are revered by their fellow Skylanders for their inspiration and unwavering commitment to defend Skylands!
elite-terrafin.personality: Elite Terrafin is a brave and committed leader, revered by his fellow Skylanders for his unwavering dedication to defending Skylands.
elite-terrafin.gameplay: As an Eon's Elite, Elite Terrafin is significantly more powerful than his standard counterpart, featuring boosted stats. In gameplay, he retains his signature moves of Shark Punching and Earth Swimming while benefiting from superior Strength and Defense.

abilities.name: Shark Punch
abilities.description: Elite Terrafin throws a heavy punch at enemies.

abilities.name: Earth Swim
abilities.description: Elite Terrafin dives underground to move safely and attack from below.

abilities.name: Brass Knuckles
abilities.description: Brass knuckles that increase punch damage.

abilities.name: Mega Bellyflop
abilities.description: A massive bellyflop attack that crushes enemies.

abilities.name: Razorfin
abilities.description: A sharpened fin that deals more damage while earth swimming.

trivia: Elite Terrafin is voiced by Joey Camen (2012) and Chris WIlliams (The Beginning Trailer).
Elite Terrafin has significantly higher base stats compared to standard Skylanders.

elite-trigger-happy.name: Elite Trigger Happy
elite-trigger-happy.description: Elite Trigger Happy is the Eon's Elite counterpart of Trigger Happy in Skylanders: Trap Team. He is revered by his fellow Skylanders for his courage and unwavering commitment to defend Skylands, and is notable for holding the record for the most damage any playable character can deal in a single attack.
elite-trigger-happy.biography: Of all the heroic Skylanders, there are several that Master Eon depends on to lead others into battle against the forces of evil. Eon's Elite are the selected few that have displayed courage and bravery against all odds – and are revered by their fellow Skylanders for their inspiration and unwavering commitment to defend Skylands!
elite-trigger-happy.personality: Trigger Happy is chaotic, energetic, and obsessed with gold, always ready to blast away enemies with his dual coin shooters and a wild laugh.
elite-trigger-happy.gameplay: Elite Trigger Happy is the Eon's Elite version of Trigger Happy. His signature move, the Golden Yamato Blast, is the most powerful attack in the later games, capable of causing 2880 damage with a critical hit, which is the highest damage output of any playable character in the series.

abilities.name: Gold Coin Shooters

trivia: Elite Trigger Happy's Golden Yamato Blast is the most powerful attack in the last games, landing him the record for most damage any playable character in the series can do in a single attack. Though Cuckoo Clocker comes at a very close second, he is unavailable after Trap Team.
This blast with a critical hit causes 2880 damage.
Oddly, in Skylanders: SuperChargers, the critical hit instead causes 1050 damage.

elite-voodood.name: Elite Voodood
elite-voodood.description: Elite Voodood is the Eon's Elite counterpart of Voodood in Skylanders: SuperChargers. He possesses significantly higher stats than his standard form.
elite-voodood.biography: Elite Voodood is the Eon's Elite counterpart of Voodood in Skylanders: SuperChargers. Like all Eon's Elites, he is a powered-up version of his original self, boasting significantly higher stats and starting at level 20. He remains a dedicated defender of Skylands, using his magical axe to strike down evil. He is known for acting with his axe first and asking questions only when the battle is won.
elite-voodood.personality: Elite Voodood is a fierce and direct warrior, living by his motto of acting first and asking questions later. He is brave and loyal to Master Eon's cause, characterized by his swift and decisive combat style.
elite-voodood.gameplay: Elite Voodood plays identically to his standard version but possesses much higher health and damage output. He excels in close-quarters combat with his Axe Reaver and utilizes his Zipline Axe for mobility and strategic positioning on the battlefield. As an Eon's Elite, he is capable of withstanding far more damage than standard Skylanders.

abilities.name: Axe Reaver
abilities.description: A melee attack that strikes enemies with a powerful magical axe.

abilities.name: Zipline Axe
abilities.description: Voodood throws his axe and uses it as a grappling hook to pull himself toward enemies or traverse gaps.

abilities.name: Magical Tripwire
abilities.description: Leaves behind a magical tripwire that damages enemies who pass through it.

abilities.name: Extended Blade
abilities.description: Increases the range and reach of the Axe Reaver.

abilities.name: Electro Axe
abilities.description: The Axe Reaver is imbued with electrical energy, dealing additional damage.

trivia: Although he wields an upgraded Axe Reaver in toy form, there are no new upgrades for Elite Voodood besides possessing higher stats and starting off at Level 20 like the other SuperChargers Eon's Elites.
His English voice actor is André Sogliuzzo.

elite-whirlwind.name: Elite Whirlwind
elite-whirlwind.description: Elite Whirlwind is the Eon's Elite counterpart of Whirlwind in Skylanders: Trap Team.
elite-whirlwind.biography: Of all the heroic Skylanders, there are several that Master Eon depends on to lead others into battle against the forces of evil. Eon's Elite are the selected few that have displayed courage and bravery against all odds - and are revered by their fellow Skylanders for their inspiration and unwavering commitment to defend Skylands!
elite-whirlwind.personality: Courageous and brave, Elite Whirlwind is revered by her fellow Skylanders for her unwavering commitment to defend Skylands against all odds.
elite-whirlwind.gameplay: Elite Whirlwind is the Eon's Elite counterpart of Whirlwind, featuring significantly higher stats in gameplay. As an Elite Skylander, her power is significantly increased compared to her standard form, making her a formidable ally in the fight against evil.

abilities.name: Rainbow of Doom
abilities.description: Whirlwind shoots a rainbow that damages enemies.

abilities.name: Tempest Cloud
abilities.description: Whirlwind creates a cloud that strikes enemies with lightning.

abilities.name: Dragon Flight
abilities.description: Whirlwind takes to the sky, flying over obstacles and enemies.

abilities.name: Duel Rainbows
abilities.description: Whirlwind fires two rainbows at once to double her damage.

abilities.name: Atomic Rainbow
abilities.description: An incredibly powerful rainbow attack that causes massive damage.

trivia: She and Elite Spyro are the only Dragon Skylanders to have Eon's Elite versions.
She and Elite Stealth Elf are the only female Skylanders to be part of Eon's Elites.
She is the only Elite Skylander of the Air element.
She and Elite Eruptor are the only Elite Skylanders of their respective elements.

ember.name: Ember
ember.description: Ember is an orange woman with fire in place of legs black and gold traditional samurai armor and the golden sensei belt. She wields a dual-bladed red-hot katana.
ember.biography: Ember was raised inside the Dragonfire Dojo, having come from a long line of Fire Sentinels that were skilled in the art of Dual-Blades. It was the dream of her father that Ember would follow their tradition and take over the family training facility, and so she practiced every day. She was naturally gifted, and soon even the greatest Dual-Blade Masters were no match for Ember. When Kaos heard of this, he took over her village and banned martial arts entirely, for fear of an uprising. But Ember fought back, unleashing an impressive barrage of Samurai pyrotechnics that drove the invaders away. Even though her village was free, she knew then that there was greater evil out there that needed to be stopped, and so she joined the Skylanders to train others in the art of the Sentinel Battle Class. One day though, Ember plans to return to her homeland and reopen her family’s school, but not until Skylands is safe once and for all.
ember.personality: Naturally gifted in the arts of the Sentinel Class, Ember is a disciplined warrior with deep ties to her tradition. She is dedicated to protecting Skylands so that she may one day return to reopen her family's training facility. Her wisdom is reflected in her use of philosophical battle cries and training advice.
ember.gameplay: Ember can use her Dual-Blade red-hot katanas to attack at mid-range with quick slices and spinning motions. She can summon meteor strikes and streams of magma from afar, and slam into the ground with her fiery tail to set it on fire. She can also attach explosive rocks to her enemies that explode after a short period of time. With her Sky-Chi, she can spin in such great speeds that her tail forms a fiery tornado, shooting her belt's shurikens and meteor strikes across the battlefield. Her Soul Gem allows her to create fiery shield that blocks all damage for a short time when at low health, this can be used once per level.

trivia: Despite being a Sentinel Sensei, her Sky-Chi has her throwing fiery shurikens, making her similar to another Sensei of her element.

Ember's voice actor, Stephanie Sheh, is best known for voicing Hinata Hyuga from Naruto, Katana from DC Superhero Girls, Jinafire Long from Monster High, Sailor Moon/Usagi from Sailor Moon, and Orihime from Bleach.
Most of Ember's quotes are actual inspirational quotes from real people.
Ember has a Chase Variant named Dec-Ember, with a cyan crystal body, white translucent hair and shurikens designed after christmas lights (similar to Snow-Brite Stormblade).
She's the only Fire Sensei without an alt deco.
During development, she was named Scorch.
A Power Blue variant for Ember was planned, but was scrapped.
She was named after Toys for Bob staff member Kim Acuff Steiner, also known by her screen name Ember Dione.

enchanted-hoot-loop.name: Enchanted Hoot Loop
enchanted-hoot-loop.description: Hoot Loop was raised by a guild of magicians in Skylands' most famous traveling circus. At a young age, he perfected illusions and spells that only the very best of their guild could perform, and even mastered the art of teleportation! Soon enough, he became the star of the show, known far and wide as the Amazing Hoot Loop. However, one day an army of Greebles disguised as clowns invaded, determined to destroy the popular circus. It was then that Hoot Loop gave a performance that few would ever forget. Using his incredible powers, he fought off the invaders and saved the circus - to the raucous applause of the many spectators - including Master Eon, who presented Hoot Loop with an opportunity to learn some real magic as a member of the Skylanders.
enchanted-hoot-loop.biography: Enchanted Hoot Loop is the alter ego of Hoot Loop in Skylanders: Swap Force. His Swap Force Ability is Teleport. He is a Walmart exclusive Skylander.
enchanted-hoot-loop.gameplay: These are the starting and maximum Statistics for this Skylander in the Skylanders games. Warning: These stats are not used in any of the Skylander games. They are only listed for completeness reasons. Strength: 100, Defense: 100, Agility: 60, Luck: 200.

enchanted-star-strike.name: Enchanted Star Strike
enchanted-star-strike.description: Enchanted Star Strike is the alter ego of LightCore Star Strike in Skylanders: Swap Force.
enchanted-star-strike.biography: Enchanted Star Strike is the alter ego of LightCore Star Strike in Skylanders: Swap Force.
enchanted-star-strike.personality: Mysterious and cosmic, Enchanted Star Strike shares the enigmatic traits of her original form, Star Strike, enhanced by her specialized Enchanted state.
enchanted-star-strike.gameplay: In Skylanders: Swap Force, Enchanted Star Strike features a hooded cape that changes from white to turquoise. If her Soul Gem ability, 'Shooting Stars,' is purchased, the rest of her outfit also changes colors. In Skylanders: Imaginators, she has a Health stat of 260 (scaling to 780), Attack of 9 (59), and Armor of 4 (29).

In the game, her hooded cape changes from white to turquoise. If her Soul Gem ability, 'Shooting Stars,' is purchased, the rest of her outfit also changes colors.
The pose in her official artwork is similar to Star Strike's non-LightCore art, except with glowing eyes.
She is the first non-Legendary Alt Deco LightCore figure.

enigma.name: Enigma
enigma.description: Enigma is a mysterious cloaked figure who is one of the Magic Trap Masters in Skylanders: Trap Team.
enigma.biography: Summoned by a Mabu Mystic, Enigma comes from a nameless place 'between the worlds.' Though the Mystic was really just looking for someone to play Skystones, he was quickly enraptured by Enigma's stories about his mysterious homeland. Unfortunately, the Darkness got wind of these stories, and seeking another realm to conquer, sent minions to lay siege on the gateway that remained open. Making matters worse, the Mabu had no idea how to close it. So, with a legion of minions fast approaching, Enigma chose to use his Sigil of Mystery to seal the doorway – cutting him off from his home forever. This large sacrifice caught the attention of the Trap Team, who welcomed Enigma and gave him a new home as a protector of Skylands. He now uses his Traptanium Sigil to put a world of hurt on evil everywhere!
enigma.personality: Sometimes Enigma can be difficult to figure out. He's kind of like a puzzle. Despite his reclusive nature, he possesses a courageous side as he willingly sacrificed his only gateway home to prevent the Darkness from entering his realm. In Ring of Heroes, he's inquisitive and spares no compliments for those who deserve it, but keeps it to himself when it comes to teamwork and focuses on the larger picture when it comes to villains.
enigma.gameplay: Enigma is a Magic Trap Master who uses his Traptanium Sigil, a large U-shaped staff with a large eyeball. He excels in stealth, turning invisible to evade enemies and leave damaging magic mist behind. His staff attacks can be chained into powerful combos, and he can slam his staff for area damage or charge it to rain down magic eyeballs.

trivia: Much like Star Strike, Enigma's face is concealed by his hood. However, Enigma's head appears to be invisible.
Enigma is the first to have a figure form that is half transparent.
Enigma shares the ability to go invisible with Stealth Elf.
Enigma, Flameslinger, and Blaster-Tron are the only three Skylanders without visible eyes.
He makes a cameo in the Fortune Telling card in Skylanders: Battlecast, possibly as a reference to The Magician Tarot Arcana.
Enigma is the only Skylander with a special running animation in Ring of Heroes, teleporting to the next screen rather than walking.
Enigma and Double Trouble have many similarities: They both have blue skin. They are both Magic sorcerers with covered faces.
Enigma is also similar to Wisemon from the Digimon series: both are mysterious, cloaked entities.
Enigma can skip nearly 37 Villains Except for Doom Raiders. (as this will softlock the game) To do this, you need the Invisible Invader path

eon-s-elite.name: Eon's Elite
eon-s-elite.description: Eon's Elite are a group of Skylanders originated from Skylanders: Spyro's Adventure that stand atop golden bases with a transparent bottom, who are three times stronger than their normal forms. They were offered in premium foil packaging, featuring a display case with a 3D lenticular background.
eon-s-elite.biography: Of all the heroic Skylanders, there are several that Master Eon depends on to lead others into battle against the forces of evil. Eon's Elite are the selected few that have displayed courage and bravery against all odds – and are revered by their fellow Skylanders for their inspiration and unwavering commitment to defend Skylands!
eon-s-elite.personality: Courageous and brave leaders who have displayed bravery against all odds. They are revered by their fellow Skylanders for their inspiration and unwavering commitment to defend Skylands.
eon-s-elite.gameplay: When played in-game, Eon's Elite will be up to three times as powerful as other characters. All members of Eon's Elite start off at Level 20 in SuperChargers, and in SuperChargers Racing, they are the only Skylanders other than SuperChargers who provide stat boosts to Vehicles. They are labeled as Series 2 Specials in Skylanders: Giants, allowing them to activate Wow-Pows and change paths.

abilities.name: Elite Power Boost
abilities.description: When played in-game, Eon's Elite will be up to three times as powerful as other characters, which represents the biggest in-game boosts ever incorporated into a Skylanders toy to date.

abilities.name: Elite Wow-Pow
abilities.description: Eon's Elite Skylanders are labeled as Series 2 Specials in Skylanders: Giants. Because of this, they can activate Wow-Pows and change paths, though their Wow-Pow cannot be carried over into later games.

trivia: Every Skylander in the first set of Eon's Elite have had Series 3 counterparts.
Eon's Elite Skylanders are labeled as Series 2 Specials in Skylanders: Giants, except for Dino-Rang, Ghost Roaster, Boomer and Voodood, who are labeled as Series 1 Special.
All members of Eon's Elite start off at Level 20 in SuperChargers.
In SuperChargers Racing, they are the only Skylanders other than SuperChargers who provide stat boosts to Vehicles.
Elite Stealth Elf and Elite Whirlwind are the only female members of Eon's Elite.
Elite Gill Grunt and Elite Eruptor use their Series 2 artwork instead of their Series 1 artwork, edited to remove any upgrades.
With the release of the Eon's Elite figures in Skylanders: Superchargers, Sunburn was left as the only Skylander from Skylanders: Spyro's Adventure without a reposed figure.
Elite Terrafin and Elite Slam Bam equally have the most health, while Elite Boomer has the least health.
Elite Stealth Elf's daggers and Elite Gill Grunt's harpoon ammo are gold on the physical toys, but normal colored in-game.

eruptor.name: Eruptor
appearances: Trigger Happy Targets the Evil Kaos
eruptor.description: Eruptor is a lava monster Skylander in Skylanders: Spyro's Adventure. His Series 3 counterpart is called Lava Barf Eruptor. In Skylanders: SuperChargers, Eruptor is redesigned as a SuperCharger named Lava Lance Eruptor.
eruptor.biography: Eruptor is a force of nature, hailing from a species that lived deep in the underground of a floating volcanic island until a massive eruption launched their entire civilization to the surface. He's a complete hot head -- steaming, fuming, and quite literally erupting over almost anything. To help control his temper, he likes to relax in lava pools, particularly because there are no crowds.
eruptor.personality: Eruptor is a hot head with a strong dislike for anything evil, so whenever something bad threatens his world, he quickly erupts... quite literally. When he isn't getting angry at the forces of Kaos, he's blowing a fuse and exploding with rage about smaller things, such as creaky floorboards and people not covering their mouths when they cough. With his hot temper, Eruptor never shies away from speaking his mind. He also has a case of indigestion, prone to burping up a pool of molten lava whenever he feels nauseous, nervous or startled. A flaming force of nature, Eruptor still blows his top from time to time. He doesn't suffer fools gladly, but tries to keep his fiery temper in check. In Skylanders: Imaginators, Eruptor is portrayed as a nervous lava monster who is afraid of a lot of things, such as bugs and Rats.
eruptor.gameplay: Eruptor has the power to hurl and spew fireballs of molten rock, and unleash a lava plume all around him like a volcanic eruption. In Skylanders: Battlecast, Eruptor can control magma with a larger range of abilities. With energy cost halfway through, he can create a variety of effects by opening thermal vents and heat waves; notably, he can also turn Gear into Molten Metal by using Metalmorphosis and submerging it in lava. His Special Ability is Scorching Fumes, increasing his team's spell damage, and his signature gear is a Magma Core, that creates fire spells.

trivia: As a LightCore, his mouth lights up. On Lightcore Eruptor's artwork, his body colour is crimson instead of red.
When Eruptor sings he often sings his favorite song: The 1st movement from Beethoven's 5th symphony.
In Skylanders Giants, he doesn't sing his name, while listening to the music box on Captain Flynn's Ship.

While saying his Catchphrase when he's placed on the portal in Spyro's Adventure and Trap Team, Eruptor's face seems to be frowning, when he is actually happy. On other games it shows him smiling when saying his Catchphrase. Skylanders : Giants was when he started smiling when saying his Catchphrase. However if he's playing a Heroic Challenge, Player Vs Player Battle Arena or after finding a certain item, he is shown frowning, when the screen says 'Please return the Skylander to the Portal of Power', if he's taken off the portal too early.
There is a glitch with most Eruptor toys from series 1, where after time, they cannot be read by the Portal of Power, making them unplayable.
Eruptor, Stump Smash, Prism Break, Drill Sergeant and Countdown are the only bipedal Skylanders without hands.
When Series 2 Eruptor has his 'Lava Barf' upgrade, four extra spikes appear on his head, giving him five head spikes.
On his Series 2 figure, his facial expression is similar to the facial expression on Hot Head's figure.
Eruptor and Bouncer are the only two Skylanders who don't sing their names while playing the music box on Flynn's Ship.

Eruptor had more commercial and trailer appearances than any other Skylander. Eruptor is the only Skylander to be seen in every main trailer (i.e. The Beginning, Tall Tales, Just Like SWAP Force, and The Discovery).
Despite having new Wow Pows, he, Trigger Happy and Gill Grunt are the only Series 3 Skylanders whose appearances remain the same as before.
In Eruptor's original art for Spyro's Adventure, his mouth only had two teeth.

He and Fryno share similarities. Both are short tempered and have anger issues. Both are of the fire element. Both share the quote 'Too hot to handle!' Both have mini counterparts. Both have the word, 'burn' in their Catchphrases.

Eruptor is noticeably similar to Hot Dog: Both are lava-based creatures. Both are Fire Skylanders. Both their Soul Gems upgrades their third attacks. Both have have the word 'burn' in their catchphrases.
Eruptor, Prism Break, Gill Grunt, Jet-Vac and Pop Fizz are the only Skylanders so far to have four versions (series) of themselves, including LightCore.
At the end of the Up /Down lightcore commercial, a Series 2 Eruptor figure is mistakenly displayed, instead of the actual LightCore Eruptor figure.

In 2014, a balloon of Eruptor was made in the Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade, representing the Skylanders franchise. This balloon would also have a special figure made for it based off the series 1 figure that does not work in the games.
An Eruptor balloon can be seen in Crash Bandicoot 4: It's About Time in the level, Off Beat.

eye-brawl.name: Eye-Brawl
eye-brawl.description: Eye-Brawl is a being composed of a flying eyeball and a headless Undead Giant who live in a symbiotic relationship. He is an Undead Skylander and one of the eight Giants in Skylanders: Giants. He notably has a twin brother named Dive-Clops.
eye-brawl.biography: Throughout history, there have been many epic battles, though none more bizarre than the legendary brawl between the headless giant and the infamous flying eyeball. It all started with a staring contest, but with the headless giant having no eyes and the flying eyeball unable to blink, it soon escalated into an all out war as the two rivals fought fiercely throughout the land of the Undead for over a hundred years! With neither opponent down, the two combatants were eventually struck with the realization that if they were to combine their formidable powers, they would be a force to be reckoned with. By teaming up, the infamous flying eyeball and the headless giant became known as Eye-Brawl, one of the most powerful Skylanders ever known.
eye-brawl.catchphrase: I've Got My Eye On You!
eye-brawl.personality: Eye-Brawl is hyper-observant. Nothing gets past him (without being thumped, that is).
eye-brawl.gameplay: Eye-Brawl's gameplay revolves around a unique symbiotic relationship between a headless giant and a flying eyeball. The giant delivers heavy melee punches, while the detached eyeball can fly around and shoot eye lasers. His abilities include powerful melee attacks, summoning additional eyeballs, and enhancing his eye's laser fire and flight capabilities. His Soul Gem allows him to launch his eye as a smashing projectile.

abilities.description: New armor provides additional protection.

abilities.name: Bouncy Bouncy!
abilities.description: While flying the eyeball, press Attack 3 to bounce the eye on the ground.

trivia: Eye-Brawl's placeholder name was Flyclops.

The Flying Eyeball (Eye-Brawl's head) slightly resembles Occulous and the Headless Undead Giant (Eye-Brawl's body) slightly resembles the Headless Horseman. However, Eye-Brawl isn't related to Occulous, according to the Bradygames strategy guide for Giants.

It is said that if Eye-Brawl ever cries, entire villages will get washed away. This would later be exemplified by Dive-Clops, who can shoot powerful geysers within a few seconds of his eye window being opened.
Eye-Brawl speaks in a slight Transylvanian accent.

He is the successor of Krypt King, who was originally planned to be the Undead Giant. He and Krypt King both have black armor, and they both have the phrase 'I've got' in the first part of their official catchphrases.
Eye-Brawl's Soul Gem name is the famous quote from the movie, A Christmas Story, 'You'll Shoot Your Eye Out!'
His name is a pun on the word 'eyeball.'

There is a glitch in Rumbletown in a small area before the arena where if the player preforms Eye Fly, the eyeball will fall off the island to an extent. If this glitch is performed, no eyes will form if the flying eyeball shoots eye lasers with the upgrade Eye-Crawlers until the eyeball returns to the body.
Despite the upgrade picture and description, the Bouncy Bouncy! The upgrade does not make the eye explode, nor does the body dribble the eyeball. It only slams the eyeball on the ground.

The Flying Eyeball (Eye Brawl's head) does the talking, as he refers to the bouncing eyeballs Eye-Brawl summons from the underworld as his 'little brothers'. He also frequently uses Eye puns in his lines.

Eye-Brawl is voiced by Travis Willingham, who also voiced Doom Stone, Buzz, the Hulk in The Super Hero Squad Show, Knuckles the Echidna and Storm the Albatross from the Sonic the Hedgehog series, and Thor in Ultimate Spider-Man, Avengers Assemble, Hulk and the Agents of S.M.A.S.H. Coincidentally, he is the husband of Laura Bailey, the voice actress of another one of the Giants, Ninjini.

In Skylanders: Lost Islands, the Flying Eyeball mentions that eating a lot of carrots makes him able to see far and well in the darkness in places like the Necropolis. He also mentions their conflict first started in the Creepy Citadel.
He, Shroomboom, Rocky Roll (only Rocky), Magna Charge, and Dive-Clops are currently the only non-Imaginator Skylanders with one eye.
In the cut-scene where the Giants are being sent back to earth, Eye-Brawl is shown able to lift his whole body with his eye wings.
Eye-Brawl shares the same name as a minigame from Mario Party 8.

In the alpha version of Skylanders: Giants, Eye-Brawl's iris was red, and his wings often appeared crooked. His eye minions reused the screeching sound effects of Sonic Boom's chicks and crawled on spiderlike legs rather than bouncing around. The upgrade description for his 'Eye for an Eye' upgrade path still refers to his minions as Eye Ball Bugs in the final version of Skylanders Giants. Curiously, when teleporting in the alpha, Eye-Brawl's eye reappears before his body does.

Eye-Brawl's 'Headless, Not Helpless' movement ability varies depending on which game is being played. In Skylander's Giants, if the Control Stick is neutral and 'Eye Fly' is used, Eye-Brawl's body will move in a random direction, but with other Skylanders games, like Trap Team, the direction is based on which direction Eye-Brawl is facing when 'Eye-Fly' is used.

eye-small.name: Eye-Small
eye-small.description: Eye-Small is one of the four Sidekicks in Skylanders: Giants. He is the miniature counterpart of the giant Eye-Brawl, eventually becoming a Mini Skylander in Skylanders: Trap Team.
eye-small.biography: Within the Skylands, a realm of infinite possibilities, there is in fact an alternate reality known as the Skylands Miniverse. Everything there is smaller, including the Skylanders. The Skylanders Sidekicks come from that Miniverse and have traveled to the Skylands to meet their regular-sized alter egos and tag along with them on adventures. The Skylander Minis started off as regular 'Sidekicks,' assisting the Skylanders on many exciting adventures. And what they lacked in size they more than made up for in courage. Ultimately determined to become full-fledged heroes, they trained at the Skylands Academy - honing their powers and skills until they were ready. Now, they stand side by side with their full grown counterparts, ready to defend Skylands against Kaos and his evil minions.
eye-small.catchphrase: I've Got My Eye On You!
eye-small.personality: Eye-Small may look like a cute little cyclops, but he'll jump into a fight at the bat of an eye. He's a scrapper like that. Eye-Small pays keen attention to detail. He notices just about everything. He is an eyeball, after all.
eye-small.gameplay: These are the starting and maximum Statistics for this Skylander in the Skylanders games.

abilities.name: Haymaker
abilities.description: Punch enemies with your giant fist.

abilities.name: Eye Fly
abilities.description: The eyeball head flies around and shoots eye beams.

abilities.name: An Eye In Team
abilities.description: A second smaller eyeball follows the Eye Fly around and shoots eye beams.

abilities.name: The Pummeler
abilities.description: Upgrades the Haymaker attack to do more damage.

abilities.name: Awesome Occu-Blast
abilities.description: Charge up to release a massive blast from the eyeball.

trivia: His artwork for the upgrades, 'Bouncy Bouncy!' and 'You'll Shoot Your Eye Out!', are switched from Eye Brawl's.
His eyeball allies are regular-sized in SuperChargers, ironically not appearing to be the infamous flying eyeball's 'little brothers' as they are bigger than him.

festive-edition-skylanders.name: Festive Edition Skylanders
festive-edition-skylanders.description: Festive Edition Skylanders are Skylanders that have a design that represents a specific day of the year, primarily Easter, Halloween, Christmas or Valentine's Day. These include both Alt Deco figures and digital Alter Egos.
festive-edition-skylanders.biography: Festive Edition Skylanders are Skylanders that have a design that represents a specific day of the year, primarily Easter, Halloween, Christmas or Valentine's Day. These include both Alt Deco figures and digital Alter Egos.
festive-edition-skylanders.catchphrase: Design that represents a specific day of the year, primarily Easter, Halloween, Christmas or Valentine's Day.
festive-edition-skylanders.gameplay: Festive Skylanders are special themed versions of standard characters. They function identically to their regular counterparts in terms of gameplay and abilities but feature unique holiday-themed aesthetic designs and in-game models. These variants include both physical Alt Deco figures and digital-only Alter Egos found in spin-off titles.
trivia: Heartbreaker Buckshot is the only Festive Skylander which never had an official release.
Christmas counterparts are mainly of the Life and Water elements.
Halloween counterparts are exclusively of the Undead element.
Valentine's Day counterparts are mainly of the Magic element.

In Skylanders: Imaginators, some of the color schemes for Imaginators are themed around holidays as well: Be My Valentine (Valentine's Day), Lucky Clover (St. Patrick's Day), Egg Hunt (Easter), Trick or Treat (Halloween), and Jingle All the Way (Christmas).

variants.name: Birthday Bash Big Bubble Pop Fizz

fiesta.name: Fiesta
fiesta.description: Fiesta is a skeletal mariachi band leader who is one of the Undead SuperChargers in Skylanders: SuperChargers. His signature vehicle is the Crypt Crusher.
fiesta.biography: Despite being Undead, Fiesta had always been the life of the party. He was once the head member of a popular mariachi band in the personal court of Count Moneybone, who all undead citizens respected immensely. In his spare time, Fiesta and his bandmates played music for all of the new arrivals that entered the Underworld. However, a day came when the new arrivals were actually several Skylanders, who had come on a mission to stop Count Moneybone from unleashing a robot army on all of Skylands. Fiesta then realized that he, like so many others, had been fooled by the evil Count into thinking he was kind and generous – not the vengeful monster he truly was. Unbeknownst to the Skylanders, Fiesta and his bandmates helped to distract the robot army so they could infiltrate Moneybone's mansion and put a stop to him. Even though the Skylanders were unaware, this act of bravery and defiance did catch the attention of Master Eon, who recruited him at once.
fiesta.personality: Although he comes from The Underworld, Fiesta is more free-spirited than most of its Undead inhabitants. He enjoys striking up parties as all who are good are invited (even if they go unannounced).
fiesta.gameplay: Fiesta is a tactical summoner who controls the battlefield with his ghostly bandmates, the Amigos. He uses a trumpet gun for short-to-mid-range musical attacks and can summon up to five Amigos to provide consistent damage. His 'Laid Low' ability allows him to become partially hidden and reduce incoming damage while his minions continue the fight. Players can choose to upgrade him along two paths: one that strengthens his bond and the damage of his Amigos, or another that enhances his solo performance with pierce-effect notes and explosive finishes.

abilities.name: Amigos

abilities.name: Family Fiesta
abilities.description: Hold Attack 2 to summon a Fiesta! The guest list is huge!

abilities.name: Take It Away Amigos!
abilities.description: Press Attack 1 while trumpeting to play a solo note, every fifth solo note played makes Amigos get a damage boost!

abilities.name: Mucho Amigos
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 to summon an Amigo. Now have up to FIVE Amigos.

abilities.name: Soul Jam
abilities.description: Press Attack 3 to become Laid Low, Amigos move faster while Laid Low.

abilities.name: Diva
abilities.description: After playing five Solo Notes, a spotlight appears around you which gives increased money, experience and food.

abilities.name: Shot to the Hearth
abilities.description: Press Attack 1 while trumpeting to play a Solo Note; solo notes now pierce enemies.

abilities.name: Big Finish
abilities.description: Press Attack 3 to become Laid Low, Amigos grow and large and then explode after a short time while Laid Low.

trivia: Fiesta's character design is inspired by the Day of the Dead, a Mexican holiday where family and friends pray for and remember friends and family members who died.
Fiesta is voiced by Carlos Alazraqui, who voiced Hot Dog in Skylanders: Giants and Duff in Skylanders: Swap Force.
Fiesta and his Amigos are based on the glowing skeleton enemies seen in the Undead Fiesta in the 3DS version of Swap Force, making him the first Skylander based on a 3DS only species.
Fiesta was one of the expansion characters planned for Skylanders: Battlecast, with a single known card, Sinister Symphony. However, because of the ending of the game's development, he was scrapped.
Fiesta was a character planned for the Skylanders Academy's second season and would've been the first SuperCharger to appear, but he was cut due to budget reasons.
He is similar to Brook from One Piece, as both are musical skeletons.
When Fiesta summons a trumpet-playing amigo, it plays part of The After Party's musical theme.
Developer Bill Castagna says of Fiesta, "This guy is my jam... my Soul Jam."

figures.name: Figures
figures.description: Figures are the physical medium used to interact with the Skylanders games. From Spyro's Adventure to Trap Team, all Skylanders of a particular Element share bases with near-identical designs. Starting with SuperChargers, certain figure types have special bases that remain elementally themed but are vastly different from the original designs.
figures.biography: The Skylanders Figures are the key focal point in the Skylanders franchise, as they not only allow access to the Skylanders but also are the means to carry that data around and be shared with others. They are what truly bridges the gap between the home consoles, handheld devices, and even PCs. As the series progressed, new kinds of figures were released with new abilities.
figures.catchphrase: They are what truly bridges the gap between the home consoles, handheld devices, and even PCs.
figures.personality: While figures themselves do not have personalities, they act as the bridge between physical toys and digital heroes, each type (Core, Giant, Swap Force, etc.) bringing unique mechanics and capabilities to the player.
figures.gameplay: Core Skylanders are the original type, with Series 2-4 allowing for re-posability and 'Wow Pows'. Giants are massive in game and physical form, capable of Feats of Strength. SWAP Force characters can mix and match their top and bottom halves for unique power combinations. Trap Masters use Traptanium weapons to defeat Villains and unlock Elemental gates. Minis are small but fully functional versions of Cores. Eon's Elites are significantly more powerful versions of original characters. SuperChargers pair with Vehicles for power boosts, and Senseis train Imaginators while unlocking Secret Techniques.

abilities.name: LightCore Blast
abilities.description: LightCore figures feature parts that light up when placed on the portal. In game, this translates as a massive blast when summoned, knocking away or damaging nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Feats of Strength
abilities.description: Giant figures have unique abilities, including Feats of Strength, breaking objects which otherwise require bombs, and lifting boulders.

abilities.name: Secret Technique Unlock
abilities.description: Sensei figures unlock a Secret Technique to Imaginators of the same Battle Class and provide a training bonus to all Imaginators.

abilities.name: Wow Pow Upgrade
abilities.description: Series Skylanders are given a special upgrade called 'Wow Pow', which grants them a new ability or boost without having to reset.

abilities.name: Series Wow Pow
abilities.description: Grants a new ability or boost to Series 2-4 figures, appearing as the latest available version in previous games.

trivia: Series Skylanders have the ability to alter their upgrade path without having to reset.
Sidekicks are the precursors to Minis, originally released as cosmetic Magic Items.
Legendary Skylanders are gold and navy blue versions of normal Skylanders, exclusive to Toys'R'Us in most countries.
Nitro figures feature a yellow-and-white checker color scheme and are exclusive to Target in North America.
Dark Edition figures mostly feature black and silver color schemes and were exclusive to Dark Edition Starter Packs.
LightCore figures create a massive blast when summoned, knocking away or damaging nearby enemies.

variants.game: Skylanders: Giants / Swap Force / Trap Team

fire-dragon.name: Fire Dragon
fire-dragon.description: Fire Dragon was a character for the unreleased Spyro's Kingdom.
fire-dragon.biography: Fire Dragon was one of the prototype characters planned for Spyro's Kingdom. During development, his spot as playable character was given to Spyro due to the decision that it wouldn't be Spyro's Kingdom 'without Spyro as a playable character.' Fire Dragon's model can still be found in the game files of Skylanders: Giants under the name 'Red Spyro'.
fire-dragon.personality: As a scrapped prototype character, Fire Dragon does not have a defined personality in the Skylanders lore.
fire-dragon.gameplay: Fire Dragon was intended to be a playable character in the prototype stage of Skylanders. No official move set was finalized, but he likely would have utilized fire-based attacks similar to other Fire element dragons.
trivia: The NPC character Flavius bears a resemblance towards the Fire Dragon.
Although his figure has his wings and horns being the same color, in the model found in Giants, they are different colors.
In Spyro's Kingdom, his artwork is the same as Spyro's, just differently colored.
While loading in the other scrapped Skylander, Sniper, Fire Dragon shows up as the troll's Magic Moment placeholder character.

fire-kraken.name: Fire Kraken
fire-kraken.description: Fire Kraken is a Chinese Fire dragon warrior who is one of the SWAP Force Skylanders in Skylanders: Swap Force. His SWAP Force Ability is Bounce.
fire-kraken.biography: Raised on a small island surrounded by a vast ocean of fire, Fire Kraken was the swiftest, most agile warrior his tribe had ever seen. And when a fleet of Fire Troll ships arrived to steal the legendary Burning Heart, a huge elemental crystal that fueled the fiery seas, Fire Kraken leapt into action. Using a magical staff to control his natural ability to wield fire, he set the mighty ships ablaze, forcing the trolls into a hasty retreat. Having saved the Burning Heart as well as his homeland, Fire Kraken soon joined the Skylanders, where he knew his skills would help those in need.
fire-kraken.personality: A desire to help others burns in the heart of this young, hot-footed warrior. He likes playing with fire, and is less likely to burn out.
fire-kraken.gameplay: Fire Kraken uses his magical staff to set enemies ablaze, and control his natural fire powers; his staff can be upgraded for a charged attack. He can throw out fireworks from his tail to damage enemies and can be upgraded for a bigger boom, he can even charge it up which causes his tail to light like a fuse, and ends with an enormous fireworks explosion. His most unique power is the ability to turn into a Chinese dragon parade costume!

abilities.description: Press Attack 1 to swing the sparkler staff, damaging nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Start the Show!
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 up to three times to perform a firework attack on each press that damages nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Dragon Parade
abilities.description: Hold Attack 3 to run around in a dragon parade costume, knocking back and damaging enemies in the way.

abilities.name: Kraken Up
abilities.description: Press Jump to jump, throwing down fireworks and damaging nearby enemies.
