abilities.name: Dance of Dragons
abilities.description: Hold Attack 3 to start Dragon Parade, release to shoot the sparkling and explosive Dragon costume at enemies.

abilities.name: The Bigger One
abilities.description: The Big One creates a huge colorful explosion that does increased damage in a larger radius.

abilities.name: Rising Charge
abilities.description: Rising Fountain causes a next staff attack to cause a large explosion.

abilities.name: Finale
abilities.description: Rising Fountain does increased damage in a larger area. It's showtime!

abilities.name: Year of the Dragon
abilities.description: Dragon Parade does increased damage, lasts longer, and reduces damage taken while it is active.

abilities.name: Dragon Candles
abilities.description: Dragon Parade shoots colorful fireworks at nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Unstable Element
abilities.description: Speed increases depending how close The Big One is to exploding. The anticipation!

abilities.name: Sizzling Sparkler
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 for a spin attack that does increased damage in a larger area.

abilities.name: Bigbadaboom
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 two times for a bounce attack that does increased damage in a larger area.

abilities.name: Strike the Foes
abilities.description: Hold Attack 2 for a short time to light the fuse for The Big One and knock away all nearby enemies.

trivia: Unlike most dragon Skylanders, Fire Kraken is bipedal so he can fit in with the Swap Force.
He is the first non-core dragon Skylander.
Both Fire Kraken and Flashwing have jade counterparts.
Fire Kraken's name is a play on Firecracker, a type of firework.
His name has also included the name of his element.
He is the first Skylander to have the name of his element in his name (the second is Wildfire and the third is Spitfire).
His name is also a reference to the Kraken, a legendary sea monster.
In concept art, Fire Kraken had a pair of long dark whiskers.
Despite showing his tail coiled up as seen in his artwork, he doesn't bounce with his tail like Rattle Shake could. Instead, he bounces with his feet and legs.
Fire Kraken's tuft of hair at the end of his tail is yellow in toy form, but in-game it is blue like the hair on his head. In his official cover art, his tail tuft is red.
Fire Kraken's nose used to be red in early screenshots. Although it was changed to yellow in the final game and in his toy form, it still appears red in his preview video.
Fire Kraken's eyes are green in-game, black in toy form and brown in the official art.

Fire Kraken's voice actor, Billy West, is very famous for portraying the title characters of The Ren and Stimpy Show, Philip J. Fry from Futurama and recreating the voice of Elmer Fudd in several Looney Tunes projects. He was also the voice actor for Sparx the Dragonfly in The Legend of Spyro: The Eternal Night.
Billy West is also the voice actor of Freeze Blade, Food Fight and Rocky Roll.
His catchphrase is based on the saying, 'Born to be Wild!'
In Spanish, his catchphrase is 'Nacido para quemar', which means 'Born to Burn', which is the same catchphrase of Eruptor.
One of his missions in Lost Islands, 'Catching Fire', shares the name of the second book of the Hunger Games series.
According to his Short Cut, a Kraken is a dragon, mixed with a ninja, mixed with a Roman candle, and mixed with a parade. In actuality, the Kraken is a mythical sea monster.

fireworks-zook.name: Fireworks Zook
fireworks-zook.description: Fireworks Zook has come to the Skylands in a blaze of glory!
fireworks-zook.biography: Fireworks Zook is a Fourth of July version of Zook, only available on Skylanders: Lost Islands in the month of July 2013.
fireworks-zook.personality: Like the standard Zook, Fireworks Zook is a dedicated and heroic warrior. He is always ready to defend his home, though he clearly enjoys the spectacle and explosive power of his festive firework-themed bamboo bazooka.
fireworks-zook.gameplay: In Skylanders: Lost Islands, Fireworks Zook acts as a playable character who can be sent on adventures, clear land, and interact with the various buildings on the player's island. His attacks and animations are aesthetically themed around fireworks instead of the standard fragmentation rounds used by Zook.
trivia: Fireworks Zook is the first fireworks themed Skylander, while Fire Kraken is the second and Flare Wolf is the third (not counting Sun Dragon).
He is also the only fireworks themed Skylander exclusive to Lost Islands.
He was released as a promotional variant for the 4th of July.

fist-bump.name: Fist Bump
fist-bump.description: Fist Bump is a rock panda who is one of the Earth core Skylanders in Skylanders: Trap Team.
fist-bump.biography: Fist Bump had long been the sleeping protector of the Bubbling Bamboo Forest, but awoke from a long hibernation when a horde of nasty purple Greebles arrived with gigantic rock-smashing machines. Intent on building a new base, their machines wreaked havoc – chewing up the land and spitting out billowing clouds of smoke into the enchanted air. Seeing this, Fist Bump was furious. Using his enormous stone fists, he hammered the ground with all his strength, creating a massive earthquake that sent huge shockwaves towards the Greeble camp. This reduced the machines to mere scrap and sent the Greebles running off in a panic. The act of bravery caught the attention of Terrafin, who brought Fist Bump to meet Master Eon. Now as a Skylander, Fist Bump makes evil quake wherever he goes!
fist-bump.personality: Fist Bump is always the first person to shake things up at a party. He loves to get loose and rock out.
fist-bump.gameplay: Fist Bump can utilize his enormous strength in combat, being able to create fault lines and earthquakes just by punching the ground. When his fault lines are activated by his panda pound, spiky rocks erupt from them that damage enemies. Fist Bump can even slide across the ground, which damages enemies in his way, and creates fault lines.

abilities.description: Walking creates Fault Lines and mini fault cracks

abilities.description: When Fault Lines are activated, some of them shoot stones at enemies.

abilities.name: Quake 'N' Bake

abilities.name: Jump For It!
abilities.description: Can perform a Panda Pound in the air much quicker and create an extra Fault Line

trivia: His catchphrase was once a tag line by Stealth Elf.

Most people may state that this Catchphrase makes no sense. However, it could be a reference to mischievous kids just randomly knocking on someone's door and running away, to make it seem like no one is there, as a naughty trick!
He and High Five are the only Skylanders who are named after two different friendly hand gestures.

Fist Bump, Blades, and Knight Light can all perform combos, however they are currently the only three Skylanders who cannot purchase any additional combos, regardless of which upgrade path is selected.
Fist Bump's placeholder name was Aftershock, which is also the name of an unused dinosaur Skylander.
Interestingly enough, Aftershock's planned abilities are incredibly similar to those of Fist Bump, being able to pound the ground and create fault lines/fissures.
An Awakened form version of Fist Bump was leaked in Skylanders: Ring of Heroes, but he never appeared in the final game.

flameslinger.name: Flameslinger
appearances: Stump Smash Crosses the Bone Dragon
flameslinger.description: Flameslinger is an elf archer Skylander in Skylanders: Spyro's Adventure. He is of the Fire element.
flameslinger.biography: Flameslinger is an Elven archer with incredible aim. In fact, he is so good that he wears a blindfold just to prove it. When he was young, he rescued a fire spirit from a watery doom and was gifted an enchanted bow and magical fire boots that he now masterfully uses to defeat evil throughout Skylands. With the scorched earth he leaves behind, you can always tell where he has been.
flameslinger.personality: Flameslinger is an elf who has the impression of being a show-off, having put on a blindfold to prove that he is an excellent archer with incredible aim. Despite this cocky image, he possesses a courageous heart, having saved a fire spirit from a watery fate when he was young.
flameslinger.gameplay: Flameslinger has the ability to infuse his arrows in flames and launch them at his enemies with his enchanted bow. His magic boots allow him to run at incredible speeds, and leave a trail of fire behind him. When he circles around an enemy while leaving a trail of flames, a torrent of fire erupts around the enemy, burning them. Choosing the Marksman path further increases Flameslinger's capabilities with his Bow and Arrow. His Hellfire Arrows upgrade increases the damage output of the arrows, Explosive Arrows damage nearby enemies rather than just a single enemy, and Triple Shot Arrows increase the range of fire. Choosing the Pyromancer path gives Flameslinger more abilities in ways of indirect damage and trickery. The Napalm Tipped Arrows upgrade is a good way to set chaos among the field of battle, setting fire wherever Flameslinger's arrows land. His Inferno Blast is good for the first strike but not necessarily great in the heat of battle. The Supernova upgrade is excellent for its ability to wipe out surrounding enemies that are far apart.

abilities.description: Shoot flaming arrows at your enemies.

abilities.name: Flame Dash
abilities.description: Dash forward, leaving a flaming path of destruction behind.

abilities.description: Fire Arrows do increased damage.

abilities.description: Draw a circle with the Flame Dash to create a fire column. Flame Dash does extra damage.

abilities.name: Volley Shot

abilities.name: Hyper Shot
abilities.description: Shoot Fire Arrows much faster.

abilities.name: Super Volley Shot
abilities.description: Flaming Arrow Rain shoots more arrows that covers more area

abilities.name: Speed Demon
abilities.description: While dashing, press Attack 1 to run even faster and leave a new flame trail.

abilities.name: Hellfire Arrows
abilities.description: Fire Arrows and Flaming Arrow Rain do even more increased damage.

abilities.name: Explosive Arrows
abilities.description: Fire Arrows explode, doing damage to anything nearby.

abilities.name: Triple Shot Arrows
abilities.description: Shoot 3 Fire Arrows at a time.

abilities.name: Napalm Tipped Arrows
abilities.description: Fire Arrows leave behind a burning patch, damaging enemies that touch it.

abilities.name: Inferno Blast
abilities.description: Hold the primary button to charge a flaming Inferno attack, then release to fire it.

abilities.name: Supernova
abilities.description: Drawing a circle with the Flame Dash causes fire to spread out, doing more damage.

trivia: In the Skylanders: Giants debut trailer, Flameslinger wears a yellow blindfold under his red blindfold.
His official catchphrase is a play on the phrase 'Let The Games Begin'.
He is similar to Katniss Everdeen in the Hunger Games. Both are archers who are associated with fire.
He also wears his blindfold because he grew sick of people staring at the strange, supernatural flames that have flickered behind his eyes since birth.
In his toy forms and artworks, his bow has no string. It can be seen in games except Spyro's Adventure and Giants, contradicting the toys and artwork.

Flameslinger and Stealth Elf have much in common - They are both green-skinned Elves of similar stature that debuted in Skylanders: Spyro's Adventure, they both cover a portion of their face (Flameslinger's eyes and Stealth Elf's mouth), both have an emphasis on speed and utilise an attack to move around quickly, and both use more traditional weaponry: a bow & arrows and daggers respectively.
There is a shoulder strap for the quiver in his toy forms and artworks, while it cannot be seen in-game.
If you purchase Searing Arrows upgrade, his bow will be colored red and given more sharpened designs.
He speaks in a French accent.
Series 2 Flameslinger has the Volley Shot upgrade with the toy, already upgraded.
His Series 2 remake of Golden Flameslinger appears more orange-colored than gold.
Flameslinger is one of the six elven Skylanders (the others being Hex, Ninjini, Fright Rider, Stealth Elf, and Bushwhack.
Flameslinger, Enigma, and Blaster-Tron are the only three Skylanders without visible eyes.
He is voiced by Keith Szarabajka, who voices Ironhide in Transformers: War for Cybertron and Laserbeak in Transformers: Dark of the Moon.
Flameslinger is the first Skylander to have archery skills, the second is Snap Shot, followed by Wolfgang, Buckshot, Ro-Bow and all of the Bowslinger class of Imaginators.
His head is a customization item for Skylanders: Imaginators and named No Sight No Problem.
Although he was absent in the 1.0 version of the game, Flameslinger did not appear nor was released until the reboot of Skylanders: Ring of Heroes after the release of Boom Bloom's episode dungeon.
In Skylanders: Swap Force, Flameslinger can use his Flame Dash even while falling, leaving a trail of flames in the air.

flare-wolf.name: Flare Wolf
flare-wolf.description: Flare Wolf is a Fire wolf and one of the Senseis in Skylanders: Imaginators. He trains Imaginators of the Bazooker Battle Class.
flare-wolf.biography: When Flare Wolf was young, he worked all summer to earn the coveted Fireworks Badge from the Wolf Scouts. In doing so, he had earned the right to light the fireworks in the annual St. Wigglewort's Day celebration - an honor of which Flare Wolf was extremely proud. But on the day of the celebration, a band of evil Ice Ogres attacked his village and took the entire community hostage! The only weapons at his disposal were the town's supply of fireworks they were saving for the evening festivities. One by one, Flare Wolf lit them in the center of the Ogre camp, launching a dazzling display of pyrotechnics that sent the Ogres running. Not only had Flare Wolf saved his village, he had also given its residents the most spectacular fireworks show they had seen in over 100 years! Even Master Eon was impressed, and offered Flare Wolf a position at the Academy as the Official Fireworks Launcher. But after seeing him in action, he quickly realized that Flare Wolf had much more to offer as a Sensei!
flare-wolf.personality: Flare Wolf is a proud and heroic fire wolf who is extremely passionate about pyrotechnics. He is enthusiastic about his role as a Sensei and enjoys demonstrating his 'absolutely smoking hot' secret techniques to his students. Despite his explosive arsenal, he maintains a friendly and helpful demeanor toward Portal Masters.
flare-wolf.gameplay: Flare Wolf's weapon of choice is his rocket launcher, which he uses to launch fireworks at his enemies.

trivia: Flare Wolf's name is a play on 'werewolf'.
When moving, Flare Wolf leaves behind a trail of flaming paw prints.
Flare Wolf is the second Fire canine in the series, the other being Hot Dog.
He is the fifth playable canine overall, after Funny Bone, Wolfgang and Slobber Trap.
Flare Wolf might have been a fox at some point in development, as his weapon is named the Fire Fox Bazooka. He still has a few traits of a fox, such as the short snout and reddish fur.
Fire Fox might be a reference to the Mozilla Firefox internet browser.
Flare Wolf is the second Fire Skylander to use fireworks as a weapon, the first being Fire Kraken.
He and the Chompy Mage are the only Bazooker Senseis.
Flare Wolf is the only Bazooker Sensei to not have previously been a villain.
One of Flare Wolf's quotes 'Hunk of burnin' yeah!' references to Elvis Presley's song Burning Love.

flashwing.name: Flashwing
flashwing.description: Flashwing is crystal dragon with white scales and horns made of crystals. She also has a crystal embedded on her forehead, and her eyes are gray. She has a blue underbelly, and her wings were made out of purple and blue crystals while with her claws, feet and tail are purple.
flashwing.biography: Flashwing's true origins are a mystery, but her first appearance came when Bash made a wish that he could fly and looked up to see a shooting star streak across the sky and into a valley below. In the centre of the glowing impact crater was a large, brilliant geode - which suddenly cracked open to reveal Flashwing. Bash may not have soared that day, but his heart sure did, because Flashwing was beautiful... and lethal. As soon as Bash stepped closer, the gem dragon turned towards him. Not knowing if he was friend or foe, she blasted him off of the cliff with a full force laser pulse from her tail! Perhaps Bash flew that day after all.
flashwing.personality: Flashwing knows just how beautiful she appears and also how deadly she can be. She often tries to steal the spotlight from her fellow Skylanders, but her kind heart always shines through in the end.
flashwing.gameplay: Flashwing can shoot crystal shards out of her body and use their reflections as powerful beams, as well as summon a crystalline 'lighthouse' out of the ground. In Skylanders: Battlecast, she can also control the crystals in various ways including the ones used for spellcasting, such as creating shields, a protective crust around her wings and body, rays that return damage dealt to her, and Skylithium scales out of her body that can be used for more spell energy. Her Special Ability is Shield Lattice, and her signature Gear is the Dragon's Circlet, which helps her with additional damage.

trivia: Flashwing is voiced by Tara Strong, who also voices Bubbles from The Powerpuff Girls, Timmy Turner and Poof from The Fairly OddParents, Raven from Teen Titans and Teen Titans Go!, Twilight Sparkle from My Little Pony: Friendship is Magic and Iggy 'Hop' Koopa in Super Mario World. Strong also voices Coco Bandicoot in the Academy TV series spin off.

She also bears a resemblance to Rarity from My Little Pony: Friendship is Magic. Both have a white/blue/purple color scheme, are vain yet ultimately kindhearted and heroic, are the target of a dragon's romantic affections (Spike and Bash, respectively), and Rarity's Equestria Girls counterpart is capable of manipulating crystals like Flashwing can.
Flashwing's placeholder name was Gem Dragon.

Flashwing once arranged a beauty contest that was open to male and female Skylanders alike. However, as well as entering the contest, she appointed herself as judge. Needless to say, she didn't just take first place... she took second and third too!

Like Sunburn, Spotlight, Blackout, Scratch and Blades, despite having wings, she is unable to fly in-game. However, in the 3DS version of Skylanders: Giants, she can glide short distances - this replaces her spin attack.
She, Whirlwind, Cynder, Echo, and Spotlight are currently the only five female dragons in the series. They are also the only dragons who don't have visible teeth.
She is the first female Earth Skylander in the series (with the second being Head Rush and the third being Barbella).
She and Prism Break are the only two Skylanders who attack with crystals.
In her original prototype photo for her toy form, she is shown to have yellow claws and blue feet. In the final version, her claws and feet are purple.
She is the only dragon Skylander in the Giants lineup.
Despite having blue eyes in both artwork and the game, Flashwing's figure, both Series 1 and LightCore versions, lack blue irises in her eyes.
Flashwing is also the first dragon to be in an element with another (with the other being Bash).

She is also the first dragon Skylander who did not appeared in Spyro's Adventure (the second is Fire Kraken, followed by several others as the games went on). Both Flashwing and Fire Kraken have jade counterparts.
Her powers resemble those of Diamondhead (her in-game ability to create crystals) and Chromastone (her out-of-game flight and energy projection) from the Ben 10 franchise.
Her catchphrase is a reference to the song, 'Blinded by the Light' by Manfred Mann.
There is a glitch in The Oracle level in Skylanders: Giants where she walks differently.

Her appearance and attacks are similar to Spotlight, who is also a dragon that uses light-based abilities. A few of Flashwing's battle cries are shared by Spotlight; 'Outshining the rest!' and 'Brilliant!'. Flashwing's battle cry, 'Time to Shine!', would later be used as the catchphrase for Spotlight.
Although not a bird herself, Flashwing is able to access the Bird House in Skylanders: Lost Islands.

fling-kong.name: Fling Kong
fling-kong.description: Fling Kong is a monkey who is one of the Air Core Skylanders in Skylanders: Trap Team.
fling-kong.biography: As a royal protector of the legendary monkey idol Kubla-Wa, Fling Kong trained seriously in the mysterious art of Monk-Ru, a form of fighting using the power of air. He was a devoted student, always the first to arrive to training and the last to leave. One day, a troop of foul-smelling, well-armed Gorilla-Goos appeared, led by the infamous General Snot. Snot had heard stories about the idol, particularly that it was made of solid gold. The villains quickly seized control of the temple that housed the idol and were on the verge of taking it. But suddenly the smelly gorillas found themselves face to face with Fling Kong – who attacked with the power of a true Monk-Ru master! Using his flying rug and powerful vortex discs, he expertly defeated the Gorilla-Goos and saved the idol. Soon after, word of his actions spread to Master Eon. Now a Skylander, Fling Kong knocks the wind out of evil throughout all of the Skylands!
fling-kong.personality: Fling Kong is no stranger to battle, but he prefers a little life of peace. He is committed to his training and is willing to do whatever it takes to fight for what is right.
fling-kong.gameplay: Fling Kong is a mobile fighter who utilizes his Power Discs for long-range combat and his Magic Carpet for swift movement and dash attacks. His Monk-Ru training allows him to conjure cymbals for area-of-effect sound wave attacks, which can be upgraded to stun enemies. In the 3DS version, he can perform a Carpet Rush and use Pinball Discs that drop mines. In Ring of Heroes, he possesses abilities such as Disc Attack, Magic Carpet Run, and a passive called Crazy Dash.

trivia: He is the second simian Skylander (the first being Grilla Drilla and the third being Turbo Charge Donkey Kong). However, he is the only primate Skylander who is not a part of the Life element.
His name is a play on the movie character King Kong.
Fling Kong may also be a reference to Sun Wukong, the mischievous Monkey King in the famous novel Journey to the West. His Awakened Form in Skylanders: Ring of Heroes takes a direct nod to this.
His catchphrase is a play on 'Monkey see, monkey do'. This is shared with Mr. Chimes' taunt, another monkey-themed character from the indie game Cuphead.
Some of the helmets on Fling Kong's toy figures were oddly shipped out in the color pink.

flip-flop-fryno.name: Flip Flop Fryno
flip-flop-fryno.description: Get your sunblock out because Flip Flop Fryno is ready for the summer sun in Skylands!!
flip-flop-fryno.biography: Flip Flop Fryno is a summer variant of Fryno who appeared in Skylanders: Lost Islands in August 2014.
flip-flop-fryno.catchphrase: Get your sunblock out because Flip Flop Fryno is ready for the summer sun in Skylands!!
flip-flop-fryno.personality: Flip Flop Fryno is ready for the summer sun in Skylands!!
flip-flop-fryno.gameplay: Flip Flop Fryno is a summer variant of Fryno who appeared in Skylanders: Lost Islands.

flip-wreck.name: Flip Wreck
flip-wreck.description: Flip Wreck is a small blue dolphin-like creature, with a small blowhole on his forehead, yellow eyes, a small dorsal fin on his back, a short rounded beak and small pointed triangular teeth in his mouth. He wears a blue belt, with a small silver seashell as the buckle, blue shoulder pads, blue boots on his feet, and silver armour, containing the water logo, on his forehead. He also carries two weapons, a large navigator wheel from a boat, and a wooden sword with shark's teeth tied around the edges.
flip-wreck.biography: Most of the dolphins of Bottlenose Bay spent their days playing in the waves. However, Flip Wreck was different. Always the adventurous one, he took it upon himself to be a self-appointed protector of his undersea world. One day, while exploring an underwater graveyard of shipwrecks, he came across a massive Ice Viking ship that was still intact. Suddenly, a huge crew of Ice Vikings burst out from inside and began leading an attack on the unarmed dolphin residents. Flip Wreck took off at once and quickly fastened together armor, shield, and sword using pieces from the nearby wrecks. He then single-handedly defeated the Ice Vikings, who retreated never to be seen again. For his heroic actions, Flip Wreck was made a Skylander and now turns the tide against evil in Skylands!
flip-wreck.personality: Flip Wreck might be the fearless protector of Bottlenose Bay and a hero to his dolphin friends but, don't worry, he doesn't let it go to his head.
flip-wreck.gameplay: Flip Wreck utilizes a combination of sword techniques and defensive shield maneuvers. He can ride his wheel shield to damage enemies in his path, bash them directly, or enter a defensive Shield Mode. His blowhole allows for water-based splash damage, and he can be upgraded to release homing fish projectiles and execute powerful sword combos like the Whirlpool and Undersea Ambush.

trivia: Flip Wreck, and Thumpback are currently the only Skylanders based on cetaceans. Also being kinds of whales, they share similarities.
They both share the ability to shoot water out of their blowholes as a method of attack.
They both wear shoulder pads and belts around their waists.
They both have pointed teeth in their mouths.
Flip Wreck is voiced by Jess Harnell, who also voices Blast Zone, Gusto, and Crash Bandicoot.
He is the only one of the Frito Lay Skylanders whose original name wasn't revealed.
His files in Trap Team show his placeholder name as Sea Saw.
Flip Wreck is one of the several Skylanders who use a shield (the others being Ignitor, Chop Chop, Chill, Doom Stone, Wildfire and High Volt).
Flip Wreck's weapon is based off of a Hawaiian shark toothed sword.
His name is a play on 'Shipwreck'.

fortune-funny-bone.name: Fortune Funny Bone
fortune-funny-bone.description: Fortune Funny Bone is the St. Patrick's Day counterpart of Funny Bone in Skylanders: Lost Islands. He is available on March 2015.
fortune-funny-bone.biography: Fortune Funny Bone is the St. Patrick's Day counterpart of Funny Bone in Skylanders: Lost Islands. He is available on March 2015.
fortune-funny-bone.catchphrase: Glimpse the gleam of gold with Fortune Funny Bone!
trivia: He is the second St. Patrick's day counterpart in Lost Islands (the first being Lucky Boomer).

free-ranger.name: Free Ranger
free-ranger.description: Free Ranger is a storm chicken who is one of the SWAP Force Skylander in Skylanders: Swap Force. He is of the Air element, and his SWAP Force ability is Spin.
free-ranger.biography: Free Ranger was hatched during a storm when a thunderous bolt of lightning struck his egg. From that very moment, his destiny was clear – he would become the greatest storm chaser ever known! He spent his entire life pursuing hurricanes, spinning inside tornados, and riding lightning. But a day came when he encountered a storm unlike any other. It was unnatural and ominous, billowing with evil, and leaving only desolation in its wake. Free Ranger was standing at its edge, moments from boldly leaping into it, when he was stopped by none other than Master Eon. The wise Portal Master told him that it was The Darkness that raged before them, and if he were up to the challenge, he could join the Skylanders to help defend against it in the Cloudbreak Islands.
free-ranger.personality: A real whirlwind, Free Ranger is sometimes too impetuous for his own good. He has a love for bad weather, such as tornadoes, hurricanes and thunderstorms, and would often throw himself into them. He is most likely to talk about the weather; and least likely to stay indoors because it's raining. He is incredibly brave (but also a big chicken) and uncomfortable in confined spaces.
free-ranger.gameplay: The primary ability is available from the start of the game. Skylanders can buy new abilities from Persephone/Power Pods. Skylanders can use abilities depending on their level. 3DS Starting Powers: Storm Blade Combo (Primary Attack): Rapidly tap (Y) to perform a combo chain. Eyes of the Storm (Secondary Attack): Press (X) to launch a blast of lightning. Spin (SWAP Force Power): Press (L) to create a vortex that pulls in coins, pulls in and damages nearby targets, reflects projectiles, and causes the Skylander to hover. 3DS Upgrades: Sonic Boom Blast (requires level: 3): Upgrade the Storm Blade Combo to launch a massive blast of wind on the final strike. Sprint Twister (requires level: 6): Leaves whirlwinds behind while sprinting (A) that pull in enemies and deal damage. Lightning Blast (requires level: 9): Hold (X) to charge a stronger version of Lightning Tail.

trivia: Free Ranger's name is a play on the term 'free range,' a farming method for chickens.
He shares the same few battle quotes as Sonic Boom.

Free Ranger appears in the Clutch - The Art of Skylanders SuperChargers art book, in which he is depicted riding a vehicle. This makes him one of two SWAP Force Skylanders to have been potentially considered as a candidate for SuperChargers.
Free Ranger's lower half is capable of stopping enemies from spinning and using swirling shields as their means of defense by using his tornado ability.

His blades resemble Adam Frankenstein's blades from I, Frankenstein and the bat'leth from Star Trek. Incidentally, they also resemble Stealth Elf's blades, and even Hodge's blades from the Mortal Instruments: City of Bones. His blades also resemble Plasma Rifles from the Halo series.
His stormblades are similar to chakrams.
Oddly, his belt buckle is gold on his artwork and toy, but is blue in-game.
Free Ranger is voiced by Joey Camen, who is also the voice actor of Terrafin and Boomer.

He is the second Air Skylander to come with a starter pack; the first was Jet-Vac for Skylanders: Giants, and the third was Gusto for Skylanders: Trap Team. He's also the first to do so both for Nintendo 3DS and as a non-core Skylander.
In early packaging, his catchphrase was mistakenly Hoot Loop's catchphrase.

He and Magna Charge are the only SWAP Force Skylanders whose secondary attacks are capable of causing enemies to drop defenses. Other SWAP Force Skylanders with their bottom halves are able to do the same thing.
In the Wii version of SWAP Force, Free Ranger doesn't say his catchphrase until after he stops spinning.
Free Ranger appears on the cover of the Strata art book for Swap Force, where his feathers appear to be blue and he exhibits the ability to exhale lightning.

freeze-blade.name: Freeze Blade
freeze-blade.description: Freeze Blade is a feline ice skater who is one of the SWAP Force Skylanders in Skylanders: Swap Force. He is of the Water element.
freeze-blade.biography: When he was young, Freeze Blade's family moved from the Frozen Wastelands of Vesh to the Great Lava Lakes. As it turned out, this was a very difficult adjustment for Freeze Blade. Not only was he the sole one of his kind, it was also incredibly hot and there was no ice to skate on whatsoever. But over the years, he learned to fit in with the other fire-like creatures and even discovered he had a magical ability to ice skate on any surface... even bubbling lava. One day, while out setting a new frozen lava speed record, he came across Blast Zone, who had just been ambushed by some nasty Spell Punks. After Freeze Blade stepped in to defend him, Blast Zone was so impressed by his skill in battle that he introduced him to Master Eon, who invited him to join the Skylanders.
freeze-blade.personality: Freeze Blade slides into action without a thought of his own personal safety. He's always on the move, not one to stay in one place for long. He is known for making friends easily. Bullies, however, leave him cold.
freeze-blade.gameplay: Freeze Blade slides into action without a thought of his own personal safety. He's always on the move, not one to stay in one place for long. Known for his magical ability to ice skate on any surface, including lava, he utilizes icy chakrams for ranged combat and his unique skating abilities for high mobility. In Skylanders: Ring of Heroes, he serves as an attacker who can inflict the Freeze Effect on enemies and deal damage to frozen targets.
