abilities.description: Hold Attack 3 to charge Frostcicle, release to freeze an entire area.

abilities.name: Ice To Meet You
abilities.description: Frostcicle and Oh Snow! Do increased damage.

abilities.name: Flash Freeze
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 to dash, dashing will now leave behind an ice trail that damages enemies.

abilities.name: Nice Ice
abilities.description: Flash Freeze does increased damage. A nasty case of freezer burn!

abilities.name: Penalty Frost
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 to knock back an enemy, wherever the knocked back enemy lands will cause a large freezing explosion.

abilities.name: Iced Skates
abilities.description: Penalty Frost does increased damage. Don't worry, this is not a typical sports penalty.

trivia: Freeze Blade is one of many SWAP Force Skylanders that don't have pupils, the others include Trap Shadow, Stink Bomb, Free Ranger, and Night Shift. It is unknown whether his goggles are transparent or not.
He is the third Water Skylander with ice powers while Slam Bam is the first and Chill is the second. This was then followed by King Pen, who became the fourth one.
In early trailers of Skylanders Swap Force, Freeze Blade's mask is blue instead of dark purple.
Freeze Blade appeared in several beginning trailers for Swap Force, yet he was only released at a later date.
Freeze Blade might be ambidextrous, since even though he holds his chakram in his right hand, in Night Shift's Short Cut, he is able to tap the bell with the hammer using his left hand.
Freeze Blade's battle cry, 'Licensed to chill!' is similar to Drill Sergeant's catchphrase 'Licensed to Drill'.
He is currently the only SWAP Force Skylander to skate. However, Roller Brawl also skates, but in a different way since she uses roller blades.
He and Chill Bill share the following qualities: Both are Water-elemental and both possess ice-based attacks.
In Trap Team, when he performs 'Frostcicle', enemies do not appear to be encased in ice, but do wind up frozen for a few seconds. The same goes for his second upper path, 'Ice Sculptor.'
He is the only Water Skylander originally from Swap Force who has no primary traits originally from the scrapped Skylander, Krayken.

Freeze Blade has multiple similarities to Tundra Man from Mega Man 11. Both are ice manipulators that have ice coating their bodies and even icy hair, primarily move through ice skating, and have the ability to move at high speeds.

fright-rider.name: Fright Rider
fright-rider.species: Fright Rider: Undead Elf, Ozzy: Skeletal Ostrich
fright-rider.description: Fright Rider and his steed Ozzy (incorrectly known as Rider and Fright, in their backstory), are an Elven jouster and a skeletal ostrich, who together form an Undead jousting team. The two of them serve as one of the core Skylanders in Skylanders: Giants.
fright-rider.biography: (Disclaimer: this official biography mistakenly uses the names Fright (the ostrich) and Rider (the elf)) Rider (Fright Rider) and his magnificent ostrich, Fright (Ozzy), were the finest jousting team in all of Skylands. But after winning the championship for the third straight year, a jealous competitor placed a curse on the elf that sent him to the land of Undead. Not wanting to be without his partner, Fright, who up until this point had been afraid of nearly everything, ate a bag of skele-oats that turned him into a skeleton so that he could brace the journey to the underworld to save his friend. Grateful for being rescued, Fright/Rider returned to the surface dedicated to helping others - while still dominating an occasional jousting tournament from time to time.
fright-rider.personality: Gallant and brave, Fright Rider is always ready to rush headlong into action. Together with Ozzy, they are a courageous pair, honour-bound to right wrongs wherever they roam. Before becoming one of the Undead, Ozzy was terrified of pretty much everything. His list of fears included shadows, curtains, certain types of sandwiches and having a jousting spear accidentally plunged into his head. All that changed when he munched a bag of skele-oats so that he could be transformed into a skeleton and rescue Fright Rider. Now he isn't scared of much, apart from getting a spear through his skull. And certain types of sandwiches.
fright-rider.gameplay: These are the starting and maximum Statistics for this Skylander in the Skylanders games. Health: 270 (max. 540), Speed: 43 (max. 91), Armor: 12 (max. 42), Critical Hit: 30 (max. 80), Elemental Power: 25 (max. 75). His abilities include melee attacks with his spear and charging headlong into enemies with Ozzy. He can also burrow underground to teleport or drag enemies down with his spear.

abilities.name: Melee Attacks
abilities.description: Press the Attack 1 button to perform melee attacks with the ostrich and spear. Press Attack 1, Attack 1, and Hold Attack 1 for a special combo.

abilities.name: Jousting Charge
abilities.description: Press and Hold Attack 2 button to charge towards enemies with spear extended.

abilities.name: Ghoul Glaive
abilities.description: Melee attacks do increased damage.

abilities.name: Burrow Bomber
abilities.description: Hold Attack 3 to burrow and set the ostrich's head underground. Release Attack 3 to teleport to that location.

abilities.name: Phantasm Strike
abilities.description: Jousting Charge does increased damage.

abilities.name: Halberd of Horror
abilities.description: Melee attacks do even more increased damage.

abilities.name: A Real Drag
abilities.description: While burrowing, the spear can drag enemies underground.

abilities.name: Fright Rider Combos
abilities.description: Press Attack 1, Attack 1, and Hold Attack 2 for Spear Vault. Press Attack 1, Attack 1, and then Hold Attack 3 for Skull Slam.

abilities.name: Flock of Fury
abilities.description: Hold Attack 1 to unleash a fury of multiple ostrich heads.

abilities.name: Supreme Spear
abilities.description: Melee Attacks do maximum damage.

abilities.name: Joust Juice
abilities.description: Jousting Charge is faster and does increased damage.

abilities.name: Entombment Strike
abilities.description: While charging, press Attack 3 to perform a powerful, downward strike.

abilities.name: 360 Degrees of Spear
abilities.description: While charging, press Attack 1 to swing the spear around in a 360-degree attack.

trivia: Fright Rider's catchphrase is similar to Hex's, whose catchphrase is 'Fear the Dark!', and Gill Grunt's catchphrase 'Fear the Fish!'
Fright Rider shares the same skin color with Hex since both of them are Undead Elf Skylanders.
Sprocket's original catchphrase ''Fear the Gear'' is very similar to Fright Rider's (as gear and spear both rhyme)

Fright Rider, along with Eye-Brawl, Rocky Roll, Bad Juju, and Air Strike are the only five Skylanders who are either composed of two different characters in a symbiotic relationship, or fight alongside another creature.

During Giants's early development, Fright Rider's abilities and upgrades went by different names: 'Melee Attacks' was called 'Ostrich Fighter', 'Jousting Charge' was called 'Jousting Lance', 'Halberd of Horror' was misspelled as 'Halbred of Horror', 'Fright Rider Combos' was called 'Dark Champion', 'Flock of Fury' was called 'Flock of Ostrich Fury', 'Supreme Spear' was called 'Coresque of Styx', '360 Degrees of Spear' was called 'Soul Cyclone', and 'A Real Drag' was called 'The Crypt Catcher'.
In the primary combo, burrow move, and Flock of Fury attack, Ozzy sticks his head in the ground. This is a reference to the misconception of real ostriches poking their heads in the ground.
While officially stated as being an ostrich, Ozzy closely resembles a Gastornis, an extinct species of giant predatory birds (somewhat more commonly known as a terror bird).

Fright Rider is voiced by Yuri Lowenthal, who is best known for voicing teenage Ben Tennyson from the later Ben 10 series, Young Superman from ‘’Legion of Super Heroes ‘’ and Sasuke Uchida from Naruto.
The name is a pun on the iconic TV series Knight Rider, starring David Hasselhoff.
Fright Rider also refers to his ostrich as Ozzy in Skylanders Giants. Also, when given a nickname, one of his particular lines is 'Like the new name. Not sure about Ozzy though'.

While most Weapon Skylanders hold their weaponry in their right hands, Fright Rider appears to be left-handed because he is holding a spear in his left hand while holding Ozzy's harness with his right hand.

frightful-fiesta.name: Frightful Fiesta
frightful-fiesta.description: Frightful Fiesta is the Halloween counterpart of Fiesta in Skylanders: SuperChargers.
frightful-fiesta.biography: Several Halloweens ago, the legendary Pumpkin Pixies challenged Fiesta and his mariachi band to a duel of music in the Land of the Undead. The Pixies began with a bone-chilling tune, but Fiesta immediately followed with a spooky song of his own. On and on they played, each song more haunting than the one before it. And soon, the entire pumpkin patch was dancing. What began as a challenge had turned into the party of the year! So impressed were the Pumpkin Pixies that they used their magic to make Fiesta an honorary pumpkin for that day – and every Halloween thereafter!
frightful-fiesta.personality: Frightful Fiesta is a musically talented skeleton who enjoys turning any challenge, even a musical duel, into a grand party. His skill and festive nature are enough to impress even the legendary Pumpkin Pixies.
frightful-fiesta.gameplay: In Skylanders: SuperChargers Racing, Frightful Fiesta utilizes stats for Top Speed, Acceleration, Handling, Firepower, and Armour. His standard Power Stats emphasize high Luck and Agility.

abilities.name: Trumpet Concord
abilities.description: Fiesta plays a haunting tune on his trumpet.

abilities.name: Amigos
abilities.description: Fiesta summons his mariachi band amigos to assist him.

abilities.name: Laid Low
abilities.description: Further enhances Fiesta's combat capabilities.

abilities.name: Take It Away Amigos!
abilities.description: Fiesta's amigos take charge in the battle.

abilities.name: Diva
abilities.description: A powerful musical performance that dazzles enemies.

trivia: The black part of Frightful Fiesta's mariachi outfit is much darker than his original counterpart's only as figures.
His outfit bears a resemblance to the marching band skeleton on the album cover of 'The Black Parade' by My Chemical Romance.
His Rift Engine is colored black with the Undead icon in orange to symbolize Halloween.
Interestingly, on his promotional image of his toy packaging, his Rift Engine is silver instead.

frito-lay-skylanders.name: Frito-Lay Skylanders
frito-lay-skylanders.description: The Frito-Lay Skylanders were part of a naming competition for picking a new Skylander set for Skylanders: Trap Team. These Skylanders were given names and backstories created by fans who were chosen as winners of the Frito-Lay Skylander naming competition. The names chosen for three Skylanders are High Five, Bat Spin, and Flip Wreck.
frito-lay-skylanders.biography: High Five was declared the winner of the Frito Lay contest. Not only were the given names of both Bat Spin and Flip Wreck kept, the two Skylanders would remain playable in Trap Team.
frito-lay-skylanders.gameplay: Gameplay involves the three winners of the Frito-Lay naming competition: High Five, Bat Spin, and Flip Wreck. All three characters are fully playable in Skylanders: Trap Team.
trivia: The Frito-Lay Skylanders were part of a naming competition for picking a new Skylander set for Skylanders: Trap Team.
The names chosen for three Skylanders are High Five, Bat Spin, and Flip Wreck.
High Five was declared the winner of the Frito Lay contest.
Not only were the given names of both Bat Spin and Flip Wreck kept, the two Skylanders would remain playable in Trap Team.

frosted-food-fight.name: Frosted Food Fight
frosted-food-fight.description: 'Frosted Food Fight just brought sugary treats to the Lost Islands! Help us celebrate the release of Trap Team with him!' —Frosted Food Fight's description
frosted-food-fight.biography: Frosted Food Fight is a party counterpart of Food Fight who appears exclusively in Skylanders: Lost Islands. Players could get him for free by downloading an update for Lost Islands but he was only available until the end of October 2014.
frosted-food-fight.catchphrase: Frosted Food Fight just brought sugary treats to the Lost Islands! Help us celebrate the release of Trap Team with him!
frosted-food-fight.personality: As a party counterpart of Food Fight, he is associated with celebrations and sugary treats, reflecting a festive and cheerful nature.
frosted-food-fight.gameplay: In Skylanders: Lost Islands, Frosted Food Fight functions as an Alter Ego of Food Fight. He was released as a special promotional character to celebrate the launch of Skylanders: Trap Team and was obtainable for a limited time by downloading an update in October 2014.
trivia: He is the third Lost Islands Alter Ego Skylander who can't be earned from the Wishing Well (the first is Admiral Thumpback and the second is Holiday Wash Buckler).

fryno.name: Fryno
fryno.description: Fryno is an orange Firey Biker Rhinoceros in Skylanders: Swap Force. His Series 2 counterpart from Trap Team is named Hog Wild Fryno. He also has a summer counterpart called Flip-Flop Fryno who was available in Skylanders : Lost Islands in August 2014. Fryno is a small rhino, with orange skin, no snout, brown (or red, when heated) eyes and a wide square mouth with two pointed teeth sticking up from his lower lip, and flatter teeth inside. He also has short stumpy legs and feet, with two big toes, each protected by hard white hooves. On his head, he wears a black and gold helmet, with his ears and one long horn sticking out from the top. He also wears a grey/black bikesuit containing a biker coat, with a black shirt underneath, and grey/black pants with a gold belt buckle. He even wears metal heat-resistant gloves on his hands that turn red hot when heated. When he's upgraded, his coat contains the fire element logo on the back.
fryno.biography: Fryno was once a member of the notorious Blazing Biker Brigade and spent most of his youth riding around Skylands with the rest of his crew. But what Fryno did not realize was that, while he enjoyed a life of freedom and adventure, his crew was responsible for acts of burglary throughout Skylands. When Fryno discovered that he had been riding around with a bunch of villains, he burned with rage and demanded that they make amends for the wrong they had done. This resulted in an epic fight, which Fryno won, and the disbanding of the Blazing Biker Brigade. Fryno was in the midst of returning the valuables his crew had stolen when he met Master Eon, who was impressed with his good character and fighting abilities, and offered him a membership to a new crew -- the Skylanders.
fryno.personality: Fryno is hot on honesty. In fact, liars and cheats make him flaming mad! Being a firey rhino, he possesses a short temper, but is trying to keep his anger in check.
fryno.gameplay: Fryno utilizes a melee-focused combat style that revolves around punches and heat management. His Primary Ability, Brawl, allows him to punch enemies with increasing speed and damage as his heat level rises. His Secondary Ability, Heated, lets him smash the ground to manually increase his heat. Upgrades introduce a Molten Motorcycle for dashes and explosions. His soul gem, Madness Maxed, increases his maximum heat potential for even greater fury.

abilities.name: Brawl
abilities.description: Press Attack 1 to punch nearby enemies. Speed and damage of punches is increased depending on heat.

abilities.name: Heated
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 repeatedly to smash the ground and increase heat level.

abilities.name: The Horn And The Hog
abilities.description: Press Attack 3 to dash forward dashing damage to enemies in the way. When heated, Fryno jumps on a motorcycle to deal damage to nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Built Tough
abilities.description: Health is increased. Probably from punching the ground so much.

abilities.name: Fired Up!
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 repeatedly to throw a tantrum and become heated. Tantrums now have increased range and damage.

abilities.name: Molten Fury
abilities.description: All attacks do increased damage when heated.

abilities.name: Madness Maxed
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 rapidly to make Fryno even more heated. So angry!

abilities.name: Burning Rubber
abilities.description: While riding the motorcycle, hold Attack 2 to go into a power drift, blasting enemies with molten rocks.

abilities.name: Hot Hands
abilities.description: Hold Attack 1 to rapidly punch nearby enemies and release heat.

abilities.name: Spiked Up
abilities.description: New metal gloves causes Hot Hands to do increased damage.

abilities.name: Temperature Tantrum
abilities.description: Nearby enemies take damage while Fryno is heated.

abilities.name: Born To Ride
abilities.description: The Horn and The Hog will always summon a molten motorcycle.

abilities.name: Hot Rod
abilities.description: All attacks with the motorcycle do increased damage.

abilities.name: Crash And Burn
abilities.description: Fryno throws the motorcycle at the end of a dash, causing a massive explosion that damages nearby enemies. Who's paying for that...?

trivia: Fryno was considered for the SuperChargers character lineup at some point in development of Skylanders: SuperChargers.
Fryno's name is a combination of 'fry' and 'rhino.'

Fryno bears a resemblance to Rhino from Marvel. In the 'Ultimate Spider-Man' episode 'Return of the Sinister 6', Rhino had armor with a track allowing an attack similar to Fryno's 'The Horn and The Hog'.
Fryno, along with Gorm and Tuk are three of the few characters in Skylanders who are pachyderms. Fryno is the only pachyderm to be a Skylander.
One of the names of Fryno's upgrade paths is called Brawler, which is also the name of one of Terrafin's upgrade paths and later a Sensei Battle Class.
According to his Short Cut, Fryno goes to anger management lessons. In the commercial, there is an error where his left foot clips through the couch.
Fryno is one of the few Skylanders who uses a vehicle for an attack (others include Sprocket and Hot Head). Both he and Hot Head are Fire element.
His Soul Gem power, 'Madness Maxed', is a reference to the film series Mad Max.
His eyes are brown when calm but turn fiery red when mad or heated. His hands and horn also turn fiery red when heated.
Despite smiling in artwork, he's rarely seen smiling in gameplay.
He is the first and only Skylander first appearing in Swap Force to have a Mini version (Small Fry).
He, Eruptor and Fire Kraken share the quote 'Too hot to handle!'
His tagline 'Burn to be wild!' is another Skylander's Catchphrase (Fire Kraken).
Fryno is voiced by Robert Cait, who also voiced Colossus in X-Men and Norm the Genie in The Fairly Odd Parents.
His personality is similar to Flame Princess from Adventure Time and Yang Xiao-Long from RWBY.
He is the only core Skylander from Swap Force to get a Series 2 in Trap Team.
His Series 2 toy shows a new black biker outfit with spikes, but this change does not appear in gameplay.
His Catchphrase (Crash And Burn) is a lyric in the David Guetta song 'Sound Of Letting Go'.

funny-bone.name: Funny Bone
funny-bone.description: Funny Bone is a Skeleton dog who is one of the Undead core Skylanders in Skylanders: Trap Team. He has a St. Patrick's Day themed variant called Fortune Funny Bone.
funny-bone.biography: Funny Bone once lived on Punch Line Island – the funniest place in the Land of the Undead and home of the Eternal Chuckling Trees that magically make everyone laugh when the breeze tickles them. But after hearing stories of this, the evil Count Moneybone sent his minions to investigate if this magic could be used to make a 'Funny Bomb' that would render Skylands helpless with laughter. Funny Bone was in the middle of burying his neighbors' birthday cake on a breezeless day when the invaders arrived. Seeing their large axes, Funny Bone instantly knew that the Chuckling Trees were in danger. Without hesitation, he sprang into action, fighting off the minions and driving them from his humorous home. Now as a Skylander, Funny Bone delivers his own punch line to evil!
funny-bone.catchphrase: I Have a Bone to Pick!
funny-bone.personality: Funny Bone is very protective. He always knows when danger's afoot. How does he know? Well, let's just say he gets a funny feeling about it.
funny-bone.gameplay: Funny Bone, being part of the Undead, possesses bone summoning abilities. He can fling out phantom frisbees to pummel enemies as his primary attack. Later upgrades allow him to chase after the disk and perform a slam attack once the disk is caught. Funny Bone also can charge up a spinning bone saw attack and grind into enemies. His third attack involves digging underground to bring up skeletal bone paws that attack enemies.

abilities.name: Flying Bone Disc
abilities.description: Press Attack 1 to shoot a Flying Bone Disc.

abilities.name: Bone Saw
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 to dash forward and slice enemies.

abilities.name: Bone Paws
abilities.description: Press Attack 3 to raise Bone Paws from the ground which attack enemies.

abilities.name: Disc Demon
abilities.description: Flying Bone Disc does extra damage.

abilities.name: Ferocious Fetch
abilities.description: Press and hold Attack 1 to chase after the Flying Bone Disc and release to fetch it.

abilities.name: Bump Up the Blades
abilities.description: Press and hold Attack 2 to charge a Bone Saw.

abilities.name: Healing Paws
abilities.description: Bone Paws pet Funny Bone to heal him.

abilities.name: Supercharged Saw
abilities.description: Press and hold Attack 2 to supercharge the Bone Saw.

abilities.name: Bone Paw Power
abilities.description: Dash towards a Bone Paw to supercharge the Bone Saw.

abilities.name: Head Case
abilities.description: Press and hold Attack 3 to summon a ghostly skull to devour enemies during the Bone Saw attack.

abilities.name: Flying Bone Doom
abilities.description: Flying Bone Discs now explode and do additional damage.

abilities.name: Ultimate FBD
abilities.description: Flying Bone Disc Slam affects a larger area.

abilities.name: Play Catch
abilities.description: Hit a Bone Paw with a Flying Bone Disc to play catch with other paws.

trivia: The Bone Discs are a reference to real life where a dog fetches a frisbee.
The Bone Saw attack resembles a monowheel: a vehicle with one wheel where the chair is inside.
His catchphrase is a play on the phrase 'I have a bone to pick with you'.
Funny Bone's name originates from a nerve from the human body, scientifically known as the Ulnar Nerve.
Funny Bone is one of the many Undead characters that can summon allies, others including Eye-Brawl, Krypt King, Rattle Shake, Cynder, Bat Spin, and Ghost Roaster.
He is one of the few playable canines in Skylanders (other canines include Hot Dog, Wolfgang, Slobber Trap and Flare Wolf).
Coincidentally, both he and Wolfgang are from the Undead element.
Funny Bone bears a resemblance to Horrifido from Dr. Zitbag's Transylvania Pet Shop.
In an interview during San Diego Comic Con 2014, I-Wei mispronouced Funny Bone's name as 'Bone Saw'.

gearshift.name: Gearshift
gearshift.description: Gearshift is a tall, humanoid robot with white metal plating and golden coils making up her arms, neck, and abdomen. Her shoulders are topped by a small white gear and her hands are connected by a sleeve-like collar. Her head consists of a circular bolt on each side; blue eyes with red, glowing pupils; and the forehead is embedded with the symbol of the Tech element. Her weapon of choice is a wide Traptanium Gear, with four pegs on each side and two handlebars for Gearshift to handle it. Like all Trap Masters, she has their signature symbol, inside the gear attached to her back.
gearshift.biography: Gearshift was created on the Tech island of Metallana by King Mercurus, who considered the young robot to be his own daughter. But rather than performing royal duties, Gearshift preferred to spend her time in the oily depths of the kingdom among its workers, secretly tending to the huge subterranean machines. When her father discovered this, he was furious - but then a squadron of Undead Stormriders suddenly attacked. Learning that these marauders wanted to capture her father, Gearshift used her knowledge of the labyrinth below to hide him. Seizing the emblem of her people - The Great Gear - she used it to fight the Stormriders, inspiring the workers to rise up. Together, they drove the Stormriders out of Metallana and saved the kingdom. For this, Gearshift was made part of the Trap Team, using her new awesome Traptanium-forged gear to help defend Skylands.
gearshift.personality: Gearshift's passion and spirit are an inspiration to her teammates. She's also quick on her feet.
gearshift.gameplay: These are the starting and maximum Statistics for this Skylander in the Skylanders games.

abilities.name: Traptanium Gear
abilities.description: Press Attack 1 to perform a Traptanium Gear attack, depending on which Mode you are in.

abilities.name: Mode Toggle
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 to toggle between Hoop Mode, Dual Mode, and Fragment Mode, with all different attacks.

abilities.name: Gear Grind
abilities.description: Press Attack 3 to cartwheel forward, damaging anything in your path.

abilities.name: Gear Saw
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 to switch modes and release a Gear Saw. Gear Grind into it to make it spin again.

abilities.name: Many Mini-Gears
abilities.description: Press Attack 3 to Gear Grind and release a bunch of dangerous Mini-Gears.

abilities.name: Mini-Gear Distribution
abilities.description: After Mini-Gears are released, press Attack 1 in Hoop Mode to knock Mini-Gears into enemies.

abilities.name: Swing Shift
abilities.description: Traptanium Gear is more powerful and can switch modes much faster.

abilities.name: Spare Parts
abilities.description: In Dual Mode, press Attack 1, Attack 1, Attack 1 to release a Gear Saw.

abilities.name: Keep 'Em Spinning
abilities.description: In Dual Mode, press Attack 1 to hit a Gear Saw and make it spin longer.

abilities.name: Geared Up
abilities.description: Gear Saws are larger and occasionally release Mini-Gears.

abilities.name: Enhanced Fragmentation
abilities.description: In Fragment Mode, press Attack 1 to fire more fragments more.

abilities.name: Kick It into High Gear
abilities.description: In Fragment Mode, press Attack 1 to also release Mini-Gears.

abilities.name: Hardware Overload
abilities.description: In Fragment Mode, repeatedly press Attack 1 to lob out a ton of Mini-Gears.

trivia: Gearshift's catchphrase, 'All Geared Up!', is similar to Spyro's catchphrase, 'All Fired Up!' and Wind-Up's, 'All Wound Up!'
She is the third robot to have an organic voice after Wind-Up and Spy Rise.
She, Rocky Roll, Star Strike, and Dr. Krankcase are the only Skylanders with the same number of all their stats.
Gearshift's voice actor, Susan Eisenberg, is known for voicing Wonder Woman in the DC Animated Universe.
She and Sprocket are the only female Skylanders of the Tech element. Of the two, Gearshift is the only non-core female Tech character.

ghost-roaster.name: Ghost Roaster
ghost-roaster.description: Ghost Roaster, formerly known as Olav, is an Undead skeletal ghoul Skylander in Skylanders: Spyro's Adventure. He is only available for purchase in the Darklight Crypt Adventure Pack.
ghost-roaster.biography: There was a time when Ghost Roaster was neither a ghost nor a roaster. Instead he was a chef living in a village high in the mountains. One day, while clipping wool from a sheep to use in a recipe, he accidentally fell into the Valley of the Undead and transformed into a ghost-eating ghoul! After eating an entire spectral village, its Ethereal Ruler chained Ghost Roaster to a spiked ball as punishment -- its rattle heard as he wanders the night, warning nearby spirits. When Master Eon eventually heard of his predicament, he figured even a ghost eater could be useful. So he made Ghost Roaster a Skylander... after he promised to eat only evil ghosts.
ghost-roaster.personality: Ghost Roaster is known for his relentless, undying appetite for ghosts (particularly evil ghosts). However, being a chef, he is good in the kitchen for making delicious recipes. Despite his scary behavior, he seems unfazed by pranks such as Camo's. In Secret Agent Secrets, Ghost Roaster's flaw is revealed to be a desire to have his work recognized, even if by the side of the villains. Years being put aside in favor of newcomer Skylanders made him bitter towards them, until Stormblade expressed respect for what he did regardless of his threats.
ghost-roaster.gameplay: Being a ghoul, Ghost Roaster can turn intangible to avoid enemy attacks, at the cost of his health, before returning to physical form to attack his opponents. He can also turn into a large flaming and speeding skull, and strikes his enemies using his spiked ball tail.

abilities.name: Chain Whip
abilities.description: Swing your chain tail at enemies.

abilities.name: Skull Charge
abilities.description: Transform into a ghostly head that barrels through enemies.

abilities.name: Pain Chain
abilities.description: Chain Whip attacks do increased damage.

abilities.name: Metalhead
abilities.description: The Skull Charge attacks last longer.

abilities.name: Ectoplasm Mode
abilities.description: Enter Ectoplasm Mode and be immune to all attacks, but lose health over time.

abilities.name: Haunt
abilities.description: Defeating an enemy with the Chain Whip turns them into a ghost that attacks other enemies.

abilities.name: Lingering Curse
abilities.description: Ghosts have a bigger attack range and knocks enemies away.

abilities.name: Phase Shift Burst
abilities.description: All nearby enemies take damage when you enter Ectoplasm Mode.

abilities.name: Ecto-Friendly
abilities.description: While in Ectoplasm Mode, you move faster and lose less health over time.

abilities.name: Nightmare Touch
abilities.description: Touching a ghost while in Ectoplasm Mode creates a powerful explosion.

abilities.name: Fright Bite
abilities.description: Skull Charge does increased damage.

abilities.name: Unfinished Business
abilities.description: Defeating an enemy with Skull Charge creates a ghost.

abilities.name: Life Transfer
abilities.description: Devouring a ghost while doing a Skull Charge heals you.

trivia: He is one of the very few Skylanders who had a Proper Name before becoming a Skylander (Olav).
Ghost Roaster's catchphrase 'No Chain, No Gain' is a joke on the saying 'No Pain, No Gain'.
He is the first Skylander that has an upgrade that decreases his health slightly.

Therefore, he is also the first who can get knocked out in the hub worlds of the Skylanders series. Since Imaginators, he, High Five and Knight Imaginators can drain their own health, but Ghost Roaster is the only one who can be defeated doing so.
Like Pac Man, Ghost Roaster eats ghosts. His Skull Charge is a very obvious reference to Pac Man.

Ghost Roaster is voiced by John Kassir, best known as the voice of the Cryptkeeper in Tales from the Crypt. He also provides the vocal effects for Elliott in the 2016 adaptation of Pete's Dragon and voices Rizzo, Short Cut, and Spellslamzer.
His name may have been a reference to Marvel's Ghost Rider or the Ghostbusters franchise.
Ghost Roaster was originally called Ghost Eater.
There is a glitch in Swap Force where if you jump while in Ectoplasm Mode, Ghost Roaster's chain becomes transparent until he enters Ectoplasm Mode again.
He, Bash, and Bop both have spikeballs attached to them.
There is a glitch in Giants where you cannot complete his quest Grave Circumstances after getting the Fright Bite upgrade.

One time Ghost Roaster was about to unknowingly crack open one of Sonic Boom's eggs into a mixing bowl to whip up a batch of pancakes. Needless to say Sonic Boom wasn't happy, and poor Ghost Roaster didn't know what hit him!
He and Smash Hit have spiked balls at the end of their chains.
A skin texture map of Ghost Roaster was leaked in the 1.0 version of Skylanders: Ring of Heroes, but he never appeared in the final game.

If Ghost Roaster is interrupted by a dialogue scene or cinematic while using Skull Charge in the Xbox 360 version of Spyro's Adventure, he will revert to his normal form but float gradually forward in the direction that he's facing.
In Trap Team he is the only character who doesn't laugh after the player puts a trinket on him.
The collectable skulls that appear in the Tech Gate maze of Cadaverous Crypt and the Undead Gate of Empire of Ice are modeled off Ghost Roaster's skull, with rubies for eyes.

giants.name: Giants
giants.gender: Seven male (Bouncer, Crusher, Eye-Brawl, Hot Head, Swarm, Thumpback, Tree Rex); One female (Ninjini)
giants.description: The Giants, also known as the Elder Elementals, are large beings who are the original Skylanders as well as one of the key playable characters in Skylanders: Giants. There are a total of eight Giants, one of each original Element.
giants.biography: The original Skylanders were the Giants, who united their powers to defeat the Arkeyan King. Ten thousand years ago, they banded together and fought for the freedom of Skylands against the Arkeyans, who ruled over Skylands with an iron fist. In a final battle against their adversary, the Giants were banished to Earth by the Iron Fist of Arkus, where they've been buried underground until recent days. As the years passed, the Giants became a myth.
giants.personality: The Giants are legendary heroes known for their immense strength and bravery. They are ancient protectors of Skylands who once stood against the tyranny of the Arkeyan Empire to ensure the freedom of all.
giants.gameplay: Giants wield great strength, giving them the ability to lift, throw, and destroy trees, towers, rocks, and other things that normal Skylanders can't destroy. While normal Skylanders can only destroy rocks with the help of bombs or cannons, Giants can do so with their bare hands without the use of powerups. They can also destroy crates, Chompies, and other objects that may contain coins just by walking on them. An important ability only used by the Giants is the Feats of Strength. Giants are required at certain moments to complete feats of strength that provide access to the next level in the game world.

abilities.name: Great Strength
abilities.description: Giants wield great strength, giving them the ability to lift, throw, and destroy trees, towers, rocks, and other things that normal Skylanders can't destroy. While normal Skylanders can only destroy rocks with the help of bombs or cannons, Giants can do so with their bare hands without the use of powerups. They can also destroy crates, Chompies, and other objects that may contain coins just by walking on them.

abilities.name: Feats of Strength
abilities.description: Giants are required at certain moments to complete feats of strength that provide access to the next level in the game world. For instance this may involve pulling two floating islands together, or lifting walls of logs.

trivia: The Giants were referred to as the Elder Elementals, the most powerful of all of the Skylanders (first mentioned in a Story Scroll in Skylanders: Spyro's Adventure). The Scroll also said that they possessed powers of light and darkness within their flesh, which might refer to their light-up feature.
Each of the Giants have the symbol of their Element somewhere on them. For example, Tree Rex has the Life Element symbol on his forehead.
Thumpback, Swarm, Eye-Brawl, and Hot Head are the only Giants without any in game variants other than Minis.

During the production of Skylanders: Giants, there was once a Giant Arkeyan Robot resembling Chop Chop made for the game but was scrapped, nicknamed Chop Chop Daddy. His design was later used for Krypt King in Skylanders: Trap Team.

When summoned, Giants originally jumped down from the sky and damaged nearby enemies instead of appearing in their magic moment first. This most likely was done for show purposes only and to show the sheer strength of the Giants, as it would likely cause a lot of clipping and camera issues in the final game, especially in narrow areas or indoors.
In Skylanders: Giants, the Giants are unable to flinch even after enemies attack them. However in Skylanders: Swap Force, they flinch and can be knocked away by stronger enemies and bosses.
Giants can open treasure chests faster than other Skylanders. There are also specific golden chests that only Giants can open.
They are the only team of non-Core Skylanders without Dark counterparts.
The Giants are the only special team of Skylanders where all members are present in their introductory cutscene.

In Skylanders: Giants, medium-sized enemies such as Drow Lance Masters will often take a few steps back before confronting Giant Skylanders, as if intimidated. The alpha version of Skylanders: Giants takes this idea even further, adding startled sound effects and freezing the enemies in place while a Giant is facing them, for an almost comedic effect.

gill-grunt.name: Gill Grunt
appearances: Gill Grunt and the Curse of the Fish Master
Trigger Happy Targets the Evil Kaos
gill-grunt.description: Gill Grunt is a blue Gillman wearing a teal swimsuit, teal arm gloves and legwear. He also has webbed feet, a fin on his head and two on his sides that act like ears, two gill openings (one on each side of his face) and yellow & orange eyes. He's also one of the few Gillmen with visible teeth (two long fangs sticking up from his lower lip). He's even armed with a harpoon machine and a water jetpack.
gill-grunt.biography: Gill Grunt was a brave soul who joined the Gillmen military in search of adventure. While journeying through a misty lagoon in the clouds, he met an enchanting mermaid. He vowed to return to her after his tour. Keeping his promise, he came back to the lagoon years later, only to learn a nasty band of pirates had kidnapped the mermaid. Heartbroken, Gill Grunt began searching all over Skylands. Though he had yet to find her, he joined the Skylanders to help protect others from such evil, while still keeping an ever-watchful eye for the beautiful mermaid and the pirates who took her.
gill-grunt.personality: Gill Grunt is one fish who never lets evil off the hook, willing to protect people other than himself and his friends. Brave and courageous, he is a loyal companion to have at your side. Protective and determined, Gill is a bighearted Gillman who never, ever gives up. He believes himself to be one of the greatest singers in history, while others find his singing to be dreadful; a trait shared by all Gillmen. In spite of this, Gill Grunt's friends (with the exception of Eruptor) are too fond of him to tell the truth.
gill-grunt.gameplay: Gill Grunt can shoot harpoons and also launch torrents of water at his enemies using his harpoon gun. He can also use his water jet pack to hover above ground, and even fly.

abilities.name: Harpoon Gun
abilities.description: Shoot high-velocity harpoons at your enemies.

abilities.name: Power Hose
abilities.description: Spray water at your enemies to knock them back.

abilities.name: Barbed Harpoons
abilities.description: Harpoons do increased damage.

abilities.name: High Pressure Power Hose
abilities.description: Power hose attack does extra damage and knocks enemies back further.

abilities.name: Harpoon Repeater
abilities.description: Harpoons reload faster.

abilities.name: Water Jetpack
abilities.description: Fly until the Water Jetpack runs out.

abilities.name: Anchor Cannon
abilities.description: Hold down the primary power button to charge the Anchor Cannon attack, then release to fire.

abilities.name: Anchor's Away
abilities.description: Hold Attack 1 and release to fire three giant anchors.

abilities.name: Anchor Management!
abilities.description: Charge up the Anchor Cannon and press Attack 2 to do special damage.

abilities.name: Ride the Leviathan!
abilities.description: In Jet Pack mode, press Attack 2 to ride a giant Leviathan, taking out anything in its path.

abilities.name: Quadent Harpoons
abilities.description: Harpoons do even more increased damage.

abilities.name: Piercing Harpoons
abilities.description: Harpoons travel straight through enemies and hit new targets.

abilities.name: Tripleshot Harpoon
abilities.description: Shoot three harpoons at once.

abilities.name: Reserve Water Tank
abilities.description: The Power Hose and Water Jetpack never run out of water.

abilities.name: Boiling Water Hose
abilities.description: Power Hose attack does even more damage.

abilities.name: Neptune Gun
abilities.description: When using the Power Hose, launch exploding starfish.

trivia: Gill Grunt is the only Skylander with a character-specific achievement, which involves taking out Kaos' Minions with Gill Grunt's water hose in Lava Lakes Railway.
Gill Grunt is the personal favorite Skylander of Alex Ness, the former Chief of Staff in the development of Skylanders. Alex even admitted that he has a weird loyalty to Gill Grunt.

Although Gill Grunt's biography and later games state that he still searches for his mermaid girlfriend after joining the Skylanders, Alex Ness mentioned that the Gillman eventually rescued her before he became a Skylander.
On Gill Grunt's old render image for Spyro's Adventure, he originally had a mad-looking frown on his face. So it was redesigned giving him a smile on his face.
Despite being one of the Skylanders who can speak English in Spyro's Adventure, Gill Grunt still has few of his original gibberish lines.
Gill Grunt is the only Skylander in the starter pack for Spyro's Adventure who doesn't have a Legendary counterpart. He is also the only console version starter to have an evil counterpart.
His gameplay is similar to that of F.L.U.D.D.'s from Super Mario Sunshine.
He and Jet-Vac share various similarities, including using large guns and wearing jetpacks.
Gill Grunt is the only Skylander whose Series 3 counterpart's appearance remains the same as before (shared with Trigger Happy and Eruptor).
In Spyro's Adventure, he was given a high voice with a French accent. In Giants and the rest of the future title Series, he was given a tougher and scratchier voice with an American accent.
Gill Grunt is the only Skylander to have a Series 4 version of himself in Trap Team.
He is the only Water Skylander to have a Series 3 figure.
Series 2 Gill Grunt's figure and artwork design is impossible to get in game as the design has the first upgrade from both paths.

gill-runt.name: Gill Runt
gill-runt.description: Gill Runt is one of the four sidekicks in Skylanders: Spyro's Adventure. He is the miniature version of Gill Grunt, eventually becoming a Mini Skylander in Skylanders: Trap Team.
gill-runt.biography:
Within the Skylands, a realm of infinite possibilities, there is in fact an alternate reality known as the Skylands Miniverse. Everything there is smaller, including the Skylanders. The Skylanders Sidekicks come from that Miniverse and have traveled to the Skylands to meet their regular-sized alter egos and tag along with them on adventures.

The Skylander Minis started off as regular 'Sidekicks', assisting the Skylanders on many exciting adventures. And what they lacked in size they more than made up for in courage. Ultimately determined to become full-fledged heroes, they trained at the Skylands Academy - honing their powers and skills until they were ready. Now, they stand side by side with their full grown counterparts, ready to defend Skylands against Kaos and his evil minions.
gill-runt.personality: Gill Runt is the best friend anyone could ever have. He is trustworthy and loyal and he gets the job done.
gill-runt.gameplay: Gill Runt initially appeared as a Sidekick in the first three Skylanders games, functioning as a non-playable companion that followed the player. In Skylanders: Trap Team, he was re-released as a 'Mini', making him a fully playable Skylander with the same move pool as Gill Grunt, including the Harpoon Gun, Water Cannon, and his Jetpack abilities.

abilities.name: Harpoon Gun
abilities.description: Shoots a harpoon at enemies.

abilities.name: Water Cannon
abilities.description: Blasts enemies with a powerful stream of water.

abilities.name: Boiling Water Hose
abilities.description: Spray boiling water to damage enemies.

abilities.name: Water Jet Pack
abilities.description: Allows for quick movement and tactical positioning.

abilities.name: Anchor Cannon
abilities.description: Launch heavy anchors at enemies for massive damage.

trivia: Gill Runt is the miniature version of Gill Grunt.
He originates from the Skylands Miniverse, where everything is smaller.
His English voice actor is Darin De Paul.
Gill Runt is described as being a trustworthy and loyal friend who gets the job done.
Gill Runt started as a Sidekick before training at the Skylands Academy to become a full-fledged hero as a Mini Skylander.

gnarly-barkley.name: Gnarly Barkley
gnarly-barkley.description: Gnarly Barkley is the blue counterpart of the Life Mini, Barkley, in Skylanders: Trap Team.
gnarly-barkley.biography: Gnarly Barkley is the blue counterpart of the Life Mini, Barkley, in Skylanders: Trap Team.
gnarly-barkley.personality: Gnarly Barkley is feisty and determined, embodying the strength of the forest in a miniature but powerful form.
gnarly-barkley.gameplay: Gnarly Barkley plays identically to Tree Rex and Barkley, utilizing heavy physical attacks like the Shockwave Slam and charging maneuvers like the Sequoia Stampede to dominate the battlefield.

abilities.name: Shockwave Slam
abilities.description: A powerful ground-shaking slam that creates shockwaves to damage surrounding enemies.

abilities.name: Sequoia Stampede
abilities.description: A charging stampede attack that tramples anything in its path.

trivia: He, Power Punch Pet-Vac, and Eggsellent Weeruptor are the only Minis to be available in single packs instead of double packs.
He bears the same name and color scheme as the counter part of Tree Rex, Gnarly Tree Rex.
This makes him the only Mini variant to be based of a variant for his regular sized counterpart.
His name bears a resemblance to Gnarls Barkley, a 2000's group notable for their song 'Crazy.'
He is the only variant Skylander before SuperChargers to not have an appearance in Skylanders: Lost Islands.
If Gnarly Barkley is placed on the portal in Skylanders: Giants, he shows as a 'special' variant (In Skylanders Swap Force he shows as the regular version).
He is the only variant of a mini Skylander who debuted in another game other than Trap Team.

gnarly-tree-rex.name: Gnarly Tree Rex
gnarly-tree-rex.description: Gnarly Tree Rex is a blue counterpart of the giant, Tree Rex. He was only available in the Starter and Portal Owners pack for the Super Slim PlayStation 3 and in a special Blue Wii bundle in America. He was later available in a single pack starting August of 2013.
gnarly-tree-rex.biography: Gnarly Tree Rex is a blue counterpart of the giant, Tree Rex. Long before the Giants protected Skylands, Tree Rex was a majestic tree living in the ancient woods. But when the Arkeyans built a factory nearby to forge their mechanical war machines, the pollution from the factory began to seep into the soil and transform Tree Rex into something else. He grew into a massive, walking engine of destruction with the strength of a forest. While some were afraid of him, Tree Rex used his great power to fight against the Arkeyans and protect Skylands.
gnarly-tree-rex.personality: Tree Rex is a noble and powerful giant who takes his role as a protector of Skylands very seriously. Despite his intimidating size and bark-like exterior, he is a dedicated defender of nature and a steadfast ally to the Skylanders.
gnarly-tree-rex.gameplay: These are the starting and maximum Statistics for this Skylander in the Skylanders games: Health: 430 (max. 860), Speed: 20 (max. 68), Armor: 24 (max. 54), Critical Hit: 40 (max. 90), Elemental Power: 25 (max. 75). As a Giant, Tree Rex is slow but possesses immense strength. He uses powerful punches and light-based projectiles to defeat enemies. He can also perform 'Feats of Strength' to interact with the environment, such as lifting boulders or pulling islands together.

abilities.name: Arbor Smash
abilities.description: Press Attack 1 to smash enemies with your massive wooden fists.

abilities.name: Sequoia Charge
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 to charge forward and knock enemies out of the way.

abilities.name: Photosynthesis Cannon
abilities.description: Press Attack 3 to fire a concentrated beam of light from your arm cannon.

abilities.name: Big Thorn Shockwave Slam
abilities.description: Arbor Smash now creates a shockwave that deals extra damage.

abilities.name: Woodpecker Pal
abilities.description: A friendly woodpecker joins you in battle, attacking nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Super Stampede
abilities.description: Hold Attack 2 during a charge to deal massive damage to anything in your path.

abilities.name: Titanic Smash
abilities.description: Increases damage and range of all physical attacks.

trivia: Gnarly Tree Rex has the same colors as legendary Skylanders, albeit with a more vibrant shade of blue.
In Giants, his eyes glow green much like his figure form. However, in Swap Force and Trap Team, his eyes glow blue like his original counterpart.

golden-queen.name: Golden Queen
golden-queen.description: The Golden Queen is a golden statue who is one of the Earth villains introduced in Skylanders: Trap Team. She serves as the secondary antagonist of Skylanders: Trap Team. She is the former leader of the Doom Raiders, a group of the most notorious villains in Skylands.
golden-queen.biography: A wicked queen made entirely of gold and rich beyond her wildest imagination, the aptly named Golden Queen would gladly trade her entire fortune for just a little more. But why trade when you can steal? And that's what she did. She stole, and stole, and stole! But no matter how much she took, it was never enough. Through evil sorcery, she even learned how to turn people and objects into solid gold. However, that STILL wasn't enough. The idea that any amount of treasure in Skylands did not belong to her was infuriating, so she embarked on a quest to take every last cent of it. But she couldn't do it alone. It was then that she formed the Doom Raiders – the most notorious group of villains ever assembled. As the leader, the Golden Queen promised riches, world domination, and even all-you-can-eat shrimp in order to recruit special criminals to serve her cause. Together, the Doom Raiders terrorized Skylands until Master Eon and the Trap Masters put a stop to them, locking up all of them inside Cloudcracker Prison!
golden-queen.personality: As her name suggests, the Golden Queen completely values solid gold of any kind. She was extremely greedy, never having enough gold until all of it in the world of Skylands was hers. In her attempt to satisfy her desire for more gold, she would turn objects and people into gold. As the former leader of the Doom Raiders, she had a feared, yet respected position among her allies. The Golden Queen however, can be easily angered (which causes her to glow brightly) if things don't turn out the way they were planned, and she didn't tolerate failure. Despite having recruited the Doom Raiders, she showed no concern when several of them were captured as long as their roles in helping to complete the Ultimate Weapon were fulfilled. The Golden Queen firmly believed that gold surpasses everything, including friendship. When she turned Cali to gold, she claimed that the frozen Mabu was something more precious to her than just a friend to the Skylanders. On one occasion, she became aggressive and reckless when a golden egg was stolen from her in Graduation Day, and turning down the opportunity of ruling Skylands if it meant having all the gold in the world instead. In her Meet the Villains trailer, she mentions having been 'fed with a silver spoon, but [she] didn't want silver, [she] wanted gold!', implying that the Golden Queen was always spoiled even from a young age. After her rehabilitation, the Golden Queen lost much of her obsession with gold, but kept her aggressive and prideful personality even in the side of the heroes. She has also discarded her villainous side completely, as she now values the newfound friendship and companionship among her new Skylander teammates.
golden-queen.gameplay: Through evil sorcery, the Golden Queen learned how to turn anyone or anything into solid gold with a touch of her finger or with the power of her golden staff. Being made of gold and other riches, she can regenerate herself by absorbing golden treasures. She can conjure a golden forcefield to protect her self, levitate herself, create golden butterfly-like devices that send spinning disks, and generate rings of energy from her staff. When submerged in liquid gold, she can grow to a large size. After completing her Villain Quest, she is able to activate Dr. Noobry's Piggybank-o-matic 3001s, seemingly transforming them into sentient robotic pigs. However, that appears to be a side effect, as they cough out treasure involuntarily then fall over exhausted. As of Skylanders: Ring of Heroes, she's the only character that can change into a Non-Elemental being for battle instead of an enemy from a special area, as she'll rarely be extra gilded in the Cave of Gold and gain more health and power.

abilities.name: Winged Scarabs
abilities.description: Press Attack 1 to release winged scarabs made of gold dust.

abilities.name: Golden Shockwave
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 to create a golden shockwave that turns any nearby enemies into gold.

abilities.name: Blinded By Gold
abilities.description: Winged Scarabs now release gold dust on enemies, slowing them down temporarily.

abilities.name: Royal Guard
abilities.description: Press Attack 3 to summon a Guard Turret that fires golden blades at enemies.

abilities.name: Golden Opportunity
abilities.description: When using Golden Shockwave, any enemies that are defeated when in a golden statue sometimes turn into coins.

abilities.name: 18 to 24 Karats
abilities.description: Winged Scarabs and Guard Turrets now cause more damage when attacking.

abilities.name: Royal Treatment
abilities.description: Hold Attack 2 to transform into Giant Queen. Press Attack 1 to smash the ground and Attack 3 to shoot eye lasers!

abilities.name: Scarab Swarm
abilities.description: The Ultimate Sensei attack! Press Special Attack to summon and control a massive swarm of scarabs!

abilities.name: Colossal Scarab
abilities.description: Hold Attack 1 to grow a larger and more powerful scarab.

abilities.name: Worth Its Weight
abilities.description: Winged Scarabs now deal more damage.

abilities.name: Gold Rush
abilities.description: Colossal Scarabs now release a wave of gold dust that causes additional damage for a short time. The larger your scarab, the greater the wave.

abilities.name: Extra Guard
abilities.description: You can summon an additional Guard Turret to join your defenses.

abilities.name: Shields of Gold
abilities.description: Guard Turrets are protected by a force field that knocks enemies back.

abilities.name: Compound Interest
abilities.description: If you hit a Guard Turret with the Winged Scarabs attack, the turret will fire golden blades in all directions.

trivia: When angered, the Golden Queen glows brightly.
She is voiced by CCH Pounder, who is notable for providing the voice of Amanda Waller in Batman: Arkham Origins & the Justice League, and Marion Grange in Beware The Batman.
Her ability to touch and turn things and people into golden is similar to King Midas and the Golden Touch.
She, Nightshade, and Chomp Chest are the only three villains capable of producing gold.
The Golden Queen is the second Doom Raider to have the ability to grow in size (the first one being The Gulper).
She and the Chompy Mage are the only two Doom Raiders to summon allies (Grave Clobber and Chompies) of their element.
Imhotep mentions in Lair of the Golden Queen that her favorite hat is the Classic Pot Hat.
Though being made of gold, Golden Queen appears to eat normal food, running off with a large pig-like creature and a mouth full in the Snack Attack card in Battlecast.
Notably, Golden Queen's wings in her Sky Chi do not appear to be made of gold or jewelry.
When using her Sky-Chi or summoning golden butterflies in Imaginators, Golden Queen has a custom magic circle with numerous ancient Egyptian symbols, such as ankhs and the Eye of Horus.
Golden Queen is similar to the Dragon of Earth Laethys from the MMO game Rifts. Both had the ideology that all of the world's riches belonged to them and sought out gold at any cost.
Golden Queen, Lightning Rod, Zap, Wham-Shell, Punk Shock, and Hammer Slam Bowser are the only six Skylanders who come from royalty.
As seen in the spin-off series Skylanders Academy, the Golden Queen wears leggings under her skirt and robe, only distinguishable from her skin when her boots are taken off.
In Imaginators, Golden Queen grants to Imaginators her Pharaoh's Pride headdress decoration when first placed on the portal, and her staff when the Sorcerer Sensei Shrine is opened.
She, King Pen, Wolfgang, Chompy Mage, and Crash Bandicoot are the only five members of Senseis to appear in Skylanders Academy as of Season 1.
Golden Queen, Dr. Krankcase and Pain-Yatta are the only three villains who didn't change weapons when turning into Senseis in Skylanders: Imaginators.
In Imaginators, Golden Queen is the only villain Sensei to play the normal Sensei tune when placed on the portal.
She, Stealth Elf and Super Shot Stealth Elf are the only three female Skylanders with dark edition counterparts.

gourmet-gusto.name: Gourmet Gusto
gourmet-gusto.description: Gourmet Gusto is the chef counterpart of Gusto in Skylanders: Lost Islands.
gourmet-gusto.biography: Gourmet Gusto is the chef counterpart of Gusto in Skylanders: Lost Islands. He was first released in May 2015 and is recognized as the last Skylander exclusive to the mobile game.
gourmet-gusto.catchphrase: Gourmet Gusto is bringing some flavor to the Lost Islands!
gourmet-gusto.personality: While not explicitly detailed in lore, his role as a 'Gourmet' chef counterpart to Gusto suggests a passion for culinary arts and bringing 'flavor' to the Skylands.
gourmet-gusto.gameplay: In Skylanders: Lost Islands, Gourmet Gusto acts as a playable hero. Like other Alter Egos, he can be used to perform tasks and provide elemental bonuses within the game.
trivia: Gourmet Gusto is the last Skylander exclusive to Lost Islands.

granite-crusher.name: Granite Crusher
granite-crusher.description: Granite Crusher is a black and blue variant of the Earth Giant, Crusher.
granite-crusher.biography: Granite Crusher is a black and blue variant of the Earth Giant, Crusher. He was first released as a Target exclusive in Skylanders: Giants. His voice is provided by Kevin Sorbo.
granite-crusher.personality: As a variant of Crusher, he is a formidable and heavy-hitting warrior who uses his massive size and strength to protect Skylands, often declaring it 'Crush Hour' before engaging in battle.
granite-crusher.gameplay: Granite Crusher features high health and armor as a Giant. His moveset includes crushing enemies with his hammer, petrifying them with his gaze, and creating rockslides. His starting console stats include 470 Health and 60 Speed.

abilities.name: Crusher's Crusher
abilities.description: Crusher swings his massive granite hammer to crush enemies.

abilities.name: Turn to Stone
abilities.description: Crusher uses his powerful gaze to turn enemies into stone.

abilities.name: Rockslide
abilities.description: Creates a rockslide that damages enemies in a wide area.

abilities.name: Ground Grinder
abilities.description: A powerful ground-pounding attack that grinds the earth.

abilities.name: Cavelight Blast
abilities.description: A powerful blast of energy released from deep within the caves.

trivia: He is the second Skylander to be exclusive to Target, the first being Series 1 Whirlwind (though she is no longer a Target exclusive), the third being Jade Flashwing, and the fourth being Nitro Magna Charge.
His voice is provided by actor Kevin Sorbo.

grave-clobber.name: Grave Clobber
grave-clobber.description: Grave Clobber is a living stone mummy who is one of the trappable Earth Villains in Skylanders: Trap Team. He returns in Skylanders: Battlecast as one of the two bosses of the Earth Realm in the Second Dimension, once again under the Golden Queen's command. In Skylanders: Imaginators, Grave Clobber has switched elements to Water and is one of the ten villains who trades in a life of crime to become a Sensei. He now trains Imaginators who belong to the Brawler Battle Class.
grave-clobber.biography: Grave Clobber was once a great pharaoh who ruled the Golden Desert long ago. That was until his seven jealous brothers buried him in an underwater tomb while he was sleeping. But the remaining brothers still fought among themselves, and their infighting ultimately led to their kingdom falling apart and the family name being lost forever... almost. Because Grave Clobber eventually rose from his watery grave, and when he discovered what his brothers had done to their kingdom, he hunted each of them down and clobbered them. This was how he came to the attention of the Golden Queen, who now ruled the desert herself. She recruited Grave Clobber into her gang of Doom Raiders, but when the Skylanders defeated them once and for all, Master Eon thought that perhaps there was more to this mummy than meets the eye. He gave the old pharaoh a chance for redemption, and since nobody clobbered better than Grave Clobber, he was the perfect choice to be a Sensei trainer for the Brawler Class.
grave-clobber.personality: Grave Clobber is aloof, violent, and intimidating with his attacks and threats. However, he appears to have a soft side, as he will take the time to say punny catchphrases and was seen calmly observing bugs in his Sensei Shrine cutscene before being disturbed by the Brawler Sensei Shrine. Whenever he is near others whom are smaller than he is, he unintentionally frightens them due to his imposing figure, but this does not bother him at all. Upon enlisting as a Skylander, he still retains his personality from when he was a villain, but he is now much more friendly and compassionate towards his allies. However, he is still perfectly willing to legitimately threaten and clobber anyone who poses a threat to Skylanders Academy or those who cannot defend themselves.
grave-clobber.gameplay: Grave Clobber can use his large fists for strong punches and cause shockwaves on the ground, and summon spiky bones that can be punched to throw bone shards into enemies. In Skylanders: Battlecast, he can imbue his fists with mud for a round of Fighting Dirty, and gain power from defeated teammates, even ones he sacrifices himself. In Imaginators, his rocky insides are now full of water and fire off streams when he does a variety of wrestling moves, from punches, to lariats, to belly flops and aerial kicks. Grave Clobber can also summon alligator totems that sprinkle water to reach enemies from afar or to do a powerful vertical suplex. Despite his slow walking speed however, his Sky-Chi shows that his speed lies on his fists, as he throws punches so fast that he absorbs water in waves around him to pull enemies forward.

abilities.name: Clobber Punch
abilities.description: Press Attack 1 to clobber your enemies. Jump and press Attack 1 to drop kick.

abilities.name: Gator Geyser
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 to summon a Gator Geyser Fountain that you can punch.

abilities.name: Big Splash
abilities.description: Press Attack 3 to flop on top of your enemies.

abilities.name: Luchador Lariat

trivia: Grave Clobber's name is a portmanteau of 'grave robber' and 'clobber', referencing both his nature as an undead being and his main weapon being his hands.
Grave Clobber has the highest amount of health of all the Senseis, having 400 hit points at the start and 1,200 at maximum.
He, Cuckoo Clocker and Hood Sickle are the only villains to be summoned by a Doom Raider.
He is the only villain to be summoned by a different villain of the same element.
His turning good quote is a pun off of the famous line in the movie Jerry Maguire.
His capture quote is based off the phrase 'I want my mommy!'
His head resembles that of the the Spirit of Delphi from Percy Jackson: Sea of Monsters.
His name is a play on the term 'grave robber'.
His post-Sky-Chi quote is based off the famous phrase of Julius Caesar, 'I came, I saw, I conquered.'

Despite being a humanoid made of living stone, his imprisonment has turned him into an Undead mummy. Because of this, he makes several references to the Undead element, despite not being elementally aligned with it in any of his appearances.

He is voiced by Kevin Michael Richardson, who also voiced Stump Smash, Tree Rex/Barkley, and Eye Five. Richardson was uncredited for his performance in Imaginators as a result of the SAG-AFTRA voice actor strike.
As a Sensei, water constantly drips from Grave Clobber's body to indicate the change in his element.
He and King Pen are both Brawler Senseis of the Water element.
One of his idle animations in Imaginators has him attempt to adjust his shendyt, while another has him striking the pose of a traditional Ancient Egyptian mummy.
His origin story from Imaginators is a reference to the Bible story of Joseph.
Players can change direction of the Luchador Lariat during the wind up animation to place three Gator Geysers in a row.
Originally, Grave Clobber's Gator Geysers attack was named 'Sar-croc-phagus', but it was way too hard to say.

grill-master-chop-chop.name: Grill Master Chop Chop
grill-master-chop-chop.description: Grill Master Chop Chop is the chef version of Chop Chop in Skylanders: Lost Islands. He was available only in the month of August 2013.
grill-master-chop-chop.biography: Grill Master Chop Chop is the chef version of Chop Chop in Skylanders: Lost Islands. He was available only in the month of August 2013.
grill-master-chop-chop.catchphrase: Grill Master Chop Chop is ready to get cooking in the Skylands!
grill-master-chop-chop.personality: Grill Master Chop Chop is ready to get cooking in the Skylands!
grill-master-chop-chop.gameplay: Grill Master Chop Chop is an Alter Ego variant for Skylanders: Lost Islands and does not have any unique attacks or move sets.
trivia: Grill Master Chop Chop was the first non-Legendary Undead variant.
Coincidentally, the first Legendary variant of the Undead element was also a version of Chop Chop.

grilla-drilla.name: Grilla Drilla
grilla-drilla.description: Grilla Drilla is a Drilla who is one of the SWAP Force Skylander in Skylanders: Swap Force. He is of the Life element, and his Swap Force Ability is Dig. He has a construction counterpart who is available in Lost Islands on May 2014.
grilla-drilla.biography: In the distant jungles of what was once the sprawling subterranean city of the Drilla Empire, Grilla Drilla served among the guards for the Drilla King. Every seven years, the king would select the bravest and strongest guard to become their leader. It was during the last selection ceremony that a troll mining operation broke through the ground above them and quickly snatched the king, wanting to know the location of the famed Drilla Diamond. Having never ventured above ground, Grilla Drilla risked everything to defeat the trolls and rescue the Drilla King. In return for his bravery, Grilla was selected as the new leader. But he instead decided to join the Skylanders, where he could protect even more residents of Skylands.
grilla-drilla.catchphrase: If There's a Drill, There's a Way!
grilla-drilla.personality: Never one to think of himself, Grilla Drilla gave up his jungle throne to become a Skylander, knowing it would mean he could protect even more people! Grilla Drilla also follows rules to the letter - suspecting Boom Bloom's eagerness to become a Skylander but still going through the process to ask for Master Eon's advice on the matter.
grilla-drilla.gameplay: Grilla Drilla's primary combat style involves heavy punching and drill-based attacks, supported by the ability to summon monkey allies and plant coconut or banana turrets. In the 3DS version of Swap Force, his secondary attack is to throw barrels similar to Donkey Kong. His stats are focused on balanced power and health, with starting Health at 290 and Speed at 43.

abilities.name: Monkey Call

abilities.description: Explosive Growth bomb plants will explode into three smaller bombs.

abilities.name: Nature's Bounty
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 to plant a coconut turret that shoots at nearby enemies. Press Attack 2 again to plant another.

abilities.name: This Is Coconuts!

abilities.description: Coconuts do increased damage. Go nuts for the new and improved Coconut Blaster!

abilities.name: Banana Split
abilities.description: Coconut turret upgrades into a rapid shooting Banana turret.

abilities.name: Go Bananas!
abilities.description: Bananas do increased damage. Delicious!

trivia: His base is unique, as it has a large amount of dirt on top of the leaves, compared to the standard Life base (which only has leaves).
Grilla Drilla's name is a play on 'gorilla' and 'driller.'
His named may also be a reference to drill, which is a type of primate.
He, Kaos (Sensei), and Pop Fizz has the most syllables for their catchphrases, counting seven.
At one point, Grilla Drilla was designed with a tail, long clawed fingers, and plated armor that covered his body.
He is the second Skylander to create turrets, the other being Sprocket.
According to developer Buck Chantel, 'Grilla Drill is a Life character, but his first impression does not suggest that. Then somebody had the great idea to make his turrets shoot actual fruit.'
He is one of the few Skylanders with drilling related abilities (others include Drill Sergeant and Rubble Rouser).
Coincidentally, both he and Drill Sergeant have the word 'drill' in their names and official catchphrases.
His catchphrase is based on the quote, 'If there's a will, there's a way'.
In the 3DS version of Swap Force, his secondary attack is to throw barrels similar to Donkey Kong.
In his Soul Gem preview, he is shown to have golden teeth during the gameplay.
During one of his idle animations, he can be seen picking something from his chest and then eating it, presumably a bug.
Out of every Skylander, Grilla Drilla currently has the longest catchphrase.
He and Kaos' Clone currently have the most syllables of all catchphrases.
He, Fling Kong, and Turbo Charge Donkey Kong are currently the only three Skylanders to be based upon primates.
One of his battle cries later became a pun for Fling Kong's catchphrase.
He has a similar resemblance to Chilla from Kameo: Elements of Power.

grim-creeper.name: Grim Creeper
grim-creeper.description: Grim Creeper is a reaper who is one of the Core Undead Skylanders in Skylanders: Swap Force. He is available in the Arkeyan Crossbow Battle Pack.
grim-creeper.biography: When he was young, Grim Creeper visited the prestigious Grim Acres School for Ghost Wrangling, hoping to attend as a student. But when the Scaremaster interviewed him, he found that Grim didn't have any of the usual training that other students had. Because of this, he was turned away. However, as the young Grim was about to leave, a herd of rampaging ghosts suddenly flooded the school -- carrying away the faculty and leaving the students to fend for themselves. Grim Creeper stood his ground -- not only defending the other students, but using his amazing reaping talents to fight back the ghosts and contain them until help could arrive. Now a Skylander, Grim is considered one of the best reapers ever to swing a scythe, proving that studies alone are no substitute for bravery, passion and true heroic spirit.
grim-creeper.personality: Grim Creeper may be grim by name and nature, but this reaper is passionate about fighting evil and will always be a hero through and through. He stands his ground whatever the situation.
grim-creeper.gameplay: Grim Creeper uses a ghostly scythe for primary attacks and can separate from his armor in Ghost Form. In Ghost Form, he can mark enemies for the Living Armor to attack. He is capable of knocking enemies into the air with spinning spectral attacks and can choose between mastering his scythe style or enhancing his spectral tactics to heal himself. On the 3DS, he gains additional powers like Fear Scream and Armor Spectral Scythe Spin as he levels up.

abilities.name: Haunted Help

abilities.name: Soul Sampler
abilities.description: Regain some health for each enemy hit by Spook and Destroy.

trivia: His name is a play on the name of the undead entity, 'Grim Reaper'.
Both Grim Creeper and Hood Sickle are both based on the Grim Reaper.

He is the second Undead Skylander to have a ghostly ally while Cynder is the first. However, he must defeat an enemy in order to summon it. Also, killing a Chompy or a Chompy Pod won't summon ghostly allies.
His abilities are similar to Ignitor as they can leave their suits.
Grim Creeper is voiced by Lex Lang, best known as the current voice of Dr. Neo Cortex from Crash Bandicoot.
When wearing a hat, and performing Ghost Form, the hat stays with his Ghost Form and not his Living Armor.
His living armor slightly resembles Gregg the Grim Reaper from Conker's Bad Fur Day.
If Grim Creeper chooses the Spooky Specter path, he is one of the Undead Skylanders with the ability to heal himself after attacking his enemies.
Grim Creeper was orignally called 'Grimm Streaker'.
His Ghost Form slightly resembles the ghosts from the Darklight Crypt level of the first game, including Machine Ghost from Skylanders: Giants.
Due to having a sky blue color, Grim Creeper's ghost form also resembles that of Malladus from Legend of Zelda: Spirit Tracks.
His Soul Gem, Help From Beyond, adds a mist that follows him.
His regular figure form lacks black pupils within his blue eyes.
If you look really closely inside Grim Creeper's hood-like helmet, you'll notice a skull after he goes into Ghost Form. However, that only happens after all of his basic upgrades have been purchased.
He somewhat resembles the Nethers from Ratchet & Clank: Into the Nexus as he is a ghost that wears a dark suit of protective armor. Unlike the Nethers, he can survive without his armor.
He is one of the few Undead Skylanders to have armor (others being Chop Chop, Eye-Brawl, and Krypt King).

gusto.name: Gusto
gusto.description: Gusto is a large humanoid Trap Master of the Air element in Skylanders: Trap Team. He is included in the Nintendo 3DS version's Starter Pack and a single pack.
gusto.biography: Gusto was once a cloud wrangler in the peaceful Thunderclap Kingdom, where he learned to master the wind under the guidance of the mysterious Cloud Dragon. But a day came when a fleet of dragon hunters appeared on the horizon, seeking to capture the fabled creature. Despite the danger, Gusto stepped forward to defend it. The hunters could see that Gusto was not a soldier and didn't even have a real weapon – just a 'curved stick.' However, he was no coward! And, throwing his large boomerang, Gusto hit his surprised opponents again and again – until the hunters surrendered and were forced to retreat. For standing up for himself and protecting the Cloud Dragon, Gusto was given a new Traptanium Boomerang and made part of the Trap Team!
gusto.personality: Gusto is a big guy with heart of gold. Not actual gold, of course, but Gusto's heart is just as precious.
gusto.gameplay: Mastering the wind, Gusto can throw his Traptanium boomerang with great force, which, of course, comes right back. He can charge his boomerang up, which adds electricity to the impact. Gusto can suck in enormous amounts of air, taking in his enemies as well, and blow it back out in a powerful gust that damages foes in the process.
