trivia: His catchphrase is a pun on the saying 'Guts and glory'.
He, Dino-Rang and Bone Bash Roller Brawl are the only Skylanders to wield boomerangs.
His name is a Spanish word that means 'taste', which could refer to his ability to swallow enemies and to spit them out.
In addition to this, he is similar to the Nintendo character, Kirby, since they are both able to swallow and eat their enemies.
He's one of the playable characters that can eat their enemies, the others are Wrecking Ball, Thumpback, Thumpling, Slobber Tooth, and The Gulper.
Gusto, Smolderdash and Trigger Happy all have the word 'glory' in their catchphrase.
One of his upgrades 'The Breath of Life' is named after a song.
Another one of his upgrades, 'Rang Me Like a Hurricane' is a pun on the song ('Rock You Like a Hurricane' by Scorpions).
In Ring of Heroes, Gusto is already equipped with his spiked boomerang from the Air Ace path.

When Gusto inhales mage enemies (such as Bad Jujus and Rage Mages), the mages' effects will remain active. For example, Bad Jujus' cyclones will keep swirling, and Rage Mages' power balls will hang in the air.
Oddly, if a Rage Mage is killed while inside Gusto's belly, its diamond will drop sideways and grow to double its usual size.

hallows-eve-hex.name: Hallows' Eve Hex
hallows-eve-hex.description: Hallows' Eve Hex is the Halloween 2014 counterpart of Hex in Skylanders: Lost Islands.
hallows-eve-hex.biography: Hallows' Eve Hex is the Halloween 2014 counterpart of Hex in Skylanders: Lost Islands. She was released in October 2014 as a special seasonal variant of the Undead sorceress.
hallows-eve-hex.catchphrase: Hallows' Eve Hex is here to cast a spell over Skylands!
hallows-eve-hex.personality: As a seasonal variant of Hex, Hallows' Eve Hex embraces a spooky and festive persona. Unlike her regular counterpart, she is depicted with visible hair, giving her a distinct appearance while maintaining her magical and mysterious nature.
hallows-eve-hex.gameplay: In Skylanders: Lost Islands, Hallows' Eve Hex is an Alter Ego variant. According to her character characteristics, she does not have any specific recorded attacks, serving primarily as a collectible variant within the game's kingdom-building environment.
trivia: She is the second Halloween variant in Lost Islands (the first being Skeletal Cynder).
She is also the first Lost Islands Skylander of 2014 not to be based on a Swap Force character.
Unlike her regular counterpart, she has visible hair.
She is also the third female Undead variant in Lost Islands, after Skeletal Cynder and Snowler Brawl.

hammer-slam-bowser.name: Hammer Slam Bowser
hammer-slam-bowser.description: Hammer Slam Bowser, otherwise known as Bowser, is the Koopa King and a special Skylander-amiibo hybrid, along with Turbo Charge Donkey Kong. He is well known as the main antagonist of the Mario series. Hammer Slam Bowser is one of the Fire SuperChargers in Skylanders: SuperChargers, equipped with his signature vehicle, the Clown Cruiser. He is exclusively playable on Nintendo consoles and is available only in the Nintendo Wii and 3DS Starter Packs of Skylanders: SuperChargers Racing.
hammer-slam-bowser.biography: Bowser is the king of the Koopas and believes himself to be the supreme, unquestioned ruler of a kingdom far from Skylands. A hot-tempered and spiky-shelled warrior, he was transported to Skylands by traveling through a rift that had been created by Kaos' terrible Sky Eater. The Skylanders sent out a distress call across all the dimensions to call for reinforcements, and for reasons known only to Bowser himself, he has decided to join this epic battle against Kaos and the Darkness in his Clown Cruiser as the newest and most lethal of all the SuperChargers!
hammer-slam-bowser.personality: Being one of Nintendo's most iconic antagonists, Bowser is very tyrannical, cruel, ruthless, and oppressive, willing to do whatever it takes to defeat his former nemesis Mario, and capture his love interest Princess Peach. Now as a SuperCharger, Bowser is a trustworthy warrior; courageous, selfless, and loyal to those who can't help themselves. He is still sinister, but in a good way (very similar to the SWAP Force Skylander, Rattle Shake). He is also a very frightening fellow, as he managed to scare Buzz during his quest at Skylanders Academy. Like many of the Fire Skylanders, the Koopa King is shown to have a fiery temper, though he seems to be able to control it, much like Eruptor. Bowser is also highly intelligent, as in the past, he was able to construct various weapons and machinery single-handedly, though when it comes to combat, he has his Magikoopa assistants Kamek and Kammy do the thinking for him. He also clearly detests immaturity, as shown when he was trying to get Donkey Kong to pay attention to their brawl with Blubberbeard.
hammer-slam-bowser.gameplay: Equipped with a large, fire-infused hammer, Bowser can land devastating blows on his enemies. He can also summon Koopas, Warp Pipes, and transform into Molten Bowser. Purchasing his Soul Gem will cause all active Koopa Troopas to transform into Molten Bones Koopas.

abilities.description: Press Attack 1 three times to do a massive lava slam attack.

abilities.name: Bowser Bomb
abilities.description: Press Attack 3 to enter Molten Bowser mode causing an explosion and massive damage to enemies around you.

abilities.name: Infinite Fire
abilities.description: Hold Attack 2 while in Molten Bowser mode to deliver a continuous stream of fire.

trivia: Skylanders: SuperChargers marks Bowser's second playable appearance in a fighting game outside the Mario franchise behind the Super Smash Bros. franchise, and his fourth appearance as a playable protagonist after Super Mario RPG, Super Paper Mario, and Mario and Luigi: Bowser's Inside Story. Additionally, it is his first role as a protagonist in which he doesn't ally himself with his nemesis Mario.

While Bowser is capable of speech in the IDW Skylander comics, he doesn't talk in the game. Because of this, Bowser, Donkey Kong and Crash Bandicoot are the only Skylanders to have no catchphrases. Dr. Neo Cortex doesn't have a catchphrase either, but is fully capable of speech.
Thwomps were originally part of Bowser's moveset, until it was decided that Koopas were a better fit.

Molten Bowser is a homage to Giga Bowser in the Super Smash Bros. series. Additionally, Giga Bowser was planned to be a part of Bowser's moveset in an attempt to stay loyal to Nintendo source material. Nintendo, however, encouraged deviating from source material and doing something original, and thus Molten Bowser was created instead.
Bowser is the first villain who did not appear in Trap Team to have a Skylander figurine. The second is Dr. Neo Cortex.
He and Donkey Kong are the only two SuperChargers with vehicles not of their respective Elements. They are also the only Guest Star Skylanders that have dark versions of themselves.
The second upgrade of his Molten Monstrosity upgrade path is Bowser Bomb, which originated from Super Mario Bros. 3, and the move eventually got its name in Super Smash Bros. Melee.
Bowser, Spyro, Dino-Rang, Flashwing, Star Strike, Enigma, Donkey Kong, Crash Bandicoot, Dr. Neo Cortex, and Starcast are the only Skylanders who do not originate from Skylands.
Bowser, Lightning Rod, Zap, Wham-Shell, Chill, Swarm, Grilla Drilla, Punk Shock, and Golden Queen are the only Skylanders who come from royalty.
Bowser was originally going to have his own element, before ending up as a Fire Skylander.
He is the fifth playable turtle or turtle-hybrid, the others being Warnado, Slobber Tooth, Bomb Shell, and Shellshock Sheldon.
When compared to the other SuperChargers in game, Bowser and Donkey Kong appear to be taller than the rest of them.

Bowser, Donkey Kong, Spyro, Cynder, Sparx, Malefor, Crash Bandicoot, Dr. Neo Cortex, Aku Aku, Uka Uka, and Fake Crash are currently the only characters to appear in game franchises before the Skylanders series.
Bowser is the second hammer Skylander who is not part of the Earth element (the first being Stump Smash).
In the Nintendo Wii U version of Imaginators, there is a glitch that causes Molten Bowser to hold his hammer. It happens when Bowser is in his Molten form while the player upgrades him.
In the Wii U version of SuperChargers, Buzz mistakes Bowser for being a villain from Cloudcracker Prison, which upsets the Koopa very much.

Despite being based on a specific character, Hammer Slam Bowser's Amiibo functionality acts like a generic Amiibo in certain games like Mini Mario & Friends: Amiibo Challenge and Super Mario Odyssey, most likely because it was made by a third-party company.

He is the only guest Skylander without a singular assistant guest character (the other guest Skylanders have singular assistant guest characters. Donkey Kong has Diddy Kong, Crash Bandicoot has Aku Aku and Dr. Neo Cortex has Uka Uka).

hard-boiled-flare-wolf.name: Hard-Boiled Flare Wolf
hard-boiled-flare-wolf.description: Hard-Boiled Flare Wolf is an Easter counterpart of Flare Wolf in Skylanders: Imaginators.
hard-boiled-flare-wolf.biography: When Flare Wolf was young, he worked all summer to earn the coveted Fireworks Badge from the Wolf Scouts. In doing so, he had earned the right to light the fireworks in the annual St. Wigglewort's Day celebration - an honor of which Flare Wolf was extremely proud. But on the day of the celebration, a band of evil Ice Ogres attacked his village and took the entire community hostage! The only weapons at his disposal were the town's supply of fireworks they were saving for the evening festivities. One by one, Flare Wolf lit them in the center of the Ogre camp, launching a dazzling display of pyrotechnics that sent the Ogres running. Not only had Flare Wolf saved his village, he had also given its residents the most spectacular fireworks show they had seen in over 100 years! Even Master Eon was impressed, and offered Flare Wolf a position at the Academy as the Official Fireworks Launcher. But after seeing him in action, he quickly realized that Flare Wolf had much more to offer as a Sensei!
hard-boiled-flare-wolf.personality: Hard-Boiled Flare Wolf is proud of his pyrotechnic skills, a trait developed since his youth as a Wolf Scout. He is heroic and resourcefulness, having saved his village from Ice Ogres using only his supply of celebration fireworks.
hard-boiled-flare-wolf.gameplay: Hard-Boiled Flare Wolf is a Fire-elemental Sensei of the Bazooker class. He utilizes a variety of firework-based attacks, ranging from standard rocket projectiles to complex pyrotechnic displays, and can even ride his rockets across the battlefield.

abilities.description: Launches rockets at enemies.

abilities.name: Ride the Rocket
abilities.description: Mounts a rocket to traverse the battlefield and damage foes.

abilities.name: Loop De Loop
abilities.description: Perform a specialized maneuver while riding rockets to dodge and strike.

abilities.name: Roman Candle
abilities.description: Fire specialized pyrotechnics that create multiple explosions.

abilities.name: Secret Weapon
abilities.description: Unleashes a devastating secret firework attack.

abilities.name: Pyrotechnist
abilities.description: Master the art of fire and explosions for maximum damage.

trivia: While his eyes are blue in his promotional art and the current version of his toy form, Hard-Boiled Flare Wolf's eyes are pink in the game.

head-rush.name: Head Rush
head-rush.description: Head Rush is an elven viking like Earth Trap Master who was released in Skylanders: Trap Team. She utilizes her massive Traptanium horns and powerful vocal yodels to lead the charge against evil.
head-rush.biography: Head Rush was raised in a small village that had fallen under the spell of a powerful Harvest Sphinx, who forced the frightened villagers to plow the vast fields of golden grass for his own benefit. Although there were many villagers, no individual was brave enough to confront the Sphinx and put an end to its rule. But Head Rush believed there was a chance to fight back if she could somehow inspire her people to stand together. Charging through her village, Head Rush shouted a mighty yodel that woke the villagers from their spell! With the village behind her, she then led the charge to drive the Sphinx from the island for good. For her leadership and bravery, she was made part of the Trap Team, where she uses her giant Traptanium Horns to take charge of evil!
head-rush.personality: Head Rush's positive attitude is an inspiration to her friends. She may not think of herself as a great leader, but Master Eon and the Skylanders know that she is on a path to greatness. In Ring of Heroes, she's supportive of her allies, always trying to find a quality that they might be overlooking in their skills.
head-rush.gameplay: Head Rush is a powerful Earth Trap Master who utilizes her Traptanium horns for head-bashing and charging attacks, along with powerful ground stomps and vocal yodels to damage nearby enemies. Her playstyle focuses on crowd control through AOE stomps and direct physical charging. As a Trap Master, she can also access areas locked behind Traptanium and deals extra damage to Trappable Villains. In console games, her basic attacks are 'Traptanium Horns' for head bashes and charges, and 'Stomp' for area damage. In 'Ring of Heroes', she features active abilities like 'Unstoppable Charge' (provoke, damage, self-strength buff), 'Stomp' (AoE damage, ATK/DEF debuffs), and 'Super Lungs' (AoE damage, self-DEF buff), alongside passive buffs 'Leave It To Me!' and 'Firm Bond'. For 3DS gameplay, her 'Starting Powers' include 'Head Banging' and 'Stomp', with upgrades like 'Lungs of Steel' for a singing attack and 'Big Bang Stomp' for a powerful stomp combo.

She is probably inspired by the traditional depictions of singers playing the role of Valkyries in Richard Wagner's operas like The Valkyrie or Siegfried.
She is voiced by Audrey Wasilewski, who also voiced Stealth Elf.
Head Rush is the second female Earth Skylander in the franchise (the first being Flashwing).

heartbreaker-buckshot.name: Heartbreaker Buckshot
heartbreaker-buckshot.primaryGame: Skylanders: Imaginators (scrapped, still in game files)
appearances: Skylanders: Imaginators (scrapped, still in game files)
heartbreaker-buckshot.description: Heartbreaker Buckshot is an unreleased Valentine's Day counterpart of Buckshot in Skylanders: Imaginators.
heartbreaker-buckshot.biography: When Buckshot was young, he and his siblings were banished to the Magic Realm of Mysterious Mazes by an evil Spell Punk that wanted to rid Skylands of all Sky-Fauns. Buckshot spent years looking for a way out, but found no way to escape the enchanted labyrinth. Over time, however, the magic of the realm began to grow within him, strengthening his already formidable powers. While his siblings had lost all hope of freedom, Buckshot continued to test the boundaries of the maze, using his mystical bow and arrows to try to penetrate the walls around him. Eventually, Buckshot’s powers became so potent that he even learned how to teleport. With this new ability, he was finally able to open a portal back into Skylands and free his siblings. Now as a Sensei of the Bowslinger class, Buckshot always keeps one eye on the target – and the other on the lookout for the Spell Punk that had banished him!
heartbreaker-buckshot.personality: Buckshot is determined and resilient, having spent years testing the boundaries of the Magic Realm of Mysterious Mazes to free his siblings. Despite being a Valentine's Day variant, he was noted for looking 'too evil' for the holiday due to his red eyes.
heartbreaker-buckshot.gameplay: As a Sensei of the Bowslinger class, Heartbreaker Buckshot uses his mystical bow and arrows to attack enemies. He also possesses the ability to teleport and create portals using his goat-based powers. He was intended to function as an in-game variant with unique aesthetic qualities.

abilities.description: Fires multiple arrows in a spread pattern.

abilities.name: Goat Portals
abilities.description: Creates portals to teleport across the battlefield or reposition.

abilities.name: Through and Through
abilities.description: Arrows now pierce through multiple enemies.

abilities.name: Not the Face!
abilities.description: A defensive maneuver to protect from incoming damage.

abilities.name: Main Attraction
abilities.description: A powerful attraction-based attack that draws enemies in.

trivia: Despite being a Valentines' Day themed figure, he wasn't released during the game's lineup which included two instances of Valentines' Day.
The reason is because according to Toys For Bob QA Manager Christopher Bruno, Heartbreaker Buckshot looked 'too evil' for Valentine's Day.
This also makes him the only figure that was advertised in the main website to be never released in any form.

While his page was online on the official website for a time during 2016-2017, it was later removed. In 2021, Heartbreaker Buckshot's page was temporarily restored until the Skylanders website shut down in March.
There are two known existing prototypes of Heartbreaker Buckshot, both of which are owned by Christopher Bruno.

Had he appeared in the final game, he would have been the fourth Valentine's day in-game variant (the first being Cupid Flameslinger, the second being Love Potion Pop Fizz and the third being Charming Cobra Cadabra).
He would've been the only Valentine variant with red eyes rather than light blue, which oddly were the cause for his cancellation.

variants.name: Heartbreaker Buckshot

hex.name: Hex
hex.description: Hex is an undead elven sorceress who is one of the Core Skylanders in Skylanders: Spyro's Adventure.
hex.biography: Long ago, Hex was a gifted and powerful sorceress who traveled deep into the underworld to confront the Undead Dragon King named Malefor, who made several attempts to capture her to learn her secrets. Though she successfully battled the dragon, Hex returned from the underworld changed – having unwillingly joined the ranks of the Undead. Many are wary of her since her transformation, suspecting she has used her powerful magic for evil purposes. But Master Eon trusts her, and views her as a valuable Skylander ally.
hex.personality: Since her Undead transformation, Hex has become spooky, mysterious, and even sinister, striking fear into the hearts of her enemies. She has also developed a fondness for skulls. It has been said that Hex has laughed only once since her transformation -- apparently at an incident involving Trigger Happy, Slam Bam, and a gold coin in the rear end. She also has a tendency to act on her own, even if it means not sharing her plans with her allies. Strangely in Skylanders: Battlecast, Hex appears more prideful in battle, as well as sounding more cynical, and like other Skylanders in it, will scold and sneer at the Battlecaster should they harass her by poking.
hex.gameplay: Awakening powers from unknown depths from fighting Malefor in the Underworld, Hex had her magic changed to strange spells, such as levitation, burning phantom orbs, the ability to make skulls rain from the sky, and to summon and banish bones in wall formations. Her Wow Pow allows her to create a skull monster that spits smaller skulls at enemies. In Skylanders: Battlecast, Hex has the ability to curse and weaken enemies with charms, spells or skulls summoned from a cauldron; much of her gameplay is tied around attacks that strike long after they have been cast. In Skylanders: Ring of Heroes, she is a support character specializing in debuffs and accuracy reduction.

trivia: Hex is a word meaning the practice of witchcraft, usually as a curse.
Hex is also a Dutch word meaning 'witch,' but in Dutch it's spelled as 'heks'.
Her working name during development was Shadow Maid.
Her Skull Buddy resembles the Skull Mask in Crawling Catacombs, with red eyes instead of blue.
Her Series 2 figure is based on her Rain of Skulls attack.
She holds skulls on all of her toy figures.
Her LightCore figure's dress lights up red, based on an early hand-painted prototype.
Hex is one of the few Undead Skylanders to have no skeletal features.
She bears a resemblance to Maleficent from Disney's Sleeping Beauty.
Hex, Zap and Bop have the shortest names out of every Skylander.
All of her 3DS moves are two words that start with 'S.'
Hex is one of the first three elven Skylanders, alongside Stealth Elf and Flameslinger.
Prior to the Rain of Trolls upgrade, Hex's Skull Rain attack summons dragon skulls that resemble Cynder's.
'Boil, boil, toil and trouble' is quoted from the play Macbeth.
Hex is voiced by Courtenay Taylor in English and Daniela Fava in Italian.

high-five.name: High Five
high-five.description: High Five is a dragon/dragonfly hybrid who is one of the Frito-Lay Skylanders for Skylanders: Trap Team. On September 22, 2014, he was announced the winner of the Frito-Lay contest. He was part of his own giveaway before his public release in Spring 2015.
high-five.biography: High Five is one of the most skilled sky racers of all the dragonflies. But as the fifth son of the Royal High Flying Dragonflies, he was not allowed to enter any of the racing tournaments that took place each year because of his age. Instead, he was forced to watch from the sidelines as his four older brothers competed for the coveted Trophy of Sparx, which legend has said holds magical properties. One year, during the biggest racing event of the season, High Five learned that the Troll Racing Team had stolen the valuable trophy and were going to use the race to cover their escape. He quickly took action, jumping into the race and using his amazing flying skills to weave and dodge his way to the front of the pack, where he caught up to the trolls and brought them down. For his actions, High Five was given the Trophy of Sparx. Even more importantly, he was made a Skylander, where he now helps protect Skylands from any evildoers.
high-five.personality: High Five is full of energy and is super fast. When danger calls, he is the first to fly into battle.
high-five.gameplay: High Five can fire a stream of Poison Pellets from his mouth, even in rapid fire. These Poison Pellets can leave behind Poison Clouds that damages enemies when upgraded further. As his secondary attack, High Five can dash across the ground with his super speed and leave enemies spinning while damaging them. When further upgraded, High Five can perform a powerful Fly Slam attack that can be done in the air, and even suck enemies in while charging it. While charging up the attack damages him, he also releases apples during the charge, picking them up restores some of the HP lost. Despite having no flight upgrade in the game, High Five is able to fly, but only for a short while.

trivia: His catchphrase is shared by one of Bumble Blast's battle cries.
He and Rip Tide have the shortest Catchphrases out of any other Skylanders. High Five's catchphrase is the second shortest (having an extra letter), while Rip Tide's is the first.

Although the 'Speedy Slammer' path's 'Slam Apples' ability mentions that High Five releases apples that heal him while charging up 'Fly Slam', he actually releases these apples even without this upgrade as soon as he purchases the 'Buzzerker Overdrive' skill. 'Slam Apples' only increases the number of apples released.
Despite having no flight upgrade, High Five can fly for a short time by double tapping the jump button. This is also shared with Knight Light and Chopper, except they can stay in the air.
High Five and Thrillipede (after choosing the 'Mighty-Morphosis' path) are the only two Life Skylanders that can fly.

Eye Five's name is a play on High Five's. Coincidentally, they are both introduced in Trap Team. Despite this, neither have five fingers; Eye Five only has four fingers (counting his thumb) and High Five only has three on his hands and feet.
His battle cry 'Full steam ahead!' is similar to Sonic Boom's catchphrase 'Full Scream Ahead!'
Like Fist Bump, he is named after a friendly hand gesture.
When using a certain attack method, his health decreases slightly.

High Five is the second Skylander with an ability that can drain health, which is Fly Slam. The first Skylander was Ghost Roaster, who uses Ectoplasm Mode. Unlike Ghost Roaster, High Five cannot drain all of his health or get defeated while performing his ability. He heals himself by eating apples.
High Five is the second Life Element dragon Skylander, after Camo.

High Five's voice actor is Tom Kenny, who is best known for voicing the title character in SpongeBob SquarePants, the Ice King in Adventure Time, the Mayor from The Powerpuff Girls, Spyro the Dragon in Spyro 2: Ripto's Rage!, Spyro: Year of the Dragon, Spyro: Enter the Dragonfly and Spyro: Reignited Trilogy and Doctor Octopus in Ultimate Spider-Man. Tom Kenny also voices Stink Bomb, Shield Shredder, and Arbo.

high-noon-trigger-happy.name: High Noon Trigger Happy
high-noon-trigger-happy.description: High Noon Trigger Happy is a Tech element gremlin and a card counterpart of the well-known Skylander, Trigger Happy, specifically appearing in Skylanders: Battlecast. He is styled as a western gunslinger, complete with a large cowboy hat and his signature gold-flinging antics.
high-noon-trigger-happy.biography: High Noon Trigger Happy is a card counterpart of Trigger Happy in Skylanders: Battlecast. His name refers to a cliche in western stories where gun duels were fought around midday, when the sun was at its highest. His outfit is based on the one seen in the Micro Comic, Goldslinger. He is notably the only cereal exclusive Skylander whose evilized counterpart has a unique purple hue.
high-noon-trigger-happy.personality: High Noon Trigger Happy retains the manic, gold-obsessed personality of his standard counterpart, but with a theme centered around a western gunslinger. He is energetic and focused on his quick-draw gunplay.
high-noon-trigger-happy.gameplay: In Skylanders: Battlecast, High Noon Trigger Happy functions as a playable character card. He utilizes his 'Quick Draw' special ability to engage enemies in card-based combat. Unlike his standard appearance, this version focuses on his western-themed persona, emphasizing speed and his 'Quick Draw' attack.

abilities.name: Quick Draw
abilities.description: Quick Draw is the signature special ability card for High Noon Trigger Happy, allowing him to perform a rapid-fire attack.

trivia: High Noon Trigger Happy's name refers to a cliche in western stories where gun duels were fought around midday, when the sun was at its highest.

Its timing and the fact Battlecast has developers related to another Blizzard title, Hearthstone: Heroes of Warcraft, might also be a reference to the Overwatch character McCree, whose ultimate attack is preceeded by the catchphrase 'it's high noon'.
His outfit is the same one as the seen in Goldslinger, the second Micro Comic released for Skylanders: SuperChargers, though with a bigger hat and no shoes.
On the card, High Noon Trigger Happy has gloves and four fingers. Ingame, he has no gloves and only three fingers.

He's the only cereal exclusive Skylander whose evilized counterpart has a purple hue. The rest of the evilized cereal Skylanders (Sonic Boom, Prism Break and Obsidian Hot Head) are exactly the same as their regular counterparts.

high-volt.name: High Volt
high-volt.description: High Volt is a former security officer and one of the Tech SuperChargers in Skylanders: SuperChargers. His signature Vehicle is the Shield Striker.
high-volt.biography: High Volt was once the commander of a special security force that was in charge of patrolling the border between the known regions of Skylands and the mysterious uncharted region known as the Outlands. From atop the Shockspire Tower, their security headquarters, High Volt vigilantly monitored any strange activity beyond the border, knowing that Kaos and his minions were always up to no good. Over the years, he had defended Skylands against countless Greeble attacks, Troll uprisings, and even a few evil food chains that were attempting to expand. But on a recent patrol mission into the Outlands, High Volt discovered a heavily guarded construction site, where Kaos' minions appeared to be building a colossal Doom Station of Ultimate Destruction! Realizing at once that all of Skylands was in danger, he raced to the Skylanders Academy to inform Master Eon and joined the Skylanders in their fight to stop it!
high-volt.personality: High Volt is a very dedicated commander, even willing to take orders from Buzz. He is also extremely observant and intelligent, not letting any evil being out of his sight and will get any possible information out of them. Like all Tech Skylanders, High Volt is fascinated by machinery.
high-volt.gameplay: High Volt's primary attack is Static Spear, a close-range melee combo. His secondary ability, Shock-It Shield, allows him to block incoming attacks to build up energy, which can then be released as a shockwave. He can also throw his spear to create an electrical beam connecting him to the projectile, damaging any enemies caught in between.

trivia: It is unknown what High Volt looks like underneath his armor.

He resembles a S.W.A.T riot trooper as his Static Spear resembles a shock stick and his Shock-It Shield resembles a riot shield. This may be a reference to law enforcement as his backstory says that he has been protecting Skylands as a police officer would.
His catchphrase is played on by the phrase, 'to protect and serve,' which is often utilized by police officers.

He is voiced by Josh Duhamel, best known for playing William Lennox from the live action Transformers series and voicing Captain Flynn the sand pirate from Jake and the Neverland Pirates and Oz Harmounian from Fanboy & Chum Chum.
High Volt's Static Spear resembles a plug while his Shock-It Shield resembles an electrical outlet complementing his element.
Due to his origins as a Light Skylander early in development, he still has light-related puns in his upgrades' names.

hijinx.name: Hijinx
hijinx.description: Hijinx is the Mini version of the Undead Skylander, Hex in Skylanders: Trap Team.
hijinx.biography: The Skylander Minis started off as regular 'Sidekicks,' assisting the Skylanders on many exciting adventures. And what they lacked in size they more than made up for in courage. Ultimately determined to become full-fledged heroes, they trained at the Skylands Academy - honing their powers and skills until they were ready. Now, they stand side by side with their full grown counterparts, ready to defend Skylands against Kaos and his evil minions.
hijinx.personality: Hijinx has a reputation for being too serious and maybe a little creepy. But that's okay. She's too focused on her work to notice.
hijinx.gameplay: Hijinx is the Mini version of the Undead Skylander, Hex in Skylanders: Trap Team. Hijinx features a kit identical to Hex, focusing on conjuring phantom orbs and raining skulls upon her enemies.

trivia: Hijinx is the mini counterpart of Hex.
She was first released in Skylanders: Trap Team.
Her English voice actress is Courtenay Taylor.
Hijinx has a reputation for being too serious and maybe a little creepy.
The Skylander Minis were originally regular 'Sidekicks' before training at the Skylands Academy.

holiday-wash-buckler.name: Holiday Wash Buckler
holiday-wash-buckler.description: Holiday Wash Buckler is a Christmas counterpart of Wash Buckler in Skylanders: Lost Islands.
holiday-wash-buckler.biography: Holiday Wash Buckler is a Christmas counterpart of Wash Buckler in Skylanders: Lost Islands. On December 2013 you would need to play Skylanders: Battlegrounds in order to get him.
holiday-wash-buckler.catchphrase: Here to spread the cheer is Holiday Wash Buckler!
holiday-wash-buckler.gameplay: Holiday Wash Buckler is an Alter Ego who appears in Skylanders: Lost Islands. To obtain him in December 2013, players were required to play Skylanders: Battlegrounds. As an Alter Ego, he features a unique holiday-themed appearance and specialized animations, such as his idle and poke animation.
trivia: He, Admiral Thumpback and Frosted Food Fight are the only Lost Islands Exclusive Skylanders who are not Grand Prizes of the Wishing Well.
However, Holiday Wash Buckler could be earned from the Wishing Well for a limited time when past Alter Egos returned.
Holiday Wash Buckler, Lucky Boomer, Hoppity Pop Fizz and Admiral Thumpback are the only Lost Islands exclusive Skylanders of 2013 without a specific house of their own.

hood-sickle.name: Hood Sickle
hood-sickle.description: Hood Sickle is a reaper who was originally one of the trappable Undead villains in Skylanders: Trap Team. In Skylanders: SuperChargers, he is an NPC racer, driving a Sky vehicle fashioned with skulls and ominous appendages. In Skylanders: Imaginators, Hood Sickle is a Dark-elemental Sensei who teaches Imaginators of the Sentinel Battle Class, changing slightly in appearance.
hood-sickle.biography: At first glance, it's easy to be frightened by Hood Sickle. Some say it's his imposing stature that freaks them out. Others are unnerved by his menacing hood. But most just try to stay away from his long, sharp scythe - and it didn't help that he had a bad habit of disappearing and then suddenly popping up behind unsuspecting people. In fact, the Trap Masters that locked him away in Cloudcracker Prison hoped they would never have to see him again. But Master Eon thought there might be a chance for Hood Sickle to change his ways. Everyone said Eon was crazy, but after spending time with the mysterious creep, Eon learned that Hood Sickle was actually not a bad guy - just really super spooky. Hood Sickle took his job of terrifying others very seriously, and Eon believed that perhaps he could bring a similar dedication to teaching others as a Sensei. Plus, he figured that Skylanders in training would certainly pay attention in his classes.
hood-sickle.personality: Hood Sickle takes his job of terrifying others very seriously. Though super spooky and imposing, he is not actually a bad guy. He is dedicated to teaching others and ensures his students in training pay attention in his classes - or else.
hood-sickle.gameplay: As a playable villain, Hood Sickle can strike with his spectral energy scythe, but this leaves him immobile with a lengthy delay. He can also teleport ahead a short distance, summoning black ghosts in his wake. If he has active ghosts, they will explode whenever he swings his scythe, doing more damage than attacking normally. In Skylanders: Imaginators, Hood Sickle can strike with his duel war scythe and teleport ahead, summoning Dark Remnant in his wake. If he has active Dark Remnant, they will explode whenever he swings his scythe, doing more damage than attacking normally, and his attack speed will increase. He can also create gravity wells to slow down enemies, or acts like a turret with his soul gem.

abilities.description: Now drop up to 6 remnants, which grant another combo spin, more speed, more damage, and projectile deflection for the duration of Dark Scythe Combo.

abilities.name: Dark Stinger
abilities.description: The last spin in Dark Scythe Combo now causes a powerful shockwave.

abilities.name: Longer and Stronger
abilities.description: Gravity well does more damage and lasts longer.

abilities.name: Warp Pulse
abilities.description: Hit the gravity well with your war scythe for a shower of war scythes! So exfoliating!

abilities.name: Explosive Dash
abilities.description: Detonate the gravity well by attacking it with Dark Dislocation to trigger a large explosion of dark energy.

trivia: Both Hood Sickle and Grim Creeper are based on the Grim Reaper.
Despite his name, Hood Sickle actually carries a scythe in both of his iterations.
Hood Sickle was first mentioned in a MEGA! UK magazine before the character poster was revealed.
There's a glitch that allows Hood Sickle to teleport through certain Traptanium Gates.
He and Kaos are the only Villains with Quests at the Skylanders Academy.
He has red eyes in his artwork, but white eyes in game. In Imaginators, they are light yellow in the figure.
He, Cuckoo Clocker and Grave Clobber are the only villains to be summoned by another villain.
Hood Sickle is one of the first characters to change elements between games permanently along with Tae Kwon Crow and Grave Clobber.
Grave Clobber, Bad Juju and Hood Sickle are the first Undead creatures to belong to a different element.
He is the only male Sensei of the Sentinel class.
His catchphrase ends with a question mark, a trait shared only with Tae Kwon Crow, Ninjini and Déjà Vu.
Hood Sickle wondering whether Persephone would consider dating him is a reference to the Greek myth of Hades and Persephone.

hoot-loop.name: Hoot Loop
hoot-loop.description: Hoot Loop is an owl magician who is one of the SWAP Force Skylanders in Skylanders: Swap Force. He is of the Magic element. His Swap Force Ability is Teleport.
hoot-loop.biography: Hoot Loop was raised by a guild of magicians in Skylands' most famous traveling circus. At a young age, he perfected illusions and spells that only the very best of their guild could perform, and even mastered the art of teleportation! Soon enough, he became the star of the show, known far and wide as the Amazing Hoot Loop. However, one day an army of Greebles disguised as clowns invaded, determined to destroy the popular circus. It was then that Hoot Loop gave a performance that few would ever forget. Using his incredible powers, he fought off the invaders and saved the circus - to the raucous applause of the many spectators – including Master Eon, who presented Hoot Loop with an opportunity to learn some real magic as a member of the Skylanders.
hoot-loop.personality: Hoot Loop is a natural showman, and is less likely to be modest. He is the first to boast about his extraordinary abilities. He can also be mischievous, as demonstrated in the animated Card Game Short Cut.
hoot-loop.gameplay: Hoot Loop's primary gameplay revolves around shooting magical DéjàBOOM! projectiles and using his hypnotism to slow down enemies. His bottom half provides teleportation mobility, allowing him to warp across the battlefield and damage enemies near his entry or exit points. As a SWAP Force character, he can combine his magical top-half attacks with the movement or combat capabilities of other SWAP Force members.

abilities.name: DéjàBOOM!
abilities.description: Press Attack 1 to shoot a magic projectile that hits enemies three times before it disappears.

abilities.name: Hypnotism

abilities.name: Loop the Loop

abilities.description: Hold Attack 2 to aim the portal loop, release to teleport to that area and damage all nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Temporal Whack
abilities.description: Teleport does increased damage.

abilities.name: Time Sink
abilities.description: Enemies and objects are pulled towards the area where Portable Hole is aimed.

abilities.name: Wand of Dreams
abilities.description: Press Attack 1 to shoot a DéjàBOOM! and two smaller DéjàBOOM! projectiles at once.

abilities.name: Infinite Loop
abilities.description: Hold Attack 2 to aim the portal loop, release it under Loop's body to cause a massive attack that damages enemies in a larger area.

abilities.name: Dream Beam
abilities.description: Hold Attack 1 to channel a magical beam of dreams that damages enemies.

abilities.name: Bad Dreams Beam
abilities.description: Dream Beam does increased damage.

abilities.name: Mass Hypnosis
abilities.description: Hypnotism becomes more effective, slowing enemies in a larger area.

abilities.name: Deep Asleep
abilities.description: Hold Attack 3 to use a more powerful Mass Hypnosis dealing increased damage.

abilities.name: Now You See Me
abilities.description: Hold Attack 2 to charge a Portable Hole, release to do increased damage. Damage is increased the longer it is charged.

abilities.name: Now You Don't
abilities.description: Now You See Me does increased damage. A very impressive entrance!

abilities.name: Complete Concentration
abilities.description: Press Jump after teleporting to appear back at the previous position.

abilities.name: Teleport Turbulence
abilities.description: All teleport attacks do increased damage.

trivia: On some of his toy packages in Wave 1, Free Ranger's catchphrase 'Whip Up A Storm' is mistakenly on the package instead of Hoot Loop's catchphrase. 'Let's Ruffle Some Feathers!'
Sometimes Hoot Loop blinks one eye and then the other instead of blinking both at the same time.
His name could be a play on words with the cereal, 'Froot Loops'.
Hoot Loop is the shortest SWAP Force Skylander, with very short legs and a petite torso.
He is voiced by Robin Atkin Downes, who also voices Blades and Medic from Team Fortress 2.
He shares a few of his battle cries with Jet-Vac. Coincidentally they are both bird Skylanders.
The name of his primary attack, 'DéjàBOOM,' is a play on the French term 'Déjà Vu,' which means 'already seen' and is the name of a Magic Core Skylander from Skylanders: Trap Team.
In Trap Team, certain trinkets will not work with him.
While in hypnotic mode, a slightly faint owl hoot can be heard in the background. It is unknown if he is actually making this noise himself, as he can sometimes be heard laughing over it.
He also bears a slight resemblance to Ezylryb from the Guardians of Ga'Hoole series.
He and Star Strike are the only two Skylanders to have 'Enchanted' counterparts.
In Skylanders: Imaginators, Hoot Loop's character icon image is shown as Enchanted Hoot Loop's.
In Skylanders Academy, Hex wrote an essay on him, although Jet Vac thought it was about himself until she told him.

hoppity-pop-fizz.name: Hoppity Pop Fizz
hoppity-pop-fizz.description: Hoppity Pop Fizz is the Easter counterpart of Pop Fizz who was available only in the months of April 2013 and 2014 on Skylanders: Lost Islands.
hoppity-pop-fizz.biography: Hoppity Pop Fizz is the Easter counterpart of Pop Fizz who was available only in the months of April 2013 and 2014 on Skylanders: Lost Islands.
hoppity-pop-fizz.catchphrase: Hoppity Pop Fizz has come to the Skylands with spring in his steps!
hoppity-pop-fizz.personality: Hoppity Pop Fizz is described as having spring in his steps, suggesting a cheerful and seasonal disposition.
hoppity-pop-fizz.gameplay: As an Alter Ego in Skylanders: Lost Islands, Hoppity Pop Fizz does not have traditional attacks but was available as a seasonal Skylander who could be found spreading the joy of Easter to Skylands.
trivia: Hoppity Pop Fizz, Lucky Boomer, Admiral Thumpback and Holiday Wash Buckler are the only Lost Islands exclusive Skylanders of 2013 without a specific house of their own.
Hoppity Pop Fizz is the first Easter themed variant.

hot-dog.name: Hot Dog
hot-dog.description: Hot Dog is a young Fire dog who is one of the Core Skylanders in Skylanders: Giants. He has a yellow counterpart called Molten Hot Dog that is exclusive to Walmart. His Series 2 counterpart is called Fire Bone Hot Dog. He was originally one of the three starter Skylanders in Skylanders: Ring of Heroes prior to its reboot. He is available in the Scorpion Striker battle pack.
hot-dog.biography: Hot Dog was born in the belly of the Popcorn Volcano. While on a nearby mission, a team of Skylanders had come across the stray fire pup when the volcano erupted and Hot Dog came rocketing straight into their camp, accidentally setting Gill Grunt's tent on fire. Using his nose of danger, he helped the Skylanders complete their mission - even pouncing on a Lava Golem like a blazing comet when it threatened his new friends. After displaying such loyalty and bravery, Hot Dog was brought back to Eon's Citadel where he became a Skylander - and then he proceeded to bury Eon's staff.
hot-dog.personality: Hot Dog possesses a fierce loyalty to his friends, and true to his nature, he likes to bury things, especially imps. He is always bounding around like an excitable puppy - which is exactly what he is. Not the kind of Skylander to go hungry, he is always on the lookout for a sizzling snack.
hot-dog.gameplay: Hot Dog's main attack is Firebark, which has him shooting fireballs from his mouth and tail, and he has a primary combo where he shoots three fireballs at once. He can summon a wall of fire that travels straight forward to push and damage enemies; it can also be used as a shield for incoming enemies. His third attack, the Comet Slam, flips him in the air spinning and then slamming down upon enemies for massive damage. By choosing the Burning Bow-Wow path, Hot Dog's fireball attacks are further developed with access to Burnin' Bees and Comet Dash. By choosing the Pyro Pooch path, his Wall of Fire can be upgraded into a 'Magmutt Battalion'. Despite his powerful attacks, Hot Dog has very low health and armor stats, making him a glass cannon on the battlefield.

abilities.name: Firebark

abilities.name: Wall of Fire
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 to summon a wall of fire, which can be pushed towards enemies.

abilities.name: Pyro Piercers
abilities.description: Fireballs pierce multiple enemies and do increased damage.

abilities.name: Comet Slam
abilities.description: Press Attack 3 to flip into the air and slam down on the ground like a comet.

abilities.name: Wall of MORE Fire
abilities.description: Walls of Fire do increased damage.

abilities.name: Super Comet
abilities.description: Hold Attack 3 to charge up the Comet Slam and release to do increased damage.

abilities.name: Ding Dong Ditch
abilities.description: After a Comet Slam, leave a burning bag that explodes when stepped on.

abilities.name: Bees! Bees! Bees!
abilities.description: Hold Attack 1 then release to fire a super powerful blast of bees.

abilities.name: Hot Dog Combos

abilities.name: Bark Bombs
abilities.description: Fireballs explode on impact and do increased damage.

abilities.name: Pyro Pinwheel

abilities.name: Blazing Wildfire
abilities.description: Walls of Fire travels faster and do even more increased damage.

abilities.name: Great Walls of Fire
abilities.description: Walls of Fire are bigger and do even more increased damage.

abilities.name: Magmutt Battalion
abilities.description: Walls are now made up of fiery dogs that do maximum damage and shoot fireballs.

trivia: Hot Dog is the first Skylander to have his name based on a kind of food, followed by Thumpling, Pop Thorn, Rocky Roll, Jawbreaker and Tri-Tip.
In early development of Skylanders: Giants, Hot Dog was named Comet.
During Giants's alpha development, some of Hot Dog's abilities/upgrades were differently named: his primary attack was called 'Fire Feet' and 'Hot Dog Combos' was called 'Canine Combos'.
He and Hot Head are the only Fire Skylanders with the word 'hot' in their names.
He has an incredible sense of smell. His highly sensitive nostrils can sniff out trouble from miles away.

In Giants, the Bone Hat is placed in Hot Dog's mouth instead of on his head. In Swap Force, it was changed to being placed on his head. This is because his Series 2 Wow Pow, Bees! Bees! Bees!, adds a fiery bone in his mouth.
He, Ignitor, Fryno, Fire Kraken, and Eruptor all have 'burn' in their catchphrases.
Although it's not a melee attack, he can perform combos with his Firebark, making him the only Skylander with this ability.
He, Swarm and Bumble Blast have bee-related moves. Hot Dog is the only one of those characters who is not bee-themed himself.

Hot Dog's bee attacks are a direct reference to a joke from The Simpsons Season 5 episode 'Burns Heir' where Homer Simpson comments if he's going to release dogs with bees in their mouths, that when they bark, they would shoot bees at you.
Hot Dog is one of the few playable canines in Skylanders.
Carlos Alazraqui was the first voice actor for Spyro in Spyro the Dragon in 1998. Alazraqui also voices Duff and Fiesta. In the 'Still Friends' commercial, he was voiced by Tom Kenny.
Hot Dog is noticeably similar to Eruptor: Both are lava-based creatures, both their Soul Gems upgrade their third attacks, and both have the word 'burn' in their catchphrases.
The fire dog makes a cameo in the Fortune Telling card in Skylanders: Battlecast, possibly representing the dog in The Fool Tarot Arcana.
He, Fright Rider and Sprocket are the only three Giants-debut core Skylanders without any LightCore counterparts.
His Pyro Pinwheel upgrade is misspelt as 'Pyro Pinwheel' with a double space in the Alchemy front-end games.
His combo attack 'Comet Dash' shares its name with an upgrade for Spyro.
His Catchphrase, 'See Spot Burn' may be a reference to the pun or the 2001 movie, 'See Spot Run'.

hot-head.name: Hot Head
hot-head.description: Hot Head is a Large Fire Golem who is one of the eight Giants in Skylanders: Giants.
hot-head.biography: Hot Head had always been a short tempered fire giant. But it was when magical oil was discovered in Skylands that fuel was really added to the fire. As exciting as the discovery was, the celebration lasted only 5 minutes - coming to an abrupt halt when Hot Head needed to cool off and plunged into the thick black pool, causing the entire island to explode! Though it would be another 2,000 years before magical oil was discovered again, the impact that it had on Hot Head was immediate. He was instantly infused with magical oil, giving him the ability to generate an infinite supply of fuel - making him incredibly volatile, highly combustible, and ready to torch anything that got in his way.
hot-head.personality: Impetuous is a good word to describe Hot Head. He just can't help himself. This giant Fire Golem is always burning with enthusiasm. He smothers his enemies in blazing blobs of burning oil first, and asks questions second.
hot-head.gameplay: Hot Head is a giant molten fire golem, who can fire both flames and blobs of oil from his hands. He can also summon rain-like drops of fire from the sky. Hot Head can even transform into a hot rod to run over enemies. In Time Twisters it was shown that Hot Head is very durable, as he was shot by Tech Geargolems, the projectiles deflected off his body, and merely tickled Hot Head. In Skylanders: Battlecast, he has the ability to summon a Mood Ring Gear that increases his damage the more he is attacked, and, as well as having high health to shrug off attacks, many of his spells have conditions for him being attacked in the enemy turn. Hot Head's Special Ability is Boiling Over, which increases his power and is more effective if he was attacked in that turn. His scrapped signature relic is the Fury's Forge, which increases his allies' power by damaging them slightly.

abilities.description: Press Attack 1 to shoot a burst of fire. Hold Attack 1 to keep flames going.

abilities.name: Oil Blobs

abilities.name: Premium Grade
abilities.description: Oil Blobs and ignited Oil Blobs do increased damage.

abilities.name: Sizzle Shower

abilities.name: Turn Up The Heat!
abilities.description: Flamefire burst gets even hotter and does increased damage.

abilities.name: Extended Forecast
abilities.description: Sizzle Shower lasts longer and does increased damage.

abilities.name: Hot Rod
abilities.description: Hold Attack 1 and Attack 2 to transform into a hot rod!

abilities.name: Eternal Flame
abilities.description: Can use Flamefire continuously and does maximum damage.

abilities.name: Hot Oil Treatment
abilities.description: Oil Blobs and ignited Oil Blobs do maximum damage.

abilities.name: Fossil Fuel
abilities.description: Oil Blobs turn into fossilized monsters who attack enemies.

abilities.name: Fire Storm
abilities.description: Sizzle Shower does maximum damage and covers a larger area.

abilities.name: Oil And Fire
abilities.description: During a Sizzle Shower, press Attack 2 to create an oily explosion, catching enemies on fire.

abilities.name: Hot With A Chance of Meteors
abilities.description: Hold Attack 3 to summon a gigantic meteor from the sky.

trivia: Some of Hot Head's prototype names include Fire Giant, Fire Golem and Oil Blazer.
In early development, Hot Head's shoulders were red and his claws were yellow. He also had grey screws in the sides of his head, reminiscent of Frankenstein's monster.
He is the only playable Golem who is not of the Earth element.
One of his upgrades, 'Hot with a Chance of Meteors', is a reference to the 2009 animated film 'Cloudy with a Chance of Meatballs'.

During Giants' early development, some of Hot Head's abilities/upgrades were differently named. 'Flamefire Burst' was called 'Flameball Burst', 'Oil Blobs' was called 'Oil Drum', and 'Sizzle Shower' was called 'Fire Rain'.
Hot Head has the Fire Symbol on his back.
He and Hot Dog are the only Fire Skylanders (at the same time) with the word Hot in their names.
In the Time Twisters Story Activity Book, Hot Head revealed he is almost 200,000 years old and three quarters. However, he does not believe he looks a day over 150,000.

Hot Head has an Easter Egg where if you hold his 'Eternal Flame' attack long enough in Skylanders: Trap Team, he'll start monologuing. This monologue originally referenced a very obscure part of Ninja Turtle history.
It is rumored that his original catchphrase was, 'Aaaargh, help! Someone find a hose, quick!'
He slightly resembles Fire Man from the first game in the Mega Man video game series and Oil Man from Mega Man Powered Up.
There is a glitch where when in hot rod form, when attacked, Hot Head will revert to his natural state while still moving around at a greater speed.
Hot Head is often mentioned as a cook.
Hot Head is the only character who changes pitches in his voice from time to time on the portal.
On his figure, his facial expression is similar to the facial expression on Series 2 Eruptor's figure.
He and Fryno are the only two fire characters who have motorbike based upgrades.

In the game, Hot Head is voiced by Patrick Seitz, who also voices Rip Tide, Chomp Chest, and Thrillipede, as well as Scorpion in Mortal Kombat, Zomom in Sonic Lost World, Ragna the Bloodedge in BlazBlue, and Endeavor in My Hero Academia.
His Sizzle Shower may be based on Adele's song, 'Set Fire to the Rain'.

hurricane-jet-vac.name: Hurricane Jet-Vac
hurricane-jet-vac.description: Hurricane Jet-Vac is the SuperCharger counterpart of Jet-Vac in Skylanders: SuperChargers. His signature vehicle is the Jet Stream.
hurricane-jet-vac.biography: Hurricane Jet-Vac is the SuperCharger counterpart of Jet-Vac in Skylanders: SuperChargers. A noble Sky Baron from Windham, he serves as a dedicated hero who uses his high-tech vacuum gun and fan blades to protect Skylands. His signature vehicle is the Jet Stream, and he remains a firm believer that a true hero flies with his heart, not his wings.
hurricane-jet-vac.personality: Jet-Vac is a disciplined and dedicated hero with a formal, military-like demeanor, often using phrases like 'old chum' and 'old chap'. He values training and believes that true heroism comes from the heart rather than physical abilities. He remains humble about his skills and is always eager to defend the defenseless.
hurricane-jet-vac.gameplay: Hurricane Jet-Vac uses fan blades and a vacuum to control the battlefield. He can shoot bouncing blades, suck in enemies to use as projectiles, and dash forward with powerful kicks. His upgrades allow him to create explosive hurricanes and perform advanced aerial maneuvers like the Double Flip.

abilities.name: Shooting the Breeze
abilities.description: Press Attack 1 to shoot a fan blade that can bounce off multiple enemies.

abilities.name: Jet Turbine Vacuum

abilities.name: Having a Blast!

abilities.name: Category Pain
