abilities.name: Hurricano
abilities.description: Hold Attack 1 and release to create a Hurricane. Hurricanes now explode once it is over and damages enemies inside and around the hurricane.

abilities.name: Splitting Air
abilities.description: Press Attack 1 to shoot a bouncing blade while holding an enemy.

abilities.name: Turbulent Turbine
abilities.description: Press Attack 3 to dash forward. Enemies behind you when the dash is started take more damage.

abilities.name: Talon Take Off
abilities.description: Enemies hit at the end of a Somer-Assault are knocked back further and take more damage.

abilities.name: Double Flip
abilities.description: Press Attack 3 twice to give Somer-Assault another boost to travel further. Press Attack 3 after performing the Double Flip to perform another on the same enemy.

trivia: Hurricane Jet-Vac is the only re-imagined Skylander that doesn't have two names starting with the same letter as his SuperCharger counterpart name. In fact, he is the only one that doesn't have two names for his SuperCharger counterpart.
Early concepts of Hurricane Jet-Vac depict him with a number of scrapped accessories, such as a pirate hat, sailor's hat, goggles, and a feathery shawl reminiscent of Stormblade's.

ignitor.name: Ignitor
ignitor.description: Ignitor has the ability to temporarily leave his cursed suit of armor to singe nearby enemies with his flaming spirit form as well as creating an explosion when exiting the armor, although his armor cannot move and it is left vulnerable for enemies to attack. He also wields a flaming sword to slice and sear his enemies, and slam it onto the ground for massive damage.
ignitor.biography: On his first quest as a knight, Ignitor was tricked by a cunning witch into wearing a magical suit of armor that he was told would resist fire from a dragon. But as it turned out, it was made of cursed steel. He journeyed to a dragon's lair where a single blast of fire transformed him into a blazing spirit, binding him to the suit of armor for eternity. Despite this setback, Ignitor remains a spirited knight who is always fired up to protect Skylands from evil... and find the witch that tricked him.
ignitor.personality: Gallant and trustworthy, Ignatius changed his name to Ignitor and remains true to his pledge to use his powers to protect the innocent. Since his encounter with the witch that gave him the cursed armor, he holds a dislike for witches.
ignitor.gameplay: Ignitor has the ability to temporarily leave his cursed suit of armor to singe nearby enemies with his flaming spirit form as well as creating an explosion when exiting the armor, although his armor cannot move and it is left vulnerable for enemies to attack. He also wields a flaming sword to slice and sear his enemies, and slam it onto the ground for massive damage. His attacks are very strong, but he and Sprocket are tied for having very low Health, the lowest in the game next to Boomer and Trigger Happy; which means he won't take long to get defeated.

abilities.name: Flame Blade
abilities.description: Swing your sword.

abilities.name: Flame Form Mortar
abilities.description: Launch your flame spirit in an arc at your foes.

abilities.name: Scorching Blade
abilities.description: Sword attack does increased damage.

abilities.name: Flame Form
abilities.description: Control your flame form after launching it.

abilities.name: Mega Slam
abilities.description: Perform a massive area slam.

abilities.name: Fire and Brimstone
abilities.description: Flame Form Mortar does increased damage to a larger area.

abilities.name: Fire Forged Armor
abilities.description: New Armor makes Ignitor harder to hit. Grants +40 armor.

abilities.name: Blue Flame
abilities.description: After executing Flame Form or Mega Slam attacks, Ignitor leaves a trail of blue fire. In the 3DS version, press X and his Fire Spirit will leave a trail of fire as it attacks enemies.

abilities.name: Dances with Fire
abilities.description: Flame Form moves faster and does increased damage.

abilities.name: Incinerate
abilities.description: While in Flame Form, trigger a massive explosion.

abilities.name: Fire Form Salvo
abilities.description: Fire two addition Flame Form Mortars that do extra damage.

abilities.name: Order of the Burning Blade
abilities.description: Press Attack 1 twice then hold Attack 2 for Fire Burst, Attack 1 twice then attack 3 for Mega Slam.

abilities.name: Double Mega Slam
abilities.description: Hold the Mega Slam attack long enough to do increased damage.

abilities.name: Inferno Blade
abilities.description: Sword gets larger and does even more increased damage.

trivia: Ignitor was called Ignatius before he was cursed.
It is unknown what species Ignitor was before he was turned into a fire spirit.
On the Wii version of Giants, there is a glitch where Ignitor's Flame Form Mortar goes extremely high into the air sometimes. This normally happens when you are under a ledge.
His catchphrase is a play on 'Crash and Burn', which is also Fryno's official catchphrase.
His catchphrase 'Slash and Burn' is also a technique that involves the cutting and burning of plants in forests or woodlands to create fields.

Ignitor is voiced by Dwight Schultz, who did additional voices in Spyro's Adventure, and is also known for his role of Howling Mad Murdock from the A-Team TV series as well as voicing the character, Mung Daal in the animated television series, Chowder, and villain Aloysius Animo in the animated television series, Ben 10.
In Spyro's Adventure, Ignitor is the only Fire Skylander who does not have an evil counterpart in boss battles.

According to the Book of Elements: Fire and Water; Ignitor asked his fellow Skylanders for help removing the cursed armor. Nevertheless, their methods had no effect on the armor; and he stopped trying once his mother complimented him all the same during a visit.
Ignitor is the only starter pack Skylander who did not return in Skylanders: Swap Force, along with Tree Rex.
Additionally, he is the only Skylander from the starter packs of Spyro's Adventure and Giants, without a sidekick or mini, along with Cynder.
He bears multiple similarities to Krypt King: Both wear armor, both have swords as their primary weapons, both were knights in their past lives.
The line 'Sword and scorchery' is a play on the popular fantasy media subgenre, 'sword and sorcery'
Ignitor is the only Fire Skylander with a Legendary counterpart.
He is the only Skylander whose name starts with an 'I'.
His true fire form and ability to move out of his suit are similar to the NRG transformation from the Ben 10 series.

His 'mouthpiece' appears blue in the first two games, all 3DS games and in his Series 2 toy and artwork. Whereas in Swap Force onwards, SuperChargers Racing and his Series 1 toy and artwork shows his 'mouthpiece' to be fully silver colored.

imaginators.name: Imaginators
imaginators.description: Imaginators are Skylander creations customized by Portal Masters in Skylanders: Imaginators. In the game, players can create and edit their own Imaginator at any time and add their own features using elemental Creation Crystals and the Imaginite parts that are found throughout the game. These customization options range from aesthetic changes like appearance, colors and size; effects like aura, music, sounds and voice; and their combat abilities, from stat-changing gear to powers depending on their element and battle class.
imaginators.biography: Imaginators can also be generated in the Skylanders Creator, which allows the player to order physical items based on them. With the exception of T-Shirts, the items are explained as the Imaginator being enrolled in Skylanders Academy for further training and drawn in The Book of Skylanders.
imaginators.catchphrase: You Create It, You Play It!
imaginators.personality: The personality of an Imaginator is defined by the Portal Master, who can choose from various voice options such as Hero, Wacky, or Scientist, as well as distinct music and sound effects to suit the character's theme. Voices are provided by notable actors including Crispin Freeman, Laura Bailey, and Fred Tatasciore.
imaginators.gameplay: Each Imaginator has a weapon power, an elemental power, a secret technique, and a Soul Gem ability. Customization options range from aesthetic changes like appearance, colors and size; effects like aura, music, sounds and voice; and their combat abilities, from stat-changing gear to powers depending on their element and battle class. Unlike Skylanders of other types, the Imaginators are capable of reaching up to level higher than 20 based on the amount of Senseis one has in their collection.

abilities.name: Weapon Power
abilities.description: A combat power determined by the Imaginator's chosen Battle Class. Each Battle Class has its own specific weapon power that defines their primary fighting style.

abilities.name: Elemental Power
abilities.description: A combat power determined by the Imaginator's chosen Element. These powers allow the player to harness the natural forces of their Creation Crystal.

abilities.name: Soul Gem Ability
abilities.description: A special and powerful ability unique to the character's customization, unlocked through training in the game.

abilities.name: Secret Technique
abilities.description: A high-tier technique specialized for the character's battle class, providing advanced combat options.

trivia: The default color schemes for Imaginators that aren't elemental or single color palettes are named after the levels in Skylanders: Spyro's Adventure and several popular Skylanders.
The Heroine voice option is Laura Bailey who voiced Persephone and Ninjini.
The Ghoul voice option is John Kassir, known for voicing the Cryptkeeper and Skylanders like Ghost Roaster.
The default Imaginator used in most of the promotional material is a Fire Knight called Sir Hoodington.
Imaginators are the only type of Skylander who can change hats in the Imaginators game.
The Burrbearian Imaginator part set was based on a character created by a Skylanders fan named Joshua B as part of the 'Fan-Art-to-Life' contest.
If a player were to collect all 31 Senseis, 13 Alt Deco Senseis, and the 5 known Sensei Chase Variants, the Imaginator level cap would be 64.
The theme that plays for Swashbuckler Imaginators is the theme for the Chompy Worm battles, Desert Chase, from the APM Music album THE PROMO PACK 4 - MOVIES.

instant-dive-clops.name: Instant Dive-Clops
appearances: Skylanders: SuperChargers (iOS) (in the game files of the console versions)
instant-dive-clops.description: Instant Dive-Clops was a digital counterpart of Dive-Clops in Skylanders: SuperChargers. He is only playable in the iOS version of the game.
instant-dive-clops.biography: Instant Dive-Clops was a digital counterpart of Dive-Clops in Skylanders: SuperChargers. He is only playable in the iOS version of the game. He is the twin brother of the Giant, Eye-Brawl.
instant-dive-clops.personality: As a digital counterpart of Dive-Clops, Instant Dive-Clops shares his brother's dedication to protecting Skylands from beneath the waves, characterized by his focused and observant nature.
instant-dive-clops.gameplay: Instant Dive-Clops utilizes water-based weaponry and sonar technology. His primary attacks include launching Waterpedoes and utilizing Sonar to find his mark. He can also create geysers and slow his enemies with specialized torpedoes.

abilities.name: Waterpedo
abilities.description: Instant Dive-Clops fires a high-pressure Waterpedo at his enemies.

abilities.name: Sonar
abilities.description: Instant Dive-Clops uses Sonar to track and target enemies underwater.

abilities.name: Put the Eye in Geyser
abilities.description: Enhanced geyser-based attack for more battlefield control by putting the eye in geyser.

abilities.name: Torpeslow
abilities.description: Slows down enemies hit by specialized torpedoes.

abilities.name: Sonar Smarts
abilities.description: Advanced sonar capabilities for maximum strategic advantage.

trivia: He is the only SuperCharger and Instant Skylander whose original counterpart isn't from the Starter Pack.
He is also the only Instant Skylander who does not have a Dark variant.
He is the twin brother of Eye-Brawl.

instant-food-fight.name: Instant Food Fight
instant-food-fight.description: Instant Food Fight was a digital version of Food Fight who was exclusive to the Tablet Starter Pack of Skylanders: Trap Team.
instant-food-fight.biography: Instant Food Fight was a digital version of Food Fight who was exclusive to the Tablet Starter Pack of Skylanders: Trap Team. Voiced by Billy West, he was provided as a digital-only character to allow players immediate access to gameplay without needing to place a physical figure on a portal, which was ideal for the mobile nature of tablet gaming.
instant-food-fight.personality: Determined and pugnacious, Instant Food Fight shares the personality of the original Food Fight, using his produce-based weaponry with zeal and energy.
instant-food-fight.gameplay: Instant Food Fight plays identically to the standard Food Fight, utilizing a tomato launcher and artichoke-based traps to control the battlefield.

abilities.name: Tomato Launcher
abilities.description: Shoot high-velocity tomatoes at enemies from a handheld launcher.

abilities.name: Blooms of Doom
abilities.description: Place artichoke traps that burst when enemies get close.

abilities.name: Extra-Ripe Tomatoes
abilities.description: Tomatoes deal more damage upon impact.

abilities.name: Special Squash
abilities.description: A devastating squash attack that clears the surrounding area.

abilities.name: Heavy Harvest
abilities.description: Increased fire rate for the tomato launcher.

trivia: Loading Instant Food Fight on the console versions of Skylanders: Trap Team will hang on the element indefinitely. If he was to load, he would be named 'Virtual Food Fight' instead, the internal name for instant variants.
In both Skylanders: SuperChargers and Skylanders: Imaginators he scans in as 'Food Fight Special' and can be added to the collection as a separate Skylander.

instant-skylanders.name: Instant Skylanders
instant-skylanders.description: Instant Skylanders are digital-only Skylanders which are mainly available in the iOS and Tablet versions of Skylanders: Trap Team and Skylanders: SuperChargers. However, Instant Spitfire, Instant Super Shot Stealth Elf and Instant Dive-Clops are playable on the console versions of SuperChargers, using older models of the Portal of Power; all others simply display in their normal skins as 'Special' versions.
instant-skylanders.biography: Instant Skylanders were designed to make the Skylanders experience accessible on mobile platforms without requiring a physical Portal of Power and toys immediately. These digital versions allow players to dive straight into the game and were often provided for free in the digital starter packs of the mobile editions.
instant-skylanders.personality: As digital counterparts, these characters share the same heroic personalities and backstories as their physical toy versions.
instant-skylanders.gameplay: They play identically to their physical counterparts but are accessed through a digital menu rather than being placed on a physical Portal of Power. In the console version of SuperChargers, they serve as a fallback when no physical figure is detected.
trivia: Fire is the only element to have one instant Skylander. The other two elements (Water and Life) each have two instant Skylanders.
Instant Dive Clops is the only instant Skylander whose main counterpart is not from a starter pack.

instant-snap-shot.name: Instant Snap Shot
instant-snap-shot.description: Instant Snap Shot is the grey, digital version of Snap Shot who was exclusive to the Tablet Starter Pack of Skylanders: Trap Team.
instant-snap-shot.biography: Instant Snap Shot is the grey, digital version of Snap Shot who was exclusive to the Tablet Starter Pack of Skylanders: Trap Team. He was designed to allow players to play the game on tablets without needing to have the physical figure immediately present.
instant-snap-shot.personality: As the leader of the Trap Masters, he is a stoic and focused hunter. Like the original Snap Shot, he is dedicated to protecting Skylands and capturing the escaped villains of Cloudcracker Prison.
instant-snap-shot.gameplay: Instant Snap Shot plays identically to the standard Snap Shot, utilizing his Traptanium bow for ranged attacks and a sword for melee strikes. As a Trap Master, he can shatter Traptanium crystals and deals extra damage to trappable villains.

abilities.name: Traptanium Arrows
abilities.description: Fire arrows made of Traptanium from a great distance at enemies.

abilities.name: Crystal Slam
abilities.description: A powerful melee strike using a Traptanium sword to crush nearby foes.

abilities.name: Sure Shot Croc
abilities.description: Enhanced precision for the Traptanium bow, ensuring every shot counts.

abilities.name: Arrowsplosion
abilities.description: Arrows explode upon impact, dealing damage to groups of enemies.

abilities.name: Big Wave Torrent
abilities.description: Summon a massive torrent of water to wash away all enemies in the area.

trivia: Loading Instant Snap Shot on the console versions of Skylanders: Trap Team will have the game hang on the element indefinitely. If he was to load, he would be named 'Virtual Snap Shot' instead, the internal name for instant variants.
In both Skylanders: SuperChargers and Skylanders: Imaginators he scans in as 'Snap Shot Special' and can be added to the collection as a separate Skylander.

instant-spitfire.name: Instant Spitfire
instant-spitfire.description: Instant Spitfire is the digital counterpart of Spitfire in Skylanders: SuperChargers. Unlike the other Instant Skylanders, he can be played on multiple platforms.
instant-spitfire.biography: Instant Spitfire is the digital counterpart of Spitfire in Skylanders: SuperChargers. He is unlocked by unplugging the SuperChargers Portal and plugging in any of the Portals of Power from previous games. By pressing X (PlayStation 3/PlayStation 4) or A (Xbox 360/Xbox One/Wii U), he and Instant Hot Streak become playable. However, he's significantly weaker than regular Spitfire, and this Skylander is incompatible with Co-Op mode as he requires an empty portal to be active. His English voice actor is Diedrich Bader.
instant-spitfire.personality: Spitfire is a fiery and energetic Flame Spirit who lived to race. He is incredibly fast, both in his movements and his thinking, and possesses a competitive spirit that drives him to be the best. Despite his intensity, he is a loyal Skylander dedicated to stopping Kaos.
instant-spitfire.gameplay: Instant Spitfire shares the same move set as the standard Spitfire, utilizing fast-paced claw swipes and fiery dashes. He is significantly weaker than regular Spitfire, and this Skylander is incompatible with Co-Op mode as he requires an empty portal to be active.

abilities.name: Butane Brawling
abilities.description: Slash enemies with fiery claws.

abilities.name: Flash Fire
abilities.description: Dash forward in a burst of flame, damaging anything in your way.

abilities.name: Flamenado
abilities.description: Hold the secondary attack button to create a fire tornado.

abilities.name: Flamenado 2
abilities.description: An improved version of the Flamenado attack.

abilities.name: Mega Marathon
abilities.description: Flamenado lasts much longer and covers more ground.

abilities.name: Hyper Burner
abilities.description: Dashing deals more damage and leaves a trail of fire.

trivia: He is the only instant Skylander of the Fire element. The other two elements (Water and Life) each have two instant Skylanders.
He is the only digital exclusive Skylander to be playable in the consoles.
He's significantly weaker than regular Spitfire.

instant-super-shot-stealth-elf.name: Instant Super Shot Stealth Elf
instant-super-shot-stealth-elf.primaryGame: Skylanders: SuperChargers (iOS) (in the game files of the console versions)
appearances: Skylanders: SuperChargers (iOS) (in the game files of the console versions)
instant-super-shot-stealth-elf.description: Instant Super Shot Stealth Elf is a digital counterpart of Super Shot Stealth Elf in Skylanders: SuperChargers. She is only playable in the iOS version of the game.
instant-super-shot-stealth-elf.biography: Instant Super Shot Stealth Elf is a digital counterpart of Super Shot Stealth Elf in Skylanders: SuperChargers. She is only playable in the iOS version of the game.
trivia: She is the only Instant counterpart of a Skylander from Skylanders: Spyro's Adventure.

variants.name: Instant Super Shot Stealth Elf
variants.game: Skylanders: SuperChargers (iOS) (in the game files of the console versions)

jade-fire-kraken.name: Jade Fire Kraken
jade-fire-kraken.description: Jade Fire Kraken is a jade counterpart of Fire Kraken in Skylanders: Swap Force.
jade-fire-kraken.biography: Raised on a small island surrounded by a vast ocean of fire, Fire Kraken was the swiftest, most agile warrior his tribe had ever seen. And when a fleet of Fire Troll ships arrived to steal the legendary Burning Heart, a huge elemental crystal that fueled the fiery seas, Fire Kraken leapt into action. Using a magical staff to control his natural ability to wield fire, he set the mighty ships ablaze, forcing the trolls into a hasty retreat. Having saved the Burning Heart as well as his homeland, Fire Kraken soon joined the Skylanders, where he knew his skills would help those in need.
trivia: He is the second Jade variant Skylander (the first is Jade Flashwing).
They are also both counterparts of dragons who didn't appear in Spyro's Adventure.
The fact that only dragon Skylanders have Jade counterparts may be a reference to Jade Dragons, carved statues made from the mineral from certain places in China.
This is particularly fitting for Fire Kraken, as he is based on both Chinese dragons and fireworks, which were Invented in China.
Like Slam Bam and Phantom Cynder, Jade Fire Kraken's body is translucent.
Unlike Jade Flashwing, Jade Fire Kraken is not exclusive to Target.

jade-flashwing.name: Jade Flashwing
jade-flashwing.description: Jade Flashwing is a green and gold version of the Earth Skylander, Flashwing.
jade-flashwing.biography: Flashwing's origins are a mystery, though her first appearance was quite spectacular. When Bash made a wish on a falling star that he could fly, he watched as a glowing geode fell from the sky and landed in the heart of a valley. Inside that geode was the beautiful but lethal Flashwing. Bash may not have gotten his wings that day, but Flashwing certainly made an impact.
jade-flashwing.personality: Graceful and elegant, Jade Flashwing possesses a fierce spirit and a sharp wit. While she can be somewhat vain about her beautiful crystalline appearance, she is a formidable warrior who doesn't hesitate to jump into the fray to protect her fellow Skylanders.
jade-flashwing.gameplay: Jade Flashwing can launch crystal shards from her tail spike at enemies, like a scorpion shooting poison spikes. She can also twirl around, hitting enemies with her crystalline wings, and summon a large crystal from the ground to allow light to beam through it and strike enemies surrounding it.

abilities.name: Crystal Shards
abilities.description: Shoot crystal shards from your tail at enemies.

abilities.name: Shimmering Spin
abilities.description: Spin around, hitting enemies with your wings.

abilities.name: Surrounded by Shards
abilities.description: Spinning creates a ring of crystals that damage enemies.

abilities.name: Crystal Lighthouse
abilities.description: A giant crystal beam shoots from the ground, damaging all nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Luminous Lasers
abilities.description: Crystal Shards now fire lasers.

abilities.name: Light Speed Lasers
abilities.description: Upgraded lasers move at even higher speeds.

trivia: Jade Flashwing, Prism Break and Crusher have green crystals around their bodies.
She and Jade Fire Kraken are currently the only Jade Skylanders.
They are also both counterparts of dragons who didn't appear in Spyro's Adventure.
The fact that only dragon Skylanders have Jade counterparts may be a reference to real world Jade Dragons, carved statues made from the mineral from certain places in China.
This is particularly fitting for Flashwing, as jade is a real world gem, and Flashwing herself is based on gems and precious minerals, growing them from her body.

jawbreaker.name: Jawbreaker
jawbreaker.description: Jawbreaker is an electric robot who is one of the Tech Trap Masters for Skylanders: Trap Team.
jawbreaker.biography: Jawbreaker hailed from a race of robots that operated and maintained a vast underground complex of enormous machines that powered the legendary Sky Train, which traveled between a thousand different islands daily. Like many of his fellow robots, Jawbreaker led an ordered existence – full of rules and regulations – which he followed happily. However, one day a huge army of Gear Trolls invaded the subterranean complex. Known for being major train enthusiasts, they were set on taking over the Sky Train for their own evil use. Jawbreaker quickly jumped into action and used his massive fists to beat the trolls into retreat. His quick action and ability to think for himself made him an individual. For this he was made part of the Trap Team, where he now uses his Traptanium powered fists to deliver mighty blows to evil!
jawbreaker.personality: Jawbreaker likes being an individual, even though his robot pals think he should be more like them. Sometimes you's just got to dare to be different.
jawbreaker.gameplay: Jawbreaker is capable of using his Traptanium Fists to rapidly punch enemies, much like Terrafin, Night Shift, and the villain Bruiser Cruiser. He can also go into his Robo Rage Mode to punch enemies faster. When upgraded a second time, Jawbreaker can punch the surrounding terrain and release a wave of electric sparks. After purchasing his Soul Gem, Hypercharged Haymaker, Jawbreaker can punch while releasing electric sparks. In Skylanders: Battlecast, his powers also include electrical arcs that attack along with him, summoning virtual objects to simulate an enemy's power and summon a Tech trap containing Dr. Krankcase, thus allowing the mad doctor to attack enemies for as many ranks they have. His Special Ability is Overclock, increasing his power temporarily, and his signature Gear is the Galvanic Armor.

abilities.description: Throw a powerful punch with big, Traptanium fists.

abilities.name: Robo Rage Mode
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 to enter Robo Rage Mode, moving faster, punching harder, and doing more damage.

abilities.name: Ragin' Robo Rage
abilities.description: Robo Rage Mode lasts even longer.

abilities.name: Spark Shock
abilities.description: Punch the ground and release a wave of electric sparks.

abilities.name: Alternating Current
abilities.description: Punching in Robo Rage Mode shocks enemies, doing extra damage over time.

abilities.name: Heavy Hands
abilities.description: Traptanium Punches do more damage.

abilities.name: Hypercharged Haymaker
abilities.description: Hold Attack 3 to charge up a powerful, electromagnetic punch.

abilities.name: Static Cling
abilities.description: Spark Shock attacks sticks to enemies, doing damage over time.

abilities.name: Hands Off!
abilities.description: Getting hit by an enemy automatically releases a wave of electric sparks.

abilities.name: Sparking Interest
abilities.description: Constantly release electric sparks in Robo Rage Mode.

abilities.name: Jolting Jab

abilities.description: Takes less damage while in Robo Rage Mode.

abilities.name: Punch For Power
abilities.description: Stay in Robo Rage Mode longer by landing punches.

trivia: He and Gearshift are both robotic Tech Trap Masters.
An ogre-like enemy in Skylanders: Giants shares the same name as Jawbreaker.
He has a similar resemblance to Blitzcrank from League of Legends.
He greatly resembles the Bad Bouncers from Skylanders: Imaginators, the only differences being their size, their arms, and Jawbreaker having legs instead of a roller wheel.
One of his attacks, Spark Shock, shares its name with an otherwise unrelated weapon from the Mega Man series.
Jawbreaker is the only Trap Master to have a Traptanium weapon as part of his body.
Drill-X from Skylanders: Giants says his catchphrase as part of his rap.

Jawbreaker is similar to another Skylander, Magna Charge. Both are robots. Their Soul Gems are located on the first level of their respective games. They're both one of the 'special Skylanders' (Trap Master for Jawbreaker and Swap Force for Magna Charge).
Jawbreaker's voice actor, Ike Amadi, is known for voicing Atrocitus in Infinite Crisis, LEGO Batman 3: Beyond Gotham, and Injustice 2. Ike Amadi also voices The Darkness in Skylanders: SuperChargers.
Jawbreaker doesn't say his catchphrase when placing him in Skylanders: SuperChargers Racing.
Jawbreaker was planned to be in Skylanders Academy's second season, but he was cut due to budget reasons.
His name is a pun on the alternate name for gobstopper, a type of infamously hard candy.

jet-vac.name: Jet-Vac
jet-vac.description: Jet-Vac is a wingless Sky Baron who is one of the Air Skylanders in Skylanders: Giants. His Series 2 name is Turbo Jet-Vac and his Series 3 name is Full Blast Jet-Vac. He has a Legendary counterpart known as Legendary Jet-Vac. In Skylanders: SuperChargers, Jet-Vac is redesigned as a SuperCharger named Hurricane Jet-Vac and is given new abilities.
jet-vac.biography: Jet-Vac was the greatest, most daring flying ace in all of Windham. He was given his magical wings when he was young, as was the tradition for all Sky Barons. But when his homeland was raided, he chose to sacrifice his wings to a young mother so she could fly her children to safety. This act of nobility caught the attention of Master Eon, who sought out the young Sky Baron and presented him with a gift - a powerful vacuum device that would allow him to soar through the skies once again. Jet-Vac accepted the gift with gratitude, and now daringly fights evil alongside the other Skylanders.
jet-vac.personality: Noble and courageous, Jet-Vac always thinks of others before himself. Now a Skylander, he soars where even eagles never dare. In Full Blast, he's shown to be a bit of a defeatist, thinking his worth as a fighter is lost without a weapon. In Skylanders: Imaginators, Jet-Vac displays dedication in searching for what has been stolen from him, in his case, his lunch that was stored away within the Sky Fortress.
jet-vac.gameplay: Jet-Vac attacks by shooting air blasts out of his vacuum device, and his secondary attack is that he can also use his vacuum device to suck up the treasures and enemies in the surroundings. He also can fly with his vacuum device. In Skylanders: Battlecast, Jet-Vac can also make the enemy attack itself in a tornado or the scrapped Hurticane; his special ability is Erratic Vortex, swapping in a random enemy, and his signature gear is the Duplicator Mark II, which copies spells from the enemy. In Skylanders: Ring of Heroes, Jet-Vac is a support class character.

abilities.description: Press Attack 1 to shoot enemies with a powerful blast of air.

abilities.name: Suction Gun

abilities.description: Suction Gun attacks do maximum damage.

abilities.name: Flying Corkscrew
abilities.description: While flying, Press Attack 2 to blast forward and perform a powerful corkscrew attack.

trivia: Early in development, Jet-Vac was known by his concept names, Vac Eagle, Vacuum Eagle, and Airgle.
His name is a play on the word "jet pack".

Although Jet-Vac is male, he has been known to lay eggs in times of shock. No one knows if these hatch into little Sky Barons or not. This trait is featured in the Tall Tales trailer, the Just like SWAP Force trailer, and The Discovery trailer, and is a recurring trait in his Skylanders Academy counterpart.
In the trailers, Jet-Vac has a very thick Scottish accent, even mentioning haggis at one point in the Tall Tales E3 trailer. In-game, he speaks in a British accent.

During Giants's early development, Jet-Vac's abilities/upgrades were differently named and arranged. "Vac-Blaster" was replaced by an ability called "Vac-Fu," which entailed melee clawing attacks. "Fiester Fan" was replaced by an upgrade called "Turbo Jetpack." "Jet-Vac Jet Pack" was replaced by an upgrade called "Vacuum Force Air Blaster." "Vac Blaster 9000" was replaced by an upgrade called "Vack-Pack 9000." "Turbine Suction Gun" was replaced by an upgrade called "Hyper-Suck Mega Fan." "Piercing Winds" was replaced by an upgrade called "Vac-Fu; Eagle Claw." "Vac Master-Blaster 20X" was replaced by an upgrade called "Super Bird." "Super Suction Air Blaster" was replaced by an upgrade called "Elite Vac Gun Blade." "Flying Corkscrew" was replaced by an upgrade called "Super Suction Air Blaster."
His catchphrase is a pun on Shock and Awe. But on his single character pack, his catchphrase is erroneously marked as "Choc and Chic."
He slightly resembles a Secretary Bird and a Harpy Eagle.
He is the only Air Skylander before SWAP Force who cannot fly over water.
In New York Toy Fair 2012, his toy form has more silver details on his cannon and armor than his normal toy form.

During development he originally had a scratching ability and tornado dance as one of his attacks, but these were removed in the final release. He also had a different standing and running animations during development which were later reused in following games: His standing animation was used in Cloud Patrol and Lost Islands. His running animation was used in Swap Force and subsequent installments. Early in development, his vacuum ability could move both Chompy Pods and exploding hazard plants, causing the latter to regrow wherever he relocated them. In the alpha of Giants, taking damage often caused his gun to fly backward, unnaturally extending its cord.
After he obtains the Eagle Air Battle Armor upgrade, his color scheme slightly matches the color scheme of the NFL team, the Seattle Seahawks.
He and Gill Grunt are the only two Skylanders who fly using jet packs. They both, alongside Eruptor, are also the only Skylanders to appear in 5 versions (including Minis, but excluding alter egos).
In Skylanders: Swap Force, Jet-Vac's Eagle-Air Battle Gear Soul Gem will not change his appearance.
As a S3 figure, the color scheme of Full Blast Jet-Vac's outfit is crimson instead of blue, even if his new Wow Pow hasn't been purchased yet.
Pop Fizz and Jet-Vac always appear together on animated trailers. The two appear in more trailers then anyone else from their elements—Magic and Air.

Of all Skylanders, Jet-Vac is the only one that has more upgrades that consecutively change their appearance/weapons. Having three different guns in his basic upgrades, an exclusive gun on an upgrade path, a new Jet-pack and gun as part of his other upgrade path, a new set of armor for his Soul Gem upgrade and another new set of armor and new guns as part of each of his two Wow Pow upgrades.

In Skylanders: Ring of Heroes, Jet-Vac's Awakened Form gains mechanical wings on his jetpack, much bigger than his Hurricane Jet-Vac counterpart, and his blaster also has a similar set of wing designs.

He is the only Skylander to have two legendary counterparts. He is one of the only three Skylanders whose alt deco has a reposed counterpart (the other two are Spyro and Stealth Elf). Unlike the other two, he's the only one without a Dark counterpart.

jingle-bell-chompy-mage.name: Jingle Bell Chompy Mage
jingle-bell-chompy-mage.description: Jingle Bell Chompy Mage is the Christmas counterpart of Chompy Mage, with an outfit resembling Santa Claus, in Skylanders: Imaginators.
jingle-bell-chompy-mage.biography: Jingle Bell Chompy Mage is a specially designed toy that appears in the game outfitted in a holiday-inspired wardrobe. He joins the lineup of Sensei Skylanders new to Skylanders Imaginators and is ready to teach the Skylanders some new fighting techniques and a classic Chompy holiday tradition — the White Chompy gift exchange! After all, 'tis the season to be Chompy![1]
trivia: Jingle Bell Chompy Mage is the second Christmas counterpart of the Life element (the first being Jolly Bumble Blast).
Due to regular Chompy Mage having only been sold in an Amazon-exclusive bundle with other villain Senseis, Jingle Bell Chompy Mage is significantly less valuable on resale than his base counterpart

jolly-bumble-blast.name: Jolly Bumble Blast
jolly-bumble-blast.description: Jolly Bumble Blast is the Christmas counterpart of Bumble Blast in Skylanders: Swap Force.
jolly-bumble-blast.biography: No other Skylander celebrates the holiday season quite like Bumble Blast. Every year, the magical bees that are under his protection decorate their mighty tree hero in wonderful festive colors. Then Bumble Blast makes it his mission to spread the cheer by blasting enchanted peppermint at anyone in need of a little holiday spirit. After all, 'tis the season to be jolly!
jolly-bumble-blast.personality: Jolly Bumble Blast is incredibly festive, cheerful, and dedicated. He is a protector of nature who believes that the holiday spirit should be shared with everyone, often using his magical bees to spread joy as much as he uses them to defeat evil.
jolly-bumble-blast.gameplay: Jolly Bumble Blast focuses on long-range projectile attacks using heat-seeking bees. His secondary attacks involve slowing enemies down with sticky honey globs, allowing his swarm to deal consistent damage while he maintains a safe distance. His festive skin provides a unique visual flair to his attacks in-game.

abilities.name: Sweetened Stingers

trivia: Jolly Bumble Blast comes with a unique hat for Swap Force, the Jolly Hat.
When upgrading, Stirred up a Nest on the Bee Keeper path changes his Beezooka to its default colors.
This might be because of the developers forgetting to implement the correct color for the upgrade.
Despite his Beezooka shows a white and red colored bee inside the barrel, they come out in normal colors when shot.
Jolly Bumble Blast is the first Christmas themed variant who is not a Water element Skylander (the second being Jingle Bell Chompy Mage).
Coincidentally, both are Life Skylanders.
Jolly Bumble Blast is one of three holiday based alter-ego Skylanders to come with an exclusive hat, the other two being Springtime Trigger Happy and Kickoff Countdown.
He is the only one of the three who isn't of the Tech Element.

ka-boom.name: Ka-Boom
ka-boom.description: Ka-Boom is one of the Fire Trap Masters in Skylanders: Trap Team.
ka-boom.biography: Ka-Boom hails from an ancient volcanic island known as Munitions Forge, where he and his people crafted machinery that was used all throughout Skylands. But the ruthless Captain Ironbeard wanted the forge for himself so he could build an unstoppable pirate armada. With a fleet of pirate ships approaching, Ka-Boom went to work, creating the greatest anti-pirate weapon ever forged – The Boom Cannon! When Ironbeard arrived with his invaders, Ka-Boom met them at the edge of the docks with his cannon lowered, still smoldering red hot from having just come out of the fire. One by one, he sank their ships until Captain Ironbeard finally retreated. Now as a valued member of the Trap Team, Ka-Boom uses his Red Hot Traptanium Cannon to blast evil in the broadsides!
ka-boom.personality: Ka-Boom is a thinker and tinker. He'll mess around with his inventions until he gets them absolutely perfect.
ka-boom.gameplay: Fill up the Trap Attack gauge by defeating enemies and collecting TRAPTANIUM shards. Once the gauge is full, press [L] to unleash a devastating attack, unique to each Trap Master!

trivia: Ka-Boom, Boomer, Shroomboom, Sonic Boom, Boom Bloom, and Boom Jet all have the word Boom in their names.
He, Dino-Rang, Eye-Brawl, Dive-Clops and Tri-Tip are the only Skylanders with hyphenated names.
He and Snap Shot are the only two Trap Masters to wield a projectile weapon.

Ka-Boom bears a notable resemblance to several other characters or individuals, such as: Former WWE star, Hulk Hogan. Hellboy, a Dark Horse Comics character. Various bruisers in the Borderlands series. Tristana from League of Legends. Thunderbolt Ross a.k.a. The Red Hulk from Marvel Comics.
Ka-Boom's backstory references Munitions Forge, a level in The Legend of Spyro reboot.

kaos.name: Kaos
kaos.description: This version of Kaos is a clone created by the Dark Portal Master himself, but defected to the side of the Skylanders. He is a Sensei who is a master of all the Battle Classes.
kaos.biography: With Kaos having discovered the power of Mind Magic to create Doomlanders, one of his first creations was none other than a clone of himself! Figuring that no one in the universe, including the Skylanders, could ever stand up to more than one Kaos, he unleashed his clone in his quest to take over Skylands. But to Kaos' surprise, the clone –also being Kaos– wanted victory for himself! As a result, he decided to fight against his creator, in turn helping the Skylanders in their endeavor to defeat the real Kaos!
kaos.personality: Retaining the original Kaos's massive ego, arrogance, and penchant for dramatic monologues, this clone is uniquely driven by a spiteful desire to upstage his creator. While he remains rude to the Skylanders, often calling them 'fools' or 'stupid,' his competitive nature makes him a powerful ally against the real Kaos.
kaos.gameplay: As a master of all Battle Classes, Kaos is able to summon mind weapons from each class and use them to attack enemies. He is also able to summon Doom Sharks, Doomlanders and Doom Hands to aid him in battle. His Sky-Chi ability transforms him into a large version of his head, able to fire lasers from its eyes. For his Soul Gem, he summons a portal that rains down various heavy objects upon enemies. His primary attack combos start with a swing of a Knight or Smasher weapon, followed by two Swashbuckler or Sentinel weapons, and ending with a Brawler attack. His secondary combos start with a Bazooker or Bowslinger shot, followed by a stream of lightning from a Sorcerer staff, and ending with a flurry of Ninja or Quickshot projectiles.

trivia: The Doomlanders summoned by Sensei Kaos look like small, blue copies of the Knight Doomlander.
Though being on the side of the Skylanders, he stills refers to them as 'stupid' in his Sensei Training Bonus, just like the original Kaos.
Kaos is the only Sensei who doesn't provide any Secret Techniques or exclusive weapons for the Imaginators.
He provides a backpack attachment as well as raises the level cap for the Imaginators, like every other Sensei.
Kaos is the only Sensei with a Sky-Chi that is already unlocked.
He is the only Sensei without any Sensei Shrine interaction, despite being a master of all Battle Classes.
Pressing the Primary Attack button while Kaos is in the air will cause him to transform into his giant head and slam into the ground.
He, Pop Fizz, and Grilla Drilla have the most syllables for their catchphrases, counting seven.
Kaos shares the same elemental booming effects with the Skylanders of the Dark element.
When placing Kaos on the Portal, it shows the emblem of Villains instead of the Kaos element.
Due to being a master of all Battle Classes, the Kaos element is shown on the bottom of his base instead of a Battle Class emblem.
The pose used for the Kaos figure dates back to at least the Giants era.

kickoff-countdown.name: Kickoff Countdown
kickoff-countdown.description: Kickoff Countdown is a soccer ball themed variant of Countdown in Skylanders: Swap Force.
kickoff-countdown.biography: Countdown was discovered by a group of Yetis who were snowboarding one particularly chilly morning when they came across a big bomb encased in ice. After bringing it back to their cabin, they were shocked when it actually came to life. No one, not even Countdown himself, has any memory of where he came from or how he ended up frozen in the mountains. Since becoming a Skylander, Master Eon has been graciously trying to help piece together fragments of his past. But this has proven difficult, as Countdown loses some of his memory every time he explodes - which happens a lot. In the meantime, Countdown has enjoyed working with Eon and fighting alongside the Skylanders to defend their world against evil - even though he occasionally forgets what he is doing.
kickoff-countdown.personality: Countdown is brave and dedicated to protecting Skylands, though his most defining trait is his extreme forgetfulness caused by the frequent detonation of his own head. He often forgets what he is doing mid-task, yet he remains an enthusiastic member of the Skylanders.
kickoff-countdown.gameplay: Kickoff Countdown uses his head as a primary projectile, throwing bombs at enemies. He can also fire rockets and summon mini-bomb companions to assist him in battle. Like his standard counterpart, his head regenerates after every explosion.

abilities.name: Bomb Head

abilities.name: Rocket Blast
abilities.description: Fire a rocket from your hand.

abilities.description: Bombs deal more damage.

abilities.description: Summon small bombs to follow you.

trivia: Although his clock is silver in his promotional art and figure, in the game is still golden.
Despite him smiling on most artworks, he's rarely ever seen smiling in gameplay.
He unlocks an exclusive hat called the 'Kickoff Hat'
He, Springtime Trigger Happy, and Jolly Bumble Blast are the only Skylanders to unlock exclusive hats.

king-cobra-cadabra.name: King Cobra Cadabra
king-cobra-cadabra.description: Cobra Cadabra is a Magic black King Cobra who was one of the Magic core Skylanders that first appeared in Skylanders: Trap Team. He is a musical serpent who uses an enchanted pungi flute to cast spells and command magic baskets.
king-cobra-cadabra.biography: Though Cobra Cadabra was an assistant to The Great Mabuni, a traveling magician that performed all over Skylands, he wanted more than anything to become a magician himself. Unfortunately, the guild of Mysteriously Mad Magic Masters of Mystery, who for centuries taught all of the greatest magicians, would not permit it. And so Mabuni decided to teach the cobra himself, even though it was forbidden. They studied everything together, from vanishing acts to snake charming. But when the guild discovered this, they sent a team of magic rabbit enforcers to punish them both. Although the beastly hares were the most powerful of their kind in Skylands, Cobra Cadabra remained brave. Playing an enchanted tune on his flute, he used what he had learned to cast a spell over the rabbits and lead them away. Upon hearing this, this guild was impressed by such a display of skill, and accepted the snake charmer as a member. Soon after, Cobra Cadabra was made a member of another group – the Skylanders!
king-cobra-cadabra.personality: Cobra Cadabra is a charmer, all right. He's brave too! When he plays an enchanting tune, everyone listens. Like a magician, he never reveals his secrets.
king-cobra-cadabra.gameplay: Cobra Cadabra can play his magical pungi flute, which launches magic notes that attack his enemies, or cast various spells through songs, one can put enemies under his control. His secondary attack allows him to launch cobra baskets which have cobra allies to attack his enemies. His third attack lets Cobra Cadabra launch himself out of his basket which damages enemies in his way, and land into other cobra baskets.

abilities.description: Hold Attack 2 to detonate all active Cobra Baskets.

trivia: He is the second snake Skylander in the series, after Rattle Shake and before Pit Boss.
He is currently the only snake Skylander who is not in the Undead element.
Cobra Cadabra's name is a play on the magic word 'Abracadabra.'
His eyes constantly shrink and grow, a reference to snake hypnotism.

He is one of the few playable characters to use a musical instrument as a weapon (the others being Wolfgang, Fiesta, Pain-Yatta, and Turbo Charge Donkey Kong). Additionally, each of the characters' weapons come from the four main instrument groups; Cobra Cadabra's flute: Woodwinds, Wolfgang's bone harp: Strings, Fiesta's trumpet: Brass, and Donkey Kong's bongo drums: Percussion.
Oddly, Cobra Cadabra does not hiss whenever he says the letter 'S.'
As of Imaginators, he is the only snake character to not do so.
Not counting the variants, guests or SuperCharger versions of previous Skylanders, Cobra Cadabra has the highest amount of syllables in his name, specifically five.
Cobra Cadabra is bugged in Trap Team so that, if a cinematic or dialogue scene interrupts him while playing the flute, he will remain in his flute-playing position until the attack is used again.
If Cobra Cadabra is wearing a trinket which goes in his mouth, when he goes to play his flute, the trinket will temporarily disappear, only to reappear when he finishes playing.
In SuperChargers and Imaginators, when he plays his snake charmer's solo, his flute tune and music sounds different from how it did in Trap Team.
It sounds like ordinary flute music instead of hypnotic flute music.

king-pen.name: King Pen
king-pen.description: King Pen is an Emperor Penguin Brawler Sensei in Skylanders: Imaginators, who serves as the leader of the Skylander Senseis.
king-pen.biography: King Pen hails from a militaristic unit of penguins who protect the Cloudmelt Glaciers. During an epic battle, King Pen was trapped in an avalanche and had to take refuge in a nearby cave for the remainder of the winter season. During his solitude, he was visited by a mysterious Yeti Master, named Snow Wah, who began teaching him an ancient combat style known as 'Flipper-Fu'. King Pen was already a skilled fighter, but the wise teacher helped him to understand the spiritual and philosophical nature of warfare, turning the penguin into an unstoppable force. When he finally emerged from the cave, tales of his newfound abilities spread far and wide. When Master Eon caught wind, he recruited King Pen into his top secret training program, where he quickly rose up the ranks to become the leader of the Skylander Senseis. Years later, King Pen returned to the site of the avalanche to thank his teacher, but no evidence of Snow Wah or the cave was ever found – leaving many to wonder if the Yeti had ever existed at all.
king-pen.personality: King Pen is a disciplined and militaristic leader who values the spiritual and philosophical aspects of warfare. Despite being a highly skilled fighter, he maintains a respect for his mentors and has a spiritual understanding of combat. He is confident in his status as a Sensei and leader, occasionally displaying a boastful side and a sense of humor regarding his preferences for names like 'Austin'.
king-pen.gameplay: King Pen can slash his enemies with his bladed wings, and even infuse ice into his attacks. King Pen can use his frost breath to leave a path of ice, and freeze his foes. King Pen can also perfrom a corkscrew dash which knocks enemies out of the way, and even create a huge snowball to launch at his enemies after the attack. King Pen is capable of creating a arena of ice to protect himself from attackers.

trivia: His name is a pun on the words 'Penguin' and 'Kingpin'. It may also come from 'king penguin', a species of penguin.
Additionally, one of his upgrades 'Emperor Penguin', is also named after his species of penguin.
Despite being shown to have the means to walk during his Sky-Chi, King Pen awkwardly waddles during his running animation.
King Pen grants to Imaginators his Ponytail Headpiece when first placed on the portal, and Flipper Blade Knuckles fashioned after his own weapons when his Shrine is opened.
He is the fourth Water Skylander with ice related abilities (behind Slam Bam, Chill and Freeze Blade).
He is the second Skylander to be voiced by Rino Romano, the other being Scorp.
King Pen and Grave Clobber are both Brawlers of the Water Element.
This makes them the only Senseis to share both a Battle Class and an Element.
He is similar to Snap Shot, the leader of the Trap Masters, as both are Water-elementals who are the leaders of elite Skylander teams.
His catchphrase was originally planned to be 'Cold Cuts'.
His new catchphrase, 'Stay Frosty' may be a reference to Minecraft Youtuber Jackfrostminer's motto of the same name.
His quote, 'Enter the Penguin', is a reference to the Bruce Lee movie Enter the Dragon.

King Pen is the only new Sensei to appear in the starter pack. The other Starter Pack Senseis appeared in previous games (Golden Queen and Wolfgang from Skylanders: Trap Team and Crash Bandicoot and Dr. Neo Cortex from the original Crash Bandicoot franchise).

knight-light.name: Knight Light
knight-light.description: Knight Light is the Light Trap Master in Skylanders: Trap Team. He comes with the Sunscraper Spire expansion pack, but later came in a single pack.
knight-light.biography: Before the destruction of the Core of Light left him stranded in the Light Realm, Knight Light was the protector of the Starlight – the source of light, wisdom and vast energy in Radiant City. But an evil villain known as Luminous wanted the Starlight for himself. Without warning, Luminous attacked, and the two took to the skies in an epic battle which lasted several days. In the end, Knight Light stood victorious and Luminous was imprisoned within Sunscraper Spire so that he could no longer pose a threat to Skylands. Now with his Traptanium blade, Knight Light fights alongside the Trap Team to keep evil at bay!
knight-light.personality: Knight Light is described as pure, gallant, righteous and illuminating.
knight-light.gameplay: In Skylanders: Trap Team, Knight Light is a Light Trap Master whose gameplay centers on high-speed sword combat and area-denial. His console abilities include 'Traptanium Scimitar' for combos and 'Prismatic Pounce' which creates a Light Aura where his sword attacks deal increased damage. His upgrades allow him to slow enemies within his auras ('Hallowed Ground'), create damaging circles of light ('Light Up'), and increase aura duration. Players can choose between the 'Scimitar Slasher' path, which focuses on vertical combat and teleporting strikes, or the 'Luminary of Light' path, which enhances his leap attacks and makes his auras explosive. His Soul Gem, 'Brilliant Blade', provides a massive damage boost to his primary weapon. In Skylanders: Ring of Heroes, he has active abilities like 'Spin Slash' (damage, ATK DOWN), 'Spectrum Attack' (damage, ally HP recovery), and 'Light!' (ally shield, debuff immunity), alongside passive abilities 'Light Will Protect You' (ally HP regen, debuff removal) and 'Guardian's Light' (self damage reduction, increased effect accuracy, team leader effect for accuracy). On the 3DS, he uses 'Bringer of Light' and 'Pacification' as starting powers, with upgrades that add teleportation and slowing effects to his leaping blows. Notably, he possesses the highest health among all Trap Masters and can fly by double-tapping the jump button.

trivia: Both he and Knight Mare both have the word 'knight' in their names.
Knight Light and Knight Mare both have names that play on terms that involve sleep.
His name is a play on nightlight, a small lamp that provides light in dark areas during the night.
He loosely resembles an angel or seraph.
He also slightly resembles a harpy.
Knight Light also resembles to Angemon from the Digimon franchise, both are angelic beings who wear masks that obscure half of their face only exposing their mouths.
One of his Passive abilities in Ring of Heroes creates a halo around a random ally after he is defeated, supporting that he might be one himself.
He has the highest health out of all the Trap Masters.
Despite not having a flight upgrade, Knight Light can fly by double tapping the jump button.
Knight Light is the first Skylander to have a Doom Raider mentioned in their backstory.

knight-mare.name: Knight Mare
knight-mare.description: Knight Mare is a dark centaur and the Dark Trap Master in Skylanders: Trap Team. She was initially released with the Midnight Museum expansion pack, but later came out in a single pack.
knight-mare.biography: Before the destruction of the Core of Light left her stranded in the Dark Realm, Knight Mare was one of the Dark Centaurs who guarded The Oracle of Stones – an enchanted game of Dark Skystones that could predict the future. When it was stolen by an unknown force, Knight Mare was called upon to retrieve it. She knew it would be dangerous because if the Oracle was asked the wrong questions seven times, it would unleash a terrible curse upon all of Skylands. Fortunately, she found it in a cave – with a gang of Bicyclopes about to ask their seventh wrong question. With no time to lose, she charged forward, beating the fierce Bicyclopes and saving Skylands from the terrible curse. Now having joined the Trap Team, Knight Mare uses her hunting skills and Traptanium Lance to bring down evil everywhere!
knight-mare.personality: Knight Mare is described as a solitary, stubborn, shadowy and skilled huntress.
knight-mare.gameplay: Knight Mare is a skilled huntress who uses her Traptanium Flamberge and centaur biology to dominate the battlefield. Her primary attacks involve sword combos with her lance, while her secondary ability, Shadow Joust, allows her to charge through enemies. Her tactical advantage comes from her Battle Horn, which stuns enemies and creates Shadowy Clones to fight alongside her. Her Soul Gem, The Shadow Realm, enhances these clones and blinds enemies. In the 3DS version, her playstyle focuses on absorbing shadows to boost sword damage and triggering shadow explosions.

abilities.name: Sword of Darkness

trivia: Her name is a play on the word 'nightmare', a bad dream, and her knight-like armor and sword.
Her name may also be a reference to her horse qualities.
Both Knight Mare and Knight Light have the word 'knight' in their names.
They are also the only Trap Masters to be included in Expansion Packs.
They are also the only Trap Masters of their respective elements.
She is the only quadrupedal Trap Master, unless you count Wildfire while using his Soul Gem ability.
However, she fights like a bipedal Skylander since she has arms while having four legs.
She and Trail Blazer are the only Skylanders with horse-related features.
Knight Mare has a doubled voice effect, by having the second one slightly delayed.

For unknown reasons, Knight Mare has two lines exactly the same as Hex's ('Fear the darkness!' and 'My power knows no equal!'), with whom she shares her voice actress, Courtenay Taylor. However, they're pronounced slightly differently.
Despite having protected the Oracle of Stones for years, Knight Mare had yet to play Skystones herself until she decided to try it out in Lost Islands.
In at least the Wii version of Trap Team, Knight Mare can perform the Light and Dark Gate Glitch using her secondary attack on a few of the glitched gates.

In the 3DS version of Trap Team, Knight Mare summoned small Shadow clones of herself instead of the enemies. In Skylanders: SuperChargers, both are replaced with shadow clones of Greebles no matter the enemy.
Her Traptanium Flamberge makes a cameo appearance in the Skylanders: Battlecast card Tree Wrecked, being shattered by vines summoned by Tree Rex for reasons unknown.
This is its only reference to the Light and Dark characters and elements.
She and Mysticat both have centaur-like builds, as she is literally a centaur.
She was originally named 'Shadow Runner' during development.
In the animated introduction of her Soul Gem preview, Knight Mare appears with red hair. This may be a leftover from earlier development.

knockout-jawbreaker.name: Knockout Jawbreaker
knockout-jawbreaker.description: Knockout Jawbreaker is the November 2014 counterpart of the Tech Trap Master, Jawbreaker, in Skylanders: Lost Islands.
knockout-jawbreaker.biography: Knockout Jawbreaker is the November 2014 counterpart of the Tech Trap Master, Jawbreaker, in Skylanders: Lost Islands.
knockout-jawbreaker.catchphrase: Knockout Jawbreaker has left the ring and stepped into Skylands!
knockout-jawbreaker.personality: As a counterpart to Jawbreaker, he likely shares a similar sense of duty and power, now geared specifically for boxing knockout power.
knockout-jawbreaker.gameplay: Knockout Jawbreaker was released as an exclusive Alter Ego in Skylanders: Lost Islands.
trivia: He is the first Lost Islands exclusive Skylander to be a Trap Master.
'Knockout' was also used for the Series 3 counterpart of Terrafin.

krypt-king.name: Krypt King
krypt-king.description: Krypt King is a haunted suit of armor who is one of the Undead Trap Masters in Skylanders: Trap Team.
krypt-king.biography: The perfect blend of sword and sorcery, Krypt King wandered Skylands for years as the disembodied spirit of a knight – until he found his way into the depths of an ancient Arkeyan weapon vault. Upon finding an enormously powerful suit of armor, the spirit decided to make it his own. Unfortunately, this triggered a long dormant auto defense system. With alarms blaring, a massive sealed chamber was opened, revealing a huge army of war machines. Krypt King launched himself towards the attack force, swinging his newly found giant sword until every machine was utterly destroyed. Realizing the power he wielded could serve a broader purpose, Krypt King sought out the Skylanders and was made a member of the Trap Team, where he now uses his massive Traptanium blade to cut down evil!
krypt-king.personality: Krypt King may look imposing, but he's really just a curious spirit who's looking to settle down with the right suit of armor.
krypt-king.gameplay: Krypt King has great skill over his swordfighting, which can be enhanced by releasing his sword to attack from afar; he can also summon a swarm of undead insects from inside the armor. In Skylanders: Battlecast, he also has the ability to summon mummies from the ground with varying effects, also being able to temporarily haunt one, and summon a powerful Pharaoh's Plague. His Special Ability is Grave Resolve, and his signature Gear is the Titan's Hilt, a gigantic version of his sword. Like the other Trap Masters in the card game, he also has the ability to summon a Trap Relic, containing Masker Mind.

abilities.name: Traptanium Broadsword
abilities.description: Press Attack 1 to swing the Traptanium Broadsword. Press Attack 1, 1 hold 1 for a combo attack.

abilities.name: The Swarm
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 to unleash a swarm of undead insects that seek out enemies

abilities.name: Haunted Sword
abilities.description: Press Attack 3 to release the Traptanium Broadsword and steer it towards enemies

abilities.name: Spectral Slowdown
abilities.description: Haunted Sword slows down all enemies it touches

abilities.name: The Broader the Broadsword
abilities.description: Traptanium Broadsword does extra damage with greater range

abilities.name: Super Swarm
abilities.description: Hold Attack 2 to charge up the swarm attack to unleash a larger swarm

abilities.name: Storm Swords
abilities.description: Critical hits cause swords to rain down upon your enemies

abilities.name: Enchanted Armor
abilities.description: Armor is increased upon defeating an enemy

abilities.name: The Rich Get Richer
abilities.description: Attacks do increased damage after defeating an enemy

abilities.name: Combo Attacks
abilities.description: Press Attack 1, 1, and hold Attack 2 for a Sabre Spin combo. Press Attack 1, 1, hold Attack 3 for a Nether Blast combo.

abilities.name: Stunning Sting
abilities.description: Swarm Attack now stuns enemies

abilities.name: Stir up the Swarm
abilities.description: Hit the swarm with the Traptanium Broadsword to power it up

abilities.name: Parasitic Power
abilities.description: Get Healed by the Swarm after it disappears

trivia: Before Krypt King appeared in Trap Team, he was originally planned as the Magic Giant for Skylanders: Giants. He also had an open rib cage rather than closed.
Arkeyan Duelist's swords to an extent look very similar to Krypt King's earlier sword renditions.

According to a typo from a promotional poster handed out at San Diego Comic Con 2014, his name was originally 'King Kut', a pun based on the Ancient Egyptian pharaoh Tutankhamun, also known as 'King Tut'. The name was most likely changed due to the fact that 'kut' translates to a swear in Dutch.
Krypt King, Thunderbolt, Knight Mare, and Knight Light are the only Trap Masters who have Traptanium swords.
He and Head Rush are the only Trap Masters to have Nitro counterparts. He is the only Nitro Skylander who doesn't have any moves relating to speed.

He, and Chopper were both planned to be in Giants, but were scrapped prior to being revealed in Trap Team. Unlike other characters such as Golden Queen, they underwent few changes to their mechanics and design.
If an enemy is defeated by the second or third slash in his combo, they will have a unique defeat animation.
The Face Your Fears card in Battlecast shows his greatest fear is having his sword destroyed.

In the Signature Series Guide for Skylanders: Trap Team, Krypt King's Soul Gem ability is titled as Unlimited Traptanium Works, which is a likely reference to the anime Fate/stay night: Unlimited Blade Works.

lava-lance-eruptor.name: Lava Lance Eruptor
lava-lance-eruptor.description: Lava Lance Eruptor is the SuperCharger counterpart of Eruptor in Skylanders: SuperChargers. His signature vehicle is the Burn-Cycle.
lava-lance-eruptor.biography: Lava Lance Eruptor is the SuperCharger counterpart of Eruptor in Skylanders: SuperChargers. Born from the depths of a volcano, he utilizes his volcanic nature and a powerful lava lance to fight. His signature vehicle is the Burn-Cycle.
lava-lance-eruptor.personality: Lava Lance Eruptor is bold, fiery, and enthusiastic. He embraces his volcanic heritage, as shown by his motto 'Born to Burn!', and is always ready for high-speed action.
lava-lance-eruptor.gameplay: Lava Lance Eruptor focuses on rapid lance strikes and area-denial with volcanoes. He can dash through enemies and trigger eruptions for massive damage. A unique hidden mechanic allows him to use his lance as a pogo stick by repeatedly pressing Attack 2 while jumping.

abilities.name: Lava Lancing
abilities.description: Rapidly press Attack 1 to unleash a series of lance attacks.

abilities.name: Lance Legwork
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 to spring forward with your lance out to damage enemies along the way.

abilities.name: Hot Spot
abilities.description: Press Attack 3 to spit a magma ball into the ground that burrows towards your enemies. It will create an active volcano that shoots fiery projectiles at nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Lava Joust
abilities.description: Hold Attack 2 to dash for a longer amount of time, damaging enemies along your way.

abilities.name: Lance Advanced
abilities.description: Upgrade your Lance with metal and do more damage.

abilities.name: Lance Cannon
abilities.description: Hold Attack 1 to charge up and throw a super lance that explodes on contact.

abilities.name: Magma Chamber
abilities.description: Press Attack 3 while in the air to cannon ball into the ground creating a lava fountain. Rapidly tap Attack 3 to stay on top of the fountain shooting hot magma all around you.

abilities.name: Hot Feat
abilities.description: Gain an uppercut explosion at the end of dash attacks.

abilities.name: Volcanic Rain

abilities.name: Third Volcano's The Charm

abilities.name: Volatile Volcanoes
