abilities.name: Eruption Conduction
abilities.description: While dashing, your Lance grows extra spikes. Press Attack 3 to shoot the spikes off your Lance causing them to form a volcano where they land.

abilities.name: Cannon Stop Me Now
abilities.description: Your Lance will now regrow spikes over time allowing you to create volcanoes to boost over forever!

trivia: Lava Lance Eruptor and Fryno both use motorcycles. Coincidentally, they are part of the Fire element and have mini counterparts.
After jumping, if you continuously press the second attack button, Lava Lance Eruptor uses his lance as a pogo stick. This is not mentioned in his upgrades though.
He is the only Fire SuperCharger without a dark edition counterpart.
He is also the only Fire SuperCharger without an alt deco.
He is also the only Fire SuperCharger to not be included in a starter pack.
Lava Lance Eruptor is the only reposed character whose Soul Gem plays the 'Rift into Overdrive' theme.

legendary-astroblast.name: Legendary Astroblast
legendary-astroblast.description: Legendary Astroblast is the Legendary counterpart of Astroblast in Skylanders: SuperChargers, featuring a distinct black and gold color scheme.
legendary-astroblast.biography: For centuries, Skylanders have competed in gladiator-style events inside epic arenas of sport, where only the greatest of combatants become immortalized as magical, golden statues that stand watch as guardians. These are the Legendary Skylanders. Whenever the world is in peril, special Portal Masters can bring these statues to life and summon the Legendary Skylanders to defend Skylands against any evil that threatens it.
legendary-astroblast.personality: Legendary Astroblast is a daring and inquisitive explorer of the deep cosmos. He possesses a relentless drive to uncover the mysteries of the universe and defends the Light with unwavering valor, embodying the prestige associated with the Legendary Skylanders.
legendary-astroblast.gameplay: Legendary Astroblast utilizes light-based attacks, including his Solar Flair for long-distance precision and an Asteroid Belt for close-quarters defense. In-game, he features slightly higher stats than his standard counterpart and a unique aesthetic.

abilities.name: Solar Flair
abilities.description: Legendary Astroblast fires a beam of concentrated solar energy at his enemies.

abilities.name: Asteroid Belt
abilities.description: Summon a ring of asteroids to orbit and protect Legendary Astroblast from nearby threats.

abilities.name: Starsault
abilities.description: Perform a powerful aerial maneuver that releases bursts of light energy.

abilities.name: Surface of the Sun
abilities.description: Legendary Astroblast radiates intense heat and light, damaging all surrounding enemies.

abilities.name: Meteor Shower
abilities.description: Call down a devastating rain of meteors from the heavens to crush enemies.

trivia: He is the first Alt Deco Light Skylander.
He is the only Legendary version of a new Skylander in SuperChargers. The other Legendary SuperChargers (Hurricane Jet Vac and Bone Bash Roller Brawl) are from reposed Skylanders.
Additionally, he is the only Legendary SuperCharger to have a Legendary counterpart of his vehicle.

legendary-bash.name: Legendary Bash
legendary-bash.description: Legendary Bash is the Legendary counterpart of Bash, exclusive to the original Toys'R'Us Legendary Pack (with Legendary Chop Chop and Legendary Spyro).
legendary-bash.biography: For centuries, Skylanders have competed in gladiator-style events inside epic arenas of sport, where only the greatest of combatants become immortalized as magical, golden statues that stand watch as guardians. These are the Legendary Skylanders. Whenever the world is in peril, special Portal Masters can bring these statues to life and summon the Legendary Skylanders to defend Skylands against any evil that threatens it.
legendary-bash.personality: As a Legendary Skylander, Legendary Bash is one of the greatest of combatants, immortalized as a magical, golden statue that stands watch as a guardian. He is a defender of Skylands against any evil that threatens it.
legendary-bash.gameplay: Legendary Bash has the same abilities as Bash. His Console Stats are slightly higher, but this has little effect on the actual gameplay. Finding Bash's Soul Gem will also unlock the new ability for Legendary Bash.

abilities.name: Tail Swipe
abilities.description: Swing Bash's spiked tail to damage nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Rock Roll
abilities.description: Curl into a ball and roll over enemies.

abilities.name: Iron Tail
abilities.description: Tail Swipe attacks do increased damage.

abilities.name: Mace of Destruction
abilities.description: Tail Swipe has a longer reach and hits more enemies.

abilities.name: Gaia Hammer
abilities.description: While in Rock Roll, Bash can leap into the air and slam down, creating a shockwave.

trivia: Legendary Bash is the Legendary counterpart of Bash, exclusive to the original Toys'R'Us Legendary Pack.
He has slightly higher Console Stats than the standard Bash, though it has little effect on gameplay.
Finding Bash's Soul Gem will also unlock the new ability for Legendary Bash.
Legendary Bash is voiced by Keith Silverstein.

legendary-blades.name: Legendary Blades
legendary-blades.description: Legendary Blades is the Legendary counterpart of the Air Skylander, Blades, in Skylanders: Trap Team. He is mainly available in the Legendary bundle of the Nightmare Express, along with the Legendary Hand of Fate and the Piggy Bank.
legendary-blades.biography: For centuries, Skylanders have competed in gladiator-style events inside epic arenas of sport, where only the greatest of combatants become immortalized as magical, golden statues that stand watch as guardians. These are the Legendary Skylanders. Whenever the world is in peril, special Portal Masters can bring these statues to life and summon the Legendary Skylanders to defend Skylands against any evil that threatens it.
legendary-blades.personality: Blades is a brave, disciplined dragon with a strong sense of duty and justice. Having spent years guarding a dungeon against intruders, he is always alert and ready for a challenge, possessing a wit as sharp as his metallic wings.
legendary-blades.gameplay: Legendary Blades focuses on high-speed melee combat using his wings and long-range shard projectiles. He can create cyclones to trap enemies and uses his agility to navigate the battlefield quickly, making him a versatile Air element fighter.

abilities.name: Wing Slice
abilities.description: A quick melee strike with metallic wings.

abilities.name: Blade Shards
abilities.description: Shoot sharp shards of metal at enemies.

abilities.name: Cyclone Swirl
abilities.description: Create a spinning cyclone to damage and knock back foes.

abilities.name: Razor Wings
abilities.description: Wing Slice deals increased damage.

abilities.name: Crushing Cyclones
abilities.description: Cyclones deal massive damage and pull in enemies.

abilities.name: Hurricane Whirl
abilities.description: Wing attacks create mini-cyclones.

abilities.name: Razor Sharper
abilities.description: Fires more shards at a faster rate.

trivia: Legendary Blades is a blue and gold color swap of the standard Blades.
He was released exclusively in the Toys 'R' Us Legendary Nightmare Express Adventure Pack.

legendary-bone-bash-roller-brawl.name: Legendary Bone Bash Roller Brawl
legendary-bone-bash-roller-brawl.description: Legendary Bone Bash Roller Brawl is the Legendary counterpart of Bone Bash Roller Brawl in Skylanders: SuperChargers.
legendary-bone-bash-roller-brawl.biography: For centuries, Skylanders have competed in gladiator-style events inside epic arenas of sport, where only the greatest of combatants become immortalized as magical, golden statues that stand watch as guardians. These are the Legendary Skylanders. Whenever the world is in peril, special Portal Masters can bring these statues to life and summon the Legendary Skylanders to defend Skylands against any evil that threatens it.
legendary-bone-bash-roller-brawl.personality: Competitive, tough, and spirited, Legendary Bone Bash Roller Brawl shares the same feisty personality as her standard counterpart, having grown up as the only girl among five older werewolf brothers.
legendary-bone-bash-roller-brawl.gameplay: Legendary Bone Bash Roller Brawl is a high-speed melee fighter who utilizes her roller derby skills and undead abilities. She excels at dashing through groups of enemies and performing rapid, agile strikes that overwhelm her opponents.

abilities.name: Derby_Duke
abilities.description: A powerful melee attack using roller derby skills.

abilities.name: Fangerang
abilities.description: A ranged attack involving sharp vampire fangs.

abilities.name: Love_Bites
abilities.description: A specialized bite attack that drains energy or causes damage.

abilities.name: Serious_Substitution
abilities.description: An evasive maneuver to avoid enemy attacks.

abilities.name: Eat_Pavement
abilities.description: A high-speed dash that knocks enemies to the ground.

trivia: She is the second Legendary vampire Skylander, while Legendary Night Shift is the first.
She and Birthday Bash Big Bubble Pop Fizz currently have the longest name out of all the Skylanders, consisting of a whopping 28 letters. Coincidentally, both have Bash in their name.

legendary-bouncer.name: Legendary Bouncer
legendary-bouncer.description: Legendary Bouncer is the Legendary counterpart of the Tech Giant Bouncer in Skylanders: Giants.
legendary-bouncer.biography: For centuries, Skylanders have competed in gladiator-style events inside epic arenas of sport, where only the greatest of combatants become immortalized as magical, golden statues that stand watch as guardians. These are the Legendary Skylanders. Whenever the world is in peril, special Portal Masters can bring these statues to life and summon the Legendary Skylanders to defend Skylands against any evil that threatens it.
legendary-bouncer.gameplay: These are the starting and maximum Statistics for this Skylander in the Skylanders games.
trivia: If Bouncer is placed on the portal, his eyes glow white and the rim near his waist glows orange, however, Legendary Bouncer's waist and eyes glow white instead.
Legendary Bouncer's wheel is gold on his toy, however, in-game, it is oddly black.

legendary-bushwhack.name: Legendary Bushwhack
legendary-bushwhack.description: Legendary Bushwhack is the Legendary counterpart of the Life Trap Master, Bushwhack, in Skylanders: Trap Team.
legendary-bushwhack.biography: For centuries, Skylanders have competed in gladiator-style events inside epic arenas of sport, where only the greatest of combatants become immortalized as magical, golden statues that stand watch as guardians. These are the Legendary Skylanders. Whenever the world is in peril, special Portal Masters can bring these statues to life and summon the Legendary Skylanders to defend Skylands against any evil that threatens it.
legendary-bushwhack.personality: Legendary Bushwhack is a noble warrior who serves as a guardian of the Arcadian Timberland. As a Legendary Skylander, he represents the pinnacle of combat skill and heroism, immortalized in gold for his deeds.
legendary-bushwhack.gameplay: These are the starting and maximum Statistics for this Skylander in the Skylanders games. Health: 290 (max. 580), Speed: 180 (max. 228), Armor: 18 (max. 48), Critical Hit: 60 (max. 110), Elemental Power: 39 (max. 89).

abilities.name: Traptanium Axe
abilities.description: A powerful strike using the Traptanium Axe.

abilities.name: Mystic Acorn
abilities.description: Throw a Mystic Acorn at enemies.

abilities.name: Headbash
abilities.description: A headbutt attack to stun or damage foes.

abilities.name: An Axe to Grind
abilities.description: An enhanced axe combo for maximum damage.

abilities.name: Bush's Shack
abilities.description: The ultimate shack construction to provide strategic advantages.

trivia: In the artwork, Legendary Bushwhack's acorns are gold on top and navy blue on the bottom. But in the game, the acorns' color schemes are reversed.
The Power Stats (Strength: 250, Defense: 90, Agility: 230, Luck: 70) are listed for completeness but are not used in any of the Skylanders games.

legendary-chill.name: Legendary Chill
legendary-chill.description: Legendary Chill is the Legendary counterpart of LightCore Chill who appeared in Skylanders: Giants. She features a distinct blue and gold color scheme signifying her status as an arena champion.
legendary-chill.biography: For centuries, Skylanders have competed in gladiator-style events inside epic arenas of sport, where only the greatest of combatants become immortalized as magical, golden statues that stand watch as guardians. These are the Legendary Skylanders. Whenever the world is in peril, special Portal Masters can bring these statues to life and summon the Legendary Skylanders to defend Skylands against any evil that threatens it.
legendary-chill.personality: Chill is a noble, stoic, and highly disciplined warrior. Having served as the personal guardian to the Snow Queen, she maintains a serious demeanor and a strong sense of duty, rarely letting her guard down even in the heat of battle.
legendary-chill.gameplay: Legendary Chill excels at medium-range combat and area denial. She throws ice javelins that can pierce through enemies and uses her shield to block incoming projectiles or bash foes. She can also summon ice walls to obstruct enemies and call upon a narwhal to charge through lines of opponents.

abilities.name: Ice Javelin
abilities.description: Throw a sharp ice javelin at enemies from a distance.

abilities.name: Ice Wall
abilities.description: Summon a frozen wall to block enemy attacks and movement.

abilities.name: Glacial Bash
abilities.description: Perform a powerful shield bash that knocks back enemies.

abilities.name: Cold Front
abilities.description: Upgrades the Ice Wall to deal damage to enemies.

abilities.name: Imperial Armor
abilities.description: Increases armor and defensive capabilities.

abilities.name: Call of the Narwhal
abilities.description: Summon a mighty narwhal to crash through enemies in front of you.

abilities.name: Empowered Javelins
abilities.description: Ice javelins deal significantly more damage.

trivia: Legendary Chill is the first LightCore Skylander to be a Legendary Skylander, the second being Legendary Grim Creeper.
Her Narwhal companion is gold instead of the original color.
In Skylanders: Swap Force, her Narwhal is the original color instead of gold.

legendary-chop-chop.name: Legendary Chop Chop
legendary-chop-chop.description: Legendary Chop Chop is the Legendary counterpart of Chop Chop, exclusive to the original Toys 'R' Us Legendary Pack (with Legendary Bash and Legendary Spyro).
legendary-chop-chop.biography: For centuries, Skylanders have competed in gladiator-style events inside epic arenas of sport, where only the greatest of combatants become immortalized as magical, golden statues that stand watch as guardians. These are the Legendary Skylanders. Whenever the world is in peril, special Portal Masters can bring these statues to life and summon the Legendary Skylanders to defend Skylands against any evil that threatens it.
legendary-chop-chop.personality: Legendary Chop Chop is a stoic and disciplined warrior. Having been an elite member of the Arkeyan guard, he possesses an unbreakable sense of duty and a cold, calculating approach to combat. He rarely speaks outside of his battle cries, preferring to let his sword and shield do the talking.
legendary-chop-chop.gameplay: Legendary Chop Chop plays as a melee brawler with strong defensive capabilities. He can chain sword strikes for high DPS or use his shield to block incoming projectiles and negate damage. His playstyle allows for a high-risk, high-reward approach by absorbing energy with his shield to unleash powerful counterattacks.

abilities.name: Sword Slash
abilities.description: Perform a quick slash with the Arkeyan Blade.

abilities.name: Arkeyan Shield
abilities.description: Raise your shield to block attacks.

abilities.name: Spiked Shield Bash
abilities.description: Shield bash deals more damage and has spikes.

abilities.name: Arkeyan Vorpal Blade
abilities.description: Sword deals increased damage.

abilities.name: Vampiric Aura
abilities.description: Sword attacks now provide health when they damage enemies.

abilities.name: Triple Slash
abilities.description: Adds a third hit to the sword combo.

trivia: Skylanders: Giants has a glitch where it is impossible for him to obtain the Quest Rank of Gold to wear the Gold Top Hat.
It is now possible for him to wear the Gold Top Hat from Skylanders: Swap Force.
English voice actor: Steven Blum (2012).

legendary-deja-vu.name: Legendary Déjà Vu
legendary-deja-vu.description: Legendary Déjà Vu is the Legendary counterpart of the Magic Skylander, Déjà Vu, in Skylanders: Trap Team.
legendary-deja-vu.biography: For centuries, Skylanders have competed in gladiator-style events inside epic arenas of sport, where only the greatest of combatants become immortalized as magical, golden statues that stand watch as guardians. These are the Legendary Skylanders. Whenever the world is in peril, special Portal Masters can bring these statues to life and summon the Legendary Skylanders to defend Skylands against any evil that threatens it.
legendary-deja-vu.personality: Legendary Déjà Vu is a calculated and strategic combatant. She relies on her temporal abilities to remain several steps ahead of her enemies, displaying a calm and confident demeanor in the heat of battle.
legendary-deja-vu.gameplay: Legendary Déjà Vu uses her time-based powers to create clones of herself from the past to assist in combat. She can also set a time marker to teleport back to a previous position and health state, allowing for high survivability and tactical movement.
trivia: There's a glitch in Skylanders: SuperChargers where her eyes will be black during the Magic Moment.

legendary-free-ranger.name: Legendary Free Ranger
legendary-free-ranger.description: Legendary Free Ranger is the Legendary counterpart of Free Ranger in Skylanders: Swap Force.
legendary-free-ranger.biography: For centuries, Skylanders have competed in gladiator-style events inside epic arenas of sport, where only the greatest of combatants become immortalized as magical, golden statues that stand watch as guardians. These are the Legendary Skylanders. Whenever the world is in peril, special Portal Masters can bring these statues to life and summon the Legendary Skylanders to defend Skylands against any evil that threatens it.
legendary-free-ranger.gameplay: These are the starting and maximum Statistics for this Skylander in the Skylanders games.
trivia: Even though Legendary Free Ranger's eyes are white in both artwork and figure forms, his eyes are gold only within the game.
Also his windblades are silver within the game while they're gold in both artwork and figure forms.
On some of his name stickers, the label incorrectly puts Legendary Free Ranger as a Life Skylander.
This error also happened to Grinnade, a Fire villain from Skylanders: Trap Team.

legendary-grim-creeper.name: Legendary Grim Creeper
legendary-grim-creeper.description: Legendary Grim Creeper is the Legendary counterpart of LightCore Grim Creeper in Skylanders: Swap Force.
legendary-grim-creeper.biography: For centuries, Skylanders have competed in gladiator-style events inside epic arenas of sport, where only the greatest of combatants become immortalized as magical, golden statues that stand watch as guardians. abilities.name: Scythe Swing

abilities.name: Ghost Form
abilities.description: Grim Creeper leaves his armor to move quickly as a ghost.

abilities.name: Sphere of Fear
abilities.description: Create a sphere of energy that damages enemies over time.

abilities.name: It's Alive!
abilities.description: The armor attacks on its own while Grim Creeper is in Ghost Form.

abilities.name: Polterguest Scythe
abilities.description: The scythe attacks deal significantly more damage.

abilities.name: Ghosterizer

trivia: Legendary LightCore Grim Creeper is the second Legendary figure to be LightCore, the first being Legendary Chill.

legendary-hurricane-jet-vac.name: Legendary Hurricane Jet-Vac
legendary-hurricane-jet-vac.description: Legendary Hurricane Jet-Vac is the Legendary counterpart of Hurricane Jet-Vac in Skylanders: SuperChargers.
legendary-hurricane-jet-vac.biography: For centuries, Skylanders have competed in gladiator-style events inside epic arenas of sport, where only the greatest of combatants become immortalized as magical, golden statues that stand watch as guardians. These are the Legendary Skylanders. Whenever the world is in peril, special Portal Masters can bring these statues to life and summon the Legendary Skylanders to defend Skylands against any evil that threatens it.
legendary-hurricane-jet-vac.personality: Jet-Vac is a noble and disciplined Sky Baron who takes his responsibilities as a Skylander very seriously. He is brave, loyal, and adheres strictly to a code of honor, though his serious nature is often contrasted by his high-flying heroic antics.
legendary-hurricane-jet-vac.gameplay: Legendary Hurricane Jet-Vac utilizes a high-powered vacuum gun and a specialized flight suit. He can blast compressed air at enemies, suck them into his turbine for damage, and perform quick aerial dashes to avoid incoming attacks.

abilities.name: Shooting the Breeze
abilities.description: Fire a blast of compressed air from the vacuum gun.

abilities.name: Jet Turbine Vacuum
abilities.description: Suck in enemies and debris with the powerful vacuum turbine.

abilities.name: Somer-Assault
abilities.description: Perform an aerial somersault that knocks back enemies.

abilities.name: Turbulent Turbine
abilities.description: Enhance the Jet Turbine Vacuum to deal continuous damage.

abilities.name: Eagle-Air Battery
abilities.description: Increases the duration and power of the vacuum suction.

abilities.name: Category Pain
abilities.description: The vacuum suction creates a powerful vortex that deals massive damage.

trivia: He is the second Legendary counterpart of Jet-Vac, making him the first Skylander to have two Legendary counterparts.

legendary-ignitor.name: Legendary Ignitor
legendary-ignitor.description: Legendary Ignitor is a playable Legendary version of Ignitor in Skylanders: Giants.
legendary-ignitor.biography: For centuries, Skylanders have competed in gladiator-style events inside epic arenas of sport, where only the greatest of combatants become immortalized as magical, golden statues that stand watch as guardians. These are the Legendary Skylanders. Whenever the world is in peril, special Portal Masters can bring these statues to life and summon the Legendary Skylanders to defend Skylands against any evil that threatens it.
legendary-ignitor.personality: Legendary Ignitor is a brave and valiant warrior who upholds the principles of chivalry. Despite being a spirit of fire trapped in a suit of armor, he remains steadfast, heroic, and always ready to dive headfirst into battle to defend the innocent.
legendary-ignitor.gameplay: Legendary Ignitor is a melee-focused character who uses his massive Flaming Sword to deliver devastating strikes. His primary gameplay mechanic involves switching between his armored form for defense and his Flame Form for speed and area-of-effect damage. He excels at close-quarters combat and can unleash fire-based projectiles by swinging his sword.
trivia: Legendary Ignitor was originally a Toys 'R' Us exclusive figure.
His stats are higher than the standard Ignitor counterpart.
In Skylanders: Giants, he is one of the four Legendary Skylanders available.

legendary-jawbreaker.name: Legendary Jawbreaker
legendary-jawbreaker.description: Legendary Jawbreaker is the Legendary counterpart of the Tech Trap Master, Jawbreaker, in Skylanders: Trap Team. He features a distinct gold and blue color scheme, signifying his status as a champion of the arenas.
legendary-jawbreaker.biography: For centuries, Skylanders have competed in gladiator-style events inside epic arenas of sport, where only the greatest of combatants become immortalized as magical, golden statues that stand watch as guardians. These are the Legendary Skylanders. Whenever the world is in peril, special Portal Masters can bring these statues to life and summon the Legendary Skylanders to defend Skylands against any evil that threatens it.
legendary-jawbreaker.personality: Legendary Jawbreaker is a disciplined and focused guardian. Driven by a sense of order and justice, he approaches every battle with robotic precision and the heart of a champion. He is known for his unwavering dedication to protecting Skylands.
legendary-jawbreaker.gameplay: Legendary Jawbreaker is a heavy-hitting melee fighter. His gameplay revolves around chaining fast punches and using his Robo Rage mode to increase his attack speed. As a Trap Master, he deals increased damage to trappable villains and can break Traptanium shards found throughout the world.

abilities.name: Traptanium Punch
abilities.description: Punch enemies with Traptanium fists. Press Attack 1 repeatedly for a combo.

abilities.name: Robo Rage Mode
abilities.description: Enter a state of high-speed punching and increased power.

abilities.name: Static Cling
abilities.description: Attacks have a chance to shock enemies, dealing extra damage over time.

abilities.name: Jolting Jab
abilities.description: A powerful forward dash punch that knocks back enemies.

abilities.name: Overclocked
abilities.description: Robo Rage mode lasts longer and significantly increases movement speed.

abilities.name: Heavyweight Combo
abilities.description: Adds a powerful finisher to the primary punch combo.

trivia: He is the Legendary variant of the character Jawbreaker.
In Skylanders: Trap Team, his statue is located in the Hall of Legends.
His primary weapon is his Traptanium fists.

legendary-jet-vac.name: Legendary Jet-Vac
legendary-jet-vac.description: Legendary Jet-Vac is the Legendary counterpart of Jet-Vac in Skylanders: Giants. He is in a Legendary 3-pack with Legendary Ignitor and Legendary Slam Bam. He has a SuperCharger counterpart called Legendary Hurricane Jet-Vac.
legendary-jet-vac.biography: For centuries, Skylanders have competed in gladiator-style events inside epic arenas of sport, where only the greatest of combatants become immortalized as magical, golden statues that stand watch as guardians. These are the Legendary Skylanders. Whenever the world is in peril, special Portal Masters can bring these statues to life and summon the Legendary Skylanders to defend Skylands against any evil that threatens it.
legendary-jet-vac.personality: Not mentioned in the biography, though as a Legendary Skylander, he is one of the greatest combatants and guardians of Skylands.
legendary-jet-vac.gameplay: In Skylanders: Giants, Legendary Jet-Vac features a starting Health of 240, Speed of 50, Armor of 18, and a Critical Hit rate of 20. These can reach a maximum of 480 Health, 98 Speed, 48 Armor, and 70 Critical Hit. Additionally, his power stats—though not utilized in gameplay—are listed as Strength 60, Defense 50, Agility 80, and Luck 85. Elemental Power is listed as ??.

abilities.name: Vac Blaster
abilities.description: Primary attack. Uses the Vac Blaster.

abilities.name: Suction Gun
abilities.description: Secondary attack. Uses the Suction Gun.

abilities.name: Jet Vac Jet Pack
abilities.description: An upgrade for Jet-Vac's jet pack.

abilities.name: Vac Blaster 9000
abilities.description: An advanced version of the Vac Blaster.

abilities.name: Fiester Fan
abilities.description: The ultimate soul gem ability for Legendary Jet-Vac.

trivia: He slightly resembles a peregrine falcon, despite his catchphrase being 'Hawk and Awe'.
His name is a play on 'jet-pack'.
He is the third Alter Ego Skylander to have a repose (The first being Dark Spyro and the second being Dark Stealth Elf).
He is the only one of the three to be a Legendary counterpart. The rest are Dark edition counterparts.
In Imaginators, when viewing the Skylanders collection, his character icon is the same as in Giants, but in regular gameplay, it shows the icon for his SuperCharger counterpart instead.
He shares the same problem with Dark Super Shot Stealth Elf.

legendary-night-shift.name: Legendary Night Shift
legendary-night-shift.description: Legendary Night Shift is a Legendary counterpart of Night Shift, released for Skylanders: Swap Force. He is of the Undead element. His Swap Force Ability is Teleport.
legendary-night-shift.biography: For centuries, Skylanders have competed in gladiator-style events inside epic arenas of sport, where only the greatest of combatants become immortalized as magical, golden statues that stand watch as guardians. These are the Legendary Skylanders. Whenever the world is in peril, special Portal Masters can bring these statues to life and summon the Legendary Skylanders to defend Skylands against any evil that threatens it.
legendary-night-shift.personality: A competitive fighter who embodies the spirit of the Legendary Skylanders, maintaining a champion's discipline in battle.
legendary-night-shift.gameplay: Legendary Night Shift is an Undead element Skylander with boxing-style combat. His Swap Force Ability is Teleport, allowing him to bypass obstacles and access Teleport Zones.

abilities.name: One-Two Punch
abilities.description: A primary boxing attack involving a quick combination of punches.

abilities.name: Ethereal Shift
abilities.description: A secondary move that allows the character to shift into an ethereal form to avoid damage and move through enemies.

abilities.name: Vampire's Bite
abilities.description: An upgrade to his combat style, allowing for health-draining bites.

abilities.name: Float Like a Vampire
abilities.description: Enhanced movement and agility, making the character harder to hit.

abilities.name: Infectious Smile
abilities.description: A powerful Soul Gem ability that affects nearby enemies with a terrifying smile.

legendary-pit-boss.name: Legendary Pit Boss
legendary-pit-boss.description: Legendary Pit Boss is a Legendary counterpart of Pit Boss in Skylanders: Imaginators.
legendary-pit-boss.biography: For centuries, Skylanders have competed in gladiator-style events inside epic arenas of sport, where only the greatest of combatants become immortalized as magical, golden statues that stand watch as guardians. These are the Legendary Skylanders. Whenever the world is in peril, special Portal Masters can bring these statues to life and summon the Legendary Skylanders to defend Skylands against any evil that threatens it.
legendary-pit-boss.personality: As a Legendary Skylander, Legendary Pit Boss is a noble guardian of Skylands. While much of his individual personality is reflected in his counterpart Pit Boss, he is characterized by his dedication to justice and his role as a summoned protector in times of peril.
legendary-pit-boss.gameplay: Legendary Pit Boss is a Sorcerer class Sensei. He uses a combination of direct strikes and summoned serpents to control the battlefield. His stats prioritize Strength and Agility, making him a fast and powerful magic user in the arena.

abilities.name: Snake Attack
abilities.description: Legendary Pit Boss strikes enemies with a quick snake-like attack.

abilities.name: Slithering Soul Snake
abilities.description: Summons a slithering soul snake to haunt and damage enemies.

abilities.name: Viper Pits
abilities.description: Legendary Pit Boss creates viper pits that deal damage to those who step in them.

abilities.name: Superior Slithering
abilities.description: Improves slithering movement, allowing for better battlefield positioning.

abilities.name: Restless Reptiles
abilities.description: A powerful attack where restless reptiles swarm the area to attack enemies.

trivia: Like Legendary Tri-Tip, he has red in his color scheme instead of dark blue.
Unlike his official artwork and figure form, Legendary Pit Boss's scepter is reversed in color schemes.

legendary-skylanders.name: Legendary Skylanders
legendary-skylanders.description: Legendary Skylanders are stronger versions of regular Skylanders in the Skylanders franchise, though they have exactly the same upgrades and Heroic Challenges. They all commonly take on the color schemes of navy blue and gold, although the Legendary Senseis instead wear prestigious Legendary red and gold armor.
legendary-skylanders.biography: For centuries, Skylanders have competed in gladiator-style events inside epic arenas of sport, where only the greatest of combatants become immortalized as magical, golden statues that stand and watch as guardians. These are the Legendary Skylanders. Whenever the world is in peril, special Portal Masters can bring these statues to life and summon the Legendary Skylanders to defend Skylands against any evil that threatens it.
legendary-skylanders.personality: Immortalized for their greatness in gladiatorial arenas, these Skylanders serve as magical guardians who stand ready to be brought to life by Portal Masters when the world is in peril.
legendary-skylanders.gameplay: Legendary Skylanders are stronger versions of regular Skylanders. They possess exactly the same upgrades and Heroic Challenges as their standard counterparts, but feature enhanced stats. Their appearance is distinct, traditionally featuring navy blue and gold or red and gold color schemes.
trivia: Legendary Skylanders are commonly exclusive to Toys R' Us.
In games beyond Skylanders: Giants, the older Legendary Skylanders take on a deep navy blue color.
In Spyro's Adventure, the Legendary Series 2 Skylanders from Giants (Slam Bam, Ignitor and Stealth Elf) are displayed as their original counterparts.

In Spyro's Adventure and Giants, the number of Legendary Skylanders is similar to the number of Skylanders in each element. In Spyro's Adventure, there are four Legendary Skylanders which is the same number for each element. In Giants, there is one Legendary Giant, one Legendary LightCore Skylander, three Legendary Series 2 Skylanders and one Legendary new core Skylander, relating to what each element contains.
Giants and SuperChargers are the only games to add Legendary versions of reposed Skylanders. Unlike the Series 2 Legendaries, the Legendary SuperCharger reposes are not backwards-compatible.
The Legendary Skylanders from Spyro's Adventure did not get a release in Japan.
Jet-Vac is currently the only Skylander with two Legendary counterparts.
Dark is currently the only element without any Legendary counterparts.
Undead currently has the highest amount of Legendary Skylanders.
Giants introduced the highest amount of Legendary Skylanders, with 6. While Imaginators introduced the lowest amount, with just 2.
Trap Team introduced the highest amount of Legendary Items, with 4. While SuperChargers introduced the lowest amount, with just 1.

legendary-slam-bam.name: Legendary Slam Bam
legendary-slam-bam.description: Legendary Slam Bam is the playable Legendary counterpart of Slam Bam in Skylanders: Giants.
legendary-slam-bam.biography: For centuries, Skylanders have competed in gladiator-style events inside epic arenas of sport, where only the greatest of combatants become immortalized as magical, golden statues that stand watch as guardians. These are the Legendary Skylanders. Whenever the world is in peril, special Portal Masters can bring these statues to life and summon the Legendary Skylanders to defend Skylands against any evil that threatens it.

abilities.name: Yeti Fists
abilities.description: Slam Bam uses his four arms to deliver powerful punches to his enemies.

abilities.name: Ice Prison
abilities.description: Create a block of ice to trap and freeze enemies in their tracks.

abilities.name: Arctic Explosion
abilities.description: A powerful icy blast that damages surrounding enemies.

abilities.name: Yeti Ice Shoes
abilities.description: Icy shoes that allow Slam Bam to slide across the ground.

abilities.name: Ice Knuckles
abilities.description: Increases the power and reach of Slam Bam's punches.

trivia: Before upgrading Legendary Slam Bam, the only thing golden is his nails.
If you choose the Glacier Hit path and fully upgrade Legendary Slam Bam, the only thing golden will be his nails and eyewear.

Legendary Slam Bam and Starcast are similar in the following ways: Both have four arms. Both have a gold and dark blue color scheme. Both are hunched and have hair on the back of their heads. However, it's unclear if Starcast's 'hair' is actually some sort of fur or is another material.

legendary-spyro.name: Legendary Spyro
legendary-spyro.description: Legendary Spyro is the Legendary counterpart of Spyro from Skylanders: Spyro's Adventure, exclusive to the original Toys' R' Us Legendary Pack (with Legendary Chop Chop and Legendary Bash). In the United States, the legendary three pack was sold exclusively through the Toys R' Us chain of toy stores for a limited time.
legendary-spyro.biography: For centuries, Skylanders have competed in gladiator-style events inside epic arenas of sport, where only the greatest of combatants become immortalized as magical, golden statues that stand watch as guardians. These are the Legendary Skylanders. Whenever the world is in peril, special Portal Masters can bring these statues to life and summon the Legendary Skylanders to defend Skylands against any evil that threatens it.
legendary-spyro.personality: Legendary Spyro is a skilled and versatile combatant, recognized for his legendary status and prowess in the arenas of sport. He shares the same courageous and determined traits as his standard counterpart.
legendary-spyro.gameplay: Much like his normal counterpart, Legendary Spyro can charge at his enemies and knock down obstacles with his horns whilst infusing them with the element of fire. Being a dragon he also has the ability to fly. In gameplay terms, Legendary Spyro is a versatile character, being both effective at close range combat with his Charge and Earth Pound attacks, and capable at mid and long-range combat with his Flameballs. His upgrade paths either let him specialize in large area of effect damage with his Flameball's firebreath, or adding additional strength to his Charge. His upgrades are also the same as normal Spyro.

abilities.name: Fire Breath
abilities.description: Legendary Spyro shoots a fireball at enemies.

abilities.name: Horn Charge
abilities.description: Legendary Spyro charges with his horns to knock down obstacles and enemies.

abilities.name: Spyro's Flight
abilities.description: Legendary Spyro takes to the air.

abilities.name: Triple Flameballs
abilities.description: Shoot three flameballs at once.

abilities.name: Fire Shield
abilities.description: A powerful fire shield that protects and damages nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Sheep Burner
abilities.description: Flameball's firebreath deals large area of effect damage.

abilities.name: Blitz Spyro
abilities.description: Additional strength and damage for the Horn Charge.

trivia: He has the same promotional art as Dark Spyro, despite having regular Spyro's catchphrase.
This is the only version of Spyro without a Mega Ram toy.

legendary-stealth-elf.name: Legendary Stealth Elf
legendary-stealth-elf.description: Legendary Stealth Elf is the Legendary counterpart of Series 2 Stealth Elf.
legendary-stealth-elf.biography: For centuries, Skylanders have competed in gladiator-style events inside epic arenas of sport, where only the greatest of combatants become immortalized as magical, golden statues that stand watch as guardians. These are the Legendary Skylanders. Whenever the world is in peril, special Portal Masters can bring these statues to life and summon the Legendary Skylanders to defend Skylands against any evil that threatens it.
legendary-stealth-elf.personality: As a Legendary Skylander, Legendary Stealth Elf is a master of stealth and combat, dedicated to protecting Skylands with speed and precision. She is silent, disciplined, and deadly in battle.
legendary-stealth-elf.gameplay: Legendary Stealth Elf is a fast-paced melee fighter who uses her Dragonfang Daggers and stealth abilities to outmaneuver enemies. She can create decoys to confuse opponents while closing in for rapid-fire slashing attacks. In Skylanders: Giants, she benefits from improved stats as a Legendary hero.

abilities.name: Blade Slash
abilities.description: A quick melee attack with her daggers.

abilities.name: Stealthier Decoy
abilities.description: Creates a decoy to distract enemies while turning invisible.

abilities.name: Dragonfang Daggers
abilities.description: Upgraded daggers that deal increased damage.

abilities.name: Elf Jitsu
abilities.description: A powerful martial arts technique that enhances her combat prowess.

abilities.name: Arboreal Acrobatics
abilities.description: A powerful acrobatic move exclusive to Series 2 Stealth Elf.

trivia: She slightly resembles Jago from the Killer Instinct series.
For some unknown reason, in Arbor Day, her leggings are gold instead of dark blue.

legendary-tri-tip.name: Legendary Tri-Tip
legendary-tri-tip.description: Legendary Tri-Tip is the Legendary counterpart of Tri-Tip in Skylanders: Imaginators.
legendary-tri-tip.biography: For centuries, Skylanders have competed in gladiator-style events inside epic arenas of sport, where only the greatest of combatants become immortalized as magical, golden statues that stand watch as guardians. These are the Legendary Skylanders. Whenever the world is in peril, special Portal Masters can bring these statues to life and summon the Legendary Skylanders to defend Skylands against any evil that threatens it. Legendary Tri-Tip has earned the honor to wear the prestigious Legendary Red and Gold Armor.
legendary-tri-tip.personality: As a Legendary Sensei, Tri-Tip is a disciplined and powerful guardian of Skylands, honored for his combat prowess.
legendary-tri-tip.gameplay: Legendary Tri-Tip is an Earth Smasher who uses his mace and triceratops strength to dominate the battlefield.

abilities.name: Mace Smash
abilities.description: Tri-Tip swings his mighty mace to crush enemies.

abilities.name: Dino Dash
abilities.description: Tri-Tip charges forward to knock back foes.

abilities.name: Summon Fossil Traps
abilities.description: Summons fossil traps to entangle enemies.

abilities.name: Mightier Mace
abilities.description: Increases the power of mace attacks.

abilities.name: Historic Preservation
abilities.description: An ancient preservation technique that grants ultimate power.

trivia: Unlike the previous Legendary Skylanders, Legendary Tri Tip has red instead of dark blue in his color scheme. This also happens with Legendary Pit Boss.

legendary-trigger-happy.name: Legendary Trigger Happy
legendary-trigger-happy.description: Legendary Trigger Happy is the Legendary counterpart of Trigger Happy. Unlike the other Legendary characters in Skylanders: Spyro's Adventure, Legendary Trigger Happy is not available in the Legendary Character 3-pack (Legendary Bash, Legendary Chop Chop, and Legendary Spyro).
legendary-trigger-happy.biography: For centuries, Skylanders have competed in gladiator-style events inside epic arenas of sport, where only the greatest of combatants become immortalized as magical, golden statues that stand watch as guardians. These are the Legendary Skylanders. Whenever the world is in peril, special Portal Masters can bring these statues to life and summon the Legendary Skylanders to defend Skylands against any evil that threatens it.
legendary-trigger-happy.personality: Legendary Trigger Happy embodies the same chaotic, gold-loving personality as his regular counterpart, but with an intensified sense of glory and an aura of ancient power. He is reckless, obsessed with treasure, and always ready for a fight, believing that more gold means more power and more fun. His legendary status only fuels his boisterous and confident demeanor.
legendary-trigger-happy.gameplay: Like his normal counterpart, Legendary Trigger Happy can fire a barrage of gold coins at his enemies from his two guns. He can also hurl a pot of gold, fire away at his opponents using a machine gun filled with coins, and release two yellow beams from his guns after charging them up.

abilities.name: Gold Coin Shooters
abilities.description: Legendary Trigger Happy fires a barrage of gold coins at his enemies from his two guns.

abilities.name: Safe Cracker Bomb
abilities.description: Hurls a safe-cracker bomb to damage enemies in an area.

abilities.name: Pot O' Gold
abilities.description: Legendary Trigger Happy can hurl a pot of gold at his opponents.

abilities.name: Golden Super Charge
abilities.description: Charges up guns to release two yellow beams.

abilities.name: Coinsplosion
abilities.description: Fire away at opponents using a machine gun filled with coins.

trivia: In the game, Legendary Trigger Happy is light blue but his toy form color is much darker, almost blackish.
He has gold teeth, but in his toy form, they are white.

legendary-zoo-lou.name: Legendary Zoo Lou
legendary-zoo-lou.description: Legendary Zoo Lou is the Legendary counterpart of Zoo Lou in Skylanders: Swap Force.
legendary-zoo-lou.biography: For centuries, Skylanders have competed in gladiator-style events inside epic arenas of sport, where only the greatest of combatants become immortalized as magical, golden statues that stand watch as guardians. These are the Legendary Skylanders. Whenever the world is in peril, special Portal Masters can bring these statues to life and summon the Legendary Skylanders to defend Skylands against any evil that threatens it.
legendary-zoo-lou.personality: As a Legendary Skylander, he is a dedicated guardian of Skylands, recognized as one of the greatest combatants immortalized in golden statues.
legendary-zoo-lou.gameplay: Legendary Zoo Lou features animal-summoning combat. Notably, he does not jump as high as other Skylanders.

abilities.name: Piggyback Ride
abilities.description: Lou uses his staff to smack enemies.

abilities.name: Raging Boar
abilities.description: Lou summons a spectral boar to charge at enemies.

abilities.name: Swoop Re-Loop
abilities.description: An upgraded attack involving bird spirits.

abilities.name: Thicker Pigskin
abilities.description: Increases the defense of the summoned boar.

abilities.name: Hunger of the Wolf
abilities.description: A powerful soul gem attack where a wolf spirit is summoned.

trivia: Legendary Zoo Lou doesn't jump as high as the other Skylanders.
His staff is blue in his artwork, but is golden in-game and on his figure.
His shirt is gold on his artwork and figure, but is blue in-game.
In his artwork, the animal spirits are also blue. However in-game they are green, just like regular Zoo Lou's.

light-flashwing.name: Light Flashwing
light-flashwing.description: Light Flashwing is a Light elemental alter ego of the Earth Skylander Flashwing in Skylanders: Ring of Heroes.
light-flashwing.biography: Light Flashwing is the alter ego the jewel dragon Flashwing. The shiny crystals of Flashwing shows off its brilliance with the light. If the rock dragon, Bash, had originally met Light Flashwing and not the original ego, his love for her would've gone out of control. It's just an imagination, but just thinking about it makes you happy. But the power of Light Flashwing in the battlefield is not just an imagination, it actually helps the allies and defeats enemies. Look forward to her brilliant performance!
light-flashwing.personality: Light Flashwing is a radiant and helpful ally, described as a brilliant performer on the battlefield whose presence can be quite overwhelming to certain others like Bash.
light-flashwing.gameplay: Light Flashwing wields power over the Light element. Her moveset consists of using her crystals to project light lasers and heals her allies with crystal particles she releases.

abilities.name: Light Ray
abilities.description: [1 enemy] Inflicts 23% of ATK as damage to 1 enemy 3 time(s), and recovers the HP of the ally with the lowest HP ratio by 15% of your MAX HP.

abilities.name: Spinning Crystal
abilities.description: [All Allies] Grants a [Shield] Effect that's proportionate to 10% of the ally's MAX HP on the ally for 1 turn(s).

abilities.name: Light Crystal Lighthouse (Passive)
abilities.description: Grants the [Debuff Effect Immunity] Effect on yourself for 1 turn(s) if your Endurance is below 1 when the turn begins.

abilities.name: Crystal Dust (Leader)
abilities.description: [All Allies] Increases your MAX HP by 10% in battle. Increases the MAX HP of team members by 10% in battle.

trivia: She and Shadow Spyro are both alter ego dragons whose original counterparts are from another element.
She and Light Hex are both female Light elemental counterparts of Skylanders from another element.
The Light elemental symbol can be seen on Light Flashwing's chest, replacing the Earth symbol.

light-hex.name: Light Hex
light-hex.description: Light Hex is a Light element alter ego of the Undead Skylander Hex, in Skylanders: Ring of Heroes. Though she is also a support character like her original counterpart, she works with buffs instead of debuffs, becoming more powerful and even taking them from her opponents.
light-hex.biography: Light Hex is the alter ego of the undead elf wizard Hex. This ego refuses to go back to being a talented wizard before becoming an undead. She used to control powerful magic in the past, but she was also clearly conceited - she turned into an undead because of her recklessness. Therefore, Light Hex accepts the power of the Light Element to embrace her allies, instead of the power that was strong yet cold-hearted. Of course, when it comes to dealing with evil forces, she will burn her enemies with the magic of light!
light-hex.catchphrase: Of course, when it comes to dealing with evil forces, she will burn her enemies with the magic of light!
light-hex.personality: Light Hex is a more compassionate version of Hex, choosing to embrace her allies with the power of light rather than using cold-hearted magic. While she was once conceited and reckless, leading to her undead state, she now accepts her role as a support Skylander, though she remains fierce against evil forces and is willing to burn them with light magic.
light-hex.gameplay: In Skylanders: Ring of Heroes, Light Hex is a support character that works with buffs instead of debuffs, becoming more powerful and even taking them from her opponents. She focuses on copying enemy beneficial effects and providing recovery and skill cooldown reduction for her allies. By accepting the power of the Light Element, she embraces her allies instead of relying on the cold-hearted powers of her past.

abilities.name: Light Marble
abilities.description: [1 enemy] Inflicts 40% of ATK as damage 2 time(s) to 1 enemy, and inflicts 20% of ATK as damage to 1 random enemy 2 more times if you possess 3+ buff effects.

abilities.name: Vanish into Thin Air
abilities.description: [1 Enemy] Inflicts 60% of ATK as damage to 1 enemy. Additionally, copies 1 random beneficial effect of the target to all enemies with a 70% chance if the target possesses beneficial effects.

abilities.name: Light Rain
abilities.description: [All Allies] After charging for 3 turns, decreases the cooldown time of all skills of all allies by 1 turn.

abilities.name: Recovery Light
abilities.description: [All Allies] Recovers all allies by 10% of each target's MAX HP whenever you're designated as the attack target for the 6th time. (Not counted when the attack is evaded.)

abilities.name: Light Acceleration
abilities.description: [All Allies] Light Hex's charging skills will be changed temporarily to be [instantly activated] if you have 4+ buff effects when the turn begins. (Not applied if charging is already in progress.) Additionally, increases your Effect Resistance Rate by 15% in battle. Leader Effect: Increases the Effect Resistance Rate of allies by 15% in battle.

trivia: Though Light Hex's first ability is called Lightcore Orbs, only her regular counterpart in the game has the LightCore appearance. In the Reboot Update, the ability name was adjusted.
She was temporarily absent in the revamped version of Ring of Heroes, up until the Guardian Subjugation update on March 2021.
As of Ring of Heroes, Light Hex is the only Light-aligned undead creature.

light-jet-vac.name: Light Jet-Vac
light-jet-vac.description: Light Jet-Vac provides battle support for his allies using the Light element. He was a Light element alter-ego of the Air Skylander Jet-Vac in the beta and 1.0 version of Skylanders: Ring of Heroes. Though he had the same stats as his regular counterpart, he had an extra skill for a more aggressive approach to healing.
light-jet-vac.biography: Light Jet-Vac was a Light element alter-ego of the Air Skylander Jet-Vac in the beta and 1.0 version of Skylanders: Ring of Heroes. Though he had the same stats as his regular counterpart, he had an extra skill for a more aggressive approach to healing. He was the only male Light elemental counterpart of a Skylander from another element. He provided battle support for his allies using the Light element and was known for a notorious laugh, which was distinct from his regular counterpart.
light-jet-vac.personality: Noble and brave, Light Jet-Vac is a dedicated Sky Baron who adheres to a strict sense of duty. While typically serious, this version is known for a notorious laugh when idling, showcasing a slightly more aggressive and confident persona compared to his Air counterpart. He blurs the line between support and offense with his vacuum technology.
light-jet-vac.gameplay: Light Jet-Vac provides battle support for his allies using the Light element. He features a mix of defensive shielding with his Vac Blaster and powerful team healing with Shoot the Breeze!, allowing for a more aggressive support role. His passive gear allows him to recover HP and restore endurance to allies after taking hits.

abilities.name: Vac Blaster (Active)
abilities.description: [1 enemy] Blasts a gust of air towards the enemy and gains a [SHIELD] for 2 turn(s).

abilities.name: Shoot the Breeze! (Active)
abilities.description: [All Allies] [Heals] all allies in proportion to his max HP. Grants [Wide Range DMG DOWN] on all allies for 1 turn (s).

abilities.name: Eagle-Air Gear (Passive)
abilities.description: [SELF] For every 5 attacks received, heals a small amount of HP and restocks [Endurance by 10] of the ally with the lowest Endurance. Further grants [Strength] for 2 turn(s).

trivia: Because of his element change, Light Jet-Vac's belt symbol is changed as well.
While regular Jet-Vac had a generic sound effect when idling, Light Jet-Vac had a notorious laugh, which oddly isn't heard in other games or in the TV show.
Light Jet Vac was the only male Light elemental counterpart of a Skylander from another element.
He was also the only Light Skylander absent in the revamped version of Ring of Heroes.
He and Shadow Spitfire are the only Skylanders from the beta and 1.0 version of ROH absent in the revamp.

lightcore-skylanders.name: LightCore Skylanders
lightcore-skylanders.description: LightCore Skylanders are special versions of characters introduced in Skylanders: Giants that call upon the power of the Core of Light to ignite their own light from within, causing them to glow when placed on the Portal of Power.
lightcore-skylanders.biography: LightCore Skylanders are playable characters introduced in Skylanders: Giants. The Skylanders are protectors of the Core of Light, and in times of peril, they can call upon its power to ignite their own light from within and radiate with magic, becoming known as LightCore Skylanders. These characters light up without batteries when placed near the Portal of Power. They have a LightCore shockwave attack that defeats all surrounding enemies when placed in the game. This attack can be used once per level for each LightCore Skylander the player owns.
lightcore-skylanders.catchphrase: Ignite their own light from within!
lightcore-skylanders.personality: As a group, LightCore Skylanders are characterized by their dedication to protecting the Core of Light and their ability to channel its power in times of peril. Their individual personalities match their base character counterparts.
lightcore-skylanders.gameplay: LightCore Skylanders light up without batteries when placed near the Portal of Power. They feature a unique LightCore shockwave attack that defeats all surrounding enemies when placed in the game, usable once per level. Additionally, they often feature different poses from their regular character models.

abilities.name: LightCore shockwave
abilities.description: LightCore Skylanders have a LightCore shockwave attack that defeats all surrounding enemies when placed in the game. This attack can be used once per level for each LightCore Skylander the player owns.

abilities.name: Core of Light Radiance
abilities.description: These characters light up without batteries when placed near the Portal of Power, calling upon the power of the Core of Light to ignite their own light from within and radiate with magic.

abilities.name: LightCore shockwave
abilities.description: A powerful shockwave attack that defeats all surrounding enemies when the Skylander is placed on the Portal of Power. This attack can be used once per level for each LightCore figure owned.

trivia: LightCore Figures of Skylanders introduced in Skylanders: Spyro's Adventure are compatible with Skylanders: Spyro's Adventure but will not light up in game or create a shockwave, due to LightCore being a concept introduced after the game's release.
No new LightCore Skylanders were introduced after Swap Force.
The Sunscraper Spire and Midnight Museum Expansion Packs from Trap Team light up when placed on the Traptanium Portal.
Light and Dark are the only elements without any LightCore Skylanders.
LightCore Hex is the only variant of this kind used in Skylanders: Ring of Heroes, replacing her default appearance.
Despite not being a LightCore character, Light Hex has an ability that uses its power.
None of the Skylanders from Spyro's Adventure in the Magic or Life elements have a LightCore counterpart.
With the exception of Hot Dog, Fright Rider and Sprocket, each of the core Skylanders who first appeared in Giants had a LightCore counterpart.
In Ring of Heroes, the Light elemental versions of Skylanders from other elements (Light Hex, Light Jet-Vac and Light Flashwing) seem to be based on the LightCore Skylanders.
Flashwing, Wham-Shell and Warnado are the only LightCore Skylanders without an additional counterpart in the Swap Force toyline.
They are also the only Swap Force-debut LightCore counterparts of Skylanders who had appeared in previous games.

lightning-rod.name: Lightning Rod
appearances: Lightning Rod Faces the Cyclops Queen
Trigger Happy Targets the Evil Kaos
lightning-rod.description: Lightning Rod is an Air storm giant Skylander from Skylanders: Spyro's Adventure.
lightning-rod.biography: Lightning Rod once lived in the majestic Cloud Kingdom, where his countless acts of heroism along with his winning smile and electric physique made him the most famous storm giant in the realm. He was a true celebrity, and the palace halls were littered with statues of the chiseled hero. But all the praise and admiration could never quite satisfy Rod, who yearned for something more. As luck would have it, he met an adventurous young dragon named Spyro, who told him fantastic stories of faraway places and dangerous adventures. Rod was spellbound, and he set off with Spyro to seek an audience with Eon to join the Skylanders.
lightning-rod.personality: Lightning Rod prides himself on being the most macho of all the other storm giants in Skylands, though he isn't used to sharing the spotlight. He is brave, but can also be charming and charismatic. Lightning Rod even considers everyone else in Skylands to be 'girlie', especially girls, and few are brave enough to argue with him! He is fully aware of his own monumental talents and is happy to blow his own trumpet, but happier to blast evildoers with thunder and lightning.
lightning-rod.gameplay: Lightning Rod can throw bolts of lightning at his enemies, he can also summon a powerful blast of lightning from above and control where it strikes. Lightning Rod can even produce an electrical field from his cloud torso. In the Mask of Power novels, it has been revealed that Lightning Rod has god-like strength, as he was able to lift a 400 ton hammer and hurl it far, as well as take a cannon ball blast to the chest without any damage or harm. He could also control the weather in different ways, whether it would be creating a thunder storm, or creating mighty winds. Being a storm giant, he can fly, and create clouds that allow others to fly as well.

abilities.name: Lightning Bolt
abilities.description: Throw a lightning bolt at enemies.

abilities.name: Grand Lightning Summoning
abilities.description: Bring lightning down from the sky and control where it moves.

abilities.name: Lightning Lancer
abilities.description: Lightning Bolt does increased damage.

abilities.name: Thunderation
abilities.description: Grand Lightning attack lasts longer and does increased damage.

abilities.name: Zapper Field
abilities.description: Create a electrical storm that damages enemies.

abilities.name: Lightning Harpoon
abilities.description: Lighting Bolts stick into enemies and continue to damage them.

abilities.name: Zapper Field Deluxe
abilities.description: Zapper Field and clouds do extra damage.

abilities.name: Big Bolt
abilities.description: Hold Attack 1 to throw the biggest bolt of lightning known to man!

abilities.name: Faster Caster
abilities.description: Summon the Grand Lightning attack much faster.

abilities.name: Electricity City
abilities.description: Grand Lightning attack has even more power and does more damage.

abilities.name: Lightning Avatar
abilities.description: Summon the most powerful Grand Lightning attack ever!

abilities.name: Cloud Zapper Satellite
abilities.description: A protective cloud follows you and zaps any enemies that come near.

abilities.name: Zappier Sats
abilities.description: Protective zapper clouds do increased damage.

abilities.name: Zapper Satellite Defense
abilities.description: A third protective cloud joins you.

trivia: Lightning Rod seems to be based on Zeus from Greek Mythology.
Lightning Rod, the Leviathan and Persephone are the only three characters to be based on Greek Mythology.
Lightning Rod was the first Skylander whose toy stand is also part of his body. The second was Nightfall with her hair forming the base.
He is the only Air Skylander who doesn't fly, though he is considered already a flying Skylander, as he is levitating.

According to the Skylanders Sticker Book: Meet the Skylanders, Lightning Rod was invited by Master Eon to join after driving away Kaos with a lightning bolt, which differs from his official game biography.
Though Lightning Rod's species is Storm Giant, his Skylander class is not a Giant. In the book, his species is referred to as a storm titan.
His hair is purple in some of his upgrade pictures, though this is fixed in Skylanders: Giants.
Lightning Rod, Warnado, and Jet-Vac are the only Air Skylanders who don't need wings to fly.
His catchphrase is a pun on 'Three Strikes And You're Out!'
Lightning Rod is voiced by Alex Ness, who also voices Drobot, Double Trouble, Broccoli Guy and the Chompy Mage.
Whispering quietly is not Lightning Rod's strong point.
There is a glitch that removes Lightning Rod's cloud and makes him appear without any legs near the Mirror of Mystery.
He is similar to the Lightning Lord enemies from Mega Man 2 in name, appearance, and gameplay.
His series 1 figure has him holding one lightning bolt, and his series 2 has him holding two.
His Series 2's Wow Pow is a reference to the Kamehameha from Dragon Ball.

lob-star.name: Lob-Star
lob-star.description: Lob-Star is a blue lobster who is one of the Water Trap Masters in Skylanders: Trap Team. He was once the head chef of a five-star restaurant in Star City before revealing his secret combat training to defend his home from a giant Leviathan. Now a member of the Trap Team, he uses Traptanium Ninja Stars and steam-based powers to fight for Skylands.
lob-star.biography: Hailing from the depths of the undersea kingdom of Star City, Lob-Star was the head chef of his own five-star restaurant, often cooking for the King Fish himself. However, few knew that Lob-Star had secretly been training in a mysterious art of fighting known only to a few crustaceans. For a while, Lob-Star was able to keep the peace while still keeping his hidden identity. But when a giant Leviathan threatened to swallow up Lob-Star's guests and capture the King Fish himself, he had no choice but to swim into action. Calling on every trick his mysterious training had taught him, Lob-Star defeated the Leviathan and drove it out of Star City. For risking everything, Lob-Star was recruited by Master Eon to join the Skylanders. Now, as part of the Trap Team, he uses his powerful Traptanium Throwing Stars to serve up defeat to anyone who threatens Skylands!
lob-star.personality: Lob-Star is a disciplined crustacean and a hard worker. He has been able to accomplish great things by being patient and understanding in his studies.
lob-star.gameplay: Lob-Star can throw his Traptanium Ninja Stars which burst when it hits an enemy. His Secondary attack allows him to create steam blasts from his body; when charged, it allows him to enter a steamed state where his attack power and speed are increased. His third attack allows him to dash, which increases his speed and damages enemies in his path. He can also fill up a Trap Attack gauge by defeating enemies to unleash a unique, devastating attack.

abilities.name: Starshooter
abilities.description: Press Attack 1 to shoot Traptanium Stars. Shoot faster when boiled.

abilities.name: Boiling Temper
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 to release a steam blast. Hold Attack 2 to boil up with rage, increasing speed and power.

abilities.name: Lob-Star Roll
abilities.description: Press Attack 3 to dash and evade attacks. Go faster and further while Boiled.

abilities.name: Sharp Shot
abilities.description: New Traptanium Stars do increased damage.

abilities.name: Boiling Over
abilities.description: Release steam while boiling to repel enemies. Tap Attack 2 to let off more steam.

abilities.name: Lob-Star Express
abilities.description: Lob-Star Roll is faster and knocks away enemies. If Boiled, releases a steam blast afterwards.

abilities.name: Hard Boiled
abilities.description: Fully charge up Boiling Temper attack to release the ultimate steam blast.

abilities.name: Super Stars
abilities.description: When Boiled, Traptanium Stars do increased damage and cut through enemies.

abilities.name: Twice the Star Power
abilities.description: Hold Attack 1 and release to shoot two Traptanium Stars at once.

abilities.name: Star Defense
abilities.description: Hold Attack 1 longer to create more Traptanium Stars for protection.

abilities.name: Getting Steamed
abilities.description: After getting hit by enemies, automatically release steam to damage them right back.

abilities.name: Self E-Steam
abilities.description: All steam abilities get stronger and consume less Boiling Power.

abilities.name: Full Steamed Ahead
abilities.description: Leave a trail of damaging steam behind.

trivia: Lob-Star's name is a play on 'lobster'.
Lob-Star and Wham-Shell are both crustacean Skylanders. Both characters also have star-related moves.
His catchphrase is a play on the children's rhyme 'Star light, star bright'.
He is the first Water Skylander with steam-based powers.
His gameplay is somewhat similar to Fryno's. They both have an ability that temporarily increases their power, and have a third attack that acts like a way to move faster.
His figure pose is based on his charging stance in the upgrade 'Double the Star Power'.
He is the fourth ninja Skylander, the first is Stealth Elf, second being Ninjini, and the third being Stink Bomb.
He and Stink Bomb also use shurikens, or ninja stars, and aren't elves. Lob-Star however, can't turn invisible like the others.
In his Soul Gem preview video, the starfish on his face is missing. Instead, it shows his black neckerchief concealing his mouth like a ninja mask.
Lob-Star is voiced by Kevin Schon, best known as the third voice of Timon from the Timon and Pumbaa TV series and The Lion Guard.
Schon is the one of the two voice actors of Timon to have a role in Skylanders (another being Quinton Flynn who also voices Dr. Krankcase).
An Awakened form version of Lob-Star was leaked in Skylanders: Ring of Heroes, but he never appeared in the final game.

love-potion-pop-fizz.name: Love Potion Pop Fizz
love-potion-pop-fizz.description: Love Potion Pop Fizz is a pink Valentine's Day counterpart of Fizzy Frenzy Pop Fizz in Skylanders: Trap Team.
love-potion-pop-fizz.biography: Potions are red. Potions are blue. Pop Fizz loves potions. And he drinks them all too! When his latest attempt to concoct the ultimate raspberry soda totally backfired, Pop Fizz was caught in a blast that turned him pink and gave him an alluring aroma. At least that's how he tells it. But with Valentine's Day right around the corner, the Skylanders are all wondering if Pop Fizz is telling the truth – or if there is a special someone that he's trying to impress!
love-potion-pop-fizz.personality: Pop Fizz is widely known as being a bit crazy. He is a master alchemist who is constantly experimenting with new potions, often using himself as a test subject. He is impulsive, unpredictable, and has a wild energy that is reflected in his combat style.
love-potion-pop-fizz.gameplay: Love Potion Pop Fizz shares the same move set as Fizzy Frenzy Pop Fizz. He can throw potions with varying effects including acid pools and explosions, or drink his concoction to transform into a powerful beast with melee capabilities.

abilities.name: Potion Lob
abilities.description: Lobs a potion that has different effects depending on the color.

abilities.name: Beast Form
abilities.description: Pop Fizz drinks a potion to transform into a large, powerful beast.

abilities.name: New Concoctions
abilities.description: Allows Pop Fizz to mix new and more powerful potion types.

abilities.name: Puddle of Pain
abilities.description: Potions leave behind a damaging puddle on the ground.

abilities.name: Raging Beast
abilities.description: Increases the damage and duration of the Beast Form.

abilities.name: Shake It!
abilities.description: Shake the potion bottle to increase the power of the next potion thrown.

abilities.name: Double Trouble
abilities.description: Allows for two beast forms to be active at once or one beast and one mini.

trivia: If Love Potion Pop Fizz is played in Skylanders: Giants, he will appear as Punch Pop Fizz.

In Skylanders: SuperChargers and Skylanders: Imaginators, Love Potion Pop Fizz in his beast form appears with eyes much like his normal beast form, along with the bottom of his feet, which are indigo. His regular form uses the intended eyes for the beast form, instead of the flat cyan coloured ones intended for him.
This is the only alt deco Pop Fizz whose figure is in his beast form.

He is the only Valentine alt deco Skylander to have a released figure. Heartbreaker Buckshot's release was cancelled and the other two Valentine counterparts (Charming Cobra Cadabra and Cupid Flameslinger) are Lost Islands exclusives.
His figure render depicts his gauntlets and footwear to be rose gold, and the straps of his backpack to be white, however they are actually brown in reality and in-game.

lucky-boomer.name: Lucky Boomer
lucky-boomer.description: Lucky Boomer is a St. Patrick's Day version of Boomer who is available only on Skylanders: Lost Islands.
lucky-boomer.biography: Lucky Boomer is a St. Patrick's Day version of Boomer who is available only on Skylanders: Lost Islands.
lucky-boomer.catchphrase: Lucky Boomer is here spreading the luck of the Skylanders!
lucky-boomer.personality: Lucky Boomer is known for spreading the luck of the Skylanders.
lucky-boomer.gameplay: Lucky Boomer is a seasonal Alter Ego of Boomer available only in Skylanders: Lost Islands. He features unique idle and poke animations within the game.
trivia: Lucky Boomer, Hoppity Pop Fizz, Admiral Thumpback and Holiday Wash Buckler are the only Lost Islands exclusive Skylanders of 2013 without a specific house of their own.
Lucky Boomer's English voice actor is Joey Camen.

magna-charge.name: Magna Charge
magna-charge.description: Magna Charge is a Tech element robot and member of the SWAP Force. Born with a unique magnetic head, he was initially exiled by his metallic peers before mastering his powers and joining the Skylanders. He is characterized by his scientific mind and wheel-based mobility.
magna-charge.biography: Magna Charge came from the great race of Ultron robots, but was mysteriously created with a giant magnet head. This proved problematic, as his peers were all made of metal and were constantly being pulled towards him. As a result, Magna Charge was exiled to a faraway island, where he eventually learned to control his magnetic powers. After years of training, he returned to his home to demonstrate his abilities, but found everything completely destroyed. In searching for answers, Magna Charge caught the attention of Master Eon, who realized the unique Ultron soldier was a perfect candidate for the Skylanders.
magna-charge.personality: Magna Charge is a disciplined and highly confident Ultron robot. He often views himself as superior in efficiency and skill, describing his actions as 'MAGnificent' and 'superior in all areas.' He possesses a scientific mind, frequently referencing magnetic force density and affector fields during combat.
magna-charge.gameplay: Magna Charge is a high-speed Speed-type Skylander. He uses a Magnet Cannon for rapid-fire ranged attacks and his magnetic head to lift and throw enemies with Polarized Pickup. His wheel-based lower half allows for exceptional mobility and the ability to drag and launch enemies across the battlefield. He can also use magnetic abilities to gather gold and food.

abilities.name: Magnet Cannon
abilities.description: Hold Attack 1 to rapidly fire energy projectiles. Firing for too long will cause the cannon to overheat.

abilities.name: Magneto Ball
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 to drag an enemy around. Press Attack 2 again to launch them forward. Large enemies cannot be dragged.

abilities.name: Polarized Pickup
abilities.description: Press Attack 3 to pick up enemies. Press Attack 3 again to slam them. While active, loot will be drawn in from a distance!

abilities.name: Eject
abilities.description: Press Attack 1 while dragging an object or enemy to throw it behind to boost forward.

abilities.name: Plasma Shots
abilities.description: Hold Attack 1 to rapidly shoot a Magnet Cannon that does increased damage. Projectiles heat up after a short time, dealing extra fire damage.

abilities.name: Rad Wheels
abilities.description: Speed is increased. Brand new developments in magnet wheels!

abilities.name: Magnetic Buildup
abilities.description: Hold an object with Polarized Pickup for a short time, release it to deal extra damage.

abilities.name: Drag Capacity
abilities.description: Two enemies can be dragged at once while dashing.

abilities.name: Multi Barrelled
abilities.description: Upgraded Magnet Cannon that shoots 3 projectiles at once!

abilities.name: Super Repulsor
abilities.description: A new wheel makes thrown objects gain increased damage, range and speed.

abilities.name: Discharge Recharge
abilities.description: Hold Attack 1 to overheat the Magnet Cannon, release to shoot a large fireball.

abilities.name: Heavy Blaster
abilities.description: Magnet cannon does even more damage.

abilities.name: Burst Pickup
abilities.description: Picking up enemies with Polarized Pickup will knock back nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Magnetic Personality
abilities.description: Magnet attacks do increased damage. Two-Ton's Law states: if it has mass, it can be slammed.

abilities.name: Shock Stop
abilities.description: Press (X) while dragging an enemy to drop it in front of you and shock it.

abilities.name: Crash Test
abilities.description: Shock Stop and Eject do increased damage.

abilities.name: Rapid Repel
abilities.description: Press (X) while dragging an object or enemy to shoot it without stopping.

abilities.name: Opposites Repel
abilities.description: Rapid Repel does increased damage. Repulsive!

trivia: He is the only SWAP Force Skylander to have a hand on only one arm.
The original concept designs for Magna Charge included a massive gatling gun on his left arm. This was later included as his Soul Gem upgrade.
He, Shroomboom, Rocky Roll, Eye-Brawl, Dive-Clops and Ro-Bow are the only Skylanders with one eye.
During earlier development, Magna Charge's eye and wheel were yellow instead of green.
When you fully upgrade Magna Charge's bottom half, his wheel turns blue.
If you press the primary attack button while charging, Magna Charge will do a damaging backflip not mentioned in his upgrades.
Magna Charge resembles Rocket from Robot on Wheels.
He is one of the only Swap Force Skylanders without true legs, along with Doom Stone, Rattle Shake, and Night Shift.
In Trap Team, a glitch allows Polarized Pickup to remove training dummies at the Academy.
He and Freeze Blade are the only Skylanders with Nitro variants with the Speed ability.
His voice actor, Gregg Berger, is well-known for voicing Grimlock in Transformers and Hunter and Ripto in the original Spyro the Dragon games.
The name of his species is possibly a reference to the Marvel Comics character, Ultron.

merry-snap-shot.name: Merry Snap Shot
merry-snap-shot.description: Merry Snap Shot is the December 2014 counterpart of Snap Shot in Skylanders: Lost Islands.
merry-snap-shot.biography: Merry Snap Shot is the December 2014 counterpart of Snap Shot in Skylanders: Lost Islands. He was introduced as a special festive variant to celebrate the season of giving.
merry-snap-shot.catchphrase: Celebrate the season of giving with Merry Snap Shot
merry-snap-shot.personality: Merry Snap Shot embodies the festive spirit of the holiday season, specifically the 'season of giving.' As a Trap Master, he remains a dedicated protector of Skylands, but with a jolly, winter-themed disposition.
merry-snap-shot.gameplay: As an Alter Ego in Skylanders: Lost Islands, Merry Snap Shot serves as a holiday-themed version of Snap Shot. While he functions similarly to his standard counterpart in the mobile environment, his primary distinction is his festive appearance and his status as a Christmas-themed Trap Master.
trivia: He, Jolly Bumble Blast, Holiday Wash Buckler, Missile-Tow Dive-Clops, Jingle Bell Chompy Mage and Winterfest Lob-Star are the only Skylanders who are Christmas counterparts.
Also Merry Snap Shot and Winterfest Lob-Star are the only Christmas Trap Masters.
Coincidentally they are both Water element.
However, Merry Snap Shot and Holiday Wash Buckler are the only Christmas Skylanders who are exclusive to the Lost Islands
Coincidentally, they are also counterparts of non-core Water Skylanders that were on a Starter Pack.

metal-mage.name: Metal Mage
