metal-mage.description: Metal Mage is a scrapped Skylander, turned single use enemy, in Skylanders: Trap Team. He is a wizard troll with an Air themed headdress and metal staves, with the ability to create barriers around its allies, and like Broccoli Guys and Rage Mages, holds treasure over his head.
metal-mage.biography: Metal Mage is a scrapped Skylander, turned single use enemy, in Skylanders: Trap Team. He is a wizard troll with an Air themed headdress and metal staves, with the ability to create barriers around its allies, and like Broccoli Guys and Rage Mages, holds treasure over his head. Vimeo demo reels and Skylanders: Giants behind-the-scenes footage were the only hints that this character had a bigger role for some time, until Nat Loh's character design portfolio had more details. Though they first started as inspired by Boomer, the developer received the concept art for Rocky Roll instead and worked Metal Mage's abilities into them. His abilities involved creating metal balls that he could combine into various weapons such as a giant metal hammer or a metal battering ram. In the final game of Trap Team, Metal Mage appears only once, in Mystic Mill, to briefly provide support for the Evilikin in one of the gates.
metal-mage.gameplay: In Skylanders: Trap Team, the Metal Mage functions as a support unit in the Mystic Mill stage, casting Electric Shield to defend Evilikin allies. He is one of the few enemies that holds treasure over his head. Scrapped gameplay elements for the character included the ability to forge large metal weapons from conjured spheres such as a giant hammer or battering ram.

abilities.name: Electric Shield
abilities.description: The ability to create barriers around its allies.

abilities.name: Metal Ball Conjuration
abilities.description: Creating metal balls that he could combine into various weapons such as a giant metal hammer or a metal battering ram.

abilities.name: Metal Weapon Forging
abilities.description: His ultimate potential: forging powerful weapons like hammers and battering rams from his metal spheres.

trivia: Had Metal Mage actually been playable, he would've been the first character with metal abilities not in Tech.
He would have also been the second Troll to be a Skylander.
Though he carries a dagger, he's incapable of attacking with it in his enemy form, nor is it mentioned in the development info for Rocky Roll.
He has the same red skin as troll Nightmare Villains, though he doesn't wear any purple or red outfits.
Unlike every other Troll, he also doesn't have an apparent nose.

mini-jini.name: Mini-Jini
mini-jini.description: Mini-Jini is one of the four Sidekicks in Skylanders: Giants. She is the miniature version of the giant Ninjini, eventually becoming a Mini Skylander in Skylanders: Trap Team.
mini-jini.biography: Within the Skylands, a realm of infinite possibilities, there is in fact an alternate reality known as the Skylands Miniverse. Everything there is smaller, including the Skylanders. The Skylanders Sidekicks come from that Miniverse and have traveled to the Skylands to meet their regular-sized alter egos and tag along with them on adventures. The Skylander Minis started off as regular 'Sidekicks', assisting the Skylanders on many exciting adventures. And what they lacked in size they more than made up for in courage. Ultimately determined to become full-fledged heroes, they trained at the Skylands Academy - honing their powers and skills until they were ready. Now, they stand side by side with their full grown counterparts, ready to defend Skylands against Kaos and his evil minions.
mini-jini.personality: Mini-Jini always looks on the bright side of life. She believes in the power of positive thinking, and her good energy is infectious. Mini Jini is least likely to put a curse on everyone, as she the nice kind of genie.
mini-jini.gameplay: In games, Mini-Jini has a starting health of 410 (max 820) and a speed of 85 (max 133). Her console stats include Armor at 48, Critical Hit at 80, and Elemental Power at 60. Though not used in gameplay, her power stats list her Agility and Luck at 130. She uses a variety of magical attacks including Wishblades and Bottle Blast.

abilities.name: Wishblades
abilities.description: A primary melee attack using twin magical blades.

abilities.name: Bottle Blast
abilities.description: A secondary magical projectile attack where Mini-Jini fires energy from her bottle.

abilities.name: Surrealistic Spheres
abilities.description: Upgraded magical spheres for increased range and damage.

abilities.name: Abra-Ca-Stab-Bra
abilities.description: A swift stabbing maneuver with magical blades.

abilities.name: Juggling Act
abilities.description: A powerful juggling maneuver that acts as Mini-Jini's ultimate attack.

trivia: Mini-Jini always looks on the bright side of life.
She is the miniature version of the giant Ninjini.
She originally debuted as a Sidekick in Skylanders: Giants.
She became a full-fledged Mini Skylander starting in Skylanders: Trap Team.
Mini-Jini hails from the Skylands Miniverse, where everything is smaller.

minis.name: Minis
minis.description: The Minis are miniature versions of existing Skylanders that were introduced in Skylanders: Trap Team. They take after their bigger counterparts, in both personality and abilities. In the IDW comics, they are depicted as Skylanders with personalities to that of children.
minis.biography: The Skylander Minis started off as regular 'Sidekicks', assisting the Skylanders on many exciting adventures. And what they lacked in size they more than made up for in courage. Ultimately determined to become full-fledged heroes, they trained at the Skylands Academy - honing their powers and skills until they were ready. Now, they stand side by side with their full grown counterparts, ready to defend Skylands against Kaos and his evil minions.
minis.personality: Playful and courageous, the Minis possess child-like personalities and a strong determination to prove themselves as full-fledged heroes alongside their larger counterparts. Despite their small size, they are noted for having courage that more than makes up for their stature.
minis.gameplay: Minis play identically to their full-sized counterparts, possessing the same movesets, upgrades, and power levels. Their primary differences are their smaller physical scale, higher-pitched voices, and unique animations for certain actions. Giant Minis also share some large effects with their full-size counterparts, such as the ability to destroy bomb-able obstacles. Unlike their normal counterparts, the Minis have different defeated animations.
trivia: Despite their small size, Giant Minis share some large effects with their full-size counterparts, such as the ability to destroy bomb-able obstacles.
Unlike their normal counterparts, the Minis have different defeated animations.
Minis that were Sidekicks in previous games are usable as Sidekicks in those games.
In 2017, opposite versions of Minis were considered - far older versions of Skylanders with different outfits. However, at the time, they never made it past the concept phase.

Like when they were sidekicks, the Minis' voices are basically sped up versions of their normal counterparts'. In Skylanders: Imaginators, Spry is the only mini Skylander with a unique voice. This is due to Spyro's change of voice actors while Spry still kept his old voice recordings.
In the 3DS version, they call themselves the name of their regular counterpart instead of their own names.
All of Minis are counterparts of Skylanders who first appeared in Skylanders: Spyro's Adventure and Giants (except for Small Fry who is a counterpart of Fryno, a Swap Force-debut Skylander).

missile-tow-dive-clops.name: Missile-Tow Dive-Clops
missile-tow-dive-clops.description: Missile-Tow Dive-Clops is the Christmas counterpart of Dive-Clops in Skylanders: SuperChargers.
missile-tow-dive-clops.biography: Every Skylander celebrates the holiday season in their own special way. For some, it means giving and receiving presents. For others, it means stuffing their face with festive food. For Dive-Clops it means hiding beneath the Academy archways to shoot candy-coated missiles at fellow Skylanders that pass by. To be fair, he does hang a sign that reads: 'Ho-Ho-Ho...Look Out Below!'
missile-tow-dive-clops.personality: Missile-Tow Dive-Clops is festive and mischievous, taking great joy in the holiday season by playing lighthearted pranks on his fellow Skylanders with his candy-coated missiles.
missile-tow-dive-clops.gameplay: In Skylanders: SuperChargers, Missile-Tow Dive-Clops fights using holiday-themed weaponry, specifically shooting candy-coated missiles at his opponents. He is known to use his environment to hide and ambush enemies with projectiles.

abilities.name: Waterpedo
abilities.description: Dive-Clops launches a powerful torpedo at enemies.

abilities.name: Sonar
abilities.description: Dive-Clops uses his eye to emit sonar waves to detect and damage enemies.

abilities.name: Put the Eye in Geyser
abilities.description: Dive-Clops creates a massive geyser to launch enemies into the air.

abilities.name: Torpeslow
abilities.description: Dive-Clops releases a slow-moving but high-impact torpedo.

abilities.name: Sonar Smarts
abilities.description: Dive-Clops uses his intelligence to enhance his sonar capabilities.

trivia: The first half of his name, 'Missile-Tow' is a pun of 'mistletoe' and 'missile'.

molten-hot-dog.name: Molten Hot Dog
molten-hot-dog.description: Molten Hot Dog is a yellow flaming version of the Fire Skylander, Hot Dog.
molten-hot-dog.biography: Molten Hot Dog is a yellow flaming version of the Fire Skylander, Hot Dog. He has the same ability as his normal counterpart, lobbing fireballs and turning himself into a comet to hurl himself at enemies. He can also summon a wall of fire.
molten-hot-dog.personality: Molten Hot Dog behaves similarly to a playful but fierce fire dog, using his flame-based powers to protect Skylands.
molten-hot-dog.gameplay: Molten Hot Dog has the same ability as his normal counterpart, lobbing fireballs and turning himself into a comet to hurl himself at enemies. He can also summon a wall of fire.

abilities.name: Firebark
abilities.description: Lob fireballs at enemies.

abilities.name: Wall of Fire
abilities.description: Summon a wall of fire to damage enemies.

abilities.name: Comet Slam
abilities.description: Turn into a comet and hurl yourself at enemies.

abilities.name: Wall of More Fire
abilities.description: Create a more powerful and larger wall of fire.

abilities.name: Super Comet
abilities.description: An advanced version of the comet attack for maximum damage.

trivia: Molten Hot Dog is set to be featured in his own Skylanders Activity Book: Molten Hot Dog's Quiz Quest.

He is the third Wal-Mart exclusive, and the first to appear different in-game (the first was a Red Drill Sergeant, the second was a Glow-In-The-Dark Series 2 Sonic Boom and the fourth was Enchanted Hoot Loop).

mystic-star-strike.name: Mystic Star Strike
mystic-star-strike.description: Mystic Star Strike is a fortune telling counterpart of Star Strike for Skylanders: Lost Islands.
mystic-star-strike.biography: Mystic Star Strike is a fortune telling counterpart of Star Strike for Skylanders: Lost Islands.
mystic-star-strike.catchphrase: Mystic Star Strike is here to unravel the mysteries of Skylands!
trivia: She is the third female Lost Islands exclusive, the first being Skeletal Cynder, the second being Snowler Brawl and the fourth being Hallows' Eve Hex.
She is also the only Lost Islands exclusive female that is not an Undead element character.

mystical-bad-juju.name: Mystical Bad Juju
mystical-bad-juju.description: Mystical Bad Juju is the Mystical counterpart of Bad Juju in Skylanders: Imaginators. The figure was exclusively sold at GameStop stores and features a distinct black, white, and gold color scheme.
mystical-bad-juju.biography: Just like her name suggests, Bad Juju had always been bad. From her humble beginnings as a witch doctor, where she put curses on her patients instead of curing them, to being the Golden Queen's right-hand sorceress, she had spent her entire life as a villain. Being captured by the Skylanders didn't do much to change her attitude either. At least, that was the case until the day she conjured up more than she bargained for – a son named Juju Junior. That was when she finally decided it was time to change her lifestyle. She didn't want to raise Juju Junior inside a prison thinking that his magical mother was a criminal. So she asked Master Eon to give her a chance to be a hero instead. As luck would have it, Eon was looking for a Swashbuckler Sensei who could help train Imaginators the value of being good. Not bad for Bad Juju.
mystical-bad-juju.personality: Mystical Bad Juju is a reformed villain whose primary motivation is her son, Juju Junior. She is determined, protective, and seeks to prove that even those with a dark past can become heroes through devotion and change.
mystical-bad-juju.gameplay: As a Swashbuckler Sensei, Mystical Bad Juju utilizes rapid-fire blade strikes and air-based magic. She can summon Juju Junior to the field to create whirlwinds and knock back enemies, providing a mix of melee and area-of-effect damage.

abilities.name: Whirling Blades
abilities.description: Press Attack 1 to slash with your blades. Continue pressing for a combo.

abilities.name: Juju Junior
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 to summon Juju Junior to create a small whirlwind.

abilities.name: Windy Wail
abilities.description: Hold Attack 2 to charge a more powerful whirlwind attack.

abilities.name: Static Shock
abilities.description: Blade attacks now deal additional lightning damage to nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Child Protection
abilities.description: Juju Junior will automatically counterattack any enemy that strikes Bad Juju.

abilities.name: Junior's Justice
abilities.description: Juju Junior's whirlwind and attacks deal significantly more damage.

trivia: Though her blades are red in the figure and official artwork, they have their original cyan color in the game.
Possibly because they share the same palette and outfit, Juju Junior has the same color changes as his mother, which rarely happens with alternate counterparts of Skylanders that can summon helpers.
She and Mystical Tae Kwon Crow are the only Mystical counterparts of the franchise. Both are Senseis, and their original counterparts are both former villains.
A villainous variant appears as an Undead enemy in Skylanders: Ring of Heroes, though her black outfit has a slightly more brownish tone and several black and white areas are swapped around.

mystical-tae-kwon-crow.name: Mystical Tae Kwon Crow
mystical-tae-kwon-crow.description: Mystical Tae Kwon Crow is a mystical counterpart of Tae Kwon Crow in Skylanders: Imaginators. The figure was exclusively sold at GameStop.
mystical-tae-kwon-crow.biography: Mystical Tae Kwon Crow is a mystical counterpart of Tae Kwon Crow in Skylanders: Imaginators. The figure was exclusively sold at GameStop.
mystical-tae-kwon-crow.personality: Not much is known about Mystical Tae Kwon Crow's personality, but as a Sensei, he is a master of the Ninja battle class.
mystical-tae-kwon-crow.gameplay: Mystical Tae Kwon Crow utilizes Ninja techniques, throwing shurikens and delivering flame-powered kicks to his enemies. His arsenal includes Shuriken Throw, Flame Kick, Buzzer Beak, and advanced versions like Triple Shurikens and Triple Kicks.

abilities.name: Shuriken Throw
abilities.description: Mystical Tae Kwon Crow throws a sharp shuriken at enemies from a distance.

abilities.name: Flame Kick
abilities.description: Mystical Tae Kwon Crow delivers a powerful kick imbued with fire.

abilities.name: Buzzer Beak
abilities.description: A specialized ninja technique used to strike down foes.

abilities.name: Triple Shurikens
abilities.description: Allows Mystical Tae Kwon Crow to throw three shurikens at once.

abilities.name: Triple Kicks
abilities.description: A powerful combination of three flaming kicks.

trivia: Though his shurikens are red in the figure and official artwork, they have their original silver color in the game.
He and Mystical Bad Juju are the only Mystical counterparts of the franchise. Both are Senseis, and their original counterparts are both former villains.

mysticat.name: Mysticat
mysticat.description: Mysticat is a sphinx Magic Sensei in Skylanders: Imaginators who trains Imaginators of the Sorcerer Battle Class.
mysticat.biography: For centuries, Mysticat and the great Sphinxes guarded the entrance to the Enchanted Desert with their famous riddles, which few could solve. Mysticat was a curious creature, and had his own question that even he could not answer. He was puzzled as to why others wanted to enter the Enchanted Desert so badly. So he decided to venture himself to find the answer. But instead of finding answers, he was attacked by wandering gypsies and evil sand raiders that scoured the desert for lost treasure. After fighting them off with his impressive sorcery skills, he returned to the elders and explained what happened. It was then that they revealed the true nature of the desert to him. They told him that what he saw was a vision of his own destiny - and that he was meant to protect all of Skylands, not just the Enchanted Desert. Master Eon was then invited to enter the desert to meet Mysticat to see if their two destinies were intertwined. When Eon emerged the next day, it was clear to him that Mysticat was meant to be one of his best Senseis... and that he would one day shave his beard. But he kept that part to himself.
mysticat.gameplay: Mysticat can shoot magical beams out of his staff, and create a wave of energy to push back enemies. He can throw his staff which generates a clone of himself that helps him fight. Mysticat can also become invisible and gain immense speed while invisible. In additional upgrades, he is able to leave behind a magic decoy before disappearing.Mysticat can even conjure magical balls of yarn which seek out foes and explode upon impact. His Soul Gem allows him to create a rift which shoots out cat familiars, and spawns a copy cat as well. His Sky-Chi power lets Mysticat to temporarily levitate himself, and create a giant Cat Familiar that shoots out smaller balls of of yarn as well.

abilities.name: Laser Painter
abilities.description: Press Attack 1 to channel a beam in front of you. Press it thrice to push back enemies with a laser wave.

abilities.name: Paw Print
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 to throw a magical staff that creates a Copy Cat that attacks with its own Laser Painter.

abilities.name: Help Meow-t
abilities.description: You can now have up to two Copy Cats active at a time.

abilities.name: Disappurring Act
abilities.description: Press Attack 3 to leave a decoy. You become invisible and run really fast. Reappear with an explosion at your location and your decoy's location.

abilities.name: Cat's Familiar
abilities.description: Press Attack 1 to create magical yarnballs that circle around you.

abilities.name: Pawsome Painter
abilities.description: Your lasers hit an additional time. Attack 1 triple-combo shoots a wider laser spread.

abilities.name: Konnichi-paw!
abilities.description: Hold Attack 1 to conjure a rift that shoots homing projectiles and creates a Copy Cat.

abilities.name: Domo Arigato Hisster Rift-boto
abilities.description: The ultimate Sensei attack! Hold Special Attack to create a Sensei-tional yarnball rift that shoots out Cat's Familiars. Move around with Left Stick.

abilities.name: Cat-astrophic Chasers
abilities.description: Conjure 4 Cat's Familiars when you press Attack 1. They will do increased damage each time they hit an enemy.

abilities.name: Patience is a Fur-tue
abilities.description: Lasers are larger and increase in damage over time. Attack 1 triple-combo casts a much wider laser spread.

abilities.name: Fur-st Degree Purr-ns
abilities.description: Copy Cats create an explosion of magical energy when hit with a laser or a Cat's Familiar. Copy Cats also create this explosion when they time out.

abilities.name: The Feline's Mutual
abilities.description: Disapurring Act's explosion hits harder and wider. Press Attack 3 to now cause an explosion when entering stealth.

abilities.name: Keep Your Fur-ends Close
abilities.description: Hold Attack 3 when you are invisible to cause your Copy Cats to charge at nearby target for area damage. Your decoy explodes shortly afterwards too.

abilities.name: Not Kitten Around
abilities.description: You can now have three Copy Cats active at a time. Their charging explosion is stronger, as well as the decoy's explosion.

trivia: Mysticat's name is a play on the word "mystical".
Although he is a sphinx, Mysticat resembles a Wampus cat, a mythical feline-like creature, often depicted with six or more legs.
Mysticat and Knight Mare both have a centaur-like structure.
His usage of riddles also resembles the behaviour of the mythological Sphinx.
Mysticat grants the King's Tail piece to Imaginators when first placed on the portal, and the Mysticat Staff when the feline's Shrine is opened.
One of his quotes "Cat's all, folks!" may have been a play on the Looney Tunes quote, "That's all, folks!"
Mysticat hisses loudly while he is jumping.
Like real life cats, one of his idle animations is also suddenly jumping with surprise despite no obvious threat.
Mysticat has a feminine voice despite being a male. This is because he is voiced by a female voice actress.
This would make him the first playable character to have a voice actor of the opposite gender.
The name of his Sky Chi is a reference to the song “Mister Roboto” by the band Styx.
Though he did appear in the original version of the game, he didn't appear in the revamped version of Ring of Heroes until a few weeks later.

new-year-s-countdown.name: New Year's Countdown
new-year-s-countdown.description: New Year's Countdown is a New Year's counterpart of Countdown, available on January 2014 and 2015 in Skylanders: Lost Islands.
new-year-s-countdown.biography: New Year's Countdown is a New Year's counterpart of Countdown. He was available on January 2014 and 2015 in Skylanders: Lost Islands, featuring a festive hat with the year printed on it.
new-year-s-countdown.catchphrase: New Year's Countdown is here to ring in the New Year!
new-year-s-countdown.personality: Like the standard Countdown, he is known for being explosive and high-energy. This variant specifically embraces a festive and celebratory spirit to ring in the New Year.
new-year-s-countdown.gameplay: In Skylanders: Lost Islands, New Year's Countdown could be obtained through the Wishin' Well during the January event. Once obtained, he could be used to perform tasks and help manage the player's island, similar to other Skylanders in the game.
trivia: He is the first Lost Islands Exclusive Skylander to be released in 2014.
Because the Wishin' Well first appeared on February 2013, New Year's Countdown is the first and only Lost Islands Exclusive Skylander to be released on January.
In January 2015, the year on his hat was changed to 2015. No further changes have been made due to the lack of Lost Islands updates since May 2015.

night-shift.name: Night Shift
night-shift.description: Night Shift is an Undead vampire boxer who is one of the SWAP Force Skylanders in Skylanders: Swap Force. His SWAP Force Ability is Teleport.
night-shift.biography: From high up in the gloomy Batcrypt Mountains, Night Shift was a full-fledged baron and heir to a great fortune. But one day, he decided to leave it all behind to pursue his dream as a prizefighter. It wasn’t long before Night Shift became the undefeated phantom-weight champion of Skylands famous for his massive uppercut and for having once bitten an opponent in the ring. Unfortunately, a rule change made teleportation illegal and Night Shift was forced to give up his belt, officially ending his career as a boxer. Crestfallen over being disqualified from a sport he loved so dearly, his spirits picked up when he was sought out by Master Eon, who told him that his skill as a fighter could be put to great use as a member of the Skylanders.
night-shift.personality: Night Shift can come off a bit grumpy, due to being an Undead character. He values boxing, and is commonly considered by others as old-school. Whenever he hears the sound of a boxing bell however, he goes into a wild frenzy, punching anyone and anything around him. Night Shift always plays by the rules, so when the Skylands Boxing Federation banned Teleportation, he had to give up the sport he loved.
night-shift.gameplay: As a former boxing champion, Night Shift can throw heavy punches as his enemies, and can even charge up an enormous uppercut that deals heavy damage. Night Shift can teleport very quickly, and shoot out ghostly bat allies to attack enemies. Night Shift can even bite his enemies with his huge vampire fangs and regain health.

abilities.name: One-Two Punch
abilities.description: Press Attack 1 to punch nearby enemies with enormous boxing gloves.

abilities.name: Ethereal Shift
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 to turn into mist and teleport a short distance forward.

abilities.name: Vampire’s Bite
abilities.description: Press Attack 3 to bite enemies and regain some health.

abilities.name: Sting Like a Bat
abilities.description: Punching does increased damage. Give 'em the ol' one-two combo!

abilities.name: Don’t Move, Just Stick!
abilities.description: Hold Attack 1 to charge a punch, release to deal a massive uppercut to enemies.

abilities.name: Float Like a Vampire
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 to teleport and shoot out a projectile that damages nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Foggy Movement
abilities.description: Speed is increased. Become faster than an old foggy!

abilities.name: A Batty Coach
abilities.description: A bat ally prevents being defeated one time. What a great pep talk!

abilities.name: Gentlemanly
abilities.description: All attacks do increased damage at full health. Quite sporting of the enemies to miss so often, yes...quite.

abilities.name: Grand Entrance
abilities.description: Slows down nearby enemies when appearing after a teleport.

abilities.name: Infectious Smile
abilities.description: Vampire's Bite deals damage over time to its targets.

abilities.name: Healthy Appetite
abilities.description: Vampire's Bite deals more damage with extra healing. Pack on the pounds!

abilities.name: Prize Fighter
abilities.description: Hold Attack 1 to charge a punch, release to do an uppercut that causes enemies that are hit to take damage and drop money.

abilities.name: Pay Day
abilities.description: Prize Fighter gives more money. Don't spend it all in one place like Moe Money and Moe Problems did.

abilities.name: Vortex of Doom
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 to teleport and create a large vortex that pulls in enemies.

abilities.name: Close to Doom
abilities.description: Vortex of Doom now deals damage to enemies. Doooooom!

abilities.name: Round 2
abilities.description: A Batty Coach now gives a health boost when returning from defeat. Get back in there!

abilities.name: Luck of the Underbat
abilities.description: A Batty Coach can be used twice. Okay, this time it's serious!

trivia: Night Shift is the first Skylander to have the ability to return to life after getting defeated.
In early concept art, Night Shift was designed as a vampire bat.
Night Shift has the smallest base health out of all SWAP Force Skylanders.
Night Shift exemplified the need to make Swap Force's animation system work flawlessly for Swap Force characters, as the developers had to maintain his boxer attitude no matter how he was swapped.
In his magic moment, a boxing match bell ring is heard.

His teleporting differs from that of Hoot Loop, as he can only teleport a set distance in front of him, while Hoot Loop can choose where he teleports. However, Night Shift can teleport faster than Hoot Loop, especially in Teleport Zones.
He and Stink Bomb are seen in most of the commercials of Swap Force so far, including the intro of the game. They're always seen swapping with each other.

Night Shift, Bat Spin and Roller Brawl are all vampires. However, he is the only one whose attack involves biting his enemies. The way he bites is similar to a fiasco at the 2014 FIFA World Cup match between Italy and Uruguay, where Luis Suarez bit Giorgio Chiellini. His bite is a reference to boxer Mike Tyson’s infamous 1997 incident where he bit off Evander Holyfield’s ear. Like most vampires, he speaks with a stereotypical Transylvanian accent. So far, Night Shift is the only male vampire in Skylanders.

Night Shift's voice actor, Maurice LaMarche, is best known for his voicework in Futurama as Kif Kroker, The Brain in Animaniacs and Pinky And The Brain, Horace Badun in 101 Dalmatians: Patch's London Adventure and Dr. Victor Fries/Mr. Freeze in the Batman: Arkham games. LaMarche is also the current voice actor for Doctor Nitrus Brio from Crash Bandicoot as of Crash: Mind over Mutant in 2008. He is also known as one of the most prolific soundalike artists in the industry, be famous for his impression of Orson Welles, and flawlessly imitating Sean Connery's voice for the character Athair in Sonic Underground.
If you look closely in the Just Like Swap Force trailer, Night Shift's fangs are slightly drenched with blood.
As stated in his Short Cut, Night Shift is older than school itself.
He can heal himself with his Vampire Bite by biting sheep.
When swapped with the bottom half of Free Ranger, it creates Night Ranger, which shares a name with a rock band.
When swapped with the bottom half of Freeze Blade, it creates Night Blade, which shares a name with a character from the Saints Row Series.
Like Hood Sickle, in Skylanders: Trap Team, there is a glitch that allows you to Teleport through certain Mystery Traptanium Gates (in Know-It-All Island, Chompy Mountain and The Future of Skylands).
Night Shift was one of the many Skylanders planned to appear in Skylanders: Ring of Heroes. Before the game's closure, only concept art of his Awakened Form was released.
If Night Shift has the Batty Coach upgrade and falls during a Ring Out challenge, his health boost will appear on-screen although it will not revive him.
Night Shift's name references a 'night shift,' a period of time when an employee works at night.

nightfall.name: Nightfall
nightfall.description: Nightfall is a Dreadwalker who is the Dark SuperCharger in Skylanders: SuperChargers. Her signature vehicle is the Sea Shadow. She's featured in the first Skylanders: Ring of Heroes Episode Dungeon, Story of Nightfall.
nightfall.biography: Nightfall was a Dreadwalker from Fogshadow Tower, a mysterious fortress in the middle of the Poison Sea. While most Dreadwalkers stayed within the noxious cloud they called home, Nightfall preferred to dive into the black abyss and hunt the dark monsters that threatened her people. One day, as she was exploring a deep cavern in her submarine, the Sea Shadow, Nightfall came upon an enormous object that pulsed with a strange energy. It was gigantic, and before she could comprehend what she was looking at, it hatched! Out came a creature 100 times larger than anything she had ever seen! She fired the engines and raced back to warn her people. Just as the last citizens boarded an evacuation ship, the colossal head of the Leviathan broke the surface of the water and let out a terrible roar! Without hesitation, Nightfall rushed towards the monster, blasting it with everything she had while the others made their escape. This act of heroism caught the attention of Master Eon, and the rest is Skylander history!
nightfall.personality: As a Dark Skylander herself, Nightfall is considered pessimistic and brooding. When she became irritated by Stormblade's optimism, the lark called the Dreadwalker a 'walking bummer cloud'. She always has a threatening tone even towards her allies, and is implied by Buzz to skip training because of her overconfidence and pride. Nightfall hates being bored; she is inquisitive and energetic, and loves exploring. She cares deeply for her people, but has never cared about being popular or fitting in with the crowd. Nightfall is also easy to anger, though she's quick to dial it back to just complaining.
nightfall.gameplay: Using the power of her mysterious shadowy hair, Nightfall can use it to attack at a distance by burrowing it into the ground, and releasing flating strands of it that seek out enemies. She can also manipulate shadows to hide and move unseen; and as a less offensive ability, it is also used to propel Nightfall forward when she pushes objects. Her hooks also allow her to fight in close range with great speed if charged.

abilities.name: Handy Hooks
abilities.description: Press Attack 1 to perform a flurry of right and left hooks.

abilities.name: Ambrush
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 to dash forward or behind enemies.

abilities.name: Whip Lash
abilities.description: Press Attack 3 to unleash a strand of dark energy that whips enemies and knocks them into the air. Using Whip Lash in the air knocks enemies down.

abilities.name: Split Hook Ends
abilities.description: New hooks cause melee attacks to do more damage.

abilities.name: Hair Today, Gone Now
abilities.description: Damage enemies at the start of Ambrush and move faster during it.

abilities.name: Scape-Goat
abilities.description: The first hook melee attack after an Ambrush is guaranteed to critically strike.

abilities.name: Bad Hair Day
abilities.description: Tap Attack 3 repeatedly to knock all enemies into the air in an area. Continue taping Attack 3 to increase the area and knock all enemies down to the ground.

abilities.name: Splitting Hairs
abilities.description: Hold Attack 1 and release to unleash a devastating combo of hook and dark energy attacks.

abilities.name: Comb-O
abilities.description: Every fourth attack in the basic melee combo does more damage.

abilities.name: Playing Hooky
abilities.description: Press Attack 1 during Ambrush to deal more damage in a larger area on exit.

abilities.name: Ambrush Rush
abilities.description: Hold Attack 2 to Ambrush longer and shoot strands of dark energy towards enemies.

abilities.name: Up-Sweep
abilities.description: Knock enemies into the air at the end of Ambrush.

abilities.name: Vast Volume
abilities.description: Press Attack 3 to send three strands of dark energy out to knock more enemies into the air during Whip Lash.

trivia: Nightfall and Astroblast are the only SuperChargers of their respective elements.
She is the only figure between the light and dark element SuperChargers that did not get a special variant.
Both Nightfall and Snap Shot were monster hunters before becoming Skylanders.
Nightfall's toy was recalled due to a faulty RFID chip. Recalled shipments feature the typo 'Night Fall' on the packaging.
She is the second Skylander to have the words 'and Dangerous' in her catchphrase.
Despite floating, she is held up by her hair in several animations and her figure pose.
Her hair is described in the Clutch artbook as being 'designed exclusively to make the FX artists cry.'

ninjini.name: Ninjini
ninjini.description: Ninjini is a Magic ninja genie, and one of the eight Giants in Skylanders: Giants. She has an alter ego called Scarlet Ninjini.
ninjini.biography: Ninjini was the most renowned magical ninja from ancient times, long before the Arkeyans rose to power. But a dark sorceress, who was jealous of Ninjini's skill as a warrior, trapped her within an enchanted bottle to be imprisoned for all of eternity. Time stretched on, yet Ninjini remained steadfast and determined to escape - even mastering the dual sword technique within the solitude of her bottle. Over the years, her strength continued to grow until alas, through sheer force of will, she broke free! From that moment on, Ninjini made it her mission to help those in need as one of the first Skylanders, always carrying that enchanted bottle as a reminder of her own resilience.
ninjini.personality: An eternal optimist, Ninjini spins into battle, convinced she will always succeed come what may.
ninjini.gameplay: Ninjini is a powerful Giant who can summon her ninja swords out of thin air to fight in close combat, she can create magical orbs to attack from afar, and hide inside her bottle for faster movement, more endurance and homing attacks such as magical rockets and enchanted mist which entrances enemies. In Skylanders: Battlecast, hiding inside her bottle gives many bonuses to her spells, though she will break free to attack. Her Special Ability is the Genie's Hideout itself, and her signature Gear is the Star Shell Stopper, magical bombs that only activate when she is in the bottle.

abilities.name: Wishblades
abilities.description: Press the Attack 1 button to swing dual swords for hacking and slashing enemies. Press Attack 1, Attack 1, Hold Attack 1 for a special combo.

abilities.name: Bottle Blast
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 to hide inside the bottle. Press Attack 2 again to blast out in a magical explosion.

abilities.name: Surrealistic Spheres
abilities.description: Hold Attack 3 to summon magical orbs and cast them towards enemies.

abilities.name: Abra-Ca-STAB-Bra
abilities.description: Wishblades do increased damage.

abilities.name: Juggling Act
abilities.description: Hold Attack 3 to summon four magical orbs and damage multiple enemies.

abilities.name: Bottle Rockets
abilities.description: While inside the bottle, press Attack 1 to launch rockets.

abilities.name: Dazzling Enchantment
abilities.description: While inside the bottle, hold down Attack 3 to put enemies into a trance.

abilities.name: Wishblade Combos
abilities.description: Press Attack 1, Attack 1, Hold Attack 2 for Fling Blade. Press Attack 1, Attack 1, Hold Attack 3 for Enchanted Blade.

abilities.name: Wishbladesplosion
abilities.description: Hold Attack 1 button to charge up the swords into an explosive blast.

abilities.name: Ultimate Wishblade
abilities.description: Wishblades do maximum damage.

abilities.name: Super Surrealistic Spheres
abilities.description: Magical orbs do more damage and affect a greater area.

abilities.name: Ultimate Bottle Rockets
abilities.description: Bottle rockets launch faster, do more damage, and affect a greater area.

abilities.name: Buy a Better Bottle
abilities.description: Bottle is stronger and moves faster.

trivia: Ninjini is the only Giant who is female. She is also the first female Magic Skylander, as well as the first female non-core Skylander.
Ninjini holds her swords for a few seconds after entering the game or using her primary attack, before they disappear with a sparkle effect. They reappear whenever she uses the attack again.
Ninjini is the only Giant that doesn't pick up a boulder and pull a chained isle physically. Instead, she uses telekinesis.

Even when Ninjini hides in her bottle, she can still run over small enemies, such as Chompies, Spiderlings, and Trog Pinchers, like the rest of the Giants. In Swap Force, Ninjini can move while inside her bottle faster than being in Giants.

Ninjini is voiced by Laura Bailey, who also voices Persephone and is the wife of Travis Willingham who voices Eye-Brawl, Doom Stone, and Buzz. Outisde of Skylanders, she is also the voice of Rayne in the Bloodrayne series, Jaina Proudmoore in World of Warcraft, and Maka Albarn in Soul Eater.
Ninjini is the first Skylander to have her catchphrase ending with a question mark, the second being Déjà Vu. Coincidentally, they are both female Magic Skylanders.
Ninjini's Wishbladesplosion attack has the ability to slow time for a short moment. Because of this, she is the only Skylander able to manipulate the flow of time, other than Déjà Vu.
Out of all the Giants, Ninjini took the longest to develop. In early development, Ninjini was called Djini and appeared drastically different from her final counterpart.
Her original model was shorter, light-skinned, and blonde, and she wore a crop top, purple earrings, and a yellow-jeweled purple skirt. Her catchphrase was 'Your wish is my command.'
Ninjini, Thumpback, and Crusher are the only three Giants to have weapons that are not a part of their bodies.
She, Stealth Elf and Boom Bloom are the only female Skylanders who are ninjas.
Ninjini's name is a play on 'Ninja' and 'djinni' (or 'jinn'), the Arabic word for 'genie'.
Ninjini has more syllables in her name than any other giant.
Ninjini is similar to Giganta from Justice League Unlimited. Both are female giants who have red haired ponytails.
Several aspects of Ninjini were used for the Swashbuckler battle class in Imaginators.
In Swap Force, when Ninjini is removed from the Portal, she either giggles or says 'Goodbye.'
Ninjini has the record for being the tallest Skylander figure across all games.
On her figure, Ninjini's LED eyes originally glowed so brightly that her face glowed as well, which required her face to be painted over twice.

nitro-freeze-blade.name: Nitro Freeze Blade
nitro-freeze-blade.description: Nitro Freeze Blade is the Nitro counterpart of Freeze Blade in Skylanders: Swap Force.
nitro-freeze-blade.biography: When he was young, Freeze Blade's family moved from the Frozen Wastelands of Vesh to the Great Lava Lakes. As it turned out, this was a very difficult adjustment for Freeze Blade. Not only was he the sole one of his kind, it was also incredibly hot and there was no ice to skate on whatsoever. But over the years, he learned to fit in with the other fire-like creatures and even discovered he had a magical ability to ice skate on any surface... even bubbling lava. One day, while out setting a new frozen lava speed record, he came across Blast Zone, who had just been ambushed by some nasty Spell Punks. After Freeze Blade stepped in to defend him, Blast Zone was so impressed by his skill in battle that he introduced him to Master Eon, who invited him to join the Skylanders.
nitro-freeze-blade.personality: Freeze Blade is incredibly adaptable and determined. Having grown up in an environment completely opposite to his natural habitat, he developed a resilient and cool-headed nature. He is confident in his skating abilities and enjoys pushing his speed to the limit.
nitro-freeze-blade.gameplay: Nitro Freeze Blade focuses on speed and range. He can throw frozen chakrams that return to him or skate quickly across the battlefield, leaving a trail of ice that damages enemies. His SWAP ability allows him to combine his speed with the powers of other Skylanders.

abilities.name: Chakram Throw
abilities.description: Throw a frozen chakram that slices through enemies and returns.

abilities.name: Speedy Skate
abilities.description: Skate rapidly in any direction to evade or move quickly.

abilities.name: Frostcicle
abilities.description: Chakram deals increased damage and has a chance to slow enemies.

abilities.name: Ice Trail
abilities.description: Leaving a frozen trail while skating that damages and slows enemies.

abilities.name: Shaved Ice
abilities.description: An advanced ice attack that deals high damage to surrounding enemies.

abilities.name: Frozen Solid
abilities.description: Skating into enemies has a chance to freeze them solid for a short time.

abilities.name: Double Chakram
abilities.description: Throw two chakrams at once for double the damage.

trivia: He, Nitro Magna Charge, Nitro Head Rush and Nitro Krypt King are the only Nitro Skylanders.
Nitro Freeze Blade and Nitro Magna Charge are also counterparts of SWAP Force Skylanders with the Speed ability.

This is probably more than a coincidence as Nitro is a term used for a chemical makes cars move faster than normal and both Nitro variants have checkered patterns in their design, a symbol for racing.
Unlike his normal counterpart, Nitro Freeze Blade's fur is lighter, silvery and shiny.

nitro-head-rush.name: Nitro Head Rush
nitro-head-rush.description: Nitro Head Rush is the Nitro counterpart of the Earth Trap Master, Head Rush in Skylanders: Trap Team.
nitro-head-rush.biography: Head Rush was raised in a small village that had fallen under the spell of a powerful Harvest Sphinx who forced the frightened villagers to plow the vast fields of golden grass for his own benefit. Although there were many villagers, no individual was brave enough to confront the Sphinx and put an end to its rule. But Head Rush believed there was a chance to fight back if she could somehow inspire her people to stand together. Charging through her village, Head Rush shouted a mighty yodel that woke the villagers from their spell! With the village behind her, she then led the charge to drive the Sphinx from the island for good. For her leadership and bravery, she was made part of the Trap Team, where she uses her giant Traptanium Horns to take charge of evil!
nitro-head-rush.personality: Head Rush is a brave and inspirational leader who is not afraid to confront powerful foes to protect her people. Her determination and powerful yodel allow her to rally others and take charge of any situation.
nitro-head-rush.gameplay: In Skylanders: Trap Team, Nitro Head Rush is an Earth Trap Master who utilizes her Traptanium Horns and shockwave-inducing stomps. Her console statistics start at 340 Health and 60 Speed, making her a durable front-line fighter capable of charging through enemy ranks.

abilities.name: Traptanium Horns
abilities.description: Nitro Head Rush uses her Traptanium Horns to take charge of evil, dealing damage to enemies in her path.

abilities.name: Stomp
abilities.description: Head Rush performs a powerful stomp to create shockwaves that damage nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Mega Stomp
abilities.description: An enhanced stomp attack that covers a larger area and deals increased damage.

abilities.name: High Note
abilities.description: A powerful yodel attack that can stun or damage enemies in front of Head Rush.

abilities.name: A Stomp To Remember
abilities.description: A massive finishing move that combines all of Head Rush's strength for a final, devastating blow.

trivia: The species 'Elf' was confirmed for Head Rush in an interview with designer I-Wei Huang on the Starter Pack Podcast.
Nitro Head Rush is the Nitro variant of the Earth Trap Master, Head Rush.
She is one of the few Skylanders capable of yodeling as a form of attack.

nitro-krypt-king.name: Nitro Krypt King
nitro-krypt-king.description: Nitro Krypt King is the Nitro counterpart of Krypt King in Skylanders: Trap Team.
nitro-krypt-king.biography: Nitro Krypt King is the Nitro counterpart of Krypt King in Skylanders: Trap Team. He is a Knight Spirit possessing Arkeyan Armor who serves as a Trap Master of the Undead element.
nitro-krypt-king.personality: As a powerful Knight Spirit in Arkeyan Armor, Nitro Krypt King is a disciplined and formidable warrior dedicated to defending Skylands.
nitro-krypt-king.gameplay: Nitro Krypt King is a Trap Master who utilizes a massive Traptanium Broadsword for close-quarters combat. He can also summon a swarm of insects to damage enemies from a distance and possesses upgrades that enhance his armor and sword with haunted properties.

abilities.name: Traptanium Broadsword
abilities.description: Nitro Krypt King wields his massive Traptanium Broadsword to deliver powerful melee strikes to enemies.

abilities.name: The Swarm
abilities.description: Summons a swarm of insects to plague and damage nearby foes.

abilities.name: Haunted Sword
abilities.description: Enhances the Broadsword with haunted energy for increased damage.

abilities.name: Enchanted Armor
abilities.description: Provides additional defense and protection during battle.

abilities.name: Stunning Sting
abilities.description: Adds a stunning effect to sword attacks, momentarily dazing enemies.

trivia: He is the only Nitro variant that is not a character with a speed attack. This doesn't apply to when playing as him in the 3DS version of Trap Team, where every Skylander including Nitro Krypt King can sprint.
In Skylanders: SuperChargers, Nitro Krypt King's blue dots on the front of his helmet become red, which match with his original counterpart's.

nitro-magna-charge.name: Nitro Magna Charge
nitro-magna-charge.description: Nitro Magna Charge is a special Nitro-themed variant of the Tech element Skylander Magna Charge. He features a distinctive gold and checkered racing aesthetic, representing the high-speed 'Nitro' theme.
nitro-magna-charge.biography: Magna Charge came from the great race of Ultron robots, but was mysteriously created with a giant magnet head. This proved problematic, as his peers were all made of metal and were constantly being pulled towards him. As a result, Magna Charge was exiled to a faraway island, where he eventually learned to control his magnetic powers. After years of training, he returned to his home to demonstrate his abilities, but found everything completely destroyed. In searching for answers, Magna Charge caught the attention of Master Eon, who realized the unique Ultron soldier was a perfect candidate for the Skylanders.
nitro-magna-charge.personality: Magna Charge is incredibly focused, calculating, and efficient, as expected of a high-tech Ultron robot. Despite his mechanical nature, he shows great loyalty to the Skylanders and possesses a heroic drive to protect the innocent from Arkeyan-level threats. He considers himself superior in all areas, which is rarely a surprise given his advanced construction.
nitro-magna-charge.gameplay: Nitro Magna Charge is a speed-based character who uses magnetism to manipulate enemies. He can pick up enemies and throw them, or use his bottom half to dash through groups of foes at incredible speeds. His top half focuses on projectile magnetic blasts. He is capable of gathering gold and food around him while using Polarized Pickup and can stop enemies from spinning by using his magnetic abilities.

abilities.name: Magnet Cannon
abilities.description: Hold Attack 1 to rapidly fire energy projectiles. Firing for too long will cause the cannon to overheat.

abilities.name: Magneto Ball
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 to drag an enemy around. Press Attack 2 again to launch them forward. Large enemies cannot be dragged.

abilities.name: Polarized Pickup
abilities.description: Press Attack 3 to pick up enemies. Press Attack 3 again to slam them. While active, loot will be drawn in from a distance!

abilities.name: Eject
abilities.description: Press Attack 1 while dragging an object or enemy to throw it behind to boost forward.

abilities.name: Plasma Shots
abilities.description: Hold Attack 1 to rapidly shoot a Magnet Cannon that does increased damage. Projectiles heat up after a short time, dealing extra fire damage.

abilities.name: Rad Wheels
abilities.description: Speed is increased. Brand new developments in magnet wheels!

abilities.name: Magnetic Buildup
abilities.description: Hold an object with Polarized Pickup for a short time, release it to deal extra damage.

abilities.name: Drag Capacity
abilities.description: Two enemies can be dragged at once while dashing.

abilities.name: Multi Barrelled
abilities.description: Upgraded Magnet Cannon that shoots 3 projectiles at once!

abilities.name: Super Repulsor
abilities.description: A new wheel makes thrown objects gain increased damage, range and speed.

abilities.name: Discharge Recharge
abilities.description: Hold Attack 1 to overheat the Magnet Cannon, release to shoot a large fireball.

abilities.name: Heavy Blaster
abilities.description: Magnet cannon does even more damage.

abilities.name: Burst Pickup
abilities.description: Picking up enemies with Polarized Pickup will knock back nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Magnetic Personality
abilities.description: Magnet attacks do increased damage. Two-Ton's Law states: if it has mass, it can be slammed.

abilities.name: Shock Stop
abilities.description: Press (X) while dragging an enemy to drop it in front of you and shock it.

abilities.name: Crash Test
abilities.description: Shock Stop and Eject do increased damage.

abilities.name: Rapid Repel
abilities.description: Press (X) while dragging an object or enemy to shoot it without stopping.

abilities.name: Opposites Repel
abilities.description: Rapid Repel does increased damage. Repulsive!

trivia: He is the only SWAP Force Skylander to have a hand on only one arm.
The original concept designs for Magna Charge included a massive gatling gun on his left arm, which was eventually included as his Soul Gem upgrade.
He is one of the few Skylanders with only one eye, alongside Shroomboom, Rocky Roll, and Eye-Brawl.
During early development, his eye and wheel were both yellow instead of green.
When his bottom half is fully upgraded, his wheel turns blue.
He can perform a secret backflip that damages enemies by pressing the primary attack while charging.
Magna Charge resembles Rocket from Robot on Wheels.
He is one of the few Swap Force Skylanders without true legs, alongside Doom Stone, Rattle Shake, and Night Shift.
His voice actor, Gregg Berger, also voiced Hunter and Ripto in the original Spyro the Dragon games.
The name of his species is a reference to the Marvel Comics character, Ultron.
The magnet theme is a reference to how the real-world SWAP Force figures use magnets to swap parts.

nitro-skylanders.name: Nitro Skylanders
nitro-skylanders.description: Nitro Skylanders are characters introduced in Skylanders: Swap Force that are mostly associated with speed. They have a yellow-and-white checker color scheme. They were exclusively sold at Target stores.
nitro-skylanders.biography: Nitro Skylanders are characters introduced in Skylanders: Swap Force that are mostly associated with speed. They have a yellow-and-white checker color scheme. They were exclusively sold at Target stores.
nitro-skylanders.gameplay: Nitro Skylanders are characters that are mostly associated with speed. They have a yellow-and-white checker color scheme. Nitro Krypt King is currently the only Nitro Skylander who doesn't possess any speed moves.

abilities.name: Various
abilities.description: Nitro Skylanders possess various attacks unique to each character, though they are mostly associated with speed.

trivia: Nitro Krypt King is currently the only Nitro Skylander who doesn't possess any speed moves.
Nitro is a term used for a chemical makes cars move faster than normal, and Nitro variants have checkered patterns in their design, a symbol for racing.
Strangely there are no Nitro Skylanders for Skylanders: SuperChargers.
There are currently no core Nitro Skylanders.

obsidian-hot-head.name: Obsidian Hot Head
obsidian-hot-head.description: Obsidian Hot Head is a card counterpart of Hot Head in Skylanders: Battlecast.
obsidian-hot-head.biography: Obsidian Hot Head is a card counterpart of Hot Head in Skylanders: Battlecast.
obsidian-hot-head.personality: As an alternate counterpart of Hot Head, he likely shares the same explosive and enthusiastic personality as his original version.
obsidian-hot-head.gameplay: In Skylanders: Battlecast, Obsidian Hot Head functions as a character card with the special ability Fiery Outburst.

abilities.name: Fiery Outburst
abilities.description: Obsidian Hot Head unleashes a powerful burst of fire on his enemies.

trivia: He is the second alternate counterpart of a Giant to be released after Skylanders: Giants, the first being Admiral Thumpback in Skylanders: Lost Islands.
Unlike High Noon Trigger Happy, Obsidian Hot Head does not appear in other media.

pain-yatta.name: Pain-Yatta
pain-yatta.description: Pain-Yatta is a piñata monster who is one of the Magic villains in Skylanders: Trap Team. After changing his ways in Skylanders: Imaginators, he is now a Sensei that trains Imaginators of the Smasher Class.
pain-yatta.biography: Growing up, Pain-Yatta's best friend was the legendary Unocorn, a unicorn with a churro-horn that sprinkles magical cinnamon from time to time. While the cinnamon donuts for breakfast were incredible, being so sweet and delicious made them both easy targets for those looking for yummy treats. But Pain-Yatta had no problem protecting the both of them with his giant sucker! One day, however, the Unocorn went missing, and Pain-Yatta was beside himself. He tried desperately to find his buddy, but to no avail. That's when the Doom Raiders tricked him into thinking that the Skylanders were behind it all, and Pain-Yatta fell for it. He joined up with the band of villains and ventured out to get revenge on the Skylanders, but was eventually captured by the Trap Masters. Master Eon explained that the Skylanders had nothing to do with the Unocorn's disappearance and said he would help Pain-Yatta find his friend, if he became a Skylander Sensei and trained new Imaginators in the ways of smashing! Pain-Yatta agreed and the search for the missing Unocorn continues.
pain-yatta.personality: Pain-Yatta is an aggressive and vengeful creature, taking out his frustration of being rejected by the Doom Raiders in his attempts to rule Skylands no matter how many would be harmed by his candy army. However his backstory and Ring of Heroes show he's gullible, and was easily tricked by the Doom Raiders into believing the Skylanders were responsible for the disappearance of his best friend, the Unocorn; and later by Kaos. In Imaginators, however, he seems to have become more carefree and mocking, treating his fights like a party, though he takes his responsibility in protecting Skylands very seriously.
pain-yatta.gameplay: In Trap Team, when used as a trapped villain, Pain-Yatta wields a giant lollipop, which he uses to smash his enemies with as his main attack. His secondary attack makes him spew out large amounts of candy from his mouth at targets. He usually spits out a piñata as well during this attack - hitting the piñata with the lollipop will make it explode. During his boss fight, he only uses lollipop attacks, which however have a greater area and create an expanding shockwave. In Battlecast, hitting him will cause candy to fall out in the form of cards. However, he can also use it to his advantage, using its properties to force the opponent and himself to draw more cards, and then use several spells that cause more damage depending on how many they have. In Imaginators, Pain-Yatta retains his traditional attacks of lollipop slam and candy breath but now uses a variety of candy weapons with different attacks every time his current lollipop breaks. Additionally, he can summon miniature piñatas that distract enemies, then target them to explode. Upon taking damage, Pain-Yatta drops candy that restores health when picked up. Despite his bulk and size, Pain-Yatta is surprisingly nimble, allowing him to walk and smash with surprising speed.

abilities.name: Lollipop Slam
abilities.description: Press Attack 1 to smash your lollipops, which break and explode after enough hits! Different lollipop flavors have different explosions!

abilities.name: Candy Barf
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 to barf out candy!

abilities.name: Break It Down!
abilities.description: Get to the good stuff! Lollipops now break much faster!

abilities.name: Piñata Summon
abilities.description: Press Attack 3 to summon a piñata that distracts enemies and explodes when hit!

abilities.name: Piñata Posse
abilities.description: Piñata Summon now creates three piñatas

abilities.name: You Are What You Eat
abilities.description: You drop candy when you take damage! Pick it up to get health back!

abilities.name: Everybody Dance Now
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 while jumping for a dance party!

abilities.name: Party of One
abilities.description: The ultimate Sensei attack! Hold Special Attack to perform your Sky-Chi Power!

abilities.name: Sour Sucker
abilities.description: Lollipop Slam can give you a Sour Sucker, which shocks enemies when it breaks!

abilities.name: Sugar Rush
abilities.description: Lollipops now break MUCH faster!

abilities.name: Party Mode!
abilities.description: After breaking a lollipop, you enter PARTY MODE! For a short time, you deal more damage, take less damage, and move faster!

abilities.name: Rock Candy!
abilities.description: Lollipop Slam can give you a Rock Candy, which gives you a tough shield when it breaks!

abilities.name: After Party!
abilities.description: A piñata magically appears anytime you defeat an enemy!

abilities.name: Candy Laser
abilities.description: Hold Attack 2 for a spectacular candy laser attack!

trivia: While Pain-Yatta's promo art and figure has a white tooth, in-game, his tooth is a candy corn. This happened once again in Skylanders: Imaginators.
His name is a combination of 'pain' and 'piñata'.
His voice was originally deeper in early stages of development.
In his Meet the Villains video, Pain-Yatta speaks with a Spanish accent, provided by John DiMaggio.
He is the only villain in Telescope Towers not to say 'Heads up!'. Bomb-Shell, who is from the same element, replaces him on this occasion.
Pain-Yatta, Bad Juju, and Blaster-Tron are the only non-Doom Raider characters to not have major changes in Imaginators, be it color scheme or element.

Each of Pain-Yatta's lollipops have different effects: Traditional lollipops create a shockwave, candy canes freeze enemies, cake pops slow enemies, sour suckers shock enemies, and rock candies temporarily increase armor.
His quotes in Trap Team show him to be terrified of blindfolded children.
He's the only Smasher Sensei without an alt deco, though he has a chase variant.
Pain-Yatta is technically the only Skylanders character to own and drive two signature vehicles, one for land and another for sky.
Both he and Trail Blazer have come across the Unocorn once, with the latter freeing it not long after the piñata lost his friend.
His Soul Gem attack, 'Everybody Dance Now' is a reference to the song of the same name.
During a Grind Challenge, he and the Chompy Mage are the only Skylanders to slide on their behinds instead of their feet.
Pain-Yatta's theme is 'Mexico City' from APM Music.
He's the only Magic Villain who doesn't escape from the Skylanders.

pet-vac.name: Pet-Vac
pet-vac.description: Pet-Vac is the Mini version of the Air Skylander, Jet-Vac. He made his debut in Skylanders: Trap Team.
pet-vac.biography: The Skylander Minis started off as regular 'Sidekicks', assisting the Skylanders on many exciting adventures. And what they lacked in size they more than made up for in courage. Ultimately determined to become full-fledged heroes, they trained at the Skylands Academy - honing their powers and skills until they were ready. Now, they stand side by side with their full grown counterparts, ready to defend Skylands against Kaos and his evil minions.
pet-vac.personality: Pet Vac is an honorable soldier who gladly puts the needs of others before himself. His bravery and heroism earned him the respect of his teammates.
pet-vac.gameplay: Pet-Vac functions as a projectile-based fighter who uses his vacuum gun to control the battlefield. He can fire high-velocity air blasts to damage enemies from a distance or use his suction ability to pull smaller enemies toward him, leaving them vulnerable. His jetpack provides excellent aerial mobility, allowing him to hover over hazards and reposition quickly during combat.

abilities.name: Vac Blaster
abilities.description: Fire a blast of pressurized air at your enemies.

abilities.name: Suction Gun
abilities.description: Suck up enemies and then fire them back out.

abilities.name: Jet-Vac Jet Pack
abilities.description: Hold the jump button to hover in the air.

abilities.name: Air-Tight
abilities.description: Vac Blaster shots travel further and do more damage.

abilities.name: Vac Blaster 9000
abilities.description: Further upgrades to the Vac Blaster for maximum efficiency.

abilities.name: Fiester Fan
abilities.description: A powerful fan upgrade to enhance air-based attacks.

abilities.name: Eagle-Air Mastery
abilities.description: While hovering, you can fire a powerful air strike that hits all nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Vacuum Lung
abilities.description: Increase the range and power of the Suction Gun.

abilities.name: Flying High
abilities.description: Increases speed and attack power while in the air.

trivia: Pet Vac is the only Mini who is the counterpart of a core Skylander from Giants.
He and Small Fry are the only Mini counterparts of core Skylanders who didn't appear in Spyro's Adventure.
He and Weeruptor, besides Barkley, are the only Minis who have variants.
Coincidentally, both of their original counterparts are the only Skylanders with Mini counterparts new to Trap Team who have SuperCharger forms in Skylanders: SuperChargers.

pit-boss.name: Pit Boss
pit-boss.description: Pit Boss is an Undead viper Sensei of the Sorcerer Battle Class in Skylanders: Imaginators.
pit-boss.biography: Pit Boss was a member of a powerful order of snake philosophers that lived high up in the Great Twisty Mountains. Travelers would come from miles around and make the treacherous climb just to seek out the snakes' wisdom. Each visitor was permitted to ask one question, but Pit Boss became alarmed when the same question was asked by several different people – how to deal with the growing threat of Kaos! With such a great concern, Pit Boss knew that it was time for action, not words. He left the Order of the Snake in search of this threat, and soon it was clear that Kaos was worse than Pit Boss had imagined. Knowing he could not stop Kaos on his own, Pit Boss joined the Skylanders, and due to his great wisdom and mystical powers, Master Eon enlisted him into the Sensei program as a Sorcerer Master.
pit-boss.personality: Pit Boss' wisdom is said to have no bounds. He has a love for certain 'S' words that are related to snakes, such as the words 'snake', 'slither', 'serpent', and 'statistics'.
pit-boss.gameplay: Pit Boss can blast ghostly snakes at his foes, as well as summon a swirling pit of vipers that damage foes. Pit Boss can also transform into a giant beastly snake, and even drag enemies along with him. His Soul Gem allows him to summon a colossal undead snake from the ground when in his snake form. His Sky-Chi power allows him to summon a rain of snakes from above which damages enemies in a wide range.

abilities.name: Snake Attack
abilities.description: Press Attack 1 to launch ghostly snake attacks.

abilities.name: Slithering Soul Snake
abilities.description: Press and hold Attack 2 to turn into a Snake.

abilities.name: Viper Pits
abilities.description: Press Attack 3 to create Viper Pits that damage enemies, and make your primary attacks do more damage and travel faster.

abilities.name: Besst for Lasst
abilities.description: Do damage around you when releasing Attack 2.

abilities.name: Pit Master
abilities.description: Viper Pits slow enemies down, and they will always take critical hits. You can also make one more Viper Pit.

abilities.name: Slither Away
abilities.description: Carry enemies with you when turning into a Snake with Attack 2.

abilities.name: The Undersnaker
abilities.description: Release Attack 2 while coiled in Slithering Soul Snake to unleash a giant undead Snake.

abilities.name: Viper Volley
abilities.description: The ultimate Sensei attack! Hold Special Attack to perform your Sky-Chi Power! It's raining snakes!

abilities.name: Superior Slithering
abilities.description: You can carry one more enemy during the secondary attack.

abilities.name: The More the Snake-ier
abilities.description: The more enemies you carry with Attack 2, the more damage you do.

abilities.name: Shedding
abilities.description: Leave your remains behind as a barrier when transforming back from Attack 2.

abilities.name: Restless Reptiles
abilities.description: Vipers will shoot out of Viper Pits when they expire and damage enemies.

abilities.name: Viper Pit Pounce
abilities.description: Jumping while in Snake Form creates a Viper Pit. You can now make up to three of them.

abilities.name: Really Restless Reptiles
abilities.description: Vipers will continuously escape the Viper Pits and damage enemies.

trivia: Pit Boss is the third snake Skylander, after Rattle Shake and Cobra Cadabra.
Like them, Pit Boss has limbs and can call forth more snakes to assist him.
His name is based on the name of the snake species, the Pit Viper.

His name may also be based on concept of snake pits, places of torture in mythology and folklore, where unfortunate prisoners would be thrown in to be traumatized or even killed in horrific ways. Likewise, he can summon and control large amounts of snakes to harass his enemies, making him the boss of the pit.
His name also might be based on casino pit bosses, which manages other supervisors in the game tables.
He is the third Undead character voiced by John Kassir, after Ghost Roaster and Short Cut.
Although his scepter is golden on his promotional art and figure toy, in game is silver.
During development, Pit Boss was a Dark Skylander, at that point simply named Viper.

According to Jeff Murchie, Pit Boss was one of the first characters approved for Skylanders: Imaginators. Initially, some designers were concerned that he looked too much like a villain, but they decided that it was good to have at least one 'edgy' Skylander in the lineup.

polar-whirlwind.name: Polar Whirlwind
polar-whirlwind.description: Polar Whirlwind is the winter version of the Air Skylander, Series 2 Whirlwind. She was released as a special variant in Skylanders: Giants.
polar-whirlwind.biography: Polar Whirlwind is the winter version of the Air Skylander, Series 2 Whirlwind. Being a unicorn/dragon hybrid, Whirlwind was never truly accepted by either species. The unicorns were envious of her ability to fly, and the dragons were jealous of her graceful beauty. But she found peace within the stormy clouds, where she learned to harness the power of the rainbow, making it a powerful force for good. Now, as a Skylander, she protects Skylands with her unique powers.
polar-whirlwind.personality: Whirlwind is known for being graceful, courageous, and determined. Despite being an outcast in her youth, she uses her unique heritage to help others and defend the Skylands.
polar-whirlwind.gameplay: Polar Whirlwind plays identically to Series 2 Whirlwind, utilizing rainbows and clouds to attack enemies. Her rainbows can bounce between enemies and her clouds provide area-of-effect damage. Her Wow Pow allows her to charge her rainbows for extra explosive damage.

abilities.name: Rainbow of Doom
abilities.description: Shoots a rainbow that can damage enemies and bounce between them.

abilities.name: Tempest Cloud
abilities.description: Creates a cloud that rains down lightning on enemies.

abilities.name: Dragon Flight
abilities.description: Allows Whirlwind to fly over obstacles.

abilities.name: Healing Rainbows
abilities.description: Rainbows heal allies in co-op mode.

abilities.name: Rainbow Singularity
abilities.description: Summons a black hole rainbow that sucks in enemies.

abilities.name: Cloudbursting
abilities.description: Hold the Rainbow button to charge a rainbow that creates a large explosion.

abilities.name: Atomic Rainbow
abilities.description: Rainbows create a large explosion on impact.

trivia: Polar Whirlwind's wings are blue in some occasions in the game but the toy does not show her with blue wings.

Her colorfully-glowing horn indicates her Wow Pow, Cloudbursting. However in Skylanders: Swap Force, her horn doesn't glow and there is a glitch in which it does if she doesn't fully charge her Rainbow Singularity attack.
She is one of the few variants that has a different color scheme in-game than her standard counterpart.

pop-fizz.name: Pop Fizz
appearances: Lightning Rod Faces the Cyclops Queen
pop-fizz.description: Pop Fizz is a blue gremlin alchemist who is one of the Magic Skylanders in Skylanders: Giants. His Series 2 counterpart is called Super Gulp Pop Fizz, and his Series 3 counterpart is Fizzy Frenzy Pop Fizz. Pop Fizz has a red counterpart called Punch Pop Fizz, who is available in the 3DS Starter Pack of Giants and is now available in a single pack. His Series 3 figure has a pink version called Love Potion Pop Fizz. He also has an Easter counterpart, Hoppity Pop Fizz, who was only available in Skylanders: Lost Islands for a limited time. In Skylanders: SuperChargers, Pop Fizz is redesigned as a SuperCharger named Big Bubble Pop Fizz.
pop-fizz.biography: Nobody is quite sure who Pop Fizz was before he became an alchemist, least of all Pop Fizz himself. After many years of experimenting with magical potions, his appearance has changed quite significantly. In fact, no one even knows his original colour. But it's widely known that he is a little crazy, his experiments are reckless, and the accidents they cause are too numerous to measure. Understandably, he has had a difficult time finding lab partners, or anyone that even wants to be near him. In hopes of making himself more appealing to others, he attempted to create the most effective charm potion ever — but that just turned him into a big, wild, berserker. Or maybe that's just how he saw the potion working in the first place...
pop-fizz.personality: Pop Fizz is widely known as being a little crazy. The Skylander who puts the mad into a mad scientist, he is bubbling over with crazy amounts of enthusiasm. And that's before he's glugged from his bonkers beast beaker! According to Pop Fizz, the reason he keeps drinking his potion, or soda, is that the effects keep him on edge, gives him powers and that it is 'soda-licious.' He is also one of the few characters who fully understand Double Trouble's language.
pop-fizz.gameplay: Pop Fizz can throw his potions at enemies. He has three potions: a green one (which when thrown forms an acid pool on where it lands), a purple one (which when thrown spawns a potion minion that will attack for you), and an orange one (which explodes like a bomb on contact), and he can switch the active potion with the third attack button. For his second attack, he drinks his current potion and transforms into his Beast Form. Depending on his chosen upgrades, he will have different attacks in Beast Form. With his Soul Gem upgrade, repeatedly switching potions causes an explosion. In Skylanders: Battlecast, his potions can be used as spells, though with random results. He can also use cheap and powerful spells, but at great costs, such as muting him for the rest of a fight. His signature Gear is the Soda Fountain, which creates spells of an ally's element, and his Special Ability is Strange Brew, which randomly creates a spell. His scrapped card and signature Relic is the Carbonator, which decreases the cost of spells drawn after it is placed.

abilities.name: Potion Lob
abilities.description: Press the attack 1 button to lob his currently-equipped potion.

abilities.name: Beast Form
abilities.description: Press the attack 2 button to drink his potion and temporarily change into a beast form.

abilities.name: New Concoctions
abilities.description: Press the attack 3 button to switch to some new potions, which forms a potion minion when it hits the ground

abilities.name: Puddle of Pain
abilities.description: Press the attack 3 button to cycle to a new potion that leaves a damaging puddle of acid when thrown.

abilities.name: Raging Beast
abilities.description: All attacks in Beast Form do additional damage.

abilities.name: Dexterous Delivery
abilities.description: Throws potions and grabs new ones much faster.

abilities.name: Shake It!
abilities.description: Repeatedly press attack 3 to shake potion bottle until it explodes.

abilities.name: Beaker Buddy
abilities.description: When throwing Purple Potions, one of them will grow into a giant, special pet.

abilities.name: Oversize ME!
abilities.description: Tap Attack 2 repeatedly to swallow a potion whole and become a Super Beast with overload abilities.

abilities.name: More Beast!
abilities.description: Beast Form meter drains more slowly and recharges faster.

abilities.name: Berserker Boost
abilities.description: In Beast Form, damaging enemies increases the Beast Form meter.

abilities.name: Mutant Beast
abilities.description: In Beast Form, press attack 3 to perform a special attack based on which potion is active.

abilities.name: Master Chemist
abilities.description: All potions do increased damage and have improved effects.

abilities.name: Mixologist
abilities.description: Mix the effects of different color potions for brand new effects.

abilities.name: All in
abilities.description: Hold the attack 1 button to pull up to 3 potions out and release to throw them all out at once.

trivia: Early in development, Pop Fizz was called Alchemist. He was one of the earliest Skylanders for Skylanders: Giants to have voice lines during gameplay, and spoke with a heavy German accent. Unlike his final version, Pop Fizz originally ran all fours in Beast Form, and his standard orange potion was initially red.
In the 3DS version however, Pop Fizz's beast form still runs on all fours.
His bottle minions originally reused the models of dark Flame Imps, firing purple energy bullets from their stalks.
During Giants' alpha development, some of Pop Fizz's abilities/upgrades were differently named and arranged.
'New Concoctions' was called 'Potion of Animation.'
'Puddle of Pain' was called 'Potion of Acid Splash.'
'Raging Beast' was called 'Raging Hulk.'
'Dexterous Delivery' was called 'Hyper Throw.'
'More Beast!' was replaced by an upgrade called 'Berserker,' which had the same effect as 'Berserker Boost.'
'Berserker Boost' was replaced by an upgrade called 'Smoldering Rage,' which had the same effect as 'More Beast!'
'Mutant Beast' was called 'Mutant.'
'Shake It!' was called 'Shake it like you just don't care.'
In a particular demo of Pop Fizz on YouTube, when he drinks his potion, his berserker form is pink instead of blue.
Pop Fizz bearing the ability to change between his normal state and his violent state using a potion is similar to the character, Dr. Jekyll and his split personality, Mr. Hyde.
Unlike Mr. Hyde, Pop Fizz retains his personality in his beast form; he does, however, seem to become more hyper.
As a LightCore figure, his bottle lights up. The beaker appears to be bigger than his regular counterpart's
There is an unused Prototype art of the lightcore figure shown on most platforms. It has two bottles.

As a Series 2 figure, he stands on top of his giant purple beaker indicating his Wow Pow, Beaker Buddy. His gauntlets appear to have turned gold after obtaining his Wow Pow. Also, his backpack of bottles appears to be purple as well.

pop-thorn.name: Pop Thorn
pop-thorn.description: Pop Thorn is a pufferthorn who is one of the two Air Core Skylanders in Skylanders: Swap Force. He is part of the Tower of Time Adventure Pack, but is also available in a single pack.
pop-thorn.biography: Pop Thorn hails from a race of creatures known as Pufferthorns. Often considered one of the cutest creatures in all of Skylands, they are generally quite timid and puff out sharp spines when scared. It is this ability that long ago led to the unfortunate legacy of being used as combs by giant trolls everywhere, being the sharp spines are perfect for brushing out tangles from their long, matted hair. But not long ago, one Pufferthorn took a stand. Tired of his race being used for nothing more than good grooming, Pop Thorn used his naturally thorny abilities to stand up and fight back against the giant trolls.
