Soon after, Master Eon made Pop Thorn a Skylander. And to this day, no trolls dare to comb their hair.
pop-thorn.personality: Pop Thorn is sweetness and light until something ruffles his spines. Nothing needles him more than being taken for granted. He doesn't let anyone walk all over him, and ensures that his foes get the point.
pop-thorn.gameplay: Pop Thorn can inflate himself to a large size, and shoot homing spikes at enemies while inflated. Pop Thorn can also deflate himself and shoot blasts of wind while popped. While deflated, Pop Thorn's third attack allows him to create wind traps which explode when enemies are near, when he is deflated. While inflated, Pop Thorn's third attack lets him smash enemies with his spiky body.

abilities.name: Puff
abilities.description: Press Attack 1 to Puff and damage nearby enemies. While puffed, rapidly press Attack 1 to shoot out homing spikes at nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Pop
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 to Pop and shoot a large wind blast. While popped, hold Attack 2 to shoot gusts of wind at enemies.

abilities.name: Fresh Breath
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 to Pop. After popping, hold Attack 2 to shoot more powerful air projectiles for a short time.

abilities.name: Puffball Pound
abilities.description: Press Attack 1 to Puff. Press Attack 3 while puffed to slam into the ground, damaging all nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Polished Spikes
abilities.description: Press Attack 1 to Puff. After puffing, press Attack 1 rapidly to shoot more powerful spike projectiles for a short time.

abilities.name: Wind Trap
abilities.description: While popped, press Attack 3 to leave behind a spiny mine. The mine puffs and explodes when enemies approach, launching them into the air.

abilities.name: To Puff or Not to Puff
abilities.description: While popped, speed is increased. While puffed, armor is increased, which reduces damage taken.

abilities.name: Rollerpuff
abilities.description: While puffed, hold Attack 3 to roll forward, damaging all enemies in the way.

abilities.name: Bounceback
abilities.description: Puffing deals increased damage and reflects nearby projectiles.

abilities.name: Prickly Body
abilities.description: While puffed, taking damage releases a spike projectile that damages an attacker.

abilities.name: Aero Trampoline
abilities.description: While puffed, hold Attack 3 to charge a powerful slam attack, release to bounce multiple times, damaging all enemies in the way.

abilities.name: Deep Breath
abilities.description: While puffed, press Attack 2 to shoot three air blasts instead of one.

abilities.name: Scattered Winds
abilities.description: While popped, air beams now shoot multiple projectiles that spread

trivia: Pop Thorn resembles a pufferfish.
When not puffed, he looks similar to a dragon.
He and Pop Fizz are the only Skylanders that have 'Pop' in their names. Coincidentally, they both also have two changeable forms and were voiced by two American stand-up comedians.
His name is a play on the popular movie snack food 'popcorn.' Coincidentally, his Lost Islands alter ego, Buttered Pop Thorn, is based on popcorn.
Developer Dan Wallace remarks, 'From the first time I saw Pop Thorn I knew he was going to be a character people love.'

Soon after Pop Thorn was born, the Pufferthorns held a competition to find the cutest baby. The entries were all so adorable that every single one of them tied for first place except for Pop Thorn, who came second. Even back then, it seems, there was a hint of danger about him that was not present in other Pufferthorns.
Pop Thorn's single pack toy figure has a completely different mold and is more vibrant in color compared his toy figure in the Tower of Time adventure pack.
He makes squeaky noises whenever he walks.
Pop Thorn is mostly portrayed in his Puffed form.
Pop Thorn is a bit similar to Wrecking Ball, both are blue, small, roundish, and have a cute appearance.
He was originally called Gasteroid.
Whenever he is placed on the portal, after he says his Catchphrase, a tinkly sound can be heard in the background before he puffs up.
Whenever Pop Thorn changes from Pop to Puff form and vice versa, the resulting transformation can deal damage, but this is not mentioned in the upgrades.
Pop Thorn, Blades and Free Ranger are the only Air Skylanders who can't fly in-game.
As seen in the Skylanders Short Cuts, Pop Thorn puffs up when he bluffs.
On the 3DS, the art of Puffed Pop Thorn will switch to a picture of his Popped form, not seen anywhere else, when switched.
His Soul Gem Ability title, 'To Puff or Not to Puff,' is a joke on 'To be or not to be', a popular quote from William Shakespeare's Hamlet.

Pop Thorn and Blades share some similarities with each other: They are both Air element Skylanders. They are both quadrupedal creatures. They both have protection on their bodies (Pop Thorn's spikes and Blades' bladed armor). Both of their Soul Gems are found in the first level of their respective games. They both come in Adventure Packs (Tower of Time for Pop Thorn and Nightmare Express for Blades) that are available in the first wave.

power-blue-ember.name: Power Blue Ember
power-blue-ember.description: Power Blue Ember is the scrapped Power Blue counterpart of Ember.
power-blue-ember.biography: Power Blue Ember is the scrapped Power Blue counterpart of Ember. She was planned as a special variant for the Power Blue series, a partnership between Activision and Autism Speaks. Like other Power Blue Skylanders, she would have featured a distinct blue and white color scheme. However, the variant was never officially released and remains a piece of cut content from Skylanders: Imaginators.
power-blue-ember.personality: Determined and disciplined, Ember is a master of the dual blades who treats her role as a Sensei with the utmost respect and focus.
power-blue-ember.gameplay: As a Sentinel Sensei, Power Blue Ember would have utilized dual-wielding katana attacks, fire geysers, and explosive dash moves to control the battlefield. Her combat style focuses on the Sentinel battle class.

abilities.name: Samurai Combo
abilities.description: Swing the dual blades in a series of powerful strikes.

abilities.name: Flame Geyser
abilities.description: Summon a geyser of fire from the ground to burn enemies.

abilities.name: Immolation
abilities.description: Surround yourself in a cloak of fire to damage nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Inner Fire
abilities.description: Channel your energy to increase attack power and speed.

abilities.name: Living Bomb Path
abilities.description: Unleash a devastating path of explosive living fire bombs.

abilities.name: Living Bomb Path Upgrade
abilities.description: Enhance the power of your living fire bomb attacks.

trivia: She is one of the few scrapped Sensei variants known to exist.
The Power Blue line was created to support autism awareness.
Her design replaces her usual red and gold armor with blue and white.
Her existence was confirmed via Artstation on December 22, 2022.

power-blue-splat.name: Power Blue Splat
power-blue-splat.description: Power Blue Splat is the Power Blue counterpart of Splat in Skylanders: SuperChargers. She is a special edition variant released in partnership with Autism Speaks to promote awareness.
power-blue-splat.biography: Splat grew up in a typical faun village which was perfectly manicured and orderly. Every day in school, she and her classmates would recite the same poems, play the same music, and paint the same picture – which was always a portrait of their great ancestor, Fluty Hoofdancer. But this didn’t suit Splat. The only art she wanted to learn was the art of war! After school, she would sneak off to the river and practice her own free form fighting technique against Chompies and other creatures that were causing trouble. When the elder fauns learned of this, they were outraged. But soon thereafter, a band of Drow attacked the village to steal their valuable art, and while the other fauns cowered in fear, Splat stood her ground. Unleashing her self-taught fighting style, she defended her village and sent the Drow running. Now as a member of the Skylanders, Splat makes quite the impression wherever she goes!
power-blue-splat.personality: Splat is a rebellious and creative soul who finds beauty in combat. Unlike the rest of her village, she values self-expression through martial arts and is fiercely protective of her home and fellow Skylanders.
power-blue-splat.gameplay: Power Blue Splat uses her staff and magical ink to fight. She makes quite the impression wherever she goes, utilizing her self-taught fighting style to defend Skylands. Her attacks include Artisan Arts, Heave Hue, Have an Inkling, Wet Paint, and Running Colors.

abilities.name: Artisan Arts
abilities.description: Attack enemies with your staff and paint.

abilities.name: Heave Hue
abilities.description: Fire a splash of ink at distant enemies.

abilities.name: Have an Inkling
abilities.description: An artistic new attack.

abilities.name: Wet Paint
abilities.description: Covers enemies in wet paint.

abilities.name: Running Colors
abilities.description: Dodge and move with style through combat.

trivia: While Power Blue Splat's eyes are blue in her promotional art, her eyes are green in the game and in toy form. This error is the same as her original counterpart's.
The Power Blue series was created in partnership with Autism Speaks.

power-blue-trigger-happy.name: Power Blue Trigger Happy
power-blue-trigger-happy.description: Power Blue Trigger Happy is a special edition variant of Double Dare Trigger Happy, released in 2016 as part of a partnership between Activision and Autism Speaks.
power-blue-trigger-happy.biography: Power Blue Trigger Happy is the special Power Blue version of Double Dare Trigger Happy. Like all Power Blue Skylanders, he was created to help raise awareness for autism through the Power Blue initiative. Despite his blue and white exterior, he remains the same hyperactive gold-loving Gremlin that Portal Masters have come to know and love.
power-blue-trigger-happy.personality: Trigger Happy is the solution to every problem, and that solution is usually 'shoot it'. He is hyperactive, easily excited, and has a near-obsessive love for gold and firepower. He is never seen without a manic grin on his face.
power-blue-trigger-happy.gameplay: As a SuperCharger, Power Blue Trigger Happy uses high-speed dual pistols called Fire Crackers. He can deploy a massive golden cannon for heavy damage and uses a variety of gold-themed gadgets to overwhelm enemies on the battlefield.

abilities.name: Fire Cracker
abilities.description: Shoot gold-flinging pistols at enemies.

abilities.name: Crowd-Pleaser
abilities.description: Deploy a golden cannon that blasts enemies away.

abilities.name: Breaking Cannon
abilities.description: An improved golden cannon with increased firepower.

abilities.name: Hoop N' Holler
abilities.description: A rhythmic attack that deals damage to surrounding enemies.

abilities.name: Can On and On
abilities.description: A powerful, continuous cannon attack that shreds through enemies.

trivia: He is the only alternate counterpart of a SuperCharger repose who does not keep his SuperCharger title.
If he had kept it, his name would have been slightly longer than that of Birthday Bash Big Bubble Pop Fizz, who currently has the longest name of any Skylander.

His in-game colors don't match his artwork and figure. The flaming rings in front of his Firecracker pistols are yellow instead of blue, and his eyes are yellow instead of white. The wing flaps on his arms are partially blue, instead of all white.
The Power Blue figures were released to support Autism Speaks.

power-blues.name: Power Blues
power-blues.description: The Power Blues are special Skylanders that appeared in Skylanders: SuperChargers. These Skylanders were created in response to the fans who are diagnosed with autism and help spread awareness.
power-blues.biography: The Power Blues are special Skylanders that appeared in Skylanders: SuperChargers. These Skylanders were created in response to the fans who are diagnosed with autism and help spread awareness. In addition to the partnership between Activision and Autism Speaks, Splat, Double Dare Trigger Happy and their respective vehicles are colored blue and white to reflect Autism Speaks' official colors.
power-blues.gameplay: These variants play identically to their standard versions in terms of mechanics and move sets, but they are visually distinct with their blue-and-white color schemes in both the physical world and the digital game. In Skylanders: SuperChargers, Power Blue Splat and Power Blue Trigger Happy appear in-game with their unique blue and white skins.
trivia: Power Blue Splat and Power Blue Trigger Happy's Rift Engine pedestals are white while their element icons and bottom elemental parts are blue.
A Power Blue variant of Ember was planned for Skylanders: Imaginators but was scrapped.

power-punch-pet-vac.name: Power Punch Pet Vac
power-punch-pet-vac.description: Power Punch Pet Vac is an alter ego of the Air Mini, Pet Vac, in Skylanders: Trap Team.
power-punch-pet-vac.biography: This year, Pet Vac is aiming to reign supreme in the Annual Dragon Egg Hunt and break the all-time Skylander record for number of eggs collected (currently held by Sonic Boom). Some say that having a suction gun gives Pet Vac an unfair advantage. But everyone knows better than to say that directly to the little Sky Baron, because despite being small, he packs a big punch!
power-punch-pet-vac.personality: Despite being small, Power Punch Pet Vac is highly competitive and determined, especially regarding the Annual Dragon Egg Hunt. He is known for packing a big punch and isn't afraid to use his suction gun to gain an advantage.
power-punch-pet-vac.gameplay: Power Punch Pet Vac is a Mini Skylander with a moveset identical to Pet Vac. His gameplay focuses on vacuum-based attacks, utilizing the Vac Blaster for range and the Suction Gun for crowd control. While his in-game console stats are mostly unknown, his promotional power stats show a strong emphasis on Agility and Luck. Notably, his physical figure's black and red color scheme differs from his in-game gold and red model.

abilities.name: Vac Blaster
abilities.description: Uses a vacuum-powered blaster to shoot air projectiles at enemies.

abilities.name: Suction Gun
abilities.description: Uses suction to pull in enemies or objects.

abilities.name: Jet Vac Jet Pack
abilities.description: Utilizes a jet pack for enhanced mobility and aerial attacks.

abilities.name: Vac Blaster 9000
abilities.description: An upgraded version of the Vac Blaster with increased power.

abilities.name: Fiester Fan
abilities.description: A powerful upgrade that enhances Pet Vac's fan-based abilities.

trivia: His appearance resembles Full Blast Jet-Vac.
This is exemplified by his figure, whose colour combinations are effectively identical to Full Blast Jet-Vac.
He, Eggsellent Weeruptor, and Gnarly Barkley are the only Minis to be available in single packs instead of double packs.
The coloration of his figure is actually different than the coloration of his official art and in game model. His figure is black and red, but his in game model and official art are gold and red.
Interestingly, the figure shown on the official Skylanders website shows it with the in game colouration, despite this never being released.
The color of the suit resembles Iron Man.

prism-break.name: Prism Break
prism-break.description: Prism Break is a crystal rock golem Skylander in Skylanders: Spyro's Adventure. His Series 3 counterpart is named Hyper Beam Prism Break.
prism-break.biography: Prism Break was once a fearsome Rock Golem who didn't like to be disturbed. Then, an accidental cave-in left him buried underground. One hundred years later, a mining expedition digging for valuable jewels discovered him by chance with a well-placed blow from a pick axe – something Prism Break doesn't talk about. After 100 years of solitude, he found that the pressure of the earth had transformed him emotionally as well as physically, turning his crude rocky arms into incredible gems with powerful energy. Grateful for being free of his earthly prison, Prism Break decided to put his new abilities to good use and dedicated himself to protecting Skylands.
prism-break.personality: Prism Break used to be a frightening rock golem who didn't like to be bothered. After being buried underground for 100 years in a cave-in, he gained a change of heart when a Mabu mining expedition freed him, and Prism Break dedicated himself in protecting the Mabu tribe and Skylands. While not as cranky as before, he still prefers his own company and keeps to himself until needed, although he's quick to use his precious gem-powered abilities to protect Skylands from attack.
prism-break.gameplay: Prism Break has the ability to shoot beams of energy at his enemies using his gem-like limbs, and also summon crystals to erupt from the ground under his opponents to finish them off, or use them to refract his energy beams.

abilities.name: Energy Beam
abilities.description: Fire and sustain a powerful beam of energy.

abilities.name: Summon Crystal Shard
abilities.description: Summon crystal shards to smash enemies and refract Energy Beams.

abilities.name: Super Crystal Shard
abilities.description: Summoned Crystal Shards do increased damage.

abilities.name: Crystal Eruption
abilities.description: Summon a damaging ring of crystals around Prism Break.

abilities.name: Emerald Energy Beam
abilities.description: Energy Beam attack does extra damage.

abilities.name: Chained Refractions
abilities.description: Split Energy Beams split again if they pass through a Crystal Shard.

abilities.name: Shard Soul Prison
abilities.description: Crystal Gems form at defeated enemies.

abilities.name: Pulse Power
abilities.description: While holding Attack 1, press Attack 2 to send a powerful pulse down the beam.

abilities.name: Crystal Comrade
abilities.description: Press Attack 1 to shoot Crystal Shards and gem shrapnel explode out, damaging enemies and looking cool.

abilities.name: Massive Crystal Eruption
abilities.description: Crystal Eruption does increased damage and covers a larger area.

abilities.name: Triple Crystal Shard
abilities.description: Summon three Crystal Shards at once.

abilities.name: Crystalline Armor
abilities.description: Makes it harder for enemies to hit Prism Break. +40 armor.

abilities.name: Golden Diamond Energy Beam
abilities.description: Energy Beam attack does even more increased damage.

abilities.name: Triple Refracted Beam
abilities.description: Energy Beam splits into 3 beams when refracted through a Crystal Shard.

abilities.name: Focused Energy
abilities.description: Energy Beam attack has increased range.

trivia: Some fans mistook the jagged texture in Prism Break's mouth in his official artworks as many needle-sharp teeth. However, in game he has an empty, cavernous mouth lacking any teeth at all, exactly like every one of his figures.
Prism Break's Series 2 figure has green crystals on his arms, but his Series 1 figure has sapphire-colored crystals.
His Series 2 figure has also been seen with blue-shaded crystals, though it's most likely a manufacturing error.
Prism Break, Crusher, and Flashwing are the only Skylanders who can break Tzo Crystals.
Whirlwind can also do this, but only in the Xbox 360, PS3, and PC Versions of Spyro's Adventure.
His name is a pun on the term 'Prison Break'.
As a LightCore, his arm crystals light up. His shoulder ones do not, however.
In Giants, he holds his arms a bit further apart when he pops up on-screen than in Spyro's Adventure.
Prism Break, Stump Smash, Eruptor, Drill Sergeant, Countdown and Fist Bump are the only bipedal Skylanders without hands.
Series 2 Prism Break has the Crystal Eruption and Crystalline Armor upgrades from his Crystaleer upgrade path.
He has an exclusive flocked variant known as Employee Prism Break, who was given to employees at Activision.
In Trap Team, Prism Break's Shard Soul Prisons are now red or purple depending on which upgrade path he takes.
Enemies will get distracted by his crystals on the field, allowing the player to take advantage of their trajectory.
For reasons unknown, Prism Break's voice actor, Peter Lurie, has been uncredited in Skylanders: SuperChargers.
In Skylanders: Battlecast, Lurie was replaced with Brad Abrell as the voice of Prism Break.
Hyper Beam Prism Break's artwork can be seen in the Season 1 intro of the Skylanders Academy TV series within The Book of Skylanders.

In Skylanders: Giants, Prism Break received an updated design compared to the Wii version of Spyro's Adventure, where he received a more detailed rocky appearance. On the Wii version of Giants however, he was left unchanged.

According to designer I-Wei Huang, Prism Break is 'the MVP of Skylanders' because his figure was used to test so many toy ideas. His arm was the inspiration for the shape of Trap Team's Traps, and he was the first Skylander tested for Lightcore technology.

punch-pop-fizz.name: Punch Pop Fizz
punch-pop-fizz.description: Punch Pop Fizz is a red variation of Pop Fizz, available in the Nintendo 3DS version of Skylanders: Giants. He is now available in a single pack in the United Kingdom.
punch-pop-fizz.biography: Some of Pop Fizz's experiments end with a new potion to throw at his enemies. Others change the color of his fur completely, such as the one responsible for his red color. Sporting a new red coat, the change hasn't stopped Pop Fizz from continuing to mix his strange brews. The zany Skylander rushes into battle without hesitation, tossing his concoctions at his foes or drinking them to unleash the Berserker.
punch-pop-fizz.personality: Punch Pop Fizz is a zany Skylander who rushes into battle without hesitation, driven by his eccentric passion for alchemy and strange brews.
punch-pop-fizz.gameplay: Punch Pop Fizz rushes into battle without hesitation, tossing his concoctions at his foes or drinking them to unleash the Berserker. His primary combat involves lobbing various potions or transforming into a beast form for melee destruction.

abilities.name: Potion Lob
abilities.description: Punch Pop Fizz tosses potions at his enemies with various effects.

abilities.name: Beast Form
abilities.description: Punch Pop Fizz drinks a potion to transform into a powerful Berserker beast.

abilities.name: New Concoctions
abilities.description: Allows for more complex potion mixtures and effects.

abilities.name: Puddle of Pain
abilities.description: Creates a hazardous puddle on the ground that damages enemies.

abilities.name: Raging Beast
abilities.description: Unleashes the full fury of the beast form for maximum destruction.

trivia: In the trailer, he is called Red Pop Fizz.
He resembles the Press Your Luck mascot, the Whammy as both do crazy things and have red fur.
He resembles Ickys from the Nickelodeon series 'Aaaaaah! Real Monsters!'
Initially, Punch Pop Fizz did not have a unique backstory, but eventually when he was released as part of a Trap Team promotion at GameStop for trading in an older portal, a backstory was written.
Using Love Potion Pop Fizz in Skylanders: Giants will cause him to appear as Punch Pop Fizz.
His cufflinks are silver instead of gold.
On his figure, his backpack is a darker shade of brown than the one on his regular blue counterpart.

punk-shock.name: Punk Shock
punk-shock.description: Punk Shock is an anthropomorphic electric eel who is one of the Water core Skylanders in Skylanders: Swap Force.
punk-shock.biography: Daughter to the most royal family in Wondrous Waters, Punk Shock never really accepted her role as an undersea princess. She preferred a much more exciting life - hunting with her electric crossbow and listening to super-charged music. After journeying to the outer reaches of her kingdom to find adventure, Punk Shock returned home to discover adventure had found her. The kingdom and its people were magically frozen by the Snow Trolls, who were there to steal valuable treasure. Punk Shock used her awesomely charged crossbow to single handedly defeat the Snow Troll army and melt the ice that trapped her kingdom. Gill Grunt heard of the battle and quickly recruited Punk Shock into the Skylanders.
punk-shock.personality: Punk Shock is a natural rebel. She is simply shocking when it comes to being told what to do. She dislikes acting in any way like a princess.
punk-shock.gameplay: Punk Shock can fire electrical arrows from her electric crossbow. She can also throw water bombs that can be electrified with her Spark Shots. Being an electric eel, she can also shock her enemies.

abilities.name: Spark Shot
abilities.description: Press Attack 1 to shoot an electrified bolt. Shoot a Splash Bomb puddle to cause that area to become electrified.

abilities.name: Splash Bomb
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 to throw a larger water balloon that makes a puddle where it lands. Shoot the puddle with Spark Shot to electrify it.

abilities.name: Spark Splash
abilities.description: Press Attack 3 to perform a tail attack that shocks nearby enemies.

abilities.name: High Boltage
abilities.description: Press Attack 1 to shoot high powered crossbolt attacks that do increased damage.

abilities.name: OHMG
abilities.description: Press Attack 1 to shoot electric crossbow bolts that branch out and hit enemies in a larger area.

abilities.name: Hypercharged
abilities.description: Increase movement speed. Adding a spark to each step!

abilities.name: Eelectrocute
abilities.description: Hold Attack 1 to charge a powerful crossbow attack, release to shoot all enemies around you!

abilities.name: H2Throw
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 to throw two additional water balloons. All water balloons last longer.

abilities.name: Troubled Waters
abilities.description: All water balloon attacks do increased damage. Throwing water balloons never hurt so bad!

abilities.name: Bolting Blob
abilities.description: Hold Attack 2 to throw balloon into the air, release to zap it and electrify all enemies in a very large area.

abilities.name: Positively Charged
abilities.description: Gain an electrical aura that sometimes shock and damages nearby enemies.

abilities.name: It Hertz
abilities.description: Enemies damaged by electrified water take increased damage. A perfect example of why there is no swimming during a lightning storm.

abilities.name: Re-Volting Shock
abilities.description: Hold Attack 3 to tail slap any enemies into the air.

trivia: Punk Shock is the third Water Skylander with electrical powers and is from royalty (Zap is the first and Wham-Shell is the second).
She's the second female Water Skylander in the series while the first is Chill and the third is Echo.
Most of her upgrade names are water and electricity puns.
Her face slightly resembles Gill Grunt's Mermaid Girlfriend. They also both met Gill Grunt in their history.
Punk Shock is noticeably similar to Zap: Both are Water Skylanders. Both are from royalty. Both have electrical powers. Both can mix their electrical secondary abilities with their primary abilities.
Like Stink Bomb after obtaining 'Sporting Stripes' in Trap Team, Punk Shock can literally move faster after 'Hypercharged' is purchased.

She is voiced by Tara Platt, who voices Ester in Ben 10: Omniverse, Mitsuru Kirijo in Persona 3, and Edelgard in Fire Emblem: Three Houses. She is married to Yuri Lowenthal, who voices Fright Rider, Softpaw, and Trail Blazer. Tara Platt also voices Dreamcatcher in Skylanders: Trap Team.
She and Cross Crow are the only playable characters to wield a crossbow. Coincidentally, they are both of the Water element.
Her catchphrase is the same name as an attack upgrade for Wolfgang.
Punk Shock's name may have been a play on Punk rock.

quickdraw-rattle-shake.name: Quickdraw Rattle Shake
quickdraw-rattle-shake.description: Quickdraw Rattle Shake is an alter ego of the SWAP Force Skylander, Rattle Shake. Originally, he was available exclusively in a Frito-Lays promo, then later became available in selected stores.
quickdraw-rattle-shake.biography: Some say Rattle Shake was the best tracker in the Cloudbreak Islands. Others say he could strike the center of a gold coin at a thousand paces. But the legend of Rattle Shake was immortalized when he found himself trapped by the Black Hat Gang, the infamous group of cowboys who literally were large cows... and evil ones at that. They threatened to plunder the local village unless Rattle Shake led them inside the magical volcano Mt. Cloudbreak, where they hoped to discover enchanted treasure. Badly outnumbered, the ever calm Rattle Shake magically summoned every snake in the area and overtook the notorious bovines in an epic fight. The tale of his heroism was heard by Master Eon, who then recruited him to the Skylanders.
quickdraw-rattle-shake.gameplay: Quickdraw Rattle Shake is the first non-Legendary Undead variant. In Swap Force, his ammo snake was the same color as his original counterpart's. However, in Trap Team, the color has been corrected to match with his artwork. He is mainly glow-in-the-dark green, but his lost islands model shows him as being white. There is a glitch in Trap Team, when the player puts a hat on Quickdraw Rattle Shake's head, it fits over his regular cowboy hat. In the next shots, his regular hat disappears like his regular counterpart. Unlike previous games, when you play as Quickdraw Rattle Shake in SuperChargers and Imaginatiors (unless he has a different hat put on his head), his regular hat is missing.

abilities.name: Deputy Snake
abilities.description: Deputy Snake

abilities.name: Fistful of Snake
abilities.description: Fistful of Snake

abilities.name: Spring Loaded Snake
abilities.description: Spring Loaded Snake

abilities.name: Snake Bite
abilities.description: Snake Bite

abilities.name: Nasty Sssurprise
abilities.description: Nasty Sssurprise

trivia: Quickdraw Rattle Shake is the first non-Legendary Undead variant.
In Swap Force, his ammo snake was the same color as his original counterpart's. However, in Trap Team, the color has been corrected to match with his artwork.
He is mainly glow-in-the-dark green, but his lost islands model shows him as being white.

There is a glitch in Trap Team, when the player puts a hat on Quickdraw Rattle Shake's head, it fits over his regular cowboy hat. In the next shots, his regular hat disappears like his regular counterpart.
Unlike previous games, when you play as Quickdraw Rattle Shake in SuperChargers and Imaginatiors (unless he has a different hat put on his head), his regular hat is missing.

rattle-shake.name: Rattle Shake
rattle-shake.description: Rattle Shake is a yellow rattlesnake cowboy who is a SWAP Force Skylander in Skylanders: Swap Force. He is of the Undead element. His Swap Force Ability is Bounce. He has a Frito-Lays exclusive glow-in-a-dark variant, Quickdraw Rattle Shake.
rattle-shake.biography: Some say Rattle Shake was the best tracker in the Cloudbreak Islands. Others say he could strike the center of a gold coin at a thousand paces. But the legend of Rattle Shake was immortalized when he found himself trapped by the Black Hat Gang, the infamous group of cowboys who literally were large cows... and evil ones at that. They threatened to plunder the local village unless Rattle Shake led them inside the magical volcano Mt. Cloudbreak, where they hoped to discover enchanted treasure. Badly outnumbered, the ever calm Rattle Shake magically summoned every snake in the area and overtook the notorious bovines in an epic fight. The tale of his heroism was heard by Master Eon, who then recruited him to the Skylanders.
rattle-shake.personality: Shake's enemies think he is sinister. In fact, so do some of his friends, but you can be sure that he's no slippery character - Rattle is a virtuous viper. He is calm and collected, handling situations with the poise of a classic gunslinger.
rattle-shake.gameplay: Rattle Shake is a ranged attacker who utilizes a snake launcher to shoot venom or charge up bouncy snakes. His primary attack, Snake's Venom, fires blobs of poison. His secondary attack, Tail Sweep, is a quick melee strike, while his tertiary Deputy Snake ability deploys a snake turret. As a SWAP Force character with the Bounce ability, he can perform high jumps and ground slams. His upgrades allow him to poison enemies, summon skeletal snakes, and launch bone projectiles.

abilities.name: Snake's Venom
abilities.description: Press Attack 1 to shoot snake venom at nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Tail Sweep
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 to sweep at nearby enemies with a quick tail strike.

abilities.name: Deputy Snake
abilities.description: Press Attack 3 to throw down a snake ally that will attack and slow nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Fistful of Snakes
abilities.description: All venom projectiles do increased damage.

abilities.name: Spring Loaded Snake
abilities.description: Hold Attack 1 to charge a Snake Shot, release to shoot a snake that bounces between enemies and collects items along the way.

abilities.name: Bounce the Bones
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 to shoot one bouncing bone projectile.

abilities.name: On Brand
abilities.description: Hold jump to jump and smash down into the ground, damaging and knocking enemies away.

abilities.name: Sssstampede
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 to shoot three large bone projectiles at once.

abilities.name: Raise the Snakes
abilities.description: Get a new skin which increases Critical Hit and absorbs damage. Absorbing damage causes the skin to shed then grow back over time.

abilities.name: The Snake-Skinned Kid
abilities.description: Get a new skin which increases speed and absorbs damage. Absorbing damage causes skin to shed then grow back after a short time.

abilities.name: Nasty Sssurprise
abilities.description: Deputy Snake causes an acid explosion that damages enemies where it lands.

abilities.name: Armed to the Fangs
abilities.description: Nasty Sssuprise radius and Deputy Snake damage are increased.

abilities.name: Snake Bite
abilities.description: Spring Loaded Snake poisons the first enemy it hits, dealing damage over time.

abilities.name: This Bites
abilities.description: Enemies poisoned by Spring Loaded Snake take more damage from Snake Venom.

abilities.name: Goliath Bone Snake
abilities.description: Hold Attack 2 to charge Sssstampede, release to summon a giant bone snake from the ground.

abilities.name: Dances With Snakes
abilities.description: Hold Attack 2 while moving to charge Goliath Bone Snake, release to summon many bone snakes.

abilities.name: Spurred Spring
abilities.description: Hold Attack 2 to charge Sssstampede, release to spring forward, damaging all enemies in the way.

abilities.name: Graveyard Smash
abilities.description: Spurred Spring causes tombstones to appear and damage enemies in a large area when landing.

trivia: His catchphrase is a play on 'Go ahead, make my day'.
His quote 'No fang, no gain' is a play on 'no pain, no gain'.
He resembles Rattlesnake Jake, a gunslinger rattlesnake character from the Nickelodeon movie, Rango.
He and Fire Kraken are the only two with the Bounce swap ability.
Despite being a cowboy, he has a Spanish accent instead of a Texas accent, inspired by Mexican vaqueros.
Like Wash Buckler, if a player puts a hat on Rattle Shake, his original hat disappears.
Rattle Shake, Cobra Cadabra, Pit Boss and Fire Vipers are currently the only four known snake characters who have two limbs.
He and Scorp are the only two Skylanders who can poison their enemies.
He, Night Shift, Doom Stone, and Magna Charge are the only four Swap Force Skylanders without any true legs.
He is the first Undead Skylander to have an exclusive non-Legendary variant figure, Quickdraw Rattle Shake.
He and Rubble Rouser are the only two SWAP Force Skylanders with top Soul Gems that change the colors of their skin (to purple).
He is voiced by Troy Baker, who based the voice on Antonio Banderas.
His snake gun was inspired from the boomerang attack of the scrapped Skylander, Breezewing.

rip-tide.name: Rip Tide
rip-tide.description: Rip Tide is an Aqua Fighter who is one of the Core Water Skylanders in Skylanders: Swap Force.
rip-tide.biography: Rip Tide was known far and wide as one of the best Aqua-Fighters in Skylands. He mastered a multitude of water techniques and astonished tournament spectators with his ability to adapt his fighting style to any opponent. Amongst his repertoire were Swordfish Fencing, Hammerhead Heaving, and even the rare Blubber Whale Wallop -- which he had used on numerous occasions in the legendary Rumble in the Reef. His unrivaled skill as a swordsman soon drew the attention of Master Eon. But when Kaos learned of this, he sent forth a legion of Squidface Brutes to stop Rip Tide before he could join the Skylanders... and everyone knows how that turned out, except for the Squidface Brutes, who after being knocked senseless can't remember a thing.
rip-tide.personality: Highly adaptable, Rip Tide can master any fighting style in minutes. In Skylanders: Battlecast, he has gallant and proud mannerisms.
rip-tide.gameplay: Being a skilled Aqua-Fighter, Rip Tide can swipe and slash his enemies with his Swordfish and Sharkfish like swords. He can also summon a large whale from his sleeve and slam it down on his enemies. In Skylanders: Battlecast, he can use fish for a variety of effects, from food for his allies, to draining health with jellyfish, electrifying his swordfish for a debuff, and even summoning sharks and piranhas to add to his team's own damage.

abilities.name: Horn Tetra Attack
abilities.description: Press Attack 1 to swing the currently held fish at enemies. Swordfish attacks are quick and Shark attacks are slow, but more powerful.

abilities.name: Fish Toss
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 to toss the currently held fish at enemies. Fish Toss will also change between Swordfish and Shark fish.

abilities.name: Whale On 'Em
abilities.description: Press Attack 3 to drop a large whale and smack down a large number of enemies.

abilities.name: Bigger Fish to Fly
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 to throw the held fish, doing increased damage to enemies.

abilities.name: Fresh Fish
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 to throw the currently held fish. Press Attack 1 to attack and critically hit with the new fish.

abilities.name: Blistering Blubber
abilities.description: Whale attacks do increased damage. Pocket whales are known for their helpful nature.

abilities.name: Reinventing the Whale
abilities.description: Angry fish explode out of the whale's spout, seeking out and damaging nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Nipping Needle Nose
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 to throw the Swordfish which does damage over time to enemies that it hits.

abilities.name: Practiced Parry
abilities.description: Swordfish attacks do increased damage. A sword for a nose! Convenient!

abilities.name: Straight As An Angler
abilities.description: Hold Attack 1 to charge a swordfish attack, release to dash through enemies causing them to take damage and be knocked back.

abilities.name: Shark Surprise
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 to throw the shark which bounces off of enemies heads before landing.

abilities.name: Time to Hammer
abilities.description: Hammerhead shark attacks do increased damage. There is more than one reason why they are called hammerheads.

abilities.name: Shark Bite Bait
abilities.description: Hold Attack 1 Hold (Square) to charge a shark attack, release to dash forward biting any enemies in the way.

trivia: Rip Tide is voiced by Patrick Seitz, who also voiced Hot Head in Giants. He also voiced Scorpion from Mortal Kombat (2011) and Injustice: Gods Among Us.
He resembles the Lord of Atlantis from Monster Legends.
Some of his battle quotes are shared with Gill Grunt.
Rip Tide, Chill and Tidepool have the ability to summon cetacean allies.
Developer Arzu Fallahi comments, 'Every time I use the giant whale to attack, my inner child takes over and I get really excited.'
When he uses his primary attack with the hammerhead shark three times, Rip Tide performs a move similar to Ratchet's Multi-strike move from Ratchet & Clank.
When Rip Tide grind rails, he uses the hammerhead shark as a board and holds his swordfish no matter which fish he has active.
He and High Five have the shortest catchphrases, out of every Skylanders. High Five's only has one extra letter, making Rip Tide's the shortest.
His catchphrase is also the name of a popular card game.
In the Skylanders: Swap Force: Master Eon's Official Guide handbook, it incorrectly states that his Soul Gem is found in the Rampant Ruins.
An Awakened form version of Rip Tide was leaked in Skylanders: Ring of Heroes, but he never appeared in the final game.
He is named after a heavy current from an ocean shore creating heavy tidal waves. (A Riptide)
This name is also the title of a famous song by 'Vance Joy' released in 2013.

ro-bow.name: Ro-Bow
ro-bow.description: Ro-Bow is a robotic one-eyed Tech Sensei of the Bowslinger Battle Class in Skylanders: Imaginators. He is included in the Lost Imaginite Mines Level Pack.
ro-bow.biography: There is no record of the person who originally built Ro-Bow. By the time his basic systems were fully online, his creator was nowhere to be found. Ro-Bow searched far and wide, but since his programming was incomplete, he was unable to communicate with anyone. Eventually he stumbled upon the remains of an old lair that had been built by Kaos, and discovered a strange device inside the Matter Refactoring Room. Ro-Bow was able to access the device and download a staggering amount of information from it, which gave him the ability to speak, albeit in a slightly strange language, as well as shoot driller arrows with pinpoint accuracy. He also acquired a lot of details about Kaos himself. Even though Ro-Bow's past was a mystery, his future became quite clear - his new prime directive was to seek out Master Eon and help fight evil. With this incredible archery knowledge and skills, there could be no better trainer for the Bowslinger Class, so Eon made him a Sensei on the spot.
ro-bow.personality: Though it's unclear if it was caused by the speech patterns or the other way around, Ro-Bow is prideful and arrogant, constantly taunting his enemies even after a victory and complimenting his own characteristics.
ro-bow.gameplay: Ro-Bow is a long-range Bowslinger who utilizes high-tech arrows and internal gadgets. His primary attacks involve shooting explosive arrows and executing combos, while his secondary allows him to roll to safety. He can also deploy a Deconstruction Laser or transform into a stationary turret to slow and damage enemies. His Sky-Chi power, Ctrl-Alt-Defeat, allows him to drill through multiple foes.

abilities.name: Archer Combo
abilities.description: Press Attack 1 to shoot. Press Attack 1, Attack 3, Attack 1 for an Archer Combo Finisher. Basic arrow shots also carry enemies with them.

abilities.name: Whirling Destruct-O-Matic
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 to roll out. Hold Attack 2 to increase the duration of the roll.

abilities.name: Reinforced Arrows
abilities.description: Arrows now explode.

abilities.name: Deconstruction Laser
abilities.description: Press Attack 3 to fire a laser. Enemies hit by this attack take increased damage.

abilities.name: Whirling Destruct-O-Matic V2
abilities.description: Increases max duration, damage, and speed in this mode.

abilities.name: Havoc Orb
abilities.description: Jump and press Attack 1 to fire arrows everywhere.

abilities.name: Ro-Bow Rampage
abilities.description: Press Attack 3 in the air to launch a barrage of lasers, missiles, and arrows on enemies.

abilities.name: Ctrl-Alt-Defeat
abilities.description: The ultimate Sensei attack! Hold Special Attack to perform your Sky-Chi Power and drill through your enemies! Use Left Stick to move around!

abilities.name: Charged Shot
abilities.description: Hold Attack 1 to fire a charged arrow that deals heavy damage.

abilities.name: Improved Archery
abilities.description: Arrow attacks deal increased damage.

abilities.name: Archer Combos
abilities.description: Press Attack 1, Attack 3 twice to create a storm of arrows. Press Attack 1, Attack 3, Attack 2 to auto fire arrows from both hands.

abilities.name: Enhanced Deconstruction Laser
abilities.description: Hold Attack 3 to charge the laser.

abilities.name: Whirling Destruct-O-Matic V3
abilities.description: Whirling Destruct-o-matic v3 damage increases and it deals area damage at the end of the move based on the number of enemies hit.

abilities.name: Mechanical Obelisk
abilities.description: Press Attack 3 to fire the charged laser or hold Attack 3 to transform into a turret that fires a beam that slows and damages enemies.

trivia: Ro-Bow's 'strange' speech patterns are actually internet terms and various slang, also known as chatspeak. Dreamcatcher also speaks this way, though to a lesser degree and willingly.

The Snapshot Head part for Imaginators greatly resembles Ro-Bow's, and is possibly a reference to the fact his head resembles a computer webcam. It is also the name of another bow and arrow Skylander, Snap Shot.
Ro-Bow unlocks the Cavalier Hat headgear part for Imaginators, despite wearing a hood instead.
While in turret form, he resembles the Personality Core Wheatley from the Portal franchise.
He is the only robot Tech Skylander to lack silver, gold and/or orange parts, the element's main colors.
He, Wild Storm, Crash Bandicoot, and Dr. Neo Cortex are the only Skylanders figures to also double as Adventure or Level Pack figures.
He resembles Robin Hood, a legendary heroic outlaw in English folklore who was a highly skilled archer, usually depicted using a traditional medieval cloak and hood.
During a Grind Challenge, Ro-Bow curls up into a ball and rolls instead of sliding on his two feet.
Also, he is the second Skylander to tuck and roll every time he jumps while Stink Bomb is the first.
His Sky-Chi 'Ctrl-Alt-Defeat' is a pun on 'Ctrl+Alt+Delete', a computer keyboard command on IBM PC compatible computers, invoked by pressing the Delete key while holding the Control and Alt keys.
Strangely, Ro-Bow's name is stylized in all capital letters in-game.
Ro-Bow shares some design characteristics with a flash game character named GunBot, both are one eyed robots that wear cloaks and use ranged weapons.
If Ro-Bow presses attack 1 in the air before Havoc Orb is purchased, he will fire an explosive arrow diagonally downwards.
Due to being the last Skylander released, Ro-Bow is one of the few most expensive non-variant figures on the secondhand market (the other being Chompy Mage).

rocky-egg-roll.name: Rocky Egg Roll
rocky-egg-roll.species: Rocky: Rock Digger, Roll: Living Boulder
rocky-egg-roll.description: Rocky Egg Roll is an Easter counterpart of Rocky Roll in Skylanders: Lost Islands.
rocky-egg-roll.biography: Rocky Egg Roll is an Easter counterpart of Rocky Roll in Skylanders: Lost Islands.
rocky-egg-roll.catchphrase: Rocky Egg Roll is egg-cited to roll into Skylands!
rocky-egg-roll.gameplay: Rocky Egg Roll is an Alter Ego of Rocky Roll, exclusive to Skylanders: Lost Islands.
trivia: Rocky Egg Roll is the fourth Skylander to have an Easter theme (behind Hoppity Pop Fizz, Springtime Trigger Happy and Eggsellent Weeruptor).
Rocky Egg Roll and Hoppity Pop Fizz both have bunny ears. They are also the only Easter-themed Skylanders exclusive to Lost Islands.
His name is a play on Egg roll.
Rocky Egg Roll and Snowler Brawl are the only Lost Islands variants whose names are nonconventional puns on the original Skylander's name, as opposed to words being put in front of their name.

rocky-roll.name: Rocky Roll
rocky-roll.species: Rocky: Rock Digger, Roll: Living Boulder
rocky-roll.description: Rocky and Roll are a rock digger and a sentient boulder, together known as Rocky Roll. Together, they are one of the Earth core Skylanders in Skylanders: Trap Team.
rocky-roll.biography: Rocky was a rock digger who wanted to make a difference, and Roll was a boulder that wanted to see the world. The two of them had known each other since they were young and in mining school together. They had shared the same goal – making the sacred journey to Peek’s Peak, where it was said that one’s destiny reveals itself. But time went on, and it wasn’t until many years later that they found each other traveling the same path towards the mythical peak. The connection that was established years before had finally taken shape, and the two realized they were meant to journey far and wide together – as Rocky Roll. After several adventures together, they met Master Eon by chance, who recognized that their connection was special. Now as an awesome Skylander duo, Rocky Roll will crush anything that threatens Skylands!
rocky-roll.personality: Rocky Roll loves helping others. There isn't anything they wouldn't do for their pals. Their friendship is as solid as a rock!
rocky-roll.gameplay: These are the starting and maximum Statistics for this Skylander in the Skylanders games. Health: 270 (max. 540), Speed: 60 (max. 108), Armor: 30 (max. 60), Critical Hit: 40 (max. 90), Elemental Power: 25 (max. 75).

abilities.name: Spit Ball
abilities.description: Press Attack 1 to have Roll spit out a bouncing rock projectile.

abilities.name: Boulder Dash
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 to perform a Boulder Dash charge attack.

abilities.name: Boulder Barrier
abilities.description: Press Attack 3 to form a protective Boulder Barrier, then press Attack 3 again to launch the boulders out.

abilities.name: Rock On
abilities.description: Spit Ball and Boulder Barrier attacks do more damage.

abilities.name: Bouncy Attack Mode
abilities.description: Press Attack 3 to create Boulder Barriers, then hold Attack 2 to enter Bouncy Attack Mode.

abilities.name: MOH Boulders
abilities.description: Press Attack 3 to increase the amount of boulders in the Boulder Barrier from 3 to 6.

abilities.name: Boulder Posse
abilities.description: Press Attack 3 to increase the amount of boulders in the Boulder Barrier all the way up to nine.

abilities.name: Super Spit Ball
abilities.description: Hold Attack 1 to charge up your Spit Ball into a giant boulder projectile.

abilities.name: Rock Hardest
abilities.description: Spit Ball and Boulder Barrier attacks do maximum damage.

abilities.name: Triple Spit Balls
abilities.description: Shoot 3 Spit Balls at once that ricochet into smaller boulders.

abilities.name: Let's Roll!
abilities.description: Rapidly press Attack 2 to speed up the Boulder Dash for more damage and speed.

abilities.name: Roll With The Punches
abilities.description: In Bouncy Attack Mode, press Attack 1 to perform spinning fist attack.

abilities.name: Rocky Boxing
abilities.description: In Bouncy Attack Mode, press Attack 2 to throw a dashing punch attack.

trivia: Rocky Roll, along with Eye-Brawl, Fright Rider and Eye-Small, are currently the only Skylanders who are composed of two different characters in a symbiotic relationship.
Rocky is one of the many one-eyed Skylanders.
Rocky Roll and Gearshift are the only characters to have the same number for all stats.
Rocky Roll's name is probably a combination of 'Rock and Roll' and 'Rocky Road' (a type of ice cream).
Snap Shot, Bash and Wrecking Ball have catchphrases based on 'Rock and Roll'.
Without Roll, Rocky shares his name with a Stone Golem from Terrafin Battles the Boom Brothers.

'Rocky Boxing' is the only upgrade of the 'Rolling Rumbler' upgrade path that is not a catchphrase of a Skylander ('Roll With the Punches' is the same as Night Shift's catchphrase and 'Let's Roll!' is the same as Roller Brawl's catchphrase).

If a player selects a hat for Rocky Roll, Rocky's miner helmet gets replaced. However, Rocky's original headgear can be seen along with another hat when placed on the portal and shown in his character in-game profile.
Roll resembles a Geodude from Pokémon while in Bounce Mode.
Rocky is one of the shortest Skylanders, along with Short Cut, Blastermind, and Smash Hit.
If Rocky, without Roll, is considered the smallest Skylander as of Imaginators.

Rocky Roll is voiced by Billy West, who also voiced the SWAP Force Skylanders, Freeze Blade, Fire Kraken; and the Life Skylander Food Fight. West also voiced Sparx the Dragonfly in the 2007 video game, The Legend of Spyro: The Eternal Night.
When driving a vehicle in Skylanders: SuperChargers, Roll will sometimes go missing and sometimes overlap with Rocky.
Most Rocky Roll figures are wobbly on the base. Due to how widespread this is, this may have been an intentional feature to give him playability as a toy.

roller-brawl.name: Roller Brawl
roller-brawl.description: Roller Brawl is a vampire roller jammer and one of the Undead Core Skylanders in Skylanders: Swap Force.
roller-brawl.biography: Roller Brawl grew up with five older vampire brothers, who were all very big and overprotective. Being the smallest of her family, she learned how to use her speed and cunning to become one of the toughest jammers in the Undead Roller Derby League. It was during the championship match when she caught the eye of Kaos, who fell head-over-heels in love with her. But when her overprotective brothers stepped in, Kaos had them captured by Drow and taken prisoner. Roller Brawl swore revenge, but even with her impressive skills, she was no match for an entire Drow army. Having developed a strong distaste for evil, she joined up with the Skylanders to fight against Kaos - while never giving up on her search for her brothers.
roller-brawl.personality: Roller Brawl never gives up. Realizing that she was no match for the Drow on her own, she joined the Skylanders to fight the lovesick Kaos. Her SuperChargers Quest also shows her to be extremely dedicated to her training, even guessing Buzz's orders ahead of time. Her personality file lists her as cunning and resourceful, making her an ideal scout and spy.
roller-brawl.gameplay: Roller Brawl can use the claws on her gloves to slash at enemies. She can also launch her skate blades as well as use them to travel at high speeds. After dashing, she headbutts enemies to deliver a high amount of damage. She can even closeline enemies while dashing and - when her Soul Gem is purchased - create a cursed energy link between herself and an enemy. Should a Portal Master choose the Shadow Skater path, Roller Brawl gains enhanced Derby Dash abilities. With the Pirouette and Bullrush abilities, she can extend her dash attack in several ways, by either repeatedly spinning or by charging an enemy and then continuing her dash with absolute aggression. With the Hardened Helm, she gains more Armor. Should a Portal Master choose the Skateblade Siren path, Roller Brawl gains enhanced Skateblade abilities. While the attack itself doesn't get any more powerful, she can use them in more ways, such as creating a protective field around her that slices through enemies or dropping them behind her during a Derby Dash to immobolize her enemies. With the Critical Claws, she gains a boost in her Critical Hit chance. Regardless of which upgrade path is chosen, Roller Brawl - rather appropriately - focuses exclusively on offense, though with different benefits and through different methods. In Skylanders: Battlecast, Roller Brawl is a rare Skylander card with high damage output and many abilities relating to moving from sidelines to the front. Her Special Ability is Fearsome Charge, which allows her to deal extra damage to the opponent in the one turn, dealing more if she switched in that turn. Her signature Gear are the Blades of Gory, which damage the active enemy when she switches.

abilities.name: Roller Claws
abilities.description: Press Attack 1 to slash at nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Derby Dash

abilities.name: Skateblades
