abilities.name: Impact Skater
abilities.description: All attacks while dashing do increased damage.

abilities.name: Deadly Clothesline
abilities.description: Hold Attack 2 to charge a dash, release to dash forward and clothesline any enemies in the way.

abilities.name: Aggression
abilities.description: New sharpened blades make claw attacks do increased damage.

abilities.name: Cursed Helmet
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 while dashing to head-butt an enemy and create a cursed link. Touch enemies with the link to damage them.

abilities.name: Pirouette
abilities.description: Hold Attack 1 during a dash to do a spin attack that damages nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Hardened Helm
abilities.description: A new helmet increases Roller Brawl's armor, reducing damage taken.

abilities.name: Bullrush
abilities.description: Hold Attack 2 during a dash to bullrush enemies, damaging and knocking them back.

abilities.name: Skateblade Trap
abilities.description: Press Attack 3 while dashing to leave behind a trap that damages nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Critical Claws
abilities.description: New claws increase Roller Brawl's Critical Hit chance.

abilities.name: Spinning Saws
abilities.description: Hold Attack 3 to create saws that spin around Roller Brawl.

trivia: Roller Brawl was inspired by the sport of Roller Derby.
When Roller Brawl appears after being placed on the Portal of Power, a starting whistle is heard, as an allusion to the whistle in Roller Derby.
During development, Roller Brawl wasn't well-received, due to her bad controls and missing VFX.
Her claws bear a resemblance to X-23 from the X-Men comics.
She and Eye-Brawl both have the word 'Brawl' in their names. Coincidentally, they are both Undead Skylanders.
Both her regular and SuperCharger counterparts involve hearts flying all over the place. For regular Roller Brawl, it's Skateblades. For Bone Bash Roller Brawl, it's Love Bites and Brawling Out.

Her eye appearance is inconsistent between her portrayals. In her official art and toy form, her eyes are white with pink irises, in-game, her irises glow brightly, and in her Soul Gem video, they barely have any color at all (besides a dark gray).
She, Bat Spin and Night Shift are the only three vampire Skylanders.
She was originally going to be sleeveless in her early development. She does appear sleeveless in Skylanders: Battlecast.
Her name is a play on the 1975 movie title, 'Rollerball'.
Even though Roller Brawl lacks black pupils, she is shown to have them from her Soul Gem Trailer and Trap Team Intro.

Her voice actress, Cree Summer, provided the voices of Susie Carmichael from Rugrats and All Grown Up, Valerie Gray from Danny Phantom, Numbuh 5 from Codename: Kids Next Door, Bunny Star from The Patrick Star Show, Lizzle in The Land Before Time 11, as well as being the first actress for Cynder in The Legend of Spyro series. In SuperChargers, her voice actress is uncredited.
She is the second Skylander to have her hair in a braid (the first one being Stealth Elf).
In Trap Team, her character icon is actually, the same one the one in SWAP Force instead of her concept art.
In the Skylanders: Swap Force Master Eon's Official Guide handbook, it incorrectly states that her Soul Gem is in Iron Jaw Gulch.
She, Chill, Déjà Vu, and Stealth Elf are currently the only four female Skylanders with a Legendary counterpart.
In Skylanders: Imaginators, after purchasing her Soul Gem, if you go into selfie mode and zoom in on the back of her helmet, you can see the Undead element symbol.
Her name was originally going to be Topsy Derby in development. The name was later given to one of her teammates in Biting Back.

royal-double-trouble.name: Royal Double Trouble
royal-double-trouble.description: Royal Double Trouble is a purple version of the Series 2 Magic Skylander, Double Trouble.
royal-double-trouble.biography: Double Trouble was an adept spellcaster. On an expedition to find exotic ingredients for his potions, he traveled in search of a rare lily that was said to multiply the power of any spell. So thrilled was he when he found it, Double Trouble instantly ate the plant and performed a spell. Suddenly, there was a loud pop… then another… and another – until Double Trouble was surrounded by exact copies of himself. As it turned out, he had misunderstood the details about exactly what would multiply. But it didn’t matter, for he quickly realized the clones were delightful companions… never mind that they were only half his size and would explode on contact.
royal-double-trouble.personality: Double Trouble is an eccentric and thrill-seeking spellcaster who finds great joy in the company of his exploding clones.
royal-double-trouble.gameplay: Royal Double Trouble uses his staff to fire a homing Eldritch Beam and can summon exploding clones of himself to overwhelm enemies.

abilities.name: Eldritch Beam
abilities.description: Double Trouble shoots a beam of energy from his staff that locks onto enemies.

abilities.name: Conjure Exploding Double
abilities.description: Double Trouble summons a small clone of himself that runs towards enemies and explodes on contact.

abilities.name: Summon Magic Bomb
abilities.description: Double Trouble creates a magical bomb that damages nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Arcane Eldritch Beam
abilities.description: A more powerful version of the Eldritch Beam.

abilities.name: Magical Cataclysm
abilities.description: Double Trouble creates a powerful magical explosion.

trivia: He and King Cobra Cadabra are the only variants to have a monarch-related word in their name.
Coincidentally, they are both Magic Skylanders.
Royal Double Trouble's artwork on his card is similar to his Series 1 counterpart's artwork. However, in Skylanders: Lost Islands, his artwork is more based on his regular Series 2 counterpart.
In Skylanders: Giants his health bar image is in the style of his series 2 image.
Despite being released during Skylanders: Giants, his figure's pose is a recolor of his Series 1 figure from Spyro's Adventure.

rubble-rouser.name: Rubble Rouser
rubble-rouser.description: Armored Rock Golem who is one of the SWAP Force Skylanders in Skylanders: Swap Force. He is of the Earth element. His SWAP Force Ability is Dig.
rubble-rouser.biography: Hailing from a race of creatures who ate rock for a living, Rubble Rouser spent most days digging his way through the vastness of Deep Mountain mouthful by mouthful alongside the rest of his people. But Rubble Rouser found he could eat up far more ground with a swing of his hammer or spin of his drill. However, the leaders of his race wanted no part of changing the way they worked. That is, until the evil Rock Lords trapped them deep within the mountain. It was then that Rubble Rouser showed everyone the power of his ways by defeating the Rock Lords with his mighty hammer and drill. Afterward, the leaders encouraged Rubble Rouser to seek out the Skylanders, who readily welcomed him.
rubble-rouser.personality: Rubble Rouser is always looking to improve the way things work - and for new rocks to pulverize with his hammer slam!
rubble-rouser.gameplay: Rubble Rouser's primary attacks include Hammer Swing (Press Attack 1 to swing a massive hammer, hold to charge more powerful swings) and Deep Dig (Press Attack 2 to quickly dig then come out of the ground, damaging nearby enemies). His SWAP Force ability is Dig, allowing him to dig underground to avoid damage and surprise enemies.

abilities.name: Hammer Swing
abilities.description: Press Attack 1 to swing a massive hammer. Hold to charge up more powerful swings!

abilities.name: Deep Dig
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 to quickly dig then come out of the ground, damaging nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Tools of the Trade
abilities.description: Press Attack 3 to smash nearby enemies with the hammer.

abilities.name: Happy Hammering
abilities.description: All hammer attacks do increased damage.

abilities.name: Drill Head
abilities.description: Hold Attack 3 to drill into the ground, causing an earthquake!

abilities.name: Minor Miners
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 to dig into the ground, burst out of the ground a short time later damaging nearby enemies and summoning small angry miner allies.

abilities.name: Earthy Fortitude
abilities.description: Health is increased. Tough as stone!

abilities.name: Tunnel Expedition
abilities.description: Hold Attack 2 to continue drilling while underground, release to surprise enemies from below with a devastating attack.

abilities.name: Obsidian Skin
abilities.description: Rubble's skin becomes harder than stone, decreasing damage taken.

abilities.name: Pop Rock
abilities.description: Hold Attack 2 to drill underground, release to toss a huge boulder into the sky which comes down on enemies nearby a short time later.

abilities.name: Nailed it!
abilities.description: Press Attack 1 Attack 1 and then hold and release Attack 1 to throw a charged hammer attack!

abilities.name: Sledgehammer
abilities.description: Throwing the hammer does increased damage.

abilities.name: Rock Shards
abilities.description: Press Attack 3 to send shards of rock flying out of the ground damaging nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Gem Quality
abilities.description: Press Attack 3 to unearth more powerful rock shards that damage nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Boulder Toss
abilities.description: Hold Attack 2 to drill underground, while underground boulders will rapidly shoot out.

abilities.name: So Bold
abilities.description: Boulders do increased damage. Getting hit with rocks really hurts.

abilities.name: Miner Craft
abilities.description: Call up to four miner allies to help you defeat enemies!

abilities.name: On Strike
abilities.description: Miner allies do increased damage.

trivia: His Soul Gem Obsidian Skin changes his color to black.
His name is a play on 'rabble rouser', which can also be based on the fact that he summons angry miner allies. It might also be based on the term 'rebel rouser'.
One of his upgrades, 'Miner Craft', is a reference to the game Minecraft.
Occasionally, a glitch occurs where Rubble Rouser digs down and doesn't go back up.
Most of the times, in Battle Mode, his Miners don't attack the other Skylander.
With Tunnel Expedition, Rubble Rouser's bottom half allows him or other SWAP Force Skylanders to avoid damage while underground.
He, Drill Sergeant, Ro-Bow and Grilla Drilla are the only Skylanders with drilling abilities.
He is one of the few Skylanders with a hammer for a weapon (others include Crusher, Stump Smash and Wallop).
Despite his artwork and figure form, Rubble Rouser is actually right-handed instead of being a lefty. Other Skylanders have the same situation, such as Double Trouble (Series 1), and Rattle Shake.
His bottom Soul Gem, Pop Rock, may be a reference to the candy Pop Rocks.
Rubble Rouser is noticeably similar to Doom Stone: Both are Earth Skylanders. Both are SWAP Force Skylanders. Both are made of stone. Both their names are a play on different phrases.
Rubble Rouser was one of the many Skylanders planned to appear in Skylanders: Ring of Heroes.

scarlet-ninjini.name: Scarlet Ninjini
scarlet-ninjini.description: Scarlet Ninjini is the red variant of the Magic Giant, Ninjini.
scarlet-ninjini.biography: Scarlet Ninjini is the red variant of the Magic Giant, Ninjini.
scarlet-ninjini.gameplay: Scarlet Ninjini is the red variant of the Magic Giant, Ninjini. While most of her magic fog effects, such as Bottle Blast and the trailing fog around her lower body is replaced with red fog, her Surrealistic Spheres are still purple and explode in purple fog.

abilities.name: Wishblades
abilities.description: Primary attack using dual Wishblades.

abilities.name: Bottle Blast
abilities.description: Secondary attack involving bottle fog.

abilities.name: Surrealistic Spheres
abilities.description: Creates magical spheres that float and explode.

abilities.name: Abra-Ca-Stab-Bra
abilities.description: A magical sword combo attack.

abilities.name: Juggling Act
abilities.description: A powerful juggling ability that maximizes Ninjini's damage.

trivia: Scarlet Ninjini resembles Eden from the Aladdin TV series. Both are female genies, green-skinned and have black ponytail hair.
While most of her magic fog effects, such as Bottle Blast and the trailing fog around her lower body is replaced with red fog, her Surrealistic Spheres are still purple and explode in purple fog.
A fan dressed up as Scarlet Ninjini for 2014 Comic Con, and had all the attendees cheering at a Skylanders cosplay contest.

scorp.name: Scorp
scorp.description: Scorp is a rock scorpion who is one of the Earth Core Skylanders released alongside Skylanders: Swap Force.
scorp.biography: Scorp was raised in the Salt Flat Islands, an endless flat plain of rock where every day is very hot. To keep themselves entertained, the residents live for the sport of Sting Ball, an extreme game that only the strongest play to become King of Sting -- a title Scorp had won numerous times. During his last championship game, the opposing team cheated by using an enchanted water gem to make it rain. But the spell got out of control and soon a raging thunderstorm flooded the land. Using his powerful claws and incredible agility, Scorp bravely battled the rising waters to retrieve the gem and hurl it far into the clouds, breaking the spell and saving everyone. Seeing how his abilities could be used for more than sport, Scorp soon sought out and joined the Skylanders.
scorp.personality: Rough-and-tumble Scorp is a real tough guy, but his experience with the gem taught him he could use his amazing abilities for more than just sport.
scorp.gameplay: Scorp is an Earth element Skylander who specializes in sticky crystal projectiles and poisonous tail strikes. He uses his powerful claws and high agility to navigate the battlefield, often curling into a ball for a high-speed Shoulder Roll or Avalanche Dash. His playstyle allows for a choice between focusing on venomous damage over time or enhancing the explosive power and area-of-effect of his crystal attacks.

abilities.name: Emerald Crystal
abilities.description: Press Attack 1 to throw a sticky explosive ball.

abilities.name: Tail Sting
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 to sting the ground nearby and poison enemies.

abilities.name: Shoulder Roll
abilities.description: Hold Attack 3 to curl up into a ball and roll around, damaging enemies in the way.

abilities.name: Chrome Carapace
abilities.description: Armor is increased. New stone plating causes enemies' attacks to do less damage.

abilities.name: Crystal Ball
abilities.description: Hold Attack 1 to charge a crystal attack, release to smash two crystals together and throw a massive sticky ball.

abilities.name: Earthly Power
abilities.description: Press Attack 1 to throw a sticky explosive crystal that now does increased damage to an enemy.

abilities.name: Avalanche Dash
abilities.description: Hold Attack 3 to curl up into a ball and roll around. Dashing now lasts as long as Attack 3 is held.

abilities.name: Fuming Fissure
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 to strike the ground with a poison tail and cause a shock wave that shoots toward enemies.

abilities.name: Scorpion Strike
abilities.description: Poison from tail strike does increased damage.

abilities.name: Potent Poisons
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 to strike with a poison tail that does damage to enemies over a longer amount of time.

abilities.name: Cracked Crystal
abilities.description: Press Attack 1 to throw a powerful, sticky explosive that now does damage to enemies in a larger area.

abilities.name: Crystal Shards
abilities.description: Emerald Crystal attacks now do even more damage. So pretty, yet so painful!

abilities.name: Venomous Crystals
abilities.description: When Crystal Ball explodes, it splits into two smaller crystals.

trivia: Scorp likes to sleep underground, or beneath large rocks. Once, after a hard day of battling evil, he curled under a boulder to have a nap. He didn't realize, though, that the boulder was actually one of Crusher's feet. It was only Scorp's tough armoured body that saved him from being squished flat!
He slightly resembles Scorponok from Beast Wars.
His catchphrase is similar to Swarm's catchphrase, which is 'Bring the Sting'.
One of his upgrades has a name similar to the Scorpion Striker.
Another is similar to the title of a Kirby game on the Nintendo 64, Kirby 64: the Crystal Shards.
He and Rattle Shake are the only known Skylanders who can poison their opponents.
His voice actor, Rino Romano, is also the voice of the narrator from Curious George and other animated films and Batman from the TV series, The Batman.
He also voices the Sensei, King Pen.
Scorp is currently the only arthropod Skylander who is not an insect or crustacean.
During his portal moments in Superchargers and Imaginators, he makes a stinging animation with his tail which he never did in previous games.

scratch.name: Scratch
scratch.description: Scratch is a purple winged cat who is one of the Air Skylanders in Skylanders: Swap Force.
scratch.biography: High in the peaks of Cats Eye Mountain sits a towering city of crystal and gold that can only be reached by creatures of the Air element. It was here that Scratch spent her youth soaring playfully in the clouds or exploring the endless number of crystal mines. One day, an army of Pirate Greebles arrived in a fleet of airships, looking to steal ancient magic crystals buried deep in the mountain. Donning specially made armor, Scratch led an epic battle against the pirates, using her incredible fighting skills to defend the crystals and the city. Tales of her heroism soon made their way to Jet-Vac, who traveled to Cats Eye Mountain and recruited Scratch to the Skylanders.
scratch.personality: Scratch is a natural explorer, having investigated the crystal mines of her mountain home for days on end. She's still adventurous to this day.
scratch.gameplay: Scratch's golden suit of enchanted armor comes equipped with moveable lasers that come from the crystal atop of her mask. The crystal claws of her gauntlets are able to cut through virtually any substance, from solid rock to hardened steel, meaning there are few enemies who can stand up to a scratching from Scratch. When further upgraded, Scratch can regain health by collecting treasure. When imbued with the power of rubies, Scratch can fight more offensively. Her upgrades range from an increase in critical hit percentage, to better and more powerful attacks. Her laser ability now has much better area of affect and she gains a new attack that allows her to deal lots of damage in quick bursts to a single enemy. When imbued with the power of sapphires, Scratch can fight more defensively. Now she can gain a boost to her speed as well as improved abilities that pertain to keeping her safe from enemies. Her laser attack can slow enemies that are struck by it, and she can unleash a whirlwind that sucks in enemies and immobilizes them briefly.

abilities.name: Cat Scratch
abilities.description: Press Attack 1 to scratch at nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Playful Pounce
abilities.description: Hold Attack 2 to shoot a moveable laser onto the ground, release to pounce where the laser was pointing.

abilities.name: Wing Spark
abilities.description: Press Attack 3 to dodge an attack and knock away all enemies in an area around you.

abilities.name: Silver Claws
abilities.description: Gain new silver claws that deal increased damage!

abilities.name: Whirlwing
abilities.description: Hold Attack 3 to pull enemies into a massive whirlwind and do damage to all of them caught inside.

abilities.name: Silver Mask
abilities.description: Gain a new silver mask! Hold Attack 2 to shoot a powerful new laser at the ground, release to do a devastating pounce attack that does increased damage.

abilities.name: Gem Affinity
abilities.description: Gain health from collecting gems, coins and money.

abilities.name: Sharpened Rubies
abilities.description: Sharpened Rubies grant increased damage to critical hit.

abilities.name: Ruby Rage
abilities.description: Claw damage is increased. Hold Attack 1 to charge a claw attack, release to slash through nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Ruby Mask
abilities.description: Hold Attack 2 to shoot a laser at the ground that damages enemies in a larger area.

abilities.name: Speedy Sapphire
abilities.description: Speed is increased. Sapphires infused with the speed of wind!

abilities.name: Sapphire Slash
abilities.description: Claw damage is increased. Hold Attack 1 to charge a wing attack, release to shoot a vortex that pulls enemies into it.

abilities.name: Sapphire Mask
abilities.description: Hold Attack 2 to shoot a laser at the ground that damages and slows enemies.

trivia: Scratch resembles Nefertimon, a Digivolution form of Gatomon from the Digimon franchise.
Her catchphrase is a pun on the saying 'the luck of the draw'.
Scratch's voice actress, Kathryn 'Kat' Cressida, is also the voice actress of Dee Dee from Dexter's Laboratory during Seasons 2 and 4.
Scratch is one of the few Skylanders who are able to heal themselves without eating food (others include characters like Wrecking Ball, Stealth Elf, Camo and Slobber Tooth).
One of her upgrades, Whirlwing, alludes to whirlwinds. It also happen to be a pun on another Air Skylander, Whirlwind.
Like Sunburn and Flashwing, Scratch doesn't possess a Flight upgrade despite having wings, although she does fly while performing her attacks.
In her magic moment, Scratch briefly chases after a moving laser pointer, a common trait shared by felines who love chasing after moving shiny objects.
Scratch was originally called 'Masquerade'.
Scratch is one of two Air Skylanders without a blue-centered color scheme. The other one is Swarm.
She is currently the only quadruped female Skylander to have visible teeth (not counting Cynder's appearance in the Skylanders Academy TV series).
She, Flameslinger, and Freeze Blade are the only three Skylanders that wear masks over their eyes.
Despite being revealed as a Feathercat in Imaginators, she was originally referred as a Sphynx by the official Skylanders Facebook and Twitter pages.
One of her quotes, 'A hat fit for a cat!' may be a reference to Dr. Seuss and one of his stories, The Cat in the Hat.

senseis.name: Senseis
senseis.description: The Senseis are a team of Skylanders introduced in Skylanders: Imaginators. The Sensei Skylanders are each masters of different fighting styles and secret battle techniques.
senseis.biography: For many years, it had been their mission to explore the furthest reaches of Skylands, searching for potential heroes to train in the fight against evil. However, with Kaos unleashing Mind Magic to create villainous Doomlanders, Master Eon has summoned the Senseis to return and lead a new generation of heroes into battle – the Imaginators.
senseis.personality: As mentors and masters of their respective battle classes, the Senseis are dedicated, wise, and formidable warriors. They have taken it upon themselves to guide the new generation of Imaginators, passing on their secret techniques to protect Skylands from Kaos and his Doomlanders.
senseis.gameplay: Senseis help train Imaginators by offering a range of benefits, including unlocking Imaginator parts, providing access to special areas in the game, and well as bestowing Secret Techniques across the Battle Classes. Senseis also have their own unique benefits, including the extraordinary ability to unleash Sky-Chi – the ultimate Battle Class super move. They are the only characters that can unlock Sensei Shrines and activate Battle Gongs. Additionally, one of each element is required to unlock the Sensei Elemental Realms in the M.A.P.

abilities.name: Battle Class Mastery
abilities.description: Each Sensei is a master of one of the ten fighting styles, or Battle Classes, and can use unique weapons and techniques associated with their discipline.

abilities.name: Secret Techniques
abilities.description: Senseis provide access to special areas in the game and bestow Secret Techniques across the Battle Classes to Imaginators.

abilities.name: Sky-Chi
abilities.description: The ultimate Battle Class super move. This extraordinary ability is unique to Senseis and allows them to perform a devastating attack that can clear the battlefield.

trivia: Songs played with Asian instruments play when Senseis enter the game or use their Sky-Chi, while villains play the start of their Trap Team Villain Themes, with the exception of Golden Queen, who only plays it during her Sky-Chi.
Three of the former Villains have changed Elements between games (Grave Clobber, Hood Sickle, and Tae Kwon Crow).
The icon for Senseis is a stylized version of Ember's helmet lacking the fire symbol, known in real life as a type of Kabuto, a traditional helmet for Japanese warriors.
King Pen and Grave Clobber are both Brawler Senseis of the Water Element.
Hood Sickle, Chain Reaction and Dr. Krankcase are the only male Senseis of their Battle Classes.
Tri-Tip and Blaster-Tron are the only male Senseis of their Elements.
Barbella's Element and class contain more female Senseis than males.
The Dark, Magic and Tech elements do not have any female Senseis.
There are no female Bazookers, Bowslingers, Brawlers or Knights.
The Chompy Mage is the only villain Sensei not to originate from Trap Team (Kaos's Clone does not count). He first appeared in Skylanders: Giants.
Senseis are currently the only Skylanders incapable of changing upgrade paths without resetting.
Senseis are the only Skylanders who cannot wear hats.
All Master Senseis wear a golden belt around their waists.
Heartbreaker Buckshot was planned to be released, but was scrapped at the last minute due to looking 'too evil'.
The Senseis have the most bird Skylanders out of all non-Core Skylander classifications, having King Pen, Tae Kwon Crow, and Birdie, Air Strike's partner.

shark-shooter-terrafin.name: Shark Shooter Terrafin
shark-shooter-terrafin.description: Shark Shooter Terrafin is the SuperChargers counterpart of Terrafin in Skylanders: SuperChargers. His signature vehicle is the Shark Tank.
shark-shooter-terrafin.biography: Shark Shooter Terrafin is the SuperChargers counterpart of Terrafin in Skylanders: SuperChargers. His signature vehicle is the Shark Tank. Having once been a prize-fighter in the Dirt Seas, he now uses his boxing expertise and shark-rocket artillery to defend Skylands.
shark-shooter-terrafin.personality: Terrafin is a gritty, determined fighter with a boxer's spirit. He is confident in his reflexes and footwork, often making boxing analogies while fighting. He has a rough exterior but a clear sense of duty, always ready for 'Feeding Time' when evil appears.
shark-shooter-terrafin.gameplay: Shark Shooter Terrafin focuses on ranged artillery and subterranean mobility. He fires shark rockets using Ballistic Frenzy and can burrow underground with Earth Swim Blast. His Slam Support allows him to knock back enemies or launch shark allies while submerged. He can further specialize in the Shark Team Squadron path to summon Land Sharks or the All Terrain Trooper path to enhance his underground speed and perform Mega Boomflops.

abilities.name: Ballistic Frenzy
abilities.description: Press Attack 1 to fire shark rockets that burrow into the ground.

abilities.name: Earth Swim Blast
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 to burrow into the ground. Press Attack 1 to emerge and shoot a rocket at the ground.

abilities.name: Slam Support
abilities.description: Press Attack 3 to slam the gun on the ground and knockback nearby enemies. Press Attack 3 during Earth Swim Blast to launch a shark ally that will attack nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Seek or Swim
abilities.description: Ballistic Frenzy rockets do more damage to enemies.

abilities.name: Surface to Air to Surface Missiles
abilities.description: Hold Attack 3 to fire rockets into the ground that emerge and land on enemies.

abilities.name: Seconds, Please
abilities.description: Ballistic Frenzy rockets now hit enemies twice.

abilities.name: Sand Snare
abilities.description: During Earth Swim Blast, press Jump to create a sand whirlpool to trap enemies in.

abilities.name: Three Best Fins
abilities.description: Press Attack 3 during Earth Swim Blast to launch three sharks.

abilities.name: What Goes Up...
abilities.description: S.A.S missiles do more damage on the way up and on the way down.

abilities.name: Land Shark
abilities.description: Hold Attack 1 and release to fire a mortar that summons a sand whirlpool and a large land shark.

abilities.name: Mentor Program
abilities.description: Press Attack 3 during Earth Swim Blast to make a bigger shark ally that lasts longer, can hit enemies multiple times and does more damage.

abilities.name: Finesse
abilities.description: Earth Swim Blast speed is increased and enemies are damaged by the fancy new fin.

abilities.name: Mega Boomflop
abilities.description: During Earth Swim Blast, press Attack 1 to fire rockets and perform a powerful bellyflop that knocks back enemies.

trivia: Shark Shooter Terrafin's name is a play on 'sharpshooter'.
All of Shark Shooter Terrafin's Ring of Heroes abilities start with the letter S.

The latest known concept art of Shark Shooter Terrafin depicts him with orange goggles. At one point he is also depicted riding a shark-toothed rocket while holding a remote, suggesting that this ability was one considered for his moveset. Alternate concepts include him wearing orange boxing gloves, wielding a shovel, and wearing a safari hat, leather jacket, and dog tags around his neck.
He and Super Shot Stealth Elf are the only two SuperCharger versions of previous Skylanders to appear in Skylanders: Ring of Heroes.
Unlike Super Shot Stealth Elf, Shark Shooter Terrafin's regular counterpart does not make an appearance in the game.
There was a planned chase variant of Shark Shooter Terrafin with a green camo-print look that never made it into production.

short-cut.name: Short Cut
short-cut.description: Short Cut is a seamster and one of the Undead Trap Masters in Skylanders: Trap Team.
short-cut.biography: Short Cut was renowned for making the finest clothing in all of Skylands. With his magic shears, no thread was too thick, no cloth was too bunchy, and no pattern was too hard to follow. But one day, a fleet of flying sailing ships appeared overhead, crewed by raucous Skeleton Pirates. Having plundered a cargo of golden yarn from fortunetelling soothsayers, their leader demanded that Short Cut stitch together a magic hat that would tell him the futures of everyone in Skylands – or suffer the consequences! Not wanting to see his work used for evil, he bravely snuck onto the ship that night and sewed the pants and shirts of the sleeping pirates together so they were unable to fight. Short Cut then used his magic shears to cut the sails and wrap them around the ship, preventing the pirates from escaping. His brave actions caught the attention of Master Eon, who quickly made Short Cut a member of the Trap Team, where he now uses powerful Traptanium Shears to cut evil's future short with every snip!
short-cut.personality: Short Cut can be a perfectionist, but only because he loves what he does. He puts a lot of time and energy into creating each masterpiece.
short-cut.gameplay: Short Cut is a seamster who uses magical Traptanium Shears. His playstyle focuses on close-range scissor attacks and summoning Phantom Puppets to assist him. He can upgrade his abilities to include a Nether Needle for crowd control and a powerful Soul Gem move called Scissor Stilts. In the 3DS version, he also utilizes a Scissors Charge and Needle Throw. His starting statistics are 280 Health, 70 Speed, 18 Armor, 80 Critical Hit, and 39 Elemental Power.

abilities.name: Traptanium Scissors
abilities.description: Press Attack 1 to snip away with Traptanium Scissors.

abilities.name: Phantom Puppets
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 to summon puppet minions who attack enemies.

abilities.name: Cutting Frenzy
abilities.description: Rapidly press Attack 1 to go into a cutting frenzy.

abilities.name: Nether Needle
abilities.description: Press Attack 3 to shoot Nether Needle and pull enemies you hit in closer

abilities.name: No Strings Attached
abilities.description: Cut a Puppet's string with Traptanium Scissors to make it faster and more powerful.

abilities.name: Cut Through Worlds
abilities.description: Hold Attack 1 and release to cut open a rift into another dimension.

abilities.name: Scissor Stilts
abilities.description: Hold Attack 1 and press Attack 2 to walk on the Traptanium Scissors like stilts, damaging anything in your path.

abilities.name: Treacherous Tangle
abilities.description: Enemies reeled in by the Nether Needle are tangled.

abilities.name: Super Snips
abilities.description: Enemies tangled up in thread take extra damage from Scissor attacks.

abilities.name: Threadsplosion
abilities.description: After an enemy becomes untangled, an explosion occurs doing extra damage.

abilities.name: Go Out with A Bang
abilities.description: Phantom Puppets explode before disappearing, damaging anything around them.

abilities.name: Puppet Population
abilities.description: Can summon more Phantom Puppets at a time and all do extra damage.

abilities.name: Paging Dr. Puppets
abilities.description: Phantom Puppets can heal you after damaging an enemy.

trivia: Short Cut and Blastermind are the shortest of the Trap Masters.
The way he carries his scissors is similar to that of The Scissorman from the Clock Tower game franchise.
He is the second Undead Skylander voiced by John Kassir (the first being Ghost Roaster).
The Y-shape of his Cut Through Worlds attack is possibly an allusion to autopsy cuts, used identify a person's cause of death.

Short Cut gave the designer team trouble when creating his figure, since his scissors point straight up and form a potential safety hazard. His figure was made tipsy to compensate, minimizing the chances of harm.

shroomboom.name: Shroomboom
shroomboom.description: Shroomboom is a one-eyed mushroom who is one of the eight Skylanders in Skylanders: Giants. He is of the Life element. His Series 2 counterpart is named Sure Shot Shroomboom.
shroomboom.biography: Shroomboom was most unfortunate to have been born in a pizza topping garden belonging to Kaos. Growing up among his fellow fungi, he knew it was only a matter of time before a late night craving would bring about their demise. So Shroomboom took a twig and a strand of spider web and made a slingshot. One by one, he launched all of his friends over the garden fence before flinging himself over to join them. Then he guided them all to the edge of the island and leapt to freedom, using his mushroom cap to catch a friendly breeze. Now as a member of the Skylanders, Shroomboom continues to perform courageous deeds... but he can be hard to find on pizza night.
shroomboom.personality: Courageous and determined, Shroomboom lets nothing stand in his way. He's always ready to parachute into danger, no matter the risk.
shroomboom.gameplay: Shroomboom attacks by shooting exploding mushrooms with a slingshot. His secondary attack is a force field of mushrooms. He can also launch slow mushrooms that glide before they fall and explode and launch himself out of his slingshot, and use his own mushroom cap to glide for short distances.

abilities.name: Slingshot
abilities.description: Press the Attack 1 button to shoot exploding mushrooms.

abilities.name: Mushroom Ring
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 to spawn a ring of mushrooms that damage enemies.

abilities.name: Launch Paratroopers
abilities.description: Press Attack 3 to shoot mushroom paratroopers who drop down from the sky.

abilities.name: Super Shrooms
abilities.description: Mushroom Ring gets bigger.

abilities.name: Bigger Boomshrooms
abilities.description: Press and hold Attack 1 to charge up a giant exploding mushroom.

abilities.name: Bouncing Boomshrooms
abilities.description: Exploding mushrooms bounce on the ground and do increased damage.

abilities.name: Self-Slingshot
abilities.description: While holding Attack 1, press Attack 2 to slingshot Shroomboom towards enemies

abilities.name: High Spore
abilities.description: Hold Attack 1 to create mushroom bumpers and play pinball with enemies.

abilities.name: Spore Power
abilities.description: Mushroom Ring creates a damaging spore cloud.

abilities.name: Ultimate Ring
abilities.description: Mushroom Ring is the biggest it gets.

abilities.name: Back to the Beginning
abilities.description: Hold Attack 2 to remain underground, where you can move around freely.

abilities.name: Lock 'N' Load
abilities.description: Can fire exploding mushrooms faster that do increased damage.

abilities.name: Fungal Infestation
abilities.description: Mushroom Paratroopers stick to enemies and do damage over time.

abilities.name: Paratrooper Invasion
abilities.description: Shoot three Mushroom Paratroopers at once.

trivia: Shroomboom's official catchphrase is a play on 'He Shoots, He Scores!'
According to I-Wei Huang, he was a very difficult character to pose in toy form, due to having a giant mushroom hat that covers his eye.
Shroomboom's mushroom species is a Fly Agaric. Despite the fact Shroomboom was born in a pizza topping garden, Fly Agaric mushrooms are types of toadstool and are actually poisonous.
Despite being afraid of pizza, this may not be true in gameplay as pizza appears as a food item to restore health.
Shroomboom's original name was 'Shroomy'.
He and Chill are the only ones with something sticking out of the pedestals, namely the glowing mushroom.
In-game and toy form, Shroomboom's slingshot is green. However, in the promotional artwork, it's brown.

The spikes on his back in Skylanders Giants are placed in a square grid, contradicting his toy model where the spikes are placed 45 degrees rotated to form a diamond grid. The disparity was later corrected in Skylanders: SWAP Force.
Shroomboom is one of the Skylanders to have 'Boom' in his name (others include Boomer, Boom Jet, Sonic Boom, Ka-Boom, and Boom Bloom).
He and Pop Fizz are the only two Skylanders who got a repose in Trap Team that don't have a Mini counterpart.
There are over 10,000 different species of mushroom in Skylands. Of those 10,000, Shroomboom is the only one to have dedicated his life to fighting the forces of evil.
Sure Shot Shroomboom's artwork can be seen in the Season 1 intro of the Skylanders Academy TV series within The Book of Skylanders.
Shroomboom was one of the many Skylanders planned to appear in Skylanders: Ring of Heroes. Before the game's closure, only concept art of his Awakened Form was released.
During Giants' early development, Shroomboom's abilities and upgrades had different names. He also had several abilities that never carried over to the final game.

sir-hoodington.name: Sir Hoodington
sir-hoodington.description: Sir Hoodington is made using a Hooded Mystery head, Buckles and Belts chest, Shell Arms, Deep Sea Legs, Double Guard for shoulder guards, Spike Bracelets for arm guards, Old Faithful Leg Armor and a Laserblade as his weapon.
sir-hoodington.biography: Sir Hoodington is a notable Imaginator created by Toys For Bob. He serves as a mascot for Skylanders: Imaginators. He is a Knight of the Fire element and is seen in many commercials, screenshots and other promos.
sir-hoodington.personality: Sir Hoodington is one of the most prominent Imaginators who has proved himself invaluable in the fight against Kaos and his Doomlanders.
sir-hoodington.gameplay: Sir Hoodington is a Knight of the Fire element who uses a Laserblade as his weapon. He was featured as the main example character for the Fire Knight class during the promotion of Skylanders: Imaginators.

abilities.name: Laserblade
abilities.description: Sir Hoodington wields a Laserblade as his primary weapon, striking down enemies with fiery precision.

trivia: An indirect reference to Sir Hoodington's 'mascot' role is made in the book A Portal Master's Guide to Skylands, where he is identified as 'one of the most prominent Imaginators'.
Additionally, he is stated to have proved himself invaluable in the fight against Kaos and his Doomlanders.

skeletal-cynder.name: Skeletal Cynder
skeletal-cynder.description: Skeletal Cynder has risen from the darkness to join the Skylands!
skeletal-cynder.biography: Skeletal Cynder is the Halloween 2013 counterpart of Cynder in Skylanders: Lost Islands.
skeletal-cynder.catchphrase: Skeletal Cynder has risen from the darkness to join the Skylands!
skeletal-cynder.personality: Not much is known about Skeletal Cynder's personality, though she has risen from the darkness to join the Skylanders.
skeletal-cynder.gameplay: Skeletal Cynder is a Halloween 2013 Alter Ego counterpart of Cynder exclusive to Skylanders: Lost Islands.
trivia: She is the first dragon Lost Islands exclusive Skylander.
She is also the first female Lost Islands exclusive, the second being Snowler Brawl.

skylanders.name: Skylanders
skylanders.description: The Skylanders are legendary heroes and champions, protectors of their world, Skylands, as well as the main playable characters in the Skylanders franchise. Using their powerful abilities, the Skylanders have defended their world for generations, keeping peace and balance.
skylanders.biography: The Skylanders are legendary heroes and champions, protectors of their world, Skylands. At one point, Kaos banished many of the Skylanders to Earth, while others arrived by different means. Far away from the magic of Skylands, they shrunk and turned into immobile figures, requiring a Portal of Power in order to return to Skylands and come back to life. Recruited by Portal Masters or graduated from Skylanders Academy, a new Skylander's image is engraved onto the Book of Skylanders and is bound to it.
skylanders.personality: Despite the fact that some of the Skylanders come from different realms/worlds and they each have their own personal struggles, they all know it is their duty to use their abilities and protect Skylands. For generations, the Skylanders worked with the Portal Masters in keeping peace and balance in their world. They have an unbreakable bond with their Portal Masters. Though they are not servants, the Skylanders chose to serve their Portal Master and do so eagerly.
skylanders.gameplay: Each Skylander is aligned to a single element: Air, Dark, Earth, Fire, Life, Light, Magic, Tech, Undead, or Water. The elemental alignment makes them strong against one element and weak against another in Battle Arenas (e.g., Earth is strong against Tech, Tech against Magic). Skylanders utilize magic powers, machinery, and physical abilities to defeat enemies. When defeated in battle, they do not die, but are instantly teleported back home where they can heal and rest.

abilities.name: Magic powers
abilities.description: The use of mystical energies to defeat the forces of darkness.

abilities.name: Machinery
abilities.description: Advanced technology and gadgets used in combat and traversal.

abilities.name: Physical abilities
abilities.description: Hand-to-hand combat and natural physical prowess.

trivia: In the series' marketing, Skylanders that do not belong to any specific team are called Core Skylanders.
There is at least one dragon Skylander in every element, five of which are hybrids between dragons and another species (Whirlwind, Sunburn, Camo, Echo, and High Five).
All of the Skylanders originally spoke their own gibberish languages in Skylanders: Spyro's Adventure before receiving English lines.
In Giants, all Skylanders from Spyro's Adventure receives a unique animation when checking their stats.
When Skylanders are defeated in battle, they do not die, but are instantly teleported back home where they can heal and rest.
Developers used generic names for all new Skylanders before final names were decided; some keep these as placeholders in game files.
In the Future of Skylands, it is implied the group will be extinguished or gone, as the Mabu Defense Force takes their role.
Most Skylanders have no known family or mentioned contact, with exceptions like Sonic Boom, Ignitor, and Bad Juju.
In Skylanders Academy, many veteran Skylanders like Ninjini and Snap Shot have retired to make way for a younger generation.
In Skylanders Academy, the Skylanders have a holiday named after them.

slam-bam.name: Slam Bam
slam-bam.description: Slam Bam is a blue four-armed yeti Skylander who, in Skylanders: Spyro's Adventure, comes only in the Empire of Ice Adventure Pack. In Skylanders: Giants, he comes in a singular pack as a Series 2 figure. His Legendary counterpart is Legendary Slam Bam. He also has a summer counterpart which was available on June 2013 in Skylanders: Lost Islands.
slam-bam.biography: Slam Bam lived alone on a floating glacier in a remote region of Skylands, where he spent his time ice surfing, eating snow cones, and sculpting amazing ice statues. It was a peaceful life, until Kaos destroyed the glacier, stranding Slam Bam on an iceberg that drifted through the skies for days. He awoke on Eon's Island, where he was taken in and trained to become a Skylander. Now his ice sculptures serve as a frosty prison for any evil-doer that gets in his way.
slam-bam.personality: Slam Bam can be a little frosty with folks he doesn't know, but soon thaws over time. Get on his bad side, however, and the polar pugilist will knock you out cold.
slam-bam.gameplay: Slam Bam has the ability to create ice prisons to trap his enemies in and freeze them. He can also battle opponents with his powerful four fists. Slam Bam can create various objects out of ice, such as an ice surfboard to navigate across water, an ice hammer in one of his combos, and even an protective igloo as seen in Eruptor Meets the Nightmare King.

abilities.name: Yeti Fists
abilities.description: Throw powerful punches with all four fists.

abilities.name: Ice Prison
abilities.description: Hold the secondary power button and then release to summon an ice prison that will trap enemies.

abilities.name: Three's A Charm
abilities.description: Have up to 3 Ice Prisons active at once.

abilities.name: Arctic Explosion
abilities.description: Ice Prisons explode and damage nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Yeti Ice Shoe Slide
abilities.description: Slide across the ground.

abilities.name: Ice Knuckles
abilities.description: Punch attacks do increased damage.

abilities.name: Yeti-Cooling Factor
abilities.description: Increased coolness and can surf faster.

abilities.name: Sleigh Me
abilities.description: Hold Attack 3 to take a ride on a powerful ice sleigh. To perform his Wow Pow in the 3DS version he must be at level 6 and dash to make a giant spiky ice shield appear.

abilities.name: Brawler Combos
abilities.description: Attack with Ice Hammer.

abilities.name: Ice Mace
abilities.description: Punch attacks does even MORE increased damage.

abilities.name: Blizzard Battle Armor
abilities.description: Battle Armor makes it harder for enemies to hit Slam Bam. Grants +40..

abilities.name: Deep Chill Ice Coffin
abilities.description: Ice Prisons damage enemies trapped inside them.

abilities.name: Glacier Tactics
abilities.description: Ice Prisons travel further and faster.

abilities.name: Work of Ice Art
abilities.description: Ice Prisons last longer and are more resistant to attacks.

trivia: In Skylanders: Spyro's Adventure and Giants, Slam Bam travels across the water by surfing on an ice board.
In his toy form, his blue body is translucent.
Unlike the other Water Skylanders, Slam Bam's base actually has two splashes instead of one.
He, Thrillipede and Starcast are the only three Skylanders with approximately four arms.

While Slam Bam's eyes are yellow in his toy form and his promotional art, his eyes are light blue in the console game and Spyro's: Universe, however, he still seems to have yellow eyes in the 3DS version.
In the E3 trailer, when Slam Bam doesn't believe in Jet-Vac's theory that there are Giants, he sarcastically states that Bigfoot has big feet, though Slam Bam himself is a yeti.
He, Chill, Freeze Blade and King Pen are the only four Water Skylanders who have ice abilities as well as Chill Bill, though he is a Villain.
There is a glitch in Spyro's Adventure where if Slam Bam does an attack while on a bounce pad, he will freeze.

Slam Bam has iron bracelets in his some of his upgrade pictures but not in game. It is possible they were removed last-second before finalization, and the developers had no time to correct the upgrade pictures.
He is the first Skylander to have more than four limbs (the second is Wash Buckler and the third is Spy Rise).
As seen in Swap Force, Slam Bam appears to be much shorter than the other yetis.
Slam Bam, Zap, Echo, and Grave Clobber are currently the only four Water Skylanders who don't hold a weapon.
Oddly, Slam Bam was present in the Just Like Swap Force trailer despite not receiving a repose for that game.

Coincidentally, Slam Bam's voice actor, Fred Tatasciore, would later voice Freddy Yeti from Date Everything, a personified fridge taking the form of a blue and white yeti with heavy associations to the cold, much like Slam Bam himself.

slobber-tooth.name: Slobber Tooth
appearances: Trigger Happy Targets the Evil Kaos
slobber-tooth.description: Slobber Tooth is a turtle dinosaur who is one of the Earth Core Skylanders in Skylanders: Swap Force.
slobber-tooth.biography: Having been asleep for thousands of years, Slobber Tooth was awakened by the fiery eruption of two volcanic islands crashing together. Immediately sought out by Kaos to become one of his minions, Slobber Tooth was promised great power. But the gruff and headstrong fighter chose to follow his own path instead. For this, Kaos attacked his ancient petrified homeland. As the only one who could protect his hibernating race, Slobber Tooth fought tooth and tail against Kaos and his minions, ultimately driving them away. For his heroism, Master Eon asked Slobber Tooth to join the Skylanders, where he could continue defending Skylands against the evil Kaos.
slobber-tooth.personality: Slobber Tooth is a gruff and headstrong fighter. Even though he was offered great power, he turned that down in order to follow his own path. He doesn't consider himself as a thinker to defeat Kaos's minions, but only uses his head, literally. If in doubt, Slobber Tooth will head-butt something. Or tail-thwap it. Or bite it. Or sometimes all three! He is also a ravenous eater.
slobber-tooth.gameplay: Slobber Tooth attacks his enemies with his armored head and slamming his spiked tail to create a shockwave. He can also bite his opponents with his slobbery mouth, even grab them and spit them out at other enemies. Further upgrades regarding Food Fighter path will allow Slobber Tooth to swallow enemies to recover health. In the 3DS version, he can also use Prehistoric Chomp to inhale enemies and Tail Slam to create powerful ground-based attacks.

abilities.name: Horn Swipe
abilities.description: Press Attack 1 to perform a head swipe that damages nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Chomp & Chuck
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 to grab enemies with a slobbery mouth attack. Press Attack 2 again to spit them out.

abilities.name: Unstoppable Force
abilities.description: Hold Attack 1 to charge forward a short distance with a powerful headbutt attack.

abilities.name: Tough Hide
abilities.description: Gain bonus armor. Skin as tough as tough as nails and rocks mixed together.

abilities.name: Shockwave
abilities.description: Press Attack 3 to do a tail slam on the ground, damaging all enemies nearby.

abilities.name: Loogey
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 after holding an enemy with a Chomp attack to spit them out and deal increased damage.

abilities.name: Iron Jaw
abilities.description: Gain an iron jaw causing all head attacks to deal increased damage.

abilities.name: Snot Rocket
abilities.description: Enemies hit with a spit attack will be covered in goo and take damage over time.

abilities.name: Om Nom Nom
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 to eat enemies, enemies being eaten will give more health back after a short time.

abilities.name: Feast
abilities.description: Hold Attack 2 to pull enemies into a chomping mouth attack.

abilities.name: Fling
abilities.description: Press Attack 3 to do a tail slam on the ground, press Attack 3 again to fling all nearby enemies into the air.

abilities.name: Weight Gain
abilities.description: Gain a new spikey tail causing Shock wave attacks to do increased damage.

abilities.name: Earth Shaker
abilities.description: Hold Attack 3 to continue tail slamming the ground, causing waves of rocks to spread out and damage enemies in the way.

trivia: Slobber Tooth is the second dinosaur and turtle while Dino-Rang and Warnado, respectively, are the first.

It takes Slobber Tooth almost an hour a day to keep his teeth in tip-top condition. This is partly because his fangs are so large and prominent, and partly because it's quite difficult to hold a toothbrush with those hands. Or claws. Or whatever they are.

Being a dinosaur, he most closely resembles the Ankylosaurus, which was known for its heavily armored body and its thick-ended tail, which, like Slobber Tooth, could swing as a club. He also resembles the Doedicurus, a prehistoric armadillo species.
He, Wrecking Ball, Thumpback, Gusto, and The Gulper can eat their enemies.
He and Bash are the only Skylanders that use spikes to attack in the Earth Element.
In his Short Cut, Slobber Tooth finds microphones delicious.
On the Swap Force 3DS character poster, his name was misspelled as 'Slobbler Tooth'.
His name may have been a play on 'Saber Tooth'.
Slobber Tooth was originally called 'Lock Jaw'.
He is voiced by Dave Fennoy who is most known for voicing Lee Everett from the 2012 game The Walking Dead. He also voices the Trap Master, Thunderbolt.

Slobber Tooth is noticeably similar to Wrecking Ball: Both are Core Skylanders. Both can eat their enemies. Both of their Soul Gems upgrade their primary attacks. Both can gain health without needing to eat food. Both can charge up one of their attacks each.
He, Trail Blazer, and Flashwing are capable of attacking enemies from behind without turning around.
In Skylanders: SuperChargers and Racing, he is the only four legged Skylander to actually hold the steering wheel while the others just lean on it.

small-fry.name: Small Fry
small-fry.description: Small Fry is the Mini counterpart of the Fire Skylander Fryno in Skylanders: Trap Team.
small-fry.biography: The Skylander Minis started off as regular 'Sidekicks,' assisting the Skylanders on many exciting adventures. And what they lacked in size they more than made up for in courage. Ultimately determined to become full-fledged heroes, they trained at the Skylands Academy - honing their powers and skills until they were ready. Now, they stand side by side with their full grown counterparts, ready to defend Skylands against Kaos and his evil minions.
small-fry.personality: Small Fry has a short temper. It makes him a little hot under the collar. Like his mentor, Fryno, Small Fry always tells the truth, even when others don't want to hear it. He hates it when people lie and cheat.
small-fry.gameplay: Small Fry plays identically to Fryno, utilizing fast melee punches and a high-speed motorcycle charge. His 'The Horn and The Hog' attack makes him one of the fastest Skylanders in the series, even surpassing Drobot's Thruster Flight.

abilities.name: Brawl
abilities.description: Punch enemies with fiery rhino fists.

abilities.name: Heated
abilities.description: Release a burst of heat that damages nearby enemies.

abilities.name: The Horn And The Hog
abilities.description: Summon a flaming motorcycle to charge through enemies.

abilities.name: Born to Ride
abilities.description: The motorcycle charge lasts longer and deals more damage.

abilities.name: Hot Hands
abilities.description: Increases the damage of punching attacks.

trivia: He is the only Mini Skylander who is a counterpart of a character from Skylanders: Swap Force.
He and Pet-Vac are the only Mini counterparts of core Skylanders who didn't appear in Spyro's Adventure.
Small Fry makes an appearance in Skystones Overdrive as a Skystone of the Magic element, strangely. He is also the only Skylander to appear as a Skystone before Creation Clash.
Despite his nickname, he'll say Fryno's line of 'I'm no small fry!' when checking his stats.
His name is actually a play on the name for what you would call a little 'newly hatched fish'. 'A small fry'.
Some of his upgrades mistakenly refer to him as Fryno.
Small Fry's (and Fryno's) The Horn and The Hog attack makes him one of the fastest Skylanders in the series, even surpassing Drobot's Thruster Flight.

smash-hit.name: Smash Hit
smash-hit.description: Smash Hit is a Warsupial who is one of the Earth SuperChargers in Skylanders: SuperChargers. His signature vehicle is the Thump Truck. He also has a green counterpart called Steel Plated Smash Hit, which is exclusive to Best Buy.
smash-hit.biography: Smash Hit came from a long line of Warsupials - a rare species widely renowned for their skills in combat. But in more peaceful times, his people were responsible for locating and demolishing any remaining artifacts from the Arkeyan Empire that were deemed too dangerous to leave standing. Smash Hit liked his job because it allowed him to do what he loved most - break things! He was so skillful with his wrecking ball that he could single-handedly dismantle an entire Arkeyan Conquertron in under an hour and still have time for a snack. When Master Eon noticed his skill, he enlisted the talented Warsupial into a new wrecking crew he was forming to take on Kaos - the SuperChargers!
smash-hit.personality: As his name suggests, Smash Hit loves demolishing objects (particularly remnants of the Arkeyans that were too dangerous to leave rusting). However when not battling evil, he tends to destroy old objects at the Skylanders Academy that no longer prove useful to its inhabitants (Buzz in particular). He is also a real chatterbox when having a conversation, as revealed in his interactions with Buzz during his Quests in SuperChargers.
smash-hit.gameplay: Smash Hit can use his large ball and chain to crush enemies in various ways, and detach them to attack with the chain and leave the ball attacking on its own. In Skylanders: Battlecast, he can also summon the Thump Truck via rift to run over enemies quickly, and cause a shockwave that temporarily immobilizes enemies. His special ability is Ground Pound, ensnaring an enemy, and his signature gear is the Rip Chain, which only gives him a small boost in attack but also makes him retaliate when he is attacked directly. His scrapped signature Relic is the Cement Slinger, which adds up to debuffs by damaging the targets.

abilities.name: Demolisher
abilities.description: Press Attack 1 repeatedly to swing the boulder around in circle.

abilities.name: Crushinator
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 to smash the boulder on the ground in front of you.

abilities.name: Connect and Disconnect
abilities.description: Press Attack 3 to Disconnect the boulder and gain unique chain attacks. Press Attack 3 again to Connect.

abilities.name: Junkyard Dog
abilities.description: Boulder attacks deal more damage. Rock on!

abilities.name: Spikey Spinner
abilities.description: Hold Attack 3 for a short time to charge up the boulder and send it spinning at enemies.

abilities.name: Junker
abilities.description: Chain attacks deal more damage. Chain time!

abilities.name: Down, Under
abilities.description: Hold Attack 3 when connecting to the boulder to create a huge explosion underneath you!

abilities.name: Heap
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 for a short amount of time to charge your boulder. The next attack with the boulder will deal massive damage!

abilities.name: Better Together
abilities.description: Gain a large armor increase when Connecting. Press Attack 3 to Disconnect the boulder, Press Attack 3 again to Connect.

abilities.name: Catch!
abilities.description: Hold Attack 1 while Connected to throw your boulder at enemies!

abilities.name: G'Day
abilities.description: Hold Attack 1 while Disconnected to pull yourself to enemies!

abilities.name: Cut Loose
abilities.description: The next attack will be a critical hit when Disconnecting. Press Attack 3 to Disconnect the boulder, press Attack 3 again to Connect.

abilities.name: Earth Currents
abilities.description: Press Attack 3 while Disconnected to pull enemies into the spinning boulder.

trivia: Smash Hit's voice actor, Rob Paulsen, is best known for his voice work in the 1987 and 2012 versions of Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles as Raphael and Donatello, respectively, Yakko Warner and Dr. Otto Scratchansniff from Animaniacs, Pinky from Pinky and the Brain and Animaniacs, Carl Wheezer from Jimmy Neutron, Broccoli Overlord from The High Fructose Adventures of the Annoying Orange, Arthur from The Tick, and the announcer for Funniest Pets & People.
He, Shroomboom, Eye-Brawl, Magna Charge, Rocky Roll (Rocky part), Eye-Small, Dive-Clops and Ro-Bow are the only Skylanders with one eye. Smash Hit is the only one among them who is not a cyclops.
His face resembles Conker the squirrel from the Rare video games Conker's Pocket Tales and Conker's Bad Fur Day.
He and Ghost Roaster have spiked balls at the end of their chains.
Both Smash Hit and Buzz have eyepatches over their right eye.
In his second quote to Buzz during his SuperChargers Quests, Smash Hit makes a reference to Miley Cyrus' song 'Wrecking Ball' when mentioning his cousin coming 'in like a wrecking ball'.

His species name, Warsupial, is a combination of the words 'war' and 'marsupial', an animal family consisting of kangaroos, wallabies, wombats, koalas etc, in which females have pouches to carry their babies in.
Smash Hit was originally intended to be of the Life element.
Because his quest quotes are longer than other SuperChargers', Smash Hit is considered a real chatterbox.
Smash Hit is one of the shortest Skylanders along with Rocky, Short Cut, and Blastermind.
He and Turbo Charge Donkey Kong have the highest amount of health out of all the SuperChargers.
Smash Hit's name is derived from the term used to describe a person or thing (such as a game, movie, song or play) that is overwhelmingly successful and/or popular.

smolderdash.name: Smolderdash
appearances: Trigger Happy Targets the Evil Kaos
smolderdash.description: Smolderdash is a fire spirit and one of the Core Skylanders in Skylanders: Swap Force. She is of the Fire element.
smolderdash.biography: Smolderdash had always wanted to be a royal defender of the Fire Temple - home of the First Flame, a sacred torch that had been ignited by the original Fire Source. Unfortunately, she had been born during an eclipse and was believed by her people to be cursed, which prevented her from such an honor. But when Kaos stole the flame and used it to light the candles on his birthday cake, it was Smolderdash who went after it. Blazing like a comet, she dashed into Kaos' Lair, repelled the troll security force with her flaming whip, and retrieved the sacred flame just before Kaos blew out the candles. Smolderdash returned home as a champion of her people and was finally granted the honor of becoming a royal defender. But she graciously declined, having set a new goal for herself - to help fight against Kaos as a member of the Skylanders.
smolderdash.personality: Smolderdash is as steely and determined as they come. She whips her enemies into shape, and doesn't take no for an answer.
smolderdash.gameplay: Smolderdash is a precision-based Fire Skylander who uses a flame whip and solar orbs. Her signature mechanic is the Eclipse mode, which enhances her attacks and speed. She can detonate her solar orbs for area damage or hit them with her whip to split them. Her upgrades allow her to focus on enhancing her projectile suns or becoming a melee powerhouse with sun slams and a fiery aura.

abilities.name: Flame Whip
abilities.description: Press Attack 1 rapidly to perform whip combos.

abilities.name: Solar Orb
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 to shoot a fiery orb. Press Attack 2 again to detonate it.

abilities.name: Eclipse
abilities.description: Press Attack 3 to become solar charged for a short time, making all attacks more powerful. Eclipse needs to recharge for a short time after it is used before it can be used again.

abilities.name: Solar Powered
abilities.description: Speed is increased. Time to blaze through the Skylands!

abilities.name: Sunrise
abilities.description: Hold Attack 1 to charge a sun attack, release to jump into the air and slam a huge sun into the ground.

abilities.name: Whip It!
abilities.description: Press Attack 1 to attack with more powerful whips that do increased damage. Whip it good!

abilities.name: Smolder Dash
abilities.description: Perform the powerful Smolder Dash when you press Attack 3 while in Eclipse mode!

abilities.name: Super Giant
abilities.description: Hold Attack 2 to charge a sun into a super giant sun, release to throw it forward which deals more damage and hits more enemies.

abilities.name: Solar Flare
abilities.description: Critical Hit is increased. Unleash the power of a solar flare!

abilities.name: Sun Splitter
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 to shoot a blazing sun at enemies. Press Attack 1 to strike the sun with a whip attack causing the sun to speed up. Super Giant suns split into three smaller suns when hit.

abilities.name: Solar Blast
abilities.description: Hold Attack 1 to charge a sun attack, release to jump into the air and slam a huge sun into the ground causing five smaller suns to shoot out towards enemies.

abilities.name: Sunny Armor
abilities.description: Armor is increased. So bright and cheery that enemies attacks don't do anything to damper the mood!

abilities.name: Sun's Core
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 to shoot a blazing sun at enemies. Press Attack 2 to strike the sun with a whip attack and gain a fiery aura that damages nearby enemies.

trivia: Smolderdash is the first female Fire Skylander in the series (second being Torch).
This also makes fire the last element of the original elements to have a female character, with Smolderdash not being introduced until Swap Force.
Her name is a play on 'balderdash', a word meaning preposterous or rubbish.
Developer Nathan Wilens comments, 'From the moment I started playing Smolderdash, I fell in the love with the precision, speed, grace, beauty and fire!'
Her official catchphrase 'A Blaze of Glory!' is a play on the phrase 'a blaze of glory', which doing something in a successful and impressive manner.
'Whip it good!' in her upgrades is a reference to the 80's song Whip It by Devo.

Her voice actress, Grey DeLisle, is very well known for the voice of Vicky from The Fairly OddParents, Mandy from The Grim Adventures of Billy and Mandy, Azula and Kya from Avatar the Last Airbender, Lana, Lola and Lily Loud from The Loud House, Daphne Blake from the later Scooby-Doo series and Kitty Katswell in T.U.F.F. Puppy.

As a LightCore figure, her eyes, forehead and flaming hair light up. But within the game, any part of her that is yellow makes her glow bright yellow, although the figure actually glows red. Also, despite her LightCore artwork, she doesn't wield a flaming whip in her hand, but in the game she does.

She has an Employee 2013 Special Edition variant called 'Snowderdash' in which her fiery pedestal, eyes and the rest of the parts where they are originally orange and yellow are blue instead. Also, her jet black body is glittering silvery-white.
She resembles the Flame Guard from Adventure Time.
In Skylanders: Lost Islands, Smolderdash has a different backstory than the one on the official Skylanders website.
She is the only Skylander with an attack that is the same as her name. Although it is in two words, while her name is all one word.
Concept art shows that Smolderdash was originally named 'Eclipse'.
She, Trigger Happy, and Gusto are the only Skylanders to have the word, 'glory,' in their catchphrases.
She resembles The Statue Of Liberty in New York, both sharing torches and tiaras with arrows on their ends.

snap-shot.name: Snap Shot
snap-shot.description: Snap Shot is a blue Water crocagator. He is the natural leader of the Trap Team in Skylanders: Trap Team, and is best friends with Wallop. He is available in the console Starter Pack along with Food Fight.
snap-shot.biography: Snap Shot came from a long line of Crocagators that lived in the remote Swamplands, where he hunted chompies for sport. After rounding up every evil critter in his homeland, Snap Shot ventured out into the world to learn new techniques that he could use to track down more challenging monsters. He journeyed far and wide, perfecting his archery skills with the Elves and his hunting skills with the wolves. Soon he was the most revered monster hunter in Skylands – a reputation that caught the attention of Master Eon. It then wasn't long before Snap Shot became the leader of the Trap Masters, a fearless team of Skylanders that mastered legendary weapons made of pure Traptanium. It was this elite team that tracked down and captured the most notorious villains Skylands had ever known!
snap-shot.personality: Snap Shot is a fearless crocagator who uses his wild tracking skills to hunt down evil monsters and eventually villains.
snap-shot.gameplay: Snap Shot can use his Traptanium bow and arrow to shoot enemies in various ways and summon whirlpools. In Skylanders: Battlecast, he can also attack a hook to a special arrow to drag in enemies nearer. His special ability is Sharpshooter, which allows him to hit any enemy, and his signature Gear is the XL500 Scope, which attacks alongside his spells. He can also summon a trap Relic containing Chill Bill to temporarily assist him.

abilities.description: Torrential Tidepool now calls forth the power of the Kraken.

trivia: Throughout the main series, IDW comics and commercials, Snap Shot seems to be ambidextrous, switching between left and right hands to hold his bow and traptanium arrows.
Both Snap Shot and Dino-Rang are reptilian Skylanders that use a projectile weapon. Both Skylanders also speak with an Australian accent.
He is similar to King Pen, the leader of the Senseis, as both are of the Water element and lead an elite team of Skylanders.
Prior to Imaginators, he and Flameslinger were the only two Skylanders to wield an archery set.
His name is a play on snapshot, a common word for photograph.

In an interview during San Diego Comic Con 2014, I-Wei called Snap Shot by his prototype named 'Croc Shot'. One of his expansion cards in Battlecast would be called Croc Shot. However, the card was never released.
In an early look at Skylanders merchandise, his weapons were known as 'Ranger Bow & Arrow'.

Snap Shot also appears in the Target Holiday 2014 commercials along with Barbie, Skye, Chase and Marshall from PAW Patrol, Leonardo from TMNT, Zoomer Dino and Doc McStuffins. He is the second Skylander to appear in a Target commercial whereas Tree Rex was the first.
He and Food Fight are the only two Trap Team characters with Instant counterparts, exclusive to the Tablet version of the game.
He and Wildfire are the only two Trap Masters to have Dark counterparts.
One of Snapshot's battle cries 'Croc and Awe' is similar to Jet-Vac's catchphrase 'Hawk and Awe'.
He is one of the few Skylanders whose catchphrase is a play on 'Rock and Roll' (the other two are Wrecking Ball and Bash).
Snap Shot is the fourth Skylander to be voiced by Fred Tatasciore (others being Slam Bam, Zook, and Warnado).

Although he is the leader of the Trap Masters, in the 'Trapping Kaos' trailer and the introduction of Trap Team, Wallop strangely, appears to have the leadership role. Personally they could share roles as Wallop is Snap Shot's best friend.
In the Wii version of Trap Team, there is a glitch when playing Skaletones Showdown or checking his stats, where his lower jaw will sometimes clip through his top jaw.
Buckshot's catchphrase is similar to Snap Shot's early catchphrase.

snowler-brawl.name: Snowler Brawl
snowler-brawl.description: Snowler Brawl has come from the great white north to join the Skylands!
snowler-brawl.biography: Snowler Brawl is the Winter counterpart of Roller Brawl, available exclusively on Skylanders: Lost Islands on December 2013.
snowler-brawl.catchphrase: Snowler Brawl has come from the great white north to join the Skylands!
snowler-brawl.personality: As the winter counterpart of Roller Brawl, Snowler Brawl is a vampire Skylander who traveled from the great white north to assist the Skylanders.
snowler-brawl.gameplay: Snowler Brawl is an Undead variant of Roller Brawl appearing exclusively in Skylanders: Lost Islands. As a digital-only Alter Ego, she features a unique winter-themed character model, complete with a helmet that resembles Snowmeans. In-game, she possesses unique idle and poke animations. Although she was briefly subject to a glitch that listed her as a SWAP Force Skylander, she is a standard Undead character.
trivia: There was a glitch with Snowler Brawl being listed as SWAP Force Skylander in Lost Islands. This glitch has since been fixed.
She is the second female Lost Islands-exclusive Skylander of the Undead element, the first being Skeletal Cynder and the third being Hallows' Eve Hex.
Unlike the other two, Snowler Brawl is not a Halloween counterpart.
Snowler Brawl's helmet resembles Snowmeans from the video game Scooby-Doo! and the Spooky Swamp.
Snowler Brawl and Rocky Egg Roll are the only Lost Islands variants whose names are nonconventional puns on the original Skylander's name, as opposed to words being put in front of their name.

solar-flare-aurora.name: Solar Flare Aurora
solar-flare-aurora.description: Solar Flare Aurora is a counterpart of Aurora in Skylanders: Imaginators.
solar-flare-aurora.biography: Aurora is the niece of Master Eon. For years, he tried to keep her identity a secret so that she would remain safe from harm. But as she grew older, Aurora wanted nothing more than to become a Skylander, but Eon would not permit it. So without telling him, she wore a disguise and studied swordplay and combat arts under the name 'Boss Blades McSlashinator.' Soon, everyone was talking about this new mysterious hero and her amazing abilities. Even Master Eon was notably impressed, but when he learned the skilled fighter was none other than his own niece, he once again refused her entry into the Skylanders team. However, before she could protest, Eon smiled and told her it was because he was immediately promoting her to his Sensei program, where she would train the Swashbuckler Class under her true name and identity. Although he did later admit that 'Boss Blades McSlashinator' sounded pretty cool.
solar-flare-aurora.personality: Determined and resourceful, Aurora adopted a secret persona to prove her skills. She is dedicated to the combat arts and takes her role as a Sensei seriously, showing great persistence in pursuing her dream of becoming a Skylander.
solar-flare-aurora.gameplay: Solar Flare Aurora is a Swashbuckler Sensei of the Light element. She utilizes high agility and dual-sword combat to overwhelm enemies. Her abilities include rapid strikes and light-based dashes, making her a formidable melee fighter with the speed of light.

abilities.name: Flash Dash
abilities.description: A quick dash attack moving at the speed of light.

abilities.name: Light Burst
abilities.description: Release a burst of light energy to damage nearby enemies.

abilities.description: Advanced sword combat techniques for increased damage.
