abilities.name: Jurassic Whirled
abilities.description: The last hit of your Attack 1 triple-combo creates an exploding dust storm vortex!

abilities.name: Historic Preservation
abilities.description: You get new horns! And after doing a Dino Dash, you gain a shield and take less damage.

abilities.name: Fossil Forte
abilities.description: You summon Fossil Traps faster, and you deal critical hits to enemies tarred by them!

abilities.name: Matador Might
abilities.description: Dino Dash into a Fossil Trap to create a massive explosion.

trivia: He is the only male Sensei of the Earth element.
He is the fourth dinosaur Skylander (behind Dino-Rang, Slobber Tooth and Chopper).
Tri-Tip mentioned Chopper after admitting that he 'stole' the latter's catchphrase. He and Hurricane Jet-Vac are the only two playable Skylanders to mention another Skylander in game.
He and Bash have triceratops related traits.
His name is a play on Tri-tip, which is a cut of beef.
This would make him the 6th Skylander with a food-based name, after Hot Dog, Pop Thorn, Rocky Roll, Jawbreaker and Thumpling.
Tri-Tip somewhat resembles a Triceraton from Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles.
His Posey Power Swing attack is a reference to baseball star Buster Posey.
One of his upgrades, Jurassic Whirled, is a play on the title of the movie Jurassic World.
His catchphrase is similar to Wham-Shell's.
His defeated animation is similar to Pop Fizz's, both hitting their weapon of choice against their forehead.

Tri-Tip is voiced by Brad Abrell, who is best known for voicing Bubble Buddy in Spongebob Squarepants. He also voiced Phil the Penguin and a Mammoth in Spyro: A Hero's Tail and Frankenstein in Hotel Transylvania: Transformania (replacing Kevin James).
He also voiced Prism Break (replacing Peter Lurie) in Skylanders: Battlecast. Coicidentally, both are Earth elemental Skylanders.
Tri-Tip's upgrade portraits, Mace Smash and Mighter Mace, are swapped.

trigger-happy.name: Trigger Happy
appearances: Trigger Happy Targets the Evil Kaos
trigger-happy.description: Trigger Happy is a gremlin gunslinger Skylander in Skylanders: Spyro's Adventure. He is one of the three Skylanders in the Spyro's Adventure Starter Pack, alongside Spyro and Gill Grunt. He has a Legendary counterpart called Legendary Trigger Happy exclusive to Toys 'R' Us. He also has a Spring counterpart, and his Series 3 counterpart is called Big Bang Trigger Happy.
trigger-happy.biography: Trigger Happy is more than his name -- it's his solution to every problem. Nobody knows from where he came. He just showed up one day in a small village, saving it from a group of terrorizing bandits by blasting gold coins everywhere with his custom-crafted shooters. Similar tales were soon heard from other villages, and his legend quickly grew. Now everyone in all of Skylands knows of the crazy goldslinger that will take down any bad guy... usually without bothering to aim.
trigger-happy.personality: Trigger Happy's solution to every problem is being trigger-happy. Known as a crazy gunslinger, he is reckless and impatient, often diving into danger without commands. Despite his kooky exterior and tendency to hide sheep in Hugo's wardrobe, he is highly knowledgeable about fighting gear and can think of tactical ideas that save the day, such as when he yanked the Mask of Power off Kaos.
trigger-happy.gameplay: Trigger Happy can fire a barrage of gold coins at his enemies from his two guns. He can also hurl large gold objects, fire away at his opponents using a machine gun filled with coins, and release two yellow beams from his guns after charging them up. Choosing the Golden Frenzy path upgrades his golden guns with ricocheting bullets and the devastating Golden Yamato Blast, while the Golden Money Bags path focuses on his thrown objects, turning them into explosive pots of gold or damaging coins.

abilities.description: While using the mini-gun, press Attack 1 for a super blast.

abilities.name: Rocket Ride!
abilities.description: While holding Attack 1, press and hold Attack 2 to charge up a golden rocket, then release to ride it as a missile.

abilities.description: Golden Gun does increased damage.

abilities.name: Bouncing Bullets
abilities.description: Golden Gun's bullets bounce off walls.

abilities.name: Golden Yamato Blast

abilities.name: Heads or Tails
abilities.description: Toss a coin that does extra damage ... and if it lands on heads, it does even more damage.

trivia: Trigger Happy's guns bears a slight resemblance to Maverick REV-6s, a toy made by NERF.
He has the lowest base health in the game out of all the original Skylanders.
In Series 1 Trigger Happy's artwork, the coins he is shooting have Spyro's head on them.
His catchphrase is a joke on the phrase 'No guts, No glory'.
Pop Fizz and Trigger Happy are, so far, the only Gremlin Skylanders.
Trigger Happy's Golden Yamato Blast can destroy cracked rocks in Molekin Mine and deals more damage than any other attack from a green base Skylander.
In Skylanders: Cloud Patrol, Trigger Happy is the first Skylander unlocked.
Yamato is the name of the largest ship ever constructed.
One of Trigger Happy's upgrades, 'Happiness Is A Golden Gun', is a reference to the Beatles' song 'Happiness Is a Warm Gun'.

trigger-snappy.name: Trigger Snappy
trigger-snappy.description: Trigger Snappy is one of the four Sidekicks in Skylanders: Spyro's Adventure. He is the miniature counterpart of Trigger Happy, eventually becoming a Mini Skylander in Skylanders: Trap Team.
trigger-snappy.biography: Within the Skylands, a realm of infinite possibilities, there is in fact an alternate reality known as the Skylands Miniverse. Everything there is smaller, including the Skylanders. The Skylanders Sidekicks come from that Miniverse and have traveled to the Skylands to meet their regular-sized alter egos and tag along with them on adventures. The Skylander Minis started off as regular 'Sidekicks,' assisting the Skylanders on many exciting adventures. And what they lacked in size they more than made up for in courage. Ultimately determined to become full-fledged heroes, they trained at the Skylands Academy - honing their powers and skills until they were ready. Now, they stand side by side with their full grown counterparts, ready to defend Skylands against Kaos and his evil minions.
trigger-snappy.personality: Trigger Snappy is a ball of positive energy. He's funny and happy, and his teammates love being around him. When trouble blows into town, he blows it right back out, like his mentor Trigger Happy. Trigger Snappy can be a pretty antsy sometimes.
trigger-snappy.gameplay: Trigger Snappy functions as a miniature counterpart to Trigger Happy. Originally a Sidekick who assisted other Skylanders, he became a fully playable Mini Skylander starting in Trap Team. As a Mini Skylander, he has unique summoning poses: in Trap Team, he jumps while exclaiming his catchphrase, while in SuperChargers and Imaginators, he pretend fires his guns. In later titles, his health scaling is exceptionally high, even surpassing that of Trigger Happy in SuperChargers and Imaginators.

abilities.name: Gold Coin Shooters
abilities.description: Shoots gold coins at enemies.

abilities.name: Safe Cracker Bomb
abilities.description: Throws a safe that explodes upon impact.

abilities.name: Pot O' Gold
abilities.description: Upgrades the coin shooters to fire pots of gold.

abilities.name: Golden Super Charge
abilities.description: A powerful charge attack that unleashes golden energy.

abilities.name: Coinsplosion
abilities.description: A massive explosion of gold coins that damages all nearby enemies.

trivia: As a Sidekick in Spyro's Adventure and Giants, Trigger Snappy had dark brown fur and white eyes. From Swap Force onward, his eyes and fur became just like his original counterpart's color.

As a Mini Skylander, Trigger Snappy has two different summoning poses: in Trap Team, he turns to face the player and jumps while exclaiming his catchphrase. In SuperChargers and Imaginators, he pretend fires his guns at the player and poses. He is the only Mini Skylander to have different summoning poses between games.
In SuperChargers and Imaginators, he has 840 health and more health than Trigger Happy.

tuff-luck.name: Tuff Luck
tuff-luck.description: Tuff Luck is a (caracal) feline who is one of the Life Trap Masters in Skylanders: Trap Team.
tuff-luck.biography: For many years, Tuff Luck and her tribe guarded the Fortunata Springs – the source of all good luck in Skylands. Though hidden in the Random Canyons, which move without warning to cover the hidden entrance to the magical waters, minions of Kaos located the springs and flew in sponge-tankers to drain every drop of the lucky liquid. Fortunately, Tuff Luck was patrolling the area and immediately jumped into action when she saw what was happening. Between her awesome skill and unbeatable good luck, she single-handedly drove off the minions. She then drank from the magical waters, as was custom for her tribe. Sensing a greater calling, Tuff Luck decided to leave her tribe to join the Trap Team, where she could do even more to help protect Skylands. Armed with her Traptanium Warblades, she always beats the odds – and evil – at every turn!
tuff-luck.personality: Tuff Luck has a lot of good stuff going for her. She is all about taking chances. Like the rest of her tribe, she is also very protective of the Fortunata Springs.
tuff-luck.gameplay: Tuff Luck can attack her enemies with her Traptanium Warblades, and even unleash waves of energy from them. She can also turn invisible in clusters of four-leaf clovers to pounce on her opponents. Upon purchasing her Soul Gem ability, she can create spiky blades of grass that attack all enemies around her. One of Tuff Luck's notable gameplay traits is her major luck factor. When using the Warblade Stab attack, either alone or in tangent, to another ability, there is a chance that it will be charged with the energy of a rainbow, increasing the area of effect and dealing significantly more damage to enemies.

trivia: Her original catchphrase was 'It's Your Lucky Day!' although it was changed to 'Deal With It!' late in development.
In Skylanders Collection Vault, her catchphrase is still listed as 'It's Your Lucky Day!' even though it has been changed.
She is the third Life Skylander who can turn invisible, after Stealth Elf and Stink Bomb.
She appears in the Robot Chicken episode 'Fridge Smell'.
Tuff Luck is the second female Life Skylander, while Stealth Elf is the first.
Tuff Luck speaks with an Irish accent, likely inspired by the Leprechaun of Irish folklore.
She shares the attack name 'Green Thumb' with Food Fight and a character card for Broccoli Guy.
Her appearance is similar to Cali's, as Tuff Luck's feline species is a caracal.
Tuff Luck jumps farther than the rest of the Skylanders, which gives her a slight advantage but sometimes she may miss some platforms.
Like Stealth Elf, Tuff Luck is only ever shown at her full height during her idle animation.

turbo-charge-donkey-kong.name: Turbo Charge Donkey Kong
turbo-charge-donkey-kong.description: Turbo Charge Donkey Kong, otherwise known as Donkey Kong, is a Kong who is the main protagonist of the Donkey Kong series. He is a special Skylander-amiibo hybrid, along with Hammer Slam Bowser, who is one of the Life SuperChargers in Skylanders: SuperChargers. His signature vehicle is the Barrel Blaster.
turbo-charge-donkey-kong.biography: Donkey Kong is a fun-loving powerhouse gifted with great strength and incredible agility. His insatiable curiosity and easy-going attitude led him to explore the rift that appeared in his native jungle and brought him to exciting new adventures in this world called Skylands. Donkey Kong's fearlessness and reflexes made him a welcome addition to the SuperChargers and also the perfect driver for the stunt-tacular Barrel Blaster vehicle.
turbo-charge-donkey-kong.personality: Being one of Nintendo's most iconic protagonists, Donkey Kong is a carefree, lazy, intelligence-lacking, yet trustworthy hero on Donkey Kong Island. However on various occasions, he was forced to take action with his sidekick and best friend, Diddy Kong and other members of the Kong Family to reclaim their main priority, the Banana Hoard, from their common enemies, the Kremling Krew. Now as a SuperCharger, Donkey Kong is very competitive and agile on the battlefield; because he isn't as fast as Spitfire, Stormblade, or Super Shot Stealth Elf, he tends to revert to Super Donkey Kong mode to keep up. He is also now deeply concerned for the safety of his fellow Skylanders and loved ones. Like all Life Skylanders, Donkey Kong prefers to keep his feet on the ground. At certain times, he can act a bit immature in the midst of battle, but is very protective of the defenseless. Despite his generally relaxed demeanor, he can easily get irritated when one mistakes him for a monkey, which is evidenced when Blubberbeard was introducing himself to the former and Bowser.
turbo-charge-donkey-kong.gameplay: Although he was transformed by a Rift Engine, Donkey Kong still retains some of his original powers from his old days. He can use his Barrels of Fun from the Donkey Kong Country games to sneak past enemies; his Bongo Barrel from the Donkey Konga games to release a damaging shockwave as well as summoning Diddy Kong, and transform into Super Donkey Kong to perform a barrel roll, barrel punches, and his Old School ability, using the girders and ladders from the 1981 Donkey Kong arcade game (originally forming a construction site which served as a fortress for his grandfather, Cranky Kong). Reverting to Super Donkey Kong also allows him to rapidly heal if he chooses his Pointy Preparations path. His primary ability, Primate Punch, gets its name from Donkey Kong 64, being Chunky Kong's secondary ability. He can also throw his barrels, which damage faraway enemies or self-destruct on contact with nearby baddies.

abilities.name: Healthy Kong
abilities.description: Regenerate Health while in Super Donkey Kong mode.

trivia: Skylanders: SuperChargers marks one of Donkey Kong's appearances outside of his original gaming franchise and the Mario franchise behind the Punch-Out!! and Super Smash Bros. franchises.

Unlike most bipedal Skylanders and other characters with either three or four digits on each of their hands and feet, Turbo Charge Donkey Kong and Diddy Kong have five on each hand and foot. They were the only characters to have five digits until the introduction of the Portal Masters from Skylanders: Ring of Heroes.
He is the third simian Skylander, with the first being Grilla Drilla and the second being Fling Kong.
Turbo Charge Donkey Kong was originally going to belong to a new Element called Banana, but this idea was scrapped.[1]
Turbo Charge Donkey Kong's first basic ability, the Primate Punch, has the same name as Chunky Kong's special ability in Donkey Kong 64.

His ability to heal himself (only with the Pointy Preparations path and the Healthy Kong upgrade purchased) can restore his health by +136, which makes him the fastest self-healing Skylander in the game series.
He and Bowser are the only two SuperChargers with vehicles not of their respective Elements. They are also the only Guest Star Skylanders that have dark versions of themselves.
When compared to the other SuperChargers in game, Donkey Kong and Bowser appear to be taller than the rest of them.
He, Spyro, Dino-Rang, Flashwing, Star Strike, Enigma, Hammer Slam Bowser, Crash Bandicoot, Dr. Neo Cortex, and Starcast are the only Skylanders who do not originate from Skylands.

Donkey Kong, Bowser, and Crash Bandicoot are the only Skylanders without catchphrases due to none of them actually able to talk. Dr. Neo Cortex also lacks a catchphrase, but is fully capable of speech. Crash, however, is able to say some short words and phrases, although for full communication, Aku Aku serves as his translator.
Coincidentally, Donkey Kong and Crash are currently the only guest characters of the Life element.
He and Smash Hit are tied for having the highest amount of health out of all the SuperChargers.
Donkey Kong, Bowser, Spyro, Cynder, Sparx, Malefor, Crash Bandicoot, and Dr. Neo Cortex are the only characters to appear in franchises before the series.
Of these characters, Donkey Kong was the first to make his debut. He first appeared in the 1981 arcade game Donkey Kong, making him the oldest character in the Skylanders series.
Super Donkey Kong may be a reference to the Japanese title of the Donkey Kong Country series.

user-blog-cookiecake12347-episode-idea-1.name: User blog:Cookiecake12347/episode idea 1
user-blog-cookiecake12347-episode-idea-1.description: A fan-written episode idea for the Skylanders Academy series involving a tango-style duel between Stealth Elf and Wolfgang.
user-blog-cookiecake12347-episode-idea-1.biography:
I've thought of an episode idea that could have made skylanders acadamy better

the skylander gang visit an elf viliage when it is attacked by the doomraders. wolfgang decides to fight steath elf in a one-on-one battle and almost everything stops. the elf elder then tells them that neither side can help them and that stealth elf and wolfgang cannot use weapons. as the two fight, both the skylanders and doomraders eat popcorn and talk about the fight. the fight itself is styled like a tango ,compleat with wolfgang catching a flower in his teeth near the end of the fight, but neither side backs down. soon both sides are worn out but neither has backed down. however a bell rings and tells them that because they failed to defeat eachother, they are equal and promply tells them that because of this, they must be married. of course both of them are shocked
user-blog-cookiecake12347-episode-idea-1.catchphrase: I've thought of an episode idea that could have made skylanders acadamy better
user-blog-cookiecake12347-episode-idea-1.gameplay: This is a fan-authored blog post and does not contain gameplay features.
trivia: The episode idea was proposed by user Cookiecake12347.
The story centers on a non-weapon battle between Stealth Elf and Wolfgang that is styled like a tango.
The plot concludes with the characters being declared equal and ordered to be married.

volcanic-eruptor.name: Volcanic Eruptor
volcanic-eruptor.description: Volcanic Eruptor is the black counterpart of Series 3 Eruptor exclusive to the 3DS Starter Pack of Skylanders: Swap Force.
volcanic-eruptor.biography: Volcanic Eruptor is the black counterpart of Series 3 Eruptor exclusive to the 3DS Starter Pack of Skylanders: Swap Force.
volcanic-eruptor.personality: Hot-headed and ready to erupt at any moment, Volcanic Eruptor shares the same volatile temperament as his standard counterpart, but with a distinct charred appearance.
volcanic-eruptor.gameplay: Volcanic Eruptor plays identically to Eruptor, utilizing powerful fire and lava-based attacks. He can lob magma at distant foes or cause a localized eruption to clear out enemies in close proximity.

abilities.description: Volcanic Eruptor hurls a ball of lava that explodes on impact.

abilities.name: Eruption
abilities.description: Eruptor erupts, creating a pool of lava around him that damages nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Mega Magma Balls
abilities.description: Enhances the lava projectiles for greater damage.

abilities.name: Super Eruption
abilities.description: A powerful blast that causes a massive volcanic explosion.

abilities.name: Heavy Duty Plasma
abilities.description: Increases the intensity and range of Eruption attacks.

trivia: Volcanic Eruptor is the fourth alter-ego Skylander to be part of the Starter Pack (The first is Dark Spyro, the second is Punch Pop Fizz and the third is Royal Double Trouble).
He is also the first one to not be of the Magic element.
He is currently the only 3DS exclusive character not to be released in a single pack.

voodood.name: Voodood
appearances: Lightning Rod Faces the Cyclops Queen
voodood.description: Voodood is an orc Skylander in Skylanders: Spyro's Adventure. He is in the Magic element.
voodood.biography: Voodood was a brave warrior among his people. During his rite of passage as a young orc, he entered the Cave of Trials to prove his worth. It was there he found much more than expected. Lured by a brilliant light, Voodood discovered the skeleton of an enormous dragon with an ornate axe buried where the heart would have been. The village was astonished when he exited the cave holding the legendary Axe Reaver and wearing the dragon skull on his head. Voodood quickly became warrior leader and defended his homeland from many beasts and invaders... until he was the last of his tribe. Soon after, he joined the Skylanders.
voodood.personality: Voodood was known as a highly decorated soldier of his people, commanding a well-known team of dangerous warriors. When not fighting evil, he is constantly searching for new and exotic bones to expand his collection. Voodood also insists that he has a heart of gold, despite knowing about the Orcs' bad reputation.
voodood.gameplay: Using his axe, Voodood can attack enemies using magical energy that channels through his weapon, he can even create magical tripwires with it. He can also use his axe as a grappling hook to latch onto his opponents, stunning them while he pulls himself towards their location to finish them off in close combat. In 'Secret Agent Secrets' it was also shown that Voodood's axe can unleash magical blasts.

trivia: Voodood's face bears a resemblance to the Grinch.
Voodood is voiced by Andre Sogliuzzo who voices Sparx in the classic Spyro series as well as another Skylander, Camo.
If you hit a Tripwire with his axe, it gets bigger and does more damage.
It is unknown why his Attack 2 combo is called 'Axe Spin', as his attack 3 combo (Magic Axe) is an actual spin. The Attack 2 combo is a ranged projectile attack.
This mistake is fixed in Skylanders: Swap Force.
His soul gem preview in Skylanders: Giants might have been zoomed in because of its low quality and his name not fully shown.
His catchphrase may be based off 'Shoot first, ask questions later!'.
His name is a play on 'Voodoo' and 'Dude'.
'Dood' also means 'dead' in Dutch.
His Electric Feedback upgrade also activates when he heals.
On the Wii version of Swap Force, if an enemy hits the round end of his trip wire, it will disappear which may freeze the game.
He speaks in third person.
In game, Voodood is one of the smallest non-Mini Skylanders. If one doesn't count his Axe in his height, Voodood is the smallest.
He is the only Skylander whose name starts with the letter 'V'.

During the war against the beasts that threatened their tribe, Voodood slayed three times as many enemies as his fellow tribesmen, and it is said that the axe seemed to have a life of its own - a magical power that extended beyond Voodood's hands and brought the meanest and most ferocious beasts that Skylands has ever seen to their knees!
According to prototype figures in Toys For Bob's office, Voodood was originally planned to be an Undead Skylander.

The battle-axe on Voodood's figure droops over time due to the weight of the axehead, a problem that designer I-Wei Huang wanted to fix but was unable to do because strengthening the plastic would have sharpened the axe's points, making it a hazard.

wallop.name: Wallop
wallop.description: Wallop is a Unique brown-furred, Bear-like Creature. He is one of the Earth Trap Masters in Skylanders: Trap Team and Snap Shot's best friend.
wallop.biography: For generations, Wallop's people used the volcanic lava pits of Mount Scorch to forge the most awesome weapons in all of Skylands. And Wallop was the finest apprentice any of the masters had ever seen. Using hammers in both of his mighty hands, he could tirelessly pound and shape the incredibly hot metal into the sharpest swords or the hardest axes. But on the day he was to demonstrate his skills to the masters of his craft, a fierce fire viper awoke from his deep sleep in the belly of the volcano. The huge snake erupted forth, attacking Wallop's village. But, bravely charging the beast with his two massive hammers, Wallop was able to bring down the creature and save his village. Now with his Traptanium-Infused Hammers, he fights with the Skylanders to protect the lands from any evil that rises to attack!
wallop.personality: Wallop is the best friend of Snap Shot, and is the hardest-working hero this side of Mount Scorch. His inventive mind is always looking for new ways to create.
wallop.gameplay: Wallop is an Earth Trap Master who uses two massive Traptanium-Infused Hammers in battle. He can swing them for powerful melee strikes or toss them to cause area damage. His unique playstyle includes entering a high-speed Tantrum Mode to rapidly strike his foes.

abilities.name: Traptanium Hammer

trivia: Wallop is the third Earth Skylander to have a hammer for a weapon (the other two include Crusher and Rubble Rouser).
Looking closely at his head reveals that he has whiskers, which makes him one of the first Skylanders to have whiskers (the other being Tuff Luck).
The official trailer for Wallop oddly doesn't have his name on the bottom right corner of the screen after Brawl and Chain gets trapped.
Strangely, Wallop seems to have the leadership role in the Trapping Kaos trailer and the introduction of the game, despite the fact that Snap Shot is actually the leader of the Trap Masters.
Wallop's tones of voice sound different from each other. It sounds deeper in the game while it doesn't in the TV commercials.
His helmet was gold in early development.
On the cover of the 2014 edition of the Skylanders Universe: The Complete Collection book, the Fire element symbol is mistakenly pointing to Wallop instead of Earth.
Although Wallop resembles a bear or Mabu in appearance, his actual species is unknown.
Is it possible that Wallop may be a youngest family sibling, and might have two older brothers named Crash (oldest) and Bang (middle aged)?
He is voiced by John DiMaggio, who also voices the SWAP Force Skylander, Wash Buckler.
One of his taglines, 'Brace For Impact!' is another Skylander's Catchphrase.

warnado.name: Warnado
warnado.description: Warnado is an Air-elemental turtle who is one of the main 32 Skylanders from Skylanders: Spyro's Adventure.
warnado.biography: Warnado was hatched in the fury of a rare and powerful Enchanted Twister. Although initially frightened and quite dizzy, over the passing years he grew to enjoy his whirling surroundings and learned many abilities and secrets of the Air Element. This led to Warnado becoming a powerful force and the only known turtle of his kind. Now, the only time he gets dizzy is when standing still.
warnado.personality: One of the most powerful Air sorcerers of all time, Warnado is quick-witted and has lightning fast reflexes. Because of his past, he is fond of roller coasters.
warnado.gameplay: Having learned the ways of the Air element, Warnado has the ability to spin around in a whirling motion, knocking enemies away with his spiky shell. He can also summon tornadoes at a high velocity to help him fight off nearby opponents, and he can spin himself into a gray tornado to tear his way through enemies.

trivia: Warnado is most likely based on the Japanese Kaiju, Gamera. Both are turtles who fly by using jets from their shells to spin rapidly in the air.
While he may be based off of Gamera with his spinning, his design looks a lot like Baragon from the Godzilla franchise.
Warnado, Jet-Vac, and Lightning Rod are currently the only Air Skylanders who can fly without the use of wings.
While flying, he cannot use his Spin Attack, only Summon Tornados, though he does gain several moves that use the primary attack button while flying on the Eye of the Storm path.
His catchphrase is a play on the phrase 'For the win!'.
Warnado is one of many Skylanders who have an attack that summons friendly characters to help defeat enemies (some others include Sonic Boom, Double Trouble, Terrafin, and Pop Fizz).
He, Flashwing and Wham-Shell are the only LightCore Skylanders without an additional counterpart as part of the Swap Force toyline.
He speaks with a Brooklyn-like accent in Giants.
One of his upgrades (Whirlwind Flight) is partially named after another Skylander.
As a LightCore, his shell lights up. This works even on the Spyro's Adventure Portal, though no Lightcore toy existed for that game.
Both of his toy forms have him flying on a tornado.
The 'Wind Elemental' upgrade as a part of his Wind Master path transforms his Tornadoes into recolored Windbag Djinnis.
Despite his backstory stating that he cannot stand on solid ground for long without getting dizzy, he is able to stand still just fine in-game.
Guided Twister has the black tornado from Summon Cyclone.

wash-buckler.name: Wash Buckler
wash-buckler.description: Wash Buckler is a Water Mermasquid pirate who is one of the SWAP Force Skylanders in Skylanders: Swap Force. His SWAP Force Ability is Climb.
wash-buckler.biography: Wash Buckler was an orphan Mermasquid, who grew up on one of the roughest pirate ships in Skylands. While most pirates were interested in pillaging and plundering, Wash Buckler had other ideas for the future of pirating. Over the years, he earned the respect of his crew and eventually convinced his fellow pirates that they didn't all need to be cantankerous bad guys. Thus, they set forward doing heroic deeds. Of course, this new good guy image did not sit well with other pirating crews, who attempted to sabotage Wash Buckler at every turn. But he was no ordinary pirate, and he defended his ship and his crew against the many attacking hordes. It was then that Master Eon took notice of Wash Buckler and asked him to join the Skylanders.
wash-buckler.personality: Unlike most pirates, Wash Buckler is kind-hearted and true. He was never comfortable with pirating.
wash-buckler.gameplay: Wash Buckler can attack by slapping foes with his tentacles as well as shoot ink from them which stuns enemies, his tentacles even allow him to climb walls and steep surfaces easily. He can also use his cutlass to slash at his foes, and his bubble gun to fire bubbles that trap his opponents; and his soul gem allows him to create a watery pirate ship. In Skylanders: Battlecast, Wash Buckler can Rust Gear into Rusted Junk, eat kelp to increase his attack, and paralyze enemies with his ink. His signature Gear is the Mermasquid Buckler, decreasing incoming damage, and his Special Ability is Muckshot, decreasing enemy damage temporarily.

trivia: Wash Buckler is the third pirate character to be on the side of good; the first ones are Captain Dreadbeard and Thumpback.
He is also the second pirate character to be a Skylander.
Even though Wash Buckler's catchphrase is 'Eight Legs and No Pegs', he only has six legs, in-game and toy model.
Counting his arms would add up to eight limbs, though, as would his mustache, which is made of two tentacles similar to his legs.
David Nathanielsz came up with Wash Buckler's catchphrase, 'Eight Legs, No Pegs' while he was stuck in traffic at the Detroit Metropolitan Airport.
Wash Buckler's name comes from the word 'swashbuckler,' a synonym for pirate.
He resembles Davy Jones from Pirates of the Caribbean.
He also resembles Squidfaces such as Squiddlers, Blastaneers, and Squidface Brutes (who are also pirates) and may be a more distant relative of them.

When you put on a different hat for Wash Buckler, his usual hat disappears. The same goes for Rattle Shake. However, his red bandanna remains on his head while either his original hat or another is placed.
Wash Buckler is the second Skylander to have more than four limbs (the first is Slam Bam and the third is Spy Rise).
He is the first Skylander to hold two different weapons that doesn't include a shield.
His moustache is a pair of tentacles, complete with suckers.
He also has suckers on the tips of his 'fingers.'

He is voiced by John DiMaggio who is very prominent for portraying Bender from Futurama, Jake from Adventure Time, Dr. Drakken, Fung from Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness, Motor Ed from Kim Possible.
John also provided the voice of Wallop.
He and Spy Rise are the only SWAP Force Skylanders with more than two legs.
They are also the SWAP Force Skylanders who have Climb Abilities.
He is the second Water Skylander to come with a console starter pack; the first being Gill Grunt for Skylanders: Spyro's Adventure, and the third being Snap Shot for Skylanders: Trap Team.

weeruptor.name: Weeruptor
weeruptor.description: Weeruptor is the Mini counterpart of the Fire Skylander, Eruptor in Skylanders: Trap Team.
weeruptor.biography: The Skylander Minis started off as regular 'Sidekicks', assisting the Skylanders on many exciting adventures. And what they lacked in size they more than made up for in courage. Ultimately determined to become full-fledged heroes, they trained at the Skylands Academy - honing their powers and skills until they were ready. Now, they stand side by side with their full grown counterparts, ready to defend Skylands against Kaos and his evil minions.
weeruptor.personality: Much like Eruptor, Weeruptor has a bad temper. Even the slightest thing will make him angry. Sometimes he's just a typical hothead. He doesn't just hate evil; he wants to burn it to the ground until there's nothing left but a pile of ashes.
weeruptor.gameplay: As a Mini version of Eruptor, Weeruptor possesses volcanic powers, allowing him to lob lava at foes and cause massive eruptions from the ground to burn evil to a crisp.

trivia: When viewing Weeruptor's upgrades descriptions in the 3DS version of Trap Team, they actually match Jet-Vac's descriptions.

wham-shell.name: Wham-Shell
appearances: Gill Grunt and the Curse of the Fish Master
wham-shell.description: Wham-Shell is a crimson-colored crab in Skylanders: Spyro's Adventure. He is of the Water element.
wham-shell.biography: Wham-Shell was the long-standing ruler of a kingdom deep in the oceans of Skylands that for a long time lived peacefully. That is, until his underwater utopia was invaded by a legion of oil-drilling trolls that scattered his people to the wind. Armed with a powerful mace that had been handed down from one king to the next for generations, Wham-Shell defeated the greedy trolls and drove them away. Soon after, he joined the Skylanders to help defend against this type of atrocity ever happening again.
wham-shell.personality: Regal and heroic, Wham-Shell never forgets the common clams and protects the seas for all his worth. As the son of an underwater king, he isn't used to being refused anything. It is also said that he is usually a pretty together kind of guy.
wham-shell.gameplay: Using his mace, which is called the Troll Cracker (originally called the Claw Cracker due to him defeating the trolls), Wham-Shell can release electricity discharged from the mace's spiked tip. He can also strike his enemies with his mace and release pulses of water from it. In Gill Grunt and the Curse of the Fish Master, it is shown that the mace can magically return to Wham-Shell after being thrown.

trivia: Wham Shell has the least amount of blue on his body out of any Water Skylander, with it only being on his eyes.
His razor-sharp teeth don't stay so perfectly white by themselves. Wham-Shell brushes them up to fourteen times a day with a toothbrush carved from coral and toothpaste made from mashed fish scales.
His weapon, the Malacostracan Mace, is named after the scientific class of crustaceans where crabs are part of.
His weapon as a morning star, which is a type of mace with a spiked ball in its end that was used for blunt force damage and piercing armor in medieval times.
When he enters the water, he rides on his mace like a witch riding on a broomstick.

Wham-Shell is one of the eight Skylanders without a Series 2 figure in Giants (the others being Voodood, Dino-Rang, Warnado, Boomer, Sunburn, Camo and Ghost Roaster). However, he and Warnado return in Swap Force as LightCore figures and Camo returns as a Series 2 in Swap Force as well.
In Giants, the spikes on Wham Shell's mace are red instead of gold.
He, Flashwing and Warnado are the only LightCore Skylanders without an additional counterpart as part of the Swap Force toyline.
As a LightCore figure, the head of his mace lights up when placed on the Portal of Power.
According to the Spyro's Adventure Sticker Book, Wham-Shell is the son of King Roland and is therefore the prince of said kingdom.
His exact ruling status is somewhat unclear at times however the majority of sources state that he is a prince and not a king.
It is said that Wham-Shell's mace can crack almost anything, even the shell of the legendary Sky Lobster.

Series 1 Wham Shell is the only non-variant character from Skylanders: Spyro's Adventure who was only released in a single-pack. All other characters from the game also appeared in 3-packs, starter packs, or adventure packs.

Wham-Shell and Crusher are the only Skylanders to change their "Need to Rest" animations between games. On the PS3, 360 and PC versions of Spyro's Adventure, Wham-Shell has a completely different death animation than on the Wii version and all subsequent games.
Gill Grunt was sent by Master Eon to recruit him to the Skylanders.

whirlwind.name: Whirlwind
whirlwind.description: Whirlwind is a blue unicorn dragon, Air Skylander from Skylanders: Spyro's Adventure. Her winter counterpart is called Polar Whirlwind, and her Series 3 counterpart is called Horn Blast Whirlwind.
whirlwind.biography: Whirlwind is an air dragon with unicorn ancestry – two species that could not be more opposite in nature, which made her never quite fit in with either group. Other dragons were envious of her beauty, while unicorns shunned her for her ability to fly. But Whirlwind found peace within the dark and stormy clouds, where she learned to harness the tempest power within her. Despite her turbulent youth, she was the first to defend both dragons and unicorns when the trolls began hunting them, unleashing her ferocity in a brilliant and powerful rainbow that could be seen throughout many regions of Skylands. From that day forward, evil-doers would quake when dark clouds brewed, and run from the rainbow that followed the storm.
whirlwind.personality: Whirlwind is as brave as she is graceful. Her mood swings can be as changeable as the weather, but since becoming a Skylander, she has tried to keep her temper in check. However, she doesn't keep a calm head when provoked. Whirlwind is strong-winged, wild and ferocious. But deep down, she is pure of heart, having held no grudge against the dragons and unicorns for shunning her.
whirlwind.gameplay: As a result of spending time within dark storm clouds, Whirlwind gained the ability to shoot rainbow energy from her horn, which can also be used to heal her allies. She can launch storm clouds at her enemies with a single clap of her wings. Being part dragon, Whirlwind has the ability to fly. Opting for the Ultimate Rainbower path further improves Whirlwind's 'Rainbow of Doom' attack, leaning to more offensive gameplay. The attack can be upgraded to launch a second rainbow, effectively extending the attack distance, and also deal more damage. The attack can also be charged up and then unleashed to create a 'Rainbow Singularity' black hole, sucking in enemies and leaving them susceptible to attacks. Opting for the Tempest Dragon path further improves Whirlwind's tempest clouds, leaning to more defensive gameplay. The attack can be upgraded to do more damage, but also unleash more rainbows when hit by one. With the 'Tempest Matrix' upgrade, Whirlwind can create lightning between the clouds, allowing her to create a barrier that electrocutes enemies and protects her from attackers. She holds the ability to enchant an object with her power, as evident when she empowered the Illuminator in Winter Keep. In Skylanders: Battlecast, Whirlwind also has the ability to conduct lightning through her horn to shock enemies and drain their health with a vortex or tornado. Her Special Ability is the Dragon's Wisdom, which raises the XP of her team, and her signature Gear is the Chromatic Bauble, which restores health to whichever ally is active.

trivia: Whirlwind was originally called Stormee.
Though she is a unicorn dragon hybrid, Whirlwind also has feathered wings like a Pegasus.
Prior to Skylanders: Imaginators, she was the only Skylander to be mentioned in a story chapter and a Story Scroll, as Winter Keep seems to be a level dedicated to the unicorn dragon Skylander.
Some people nickname her species a 'Unidragon'
While checking her stats in Giants, her typical animation shows her preening at her feathered wing.
Her early promotional title in her Toy Fair 2011 debut was called 'Tempest Dragon.'
Like Cynder, Echo, Spotlight and Flashwing, Whirlwind has no teeth.
Incidentally, they are all the only dragons Skylanders in the games who are female.
However Scratch is almost half dragon, and has visible fangs.

When Whirlwind revealed that one of her attacks was called the Rainbow of Doom, Flynn laughed, which proved to be a mistake when Whirlwind lashed out at him. Afterwards Flynn was back on his feet after just a few weeks, implying that Whirlwind went easier on him than she normally would have when angered.
Her catchphrase is a play on 'Fists of Fury.'
Despite her hatred for Trolls, Whirlwind is seen healing the troll Skylander Boomer in her Soul Gem upgrade picture, meaning she may only have a fondness of 'him', as he is the only good troll.
Whirlwind can also use her rainbow energy to heal her friends in battle.
She and Trail Blazer are the only two unicorn-based Skylanders.
Oddly enough, in the Tall Tales trailer for Giants, it implies that unicorns don't exist in Skylands, despite the fact that Whirlwind is part unicorn.
When shooting a rainbow once the Rainbow of Healing upgrade is purchased and as a Series 2 figure, Whirlwind's unicorn horn is colored yellow and pink.

When she obtains the Wow-Pow ability, Whirlwind's horn begins glowing in colors of the rainbow. This does not happen in Swap Force. However, there is a glitch where Horn Blast Whirlwind's horn will continue to glow in the colors of the rainbow after using a rainbow based attack, and if the Rainbow Singularity isn't charged all the way, then her horn will glow colorfully until it is fully charged and then shot.
The Tempest Matrix upgrade resembles the attacks of the Arkeyan Blasters from Spyro's Adventure.

whisper-elf.name: Whisper Elf
whisper-elf.description: Whisper Elf is a Life element Mini and Sidekick Skylander. She is the miniature version of Stealth Elf, eventually becoming a Mini Skylander in Skylanders: Trap Team.
whisper-elf.biography: Within the Skylands, a realm of infinite possibilities, there is in fact an alternate reality known as the Skylands Miniverse. Everything there is smaller, including the Skylanders. The Skylanders Sidekicks come from that Miniverse and have traveled to the Skylands to meet their regular-sized alter egos and tag along with them on adventures. The Skylander Minis started off as regular 'Sidekicks', assisting the Skylanders on many exciting adventures. And what they lacked in size they more than made up for in courage. Ultimately determined to become full-fledged heroes, they trained at the Skylands Academy - honing their powers and skills until they were ready. Now, they stand side by side with their full grown counterparts, ready to defend Skylands against Kaos and his evil minions.
whisper-elf.personality: Whisper Elf is a ninja who knows her way around an enchanted forest or two. Like her mentor Stealth Elf, she will always tell you how she's feeling. That can be really awkward sometimes.
whisper-elf.gameplay: Whisper Elf plays identically to Stealth Elf, utilizing high agility and rapid dagger strikes to overwhelm enemies. Her stealth ability allows her to safely navigate dangerous situations by leaving behind a decoy, while her acrobatic skills make her one of the quickest characters on the battlefield.

trivia: Whisper Elf reappears not only as a playable character in SuperChargers, but also in Super Shot Stealth Elf's Soul Gem ability, Health Elf.

wild-storm.name: Wild Storm
wild-storm.description: Wild Storm is a masked swordsman of an unknown species. He has ivory horns pointing sideways, on the sides of his head. His mask possesses the Air Element's emblem on his mask's 'forehead', between its metal eyes. His glowing white eyes are the only visible part of his face inside the mask. The armor covering his torso, arms and legs are black, with some golden decorations on his chest's armor. He wears pentagonal steel tassets, gauntlets and clawed boots, and his limbs are additionally protected by the strapped blue guards with golden edges, each made of three pentagonal plates. There is also some sort of a short cape made of blue feathers on his upper back and shoulders. Wild Storm's sword is very decorative; it possesses golden feather decorations and the Air symbol engraved on the blade's base. The turquoise blade splits into two tips, with the gap between them.
wild-storm.biography: By the time he was 10 years old, Wild Storm had already mastered the Air Blade. With no family of his own, he spent much of his youth traveling throughout Skylands, offering his combat services to the highest bidder as a soldier of fortune. On one such occasion, he was hired by Kaos to break into a pirate outpost in Skyhighlands to steal their legendary gold detector. But little did Wild Storm know, he was only being used by Kaos to scout their defenses – and he was captured by the pirates! While imprisoned in the highest tower, the powerful winds blew through his cell, fueling his anger. But Wild Storm would not be contained! Harnessing the storm's energy, he grew 3 times his size and exploded out of his prison – vowing to put a stop to Kaos once and for all. Soon after, he met Master Eon, who agreed to help him, provided Wild Storm would share his skills in swordsmanship with other Skylanders, as a Sensei of the Knight Class!
wild-storm.personality: Wild Storm is a disciplined and determined warrior who spent his youth as a soldier of fortune. Though initially motivated by payment, his betrayal by Kaos fueled a righteous anger and a vow to stop the villain. He is honorable enough to share his mastered skills in swordsmanship with others as a Sensei, showing a growth from a mercenary to a mentor.
wild-storm.gameplay: Wild Storm can use his blade both for melee attacks and throwing bolts of lightning. He is also skilled in hand-to-hand combat, using headbutts and a beast form to overpower foes close by. He can also create an uproar and breathe clouds into the battlefield, that can be electrified by his blade's lightning.

abilities.description: Your Uproar attack now covers a larger area. Enemies caught in the wind or clouds will be slowed down.

abilities.name: Release the Beast
abilities.description: Jump and press Attack 3 to transform into a wild beast. Press Attack 1 and Attack 2 to attack or Attack 3 to transform back to normal.

abilities.name: Unchained Lightning
abilities.description: Hold Special Attack to generate a destructive lightning storm with your sword! Run around to move the storm anywhere you wander.

abilities.name: Brute Edge
abilities.description: This new sword specializes and increases damage to any sword strike attacks.

abilities.name: Untamed Air
abilities.description: Using the Storm Strike attack in mid-air now causes bursts of air to knock enemies back.

abilities.name: Running Wild
abilities.description: Hold Attack 1 during your headbutt attack to dash further. You can steer your headbutt around to go after certain enemies.

abilities.name: Cut Loose
abilities.description: This new sword specializes and increases damage to any Lightning Bolt attacks.

abilities.name: Chain Lighting
abilities.description: Pressing Attack 2 will now split your Lightning Bolt attack into three bolts.

abilities.name: Electrical Storm
abilities.description: Hold Attack 2 to charge your Lightning Bolt attack. Release to fire a giant electrical storm.

trivia: During a Grind Challenge, Wild Storm runs on all fours like a quadrupedal animal instead of on his two feet.
While Wild Storm's face is never truly seen, the shape of his mask and his thick mane of blue fur give his head the appearance of the horned lion's.
Wild Storm's mask is also animated; its 'mouth' narrows and widens as he breathes. One could say he breathes through his mask's hole.

During his Uproar or his beast form, his white glowing eyes inside the mask disappear. Instead, the metal ones on its 'forehead' glow temporarily, until he stops roaring or returns to his normal form.
One of his quotes, 'The power is strong with this one' is a reference to the popular *Star Wars* franchise quote, 'The Force is strong with this one', used by several characters in the series.

Coincidentally, a number of Wild Storm's quotes happen to follow the object-subject-verb pattern, a pattern that Master Yoda, one of the most prominent figures of the *Star Wars* franchise, uses very often when speaking.

Wild Storm shares some similarities with Wildfire. Both have the word 'Wild' in their name, both have many lion-like features, both can channel their element through roaring, and both are traditionally bipedal but move around on all-fours in certain circumstances. They also both have a Soul Gem with a new form.
Wild Storm also shares some similarities with Pop Fizz, most notably, they are blue-furred creatures that can transform into a more beastly and aggressive version of themselves.
Coincidentally, in *Ring of Heroes*, both Wild Storm and Pop Fizz have two different ability sets, one while they’re their normal selves, and another when transformed into their beast forms.
Wild Storm bears multiple similarities to Tetrax Shard from the *Ben 10* series.
They both mentor younger heroes.
Both have pasts as soldiers of fortune or mercenaries, but stopped doing so after the main villains of their series (Kaos and Vilgax, respectively), hired them but then betrayed them.
He is the only Air Sensei without an alt deco.
Wild Storm is voiced by Keston John, who would later be known for voicing Hordak in the 2018 reboot of *She-Ra and the Princesses of Power* and Darius Deamonne from *The Owl House*.
According to John, Wildstorm was called 'Atmosfear' during development.
He is one of the most expensive Senseis on the secondhand market, the others being Ro-Bow and Chompy Mage.

wildfire.name: Wildfire
wildfire.description: Wildfire is a golden lion who is one of the Trap Masters in Skylanders: Trap Team. He is of the Fire element.
wildfire.biography: Wildfire was once a young lion of the Fire Claw Clan, about to enter into the Rite of Infernos – a test of survival in the treacherous fire plains. However, because he was made of gold, he was treated as an outcast and not allowed to participate. But this didn’t stop him. That night, Wildfire secretly followed the path of the other lions, carrying only his father’s enchanted shield. Soon he found them cornered by a giant flame scorpion. Using the shield, he protected the group from the beast’s enormous stinging tail, giving them time to safely escape. And though Wildfire was injured in the fight, his father’s shield magically changed him – magnifying the strength that was already in his heart – making him the mightiest of his clan. Now part of the Trap Team, Wildfire uses his enormous Traptanium-bonded shield to defend any and all who need it!
wildfire.personality: Wildfire is a loyal lion with a heart of gold, but he can be fierce in battle. He's very protective of the Fire Claw Clan and is always ready to lend them a magical hand when they need it.
wildfire.gameplay: Using his father's Traptanium shield, Wildfire can use it as defense, protecting himself even from the Golden Queen's magic and burning enemies that approach, or as offense, bashing enemies with it. Wildfire can also summon chains of fire that pull enemies closer and breathe fire with a mighty roar, and temporarily destroy his shield to assume a quadruped stance for melee attacks.

abilities.name: Traptainium Shield Bash
abilities.description: Press Attack 1 for a single shield bash. Press Attack 1, Attack 1 and Attack 1, Attack 1, Attack 1 for Shield Bash combos.

abilities.name: Chains of Fire
abilities.description: Summon Chains of Fire that not only burn but also pull enemies closer.

abilities.name: Heat Shield
abilities.description: Hold Attack 1 to use the Heat Shield for protection and damage to nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Extra Chains
abilities.description: Chains of Fire now pull four enemies at once.

abilities.name: Fire Roar
abilities.description: Unleash a Fire Roar attack.

abilities.name: Hotter Heat Shield.
abilities.description: Heat Shield now burns brighter and does extra damage.

abilities.name: Lion Form
abilities.description: Hold Attack 1 to enter Heat Shield Mode, then press Attack 1 again to transform into a wild, Fire Lion.

abilities.name: Burning Bash
abilities.description: Press Attack 1, Attack 1 and Attack 2 for a Heat Wave combo.

abilities.name: Fire Spin
abilities.description: Press Attack 1, Attack 1 and Attack 3 for a Fire Spin combo.

abilities.name: Searing Slam
abilities.description: Press Attack 1 in the air for a Searing Slam attack.

abilities.name: Lots of Chains
abilities.description: Chains of Fire can now pull five enemies at once.

abilities.name: Blazing Breath
abilities.description: Fire Roar has longer range and does extra damage.

abilities.name: No Escape!
abilities.description: Chains of Fire has a wider area of effect and can pull 5 enemies at once.

trivia: Wildfire is one of the few Skylanders who are felines (the others are Freeze Blade, Trap Shadow, Scratch, Tuff Luck and Mysticat).
He is the second Trap Master capable of becoming a quadruped after his Soul Gem ability, 'Lion Form', is purchased, the first being Knight Mare.
Being made entirely out of gold, Wildfire's footsteps are metallic.
Wildfire's voice sounded much like that of Eruptor, who Keythe Fairly also voiced since Skylanders: Giants. Coincidentally, they are both Fire Skylanders.
He bears a slight resemblance and is similar to Lionizer from Power Rangers In Space. Both are bipedal, golden lions. Both wield weapons relating to fire.
He, Fire Kraken and Spitfire are the only Skylanders to have 'Fire' (their element) in their names.

Wildfire shares some similarities with Wild Storm. Both have the word 'Wild' in their name, both have many lion-like features, both can channel their element through roaring, and both are traditionally bipedal but move around on all-fours in certain circumstances.

wind-up.name: Wind-Up
wind-up.description: Wind-Up is a wind-up robot who is one of the Tech core Skylanders in Skylanders: Swap Force. He is available in the Sheep Wreck Island Adventure pack. A single pack was offered at Gamestop in the US with pre-orders for Skylanders: Trap Team.
wind-up.biography: Built in the enchanted workshop of a toymaker obsessed with time, Wind-Up was created to help keep his massive collection of complicated clocks working perfectly. But when the toymaker popped out of existence in a freak accident caused by putting hot cocoa in a cross-wired Arkeyan oven, Wind-Up found himself surrounded by an invading Cyclops platoon - with an eye towards claiming the toymaker's secrets for themselves. Using split-second timing, clockwork strategy, and his totally wound up energy, Wind-Up bravely sprang into action and handily defeated the Cyclops. He later joined the Skylanders to help swing the pendulum the other way in their fight against anything that threatens Skylands.
wind-up.personality: Wind-Up is always on time. Bursting with coiled-up energy, he's also always ready to spring into action.
wind-up.gameplay: Skylanders can use abilities depending on their level. Starting Powers: Spark Punch (Primary Attack): Press (Y) to perform meelee punch. When the character is wound up, this creates an extra spark that does more damage. Wind up by holding (A). Gear Summon (Secondary Attack): Press (X) to summon a gear under enemies that will damage them. When wound up, gears will do more damage and throw enemies into the air. Wind up by holding (A). Upgrades: Boxing Glove (requires level: 3): Hold and release (Y) to attack with a giant boxing glove. When the character is wound up, this does more damage and has a large knockback. Wind up by holding (A). Wacky Wind (requires level: 6): While sprinting (A), Wind-Up will spin his top half around, damaging enemies that come too close. 3DSupgrade3 (requires level: 9): 3DSupgrade3desc

abilities.name: Short Circuit
abilities.description: Press Attack 1 to attack nearby enemies with sparking claws.

abilities.name: Wind Up!
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 to wind up and damage nearby enemies. Winding up is needed to perform more powerful attacks.

abilities.name: Overcrank Stabilizer
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 to rapidly fill the wind up meter. When full, press Attack 2 again to overcrank. During overcrank press Attack 1 to cause a large explosion that damages nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Winding Weapon
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 to wind up, dealing increased damage and pulling enemies in.

abilities.name: Spring Shot
abilities.description: Press Attack 3 to shoot a spring shot that launches enemies into the air. Attacking launched enemies will deal automatic critical damage!

abilities.name: Power Pistons
abilities.description: Press Attack 1 to deal increased punching damage.

abilities.name: Spring-Loaded Crank
abilities.description: Speed is increased. Automatically wind up while running.

abilities.name: Cymbals
abilities.description: Hold Attack 1 to charge a cymbal attack, release to attack all enemies in the way with a pair of cymbals.

abilities.name: Crash Cymbals
abilities.description: Cymbal attacks do increased damage. An easy way to crash any party!

abilities.name: Toy Gun
abilities.description: Hold Attack 3 to shoot rapid fire suction cup projectiles at enemies.

abilities.name: Windup Punch
abilities.description: Hold Attack 1 to charge a boxing glove punch, release to deliver a massive punch to enemies.

abilities.name: Auto Wind Up
abilities.description: Taking damage automatically adds to winding up.

abilities.name: Power Crank
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 rapidly to begin overcranking which now pulls enemies in and deals bonus damage.

trivia: Wind-Up's voice actor, Bob Bergen, is best known for recreating the voice of Porky Pig from the Looney Tunes Show.
Whenever Wind-Up wears a hat, it constantly spins around. This might possibly be because of the wind-up key on his head.
He, Bouncer, Magna Charge, Drill Sergeant, Jawbreaker, Gearshift, and Ro-Bow are the only seven Tech Skylanders to be fully robotic.
However, he is the first one with an organic voice instead of a mechanical type.
He, Jawbreaker, Gearshift and Ro-Bow each have two legs instead of wheels for feet.
His Soul Gem Spring-Loaded Crank adds +15 to speed in Swap Force.
Whichever upgrade path Wind-Up chooses, his original turn key changes into a gyroscope with two gears in it.
He is the only Skylander to be a toy both in game and figure.
Wind-Up's official catchphrase sounds similar to Spyro's ('All Fired Up!'). This also applies to Gearshift ('All Geared Up!').
Wind-Up was one of the many Skylanders planned to appear in Skylanders: Ring of Heroes. Before the game's closure, only concept art of his Awakened Form was released.
In Swap Force, Wind-Up will automatically turn to keep facing nearby enemies.

winterfest-lob-star.name: Winterfest Lob-Star
winterfest-lob-star.description: Winterfest Lob-Star is the Christmas counterpart of Lob-Star in Skylanders: Trap Team.
winterfest-lob-star.biography: Winter is here and the Skylanders are gearing up for the Great Annual Winterfest! Every year, the citizens of Skylands come together to celebrate the holiday season by participating in the most popular seasonal events including Sheep Skating, Bobbing for Chompies, and Angry Yeti Tipping. This year, Lob-Star plans on leveraging his legendary culinary skills to take home the coveted first place trophy in the Costume Baking Competition – with his licorice flavored suit and candy-coated frosted beard!
winterfest-lob-star.personality: Winterfest Lob-Star is as disciplined and focused as any master chef, bringing a culinary precision to his combat style. He is festive yet fierce, always ready to defend Skylands during the holidays with the same passion he uses in the kitchen.
winterfest-lob-star.gameplay: As a Trap Master, Winterfest Lob-Star uses his Traptanium Throwing Stars to deal massive damage to enemies and can open Water Elemental Gates. His secondary attack, Boiling Temper, allows him to heat up the water around him to create a steam-based area of effect attack.

abilities.name: Starshooter
abilities.description: Throws Traptanium throwing stars at enemies.

abilities.name: Boiling Temper
abilities.description: Lob-Star heats up the water around him to damage nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Lob-Star Roll
abilities.description: Perform a dash attack through enemies.

abilities.name: Pressure Cooker
abilities.description: Charging Starshooter increases the speed and damage of the stars.

abilities.name: Super Stars
abilities.description: Throw more stars at once.

trivia: He, Merry Snap Shot, Holiday Wash Buckler, Jolly Bumble Blast, Missile-Tow Dive-Clops and Jingle Bell Chompy Mage are the only Christmas Skylanders.
Coincidentally, He and Merry Snap Shot are Christmas counterparts of Water Trap Masters.
Unlike his original counterpart, he turns gold whenever he uses Boiling Temper. But in Skylanders: SuperChargers, he doesn't and only appears to be glowing red instead.
He is the first variant to get a Power Play video segment.

wolfgang.name: Wolfgang
wolfgang.description: Wolfgang is a werewolf guitarist who is one of the Undead playable villains in Skylanders: Trap Team. He is a former member of a group of notorious villains called the Doom Raiders.
wolfgang.biography: Wolfgang wasn't always a werewolf. He was once a handsome, brilliant musician set to marry a beautiful princess. Before the wedding, he planned to unveil his ultimate symphony to the greatest music aficionados in Skylands, convinced they would love it and instantly hail him as the best composer of all time. But they didn't. They hated it – and even worse, it actually physically hurt when heard. Turns out Wolfgang had unintentionally discovered the musical note for pain. Being shunned like this drove Wolfgang utterly and completely mad, physically transforming him into the werewolf he is today. With the princess no longer wanting to marry him, he turned to a life of crime, terrorizing the royal subjects and using his evil music as a weapon. The Golden Queen took note of this and realized that Wolfgang could make a powerful ally, if she could control his rage and keep him in line. And that's a pretty big 'if!'.
wolfgang.personality: Wolfgang takes joy in terrorizing civilians with his ferocity and evil music. When irritated, he won't hesitate in challenging the authority of those stronger than him. He has a short fuse, but seems to care for his fellow Doom Raiders, referring to them at one point as his 'pack' when a few of them were captured by the Skylanders. Despite his aggressive behavior, he is said to be optimistic of being rewarded for his music even when people don't appreciate the cacophony and flee in terror. He is a werewolf that can make even other werewolves run in fear. His wish to be recognized as a musician was the tipping point for him to turn over a new leaf. After his rehabilitation, Wolfgang is still somewhat agitated and aggressive in battle, but now towards those on the side of evil.
wolfgang.gameplay: Playing his bone harp, Wolfgang is able to release evil music as a means of bringing harm. He also uses the sharp blade on the harp as a melee weapon, and can slide into enemies. In Skylanders: Battlecast, he has the Special Ability to perform a Siren's Song which lures in the weakest enemy, and manipulate his damaging songs to attack several enemies at once. His Gear is the Reverb Pedal, which copies the last non-character spell cast. In Imaginators, Wolfgang's harp has been slightly modified, replacing the melee attack with bone arrows that play notes while they are shot. He can also summon speakers that play deadly music in a straight line, and use his knee slide attack much faster.

abilities.name: Strike a Chord
abilities.description: Press Attack 1 to shoot musical arrows at enemies.

abilities.name: Knee Slide
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 to knock your enemies back with a Knee Slide!

abilities.name: Song of the Underworld
abilities.description: Press Attack 3 to summon speakers so loud they'll blast your enemies away!

abilities.name: Ultrasonic Supercharge
abilities.description: Hold Attack 1 to shoot a supercharged ultrasonic arrow.

abilities.name: Now in Stereo
abilities.description: Songs of the Underworld can now make one more set of speakers and lasts longer.

abilities.name: Power Chord
abilities.description: Blast enemies around you with your notes at the end of a Knee Slide.

abilities.name: Rock Concert
abilities.description: Press Attack 3 during a jump to please a crowd of enemies with stunning music.

abilities.name: Crowd Surfer
abilities.description: The ultimate Sensei attack! Hold Special Attack to perform your Sky-Chi Power! Use Left Stick to crowd surf through your foes!

abilities.name: Lay Some Tracks
abilities.description: Knee Slide now leaves reels of recording tape behind that will damage and slow enemies.

abilities.name: Song Stuck in my Head
abilities.description: Arrows make enemies take damage over time.

abilities.name: Amp it Up
abilities.description: Speakers shoot arrows when you do.

abilities.name: Surround Sound
abilities.description: Create a musical barrier as the end of a Knee Slide that keeps enemies away.

abilities.name: Encore
abilities.description: Strike a Chord shoots multiple arrows while inside a musical barrier.

abilities.name: Grand Finale
abilities.description: Blow up your speakers by exiting the musical barrier with a Knee Slide.

trivia: His creation, the Big Bad Woofer, is a reference to the Big Bad Wolf, a character from a few fabled stories like Little Red Riding Hood and The Three Little Pigs.

Despite being a rock star, Wolfgang's name is based off of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart, who was a composer during the Classical period of music, or in other words, made classical music. His name could also be based off of Wolfgang Van Halen, son of Eddie Van Halen, guitarist for American rock band Van Halen.

Wolfgang speaks with a British accent along with Bomb Shell, Brawl & Chain and Nightshade. However, the fact that Wolfgang is a rock star with a English accent may make him be inspired by a British rock band, who is also called Wolf Gang.
Wolfgang's black eye makeup is very much like Kaos'.
Wolfgang is one of the few playable characters to use a musical instrument as a weapon (the others being Cobra Cadabra, Fiesta, and Turbo Charge Donkey Kong).
He is one of the few playable canines in Skylanders (other examples are Hot Dog, Funny Bone and Slobber Trap).
Among the Doom Raiders, Wolfgang was the most vocal in questioning the actions of their leader.
Although he says "...there will be no encore!" when he battles the Skylanders, during his capture he contradicts this by saying "Stick around for the encoooooorrree!"
His bone harp was hand-carved by him, though he also masters the piano, trombone and banjo, and is known to attempt being a one-man band on his off hours.

In Skylanders: Imaginators, Wolfgang has a twin brother named Sal, who holds animosity towards him. Though there is special dialogue for Crash and Dr. Neo Cortex in Thumpin' Wumpa Islands, Wolfgang does not have any special dialogue when speaking to Sal, despite their relationship. Wolfgang's backstory mentions that he only transformed into a werewolf after the incident at his wedding. However, it is never explained why Sal also transformed into a werewolf.
He, King Pen, Golden Queen, Chompy Mage, and Crash Bandicoot are the only members of the Senseis who appear in Skylanders Academy.
His quote/catchphrase from Trap Team/Imaginators, 'Let There Be Rock!', is a reference to the AC/DC song of the same name.
Wolfgang was once Chopscotch's favorite musical idol. After becoming a Sensei, it is unknown if Chopscotch regained any admiration for him after Wolfgang became a Sensei.
His use of his harp as a melee weapon is a pun on guitars being nicknamed as axes.

woodenem.name: Woodenem
woodenem.description: Woodenem is a scrapped Skylander during the development of Skylanders: Spyro's Adventure. Only a piece of his concept design was released.
woodenem.biography: Woodenem was an early character concept for the first Skylanders game. He was ultimately cut before production, though visual elements of his design likely inspired the creation of the character Stump Smash and the design of the Stump Demon enemies.
woodenem.personality: As a scrapped character, Woodenem has no official personality profile or backstory.
woodenem.gameplay: As he was scrapped during development, Woodenem has no playable gameplay mechanics or moveset.
trivia: He bears a resemblance to the Skylander Stump Smash and the enemy Stump Demon.
Some of Arbo's rejected designs look similar to Woodenem.

wrecking-ball.name: Wrecking Ball
appearances: Stump Smash Crosses the Bone Dragon
wrecking-ball.description: Wrecking Ball is a grub worm Skylander in Skylanders: Spyro's Adventure. He is in the Magic element.
wrecking-ball.biography: Wrecking Ball was once a tiny grub worm about to become the main ingredient in an old wizard's cauldron of magic stew. But when he was dropped in, the wizard was shocked to see the little grub devour all of the soup and emerge from the cauldron 20 times larger and with a long, sticky tongue. The poor old wizard was even more surprised seconds later, when Wrecking Ball proceeded to swallow him whole. Eventually he ran, quite literally, into the powerful Portal Master Eon, who was intrigued by how he came to be and impressed with his unique abilities.
wrecking-ball.personality: Possibly the most reckless of all the Skylanders, Wrecking Ball rolls into danger without thought for his own personal safety. This lively larva smashes anything in his path (often) by accident, and is always hungry, even when he's just eaten! In some media, he possesses dog-like qualities.
wrecking-ball.gameplay: Having consumed an entire cauldron of magic stew, its effects not only made Wrecking Ball grow 20 times his normal size and enhanced him with magical energy, but also gave him a long, sticky tongue which he uses to lash at his enemies. He can also curl into a ball and steamroll into his enemies using the magical energy he uses as a protective forcefield. This is a charged attack in home console games, but he can freely switch into the ball in the Nintendo 3DS games without charging it. Wrecking Ball can also let loose out a burp of gas from his mouth to blow enemies away, and can also devour his enemies to regain health if he has gained his Soul Gem ability.

abilities.name: Tongue Whap
abilities.description: Wrecking Ball slaps enemies with his super-tongue. Damage = 8. Crit = 12.

abilities.name: Forcefield Ball
abilities.description: Summon magic for a spin forcefield charge.

abilities.name: Magic Ball Control
abilities.description: Forcefield Ball can be controlled and it does increased damage. Damage = 44. Crit = 66.

abilities.name: Power Belch
abilities.description: Releases a burp attack that has increased range after eating something. Damage = 30-60. Crit = 45-90.

abilities.name: Tongue Evolution
abilities.description: Your Tongue Whap grows longer and does increased damage. Damage = 11. Crit = 16.5.

abilities.name: Digestive Detonation
abilities.description: Charge up your Burp attack. Damage = 40. Crit = 60.

abilities.name: Enemy Slurp
abilities.description: Wrecking Ball can swallow smaller enemies and regains 10 health when he does so.

abilities.name: Disco Ball
abilities.description: Press Attack 2 to turn Wrecking Ball's Force Field into a magical disco ball.

abilities.name: Lightning Tongue
abilities.description: Your Tongue Whap can attack quicker than ever.

abilities.name: Tongue Grabber
abilities.description: Tongue Whap does extra damage and can pick up food and power-ups. Damage = 15. Crit = 22.5.

abilities.name: Tongue Supermax
abilities.description: Your Tongue grows even longer.

abilities.name: Forcefield Blast
abilities.description: While in your Forcefield Ball, create a Forcefield explosion. Damage = 20. Crit = 30.

abilities.name: Swath of Terror
abilities.description: The Forcefield Ball is larger and does even more increased damage. Damage = 61. Crit = 91.5.

abilities.name: It's Gotta Go Somewhere
abilities.description: While in your Forcefield Ball, create a more powerful burp attack. Damage = 60. Crit = 90.

trivia: His Series 1 figure is off, model and only has 8 spikes. It's missing two of the ten yellow spikes on his body. This inconsistency was corrected in his Series 2 figure.
Series 2 Wrecking Ball's artwork can be seen in the Season 1 intro of the Skylanders Academy TV series within the Book of Skylanders.
His Series 2 figure's Wow Pow gives him two long tusks sticking out from his lower lip, and a disco ball forcefield round his body while rolling.
His missing teeth is the price all good grubs pay for eagerness in battle.
He is so energetic, he never stands still and constantly bounces from one leg to the other.
Wrecking Ball reminded Master Eon of his favorite childhood pet. The old Portal Master was also the one who named Wrecking Ball after the grub worm wrecked a few of Eon's statues.

Since Jawbreakers seem to be affected by moves that don't work on large enemies, Wrecking Ball is able to eat them. When he eats Brute, the cutscene with him still plays, but Wrecking Ball will get 10+ health.

If you eat an enemy or food item before using his regular Power Belch, the burp will have increased range and do more damage. If he eats two enemies or food items the burp will become red and it does more damage than the long-range green burp.

When Wrecking Ball eats the Armored Chompies, they don't lose any health even though Wrecking Ball gains 10+ health. Wrecking Ball can get an extra 10+ health by finishing it off. When Wrecking Ball eats the Armored Cyclopses, they will sink to the ground and die, making Wrecking Ball the only Skylander who can actually take out the Armored Cyclopses with a single hit.
In games after Spyro's Adventure, the length of his Forcefield Ball attack has been considerably decreased.
He's one of the playable characters that can eat their enemies. The others are Gusto, Thumpback, Thumpling, Slobber Tooth, and The Gulper.
Once his Soul Gem ability has been obtained, Wrecking Ball can eat treasure in Spyro's Adventure to gain +10 health.
In Swap Force, Superchargers, and Imaginators, there is a mistake in Wrecking Ball’s Digestive Detonation upgrade image where the image for his Tongue Whap ability can be seen in the top-left corner.

There are miscellaneous changes to the Force Field Ball in the Alchemy front-end games. The inputs for Forcefield Blast and It’s Gotta Go Somewhere are changed, resulting in the button used for burping not performing a burp-related attack, and the button to create the ball isn’t used to cancel out of it.

Wrecking Ball can eat the Molekin miners in Molekin Mine. Once they are eaten, these miners can only be collected by the player walking into the space where they used to be. Even the cowering Diggs model that appears near the end of the level can be consumed this way. Wrecking Ball can eat various collectible items throughout Spyro's Adventure in a similar manner, including the statues in Leviathan Lagoon and the security key card in Arkeyan Armory. Wrecking Ball can eat the clams that appear in the Ruins during Spyro's Adventure's story mode, although this will cause them to disappear and remain uncollectable until the Ruins is reloaded.
He's named after a a big heavy metal round object on a crane usually used to destroy old concrete buildings and rubble.
This name is also the name of a popular song by 'Miley Cyrus'.

zap.name: Zap
appearances: Gill Grunt and the Curse of the Fish Master
Trigger Happy Targets the Evil Kaos
zap.description: Zap is a water dragon Core Skylander who first appeared in Skylanders: Spyro's Adventure. He is available in the Scorpion Striker Battle Pack.
zap.biography: Zap was born into the royal family of water dragons, but a riptide washed him to a distant sea, where he was raised by electric eels. Growing up, he excelled in everything and even created a special gold harness that allows him to carry an endless electrical charge and shock things at a great distance. Zap also proved to be a gifted racer, outstripping any opponent... with the possible exception of the dolphins. With them, it became a good natured challenge to see who could keep up with Zap. But an electric current in his wake often reminded them who they were dealing with. Despite his mischievous streak, Zap grew to be a true protector of the seas and Skylands.
zap.personality: Zap is a friendly and mischievous water dragon, being revered by most of the sea creatures of Skylands who see him as a true dedicated guardian of both the seas and Skylands. He enjoys racing, being able to outstrip almost any opponent, and excels at everything he turns his claws to. Naturally curious and super-competitive, Zap is also a bit of a prankster, loving to shock his fellow Skylanders whenever he gets a chance. However, he can be too curious for his own good and has a nose (or snout) for trouble, which can lead him and his fellow Skylanders into dangerous situations.
zap.gameplay: Using his special golden harness he created as a child to mimic the electrifying power of his adopted parents, Zap can breathe bursts of electricity and spew electrical surges of water at his enemies. He can also leave a trail of slimy water behind him to slow down (and when hit by a spark, electrify) foes. Once upgraded enough, he can summon and ride a wave, if you do not travel with it then the wave goes off by itself, but still damages foes.

abilities.name: Lightning Breath
abilities.description: Zap spits out pure electricity.

abilities.name: Sea Slime Slide
abilities.description: Zap slides on a trail of sea slime that enemies will become stuck in.

abilities.name: Electro-Slime
abilities.description: Sea Slime can be electrified by Zap's Lightning Breath.

abilities.name: Stay Awhile
abilities.description: Zap's Sea Slime stays electrified much longer.

abilities.name: MegaVolt
abilities.description: Lightning Breath does more increased damage.

abilities.name: Wave Rider
abilities.description: Zap can summon (and ride) a great wave that washes away enemies.

abilities.name: Love for the Sea
