trivia: Zap is one of the seven dragon Skylanders who cannot fly. The other four are Bash, Camo, Fire Kraken, Echo, Flashwing, and Sunburn (the latter two are shown to fly outside of the game).
When Zap speaks, his voice is gurgley as if he has water in his mouth.
His toy form has a bigger splash in the pedestal, unlike other Water Skylanders to contain his four-legged frame.
His previous incarnation, Tarclops, appears as a hat in Trap Team under the name "Gloop Hat".
If Zap hadn't been washed out to sea by a riptide away from home, he would almost certainly have grown up to be king of the High Water Royal Dragon Family.
In Skylanders: Giants, his voice is much squeakier compared to his dialogue in Spyro's Adventure.
Zap is voiced by Jeff Bergman, who is also very notable for voicing the modern Looney Tunes characters like Bugs Bunny, Daffy Duck, Tweety, Sylvester, etc.

He and Stump Smash can regain health in water with their Soul Gem abilities. Because Swap Force has excluded the ability to swim, Zap, Stump Smash and Double Trouble's soul gems have changed. In Skylanders Imaginators, however, he regenerates health in the Sensei Water Realm.
During development, Zap was originally going to be without his electric gold harness. He would have had a longer snout, and his scales were paler.
Despite being a water dragon, Zap bears more of a resemblance to an amphibian than a reptile. Also, he is currently the only dragon without claws.
His catchphrase, "Ride the Lightning", is also the name of Metallica's second studio album, and the second track of said album.
Zap, Slam Bam, Echo and the Sensei version of Grave Clobber are the only four Water Skylanders who don't have weapons.
Out of every Skylander, Zap, Bop and Hex have the shortest names.
He and Echo share the same species and element, but differ in appearances and abilities.

Zap's Series 2 Wow Pow, "For Riley" was made as a dedication to Riley Van Zyl, a four-year old boy and Skylanders fan who passed from a rare form of cancer in May 2012. Riley's favorite character in the series was Zap, and the upgrade was named in his memory. The area in Drill-X's Big Rig, Riley's Tube was also named after Riley.
He and Camo are the only two dragon Skylanders included in battle packs (Scorpion Striker and Arkeyan Crossbow). Coincidentally, both of their figures were Series 2s.
In Goo Factory, Zap leaves unique footprints with froglike toes.
Zap's Series 2 figure is the only Skylander released in Giants not to have a single pack release in any form. He was only included in the Scorpion Striker Battle Pack.

zoo-lou.name: Zoo Lou
zoo-lou.description: Zoo Lou is a white bear-like shaman who is one of the Life Core Skylanders that was released alongside Skylanders: Swap Force.
zoo-lou.biography: Descended from a long line of shamans, Zoo Lou traveled far and wide to the Seven Strange Strongholds – ancient, mysterious sites of great wonder in Skylands – where he studied the wisdom and fighting styles of the Seven Strange Mages. After many years of traveling and studying, Zoo Lou returned to find an army of trolls had invaded his sacred homeland to mine its natural magic resources. Zoo Lou's warrior heart burned with fury. And having now mastered the enchanted art of communicating with nature and summoning animals, he unleashed his great mojo – attacking the trolls and single handedly freeing his lands once again. It was this heroic feat that caught the eye of Double Trouble, who then brought Zoo Lou to Master Eon and the Skylanders.
zoo-lou.personality: A wild and wooly warrior, Zoo Lou doesn't suffer fools gladly. He also is most likely to talk to animals, plants, and sometimes a pebble or two.
zoo-lou.gameplay: Zoo Lou is able to summon three different animal spirits to help him in battle. The first animal spirit is a ghostly eagle that swoops down on enemies before disappearing. The second animal spirit he can summon is a wolf that can attack enemies, and will disappear after a while. The third animal spirit is a Boghog that Zoo Lou can ride, and trample enemies with. However, the Boghog is not usable as a speed boosting mount, as it moves at a very slow pace while being ridden. He can still summon his eagles and wolf while riding a Boghog, but the Boghog can't be summoned again for a short while after being summoned.

trivia: Zoo Lou's name is a play on Zulu and Lou Studdert, Activision's Production Coordinator for Skylanders.
His mystical weapon slightly resembles the Green Lantern Corps' abilities to create things out of green light.
His weapon looks similar in material to the weapons wielded by Trap Masters.
He speaks with an African accent.
If Zoo Lou chooses 'The Wild Wolf', the spirit wolf becomes black with glowing green outlines. It will also dig up food if he's low on health.
On his artwork, the spirit birds face looks like Free Ranger, only without the crest.
He, Double Trouble, Sonic Boom, and Sprocket are currently the only four Skylanders that can summon an ally as their secondary ability.
He is the only Life Skylander on the 3DS to glide.
He is similar to Banjo from Banjo-Kazooie. They are both bears who attack with the help of birds.
Zoo Lou doesn't jump high as the rest of the Skylanders.
Zoo Lou's catchphrase, 'Nature Calls!', is a reference to the phrase people say when they need to use the restroom.
He also shares his catchphrase with Tree Rex for one of his battle cries.

zook.name: Zook
zook.description: Zook is a Bambazooker who is a Life Core Skylander from Skylanders: Spyro's Adventure.
zook.biography: Zook hails from a strange and unusual species called Bambazookers, who once lived their entire lives standing in place... until Zook discovered they could walk simply by stepping out of the mud. After that, he became a wandering hero, using his hand-carved bamboo tube as a bazooka that fires special explosive thorns. Campfire songs were even written about him. Now, Zook spends his time as a Skylander, figuring he can be an even bigger hero... and have even more songs written about him.
zook.personality: Zook is the cheeriest walking bamboo plant you will ever meet. He lives life to the fullest and wants to explore every last one of Skylands' many islands.
zook.gameplay: Zook can fire explosive thorns from his bamboo tube, which not only serves as a bazooka, but can be used as a a dijiridoo, a telescope, and other things. He can also summon a barricade of various plants or fungus to protect himself.

trivia: His original catchphrase was "Bamboo-Yah!" Strangely, Zook's catchphrase is still shown as "Bamboo-Yah!" on his toy packaging. However, in-game, his real catchphrase is now "Locked and Loaded!". It can be assumed his catchphrase was changed to "Locked and Loaded!" very late in development, or maybe the catchphrase was changed to "Bamboo-Yah!", too late during development, and failed to cement itself as Zook's catchphrase.
Zook and Tuff Luck are the only Skylanders known to have their catchphrases changed. Coincidentally, both are of the Life element.
His species' name is a combination of the words bamboo and bazooka.
In the Skylander commercial 'Blow it Up!', Zook speaks with an Australian accent, while in the game, he speaks with a Jamaican accent.
In the Skylanders: Cloud Patrol game, his story adds in he would prefer a nice haiku instead of a campfire song if he had a choice. Zook is said to be the subject of several popular campfire songs.
Series 2 Zook has the Old Growth Bazooka upgrade, giving him leaves on his bazooka.
He is voiced by Fred Tatasciore, who also voiced the Witch Doctor in the LEGO Hero Factory movie 'Savage Planet', who also has the same guttural Jamaican accent.
Tatasciore also voices Slam Bam, Snap Shot, Cuckoo Clocker, Krankenstein, and Cross Crow.
He, Bumble Blast, and Food Fight are currently the only Life Skylanders who wield plant-like firearms.
